job.title: Site Security Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As a Site Security Manager reporting directly to the Building Services Manager you will work closely with the rest of the Operations team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Supervise the security and soft services aspects of the data centre facility operations for assigned properties
  • Manage 3rd party security staff’s performance to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and any other requirements to deliver AirTrunk’s maintenance and compliance programs
  • Oversee maintenance and upgrades on the site security network

Your Day to Day

  • First point of contact for all visitors, responsible for the efficient processing of visitors, contractors, clients and AirTrunk staff into the facility as well as any other front of house requests
  • Conduct regular property inspections focusing on security and EHS
  • Ensure all aspects of data centre security systems are in line with AirTrunk’s policies
  • General administrative duties, such as producing reports, providing evidence for audit, and tracking time and attendance of staff
  • Coordination with Site FM team leads on security, access, and maintenance requirements
  • Ensure new security staff and security vendors are trained and qualified
  • Assist in the delivery of various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, ISO 27001 and SOC 2
  • Support the Critical Environments team in the management of physical security incidents at the property
  • Develop emergency response plans and conduct drills
  • Coordinate staff when responding to emergencies and alarms
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant security regulations and standards
  • Support Building Service Manager in soft services

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experiences and 2+ years of experience in a people management role, ideally in a physical security or operations environment
  • Data centre or mission critical background is a plus
  • Successfully managed audit and ideally experience with managing 3rd party vendors and customers
  • Security License and First Aid Certificate holder or meet requirements to acquire these
  • Experience in reporting and emergency response planning
  • Ability to comprehend, analyse and interpret operational documents
  • Can establish and review incident reports, emergency event summaries, root cause analysis reports and O&M manuals
  • Proficient in computer systems, ideally with experience in CCTV and/or EACS systems (such as Genetec or Lenel)
  • Registered as Fire Safety Officer

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer - Java Backend - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Product Software team at Equinix builds next-generation software products and architecture for our product software and services offerings. We are seeking engineers to serve as a technical pillar for the organization. In this role, you will not only design and develop product software application but also define the architectural standards for consistent APIs and event-driven microservices. You will act as a bridge between product vision and technical execution, collaborating with engineering leaders and product managers to abstract complex enterprise workflows into scalable, resilient systems. Thus, a commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, product quality and secure code is essential

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Contribute to the technical strategy and execution for modular, event-driven, and scalable microservices supporting enterprise workflows
  • Design and implement reusable frameworks and self-service modules for service onboarding, configuration, and lifecycle management
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate software design, testing, and operations - e.g., AI-assisted code reviews, test generation, and root cause analysis
  • Collaborate with senior architects and cross-functional teams on architecture decisions
  • Promote design practices that improve maintainability, observability, and operational excellence

Engineering Excellence

  • Lead by example—building secure, reliable, and observable systems that meet performance and scalability goals
  • Implement and advocate best practices for API-first development, CI/CD automation, and DevSecOps
  • Partner with product managers and peers to translate business intent into scalable technical solutions
  • Contribute to automation and AI-driven monitoring that improves reliability and accelerates problem resolution

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science and Engineering or equivalent
  • 4 - 7 years of full stack expertise in cloud-based application development on a microservice architecture with in-depth knowledge of Java
  • Experience coordinating cross cutting initiatives in a product organization and engaging with cross-functional Product Management and Engineering teams
  • Possess hands-on experience with engaging Product Managers to crystalize requirements into technology solutions for delivery
  • Hands-on experience with UI technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Typescript, ReactJS
  • Hands-on experience with frameworks and tools including Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, JPA, Junit, NodeJS, Express & SQL/NoSQL, Git
  • Possesses hands-on experience and technical expertise across AWS and GCP, with proficiency in technologies such as Ansible, Containers, Kubernetes, Temporal, and Terraform, along with observability tools including Grafana, AppDynamics, and PagerDuty
  • Basic understanding of Identity concepts such as SAML, JWT, OAuth, and microservices
  • Possesses knowledge of data modelling (RDBMS, XSD, JSON), Database/XML interaction, SQL, ORM, and hands-on experience with RDBMS databases like Postgres, Oracle and RDS

Successful candidate will

  • Be a talent multiplier who gets the team around them to excel
  • Be persistent, creative and driven to get results relentlessly
  • Exhibit a strong backbone to challenge the status quo, when needed
  • Exhibit a high level of curiosity, keeping abreast of the latest trends & technologies
  • Show pride of ownership and strive for excellence in everything undertaken

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more [here](https://careers.equinix.com/equinix-ai-guidance-for-candidates).

job.title: Security Design and Integration Manager - India
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

The Security Design and Integration Manager will drive efforts in securing data centers across India and will be based out of Mumbai, or Hyderabad, working in a remote setup.

This role supports the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects in the region, from early design through commissioning and turnover, and oversees compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards across security design, integration, implementation, and programming. The role also supports the integration of EdgeConneX security and customer security efforts, ensuring compliance with all applicable standards. Successful execution requires strong navigation of local construction practices, regulatory authorities, and stakeholder dynamics, and the ability to build durable working relationships with sophisticated enterprise customers. This position is customer-facing and must uphold the ideals of EdgeConneX excellence.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects across from early design through commissioning and site turnover and oversee compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards throughout.
  • Serve as subject matter expert (SME) on EdgeConneX requirements and physical security standards, providing authoritative guidance to project teams, delivery partners, and stakeholders.
  • Support the definition of project security requirements and acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment to EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer expectations.
  • Support procurement and provide technical oversight of security designers, integrators, and programmers.
  • Review security designs and submittals produced by integration partners for compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercoms, and related field devices.
  • Liaise with customer security teams and local construction teams to align AdaniConneX project delivery with EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer-specific requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate and liaise with both AdaniConneX stakeholders and customer subject matter experts (SMEs) to align on security requirements, resolve issues, and maintain a shared understanding throughout delivery.
  • Oversight of physical security systems, including S2, Lenel, and Genetec systems.
  • Validate installation and configuration quality through quality checks, site walks, and commissioning reviews; audit security contractors on quality, schedule, and compliance.
  • Support closure of design gaps, defects, and punch items, including verification of corrective actions.
  • Adapt EdgeConneX baseline standards to local conditions and to authorities holding jurisdiction in India.
  • Maintain documentation quality, including design drawings, as-built records, test results, configuration records, and turnover packages.
  • Provide estimating and budgeting inputs for physical security systems when requested.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations on site turnover and operational acceptance.
  • Participate in shaping Security Design and Integration global standards and processes, and improve standards, templates, and repeatable design patterns to reduce rework and improve consistency across the portfolio.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong technical understanding of physical security systems and integration methods.
  • Ability to evaluate designs quickly, identify gaps, and make practical decisions under delivery pressure.
  • Strong vendor management sets expectations, enforces baseline requirements, and holds delivery partners accountable.
  • Strong communications, both written and verbal, in leading teams and coordinating with peers and other disciplines on driving projects and issues to closure.
  • Clear communicator who can translate technical requirements into simple, executable direction for integration partners and internal project teams.
  • Customer-facing presence; able to represent EdgeConneX professionally with sophisticated enterprise customers and sustain alignment through extended ramp and onboarding cycles.
  • Strong and effective team player working across various disciplines and peer groups; able to cover the full range of tasks required to get the job done.
  • Superb ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Disciplined execution: tracking, documentation, follow-through, and closure.
  • Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders in a multilingual Indian environment without losing attention to detail.
  • Commitment to organizational excellence and constant awareness of opportunities to improve processes and quality of deliverables.
  • Superb ability to work independently while adhering to standards.
  • Ability to use computer systems related to security management and reporting.

Experience / Education

  • 3+ years of experience in physical security design, systems integration, or physical security program delivery.
  • Minimum 2 of those years managing large-scale security design and installation projects.
  • Experience supporting critical infrastructure environments; Data center experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience delivering in India or the broader APAC region, including working knowledge of local construction practices and jurisdictional security requirements.
  • Experience working with technical drawings and standard construction deliverables such as submittals, requests for information, and as-built documentation.
  • A working knowledge or ability to learn: PCI/DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 certifications, as well as AutoCAD and associated drawing programs.
  • Candidates with experience in S2, Lenel, ExacqVision and/or Genetec are highly encouraged to apply.
  • Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Physical Security Professional (PSP), or equivalent certification preferred, or willingness to pursue.
  • Fluent in English required; proficiency in Hindi or additional Indian regional languages a plus.
  • Interest in cyber security.
  • Travel - the candidate is expected to travel around 50% regional and global travel for this position, including travel on short notice.

job.title: Critical Operations Technician - Mechanical (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Critical Operations Technician provides 24×7×365 operational coverage to support continuous, safe and reliable performance of critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls and life-safety systems across the data centre. The role performs hands-on operational maintenance, system monitoring, first-response troubleshooting, incident support and contractor coordination to uphold STACK’s 100% uptime commitment. Technicians operate and monitor facility infrastructure across power and cooling paths within approved procedures and role-specific authorisations, while maintaining a concierge-level customer service approach in all stakeholder interactions.

Essential Functions – Critical Operations

  • Maintain 24×7×365 shift coverage, ensuring safe and stable operation of all critical infrastructure systems.
  • Operate and monitor critical electrical and/or mechanical systems (based on background, training and authorisation) including UPS, PDUs, switchboards, generators, CDU/FWU/CRAC/CRAH units, chilled water systems, pumps and associated plant—strictly within approved operating procedures.
  • Perform hands-on operational maintenance within authorised scope, including inspections, condition monitoring, equipment resets, minor adjustments and component-level replacements (non-licenced work).
  • Identify abnormal conditions, complete initial diagnostics, implement first-level rectification actions where authorised, and escalate promptly to the Senior Data Centre Specialist.
  • Respond to alarms and operational incidents, supporting containment, investigation, communication and restoration activities.
  • Use BMS/EPMS and monitoring platforms to track alarms, interpret trends and support performance optimisation within approved limits.
  • Complete structured rounds including meter readings, thermal/capacity checks and condition observations, recording findings accurately.
  • Coordinate and supervise licenced contractors performing trade-restricted works, ensuring compliance with permits, LOTO and site safety requirements.
  • Support planned maintenance, shutdowns, testing and return-to-service activities through operational tasks, witnessing and verification.
  • Maintain accurate shift logs, event records, handover notes and CMMS updates to ensure full operational traceability.
  • Proactively identify and report reliability risks and improvement opportunities to support STACK’s 100% uptime commitment.
  • Participate in incident management training and exercises, acting as a trained first responder under direction of incident leaders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, risk assessments and operational readiness activities.
  • Provide professional, timely communication to customers and stakeholders to support a high-quality service experience.
  • This role does not perform licenced electrical, mechanical or refrigeration work. All trade-restricted activities are undertaken by appropriately qualified contractors or licenced personnel. The role focuses on operational system management, first-response troubleshooting, vendor coordination and component-level maintenance within authorised limits.

People

  • Set a high standard for safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct across the shift.
  • Support technicians through on-the-job coaching, demonstrations and constructive feedback to improve capability and consistency.
  • Assist with onboarding and familiarisation of new team members, reinforcing authorised boundaries and operational expectations.
  • Strengthen team communication by ensuring clear handovers, accurate escalation details and calm coordination during events.
  • Participate actively in briefings, toolbox talks, training and operational discussions, offering practical observations and improvement ideas.
  • Build collaborative relationships with Security, Projects and vendor personnel to support safe, coordinated site operations.
  • Demonstrate a concierge‑level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Operational discipline with a strong focus on safety, risk control and reliability
  • Ability to operate critical electrical and/or mechanical systems within procedural and authorisation boundaries
  • Effective troubleshooting, root-cause thinking and first-response decision-making under pressure
  • Ability to interpret alarms, trends and technical documentation (SLDs, O&M manuals, procedures)
  • Proficient in digital operational systems (BMS/EPMS, CMMS, workflow platforms) and reporting tools
  • Strong communication skills and calm, structured incident support
  • Contractor coordination capability with sound permit-to-work and LOTO awareness
  • Customer-focused, professional service orientation
  • Collaborative team behaviour with personal accountability and consistency on shift
  • Continuous improvement approach (procedures, logs, risk reduction and operational uplift)

Preferred Education and Experience

  • 2-3 years' experience in critical environments such as data centres, hospitals, utilities, defence, industrial plants or similar operational settings.
  • Demonstrated capability operating and/or monitoring electrical and/or mechanical infrastructure (e.g., UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs/PMMs, ATS/STS, CRAC/CRAH, chilled water systems, pumps, fire systems and controls).
  • Hands-on experience performing operational maintenance and first-level rectification activities within authorised limits.
  • Experience using BMS/EPMS and CMMS/workflow tools to manage alarms, work orders and operational documentation.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings and documentation (including single-line diagrams and O&M manuals).
  • Familiarity with permit-to-work, LOTO and basic risk assessment principles.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills suitable for shift logs, incident updates and customer/stakeholder engagement.

Work Environment/Conditions

  • Role operates on a 24×7 rotating shift roster including nights, weekends and public holidays.
  • Work occurs in data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required as per site policy.
  • Participation in emergency response activities and incident exercises is required.

Work Authorization/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Legal entitlement to work in Australia.
  • Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements (as applicable), including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.
  • Ability to meet data centre security requirements including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.
  • Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific facility.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

job.title: Energy Portfolio Analyst (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Energy Analyst – Markets & Sustainability is a key role within STACK’s Power & Energy team, responsible for energy accounting, consumption forecasting, utility cost validation and administration of STACK’s electricity supply and renewable energy arrangements across its Australian portfolio.

The role will establish and maintain accurate visibility of energy consumption, cost and forecast demand across STACK’s data centres, providing the data and analysis required to support energy procurement, budgeting, sustainability reporting and business decision-making.

The Energy Analyst will also manage day-to-day interfaces with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and DNSPs, administer energy contracts and renewable energy certificate requirements, and support the implementation and ongoing management of STACK’s energy accounting systems.

This role will work closely with Power & Energy, Finance, Operations and other relevant stakeholders to ensure energy data, costs and forecasts are accurate, transparent and effectively managed.

Energy Accounting, Forecasting & Analytics

  • Manage energy forecasting across STACK’s Australian data centre portfolio, including validation of electricity invoices against metering data, contracted rates, network tariffs and applicable charges.
  • Investigate billing and consumption discrepancies and coordinate resolution with retailers, Metering Service Providers, DNSPs and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain short-, medium- and long-term electricity consumption forecasts, incorporating actual and forecast data centre load growth.
  • Track actual energy consumption and cost against forecast, identify material variances and provide supporting analysis.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards covering energy consumption, cost, forecasts and other relevant energy metrics.
  • Support Finance with energy accruals, budgeting, reconciliations and energy-related financial reporting.

Energy Markets, Contracts & Stakeholder Administration

  • Support administration of electricity retail contracts, PPAs, metering arrangements and other energy-related agreements.
  • Maintain a central register of energy contracts, key dates, pricing arrangements, obligations and renewal requirements.
  • Manage day-to-day interfaces with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and DNSPs relating to billing, metering, consumption data and account administration.
  • Coordinate LGC and other renewable energy certificate surrender requirements, including tracking, reconciliation and supporting evidence.
  • Support electricity procurement activities, retailer engagements, contract renewals and commercial evaluations.
  • Analyse consumption profiles, tariffs and energy costs to support procurement and portfolio decisions.

Energy Systems, Sustainability Reporting & Business Support

  • Support selection, implementation and ongoing administration of STACK’s energy accounting and energy management software, including integration of retailer, metering and internal energy data.
  • Maintain appropriate data-quality, validation and reconciliation processes across energy systems and reporting.
  • Provide accurate energy consumption, renewable energy and supporting data inputs into NABERS, NGER, renewable energy indices and other applicable sustainability and regulatory reporting.
  • Support establishment of energy accounting, metering and reporting processes for new and expanding data centre sites.
  • Identify opportunities to automate and improve energy data collection, invoice validation, forecasting and reporting.
  • Provide ad hoc energy analysis and administrative support as STACK’s energy procurement, sustainability and portfolio requirements continue to evolve.

Competencies

  • Strong numerical, analytical and data-management capability.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify billing and data discrepancies.
  • Understanding of electricity billing, metering, network tariffs and retail electricity arrangements.
  • Strong Excel/ Power BI and data-analysis capability.
  • Ability to develop clear forecasts, dashboards and management reporting.
  • Strong organisational and contract-administration skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple external service providers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and establish processes within a developing function.
  • Commercial mindset and interest in Australian electricity markets and renewable energy.

Travel Required

Travel within Australia and, from time to time, internationally to support STACK projects, stakeholder meetings, technical reviews, workshops and commissioning activities.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Energy or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3–5 years’ relevant experience in energy, utilities, energy accounting, commercial analysis, finance or a related field.
  • Experience working with electricity invoices, utility accounts, energy data or metering information.
  • Experience with forecasting, budgeting, reconciliation or management reporting.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience analysing large datasets.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to manage recurring analytical and administrative processes.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience within the Australian electricity market.
  • Experience with large commercial and industrial electricity customers.
  • Experience working with electricity retailers, Metering Service Providers and/or DNSPs.
  • Understanding of NEM metering and electricity settlement data.
  • Experience with energy accounting or energy management software.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar data visualisation tools.
  • Understanding of LGCs, renewable energy certificates and renewable electricity procurement.
  • Exposure to electricity retail contracts, PPAs or energy procurement.
  • Familiarity with NABERS, NGER and renewable energy / sustainability reporting frameworks.
  • Data centre or other large energy-user experience would be highly regarded experience with 132 kV, 220 kV, 275 kV, 330 kV or higher-voltage systems.
  • Experience with Australian TNSPs/DNSPs and contestable assets.
  • Experience with hyperscale data centres or large industrial loads.
  • Experience with BESS and renewable-energy infrastructure.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

job.title: Director, Compensation & Benefits
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the Chief Human Resources Officer, The Director, Compensation and Benefits owns the analytical foundation behind how Digital Edge pays, grades and rewards its people on a global basis. It covers salary benchmarking, total target compensation analysis, job evaluation and job architecture, and the governance around the annual compensation cycle. This is a hands-on analytical role, requiring someone who can build the models, interrogate the data and translate the output into recommendations that leadership can act on.

This role will be based in Singapore.

Key responsibilities

  • Conduct salary benchmarking globally, building and maintaining reliable comparator sets by role, level and country.
  • Produce total target compensation analysis across base, bonus and cash incentives, in local currency and on a comparable global basis.
  • Conduct market compensation reviews and provide insights on pay competitiveness.
  • Support job evaluation, grading and job architecture reviews, applying a consistent methodology across countries and functions.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partners to ensure roles are levelled correctly before going to market.
  • Develop compensation models and business cases to support talent and workforce decisions, including scenario and cost modelling.
  • Support analysis of long term incentive and carried interest structures, working with Finance and external advisors on mechanics, valuation and participant communication.
  • Analyse compensation data, trends and internal equity considerations, surfacing anomalies and retention risk.
  • Prepare compensation reports, presentations and recommendations for stakeholders.
  • Support the annual compensation review process and related governance activities.
  • Manage relationships with third party advisors for compensation and insurance advisory services.
  • Maintain compensation data within SuccessFactors and supporting systems, ensuring accuracy, consistency and auditability.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • Experience: 6-10 years in compensation and benefits, reward or a comparable analytical role within a multi-country organisation, including supporting an annual compensation cycle end to end. Exposure to private equity backed, high-growth or infrastructure environments is advantageous, but not essential.
  • Technical skills: Advanced Excel, reporting and data analysis. Strong understanding of job architecture methodologies and salary benchmarking frameworks. Familiarity with carried interest and LTIP models. Previous experience working with third party advisors for insurance and compensation advisory services.
  • Specific people skills: High level of attention to detail, discretion and the ability to manage confidential information. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Able to communicate complex compensation concepts clearly to stakeholders who are not compensation specialists, and to work across multiple markets, currencies and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Education level: Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Economics or a related field. Relevant reward or compensation certification is advantageous.
  • Systems and Tools: SuccessFactors, HRIS compensation modules or equivalent systems.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Staff AI Lead
job.description:
Brisbane, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

At Optus, we're building the next generation of AI-powered customer and employee experiences. As part of one of Australia's largest customer-facing AI portfolios, you'll play a key role in designing and optimising AI solutions that transform how millions of customers engage with Optus

We're looking for a Staff AI Lead to provide technical leadership in the design and delivery of AI agents and intelligent products across Optus. As one of the organisation's senior AI practitioners, you'll shape technical approaches, influence product direction and help establish the standards, frameworks and best practices that enable AI solutions to scale safely and effectively.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong product thinking and a passion for solving complex business challenges using Agentic AI, Generative AI and LLM-powered technologies.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build and continuously improve AI agents and AI-powered products.
  • Translate business problems and service opportunities into scalable AI solutions.
  • Develop and refine prompts, workflows, tools, orchestration logic and guardrails.
  • Drive experimentation, testing and evaluation to improve agent performance and customer outcomes.
  • Use data and insights to identify optimisation opportunities and measure impact.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Design and Analytics teams to deliver high-quality AI experiences.
  • Contribute to standards, frameworks and best practices for developing and scaling AI solutions.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Demonstrable experience building and delivering AI agents, GenAI solutions, conversational AI or LLM-powered products.
  • Strong knowledge of agent architectures, orchestration patterns, prompt engineering and AI guardrails.
  • Deep hands-on experience building, evaluating and optimising AI agents and LLM-powered products in production environments.
  • Experience using experimentation, analytics and data-driven insights to improve product performance.
  • Strong technical judgement and the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple disciplines.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and drive alignment across teams.
  • A customer-focused mindset, curiosity for emerging technologies and a passion for continuous improvement.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: Quoting Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary

The Analyst –Quoting is responsible for preparing accurate, competitive, and timely customer quotations by collaborating with Sales, Product, Finance, Service Delivery, and other cross functional teams. The role ensures compliance with pricing policies, turnaround time (TAT) expectations, and quality standards while supporting both standard and non-standard customer requirements.

Job Description

1) Quoting & Pricing Operations  Prepare and deliver customer quotation requests with high accuracy and within defined SLAs.  Analyse customer inputs, validate requirements, and follow pricing guidelines to prepare technically and commercially aligned quotes.  Use quoting tools and systems (e.g., CPQ, Explore, Price Books, etc.) for quote creation and pricing validation.  Work closely and collaboratively with the ONQT team to ensure correct and timely procurement of OLO costs.  Validate costs, discounts, margins, and ensure necessary approvals are obtained as per pricing policies and governance.  Manage revisions, re quotes, corrections, and clarifications throughout the quoting lifecycle.

2) RFP and Bid Support  Support large RFPs and customer bid requests, as required by the business, by providing complete and accurate pricing.  Coordinate with Customers, Product, Sales, and other internal teams to gather all necessary inputs for quote creation.  Ensure all bid submissions adhere to prescribed formats, internal standards, approval guidelines, and audit/compliance requirements

3) Process & Documentation Governance  Create, update, and maintain internal documentation such as customer specific work instructions, SOPs, issue logs, trackers, and other documents as required.  Support continuous process improvements by identifying gaps and recommending enhancements.  Ensure all documents remain updated as processes, tools, systems, or pricing methodologies evolve.

4) Systems, Tools & Product Knowledge  Gather all relevant systems, tools, and product knowledge during the probation period.  Participate in sessions related to processes, pricing tools, workflows, and systems, and adapt quickly to new tools, technologies, and processes.  Maintain accuracy and completeness of data within quoting tools and process workflows.  Stay updated on product portfolios, solution capabilities, and market trends to ensure accurate quotation preparation.

5) Team & Cross Functional Collaboration Functional Collaboration  Work closely with Sales, Product, Finance, ONQT, and other teams to ensure alignment on pricing and commercial terms.  Provide support and guidance to Sales and the Ordering team on pricing/quoting processes and policies.  Support knowledge sharing for new team members on tools, systems, pricing rules, and quoting processes

6) Reporting & Data Quality  Maintain accurate and audit ready documentation of - quotes, issue logs, cleansing reports, and other trackers. ready documentation of  Understanding of reports on quote volumes, turnaround times, win/loss analysis, and pricing performance. Generate reports if required.  Ensure high data quality, consistency, and compliance across all quoting tools and systems.

Key Requirements

 Strong analytical and numerical ability with excellent attention to detail.  Good verbal and written communication skills for customer and stakeholder collaboration.  Ability to work under pressure while maintaining timelines, accuracy, and service quality.  Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, and quoting/pricing tools (e.g., CPQ).  Understanding pricing, cost structures, and commercial terminology.  Customer focused and quality driven mindset.  Process oriented with strong ownership and accountability.  Proactive approach with a willingness to learn and adapt in a fast paced environment.  Strong team player with a collaborative working style.  Customer focused and quality driven mindset.  Process oriented with strong ownership and accountability.  Proactive approach with a willingness to learn and adapt in a fastpaced environment.  Strong team player with collaborative working style.

job.title: Product Manager - Enterprise Solutions
job.description:
Meta is building the future of AI-powered enterprise solutions, with APAC at the center. We're standing up forward-deployed engineering (FDE) pods to ship AI-enabled enterprise products for the region's largest partners.

The Product Manager will own the AI-enabled enterprise product for APAC end to end, turning Meta's foundational models and agent platform into deployed, revenue-generating solutions for marquee enterprises across India and Southeast Asia. Working forward-deployed with engineering and directly with partners, you'll ship agentic products, define the evaluation and data strategies behind them, and drive measurable enterprise outcomes.

This is a 0-to-1 enterprise builder role focused on applied AI, with executive visibility and commercial impact. AI is the core of the role, not a feature. For an AI-native builder, it's the opportunity to own applied enterprise AI at scale in high-growth regions.

Responsibilities

  • Is the primary driver for identifying significant near and long-term opportunities in a large Product area, and driving product mission, strategies and roadmaps in the context of broader organizational strategies and goals
  • Generate buy-in and drive consensus across organizations. Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous opportunities. Consistently demonstrate initiative and execute with limited oversight
  • Critically evaluate when AI is (and isn't) the optimal solution at portfolio level, setting the standard for rigorous tradeoff analysis
  • Translate AI capabilities into compelling, differentiated product visions that define market categories
  • Champion AI-native strategies including comprehensive evals and data strategies that enable org-wide continuous improvement
  • Drive product development with teams of engineers and designers, while maintaining team health
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to drive product mission, define product requirements, coordinate resources from other groups (design, legal, etc.), develop roadmaps, and guide the team through key milestones
  • Reimagine workflows, responsibly using AI tools to transform team velocity and capability at organizational scale
  • Foster a culture of rapid experimentation and learning across the team
  • Scale AI best practices (including responsible AI use), workflows, and artifacts across the organization so capability compounds exponentially
  • Plan, initiate, and manage information technology projects for web-based products, applications, and platforms
  • Orchestrate complex execution across multiple organizations by combining AI automation with strategic human oversight at scale
  • Maximize efficiency in a constantly evolving environment where the process is fluid and creative solutions are the norm
  • Use AI-enabled tools to build products—setting the standard for PM technical capability
  • Interpret research and state-of-the-art learnings to design product strategy and apply rigorous logical reasoning at the frontier
  • Demonstrate expert understanding of system/architecture trade-offs and how they impact user experience and business outcomes; lead strategic technical decisions with engineering leadership
  • Integrate data, usability studies, research, and market analysis into product strategies and requirements to enhance user satisfaction and improve engineer productivity
  • Express complex and technical concepts at the right altitude, choosing the right medium and level of detail for the audience (XFN partners, execs, engineering, etc.)
  • Understand Meta's strategic and competitive position and deliver products that are aligned with our mission and competitive in the industry
  • Define and analyze metrics that inform the success of products. Identify and track key performance metrics. Drive decision-making through user insights, quantitative analysis and AB testing
  • Design sophisticated experiments and interpret results (leveraging AI) and drive strategic product decisions
  • Define and run evaluations (evals) to interpret model outputs at scale—establishing evaluation as a strategic capability for AI-powered experiences

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years product management and/or Product Design
  • 10+ years of experience driving cross-functional product development with engineering, design, and user research teams
  • Experience navigating through the full product life-cycle, integrating customer feedback into product requirements, driving prioritization, and pre- and post-launch execution
  • Critical thinking and analytical leadership experience
  • Demonstrated proficiency using AI-enabled tools to build product artifacts at scale
  • Experience developing and championing AI-native strategies across organizations
  • Experience presenting to executive audiences
  • BA/BS in Computer Science or related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Track record of scaling AI best practices across organizations
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Experience in a consumer focused technology company
  • Experience building 0-1 AI-native products, platform/ecosystem products, or marketplaces

job.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI
job.description:
We help global enterprise partners integrate Meta's foundation models and AI tools directly into their core products and infrastructure. We are hiring an experienced Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to act as the primary technical bridge between Meta's internal engineering teams and our enterprise clients.

You will lead the architecture and rollout of large-scale AI systems, working side-by-side with engineering leaders at other companies to adapt our AI platform to their specific environments and constraints.

Crucially, you’ll take the friction you encounter in the field—like optimizing inference speeds, resolving interoperability issues, and connecting complex external data sources—and turn it into concrete technical proposals. Your hands-on experience will directly inform and shape the roadmap for Meta's core AI tools and ecosystem. If you want autonomy and the chance to lead complex technical deployments that define how the enterprise uses AI, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Architect Systems: Lead the technical design for major enterprise AI deployments. Ensure the solutions can scale, remain secure, and adhere to strict partner compliance requirements.
  • Build Integrations: Design reliable connections between Meta's AI platforms and client infrastructure, including CRMs, data warehouses, and custom APIs.
  • Drive the Roadmap: Serve as the definitive technical link between field deployments and internal platform teams. Synthesize real-world deployment challenges into strategic decisions that shape Meta's core AI products.
  • Establish Standards: Define deployment patterns, build tooling, and set engineering standards that reduce technical debt and speed up future execution across the team.
  • Lead and Mentor: Set technical direction, drive major cross-functional initiatives, and provide deep technical mentorship to uplevel the team and guide new engineers.
  • Optimize at Scale: Identify and resolve complex performance, latency, and scalability bottlenecks to ensure reliable performance in live production environments.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
  • Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
  • 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting and deploying large-scale software systems, including taking complex AI applications from early prototypes to enterprise-ready production
  • Experience architecting and scaling GenAI infrastructure across major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP), leveraging advanced cloud services (compute, distributed storage, ML frameworks) to optimize model performance, manage compute costs, and ensure enterprise-grade reliability
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced AI testing systems (e.g., automated evaluation loops to proactively catch hallucinations, reasoning gaps, or safety issues in live products)

job.title: Asia Logistics Program Manager
job.description:
Meta is seeking an Asia Logistics Program Manager to manage materials, equipment, and product movement across complex Asia-based supply chains that power Meta's hardware products. In this role, you will manage end-to-end commodity logistics programs spanning freight forwarding, customs compliance, carrier management, and inbound supply chain operations across the supply chain network. You will partner closely with planning, engineering, and operations teams to optimize logistics flows, reduce lead times, and ensure supply continuity for Meta's growing portfolio of consumer hardware.

Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end logistics programs for Asia-based manufacturing supply chains, including freight, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery coordination
  • Collaborate with Product Operations, Technical Program Management, and Planning to design logistics networks aligned to the geographic footprint of contract manufacturers and suppliers across Asia
  • Analyze freight cost, transit time, and carrier performance data to identify optimization opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives
  • Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and third-party logistics providers to ensure that the movement of goods is compliant and on time
  • Develop and maintain logistics program documentation, including standard operating procedures, routing guides, and carrier scorecards
  • Monitor supply chain KPIs and escalate risks related to capacity constraints, port disruptions, or regulatory changes affecting logistics lanes that impact our business
  • Engage cross-functional stakeholders, including finance, trade compliance, and operations, to align on logistics program priorities and trade-offs
  • Support trade compliance activities by ensuring shipments adhere to import and export regulations across relevant jurisdictions
  • Leverage data analysis tools and AI-integrated workflows to model logistics scenarios, forecast costs, and support program decision-making
  • Provide input into team-level logistics strategy and contribute to short, mid, and long-term goals aligned to supply chain business objectives

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in logistics program management, freight operations, or supply chain operations globally
  • Experience managing relationships with freight forwarders, customs brokers, or third-party logistics providers across global trade lanes
  • Experience in analyzing logistics data (cost, transit time, carrier performance) to identify issues and propose solutions
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders across sourcing, procurement, operations, or trade compliance functions
  • Experience navigating import and export compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting logistics programs for consumer electronics, hardware, or infrastructure commodity supply chains
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ability to use data analysis or AI tools to model logistics scenarios and support program planning decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Familiarity with customs classification, duty optimization, or free trade agreement utilization across global markets
  • Experience using supply chain management systems or transportation management platforms to track and optimize freight movements

job.title: Global Business Development Manager, Analytics
job.description:
The Telco Ecosystem Partnerships team at Meta is seeking a Global Business Development Manager, Analytics to own the analytics relationship with senior executives at some of our most strategic mobile operator and device partners, and to run the global programs that our partner analytics function delivers against. and works across our partner teams in APAC, EMEA, and the Americas.

In this role, you will work with a global team of partner data scientists and with our product, engineering, marketing, and partnerships teams to turn data into decisions that our partners act on. You will own how we measure the value that partners get from our analytics, how our programs are goal-set and tracked across four regions, and how new AI-enabled ways of working get adopted by the team. You will have experience in partner or program management in a data-rich commercial environment, the ability to hold a credible conversation with a C-suite audience, and the judgment to prioritize across competing regional demands.

You will be responsible for the operating rhythm of a distributed analytics organisation, for the executive engagement programs that put our insights in front of the people who make partnership decisions, and for the go-to-market strategy of new analytics products with partners in your region. Working directly with partner executives across APAC, you will identify where our products fall short of what partners need, and your experience in the telecommunications industry combined with your analytical and commercial background will help you propose and champion the features and programs that close the gap—so both Meta and our partners get measurable value from the relationship.

Responsibilities

  • Build long lasting relationships and partnerships with Telecom Operators
  • Drive local execution of strategic initiatives across growth, revenue, insights and connectivity, spanning across the Meta family of Apps
  • Develop and deliver market insights on regional telecom and device ecosystem trends to inform partnership strategy and product priorities
  • Identify and monitor strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats relevant for Meta in the region
  • Influence and improve the Meta experience of users in your region by identifying product - market fit gaps
  • Explore, identify and evaluate strategic growth opportunities
  • Manage growth related partnerships
  • Be an advocate for people using Meta Family of Apps in the region

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in programme management, product management, product marketing, or partner-facing strategy
  • Strategy consulting experience, or equivalent in structured analytical problem-solving
  • Track record of building relationships with senior stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones
  • Experience managing cross-regional programs with competing priorities, including defining scope, tracking milestones, and communicating status to stakeholders
  • Exceptional communication: can clarify and summarise complex analytics for a C-suite audience

job.title: Senior Specialist - Environment, Health and Safety Officer
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Environmental Health and Safety Officer is an advanced subject matter expert, responsible for consulting on and implementing Environmental Health, and Safety (EHS) policies, ensuring health and safety conditions in the work environment to prevent harm, injury and illness.

This role is accountable for instituting controls and remedial measures for hazardous and potentially hazardous conditions or equipment, including those that harm the external environment.

This role analyzes and designs control for the prevention of occupational diseases, and manages the risk related to the environment and related incident management.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Creates surveys and assessments to identify hazardous conditions that affect workers, property, the environment and the general public and develop measures to eliminate these.
  • Responsible for surveying and investigating the working conditions, determine the causes, and recommend action that will prevent further incidents or accidents.
  • Provides consulting around the practical steps to ensure compliance to laws and regulations that govern environment, health and safety matters.
  • Responsible for conducting risk assessments and related audits to mitigate organisational liability against relevant laws and regulations.
  • Accountable for new employee health and safety orientation.
  • Responsible for conducting safety training and education programs with existing employees, including demonstrating the use of safety equipment.
  • Co-ordinate and attend related committee meetings.
  • Networks with external stakeholders, including the local authorities, communities, hospitals and disaster management groups to develop maintain and update emergency response plans and procedures.

May act evacuation marshal, fire marshal and/or incident coordinator Knowledge, Skills and Attributes: Strong knowledge and understanding of applicable laws, regulations and other legal regulations that govern environment, health and safety in the workplace Display strong influencing ability and interpersonal and verbal and written communication skills Display strong planning, organising and problem-solving ability Strong attention to detail and display the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and external stakeholders Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification and/or experience Relevant Health, Safety and Environmental certification(s) Required Experience: Advanced active working experience with environment, health and safety issues in a related industry / environment Advanced experience dealing with a variety of stakeholders and influencing decision making to manage business risk Advanced experience dealing with legislators and governing bodies Advanced knowledge of the environmental, health and safety laws, regulations, codes, and standards and their application and interpretation

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Electrical & Electronics VAVE - Product Testing
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description forEngineer – Product Testing(VAVE)

Job Description

Coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform testing and validation of VAVE-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
  • Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post-cost optimization.
  • Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
  • Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
  • Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
  • Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
  • Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
  • Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.

Job Specifications:

  • Education: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Experience: 5 to 6 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).
  • Hands-on experience in automation testing tools and programming for test systems.
  • Strong understanding of analog and digital circuits, power conversion principles, and common topologies.
  • Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
  • Familiarity with VAVE methodology, cost optimization principles, and supplier component qualification.
  • Proactive, analytical, and result-oriented, with the ability to think critically and solve problems independently.
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal in English).

Key Skills:

  • VAVE (Value Analysis & Value Engineering) implementation and testing
  • Power electronics testing (AC/DC, DC/DC, UPS)
  • Automation testing and scripting
  • Analog & digital electronics troubleshooting
  • Compliance & certification validation (UL, CE)
  • Test plan creation and execution
  • Cost optimization validation techniques
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis
  • Hands-on test and measurement capability (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, etc.)

About the Team

Work Authorization

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

job.title: Technical Project Lead
job.description:
Job Description

Technical Project Lead (Energy Storage)

Pune, India

Job Description

Job Summary

The Technical Project Lead works with the offering management team to refine product requirements and turn them into product specifications that drive cross-functional team development. This role leads the development teams through the NPD process cycle at a technical level (as opposed to high-level program management) to make sure the end product meets the requirements.

This role will focus on Vertiv Energy Storage product line offerings. The individual will be responsible for understanding product requirements and developing technical product specifications that will drive the cross-functional development teams. This role works through the entire product development cycle to make sure the R&D team stays on schedule and meets the original market requirements. Close collaboration between offering management, system engineering, mechanical engineering, product engineering, firmware engineering, agency compliance, and product integrity teams.

Responsibilities

  • Drive requirements refinement, specification development, and task tracking through iterative review cycles.
  • Hold authority on system design decisions as they pertain to meeting market requirements for energy storage products.
  • Translate detailed technical development plans into simplified project milestones for executive tracking purposes.
  • Must track development progress vs plan and manage resource needs to stay on schedule.
  • Provide technical support and leadership to product development teams as the first step in the escalation path if issues or questions arise. Escalate major issues to the appropriate resources and pursue to closure.
  • Work with cross-functional teams (Offering Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical/System Engineering, Firmware Engineering, Engineering Test) to create development plans and strategy and bring products from ideation to concept and market launch. Example development stages:
  • Requirements definition and enrichment by collaborating with cross-functional teams (Service, Sales, Manufacturing, etc.)
  • Detailed specification breakdown and work/task breakdown based on higher-level requirements
  • Concept development and refinement
  • Validation test planning and prototype planning
  • Full product or platform development and release into the PLM system
  • Prototype part ordering and local assembly
  • Prototype validation testing
  • Final conformance to specification checks and manufacturing handoff
  • Track and report on team and individual performance to management and executive leadership.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering ( Electrical preferred)
  • 3–4 years of relevant experience in project management on power converters, energy storage, and electrical engineering
  • SMC (Scrum Master Certification) not required, but a plus
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) not required, but a plus
  • Prefer experience with power conversion, battery energy storage systems (BESS), or related power electronics product development

job.description:
Job Description

Job Description for Engineer – Product (VAVE & Sustaining)

Job Description

Coordinate with design, production, procurement, and product testing teams to validate cost-optimized solutions for existing and new products under VAVE (Value Analysis and Value Engineering) initiatives. The primary responsibility is to ensure reliability, functional integrity, and certification compliance after implementing VAVE changes. This role requires validating design and component modifications through structured testing, automation programs, and compliance assessments. The candidate must ensure that all VAVE changes maintain product performance, safety, and quality standards without compromising customer requirements. Being part of a Global Engineering Function, the role demands strict adherence to defined processes and communication protocols.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform testing and validation of VAVE-related design and component changes in power supply products, modules, and systems.
  • Conduct hardware and software testing (black box/white box) for communication power products to ensure compliance post-cost optimization.
  • Develop and maintain automated test programs for validating VAVE modifications efficiently.
  • Formulate test plans, stress conditions, and procedures for evaluating new components or design changes introduced through VAVE.
  • Collaborate with design, procurement, reliability, and compliance teams to verify cost-optimized solutions without affecting performance.
  • Ensure all VAVE changes comply with UL, CE, and other international safety and certification standards.
  • Prepare detailed test reports, risk analysis, and recommendations for each VAVE implementation.
  • Participate in root cause analysis for failures during VAVE validation and provide corrective action inputs.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cost competitiveness while maintaining high reliability and safety standards.

Job Specifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics / Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Experience: 3 to 4 years of experience in power electronics product/module testing (AC/DC chargers, DC/DC converters, UPS preferred).
  • Hands-on experience in automation testing tools and programming for test systems.
  • Strong understanding of analog and digital circuits, power conversion principles, and common topologies.
  • Knowledge of safety certification processes (UL, CE) preferred.
  • Familiarity with VAVE methodology, cost optimization principles, and supplier component qualification.
  • Proactive, analytical, and result-oriented, with the ability to think critically and solve problems independently.
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal in English).

Key Skills:

  • VAVE (Value Analysis & Value Engineering) implementation and testing
  • Power electronics testing (AC/DC rectifier, DC/DC converters, UPS)
  • Automation testing and scripting
  • Analog & digital electronics troubleshooting
  • Compliance & certification validation (UL, CE)
  • Test plan creation and execution
  • Cost optimization validation techniques
  • Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis
  • Hands-on test and measurement capability (oscilloscopes, power analyzers, etc.)
