  • Working knowledge of Data Center functional areas (MDA, HDA, EDA, ZDA, EF) and familiar with data center industry trends
  • Subject matter expert in many Cabling Solution and product ranges across assigned CommScope Concentration(s)
  • Knowledge in telecommunication TCP/IP, networking
  • Ability to influence, train, and mentor channel partners and system integration partners
  • Deal closing skills to assist sales force Influence outcome of a tender response technically through product expertise combined with strategic thinking in commercial landscape
  • Ability to create and deliver sales and training presentations with confidence and customer-facing skill
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills including the ability to establish and maintain relationships
  • Test procedure and field test equipment for copper and fiber knowledge require
  • Excellent problem-solving skills are important in this role drive for results in addressing customer challenges important
  • Project management experience required
  • Possess vehicle and driving license

Why CommScope:

CommScope is on a quest to deliver connectivity that empowers how we live, work, and learn.Our employees push the boundaries of communications technology that enables game-changing discoveries like 5G, the Internet of Things, and gigabit speeds for everyone, everywhere.With our unmatched expertise in copper, fiber, and wireless infrastructure, our global clients rely on us to outperform today and be ready for the needs of tomorrow.

If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at CommScope.

CommScope is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans. If you are seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process, please contact us to submit your request at talentacquisition@commscope.com. You can also learn more about CommScope’s accommodation process and EEO policy at[https://jobs.commscope.com/eeo](https://jobs.commscope.com/eeo)

job.title: Logistics Analyst (Contract), Singapore, Singapore
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Logistics Analyst supports the end-to-end execution of air freight forwarding spot quotes. The role receives and reviews internal rate requests, determines whether contracted pricing is available and applicable, sources spot pricing when required, calculates the complete transportation cost, and coordinates with internal stakeholders and freight forwarders through quote selection and move execution. The analyst works across multiple procurement, sourcing, rate-management, reporting, and communication systems while maintaining accurate, timely, and audit-ready records.

What You Will Do: ​

  • Manage assigned air freight rate requests from intake through closure, including Requests For Information (RFIs) and time-sensitive actual-move spot requests. Requests will be generated from internal and external sources.
  • Review shipment details for completeness and accuracy, including origin and destination, requested service level, service type, commodity, dimensions, actual weight, chargeable weight, shipment date, special handling requirements, and required delivery timing.
  • Research contracted rates, routing guides, rate validity dates, approved service levels, lane coverage, and allowable accessorial charges to determine whether an existing contract applies.
  • Validate calculations and commercial terms against approved rate sources; identify missing, expired, conflicting, or non-applicable rates and escalate exceptions when needed.
  • Create and maintain rate-request records across multiple systems, which may include Salesforce, RateCloud, Keelvar, Power BI, Excel, Teams, email, and other internal tools.
  • Prepare and issue RFIs to support planning or cost-estimate decisions, clearly documenting assumptions and advising requestors that pricing may require revalidation before shipment execution.
  • Launch actual-move spot requests to qualified air freight forwarders, communicate complete shipment requirements, establish response deadlines, monitor supplier responses, and follow up to meet shipment timing.
  • Compare supplier offers for pricing, transit time, routing, capacity, service level, validity, exclusions, and operational feasibility; request clarification or revised offers when information is incomplete or inconsistent.
  • Calculate the total expected move cost using the applicable chargeable weight, freight rate, minimum charges, fuel, security, pickup, delivery, handling, customs-related, special-service, and other approved accessorial charges. Normalize currencies and units of measure when required and document all assumptions.
  • Provide requestors with a clear quote comparison and recommendation that identifies total cost, provider, routing, transit time, quote validity, assumptions, exclusions, and risks. Protect supplier pricing from unauthorized external disclosure.
  • Collaborate with trade-lane teams, facilities, dealers, factories, procurement colleagues, operations teams, freight forwarders, and other internal and external partners to resolve questions and support timely spot-move execution.
  • After a quote is selected, confirm award details with the appropriate parties; obtain and record the house air waybill or other booking reference; complete required approval documentation; and update the request through final closure.
  • Maintain complete supporting documentation, including requests, quotes, calculations, approvals, correspondence, booking details, and exception rationale, in accordance with process, compliance, and audit requirements.
  • Track open requests, priorities, response times, aging items, savings or cost avoidance, and exception trends; escalate urgent, high-risk, or stalled requests promptly.
  • Follow export-control, confidentiality, procurement, sourcing, record-retention, and air freight forwarding requirements. Identify opportunities to improve templates, system data quality, turnaround time, and spot-quote reporting.

What You Have:

  • Strong analytical ability and attention to detail, with demonstrated accuracy in rate validation, cost calculations, and data entry.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests, systems, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while clearly prioritizing urgent actual moves.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, filters, comparisons, and structured cost analysis; working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Ability to learn and navigate procurement, sourcing, rate-management, CRM, and reporting platforms.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to request missing information, summarize quote options, document assumptions, and coordinate with stakeholders across functions and regions.
  • Working knowledge of air freight concepts such as chargeable weight, dimensional weight, service levels, origin/destination pairs, transit time, routing, quote validity, and accessorial charges preferred.
  • Sound judgment in recognizing rate discrepancies, operational risks, incomplete data, and situations requiring escalation.

Additional Info: ​

  • This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  • Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of Singapore which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).
  • This is on an agency contract for 12 months and will be on agency payroll.

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Final Details:

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

September 4, 2026 - September 17, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Logistics Planning and Operations Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Description

Lead logistics engineering, planning, and operations across two manufacturing facilities, ensuring safe, efficient, and cost-effective material flow to support business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive a safety-first culture across all logistics operations.
  • Lead end-to-end logistics planning, warehouse, material handling, inventory, and transportation activities.
  • Partner with Operations, Procurement, and Manufacturing Engineering to streamline processes and improve performance.
  • Manage, coach, and develop logistics specialists while building team capability.
  • Establish and monitor key logistics KPIs, benchmarks, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead logistics engineering projects focused on capacity, productivity, automation, and cost optimization.
  • Drive operational excellence through Lean, Six Sigma, and data-driven decision making.

Degree Requirement Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors Effectiveness Measurement: Knowledge of effective measurement techniques and ability to measure the quality and quantity of work effort for the purpose of improvement. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Under guidance, reports measurement results in actionable form to management.
  • Interprets and analyzes results vs. established benchmarks.
  • Establishes short-range and long-range improvement goals for own function.
  • Uses assigned measurements for own function or specialization.
  • Under guidance, develops action plans to achieve those goals.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
  • Identifies the major forces, events, and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
  • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Cross-Team Integration: Understanding of the importance of inter-team collaboration in breaking down silos and achieving business results; ability to lead employees from various functions to communicate, coordinate work across divisions, and collaborate in solving problems as one team. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Maintains a strong internal network that promotes informal collaboration.
  • Shares information that may be relevant to other teams across divisions.
  • Assesses the potential synergies from combining common practices across teams.
  • Identifies differences among teams that could cause barriers to effective integration.
  • Applies relevant information gathered from comparable teams to own team.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Level Extensive Knowledge:

  • Differentiates assumptions, perspectives, and historical frameworks.
  • Evaluates past decisions for insights to improve decision-making process.
  • Assesses and validates decision options and points and predicts their potential impact.
  • Advises others in analyzing and synthesizing relevant data and assessing alternatives.
  • Uses effective decision-making approaches such as consultative, command, or consensus.
  • Ensures that assumptions and received wisdom are objectively analyzed in decisions.

Forecasting: Knowledge of forecasting tools, approaches and practices; ability to determine product demand and estimate production requirements and loads. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Participates in preparation of short-term forecasts for a specific product or site.
  • Gathers and analyzes demand data with specific tools and procedures.
  • Locates useful information and sources of input used in weekly, monthly and quarterly forecasts.
  • Researches seasonal trends for a major product or product line.
  • Explains common types of business conditions and activities that impact demand.

Performance Management: Knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies opportunities to enhance performance, e.g., practice assignments, training, shadowing.
  • Ensures performance goals, checkpoints, and feedback focus on behaviors.
  • Provides documented input to formal performance review conducted by manager.
  • Observes individual performance and provides fair and objective feedback.
  • Uses formal and informal rewards and recognition programs for employees.

Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows procedures in carrying out routine supplier management tasks.
  • Uses electronic systems or tools to record/retrieve supplier information and carry out transactions with suppliers.
  • Resolves routine supplier issues; escalates non-routine issues up chain of command.
  • Researches alternative vendors or suppliers; participates in supplier selection.
  • Works with suppliers to ensure that purchases meet delivery date and quality specifications.

Supply Chain Management - MFG: Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and use, strategies, practices and tools for controlling the logistical processes. Level Extensive Knowledge:

  • Manages supply chain finance activities and measurements of effectiveness.
  • Advises others on capacity issues at various points in the supply chain.
  • Monitors the complete supply chain management process.
  • Consults on supply chain network design projects or processes.
  • Quantifies and evaluates benefits and risks of various supply chain strategies and approaches.
  • Participates in joint planning, process design/redesign with clients and partners.

Platform Engineering & Architecture

Cloud & Platform Enablement

  • Leverage cloud-native patterns (auto-scaling, observability, fault tolerance)

Quality, Reliability & DevOps

  • Implement CI/CD pipelines and ensure automated testing (unit, integration, contract testing)
  • Ensure SLAs/SLOs for platform services (availability, latency, throughput)
  • Monitor services using CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana
  • Lead production issue triage and root cause resolution

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • 4+ years in Java backend development
  • Strong hands-on experience with:

Spring Boot, Spring Cloud

  • Microservices & distributed systems
  • RESTful APIs and event-driven architecture
  • AWS cloud services (EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, API Gateway)

Experience designing reusable platform services and APIs

Domain & Integration Experience

  • Experience in platform/service-layer development for:

Digital commerce OR enterprise operations platforms

Strong understanding of:

  • System integration patterns (API orchestration, event streaming)
  • Data modeling for distributed systems

Leadership & Execution

  • Proven experience leading engineering teams or acting as Technical Lead
  • Strong ability to drive cross-team alignment across dependent platform services
  • Experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with domain-driven design (DDD) and bounded contexts
  • Exposure to enterprise digital platforms (eCommerce, asset/operations systems)
  • Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS)
  • Familiarity with API gateways, service mesh, and platform governance models
  • Experience with security & compliance frameworks (e.g., app security, API security)

What Success Looks Like

  • Well-architected platform services reused across multiple business capabilities
  • High-performing, reliable services supporting end-to-end digital workflows
  • Clear service ownership and well-defined domain boundaries
  • Strong team delivery with consistent engineering standards and velocity

job.title: EBG CRM, OM Domain Owner
job.description:
##

Role Mission

Own and govern StarHub's enterprise middleware and integration ecosystem, providing a common technology umbrella for integrations connecting BTS and non-BTS systems. The role ensures integrations are designed, delivered and operated through secure, scalable and reusable enterprise patterns, with clear ownership across their full lifecycle.

The role provides product ownership and governance for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and future approved enterprise integration technologies.

Accountabilities

  • Own the enterprise middleware and integration platform portfolio across BTS and the wider StarHub technology ecosystem.
  • Establish clear platform ownership, governance and operating standards for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation capabilities.
  • Ensure integrations across BTS and non-BTS systems are visible, governed and managed under a common enterprise framework.
  • Drive adoption of reusable integration patterns to reduce duplication, manual effort, unmanaged interfaces and point-to-point solutions.
  • Define platform roadmaps, investment priorities and lifecycle strategies aligned with StarHub's modernisation, automation and AI agenda.
  • Partner with application, architecture, data, infrastructure, identity, cybersecurity and service management teams to enable secure and resilient integration.
  • Optimise platform utilisation, licensing, vendor performance and total cost of ownership.

##

Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Middleware & Platform Ownership

Own the product lifecycle for enterprise middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and other approved technologies.

  • Maintain an enterprise view of middleware platforms, major interfaces, workflows, automations and dependencies.
  • Ensure platforms remain fit-for-purpose, scalable, supported, secure and aligned to target architecture.
  • Establish clear service ownership, support models and lifecycle controls for critical integration capabilities.
  • Integration Governance & Standards
  • Establish enterprise standards and guardrails for APIs, application-to-application integration, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration and automation.
  • Define decision principles for the use of middleware, native application integration, APIs, RPA and workflow automation.
  • Govern new integration demand to prevent uncontrolled point-to-point development, duplicated tooling and technology sprawl.
  • Drive reuse of approved APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Ensure designs comply with architecture, cybersecurity, identity, data protection, resilience and operational support requirements.
  • Cross-Domain Integration Accountability
  • Provide the governance umbrella for integrations across BTS domains and integrations originating outside BTS that connect into BTS-managed platforms.
  • Support cross-domain integration across Finance, People, Productivity, Identity, Data, Customer and other enterprise technology domains.
  • Identify integration ownership gaps and establish accountable owners for interfaces crossing organisational or technology boundaries.
  • Ensure critical integrations have documented architecture, technical ownership, business ownership, monitoring and support arrangements.
  • Coordinate resolution of cross-platform integration risks, dependencies and service issues.
  • Automation & Orchestration
  • Govern enterprise use of automation platforms such as UiPath to ensure sustainable, reusable and supportable adoption rather than isolated automations.
  • Identify opportunities to remove repetitive manual work through integration, workflow automation and orchestration.
  • Assess automation opportunities based on business value, complexity, risk, scalability and maintainability.
  • Promote reusable automation components and patterns across business functions.
  • Measure realised benefits including effort reduction, cycle-time improvement, error reduction and productivity gains.
  • Product Roadmap & Portfolio Management
  • Develop and maintain the Middleware & Integration product roadmap and backlog.
  • Prioritise platform enhancements, new capabilities, migrations, rationalisation and decommissioning based on enterprise demand and value.
  • Manage platform dependencies, risks, releases and delivery priorities.
  • Build business cases for material investments and track measurable value realisation.
  • Continuously assess emerging middleware, integration, automation and AI-enabled orchestration capabilities.
  • Vendor & Commercial Management
  • Manage strategic relationships with middleware, integration and automation technology vendors and delivery partners.
  • Lead platform licensing, consumption, capacity and commercial reviews.
  • Identify opportunities for licence optimisation, platform consolidation and cost reduction.
  • Establish vendor performance measures and regular service reviews.

##

  • AI & Intelligent Integration Enablement
  • Enable governed integration patterns that allow approved AI and agentic capabilities to securely interact with enterprise systems and data.
  • Partner with relevant AI, architecture, cybersecurity and identity teams on connectors, APIs, orchestration and tool-access patterns.
  • Ensure AI-enabled integrations follow least-privilege access, auditability, data protection and appropriate human approval controls.
  • Evolve middleware capabilities to support future agent-to-system and machine-to-machine integration patterns.

Scope Boundary The role owns the middleware capability, platforms, standards and governance. Individual application teams remain accountable for their application functionality and domain-specific requirements, while integrations crossing systems or domains are governed through the Middleware & Integration capability.

Areas of Impact

  • A single governed enterprise approach to middleware and integration across BTS and non-BTS platforms.
  • Reduced proliferation of point-to-point integrations, duplicated automation tools and unmanaged workflows.
  • Increased reuse of enterprise APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Faster and more reliable delivery of cross-platform business capabilities.
  • Improved resilience, observability, supportability and lifecycle ownership of critical integrations.
  • Reduced manual effort and operating cost through governed automation.
  • A secure integration foundation for AI-enabled and agentic business processes.

Ideal Track Record

  • 7-10 years of experience in enterprise integration, middleware, automation, product management or technology transformation.
  • Proven experience managing enterprise integration or automation platforms in a complex organisation.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, middleware, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration, system-to-system connectivity and RPA.
  • Experience with platforms such as Workato, UiPath, MuleSoft, Boomi, ServiceNow IntegrationHub or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience managing technology products across multiple business and technology domains.
  • Good understanding of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, identity, ITSM and operational support requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, commercial arrangements, product roadmaps and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions.
  • Experience with AI-enabled automation, orchestration or agentic integration patterns is advantageous.

job.title: Lead Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

The Lead Engineer supports the operations, maintenance, reliability, security, and capacity management of StarHub's Cable Landing Stations and submarine cable facilities. The role coordinates and overssees technical activities involving submarine cable systems, colocation facilities, interconnection services, and supporting infrastructure while ensuring compliance with regulatory, consortium, and operational requirements. The Lead Engineer provides technical guidance, mentors junior engineers, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to maintain high service availability and operational excellence.

JOB DESCRIPTION

**a. Lead the operations and maintenance of submarine cable systems, cable landing stations, and associated infrastructure. b. Support the implementation and planning of telecommunications system in the StarHub cable landing station. c. Lead fault management, troubleshooting, restoration, and service recovery activities for submarine cable systems and CLS facilities. d. 24 x 7 standby with on call duties for cable station operations requirement, submarine cable systems (dry and wet segment) fault localizations and fault repair supports and coordination. e. Oversee and provide support on the implementation of M&E, building facilities, outside plant infrastructure systems in the cable station f. On-board representatives on vessel for submarine cable projects or repairs. g. Coordinate with and submit reports to submarine cable consortia NOC and NA regarding consortia related activities. h. Lead submarine cable and equipment room projects site survey/inspection, installation, and commissioning. i. Lead the planning, implementation, and management of colocation services, interconnection facilities, cross-connect services, and customer requirements within CLS facilities. j. Oversee equipment room facilities request to ensure efficient planning and allocation of floor space and power in the cable station. k. Support the implementation of colocation projects in the cable station. l. Review the process and procedure, and work with the relevant stakeholders to achieve better efficiency for cable consortia, backhaul and colocation services (space, power, and interconnection) in the cable station. m. Lead the team in maintaining and updating documentation of all submarine cable facilities, test equipment and spare plants including colocation customers’ colocation facilities and interconnection services in the cable station. n. Review and analyze cable station space and power usage and highlights for future requirements. o. Mentor, coach, and develop junior engineers through structured knowledge sharing, technical training, and on-the-job learning.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

a. Degree in Electrical/Electronics/ Communication Engineering b. Minimum 5-8 years of experience in submarine cable systems, transmission networks, cable landing station operations, telecommunications infrastructure, or related engineering fields. c. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing technical operations, projects, and multi-stakeholder environments. d. Strong knowledge of cable landing station operations, colocation facilities, transmission systems, power and cooling infrastructure, and physical security requirements. e. Experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing engineering teams. f. Team player, self-motivated and able to work independently

  • Client relationship experience.
  • Knowledge in one of the major core areas, facility management or corporate real estate.

job.title: Technical Services Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As Technical Services Manager (TSM) reporting to our Senior Technical Service Manager (STSM), you will work closely with our Operations team, making an impact in a number of ways:

  • Supporting the STSM in relation to all aspects of data centre operations to achieve 100% uptime and compliance with customer SLAs
  • Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team of managers, technicians and third party vendors to plan, manage and supervise maintenance activities, both planned and reactive, on a nominated site.
  • First point of contact for AirTrunk’s customers in respect of works planning, incident management and reporting

What You'll Do

Either a portion of the data centre site or a portfolio of customers will be allocated to each Technical Service Manager (TSM). The TSM then runs this sub-section of the site, reporting and raising issues/tasks to the STSM as required;

  • Lead all aspects of the planning and coordination of all preventive maintenance and repair works, ensure change management and incident management procedures are followed; coordinate activities as required with customers
  • Coordinate with the Development team to run construction activity and installations, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards
  • Ensure adherence to site operating procedures (SOP, MOP, EOP) and any other documentation required by law, e.g. SWMS
  • Ensure compliance with site held accreditations, including, but not limited to, ISMS, ISO, SOC2, PCI.
  • Maintain compliance with local regulatory requirements including environmental, building, fire, electrical, hydraulic, occupational health & safety
  • Primary operational contact for customers and local point of escalation during emergency events and day-to-day operations
  • Attend witness testing of all equipment during commissioning to validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation
  • Manage the provisioning of data centre services including connectivity, power services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to customers
  • Lead minor capital projects for customers/internal purposes
  • Supervise operational metrics, data and analyse risks
  • Conduct regular property inspections
  • Take part in the 'on call' incident response roster

**

What You'll Bring

**

  • 5+ years of mechanical and electrical experience in data centres (preferred), facilities, engineering operations, trades or related fields
  • Ability to establish and review Method of Procedure documents, incident reports, emergency event summaries, root cause analysis reports, and O&M manuals
  • Ideally, successfully run 3rd party service providers and negotiate quote/pricing for services
  • Familiar with working with Customer Portals, BMS, Computerized Maintenance Management Systems
  • Have Own Security NV1 Clearance or ability to get one
  • Excellent collaborator with strong communication skills in English
  • Exceptionally flexible, forward-thinking and motivated by change
  • Effective customer management skills and meeting chair experience

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

job.title: Technology Lifecycle Risk Specialist
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it's easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is passionate about getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers. It's not about surface-level change. It's about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

The Technology Lifecycle & Risk Specialist is responsible for maintaining end-to-end visibility of the technology asset lifecycle across the Networks Business Unit. This role ensures that end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-support (EOS) milestones are proactively tracked, escalated, and managed before they create operational, security, or commercial risk. The role sits at the intersection of risk management, technology planning, and vendor governance - acting as a single point of accountability for lifecycle intelligence and providing actionable insights to senior stakeholders.

Your day to day will consist of

  • Own and maintain a comprehensive technology asset inventory, including hardware, software, network platforms, and associated EOL/EOS dates.
  • Establish and manage proactive lifecycle planning with milestone alerts and governance to ensure timely refresh, upgrade, or decommission activities.
  • Partner across technology domains to validate asset data, close inventory gaps, and ensure lifecycle coverage and accountability.
  • Identify, assess, and manage operational, security, financial, regulatory, and vendor-related risks associated with EOL/EOS assets.
  • Maintain lifecycle risk registers, drive risk remediation, and escalate critical issues with clear recommendations to leadership and governance forums.
  • Deliver lifecycle and risk reporting, executive dashboards, business cases, and insights on vendor roadmap, support, and product lifecycle changes.
  • Define and embed lifecycle management policies, processes, and tooling improvements, integrating lifecycle governance into procurement, architecture, and project delivery practices.

What makes you perfect for the role

  • 10+ years’ experience in technology risk, asset management, infrastructure lifecycle management, or a related field within large, complex environments.
  • Proven experience managing EOL/EOS programs, technology refresh initiatives, and large-scale lifecycle portfolios.
  • Strong technical knowledge of mobile- and fixed-network infrastructure, including hardware, operating systems, software platforms, and network technologie
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, maintain, and communicate technology risks through structured risk management processes.
  • Advanced data analysis, reporting, and dashboarding skills using tools such as Excel, Power BI, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively across technical and business audiences.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating complex technical information into clear business insights

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected' days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever's important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U's industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes' to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. job.title: Senior Cyber Exposure Specialist
job.description:
What You'll Do

Partnering closely with the Director, Exposure Management and stakeholders across Optus, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading continuous threat exposure management activities across Optus' external attack surface and internal vulnerability landscape, maintaining a threat-informed view of cyber risk.
  • Continuously discovering, investigating and managing internet-facing assets, exposed services, APIs, cloud resources, certificates, shadow IT and third-party dependencies.
  • Driving the end-to-end vulnerability management lifecycle including scanning, triage, validation, prioritisation, remediation tracking and verification.
  • Prioritising exposures based on exploitability, business impact, attack-path reachability and threat intelligence rather than severity scores alone.
  • Managing cyber exposure incidents, including zero-day vulnerabilities, mass exploitation events and software supply chain compromises, coordinating rapid assessment and remediation activities.
  • Partnering with infrastructure, cloud, engineering and application teams to drive remediation to closure and improve organisational cyber resilience.
  • Validating exposures through attack-path analysis, breach and attack simulation, and safe exploitation techniques to focus efforts on genuine risk.
  • Collaborating with threat hunting, detection engineering and incident response teams to convert exposure findings into actionable detections and security controls.
  • Driving continuous improvement across exposure management tooling, automation, reporting, metrics and operational processes.

What You'll Bring

  • Extensive experience in Exposure Management, Vulnerability Management, Attack Surface Management, Offensive Security, or a related cyber security discipline.
  • Strong hands-on experience managing the exposure lifecycle from discovery through remediation and risk reduction.
  • Deep understanding of modern enterprise technology environments, including cloud platforms, infrastructure, applications, containers, APIs, CI/CD pipelines and identity systems.
  • Experience using vulnerability management, attack surface management and exposure management platforms to assess and prioritise cyber risk.
  • Proficiency with security analytics and query languages such as KQL, SPL, SQL or XQL, along with scripting skills for automation and analysis.
  • Strong understanding of vulnerability exploitation, attack-path analysis, threat intelligence and MITRE ATT&CK frameworks.
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to influence remediation outcomes across teams you do not directly manage.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating technical findings into meaningful business risk and action plans.
  • Relevant qualifications in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or equivalent experience. Industry certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, GCIH, GWAPT or vendor certifications from Tenable, Qualys or Rapid7 will be highly regarded.

The Good Stuff...

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected' days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever's important to you.

job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Be a Part of Something BIG!

  • *

The Senior Manager, Group Internal Audit – Technology is a senior specialist role within Singtel Group Internal Audit, reporting directly to the Audit director, and is responsible for providing independent, objective, and risk-based assurance over Singtel’s technology, cybersecurity, and digital environments. The Senior Manager leads and delivers complex technology and cybersecurity audits, engagements, overseeing audit planning, execution and reporting, and providing robust and evidence-based challenge to key stakeholders. The role contributes to the development of the technology audit plan and ensures audit outcomes are high quality, actionable, and support effective risk management and control improvement. Audit outputs contribute directly to management assurance, Audit Committee reporting, and regulatory disclosures. Group Internal Audit operates as a key pillar of Singtel’s corporate governance framework and reports functionally to the Singtel Group Audit Committee.

Make an Impact by

**

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, risk-based technology and cybersecurity audits across Singtel Group.
  • Develop Audit Planning Memorandums (APMs), defining audit objectives, scope, risks, and audit approach.
  • Design and implement audit programs and procedures aligned to Group Internal Audit methodology and professional standards.
  • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of IT general controls, application controls, cybersecurity controls, and technology governance frameworks.
  • Evaluate major technology initiatives and systems under development to ensure appropriate governance, controls, documentation, and security-by-design.
  • Provide independent assurance over cybersecurity risk management, including protection of networks, cloud environments, systems, and sensitive data.
  • Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations, industry standards, and Singtel policies (e.g. data protection, cybersecurity, technology risk).
  • Identify emerging technology risks and assess Singtel’s control maturity and risk posture.
  • Perform control advisory reviews for significant in-flight programs and strategic initiatives where required.
  • Identify root causes of control deficiencies and develop practical, commercially grounded recommendations.
  • Prepare high-quality audit reports with minimal supervision and ensure alignment and agreement of findings with senior management.
  • Lead audit kick-off and closing meetings with senior executives, ensuring clear communication of objectives, scope, findings, and risk implications.
  • Provide clear, credible challenge to senior stakeholders while maintaining strong professional relationships and audit independence.
  • Escalate significant or high-risk matters to the Audit Director and support Audit Committee reporting.
  • Coach, train, and review the work of less experienced auditors, embedding audit methodology, quality standards, and professional judgement.
  • Provide technical leadership in technology and cybersecurity auditing across the function.
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of technology audit methodology, tools, and practices.
  • Oversee tracking and validation of management action plans and perform follow-up reviews to ensure timely and effective remediation.
  • Support annual audit planning, resource management, and prioritisation of technology audit coverage.
  • Contribute to ad-hoc assignments, investigations, and Audit Committee-related matters as required.
  • Stay current on emerging technology, cybersecurity threats, and industry developments, applying insights to strengthen audit coverage and impact.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, or CIA.
  • Extensive experience in technology audit, IT risk, cybersecurity, or internal audit, preferably within large, complex organisations.
  • Strong understanding of telecommunications, digital platforms, and large-scale technology environments.
  • Hands-on experience auditing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern architectures.

Rewards that Go Beyond

job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

As an experienced Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy end-to-end, AI-native applications. You will own the entire feature lifecycle—from designing intuitive frontend user interfaces that handle streaming AI data, to building robust backend architectures, orchestrating complex LLM or agentic workflows, and managing vector databases and cloud infrastructure. You are a generalist with architectural breadth and deep specialization in applying AI to practical software challenges.

Make an Impact by:

  • Applied AI & Intelligent Orchestration
  • Orchestration & Workflow Design: Build complex multi-agent frameworks, task routing systems, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows using orchestration engines like LangChain or LangGraph.
  • RAG & Vector Management: Architect high-performance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Design indexing strategies, chunking mechanisms, and hybrid search (semantic + keyword) utilizing vector databases.
  • Model Integration & Optimization: Integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and foundational models via commercial APIs or self-hosted inference setups. Implement strategies to manage model latency, token constraints, context windows, and fallback mechanisms.
  • Evaluation & Guardrails: Establish AI evaluation frameworks to test for hallucinations, drift, and accuracy. Implement prompt safety, structural validation, and robust guardrails to handle non-deterministic outputs safely.
  • Full-Stack Application Architecture
  • Backend & API Engineering: Design high-concurrency, asynchronous backend services using Python (FastAPI) or Node.js/TypeScript. Develop robust RESTful APIs and optimize interactions using Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems where applicable.
  • AI-Native Frontend Experiences: Build responsive, stateful UIs using React or Next.js. Implement streaming response interfaces (HTTP Stream), chat architectures, agentic UI interaction models, and intuitive data visualizations for complex model outputs.
  • Data Management: Design relational schemas and manage transactional data workflows using databases like PostgreSQL, while pairing them seamlessly with unstructured data pipelines.
  • Infrastructure
  • Containerization & Deployment: Package application layers using Docker
  • Cloud Architecture: Architect scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions across cloud ecosystems like AWS or Azure
  • CI/CD & Observability: Build automated deployment and test pipelines (e.g., Bitbucket & Bamboo). Implement advanced logging, error tracing, and observability tooling to monitor both typical software failures and LLM costs/latencies.

Skills for Success:

Technical Skill Matrix

  • Category: Core Skills & Technologies
  • AI / LLM Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini APIs
  • Vector Databases: pgvector (PostgreSQL), Azure AI Search
  • Backend Engineering:Python (FastAPI), Node.js, Java, TypeScript, API Gateway
  • Frontend Engineering: React, Next.js, State Management (Zustand/Redux), SSE/WebSockets
  • Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS S3 / Cloud Storage
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Azure, Docker, CI/CD Monitoring (OpenTelemetry)

job.title: Senior Specialist, Radio Network Engrg
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

The Senior Specialist, Radio Network Engineering is responsible for evaluating, validating, and introducing new Radio Access Network (RAN) technologies and features to support the company's network evolution strategy. The role drives the technical assessment of emerging radio technologies through standards analysis, laboratory testing, feature evaluation, field trials, and commercial readiness activities, ensuring new capabilities deliver measurable improvements in network performance, spectrum efficiency, energy consumption, and customer experience.

  • Evaluate emerging RAN technologies, vendor solutions, and 3GPP Releases (e.g., Release 17, Release 18/5G-Advanced and Release 19 features) to support network evolution and technology roadmap planning.
  • Review and assess new 3GPP specifications and industry developments, including AI/ML for RAN optimisation, Ambient IoT, Reduced Capability (RedCap) devices, Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN), Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC), XR optimisation, enhanced Massive MIMO, network energy-saving features, and multi-antenna enhancements.
  • Conduct technical evaluation of new RAN software features, hardware platforms, and vendor releases, including capabilities such as 5G Carrier Aggregation enhancements, MIMO enhancements, Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS), uplink enhancements, network slicing support, positioning services (NR Positioning), and energy-saving functions.
  • Develop, execute, and manage laboratory validation plans to verify feature functionality, interoperability, performance, stability, and standards compliance prior to field deployment.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute Proof of Concept (PoC), interoperability testing, pilot deployments, and field trials, including defining objectives, KPIs, success criteria, and performance evaluation methodologies.
  • Support commercial rollout of approved radio technologies by developing deployment strategies, implementation guidelines, operational readiness documentation, and rollout acceptance criteria.
  • Analyse trial, benchmarking, and post-deployment performance data to identify improvement opportunities and recommend optimisation or corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with Radio Planning, Optimisation, Core Network, Transport, Device, OSS, Automation, and Operations teams, as well as equipment vendors, to ensure successful end-to-end technology introduction.
  • Engage equipment vendors to assess product roadmaps, software maturity, interoperability, and implementation plans, ensuring alignment with the company's network strategy and 3GPP standards evolution.
  • Prepare technical reports, engineering recommendations, standards impact assessments, deployment documentation, and executive presentations to support engineering governance and investment decisions.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 6–8 years of experience in mobile radio network engineering, RAN planning, optimisation, technology introduction, or network performance.
  • Hands-on experience in evaluating, testing, and deploying LTE and 5G NR features.
  • Experience conducting laboratory validation, interoperability testing, field trials, and commercial rollout of radio technologies.
  • Experience working with radio equipment vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of LTE, LTE-Advanced, and 5G NR radio technologies and architecture.
  • Ability to interpret and assess 3GPP specifications and translate standards into deployment requirements.
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methodologies, feature validation, troubleshooting, and KPI analysis.
  • Knowledge of radio performance metrics, RF engineering principles, and network optimization

job.title: AI Enablement Manager (APAC) SMBG Governance and Enablement
job.description:
Meta's Small and Medium Business Group (SMBG) contributes directly to Meta's mission by connecting every small and medium business in the world with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger, and then helping them grow through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, commerce and many other tools. SMBG is one of two sales channels responsible for Meta's multi-billion dollar advertising business, supporting 1,000+ frontline sellers through Mid-Market Account Managers and external vendor partners globally.

The AI Enablement Manager is responsible for driving AI proficiency, AI-native enablement delivery, and AI-powered operational infrastructure across SMBG's 1,000+ frontline sellers spanning Small Business Solutions and Mid-Market segments. This role owns three distinct mandates: (1) Enabling proficiency WITH AI tools — driving skilled adoption of Meta's AI tool ecosystem, (2) Enabling THROUGH AI tools — architecting a unified, just-in-time enablement system that delivers the right information to sellers where they already spend time, replacing fragmented stand-and-deliver training with a governed push/pull model that personalizes by role, region, and segment, (3) AI Operations — using AI to run the enablement function itself, including how requests come in and get prioritized, how much we're asking of sellers at any one time, keeping content accurate as tools change, and spotting gaps early, and (4) Regional Enablement Partnership (~25%) — serving as the in-region enablement support for the Mid-Market APAC team, driving alignment with Sales Intelligence (SI) priorities, accelerating adoption in-market, capturing regional feedback, and ensuring APAC sellers receive timely, contextualized support that accounts for local market dynamics.

Sitting on the Sales Intelligence Governance & Enablement team, this role is a critical bridge between AI program managers, sales leadership, and frontline sellers — translating rapid product evolution into measurable behavior change at scale. ensuring regional needs shape global priorities while global programs land effectively in-market. The work is in close partnership with cross-functional teams including AI product teams and program managers, Sales Planning & Operations, Mid-Market APAC leadership, and regional sales teams.

A successful candidate will have a proven track record of driving AI adoption in large, distributed sales organizations and will be adept at designing both enablement programs and operational systems that scale without linear headcount. They will bring editorial judgment — the discipline to keep enablement brief, high-quality, and worth a seller's time: the discipline to keep enablement brief, high-quality, and worth a seller's time in an environment where AI makes it trivial to produce more content than anyone will read. They will be as willing to cut and consolidate as to create. They will be comfortable operating in a fast-moving AI landscape where the tool ecosystem evolves weekly, and will lead through influence in a highly cross-functional and matrixed environment. They will thrive as a regional node in a global team — proactively surfacing what APAC needs, translating global initiatives for local context, and building trust as the go-to SI resource for the Mid-Market APAC team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead AI adoption strategy across SMBG (Small Business Solutions and Mid-Market), driving the organization from current proficiency levels toward full AI-native operations across all segments and regions
  • Design, develop, and deliver AI enablement programs, including recurring protected learning time, role-based curriculum, and adoption of validated workflows, that build real competency rather than tool awareness and result in measurable seller behavior change
  • Evaluate adoption data, behavioral trends, and seller sentiment to diagnose gaps and drive continuous improvement across segments
  • Source and scale what's already working — run a mechanism to identify strong practices emerging in regions and teams, package them to a consistent standard, and promote them org-wide in partnership with regional leads and the SME and champion network
  • Architect a unified push/pull enablement system that consolidates fragmented tools into a single mechanism — delivering governance, product updates, training reinforcement, and operational guidance through AI-powered assistants and conversational tools where sellers already spend time
  • Design the content governance layer: a governed knowledge base with defined owners, update cadence, and review process that ensures sellers always receive accurate, current information
  • Build personalization capabilities that surface the right content based on who the seller is — role, region, segment, and vertical — without requiring manual curation per audience
  • Implement learning reinforcement through AI: training-aware triggers (post-session recaps, follow-ups for missed sessions), knowledge checks, and spaced reinforcement that replaces one-time delivery with continuous learning
  • Create feedback loops that track what sellers are asking and surface themes back to SI — turning seller demand signals into enablement priorities
  • Coordinate cross-channel (Global Business Group, Mid-Market, Enterprise, SBS) to prevent tool/skill fragmentation and ensure a single, scalable architecture
  • Bring structure to how AI enablement demand comes in and gets prioritized, applying automation where it removes manual triage, so it is clear what is being asked, what is already covered, and what needs a place on the roadmap
  • Manage seller mindshare as a finite resource, maintaining a single view of what AI enablement is asking of sellers in a given period and coordinating with the wider enablement, comms, and program teams so competing asks are sequenced rather than stacked
  • Operate the content lifecycle that keeps the enablement system trustworthy: detecting tool changes and flagging outdated assets, so content is corrected before a seller acts on it
  • Detect where sellers are getting stuck by drawing on the issues they raise and how they are actually using the tools — diagnose whether the cause is missing guidance, the wrong tool for the job, or a product gap, so each is routed to the team that can fix it
  • Replace manual trackers with reporting that is generated rather than maintained by hand, surfacing enablement health, adoption trends, seller sentiment, and governance compliance on demand from source systems
  • Serve as the primary SI enablement point of contact for Mid-Market APAC leadership — attending regional forums, joining key calls, and maintaining a continuous feedback loop between APAC sellers and the global SI team
  • Drive alignment of SI priorities in-region: ensure APAC teams understand upcoming launches, governance changes, and enablement initiatives, and that rollout timelines account for APAC-specific constraints (time zones, local market nuance)
  • Accelerate workflow adoption in APAC by contextualizing global enablement programs for regional relevance — adapting examples, use cases, and workflows to reflect APAC advertiser dynamics and seller workflows
  • Surface regional adoption gaps, seller friction, and unmet needs back to the global SI team with clear signal and proposed action — acting as APAC's voice in global prioritization
  • Partner with APAC Mid-Market leadership to identify region-specific champion sellers and build a local SME network that amplifies best practices and peer learning within the region

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 8+ years of experience in sales enablement, L&D, sales operations, or program management
  • 2+ years of experience applying AI, automation, or technology-driven approaches to scale enablement or operational processes
  • Project management experience and experience running strategic programs with cross-functional teams
  • Strong communicator with experience in facilitation across all levels — skilled at addressing both large and small audiences across multiple leadership levels and functions
  • Experience enabling large, distributed sales organizations (500+ people) including outsourced vendor partners across multiple regions and time zones
  • Experience building or improving operational systems and processes (intake workflows, prioritization frameworks, governance pipelines)
  • Experience dealing with ambiguity, rapid change, and unstructured problems
  • Open, collaborative and proven team player, with experience in initiating and driving projects to completion with minimal guidance or support

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with change management at scale during organizational transformations
  • Data fluency — able to pull adoption metrics, build dashboards, and translate data into action
  • Experience designing operational infrastructure using AI/automation (workflow orchestration, automated intake, intelligent routing)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Hands-on creative production capability — able to independently produce polished, consistent enablement assets at speed, such as short-form video, animation, visual explainers, or interactive micro-learning, without dependency on a dedicated creative team
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as an effective regional node within a globally distributed team — building trust, driving local adoption, and representing regional needs in global forums
  • Background in sales enablement for BPO/vendor ecosystems with multi-tier governance needs
  • Experience working in or closely with APAC sales teams, with understanding of regional market dynamics, advertiser ecosystems, and cultural nuances across key APAC markets
  • Knowledge of the advertising marketplace and ad products
  • Familiarity with tools like enterprise AI assistants and LLM-powered sales tools, such as conversational assistants embedded in CRM or sales workflow platforms
  • Experience building or managing AI-native knowledge systems (chatbots, LLM-powered agents, skill-based automation, push/pull content delivery)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC)
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

NTT is currently looking for a Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC). The Vice President, Regional Construction is a key executive role reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Construction. The successful candidate will have direct accountability for the design, supply chain and construction organizations in the region responsible for capital infrastructure investment. This role will provide strategic direction and leadership to enable and execute projects within specified timelines, budgets, and quality standards to enable the regional business goals of the company.

This is a full time remote role based in Malaysia, Singapore or Thailand.

What we are looking for

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans for the construction, design and supply chain organizations, aligning with the Global Infrastructure Development (GID) organization's overall goals, the business goals in the region and industry trends/best practices. Identify opportunities for growth, speed to market improvement, and cost optimization.
  • Team Leadership: Manage a team of construction, design and supply chain professionals, including project managers, engineers, architects, commercial managers, etc. Foster a collaborative and high-performing work environment, promoting teamwork and individual development.
  • Regional Leadership: Be the in-region leader of the broader GID team which includes the construction, design and supply chain organizations, but also global teams with in-region resources (safety, power, land, project controls and front end engineering).
  • Project Management: Ensure proper project management is occurring from initiation to completion, ensuring adherence to project plans, schedules, and budgets. Monitor progress, identify potential risks, and implement mitigation strategies as necessary.
  • Vendor and Contractor Management: Monitors the performance of general contractors, architects/engineers and other suppliers to ensure compliance, execution, quality, and safety standards.
  • Supply Base Development: Personally engage with the key principals of supply chain partners to develop a supply chain that can reliably support the business needs of the company in the region.
  • Budgeting and Financial Management: Liaisons with project controls on project funding plans, necessary financial forecasts and reports.
  • Quality Assurance: Work with CX/Quality team to ensure adherence to quality assurance and commissioning programs and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including sales, operations, clients and regulatory authorities. Communicate project updates, resolve issues, and maintain positive relationships with all parties involved.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, building codes, safety regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex construction projects on time and within budget.
  • Ability to build a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
  • Strong financial acumen and experience in budgeting, cost control, and financial analysis.
  • Proficiency in project management software, construction management tools, and MS Office suite.
  • Understanding of design and engineering.
  • Proven experience in implementing processes in a rapid growth environment
  • Knowledgeable of the basics necessary for operating in compliance where NTT is located.
  • Knowledgeable of the key supply chain operating concepts, executive relationships with supply chain partners in the region and claims management.
  • Knowledgeable of construction law and contracts.
  • Skilled at creating and maintaining a collaborative design/construction/operations environment in a global culture.

ACEDEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field. Master's degree (beneficial).

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Extensive experience (15+ years) in construction management, preferably in a leadership role within the construction industry. Ideally experience with design and supply chain sourcing in addition to construction.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Remain stationery for long periods of time.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Perform work during regional business hours and time zones with flexibility for global coordination.

WORK CONDITIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Travel required up to 50%.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

1\. Export Shipment and Collateral Management

This section focuses on operational oversight and documentation accuracy for technical products.

  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and proactively communicate product-related risks that could impact export timelines, such as regulatory compliance issues or last-minute design changes.

Job Description

  • Execute plans to increase market share and share of wallet in accordance with company targets for orders, revenue, and profitability, under the guidance of senior leadership.
  • Develop a strong understanding of key customers' priorities, challenges, and business objectives.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive account plans to achieve sales targets and revenue growth for assigned strategic accounts across the region.
  • Establish and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within customer organisations.
  • Understand customer requirements and collaborate with internal teams to tailor solutions that meet their specific needs, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Work closely with internal functions, including Marketing, Product Management, and Operations, to align strategies, deliver value, and provide seamless support to key accounts.
  • Analyse market trends, competitor activity, and industry developments to identify new business opportunities and recommend growth initiatives.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with key accounts, providing insights, performance updates, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions with customers, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that comply with company policies and profitability objectives.
  • Manage and resolve customer issues or disputes that may arise, maintaining open communication and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
  • Prepare accurate and timely reports, forecasts, and updates on key account activities, highlighting progress, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Remain up to date with industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance expertise and identify innovative strategies and best practices.
  • Contribute to medium and long-term strategies to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and recognition of Vertiv's capabilities, expertise, and technology leadership among targeted accounts.
  • Recommend new practices, processes, and performance measures to improve account management effectiveness and sales outcomes.
  • Act as a mentor to less experienced colleagues where appropriate, sharing knowledge and best practices to support team development.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline; an MBA would be advantageous.
  • Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in strategic account management, business development, or strategic sales, ideally within the technology, manufacturing, logistics, or industrial solutions sectors.
  • Proven track record of managing large, complex, multi-country accounts across the Asia region.
  • Demonstrated success in achieving sales objectives, driving revenue growth, and increasing share of wallet within strategic customer accounts.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and digital account management tools.

Skills & Competencies

  • Highly driven, proactive, and adaptable, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively within a fast-paced regional environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen with a sound understanding of B2B sales cycles, negotiation, and contract management.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and build credibility with senior decision-makers.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate customer insights into actionable account strategies and process improvements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret market data, industry trends, and competitive intelligence.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in English; proficiency in additional Asian languages, such as Mandarin, Japanese, or Korean, would be advantageous.
  • Highly collaborative, with the ability to work effectively across functions to deliver customer-focused, value-driven solutions.
  • Ability to work independently on key initiatives whilst consulting with management to ensure alignment on priorities and desired outcomes.

Job Summary

The AutoCAD HVAC & Revit Draftsman/Designer is responsible for preparing detailed HVAC engineering drawings, layouts, and 3D BIM models using AutoCAD and Revit software. The role involves supporting the design, installation, and commissioning teams by developing accurate drawings in compliance with project specifications, industry standards, and customer requirements.

  • Generate shop drawings, installation drawings, as-built drawings, and fabrication drawings.
  • Create HVAC schematics, mechanical room layouts, and equipment schedules.
  • Prepare BOQ support drawings and material quantity take-offs.

BIM & Revit Modeling

  • Develop 3D HVAC models for commercial, industrial, and data center projects.
  • Perform clash detection and coordination with electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and architectural teams.
  • Update and modify BIM models based on project revisions and site feedback.
