job.title: Account Manager - (TBTC Maroochydore QLD)
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

9 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Account Manager - (TBTC Maroochydore QLD)

Job Summary

Job Description

What is the focus of the role?

As a Telstra Business Technology Centre (TBTC) Account Manager, your primary focus will be to drive growth and enhance customer satisfaction among small to medium business customers across all technology platforms. This role will have a portfolio of customers to build individual relationships with and help grow., The role encompasses both sales and service responsibilities in face to face, over the phone, video and email formats ensuring a holistic approach to customer relationship management.

About the team

Telstra Business Sales is a growth engine for Telstra, focused on providing business customers of all sizes with industry-based services and solutions.

We meet a critical need in the market – combining connectivity infrastructure across the world with the leading technology solutions and expertise.

The Telstra Business Technology Centre channel is a unique component of the Telstra Business Sales segment. The channel is comprised of 25 physical locations across Australia. The TBTCs provide customers with flexibility of visiting on site, over the phone, via email or video conference, with one, consistent Account Manager for all of their needs. This is extremely unique compared to other channels and creates an exciting role for those interested in business account management.

The role with us

As an Account Manager in TBTC, you support the development of deep customer relationships, managing your own defined portfolio of accounts and delivering technology solutions to small and medium businesses. This role is critical to maintaining strong customer relationships that grow the reputation and sales performance of the TBTC.

This is a full-time on-site role that will be based in TBTC Maroochydore QLD.

What You’ll Do

As an Account Manager, you apply your relationship building, sales and organizational skills to deliver the following responsibilities:

  • Take ownership for managing relevant customer relationships to support ongoing development, drive customer satisfaction and sales objectives for the defined portfolio.
  • Contribute to implementing the segment and portfolio strategy (including outbound call campaigns) to support the retention and growth of customer portfolios.
  • Take accountability for managing inbound/outbound customer sales and service contracts, exploring sales opportunities, responding to queries, resolving issues and escalating complaints or complex leads to experienced team members as required, to ensure timely remediation and positive customer experiences.
  • Authentically collaborate with peers, team members and key stakeholders across the TBTC channel (e.g. Field Sales Team and internal Telstra team and partners) to support the identification and qualification of leads.
  • Participate in customer initiatives such as developing and maintaining relevant account and portfolio plans that support ongoing relationship development and contribute to the achievement of financial and customer targets (revenue, profitability, NPS) & exceptional customer data quality.
  • Meet individual and team sales and performance KPIs.
  • Continue to upskill and develop capability and knowledge across Telstra’s portfolio of products and business solutions.
  • Participate in individual or group coaching and feedback conversations.

About You

  • Demonstrated ability and performance in an ICT or Telco Sales roles.
  • Understand and relate to Small and Medium Business customers.
  • Understand technology essential in running a business effectively.
  • Proven experience in both cold and warm calling and engaging with potential or existing customers.
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships through effective communication and follow-up.
  • Enjoys coaching and development from leaders.

Ready to connect with your next career move?

If this sounds like the perfect fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Please attach your resume/cv when applying to allow for a more thorough review of your qualifications and experience.

job.description:

Job Title

Senior Security Advisor

Job Summary

As a Senior Cyber Security Advisor, you will play a critical role in Telstra’s Global Networks & Technology – Security & Operations team, driving enterprise-wide security outcomes through strategic engagement and technical leadership. You are accountable for establishing and maintaining strong, collaborative relationships with key stakeholders across Cyber Assurance engagements—including Group Owners, Technical Product Owners, and internal business units.

Your focus will be on enabling secure delivery of business missions by providing expert guidance, simplifying complex security challenges, and ensuring alignment with Telstra’s risk and compliance frameworks. Working within Security & Operations, the role leads end-to-end security engagements, coordinates assurance activities, and drives continuous improvement across cybersecurity processes. The Senior Cyber Security Advisor provides expert advice on security controls, risk treatment, and governance, while fostering a strong security culture and enabling the safe delivery of strategic business initiatives. The position requires significant experience in cybersecurity, risk management, and operational improvement, supported by strong communication, leadership, and influencing skills.

Job Description

Who We Are

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

This includes making Telstra the place you want to work. For you, that means a having career that grows with you and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises wellbeing and choice.

Focus of the Role As a Senior Cyber Security Advisor, you will play a critical role in Telstra’s Global Networks & Technology – Security & Operations team, driving enterprise-wide security outcomes through strategic engagement and technical leadership. You are accountable for establishing and maintaining strong, collaborative relationships with key stakeholders across Cyber Assurance engagements—including Group Owners, Technical Product Owners, and internal business units.

Your focus will be on enabling secure delivery of business missions by providing expert guidance, simplifying complex security challenges, and ensuring alignment with Telstra’s risk and compliance frameworks.

What We Offer

Performance-related pay Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.

Purchased annual leave scheme

Additional Telstra day off

Additional 30% off Telstra products and services

Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for)

What You’ll Do

  • Act as a trusted security advisor to business and technology stakeholders.
  • Lead and support security assessments, assurance activities, and risk reviews.
  • Provide practical, risk-based security recommendations aligned with security and compliance frameworks.
  • Drive security-by-design principles and promote cybersecurity awareness.
  • Improve security processes, governance, standards, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support the adoption of security tools, capabilities, and frameworks.
  • Develop security guidance, procedures, templates, and playbooks.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills.
  • Experience creating standards, procedures, and operational documentation.

job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across 270 cities in 45 countries.

Job Description

Job Responsibilities

  • Manage sustainability initiatives and engineering projects, including but not limited to solar photovoltaic (PV) installations, M&E enhancement works, smart building technologies, and environmental sustainability programs.
  • Coordinate with operations teams, business units, and stakeholders to ensure accurate collection, validation, and reporting of utility and sustainability data. Support GRESB submissions, sustainability disclosures, and periodic reporting of CapitaLand sustainability targets and performance indicators.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement innovative technologies and sustainability solutions to improve energy efficiency, water conservation, waste management, and recycling performance across the portfolio.
  • Conduct feasibility studies, pilot trials, technical assessments, and performance evaluations of emerging technologies, and oversee project execution from planning through implementation.
  • Collaborate with corporate functions, operations teams, vendors, consultants, and external stakeholders to develop and drive sustainability, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze operational performance and sustainability metrics, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and recommend strategies to enhance environmental performance and resource efficiency.
  • Prepare management reports, business cases, presentations, and recommendations for project approvals and stakeholder decision-making.
  • Undertake any other duties and projects as assigned by manager.

Requirements

  • Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in sustainability, engineering, facilities management, green building initiatives, or the built environment sector.
  • Familiarity with green building certifications, sustainability reporting frameworks, energy management, and environmental regulations.
  • Strong project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently.
  • Effective interpersonal, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Experience with sustainability data analytics and reporting tools will be an advantage.

job.title: Production Scheduler
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Production Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to generate a detailed production schedule based on the production plan to maximize the use of resources and meet established production specifications and schedules. Each day, you will feed information on production capacity issues and material availability. You will also showcase your expertise by releasing manufacturing work orders.

The work model for the role is: #LI – Onsite

This role is contributing to the Automation – Energy division in-Bangalore-Nelamangala region in India.. Main stakeholders are production, Procurement, Inventory, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance teams, and Vendors.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Developed and managed production schedules to meet customer delivery requirements and production targets.
  • Executed daily MRP activities to ensure material availability and seamless production planning.
  • Defined production sequences, routing, and lead times to align with the master production schedule.
  • Monitored actual versus planned production, identified deviations, and implemented corrective actions.
  • Managed production orders and coordinated shop floor operations to optimize productivity and resource utilization.
  • Controlled raw material, WIP, and finished goods inventory to maintain optimum stock levels and production continuity.
  • Maintained BOMs in SAP/ERP systems and generated MIS/KPI reports to support planning and performance management.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Communication (ECE), Mechanical, Instrumentation, or related engineering disciplines.
  • Possess 2-5 years of experience in Production Planning, Scheduling, Manufacturing Operations, Inventory Management, or related functions within OEM and manufacturing environments.
  • Strong knowledge of production planning, inventory control, shop floor operations, Material Requirement Planning (MRP), production scheduling, and capacity planning processes.
  • Hands-on experience working with SAP/ERP systems, Bill of Materials (BOM), production orders, and manufacturing execution processes to support operational efficiency.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions such as VLOOKUP and HLOOKUP, with the ability to prepare MIS reports, KPI dashboards, and production performance analytics.
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 quality standards, Kaizen methodologies, and continuous improvement practices within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and vendor coordination skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and support business requirements, including up to 10% travel.

More about us:

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and thrive in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain experience delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

ABB never asks for payment from job applicants. All genuine job offers follow a formal application and interview process.

View current job openings and apply at: [https://careers.abb/global/en/home](https://careers.abb/global/en/home)

For more information, read our full fraud warning notice at: [https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning](https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning)

job.title: Software Engineer, Content Safety, Core
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Content Safety organization in Core provides safety solutions that protect Google’s users from exposure to offensive, sensitive or harmful content. The team unblock and accelerate Google's product launches by providing quality implementations of company-wide standards for Responsible Artificial Intelligence (AI). The team combines subject matter expertise in the content safety domain and a practice of machine learning and AI-based techniques with the production-grade experience in serving infrastructure and product integrations to protect users from harm, maintain Google’s engagement in the area of online safety across the industry, and make foundational models and the internet safer for society.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Write and maintain high-quality, readable, and well-tested code for on-device and server-side content safety applications.
  • Develop and test validation gates, routing logic, and tool-use schemas to ensure deterministic and compliant execution within our autonomous safety agent pipelines.
  • Contribute to implementing and maintaining both stateless and stateful agentic flows, supporting multi-step AI orchestration pipelines that interact with Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), databases, and external tools to automate safety decisions.
  • Support the team in delivering on commitments to clients, ensuring robust and performant solutions to user protection challenges.
  • Collaborate closely with mentors and executive engineers to learn Google’s development processes, design patterns, and system architectures.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Analytical Lead, Planning and Measurement, Large Customer Sales
job.description:
About the job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

The Planning & Measurement team at Google is a critical part of our advertising business, ensuring that our clients understand the value and impact of their campaigns. We're searching for a passionate and experienced Analytical Lead to join our team and help drive better measurement practices across a portfolio of clients in e-commerce, gaming and travel.

In this role, you'll be a trusted advisor and consultant, working closely with both internal teams and external clients to develop and implement robust measurement strategies. You will leverage Google's cutting-edge data and technology to provide actionable insights that improve advertising effectiveness and drive business results.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Build strong relationships with key client stakeholders, understanding their business objectives and measurement needs. Partner closely with Google Sales teams, Product teams, and Engineering teams to ensure alignment and drive product innovation.
  • Craft media plan guidance (across performance and brand) in accordance with customer business objectives. Stay aware of industry trends and best practices in measurement, sharing knowledge and insights with clients and internal stakeholders through presentations, workshops, and thought leadership content.
  • Develop customized measurement frameworks and roadmaps for clients, encompassing a range of methodologies and Google's measurement solutions

job.title: Software Engineering Manager, Content Safety, Productionization
job.description:
About the job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

The Content Safety organization in Core provides safety solutions that protect Google’s users from exposure to offensive, sensitive or harmful content. The team combines subject matter expertise in the content safety domain and a practice of machine learning and AI-based techniques with the production-grade experience in serving infrastructure and product integrations to protect users from harm, maintain Google’s engagement in the area of online safety across the industry, and make foundational models and the internet safer for society.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate team priorities that support the organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams.
  • Set expectations with people based on their level and role and align to the organization's goals. Meet regularly with people to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching.
  • Develop the technical goals and roadmap within the scope of the teams. Evolve the roadmap to meet future requirements and infrastructure needs.
  • Design, build, maintain and scale content safety solutions to safeguard business-critical products for Google.
  • Protect users from exposures to offensive, sensitive or harmful content, and unlock new opportunities for the business.

Android is Google’s mobile operating system powering more than 3 billion devices worldwide. Android is about bringing computing to everyone in the world. job.title: Data Center Technician, Global Server Operations
job.description:
About the job

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions.
  • Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and apply the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards.
  • Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting.
  • Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions and limited guidance.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Building Technologies

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. As a global leader in HVAC, building automation, energy efficiency, and decarbonization solutions, we help customers operate some of the world's most critical facilities, including hospitals, data centres, universities, pharmaceutical sites, and advanced manufacturing environments.

For over 140 years, Johnson Controls has been delivering innovative solutions that improve building performance, enhance efficiency, and create better outcomes for our customers and communities. Today, our people continue to lead the way through cutting-edge technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Service HVAC Technician to join our Sunshine Coast team, based in Warana.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technician looking to work on a diverse range of commercial HVAC systems while enjoying the lifestyle benefits of the Sunshine Coast. You'll be supported by a highly experienced national technical network and have access to industry-leading training, development, and career opportunities.

Whether you're currently servicing commercial HVAC systems, working with chillers, refrigeration, or mechanical services, this role offers the chance to broaden your technical expertise and grow your career with a global organisation.

Why Technicians Choose Johnson Controls

  • Work-life balance with flexibility built into our culture
  • Variety of work across commercial, healthcare, education, industrial, and critical infrastructure sites
  • Access to advanced technology, systems, and equipment
  • Ongoing technical training and industry-recognised development programs
  • Opportunities to expand into Chillers, Building Management Systems (BMS), Controls, and specialised solutions
  • RDO or overtime options to suit your lifestyle and earning goals
  • Career pathways locally, nationally, and globally
  • Strong team culture backed by one of the world's leading building technology companies

What You'll Be Doing

  • Service, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair commercial HVAC equipment
  • Diagnose faults and provide practical, customer-focused solutions
  • Complete preventative and reactive maintenance activities
  • Install, commission, and test HVAC systems and components
  • Provide technical support and recommendations to customers
  • Maintain accurate service reports and compliance documentation
  • Collaborate with a skilled team of technicians and technical specialists
  • Ensure all work is completed safely and in accordance with industry regulations

What You'll Bring

  • Certificate III in Air Conditioning & Refrigeration (or equivalent)
  • Queensland Restricted Electrical Licence (minimum requirement)
  • Experience servicing and maintaining commercial HVAC systems
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • A customer-focused approach and excellent communication skills
  • Current driver's licence
  • Commitment to workplace safety and quality workmanship

What's On Offer

  • Competitive salary package
  • Company vehicle and tools of trade
  • Ongoing training, certifications, and professional development
  • Exposure to leading-edge HVAC and smart building technologies
  • Supportive leadership and collaborative team environment
  • Long-term career security with a global industry leader

About Johnson Controls Australia

Johnson Controls operates one of Australia's largest HVAC and building services networks, supporting customers nationwide with innovative solutions that improve performance, sustainability, and reliability. Our technicians are at the forefront of delivering critical services that keep buildings operating efficiently and safely.

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

If you're looking for more variety, greater technical exposure, stronger career development, and the backing of a global leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and take the next step in your HVAC career with Johnson Controls on the Sunshine Coast.

Applicants must have full Australian working rights. Pre-employment checks, including medical, reference, police, and drug & alcohol screening, will be required as part of the recruitment process.

job.title: BMS Service Technician
job.description:
Build Your Career. Enjoy the Lifestyle.

Imagine advancing your career while living in one of Australia's most sought-after coastal destinations. With stunning beaches, year-round sunshine, a relaxed lifestyle, and a growing economy, the Sunshine Coast offers the perfect balance between professional growth and quality of life.

At Johnson Controls (JCI), you'll join a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, working on industry-leading building automation technologies while enjoying the lifestyle that makes the Sunshine Coast such a desirable place to call home.

About Johnson Controls

For over 140 years, Johnson Controls has been helping customers create smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable buildings. As a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, we help organizations optimize performance, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with greater resilience across industries such as healthcare, data centers, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and we're committed to creating opportunities where careers thrive.

About the Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Building Automation Service Technician to join our established and high-performing Sunshine Coast Service Team.

In this role, you'll service, maintain, and optimize complex building automation systems across a diverse portfolio of commercial customer sites, helping to deliver smarter and more energy-efficient buildings.

What's in it for You?

  • Competitive salary package plus fully maintained company vehicle
  • Choice of RDOs or overtime opportunities
  • Genuine commitment to work-life balance and flexibility
  • Access to internal remote technical support from industry experts
  • Structured technical training and ongoing professional development
  • The opportunity to work with industry-leading building automation technologies
  • Career development pathways within a global organization, including leadership and management opportunities
  • Enjoy living and working on the beautiful Sunshine Coast

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, commission, and program building automation and control systems
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical faults efficiently
  • Service and maintain installed systems across existing customer sites
  • Conduct preventative maintenance and system optimization activities
  • Build strong customer relationships through exceptional service delivery
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards and company procedures

What We're Looking For

You are a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving complex problems and delivering outstanding outcomes.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Electrical Licence or Restricted Electrical Licence
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in building controls following apprenticeship completion
  • Experience with Building Performance and Energy Efficiency solutions
  • Strong understanding of commercial HVAC operations
  • Knowledge of chiller, boiler, and airside plant performance and design requirements
  • Experience with IT systems, network communications, and PC hardware configuration
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Strong commitment to safety, including proactive hazard identification and risk resolution

Grow with JCI

As a global organization, we actively support internal career progression. Whether you're looking to deepen your technical expertise, move into project delivery, explore other business areas, or develop into a leadership role, we'll help you achieve your career goals.

Ready to Apply?

If you're looking for a rewarding technical career with a global leader and want to enjoy everything the Sunshine Coast lifestyle has to offer, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to join Johnson Controls and help create smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, diversity and inclusion are integral to who we are. We foster a culture where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. Our High-Performance Culture encourages innovation, collaboration, and growth, ensuring that everyone has the opportunity to thrive and make a meaningful impact.

You have the power. You have the voice. You have the opportunity to help shape our culture and our future.

job.title: Project Manager (L&D Shared Services)
job.description:
** L&D Shared Services – Project Manager

Job Description

**

What you will do 

Manage end-to-end L&D content delivery projects by owning planning, governance, coordination, execution, tracking, and closure across the project lifecycle. The Project Manager will work closely with internal project coordinators, project leads, instructional designers, QA analysts, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure learning deliverables are delivered on time, within scope, within cost, and with the expected quality. The role requires strong operational discipline, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, intake governance, effort and timeline estimation, reporting, quality governance, analytics-driven planning, conflict resolution, and continuous improvement to support the current L&D Shared Services operating model.

In addition to the above, the Project Manager will be expected to:

Own project governance by managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, stakeholder expectations, and delivery commitments across active projects.

Enable smooth coordination between internal teams, external stakeholders, vendors, IDs, QA analysts, and coordinators to ensure clear handoffs and accountability.

Drive operational excellence through intake tracking, POD updates, vendor workflow governance, reporting hygiene, process documentation, and continuous improvement.

How you will do it 

  • Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, and closure for L&D content development and learning delivery projects.
  • Participate in requirement gathering, clarify scope, define delivery approach, and create phase-wise project and communication plans.
  • Support effort, cost, timeline, and resource estimation to enable realistic delivery commitments and project prioritization.
  • Determine and govern the execution strategy across in-house teams and vendors based on scope, capacity, skills, timelines, and delivery complexity.
  • Partner with project coordinators for internal coordination, trackers, meeting logistics, documentation, and follow-ups.
  • Partner with project leads for external stakeholder coordination, requirement alignment, escalations, and delivery commitments.
  • Manage vendor engagement under the hourly model, including initiation, onboarding inputs, effort tracking, communication, and delivery governance.
  • Coordinate with instructional designers, QA analysts, and vendors to ensure content quality, review cycles, rework tracking, and timely sign-offs.
  • Define and track quality expectations, quality metrics, review outcomes, and QA reporting inputs in partnership with QA stakeholders.
  • Maintain project plans, RACI details, trackers, status reports, action logs, risk logs, and project documentation for transparency and continuity.
  • Provide timely updates through stakeholder meetings, project reviews, dashboards, business reports, success stories, and stakeholder escalation management.
  • Use available analytics, project data, and delivery trends to inform project planning, scope discussions, risks, capacity decisions, and improvement actions.
  • Identify risks, blockers, capacity concerns, scope changes, and dependency issues early; escalate with recommended actions where needed.
  • Resolve conflicts, remove execution barriers, and drive alignment across internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support successful delivery.
  • Drive intake discipline by supporting requirement clarity, prioritization inputs, delivery readiness, and alignment with shared services processes.
  • Evaluate completed projects, capture lessons learned, track feedback, and recommend process improvements to improve speed, quality, cost discipline, and stakeholder experience.
  • Stay informed on L&D trends, authoring standards, and operational best practices to support scalable and relevant learning solutions.

**

Qualification & Experience

  • Graduate or postgraduate degree in business, learning, project management, operations, or a related field.
  • 8–12+ years of experience in project management, learning operations, content development, shared services, or vendor-managed delivery environments.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects across global stakeholders, vendors, instructional design, QA, and operations teams.

Skills

  • Strong project governance, planning, tracking, risk management, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to manage cross-functional work across PM, coordinator, ID, QA, vendor, and business stakeholder groups.
  • Strong estimation and planning skills, including effort, timeline, cost, resource, and phase-wise delivery planning.
  • Project financial and cost governance mindset with the ability to manage multiple projects within agreed timelines, cost expectations, and quality standards.
  • Strong documentation discipline, including project plans, status reports, trackers, action logs, SOPs, and handover notes.
  • Experience with dashboards, reporting governance, analytics, and tools such as Power BI, MS Project, Planner, SharePoint, Excel, and Jira or equivalent tools.
  • Working knowledge of learning content development processes, authoring tools, SCORM/xAPI standards, review cycles, quality metrics, and QA workflows.
  • Vendor management experience, including execution strategy, workflow coordination, effort tracking, communication, issue resolution, and delivery quality checks.
  • Ability to influence without authority, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, drive accountability, and work effectively across time zones.
  • Strong customer orientation with a focus on quality, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Preferred

  • Understanding of instructional design, adult learning principles, learning technologies, and multimedia/content production workflows.
  • Experience working in shared services, GCC, L&D operations, or vendor-partnered delivery models.
  • Familiarity with HVAC, Building Automation, Fire & Security, or similar industrial/technical learning environments.

job.title: Senior Instructional Designer
job.description:
Senior Instructional Designer

What You Will Do

The Senior Instructional Designer will play a key execution-focused role in supporting the Senior Manager, Instructional Design, by driving team priorities, operational initiatives, and delivering business-critical learning projects.

This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role. The role is expected to demonstrate operational leadership by driving priorities, influencing outcomes, and enabling effective execution across peers and project teams.

This role combines instructional design expertise with strong consulting, stakeholder management, and operational leadership capabilities. The successful candidate will be highly accountable, self-directed, and comfortable operating with minimal supervision while driving projects, solving problems, and influencing outcomes across the Instructional Design team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of high-impact learning solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Partner with stakeholders and SMEs to analyze needs, recommend solutions, and drive project execution.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, effectively engaging and influencing senior stakeholders.
  • Support the Instruction Design Manager in driving team priorities, strategic initiatives, and operational excellence programs.
  • Identify challenges proactively, recommend solutions, and independently drive issues to resolution.
  • Establish effective working practices, streamline workflows, and improve team efficiency.
  • Leverage data, metrics, and business insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement
  • Support project governance by proactively managing risks, upholding quality standards, and ensuring on-time delivery through effective collaboration.

What We Look For

Experience

  • 10 - 14 years of experience in Learning Consulting / Learning Experience Design, and Instructional Design
  • Proven experience working with senior business stakeholders in a global environment.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex learning projects and operational initiatives.
  • Experience influencing teams and driving outcomes without formal authority.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent communication skills with an objective and professional communication style.
  • Strong L&D consulting and performance consulting capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive presence.
  • Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Accountability and ownership mindset.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal direction and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple strategic and operational priorities in parallel.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when supporting strategic initiatives
  • Strong project and process management skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Continuous improvement and operational excellence mindset.
  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate:

  • Acts as a learning consultant to stakeholders
  • Demonstrates exceptional ownership, accountability, and execution discipline.
  • Anticipates issues and resolves them proactively.
  • Balances strategy and execution effectively.
  • Influences outcomes through expertise, credibility, and collaboration rather than formal authority
  • Acts as a trusted partner to the Senior Manager Instruction Design and the broader team.

job.title: IT Analyst
job.description:
Job Code:

Job Code Name: IT Analyst

Region:APAC

Country: India

Grade : 170

As a IT Analyst in IAM/Cybersecurity, you will work alongside experienced professionals to support the design, implementation, and operation of enterprise identity and access management and Active Directory solutions. This internship is designed to provide hands-on exposure to IAM technologies, Windows directory services, cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, disaster recovery, and real-world business challenges.

What we look for

  • Support Microsoft Active Directory administration, including user and group management, Organizational Unit (OU) administration, security groups, delegated permissions, and directory services operations.
  • Assist with Domain Controller lifecycle activities, including health monitoring, upgrades, decommissioning, replication validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Participate in Domain Controller promotion and demotion activities, following approved change, security, testing, and validation procedures.
  • Support Active Directory Sites and Services administration, including site and subnet configuration, replication topology review, and site migration activities.
  • Assist with Domain Administrator (DA) role administration, privileged account governance, access reviews, and adherence to least-privilege requirements.
  • Support the implementation and administration of security controls such as Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), privileged access management, and policy enforcement.
  • Assist in creating, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting Group Policy Objects (GPOs) aligned with enterprise security baselines and operational requirements.
  • Support Windows server and identity infrastructure patching activities, including pre-checks, deployment coordination, post-patch validation, and documentation.
  • Participate in vulnerability management activities, including reviewing findings, supporting remediation, validating closure, and maintaining evidence for reporting and compliance.
  • Support Disaster Recovery (DR) exercises for Active Directory and IAM services, including preparation, execution, service restoration validation, issue documentation, and follow-up actions.
  • Participate in monitoring system logs, analyzing security events, and responding to incidents under supervision.
  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, and security teams to troubleshoot authentication, authorization, replication, DNS, and access-related issues.
  • Help document IAM and Active Directory processes, prepare operational reports, and maintain audit and compliance records.
  • Contribute to PowerShell or Python automation for identity lifecycle management, Active Directory administration, health checks, and reporting.
  • Stay current on cybersecurity trends, threats, identity security practices, Windows infrastructure, and enterprise resilience concepts; participate in team knowledge-sharing sessions.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Currently pursuing a master’s degree (M.Tech/M.Sc) in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell & networking concepts.
  • Understanding of Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of Active Directory Domain Services, Domain Controllers, FSMO roles, DNS integration, replication, and health monitoring.
  • Exposure to Domain Controller promotion, demotion, site migration, or recovery activities.
  • Familiarity with Group Policy Management Console (GPMC), GPO configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of Domain Administrator role governance, privileged access management, and least-privilege principles.
  • Awareness of Windows patching, vulnerability management, remediation tracking, and validation processes.
  • Exposure to vulnerability management tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
  • Understanding of Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity concepts and experience supporting a DR exercise.
  • Exposure to PowerShell scripting, automation, or data analysis tools.
  • Certifications (if any): Microsoft, Okta, or other relevant security credentials (optional).

Johnson Controls International plc. is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers.

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Role: Project Manager

Location: Hyderabad Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead and manage project execution activities, ensuring successful delivery of projects within scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in project management, stakeholder coordination, resource planning, and project execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end project execution from project kickoff through completion and handover.
  • Develop project plans, schedules, resource allocation, and execution strategies.
  • Monitor project progress, milestones, risks, and budgets to ensure timely delivery.
  • Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Lead project review meetings and provide regular status updates to stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with quality, safety, and company standards throughout project execution.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks and resolve execution-related challenges.
  • Manage project documentation, reports, contracts, and change requests.
  • Drive effective communication and collaboration among cross-functional teams.

Position: EHS / Safety Officer - IBMSLocation: BangaloreEmployment Type:** Contractual (Based on Business Requirement)

Job Summary We are seeking a proactive and experienced EHS / Safety Officer to support and oversee Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) compliance for IBMS (Integrated Building Management System) projects across Bangalore. The candidate will be responsible for implementing safety programs, conducting site inspections, ensuring statutory compliance, and promoting a strong safety culture across project sites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure implementation of EHS policies, procedures, and safety standards at project sites.
  • Conduct regular safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments for IBMS project activities.
  • Monitor site activities and ensure compliance with statutory, client, and company safety requirements.
  • Develop and implement Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Method Statements, and Risk Assessment documents.
  • Conduct safety induction programs, toolbox talks, and awareness training for employees and contractors.
  • Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by all personnel at site.
  • Coordinate with project managers, site engineers, contractors, and customers on safety-related matters.
  • Maintain EHS records, reports, permits, and compliance documentation.
  • Monitor emergency preparedness and response plans at project sites.
  • Ensure compliance with local safety regulations and industry standards.
  • Promote a proactive safety culture and zero-harm environment.

  • 3 to 8 years of experience in EHS/Safety management.

For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role

We are seeking a strategic and operational leader to oversee Digital Technology across our factories in Asia and the Middle East. This role will lead a regional network of Factory IT Site Leaders and drive standardization, operational excellence, and digital transformation across all plants in scope.

This leader will build a high-performing regional organization of Factory Digital Leaders, ensuring technology becomes a strategic enabler for manufacturing excellence, operational resilience, and business growth. The role partners closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Global Digital COEs, and Business Leadership to define and execute a multi-year digital transformation roadmap aligned with enterprise objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Leadership & Governance

  • Develop and execute the regional Digital Technology strategy aligned with the enterprise manufacturing vision and business priorities.
  • Serve as the trusted technology advisor to regional manufacturing and supply chain leadership.
  • Drive long-term digital transformation initiatives that enable Smart Factory capabilities across the region.
  • Lead technology governance and investment planning to maximize business value.
  • Enforce the EDPS operating model, governance cadence, and performance management framework across all sites.
  • Ensure alignment with global Digital / IT strategy, standards, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Act as the primary escalation and decision point for critical IT incidents impacting factory operations.

2. Standardization & Process Excellence

  • Drive standardized processes across factories spanning production, quality, planning, logistics, and maintenance.
  • Eliminate site-by-site variation by enforcing common templates, architectures, and best practices.
  • Lead cross-site benchmarking to identify optimization opportunities and replicate best practices.
  • Promote Carrier Excellence CX principles in IT processes to improve reliability and efficiency.

3. Digital Transformation & Technology Adoption

  • Partner with global manufacturing and supply chain digital teams to deploy enterprise platforms including MES, ERP, analytics, and related capabilities.
  • Ensure consistent adoption of digital solutions across all sites with measurable business outcomes such as OEE, downtime, cost, and quality.
  • Oversee regional digital roadmap execution and ensure alignment with site priorities and global strategy.
  • Drive training, adoption, and change management across factories.

4. End-to-End Factory Visibility & Insights

  • Establish an end-to-end view of factory operations across the region.
  • Enable standardized data models and reporting frameworks for performance visibility.
  • Ensure integration across systems supporting manufacturing and supply chain operations.
  • Promote data-driven decision-making and real-time operational insights.

5. Operational Reliability & IT/OT Excellence

  • Ensure high availability and performance of factory systems, infrastructure, and shopfloor technologies.
  • Drive disciplined incident management, root cause analysis, and preventive actions for critical events.
  • Oversee vendor performance, SLAs, anCSAME Digital d managed services supporting factory operations.
  • Ensure lifecycle management of applications and infrastructure aligned with global strategy.

6. Strategic Roadmap & Investment Planning

  • Lead development of a multi-year digital factory roadmap for the region.
  • Align investments with business priorities, operational constraints, and global platforms.
  • Build and prioritize business cases for digital initiatives, including ROI, cost, and resource requirements.
  • Partner with senior leadership to define the long-term vision for digital manufacturing.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Manufacturing Operations Leaders, Supply Chain Leadership, Global Digital COEs, Engineering, and Quality teams.
  • Act as the bridge between business operations and digital / IT teams.
  • Ensure technology solutions directly enable production, throughput, quality, and cost objectives.

Leadership Expectations

  • Build strong relationships with factory and BU leaders across cultures and geographies.
  • Develop IT Site Leaders into business-oriented, operations-first leaders.
  • Establish a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Be highly present in factories, driving credibility through operational engagement.

Requirements

  • 15+ years of experience in IT, digital, or technology leadership within manufacturing or supply chain environments.
  • Proven experience leading multi-site or regional operations.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing operations including production, quality, logistics, and planning.
  • Experience implementing enterprise platforms such as MES, ERP, analytics, and automation.

Preferred

  • Experience in IT/OT convergence in industrial environments.
  • Lean / Six Sigma background applied to IT or operations.
  • Experience managing large, distributed global teams.
  • Strong financial acumen and business case development experience.

Role Definition:

Oversees and coordinates the activities of a more complex production line, prepares schedules, resolves issues, and ensures adherence to safety and quality standards.

Experience – Engine Assembly 12 to 18 years Responsibilities

  • Creating reports and records of production processes, tools issues performance, and inventory; sharing them with managers and providing suggestions to improve safety, productivity and quality.
  • Execute daily engine assembly operations as per production plan.
  • Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), torque charts, and control plans.
  • Monitor station-cycle time, line balancing, and resource utilization.
  • Coordinate material availability (bolts, washers, subassemblies, tools).
  • Ensure zero stoppages related to manpower, material, or machine issues. Conduct daily safety audits and ensure action closure.
  • Maintain daily production reports (DPR), attendance, downtime logs.
  • Prepare quality reports – defects, rework, FTT, torque failures. Update training records, skill matrix, and process audit scores.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO9001 and Iso 14001 documentation requirements.
  • Preparing, maintaining, and updating documentation related to operating procedures and safety and quality standards; ensuring all processes and products meet desired safety and quality standards.
  • Supervising and directing the daily activities of production lines workers, assigning tasks, ensuring coordination between different teams, ensuring their safety and monitoring their performance.

Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.

Level Working Knowledge:

Job Summary

We are seeking a Talent Acquisition Specialist (Campus Hiring) to join our Recruiting Excellence team.

Role Definition

Ensures all responsibilities within the hiring and onboarding processes are completed accurately, timely and in compliance with country-specific governmental regulations and professional standards and practices. Recruits qualified applicants according to workforce needs, including support for Students & Graduates hiring programs, internships, campus recruitment and early talent initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Placing advertisements, attending job fairs, campus recruitment events, university engagement activities, and performing other related duties to support recruitment processes.
  • Conducting qualitative candidate pre-screens while providing exemplary candidate experience, providing informed recommendations, and extending offers to candidates, including interns, graduates and other early talent candidates.
  • Sourcing candidates and evaluating resumes for jobs through internal and external tools and resources (social media, job boards, ATS and CRM etc.), as well as campus hiring channels and university partnerships.
  • Delivering the most qualified candidates, building strong candidate pipelines, and monitoring and managing reports to measure efficiency and effectiveness, including maintaining talent pipelines for internship and graduate hiring programs.

Skill Descriptors

Business Process Improvement

Knowledge of business process improvement best practices and ability to use methods for identifying, evaluating, introducing and implementing more efficient approaches to performing business-related activities.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Gathers data for use in the analysis of business processes.
  • Illustrates problems, opportunities and methods for improving existing business processes.
  • Suggests ways to reduce variation and/or waste in processes.
  • Helps evaluate what factors should be addressed in the change program.
  • Participates in requirements analysis for process changes.

Service Excellence

Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent.
  • Resolves common customer problems.
  • Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action.
  • Provides direct service to internal or external customers.
  • Documents customer complaints in a timely manner.

Relationship Management

Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, peers, universities and campus stakeholders.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.
  • Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.
  • Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.
  • Differentiates the roles and responsibilities in a business relationship.
  • Works with clients to address critical issues and resolve major problems.

Candidate Screening

Knowledge of techniques, methods and processes of candidate screening; ability to preselect suitable candidates for first and further interviews within the organization.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Screens candidates to obtain detailed information on knowledge, skills, motivation, etc.
  • Follows Human Resources (HR) policies and standards during the candidate screening process.
  • Files and maintains paper and electronic records of candidate information.
  • Exchanges candidate and job information with hiring managers, campus stakeholders and university placement representatives where applicable.
  • Reviews candidates' resumes and cover letters from both professional and personal aspects.

Candidate Sourcing

Knowledge of techniques, methods and channels of candidate sourcing; ability to attract and qualify candidates for immediate job vacancies or as potential long-term job candidates.

Level: Basic Understanding

  • Gathers information on how to improve the efficiency of candidate sourcing.
  • Describes short-term and long-term functions of candidate sourcing within the organization.
  • Cites organizational usage of candidate sourcing.
  • Identifies common channels (e.g., Internet and recruitment agencies) for sourcing candidates, including campus hiring channels, university partnerships, student organizations and career services offices.

Staffing and Recruiting

Knowledge of standards, processes, techniques and methods used in staffing and recruiting; ability to identify, select, retain and relocate qualified personnel, both internally and externally, for a wide range of positions.

Level: Working Knowledge

  • Prepares tools, record-keeping, and reports for applicant tracking.
  • Researches common processes and techniques to source qualified candidates.
  • Applies effective candidate selection techniques for a specific recruiting task.
  • Provides staffing services for routine positions of major functions or departments in an organization, including internship, co-op and graduate recruitment programs.
  • Assists in the implementation of current staffing goals, strategies and progress reports, including Students & Graduates recruiting objectives and campus hiring plans.

Workforce Analytics

Knowledge of human resources (HR) and workforce issues and trends; ability to analyze workforce data, information and metrics and apply the results to support business decisions.

Level: Basic Understanding

  • Explains the organizational benefits of workforce analysis.
  • Identifies basic methodologies and approaches in analyzing the workforce.
  • Describes the basic concepts and features of workforce analysis.
  • Discusses workforce analysis procedures and principles, including analysis of early talent hiring metrics such as campus conversion rates, internship outcomes and graduate hiring effectiveness.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers

job.title: Software Engineer - QA
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Summary

The Software Testing Engineer is responsible for driving quality engineering strategy, executing automation initiatives, and ensuring high test coverage across Caterpillar Dealer facing web application (Foresight). This role requires strong technical expertise in automation frameworks (Playwright & Selenium), and the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, reliable web solutions.

What You Will Do

Leadership & Strategy

  • Define and implement the overall QA strategy aligning with product and organizational goals.
  • Ensure best practices and skills are developed.
  • Coordinate QA activities across Project Operations modules, ensuring clarity of scope and priorities.
  • Facilitate triage calls, team meetings, and cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders.

Automation Framework Ownership

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, and RestAssured (Java/Python preferred).
  • Upgrade or optimize existing frameworks for reliability, maintainability, CI/CD compatibility, and container-based test execution.
  • Enable tagging, modularization, and classification of failures to support large-scale execution across Foresight modules.

Test Planning & Execution

  • Prepare, review, and maintain QA artifacts (test plans, cases, regression suites, reports).
  • Ensure complete test coverage—functional, integration, API, end-to-end, performance, and batch job validation.
  • Oversee defect triage, prioritization, and root cause analysis.
  • Coordinate environment setup, test execution, and regression cycles across Dev/UAT/Prod releases.

Performance & Reliability Oversight

  • Collaborate with performance engineers to define SLAs and gather non-functional requirements.
  • Monitor bottlenecks & flakiness
  • Integrate performance regressions into CI/CD pipelines for timely detection of issues.

Continuous Integration / DevOps Coordination

  • Enable development teams with regression test suites for shift-left validation of breaking changes.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated test execution in Azure DevOps and GitHub.
  • Support deployments, verification cycles, and parallel release testing across development environments.

Reporting & Governance

  • Track KPIs such as defect density, test coverage, execution reliability, and automation ROI.
  • Prepare dashboards, quality reports, and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
  • Manage risks, dependencies, and ensure timely delivery of quality outcomes.

What You Will Have

Technical Expertise

  • Strong expertise in automation tools: Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, RestAssured, Robot Framework.
  • Programming skills: Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python.
  • Frameworks: Page Object Model (POM), BDD (Cucumber).
  • API testing:Bruno, Swagger, RestAssured.
  • CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub, Azure DevOps pipelines, release management.
  • Performance tools awareness: JMeter, AppDynamics, Dynatrace, DataDog, CloudWatch.

Soft Skills & Competencies

  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead testing across multiple Foresight features.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams in Agile and hybrid environments.
  • Ability to analyze complex issues, propose solutions, and drive continuous improvement.

Considerations for Top Candidates

  • Hands-on experience with web based application automation
  • Advanced debugging and troubleshooting skills for web based test automation.
  • Experience building automated test scripts using Playwright
  • Skilled in environment troubleshooting, regression cycles, and upgrade readiness validation.
  • Ability to prepare clear test design documents, reusable QA templates, and developer guides for team adoption.
  • Strong knowledge of batch job validation, workflow automation, and performance tuning.
  • Experience with data migration testing using DMF/Data Management Framework and validation of large transactional datasets.
  • Proficiency in API testing (OData, REST/SOAP, AIF/DMF).
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps for automated regression cycles and release validation.
  • Ability to conduct peer reviews of test automation scripts, enforce coding standards, and ensure compliance with Microsoft best practices.
  • Skilled in preparing dashboards and test coverage reports for stakeholders, highlighting automation ROI and defect density.
  • Familiarity with upgrade readiness testing, hotfix validation, and ensuring compatibility of customizations during cumulative updates.

Experience

  • 4 - 7+ years of QA experience with at least 3+ years in an automation-focused role.
  • Proven experience in enterprise-scale web applications, including cloud platforms and multi-app ecosystems.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.
