job.title: Lead Digital Consultant
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Integrated Components & Solutions (ICD) division owns Caterpillar’s Wear & Maintenance (W&M) components business — the ground engaging tools, undercarriage, hose & coupling, fluids & filters, and associated hardware that keep the world’s machines running. Our team is building the digital, data, and AI capabilities that make these products easier for customers and dealers to find, buy, use, and get value from.

As Digital Architect, Wear & Maintenance (W&M), you will help bring our W&M digital strategy to life. Partnering closely with the W&M Customer Experience strategy lead, industry business partners, and engineering teams, you will assist with development, execution, and prioritization — turning strategy into projects, requirements, and delivered results. This is a hands-on, technical role as well as a coordinating one: you will help design, build, and validate AI- and data-driven solutions for W&M and connect them into Caterpillar’s digital channels, working across the full W&M digital stack — from the underlying data, to the AI capabilities that use it, to the customer- and dealer-facing channels where it all comes together.

You will play a key role in developing and validating these solutions and integrating them, while also supporting the analytics behind smarter customer and dealer experiences.

Job Summary

Assist the W&M Customer Experience strategy lead to champion a customer-back mindset in the development of the W&M digital experience; execute and prioritize W&M digital projects; and serve as the key technical contributor and coordinator across the teams and systems that make up the W&M digital ecosystem. You will help design, build, and validate W&M AI tools, using approaches such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), and connect them into the Cat customer-facing ecosystem. Our team owns the AI “tools” that expose W&M offerings and capabilities to Caterpillar’s customer-facing applications such as VisionLink, Cat Central, SIS2, and the Cat AI Assistant.

You will be a key part of the team that owns the W&M domain logic, data quality, and the solutions that live within the AI-powered digital ecosystem. You will serve as an integrator — engaging heavily with engineering, digital, and industry teams to build and support the analytics that power recommendations, remaining-life insights, and easier quoting.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and validate W&M AI tools (using approaches such as MCP) that make it easy for customers to discover our offerings and capabilities; partner with Cat Digital to get them integrated and implemented.
  • Build and support Customer Experience analytics that improve the customer and dealer experience with the digital ecosystem — examples include: surfacing remaining-life estimates, providing product recommendations, speeding up quoting, and improving service-option visibility.
  • Write and maintain SQL and Python to query data, prototype solutions, and validate that AI- and data-driven capabilities return accurate, trustworthy results.
  • Contribute to and support our core product and component data — helping close gaps, improve accuracy, and ensure high quality, because good data is the foundation of every digital and AI capability.
  • Serve as a W&M domain expert, ensuring solutions reflect our business needs and how customers and dealers work.
  • Communicate requirements, progress, and results clearly to stakeholders across functions and geographies.
  • Serve as project owner and coordinate efforts across many partner teams, managing dependencies and keeping delivery aligned to W&M priorities.

What You Will Have:

  • Requirements Analysis: Extensive knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques for requirements analysis; ability to elicit, analyze, and document required business functionality and non-functional requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  • Project Management: Extensive knowledge of project management concepts, methods, and tools; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects to ensure delivery against scope, priorities, and business outcomes. Additionally, proven ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, or activities across teams, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.
  • Effective Communications: Extensive understanding and demonstrated application of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively receive, interpret and convey ideas, information, and business needs in written & oral communications across many geographies and functional disciplines.
  • Analytical Thinking: Extensive knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Ability to utilize data design methodologies, tools and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical design.
  • Data Management: Knowledge of the processes, tools, and techniques of data management; ability to maintain the quality, integrity, and accessibility of organizational data across its lifecycle and integrate data resources for business processes and functional support. Ability to utilize AI to accelerate data maintenance and management and develop and deploy AI-powered tools as needed.

Considerations for Top Candidates:

  • 6+ years of experience leading complex, multi-functional projects and coordinating cross-functional teams with demonstrated results.
  • Hands-on proficiency, or a demonstrated ability to learn, SQL and Python for querying data, building prototypes, and validating solutions.
  • Exposure to data platforms and pipelines (e.g., Snowflake, SQL, ETL) and comfort turning data into usable, trustworthy results.
  • Interest in and aptitude for modern AI capabilities and agent/tool integration approaches (e.g., MCP, LLM-based tools), with the ability to learn to build, connect, and validate them.
  • Demonstrated ability to help prioritize work and drive execution across multiple partner teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in a collaborative, cross-functional, cross-geography environment.
  • General knowledge of Wear & Maintenance products (ground engaging tools, undercarriage, maintenance parts) is a plus; familiarity with engineering/BOM data or heavy-industry domains is valued.

Additional Details:

  • This position requires the candidate to work full-time at the Caterpillar office in Chennai, India.
  • This position may require up to 10% travel.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

September 2, 2026 - September 10, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Senior Principal Data Architect
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Serve as the senior data architecture authority for DXP Data, translating business, analytics and AI priorities into secure, scalable, operable and cost-aware architecture across AWS, Snowflake, ingestion, analytics and AI. Own target architecture, domain data models, reusable patterns and governance-by-design, and guide engineering teams and partners.

Accountabilities

  • Architecture Strategy: Own the DXP Data target and reference architecture, principles, transition states and multi-year capability roadmap.
  • Data Models and Products: Set direction for enterprise-aligned domain models, design semantic structures, data contracts and reusable data-product architecture supporting C360 and self-service analytics.
  • Design Authority and Governance: Approve material designs, manage exceptions and architecture debt, and ensure security, privacy, quality, lineage, interoperability and operability are designed in.
  • Standards and Paved Roads: Define and drive adoption of reusable patterns across ingestion, storage, modelling, serving, integration, metadata and AI-enabled data use cases.
  • Business and Technology Alignment: Convert stakeholder priorities into sequenced architecture outcomes, explicit trade-offs and actionable decisions.
  • Technical Leadership by Influence: Guide engineering, stewardship, analytics and vendor teams through reviews, prototypes, decision records, mentoring and knowledge transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture Roadmap: Maintain current, target and transition architectures; prioritize architecture runway, modernization, decommissioning and technical-debt reduction.
  • Data Product Design: Lead conceptual and logical modelling, guide physical design, and define data-product boundaries, contracts, ownership, quality and service expectations.
  • Reference Patterns: Define implementable patterns for batch, CDC, streaming and file ingestion; orchestration; warehouse/lakehouse design; sharing; metadata and lineage.
  • Assurance and Operability: Review material designs and changes for correctness, security, resilience, scale, observability, cost and performance before build or release commitment.
  • Technology Evolution: Evaluate and prototype platform choices across AWS, Snowflake, ingestion/orchestration, open formats, semantic or knowledge layers and AI; document evidence, TCO and risks.
  • Stakeholder and Team Enablement: Facilitate decisions, challenge unclear requirements, assess partner designs and uplift internal capability through reusable guidance and coaching.

Qualifications

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Scope: Data architecture and governance across the DXP Data Platform and C360 ecosystem, including AWS, Snowflake, Datapipe/Airflow/Airbyte, SageMaker, metadata, analytics enablement, and evolving data and AI platform capabilities.
  • Decision Rights: Approval of target/reference architecture, strategic data and solution designs, enterprise/domain modelling patterns, data-product architecture, technology recommendations, architecture standards and exceptions; escalation of material security, quality, operational, cost, or architectural risks before delivery or go-live.
  • Stakeholders: DXP Data Domain Owner, Enterprise and Solution Architecture, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Data Quality Stewards, BI/Analytics, Data Science/AI, Business Data Owners, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity/ISO, Legal/Risk, application domain teams, and strategic partners.
  • Role Boundary / Resources: Senior individual-contributor and design-authority role operating across internal and vendor-augmented teams in Singapore, Malaysia and India. Engineering leads retain people leadership, implementation delivery and Day-2 operational ownership; the architect sets direction, assures design & operational quality, and drives cross-team alignment and capability uplift.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience is preferred. Candidates with 12+ years may be considered where they demonstrate equivalent principal-level scope. Experience should include at least 7 years owning enterprise or domain data architecture and acting as a senior design authority in production-scale, multi-domain environments.
  • Proven ownership of data-platform strategy, target and reference architecture, modernization roadmaps and architecture governance across internal and partner delivery teams.
  • Deep expertise in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including customer/party models, dimensional and relational patterns, semantic layers, data products and data contracts.
  • Strong technical fluency in cloud data-platform architecture - preferably Snowflake and AWS - and modern ingestion, orchestration, warehouse/lakehouse, open-table, metadata, lineage and self-service analytics patterns.
  • Hands-on SQL and Python credibility sufficient to profile data, validate assumptions, prototype critical patterns and review implementation choices. Airflow and relevant ingestion technologies such as Airbyte, NiFi/Openflow or Glue are advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to embed security, privacy, classification, access control, quality, resilience, recoverability, observability, cost and regulatory requirements into implementable architecture.
  • Practical understanding of AI/ML and agentic use cases, including AI-ready data, semantic grounding, responsible-AI controls and secure use of enterprise data.
  • Executive-level stakeholder leadership and a track record of leading through influence in vendor-augmented environments. Telecommunications or Customer 360 experience is advantageous.

job.title: Director, Electrical Systems
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Director of Electrical Systems based in Sydney or Singapore, you will report to the Senior Director -Technical Operations and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in several ways:

  • You are a multi disciplined data centre technical operations SME
  • Multiskilled with electrical (HV/MV/LV) experience and knowledge across a wide range of asset types and data centre designs.
  • You are a highly experienced technical manager with great communication skills and a leader of leaders.
  • As the Director of Electrical Systems, you will interface with key areas of the business such as Design & innovation, construction, commissioning & procurement as the voice of the customer.

Your Day to Day

  • Manage a team of Electrical specialists to ensure effective solutions implementation and issue resolution.
  • Represent Technical Operations in all design aspects of new builds and upgrades including vendor selection. FWT/FOK, Commissioning and testing as needed.
  • Define & augment when required our product specifications with an “Operational Lens”
  • Define the required maintenance (frequency and scope) on all electrical critical infrastructure & develop standards which will be implemented across the portfolio.
  • Partner with site operations on event RCA’s, product failures, risks and be the central Electrical Systems feedback loop for our design / procurement teams.
  • Oversight and resolution of the Electrical operational aspects of new project deployments.
  • Development of Electrical operations strategies for new sites across APAC, with a focus on local codes & regulations especially in emerging regions where codes are evolving.
  • Support operational incidents and escalation with technical expertise.
  • Effective and timely Problem resolution within Electrical Systems.
  • Vendor engagement on product performance

Requirements

  • You have 10+ years of experience in working in either data centres or mission critical environments
  • Ideally, you have experience working for a data centre operator and have previous hyperscale experience in the APAC market
  • You have tenured experience with managing a team of specialist electrical engineers.
  • You are a strong team player and exceptional communicator with influencing skills – working across partner teams in AirTrunk such as Development, Design/ Procurement.
  • You are the subject matter expert for all aspects of Electrical Systems operations including aspects such Low/Medium/High Voltage installations.
  • Ideally, you have strong commercial acumen to understand the commercial implications of engineering decisions
  • You are willing to travel to other APAC regions on a regular basis

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical) - Singapore, Central Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical) is a senior technical specialist responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and safe operation of mission-critical power infrastructure within the data center environment. This role provides technical leadership for electrical operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and incident response activities while supporting the continuous delivery of highly resilient services to customers.

Working with a high degree of independence, the engineer leads complex electrical maintenance activities, supports critical switching operations, identifies operational risks, and drives continuous improvement initiatives that enhance infrastructure reliability, safety, and efficiency.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Operate, maintain, and support mission-critical electrical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, transformers, PDUs, breakers, and associated distribution systems
  • Perform advanced preventive and corrective maintenance activities to ensure the reliability and availability of critical power systems
  • Lead electrical troubleshooting efforts and resolve complex infrastructure issues, minimizing operational risk and customer impact
  • Monitor the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), responding to alarms and identifying potential risks before service impacts occur
  • Lead and coordinate critical electrical operations, including maintenance windows, switching procedures, energization activities, and infrastructure recovery efforts
  • Conduct site inspections and assess the health and performance of electrical infrastructure, recommending corrective actions and reliability improvements
  • Support electrical capacity planning and load management activities to ensure infrastructure readiness for future growth
  • Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, operational efficiency, and energy performance

Site Administration

  • Prepare, review, and authorize technical documentation including Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs), and switching plans
  • Ensure maintenance activities are executed safely and in accordance with operational, regulatory, and company requirements
  • Maintain accurate infrastructure records, maintenance history, and operational documentation

Incident Management

  • Serve as a technical lead during electrical incidents, infrastructure failures, and power-related events
  • Provide guidance to on-site teams during incident response and restoration activities
  • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) investigations and develop corrective and preventive action plans
  • Lead post-incident reviews and recommend improvements to operational processes and infrastructure resilience

Vendor Management

  • Manage and coordinate electrical service providers, contractors, and vendors performing maintenance and project activities
  • Review vendor work plans, technical proposals, and maintenance recommendations
  • Ensure work is performed in accordance with safety requirements, industry standards, and data center operational procedures

Work Orders & Capacity Management

  • Lead resolution of complex work orders and infrastructure-related requests
  • Support electrical capacity planning, power utilization analysis, and infrastructure growth initiatives
  • Provide technical reviews of customer power requirements and infrastructure impacts
  • Support commissioning, testing, and integration of new electrical systems

Collaboration

  • Act as a technical mentor to engineers and technicians, sharing expertise and supporting team development
  • Partner with Critical Facilities, Customer Operations, Security, Design & Construction, and vendor teams to deliver operational excellence
  • Identify underlying infrastructure issues and recommend long-term reliability improvements
  • Leverage internal and external technical resources to resolve complex electrical challenges

Additional Projects

  • Lead electrical infrastructure projects, including upgrades, capacity expansion, modernization, and reliability improvement initiatives
  • Support lifecycle management and replacement strategies for critical electrical assets
  • Participate in commissioning, integrated systems testing, and acceptance activities for new infrastructure deployments
  • Recommend and champion initiatives that improve uptime, reliability, safety, and operational efficiency

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of experience operating and maintaining critical electrical infrastructure in data centers, utilities, industrial facilities, telecommunications, or other mission-critical environments

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with mission-critical power systems, including: UPS systems Diesel generators Switchgear and breakers Transformers Low- and medium-voltage distribution systems Power monitoring systems
  • Experience performing electrical switching activities, maintenance planning, and incident response
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex electrical faults and identify root causes
  • Experience leading maintenance vendors and coordinating infrastructure projects
  • Strong understanding of electrical safety practices, operational risk management, and permit-to-work processes

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

job.title: Data Center Concierge III - Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
job.description:
Job Summary

The position will suit someone who is a strong communicator, experienced and organised in completing routing and ad-hoc tasks, admin focused and with the ability to deliver outstanding customer service at all times. Applicants may come from multifaceted industries including but not limited to hospitality, reception, administration or other customer centric roles and will be working Monday-Friday in a permanent position.

This is a customer facing role, so applicants should work onsite, enjoy client interaction and have the confidence to identify customer trends, issues or concerns, taking appropriate actions where possible and call out accordingly when needed.

Key responsibilities

Our Concierge will provide support to datacenter facilities and administrative duties following standard procedures:

  • Supports customers by coordinating visits and schedules in the data center; assists on semi-routine inquiries and issues
  • Directly coordinates activities with the Equinix Response Center (ERC), as needed
  • Keeps records of activities within the data center including circuit inventories, installed power inventories and labor hours expended
  • May generate purchase requisitions and coordinate with vendors for delivery and invoicing
  • Generating Siebel Reports for customer SH requests
  • Assist security with supervising the security office, signing in visitors, validation and assignment of access via the Siebel and EACS
  • Work closely with site security and report security related incidents to the Security Operations Control Centre
  • Perform ad hoc support tasks for IBX Operations teams, including but not limited to parking administration, CCTV and access control data retrieval and analysis, event coordination, and maintenance management system administration.
  • Take an active role in emergency response preparedness, including participating in evacuation drills and incidents by coordinating and managing designated muster areas, accounting for personnel, and supporting site emergency procedures.

Customer Support and onsite Customer Liaison

  • Supports the coordination of tasks to the appropriate cross-functional teams
  • Maintains positive business relationships with local vendors in support of customer's administrative needs; provides information about local vendors to customers upon request
  • Maintains customer care areas/conference rooms for cleanliness and fully stocking amenities as the need arises; may provide backup coverage to cross functional teams to support inventory ordering
  • Communicates semi-routine operating datacenter procedures to customers on-site, while building and developing positive customer relationships
  • Coordinates customer work visits with security and escorts customers and/or vendors, within a reasonable vicinity, as required
  • Assists with tracking, following-up, and reporting on routine or new customer inquiries and issues while customers are on-site
  • Provides general induction learning tours to new customers to orient them to the site and escorting customers to their spaces within the data center and unlocking racks where required
  • Resolving issues related to lower customer satisfaction score by coordinating with cross functional team

Benefits of Equinix and the role:

  • Salary package including healthcare allowance and annual bonus
  • Extensive on-job induction, training and continued learning and access to a range of company employee benefits
  • Career development and further opportunities within Equinix
  • Join an industry leader in the Data Centre world
  • Permanent position working Monday-Friday onsite daytime hours

job.title: SG | Manager (Service Assurance), Group Data Centre Operations
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As Manager (Service Assurance), Group Data Centre Operations (GDCO), you will be part of the Service Assurance team with responsibilities across data centres in Southeast and Northeast Asia. In this role, you will drive the performance of key operational processes to achieve continuous improvement and operational excellence, manage audit programmes to ensure compliance with required certifications including security (ISMS), processes (SMS & BCMS), and energy and environmental standards, and support the deployment and adoption of IT tools and systems to enable process automation and performance reporting.

  • Plan, schedule, and conduct internal audits for ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 22301, and ISO 50001 standards, prepare audit reports and follow up with auditees to close findings.
  • Plan, schedule, and complete external audits by engaging certification bodies to achieve and maintain ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 22301, and ISO 50001 certifications.
  • Monitor and review operations processes, including incident and change management to drive continuous improvement of key KPIs.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of physical security controls and operations to maintain and enhance overall sites security posture.
  • Support the setup and maintenance of ISMS, BCMS, and SMS management systems.
  • Contribute to the documentation of key operational policies, processes, manuals, SOPs to drive alignment and consistency across countries.
  • Support the automation of operational processes and performance reporting using appropriate IT tools and systems.
  • Provide training and coaching to the data centre operations teams and auditees on audit requirements and processes.
  • Support all service assurance-related activities, initiatives, and projects.
  • Any other tasks as assigned by the Management

Requirements

  • Degree or Diploma in IT, Mechanical & Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in a Data Centre environment.
  • Experience in data centre or critical environment operations (e.g., M&E facilities, security operations) and ITSM processes (incident, change, problem management).
  • ISO Lead/Internal Auditor certification (ISO 27001, 22301, 20000-1, or 50001) with hands-on audit and certification experience.
  • Familiarity with ISMS, BCMS, SMS frameworks and ITSM/operations support tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-cultural communication skills; bilingual in English and an additional Southeast Asian language is preferred.
  • Self-driven with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver results with minimal supervision.

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: SG | Specialist, Data Centre Site Operations
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As the Specialist, Data Centre Site Operations (DCSO), you will be responsible for the following:

  • Work in rotating shifts to support large scale data centre’s 24x7 onsite operations and critical facilities.
  • Perform 24x7 monitoring of BMS systems (upstream to downstream), critical facilities equipment and other equipment associated with the data centre environment including fire safety, plumbing, mechanical, and electrical systems.
  • Act as first responders and the Level 1 escalation point for all onsite operational incidents and issues. Perform hands-on troubleshooting and ad-hoc repair of mechanical and electrical (M&E) equipment.
  • Respond and perform all remote hands requests within the Operational and Service Level Agreements.
  • Document and update accurately and promptly all relevant activities and requests on the STT GDC Web Portal ticketing system (user requests, incidents, change, problems, provisioning, etc.), ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library).
  • Ensure effective implementation of data centre safety, security and customer support policy and procedures.
  • Oversee the security operations onsite, including processes, manpower and ability to use security software systems.
  • Co-ordinate and support all internal contractors and vendors activities onsite, including reviewing of Permit-To-Work (PTW) documents, scheduling of resources, enforcement of house rules, adherence to best practices, compliance to safety procedures, etc.
  • Co-ordinate, plan and support all preventive and reactive maintenance activities with little to no disruption to STT GDC’s services.
  • Create accurate and regular reporting to internal stakeholders when necessary (incident reports, health reports, daily reports, etc.).
  • Write and update Standard Operating Procedures and Emergency Operating Procedures for DSCO related procedures and processes.
  • Provide administrative support in assets inventory and procurement of parts/equipment.
  • Knowledge of copper/fibre deployment and be willing to learn to use tester to perform cabling troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate and supervise the activities of contracted personnel providing services or performing work in the data centre. Coordinate all preventive/contracted/general maintenance, ensuring zero/minimum disruption of building services Carry out any other duties as and when assigned by the Team Leads and Management.

Requirements

  • ITE or Diploma in Computing/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related fields.
  • At least 1 year of relevant work experience in a 24x7 DC of facility operations environment, or fresh graduate with relevant qualification such building infrastructure.
  • Possess general knowledge of M&E and Network Infrastructure.
  • Meticulous team player with the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Broad knowledge in DC facilities related systems such as PDUs, UPS, DC Rectifier, Generator, DRUPs, CRAUs, Chiller, DX cooling, fire protections, etc.
  • Possess relevant facilities management and/or data centre related certifications, such as ITIL, CDCP, CDCS, etc.
  • Broad knowledge in cloud technology, network, data centre facilities, system applications and IT systems.

As a Senior Manager/ Manager, Group Data Centre Engineering Support, you will be responsible for establishing, implementing, and continuously improving STT GDC’s global data centre operations framework, service management systems, and engineering standards to support the Group’s strategic objectives. The role provides operational leadership for new data centre start-ups, ensuring a smooth transition to in-country DC Operations teams while maintaining alignment with Group policies, standards, and best practices. You will also play a key role in driving engineering governance, operational excellence, risk management, sustainability initiatives, and continuous improvement programmes across the global portfolio.

  • Lead the operational readiness, transition, and onboarding of new data centres to in-country DC Operations teams.
  • Represent DC Operations throughout the project lifecycle, including design reviews, commissioning, Integrated Systems Testing (IST), site acceptance, and handover activities.
  • Provide operational input on design, maintenance, reliability, and constructability to ensure long-term operational efficiency and maintainability.
  • Support the development of new in-country operations teams through training, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness programmes.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance global engineering, maintenance, and operational standards across all regions.
  • Review and align regional engineering policies, procedures, and operational practices to establish consistent Group-wide operating baselines.
  • Drive global change management, problem management, incident review, and lessons-learned processes to improve operational reliability.
  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on engineering and operational matters, supporting critical incident recovery, root cause analysis, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct energy and water efficiency assessments and recommend sustainability and optimisation initiatives across the portfolio.
  • Support the alignment and implementation of OT security requirements in collaboration with Service Assurance and cybersecurity teams.
  • Develop and maintain operational risk management, governance, and capacity planning frameworks.
  • Review and analyse operational Capex and Opex budgets across regions to drive standardisation, benchmarking, and cost optimisation.
  • Establish, monitor, and report on operational KPIs, benchmarking metrics, and continuous improvement programmes.
  • Drive technical certification programmes across the portfolio, including ISO 50001, ISO 14001, SS564, BCA-IMDA Green Mark for Data Centres, TIA-942, and Uptime standards.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure compliance with Group operational policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Promote cross-functional collaboration and sharing of best practices, lessons learned, and operational knowledge across all regions.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline.

  • Experience in data centre design, construction, and/or commissioning would be an added advantage.
  • Professional certifications such as Singapore Certified Energy Manager (SCEM), Green Mark Accredited Professional, LEED Green Associate, LEED AP, or equivalent are preferred.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: Facility Manager
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to Vice President (Infrastructure Operations) and dotted to BOM2 Operations Manager, this role

is to manage the Data Center Facilities Operations teams to ensure the most efficient utilization of the Data

Center facilities resources, lowest possible operating PUE, consistent maintenance practices and service

uptime of the data centers. This role will be based in Mumbai, India.

Key responsibilities

  • Ensure consistency in the maintenance procedures of the DC Critical Electrical, Cooling, Fire Protection & Building Management System (BMS) infrastructure per DE maintenance policy or manufacturers’ recommendation and customer specifications (if required).
  • Perform Risk Assessment and develop appropriate method statements for critical infrastructure maintenance or infrastructure upgrade / replacement activities
  • Ensures services and activities of maintenance contractors and service providers as appropriate to DC facilities operations, maintenance, design and construction services in support of corporate and customer objectives (if required).
  • 3rd Level On-call emergency response & support as necessary to maintain the highest level of operations and availability to building systems, Electrical infrastructure efficiency & lowest possible operating PUE (through energy improvement program)
  • Maintain appropriate vendor relationships to obtain the required service support and competitive price for maintenance, repair & new installations.
  • Implement training & mentoring practices for Facilities Operations team members to ensure knowledge refresh, skills upgrade and quality results.
  • Ensure compliance of policies and procedures for occupational health & safety in the workplace, information security management, environmental management systems; incident management; and comply with all legal regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate and support for the existing and new initiative certifications such as ISMS, ISO 27001, 14001 and 45001, PCI DSS, etc., development and implementation works for Digital Edge India, taking guidance from HQ
  • Support Sales, Sales Engineering & Product Management team for key potential customer / Hyperscale deals.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • More than 12 years of work experience in Data Center operations and Facilities management
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Extensive operational knowledge of electrical distribution (e.g. switchgear, transformers, automatic transfer switch, UPS, STS, Drups, battery management systems, generators, and PDUs to the branch level), cooling system, fire protection & Building Management system.
  • Possess facility management and/or data centre related certifications, such as CDCP, CDCS or equivalent
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to successfully interact with both internal and external customers
  • Strong project management, trouble-shooting and organizational skills.
  • Experience in telecommunications / digital infrastructure sectors, especially on the process side, is beneficial
  • A team player willing to be hands-on in a dynamic and fast paced environment

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Associate Director, Service Delivery
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Service Delivery

Service Delivery encompasses the end-to-end deliverables specified in the Service Contract provided by Singtel Group (or its subsidiaries). This includes service governance, client engagement with customers, and managing the expectations and outcomes for both external and internal senior stakeholders. Service Delivery also focuses on account growth and ensuring an excellent customer engagement experience.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for managing multiple account delivery teams in alignment with Singtel's commitments to various service contracts.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to develop strategic and tactical plans to ensure delivery meets contractual obligations to customers. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to): -

  • Driving service delivery to meet and exceed contractual SLA commitments.
  • Sponsoring delivery teams in implementing digitalization initiatives to enhance efficiency and improve the service engagement experience.
  • Managing senior stakeholders (e.g. CxOs, VPs, and IT Heads) through effective communication and portfolio management during major incidents.
  • Building and strengthening client relationships through in-depth knowledge of customer domains.
  • Identifying opportunities and supporting the Sales Team in pursuing new business prospects to grow the EWO portfolio.

Operations

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to lead both the Service and Technical delivery team in day-to-day operations matters, and ensure services are delivered with pride and sustainable model to meet our SLA deliverables. Operation delivery includes leading team on delivery excellence, and drive towards continuous service improvements, and to enhance the service values to the customer.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to engage and manage 3rd party partners and vendors, to align their delivery competency and capabilities with Singtel service contract to our customers.

Financial Management

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to manage the financials for the service portfolios under the purview, in accordance with the Business Case of the service contracts on Cost of Delivery, recovery of cost in respective cost centre in a healthy state.

Financial management responsibilities include but not limited to: -

  • Annual AOP budgeting, financial planning across the portfolio.
  • Manpower and resourcing budgeting
  • Operation run rate and forward planning
  • Monthly financial status tracking and progressive report
  • Operations and Financial optimization

People and Growth

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to coach and mentor Service Delivery Managers, and delivery teams, whether under direct or indirect management (e.g., third-party partners or contractors). This includes providing thought leadership and demonstrating strong people management skills for the various teams within the service portfolios.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for developing a Portfolio Strategy and Tactical Performance Measurement for the teams under their supervision. They should adopt a top-down approach to KPI setting for the delivery teams within the portfolio.

Additionally, the Associate Director, Service Delivery should conduct routine communication sessions with members of the delivery teams and their direct reports to provide directives and guidance. This includes holding weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual meetings, as well as one-on-one sessions and performance assessments, as required.

Corporate Engagement

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support Global Delivery 5 key initiatives within their portfolio: -

  • Customer First,
  • Quality First,
  • People First,
  • Digital First,
  • Security First,

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support any other Singtel and/or SEB corporate program and events, as required.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support and promote collaboration within the delivery teams, Singtel and/or SEB organization.

Skills for Success:

  • ITIL Foundation
  • Min 8-10 years working in enterprise scale IT environment or 15 years in senior delivery role managing in Cross Domains (multiple technical domains) enterprise environment

Proficient in:

  • Service Delivery Management
  • Project Management
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Proficient in at least 2 or more technical workstreams (Network, System, DB, Storage, Hosting, Cloud, Workplace services, Telco services)
  • Executive Stakeholders Management
  • People management
  • Presentation skills
  • Project P&L & Portfolio Financial Management
  • Coaching / Mentorship skillsets

job.title: Senior Network Engineer Sensitive Customer

**

As the Senior Network Engineer – Sensitive Customer, you’ll provide Level 1 operational coverage and technical support for sensitive and secure incident management. You’ll take end-to-end ownership of network fault restoration and incident tickets, ensuring services are restored efficiently and customer service levels and KPI expectations are met.

You’ll work across internal engineering and operations teams, field services, third-party providers, Government and Emergency Services organisations, and regulatory stakeholders. This role is suited to a technically capable network operations professional who can work calmly in a sensitive environment, coordinate multiple stakeholders and continuously improve service outcomes.

**

**

  • Monitor, localise, correct and verify incidents affecting sensitive and secure customer services and platforms, managing tickets through to resolution.

**

  • The ability to analyse end-to-end call flows across multiple network domains, including IMS-Fixed, carrier interconnect and international traffic routing.

  • Demonstrated capability in technical and process leadership, including mentoring and upskilling team members, adopting new technologies and improving operational processes.

job.title: Specialist Care Consultant
job.description:
Adelaide, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it's easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is passionate about getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers. It's not about surface-level change. It's about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.**

The Specialist Care Community supports customers experiencing complex or heightened vulnerability. The team manages sensitive cases referred by internal teams and external authorities across voice and messaging channels, providing timely, professional and compassionate support.

Customers may be experiencing domestic and family violence, homelessness, incarceration, financial hardship, disability or other forms of vulnerability. In some cases, customers may be experiencing more than one vulnerability at the same time.

As a Specialist Care Consultant, you will coordinate sensitive and complex customer cases from start to finish. You will work closely with experts, team leaders and internal and external stakeholders to investigate concerns, negotiate appropriate outcomes and improve the way we support vulnerable customers.

This role is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference while developing specialist skills in case management, investigation, negotiation, risk identification and stakeholder engagement.

This role operates within a 24-hour, 7-day specialist support environment. Successful applicants will participate in a rotating roster that includes day, evening, overnight, weekend and public holiday shifts.

An example of shifts are; 7:30am – 3:30pm , 10:00am – 6:00pm & 11:30pm – 7:30am. Please note this role has hybrid working options after 6 months.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage complex customer cases involving technical support, account and billing queries.
  • Investigate complaints, identify risks and coordinate cases through to resolution.
  • Partner with internal teams and external stakeholders, including the Telecommunications Industry Ombudsman (TIO), NBN Co, financial counsellors, Public Trustee offices and other support agencies.
  • Negotiate tailored resolutions that balance customer, regulatory and business needs.
  • Identify trends and share insights to improve team capability and customer outcomes.
  • Support customers experiencing distress by following established de-escalation, safety and escalation procedures.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated empathy, emotional resilience and the ability to maintain professional boundaries while supporting customers experiencing distress or crisis.
  • Strong experience managing complex customer enquiries, complaints, and escalations for vulnerable customers, with effective liaison and stakeholder management across regulatory bodies
  • Strong investigation, negotiation, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities within a 24/7 rotating roster.
  • A collaborative approach and strong stakeholder relationship skills.
  • Confidence following established safety and escalation procedures when supporting customers in crisis.

The good stuff …

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.

We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. When you contact us, please advise your preferred method of contact and we will be in touch within 48 hours. job.title: Associate, Commerce Configuration & Operations
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Manage end-to-end commerce configuration execution across digital web and app journeys, covering plans, promotions, pricing reflections, campaign changes and related customer-facing setup.
  • Drive readiness for weekly changes, launches and BAU requests through accurate setup, disciplined validation and first-time-right execution.
  • Govern configuration quality and consistency by applying structured validation, issue resolution and adherence to agreed operating processes.
  • Support migration and transformation readiness by managing legacy clean-up, new configuration setup and end-to-end checks across plan, promo, price and content reflections.
  • Produce and maintain configuration documentation, knowledge materials and execution guidelines to reduce key-person dependency and improve delivery scalability.
  • Provide enablement and knowledge transfer to PM, PO, configuration and UAT stakeholders to improve understanding of setup logic, dependencies and operational requirements.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in digital configuration, commerce operations, campaign setup or related digital delivery roles. Telecom or digital commerce experience is preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of digital configuration across promotions, pricing, campaign setup, validation and deployment support in multi-system environments.
  • Strong coordination, documentation, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive structured execution across multiple teams.
  • Good understanding of customer-facing digital journeys, configuration governance, operational readiness and end-to-end reflection checks.

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Senior Delivery Architect (ICT)
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Delivery Architect to lead the design and delivery of complex network solutions for enterprise customers.

This role combines deep technical expertise, customer-facing skills, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful solution design, implementation, and operational readiness.

The Senior Delivery Architect will also play a key role in strategic design governance and internal capability building.

**

Customer Engagement & Communication

  • Work closely with customer architects to understand requirements and design tailored WAN/LAN and security solutions.
  • Attend weekly customer meetings to track progress and ensure design implementation aligns with expectations and timelines.
  • Deliver compelling presentations to customers and internal management, effectively communicating design decisions, risks, and recommendations.

Solution Design & Delivery

  • Develop detailed network designs (WAN, LAN, routing, security) and oversee implementation.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery, from architecture through deployment and testing.
  • Ensure seamless handover of designs by acting as a Technical Delivery SME (Day 1) and ensuring readiness with the Technical Operations SME (Day 2).
  • Participate in the Design Council (internal and external) to review architecture, assess feasibility, and validate solutions through testing.

Internal Collaboration & Governance

  • Support RFPs and pre-sales efforts, ensuring ESP’s capabilities address both Day 1 (setup) and Day 2 (operations).
  • Collaborate with delivery and operations teams to address design challenges and align on best practices.
  • Contribute to reusable frameworks, playbooks, and processes to improve consistency and scalability.

Operational Excellence & Escalation Support

  • Ensure solutions are robust, secure, and scalable, meeting customer performance and availability requirements.
  • Provide insights on Day 1 → Day 2 processes, ensuring smooth transitions into operational support.
  • Lead or contribute to design validation, performance testing, and risk mitigation planning.
  • Be prepared to attend weekly calls outside of business hours when required to support global or regional customers.
  • Provide on-call support during weekends or public holidays for critical escalations or coverage, ensuring minimal customer impact.
  • Participate in RCA/RFO and to be presented to customer and internal management team.

**

Skills for Success:

  • Proven experience in network design and delivery, with strong expertise in WAN, LAN, routing, and security Cloud and Automation.
  • Strong understanding of network security,cloud,automation principles, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale, complex network design deployments and operations.
  • Exceptional presentation skills for both customer engagements and internal management discussions.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills across multiple teams and organizations.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience with Day 1 delivery and Day 2 operations processes is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on solution feasibility and long-term supportability.
  • Flexibility to work during non-standard hours, weekends, or public holidays when business-critical escalations require support.

job.title: Job Redesign Lead
job.description:
Key responsibilities

**

Design & rollout the central Job Redesign Playbook

  • Develop an enterprise playbook using a task-based methodology (principles, step-by-step process, templates, tools and governance) for job redesign and role/ skills reconstruction aligned to AI augmentation.

Create frameworks & artefacts

  • Build standardised role-profile templates, task decomposition templates, grading/regrading guidelines, job family/role cluster schemas, and skills-mapping templates aligned to Singtel Skills Framework.

Enable HR Business Partners (HRBPs) & Business Units (BU)

  • Coach and enable HRBPs and BUs teams to apply the playbook at scale by running workshops, facilitating subject matter expert interviews, reviewing team structures, and guiding workforce and skills redesign.

Deliver pilots & scale-up

  • Lead early job-redesign pilots (including design, measurement and iteration), capture insights and develop repeatable playbooks for enterprise-wide roll-out.

Design career pathways & bridge programmes

  • Work with HRBPs, business leaders and learning partners to design templates and approaches for career ladders, lateral pathways and ‘bridge’ programmes that preserve career continuity and provide clear skill-to-role progression for impacted employees.

Integrate with learning & workforce planning

  • work with Skills/Capability and Learning leads to ensure role redesign outputs map into assessments, training roadmaps and redeployment plans.

Measure & report

  • Define job-redesign success metrics (e.g., % roles redesigned, redeployment rate, skills readiness), maintain dashboards and provide regular updates to the Programme Office and SteerCo.

**

Qualifications, Skills & Attributes:

  • Educated to degree level with professional certifications such as Certified Organisation Design Professional (CODP®), SHRM or IHRP certifications
  • 6-8 years’ experience in organisation design/job architecture/role design in large, matrixed organisations (or consultancy experience delivering large-scale job redesign).
  • Proven experience driving task-based job redesign (decomposition, role reconstruction, grading) and solid understanding of task-to-role analysis frameworks.
  • Practical experience translating role redesign into grading, regrading processes, and redeployment mechanisms.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence HRBPs and senior business leaders effectively.
  • Excellent facilitation capabilities, including SME interviews and co-design workshop delivery.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear playbooks, job design templates, and HRBP/manager toolkits.

job.title: Senior Technical Specialist
job.description:
• Work Pattern: either Rotating shift roster, including morning, afternoon and night OR Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm

Ready to reimagine your career at Optus?

  • Rapidly resolve complex network faults beyond the Managed Service’s scope and manage critical incident escalations to minimise customer impact.
  • Lead root cause analysis, implement permanent corrective actions, and participate in change governance including representation at Change Advisory Board meetings.
  • Recommend and approve network design changes to improve service reliability and support the introduction of new technologies and products.
  • Ensure planned network upgrades and deployments are aligned with quality and performance standards, and contribute to network expansion strategies.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Vendors, and Managed Service Suppliers to align operational processes and architecture standards, ensuring technical supportability.
  • Provide regular technical insights into KPIs and SLAs, identify performance gaps, and support resolution efforts through stakeholder collaboration.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives through automation of incident management and alarm handling, while contributing to the evolution of operational tools and strategies.

It starts with you!

  • Extensive hands-on expertise in maintaining and troubleshooting multi-vendor (Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Fortinet, Checkpoint, …) IP and security networks in a Tier 2 or Tier 3 environment.
  • Strong understanding of service provider network design, routing and switching, and security practices.
  • Experience with network automation tools such as Python and Ansible is desirable.

IP Operations:

  • Strong understanding of DDoS protection, detection, and mitigation strategies.
  • High proficiency in IP/MPLS technologies, including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, and Segment Routing.
  • Demonstrated capability in maintaining and troubleshooting large-scale IP/MPLS networks within service provider environments.
  • Cisco CCNP SP and above, and/or equivalent vendor certifications (Juniper, Nokia, etc.) are desirable.

job.title: Snr Project Mgr, Proj(TS) Ldrship
job.description:
Overview

The Infrastructure Project Manager who will be responsible for the managing and implementing of Infrastructure-based projects with quality, within scope and to ensure deliverables are on time and conform to processes and standards meeting customer’s requirements. The incumbent is also responsible for projects resource scheduling, tracking, risk management and quality assurance.

What will you do?

Project & Service Management

  • Lead, deliver and maintain projects within time, scope and cost
  • Ensure project delivery quality
  • Plan & establish project schedules, quality plans, budgets, and communication and risk management plans
  • Manage issues arising out of scope definition and disputes that impacted scope, schedule and cost
  • Manage issues arising from integration of various components of the project, e.g. hardware, software installation, testing, business process review, redesign, application development, migration and data conversion etc
  • Manage project financials, ensuring project cost/ revenue forecast is done accurately
  • Oversee the implementation of the project with regard to schedules, budget, manpower and quality
  • Resolve project overrun issues
  • Track project progress and report to Senior Management and Customer
  • Manage resources in terms of mobilising resources during different periods of time from team to team to maximise productivity or minimise wastage
  • Lead the project and service team on smooth project transition to operation in accordance to customer requirement and processes.
  • Manage project operation and ensure service level is maintained without financial penalty and security incident due to negligent or lack of awareness
  • Leverage Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other Microsoft 365 tools to analyze project performance metrics, resource utilization, and financial data.
  • Develop interactive dashboards and visual reports to track project progress, risks, and KPIs for internal and customer reporting.
  • Use data-driven insights to support forecasting, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Utilize Kanban-style tools such as Trello, Microsoft Planner, or Project for the Web to visualize project workflows, manage task assignments, and monitor progress in real time.
  • Implement agile project tracking methods to improve transparency, accountability, and responsiveness across project phases.
  • Integrate Slack or Microsoft Teams for streamlined communication, status updates, and collaboration among cross-functional teams.

Customer/Vendor/ Stakeholder Management

  • Manage contracts and subcontractors
  • Effectively engaged stakeholders in project decisions and execution
  • Build long-term customer relationships by anticipating and exceeding customer’s expectation
  • Negotiate with customers on change control mechanism to meet schedules and prioritize changes based on business needs
  • Strong customer-service orientation
  • Present project data and trends using Microsoft PowerPoint and Power BI to facilitate stakeholder engagement and decision-making.
  • Translate complex data into clear visual narratives to support change management and prioritization discussions.

Team Management

  • Work cohesively, lead, guide, manage and motivate the projects’ team members in delivering quality project works, eliminating project exceptions and delighting the customers
  • Plan for optimal use of resources across teams comprising of Project and Technical competencies
  • Manage performance review of team and maintain open communication with team for feedback on continuous improvement
  • Ensure high individual and staff billability
  • Promote the use of collaborative platforms (e.g., Trello, Microsoft Planner, Slack) to enhance team coordination, task ownership, and productivity.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups or sprint reviews using Kanban boards to ensure alignment and timely issue resolution.

The ideal candidate should possess:

1.Technical Competency – WAN Migration Experience

  • Demonstrated experience in managing WAN migration activities.
  • Ability to coordinate with Internet Service Providers for timely WAN deployment.
  • Strong project tracking skills to ensure milestones and timelines are met.

2. Experience in Tech Refresh Environments

  • Proven capability in handling system setup in collaboration with customer counterparts.
  • Experience in planning and executing migration from legacy to new systems.
  • Ability to integrate new systems into existing infrastructures (e.g. GovTech DC/GCC/GDC/Axisnet) seamlessly.

3. Domain Knowledge and Process Awareness

  • While in-depth knowledge of GovTech practices is not mandatory, familiarity with relevant processes is advantageous.

This includes:

Submission of documentation (e.g., SRs, rack mount plans, cabling plans).

Coordination of TAF sessions for obtaining stakeholder approvals.

Understanding of system integration requirements related to operations (e.g., management tools, alerting systems, backup solutions), which requires coordination with existing operational teams

4. Professional Attributes

  • The Project Manager must demonstrate a high level of professionalism, humility, and patience.
  • Must be able to effectively engage with stakeholders, listen actively to concerns, and facilitate collaborative, win-win outcomes across all parties—including the customer, internal teams, and external vendors.

5. Data Analysis & Visualization Competency

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel (advanced functions, pivot tables, charts) for data manipulation and reporting.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Power BI for building dashboards, visualizing trends, and generating actionable insights.
  • Ability to interpret data to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities that inform project strategy and execution.

6. Agile & Kanban Project Tracking

  • Proficient in using Trello, Microsoft Planner, or Project for the Web to manage tasks, visualize workflows, and track deliverables.
  • Familiarity with Slack or Microsoft Teams for real-time communication and integration with project tracking tools.
  • Ability to adapt Kanban principles to infrastructure project environments for improved efficiency and stakeholder visibility.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.
