job.title: Associate Specialist, Sourcing – DC Ops
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Associate Specialist, Sourcing – DC Ops is responsible for supporting procurement and sourcing activities related to client fit-out projects within the Finance Transformation and Procurement business unit. This role ensures cost-effective purchasing, compliance with company standards, and timely delivery of materials and services required for the Operations Team.

What we are looking for

  • ### KEY responsibilities
  • ### Assist in sourcing and procurement for client fit-out projects, including vendor identification, RFQs, and bid analysis.
  • ### Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, contracts, and supplier agreements.
  • ### Collaborate with internal teams (project managers, finance, operations) to align sourcing strategies with project timelines and budgets.
  • ### Monitor supplier performance and resolve issues related to delivery, quality, or compliance.
  • ### Support cost optimization initiatives and contribute to continuous improvement in procurement processes.
  • ### Ensure adherence to company policies, legal requirements, and sustainability standards.
  • ### KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES
  • ### Strong understanding of procurement principles and sourcing strategies.
  • ### Familiarity with construction or fit-out materials and vendor landscape.
  • ### Proficiency in MS Excel and procurement tools (e.g., SAP Ariba or similar).
  • ### Analytical mindset with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • ### Good communication and negotiation skills.
  • ### Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
  • ### Preferred: Certification in procurement (e.g., CIPS, CPSM).
  • ### REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
  • ### 2–4 years of experience in procurement or sourcing, preferably in construction or client fit-out projects.
  • ### Exposure to vendor management and contract administration.
  • ###

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • ### Regularly moves equipment and other hardware up to 25 lbs.
  • ### Frequently move about inside and outside of data center / facility
  • ### Remain stationary for long periods of time.
  • ### Ascend / Descend a ladder and perform duties atop a raised platform.
  • ### Position self in small spaces.
  • ### Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • ### Perform work during US business hours and time zones.
  • ### Work conditions & other requirements
  • ### Work onsite at a data center location.
  • ### Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.
  • ### Exposure to outdoor weather conditions.
  • ### Travel required 10% of time.
  • ### Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.
  • ###

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

###

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Design Engineer - Power Distribution
job.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Engineering Services & Systems Division (EESS) is currently seeking a Design Engineer - Power Distribution. This role can be based remote within the United States.

The Project Operations Team provides comprehensive engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services throughout the entire project lifecycle. Our team specializes in handling both greenfield and brownfield turnkey electrical projects and has expertise in designing and constructing high and medium-voltage substations and developing power distribution solutions for utilities, government, data centers, industrial, and commercial facilities. This position is remote within the United Sates.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $97,000 - $143,000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the engineering and design of medium- and high-voltage power distribution and substation projects, delivering safe, reliable, and innovative solutions for our customers.
  • Ability to independently develop complete engineering packages including single/three lines, AC/DC schematics and wiring, cable/conduit plans, equipment layout plans, etc for turnkey projects.
  • Coordinate electrical and civil design packages to ensure quality, constructability, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Develop complete engineering packages, coordinating electrical and civil design activities to ensure quality, constructability, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Drive project success by managing design deliverables, schedules, budgets, and technical accuracy in partnership with project managers, field teams, and customers.
  • Apply value-driven engineering practices to optimize designs, improve efficiency, and deliver cost-effective solutions without compromising quality or performance.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to develop technical solutions that address evolving power system needs.
  • Participate in site assessments and field walkdowns to evaluate existing infrastructure and support the development of engineering proposals and project scopes.
  • Prepare engineering estimates, review technical documentation, and support project planning activities.
  • Mentor and collaborate with fellow engineers and designers, sharing technical expertise and contributing to a culture of continuous learning and professional growth.
  • Support projects across the United States through occasional travel (approximately 10%) for customer meetings, site visits, and project support activities.

Qualifications

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of a BS in electrical or mechanical engineering from an accredited institution
  • Minimum of seven (7) years electrical engineering or electrical design experience
  • Experience in medium voltage power distribution or substation design
  • Must be able to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now and within the future. Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional Engineer qualification
  • Field experience in testing/commissioning medium voltage equipment
  • Working knowledge of NERC/FERC, NESC, NEC, ANSI, NETA
  • Experience with AutoCAD and/or MicroStation

job.title: Senior Engineer - Field Service- CSM
job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description:

The Field Service Engineer:

  • Provide consistent quality and support to customers across the region.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Assist Delivery of project site works on data center operational equipment's - Installation, commission, test and handover to client over multiple projects.
  • Assist in the completion of preventative maintenance tasks for all aspects of  Electrical Panel/UPS/Chiller/PAC/PAHU etc panels.
  • Assist in the completion of preventative maintenance tasks for all aspects of  11KV/33KV sub-station with Transformer and DG set's.
  • Improve data center efficiency (DCiE) and Power usage effectiveness (PUE).
  • Create and review the technical Equipmentmen's SOP/EOP/MOP etc.
  • Analysis and review the site specific Daily/Weekly/Monthly report.
  • Preparation of all tools, test equipment and site documentation for project/maintenance activities.

Qualifications

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum 6+ years’ experience in data center operation
  • BE/B-Tech in Electrical Engineering discipline.

Additional / Preferred Qualifications: -

  • Experience with dealing with clients/customers in a professional manner.
  • Familiar with all aspects of electrical panel testing & fault finding.
  • Understanding of data center operational support equipment and Protection devices.
  • Good understanding of safe isolation and electrical safety.
  • Familiar with maintaining accurate and detailed completion of test documentation.
  • Experience with Client Factory Acceptance Tests / Site Acceptance Tests.
  • Excellent communicator.
  • Fully flexible to work additional hours on request.
  • This is a site-based role and majority of work time will be based on-site or travelling.
  • Full driving license.

Physical & Environmental Requirements: - (To be used majorly for manufacturing jobs.)

  • A significant number of afterhours and weekend work, frequently scheduled with little notice.
  • Travel on a daily basis to and from customer sites.
  • Will be required to stay away from home or travel long distances.
  • Occasional heavy lifting required.
  • You will be expected to operate as part of a team.
  • May be required to travel abroad from time to time.
  • You will be supplied with a Company uniform, which must be warn at all times while working.

Time Travel Needed:

job.title: Manager Purchasing
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

  • The job entails developing and implementing purchasing strategies, managing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, and ensuring the timely delivery of goods and services while optimizing costs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and implement procurement strategies to support the operations of the company.
  • Manage and lead a team of buyers and other purchasing staff, providing guidance on procurement processes, supplier management, and contract negotiation.
  • Evaluate supplier performance, negotiate contracts, and ensure compliance with quality and safety standards.
  • Monitor inventory levels and adjust orders as needed to meet demand.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve the procurement process to increase efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Analyze market trends and identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement procurement best practices.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, including negotiating favorable terms and resolving any issues that may arise.
  • Proven experience in strategic procurement and supplier relationship management.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and purchasing software.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Knowledge of procurement regulations, policies, and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business administration, or a related field.
  • Master degree desirable
  • 8-10 years of experience in procurement, with at least 4 years in a leadership role.
  • Good English communications skills – written & verbal.
  • Strong project-management skills.
  • Computer skills – proficiency in Microsoft-Office suite

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • The role is primarily based in a manufacturing facility, requiring regular site visits and interaction with production teams.
  • Required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) and adhere to safety protocols.
  • The role involves extended periods of sitting in front of a computer.
  • Occasional standing or walking may be required during meetings, presentations, or site visits
  • Work is primarily conducted in an office environment with controlled temperature and lighting.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • Travel to different office or plants locations, client sites, or conferences may be necessary.

job.title: Manufacturing Quality Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Incoming Material Inspection

  • Perform incoming inspection as per Inspection Plans, Drawings, Specifications, and SOPs.
  • Verify dimensional, visual, functional, and documentation requirements of incoming materials.
  • Conduct sampling inspection as per approved sampling plans.
  • Ensure proper identification, traceability, and segregation of non-conforming materials.

Supplier Quality Coordination

  • Coordinate with Supplier Quality and suppliers for incoming quality issues.
  • Raise supplier defect reports and track corrective actions.
  • Support supplier performance monitoring and improvement activities.
  • Participate in supplier visits, audits, and technical discussions when required.

Non-Conformance Management

  • Identify and document incoming defects through NCR/PDIR systems.
  • Implement containment actions to prevent defective material usage.
  • Support root cause analysis and verification of corrective actions.
  • Ensure timely disposition of rejected and blocked stock materials.

Quality Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain inspection reports, quality records, and traceability documents.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, QMS requirements, and inspection procedures.
  • Support internal, customer, and certification audits.
  • Maintain calibration status of inspection and measuring equipment.

Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze incoming rejection trends and supplier PPM performance.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce incoming defects, line stoppages, and blocked stock.
  • Support digitalization and process improvement projects in Incoming Quality.
  • Participate in Kaizen, Lean, and quality improvement activities.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with Sourcing, Supplier Quality, Engineering, Production, and Stores teams.
  • Support MRB activities and material disposition decisions.
  • Participate in daily quality review meetings and escalation management.

Qualifications

  • Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Production, or Industrial Engineering.
  • 1-3 years of experience in Incoming Quality, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Quality Assurance.

Required Skills

  • Incoming Inspection Techniques
  • Drawing Reading & GD&T
  • Measurement Equipment Handling
  • Root Cause Analysis (5 Why, Fishbone)
  • 7 QC Tools
  • SAP/ERP Knowledge
  • Quality Documentation & Reporting
  • Supplier Defect Management
  • PFMEA and Control Plan Understanding

Preferred Commodity Experience

  • Sheet Metal Parts
  • Fabricated Components
  • Machined Parts
  • Copper Bus Bars
  • Electrical Components (MCB, MCCB, Relays, Contactors, ATS)
  • Wiring Harnesses
  • Plastic and Rubber Components
  • Packaging Materials

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Incoming PPM Reduction
  • Supplier Defect Closure Effectiveness
  • Incoming Inspection On-Time Completion
  • Blocked Stock Reduction
  • Line Rejection Reduction
  • Supplier Corrective Action Closure Time
  • Audit Compliance Score

Competencies

  • Attention to Detail
  • Problem Solving
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Team Collaboration
  • Communication Skills
  • Ownership & Accountability
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

job.title: Customer Engineer - Power, NSW
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary/Objectives of Incumbent:

The purpose of this position is to carry out service of equipment, after hours service, commissioning and service contracts as planned and directed by the Service Operations Manager and Service Supervisor – Power.

Key Responsibilities

_Planning & Reporting:_

  • Ensure that service reports, expense claims and any other reports required by Management are completed and submitted by the due date.
  • Time Sheets must be filled out correctly (ie, accurately record of hours worked, and all call out and response times) and submitted to the Operations Manager or Service Supervisor – Power by the due date each week.  A Doctor’s Certificate must be supplied for any more than two days absence from work due to illness/injury.
  • Field Service Reports are to be completed for every service call made.  These reports MUST also be signed by the customer whether the work is chargeable or not.  All items used on a job, whether Liebert spares or consumables must be detailed on the FSR.

_Operational Delivery:_

  • Carry out commissioning, service contract maintenance and after-hours service commitments in a professional, efficient manner, and achieve a high level of service to our clients within the restraints of time, expense and profitability.
  • Maintain proper levels of relationships between the Company and our customers, by ensuring all complaints are reported promptly so that remedial action can be taken.
  • Ensure that a level of competence is maintained to adequately handle the degree of technology required by application to training available and personal updating.
  • At all times ensure that your Company vehicle, personal dress and appearance are presentable within the restraints of the work to be carried out, the Company policy is well understood and that Company business is carried out in an efficient and professional manner.
  • Spare Parts Van stock requisitions must be filled out when stock is required to maintain accurate records of stock in service vans and store.

_Continuous Improvement:_

  • To be aware at all times of both Sales & Service opportunities for the Company, and to report any such opportunities to Management.
  • To ensure that the Sales Department is made aware of all new sales opportunities and prospects, and to work closely with them in achieving this business.

_WHS, Environment & Quality:_

  • Comply with all Work, Health & Safety, Environment and Quality obligations
  • Actively promote safety in the workplace

_Daily work duties and expectations_

  • Driver's License is required (may involve visit to remote sites)
  • Overnight or longer trips may be required.
  • Unaccompanied (Lone worker)
  • After-hours work and being on an On-Call Roster are needed.
  • Attending customer Service calls.
  • Occasional use of ladders
  • Working in tight and restricted locations.
  • Working on and around Energized Electrical equipment.
  • Lifting, carrying, relocating equipment and components (e.g. Batteries, tools and spare parts)

Main contacts within Company

  • Other Customer Engineers – Power
  • Service Supervisor – Power
  • Service Operations Manager
  • Safety Manager
  • Technical Support Team
  • Sales Team
  • Finance

Main contacts outside the Company

  • Customers

  • Contractors
  • Vertiv Partners

Education/Qualification:

  • Electrical/Electronics Trade Certificate (ideally)
  • Relevant State-based Electrical Licence

Specialist Knowledge:

  • Commercial acumen
  • Technical knowledge in data centres, telecom, commercial & industrial or similar industries

Practical Experience:

  • Proven track record within the power industry as a service technician
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office

Personal Characteristics:

  • Excellent communication, inter-personal and problem-solving skills
  • Learning agility
  • Interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

job.title: Application Development & Support Senior Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

The Oracle EBS Analyst/Developer will:

This is a Global position to supports NPDI Transformation team. The successful candidate must have both data analytics skills and a good level of technical knowledge. Seeking an experienced Oracle EBS Developer with strong expertise in Supply Chain Management modules, specifically Items, Bills of Material (BOM), Inventory, and Order Management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing Oracle EBS applications to support business operations

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Design, develop, and maintain custom solutions within Oracle EBS R12.x
  • Create and modify forms, reports, and interfaces using Oracle tools
  • Develop custom extensions using PL/SQL, SQL, Oracle Forms, and Reports
  • Configure and customize Item Master, BOM, Inventory, and Order Management modules
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in production environment
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Create technical documentation for custom developments
  • Collaborate with business analysts to gather requirements
  • Perform system integration testing and support UAT
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in Oracle EBS modules (Supply Chain).
  • Provide root cause analysis and manage Oracle Service Requests (SRs).
  • Participate in system upgrades, patching, and performance tuning
  • Work closely with functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, user guides, and workflow configurations.
  • Lead or support steering committees and user groups for NPDI transformation initiatives

Qualifications

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • Proficiency with data analysis, data visualization and reporting tools
  • Skilled with Microsoft Office and specifically Microsoft Excel
  • Experienced in Oracle EBS R12.x Supply Chain Module
  • Very good knowledge of modern database systems and the related best practices
  • Proficiency with SQL and experience at optimizing large, complicated SQL statements
  • Understanding of the concepts, data models, architectures and interfaces of business applications such as, for example, ERP, CPQ and PLM systems
  • Shares best practices related to Oracle development to colleagues
  • Reads and continues personal development to stay abreast of changes and new techniques within the field of Oracle application development
  • Consulting approach, ability on understanding internal customer needs
  • Ability to multitask and complete tasks in a timely manner
  • Ability to work independently with minimal direction including providing regular status on assigned activities
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to work in a team-oriented and metric-intense environment
  • Familiarity with process design, design thinking, process re-engineering, lean and/or value stream mapping principles
  • This role may require occasional off-hours support for critical issues and deployments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other products of the Oracle suite (e.g. Oracle CX Sales, etc.)
  • Familiar with Data Warehouse and/or Data Lake solutions

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree with preference for Information Systems or Computer Science as field of study
  • Strong business analysis, and communication skills with 4+ years of experience in a company of similar size, revenue, complexity and geographic diversity
  • Deep knowledge in EBS R12.x Supply Chain Module

Time Travel Needed:

  • TBC

job.title: Associate Engineer Fluid Dynamics Engineering VIII
job.description:
Job Description

To perform CFD Analysis for system and component levels using Different Software’s Such as RealityDC & Celcius EC / Ansys Fluent / Ansys Icepak / Ansys Optislang / Ansys CFX. Engineer needs to prepare analysis model, Conduct model checks and/or creating parametric models with available CAD packages and perform the sensitivity analysis. He / She should be able to generate the CFD mesh/model and run steady/ transient flow/thermal analysis using different software’s and analyze the results as well as prepare the reports clearly. Utilize the analytical skill set and simulation tools to analyze the fluid flow systems and recommendations for design improvements. It is added advantage if He/ She is having fan operation and performance curve as well as flow bench / Wind tunnel operation

  • ME/M.Tech with specialization in Thermal Engineering/ Aerospace / Mechanical from a reputed Institute.
  • Undergone on Fluid Mechanics/CFD/ Heat Transfer / Thermodynamics during masters
  • Minimum 6 years of analysis experience in any CFD Analysis software.
  • Experience in Cadence software / Ansys Icepack / Ansys Sherlock / Ansys Multiphase / Ansys Aeroacoustics is added advantage.
  • Comfortable in working with Creo/Pro-E for model checking.
  • Should be able to Interpret analysis results for base design and suggest modification
  • Sound knowledge of fundamentals of Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics & Thermodynamics
  • Knowledge of telecommunication products like cabinets, enclosures, Datacenter, Refrigeration Cycle etc.  & Sheet metal will be added advantage
  • Excellent command of the English language, good interpersonal skills, Willingness to learn, good analytical & problem-solving skills

job.title: Senior Specialist, Project Management
job.description:
Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The primary responsibility of this role is to lead the squads to meet their goals :

  • for customer satisfaction through a robust customer feedback loop
  • quality
  • time to market
  • development costs
  • product costs

but as well to support the Product Owner and the squad members in the Agile transition to common alignment, self-organization, fostering communication, encouraging adaptation and flexibility to changes.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

What she/he will do:

  • Guide the Squads focusing on creating high value releases, along with being a Scrum Master for the respective squad
  • Partner with Product Owner to ensure strategy and execution alignment
  • Be the key facilitator and primarily responsible for facilitation of Squads events
  • Drive continuous improvement by coaching Squad members in Agile methodologies to maximize efficiency and self-improvement, and drive change management.
  • Manage inter-dependencies between squads, identify risks and opportunities for execution and business success.
  • Identify, escalate, and help find resolutions to Squads impediments
  • master Agile processes and fine tune them to Squad needs (e.g., mixing Scrum & Kanban to manage maintenance & development) while providing tools and methodologies to accelerate Squad delivery
  • Lead animation of a multidiscipline cross functional squad -- Design & Engineering, Industrialization, Purchasing, Quality, Manufacturing plants, Launch.

But also :

  • Follow-up the budget of the Squads
  • Collaborate to the agile transformation of the squad

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree

  • 8+ years of work experience
  • 3 years of product or project development experience would be advantageous
  • Strong facilitation techniques
  • Ability to build and lead Squads in a matrix
  • Promotes Agile values and principles
  • Outstanding communication, facilitation, negotiation, and coaching skills
  • Knowledge of an Agile Framework (i.e. Scrum, Kanban)
  • Planning and problem solving with product management and delivery Squads
  • Strong organization, communication, and interpersonal skills. Able to communicate priorities. Interaction with senior leadership.

job.title: Sr. Procurement Category Manager, Data Center Sourcing and Procurement (DCSP)
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure team provides AWS and Amazon.com with the compute, network and datacenter capacity that are the foundations of the retail and cloud business. We are seeking a Procurement professional to support the APAC data center procurement space in India.

As a Sr. Procurement Category Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for the complex construction procurement and related categories and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to reduce risks and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. Additionally, you will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category. You will also create global Procurement processes and tools to drive innovation across teams.

Key job responsibilities Manage General Contractor and Construction Procurement category Strategy and Delivery for India

Construction material supply chain sourcing and program management

Achieve cost savings through negotiations, value engineering through the supply chain, and strategic initiatives

Analyze category data and metrics to establish and implement procurement category strategies

Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns across categories and regions to influence customers’ priorities

Provide in-depth knowledge about the supply market and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically, to the business.

Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost

Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance

Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships

Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle

Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as management of contracts post-execution

Some travel may be required, up to 25%.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of program, project or product management, or leading product implementation experience
  • 6+ years of related industry experience
  • 8+ years of data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of high volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent
  • Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments
  • Experience with Continuous Improvement and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Experience in global supply chain management, managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company
  • Experience in program, project or product management, or leading product implementation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
  • Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction
  • Experience in procurement practices working with engineering, supply chain and Tier 1 OEM partners
  • Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

  • Diploma/Graduation in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 1-2 years of project management experience or operations planning experience
  • 1-2 years’ experience with physical network infrastructure deployment and troubleshooting
  • 1-2 years’ experience with network cabling (fiber optic & copper)
  • English language communication ability
  • Basic knowledge of computer hardware and network cabling.
  • Ability to work well with others in a team environment, displaying excellent time management skills and the ability to follow direction.
  • Able to work at heights or use ladders for continued periods
  • Have strong attention to detail, maintain high quality standards.

  • Knowledge of Copper and Fiber Optic testing methodologies.
  • Ability to read basic layout drawings and floorplans.

A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

  • You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
  • your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
  • You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).

  • You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.

job.title: SDE2 - Just Walk Out , Just Walk Out
job.description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use latest technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If this sounds interesting to you, apply and come chart your own path at Amazon. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. For an update on your status, or to confirm your application was submitted successfully, please login to your candidate portal. NOTE: Amazon works with a high volume of applicants, so we appreciate your patience as we review applications

Key job responsibilities

  • Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
  • Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
  • Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
  • Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
  • Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
  • Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.

job.title: Head of Marketing, India, AWS , Field Marketing-APJ
job.description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a senior marketing leader to define and execute the marketing strategy for India — one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important markets in the Asia Pacific region. This is a player/coach role: you will set the long-term marketing direction for India while staying deeply connected to execution across demand generation, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), events, digital marketing, and public relations.

As the Head of Marketing for India, you will be the single-threaded owner of marketing strategy, planning, and campaign execution targeting startups, developers, digital natives, SMBs, enterprises, and public sector customers across India. You will lead and develop a high-performing regional marketing team, drive orchestration across global marketing functions — including the Integrated Demand Centre (IDC), digital marketing, and events (Flagship and Cohort) — and deliver locally resonant programs that accelerate customer acquisition, pipeline growth, and brand awareness.

You will partner closely with the India sales leadership team, cross-functional marketing leaders across Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ), and global corporate teams to ensure marketing programs are tightly aligned to business priorities and deliver measurable impact.

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with executional rigor, has a proven track record of building and scaling marketing functions in India's technology landscape, and brings a genuine passion for cloud technology and an entrepreneurial mindset.

Key job responsibilities

  • Create compelling, results-driven marketing plans, complete with market assessments that deliver identified objectives to the business
  • Overseeing implementation of the Marketing strategy for India - including campaigns, events, digital marketing, and PR.
  • Lead overall implementation of marketing programs including lead generation activities,

eMarketing campaigns, product & solutions sales support, reference programs, customer & developer marketing programs, etc.

  • Organize, assist and implement marketing events, including the AWS Summits, exhibitions, seminars, tradeshows and product launches.
  • Day to day management and development of the marketing team.
  • Work closely with the company’s Sales team; enabling them to meet their commercial objectives by providing them with appropriate tools, materials and presentations.
  • Develop and execute customer-driven, locally oriented marketing strategies and programs that will increase customer demand, sales, and positively impact Amazon Web Services brand equity.

A day in the life The Head of Marketing for India will be responsible for building and executing marketing plans that deliver customer acquisition and retention programs necessary to power AWS's continued growth in India. The role's core responsibility is to use a combination of strong strategic planning and hands-on execution skills to successfully plan, develop, execute, and measure demand generation programs that deliver marketing contribution to the sales pipeline. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and action — setting the quarterly roadmap in the morning, reviewing campaign performance data over lunch, and joining a customer event debrief in the afternoon. job.title: Security Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security, APJC Customer Security
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Secure AI Solution Architect to join our APJC Customer Security team in a content-and-frameworks role. Customers across the region are asking the same questions about building securely with AI — how to give autonomous agents an identity, how to defend against prompt injection, how to govern the AI development lifecycle, how to evidence AI governance for a regulator. The approaches that answer these questions are being proved with customers today; what's missing is the layer that turns them into clean, documented, deployable patterns the whole field can use. You build that layer.

Working hands-on, you take validated approaches and turn them into reference implementations that work out of the box. You test them against real customer requirements, then package them into a published library that Solutions Architects across the region draw on. Your work is the difference between a pattern proved once and a pattern the whole region can reuse.

You are technically self-sufficient: you write the code, build the reference implementation, test it, and document it so a Solutions Architect in any area can adopt it without specialist presence. We are looking for a builder who enjoys taking a defined but difficult technical problem and turning it into an elegant, well-documented answer others can build on. Deep AWS experience helps but is not required at entry; we can teach the services. What we need is strong hands-on technical craft, security depth, and the instinct to build things that scale beyond yourself.

Key job responsibilities

  • Take validated Secure AI approaches (agentic-AI identity patterns, AI security frameworks, AI development lifecycle controls, guardrail and governance-evidence patterns) and build them into clean, deployable reference implementations — working code, not slideware.
  • Test each pattern against real customer requirements to confirm it holds, then package it into the published library that the field draws on.
  • Write the code, reference architectures, and documentation to a standard that a Solutions Architect or partner in any APJC area can adopt without specialist presence.
  • Work with the AWS service teams (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) — bringing field requirements and customer data into the product conversation and taking away clarity to turn into guidance.
  • Stay current on the AWS AI and security product set, translating new and upcoming capability into field-ready reference implementations as it lands.
  • Surface customer needs and gaps as feature requests, contributing to the feedback loop that shapes what ships next.

A day in the life You start the morning building out an agentic-identity reference implementation that two areas have asked for. A customer engagement last week surfaced a gap around cross-account tool-use authorisation; you build the fix, test it, and update the library entry so every area gets the improved version.

Mid-morning you join a session with the AgentCore service team. You bring the field data — what APJC customers are hitting on non-human identity — and take away clarity on what can ship as guidance now versus what needs a product change. You'll turn that into an updated reference architecture this week.

After lunch you go heads-down and build — hands on keyboard — turning an AI development lifecycle control you prototyped into a documented reference implementation with code, deployment steps, and a short workshop a field Solutions Architect could run themselves.

You close the day handing the finished pattern to the go-to-market team to fold into the next immersion-day curriculum, publishing the write-up to the field, and briefing the Associate SA on what's ready to be packaged into next week's community event. No two days look the same, but the thread is consistent: you build it once, and the whole region gets to build on it.

About the team

APJC Customer Security helps customers across the region adopt AI on AWS with confidence — ensuring security, risk, and regulation accelerate AI adoption rather than slow it down. We run two coupled programmes: Secure AI (making AWS the best place to build securely with AI) and AI for Security (using AI to help customers defend themselves). As one of two Solution Architects, you build the reusable technical foundation both programmes scale on. You work with the AWS service teams who build the products and the field teams who take guidance to customers. You will have a clear development path, a peer community of specialists, and see your work reused across the entire region.

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
  • Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
  • Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

You’ll collaborate with a diverse team of people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standard of safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. As a Civil Engineer, you will work as part of the wider DCE Team collaborating with our Real Estate, Design Services, Construction and other partner teams. You will be responsible for the successful delivery of design delivery ensuring we continue to meet and exceed our industry leading quality and performance requirements.

Utilizing your Civil Engineering expertise, you will assist in assessing site constraints, developing acceleration strategies and supporting overall campus planning, development and construction. This position ultimately plays a pivotal role for the delivery of Data Center projects.

The successful candidate will be strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly with a history of delivering for their customers. The role requires creative engineering balanced with high quality and customer focus. You must be able to work as part of a large and dynamic team, including many internal stakeholders, customers as well as external stakeholders like design consultants, developers and general contractors.

Key job responsibilities

  • Develop and communicate conceptual designs and create/maintain project documentation before, during, and after construction.
  • Develop and maintain design standards, design prototypes, and template specifications related to site design.
  • Review Due Diligence assessments to determine site constraints, risks and develop investigation scopes.
  • Create, review, and release design consultant request for proposals.
  • Manage our external civil design consultants through the design and construction process.
  • Develop and review designs for grading, storm water, flood mitigation, utilities, and pavements.
  • Deep understanding of interdependent civil design elements to develop optimised earthworks and utilities designs and minimise the construction schedule.
  • Lead our internal modelling and documentation resources.
  • Coordinate with internal and external Architecture, Structure and MEP design engineers.
  • Effectively communicate design standards to internal and external project partners.
  • Manage multiple fast paced projects simultaneously.
  • Think outside of the box to find innovative solutions prior to and during the construction process to reduce costs without negative impacts on quality or reliability.
  • Travel for site assessments, internal design meetings, construction review, and interfacing with authorities having jurisdiction. Anticipated travel is approximately 25%.

India

About Submer

Submer enables organizations scaling AI to overcome the limits of traditional datacenters across power, compute density and efficiency.

We design and deliver scalable, high-density AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling, supporting everything from early AI deployments to full-scale production environments.**

What Impact you will have

We are looking for AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect

Department: Solutions Engineering / Presales

Position Summary

The AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect is responsible for designing end-to-end AI infrastructure solutions that enable customers to deploy scalable, high-performance AI and HPC environments. The role combines technical presales, solution architecture, infrastructure sizing, and deployment planning to deliver commercially viable and operationally sound AI infrastructure solutions.

The architect serves as the technical authority for compute, networking, storage, AI software stack, and infrastructure integration while working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product Management, OEM partners, and the Facilities Presales & Design teams to ensure that the AI infrastructure requirements are fully aligned with the data center's power, cooling, space, and physical infrastructure capabilities.

This role owns the AI infrastructure architecture and complements the facility design process.

  • GPU server deployment
  • Network topology
  • Cable density
  • Space requirements
  • Liquid cooling interfaces
  • CDU connectivity requirements
  • Infrastructure dependencies
  • Expansion strategy

job.title: Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)
job.description:
:

Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)

Houston, Texas

Apply

Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)

Location: Remote (US-based strongly preferred)

Department: Legal

Reports To: General Counsel

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Submer

Submer designs and delivers end-to-end AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling.

We help organizations scale AI beyond the limits of traditional datacenters by enabling higher density, greater efficiency and lower environmental impact – accelerating time-to-AI from first deployment to full production.

What impact you will have

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Group Legal Counsel to join our growing team. This role will provide critical support to the Legal Department across a variety of corporate, commercial, compliance, and administrative legal matters. The ideal candidate will ideally be based in the the US and possess professional fluency in both English and Spanish, as they will support legal matters and documentation involving Spanish-speaking stakeholders and operations in Spanish-speaking jurisdictions.

This is an excellent opportunity for a strong, commercially minded, high-performing legal professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced, international business environment and partnering closely with executive leadership, outside counsel, and cross-functional teams.

What you’ll do

Corporate & Commercial Transactional Support

  • Act as a strategic legal partner at the group level, advising, reviewing and supporting negotiations on large client project agreements, partnerships, and vendor/supplier contracts across entities and jurisdictions.
  • Support fundraising activity: coordinate diligence, review and negotiate term sheets, MoUs, subscription agreements, SAFEs/convertible instruments, and related financing documents alongside outside counsel and finance.
  • Review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, from high-value client/vendor contracts to routine administrative documentation.
  • Partner with corporate finance on transactional matters, including entity structuring, intercompany agreements, and support for M&A or investment activity as needed.

Corporate Governance & Compliance

  • Lead entity management, board documentation, and corporate record maintenance across the group's legal entities, spanning multiple jurisdictions (including Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India).
  • Own regulatory filings, corporate compliance requirements, and monitoring of key deadlines and renewals across all jurisdictions where the group operates.
  • Design and drive internal compliance initiatives and policy management, ensuring policies are actually usable and adopted, not just written.
  • Flag legal and regulatory risk proactively to leadership, with practical recommendations rather than just issue-spotting.

Global & Cross-Border Legal Support

  • Draft, review, and translate legal, corporate, and business documents between English and Spanish; support Spanish-speaking employees, vendors, customers, and legal advisors.
  • Coordinate with local counsel across the group's jurisdictions; including Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India; to align global agreements with local law and practice. Note: the company is actively expanding internationally, so this footprint will likely grow.
  • Serve as a central point of contact for cross-border legal questions, helping the business navigate differing regulatory, employment, and contracting norms across regions.
  • Proactively build familiarity with the regulatory norms of new jurisdictions as the company expands into them, rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Flag where local law expertise or local counsel input is needed, and manage those relationships efficiently to avoid duplicated or unnecessary external spend.

Legal Operations & Efficiency

  • Own and modernize the company's legal operations function — contract lifecycle management, document repositories, matter tracking, and legal request intake.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, templates, and playbooks that reduce turnaround time and reliance on outside counsel.
  • Build and maintain a library of standard forms (NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, vendor agreements, employment-related documents) to accelerate day-to-day contracting.
  • Set and manage the outside counsel strategy: decide what should be handled in-house vs. externally, negotiate rates/scopes, and review external counsel work product for quality and cost before it reaches leadership.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Work alongside another senior lawyer to cover the full scope of the group's legal needs - this is a genuine partnership role
  • Bring independent judgment to the table: proactively flag risks, propose alternatives, and voice disagreement constructively rather than simply executing instructions.
  • Operate effectively amid organizational change - the company's structure is actively evolving, and this role will need to adapt scope and priorities as that unfolds rather than expecting a fixed mandate.
  • Mentor and potentially oversee paralegal or junior legal support as the function scales.

What you’ll need

  • Law degree and membership in good standing of a bar of a U.S. State, preferably Texas.
  • Minimum 7–15 years of experience as a practicing attorney, ideally with a mix of law firm and in-house/corporate legal department experience.
  • Fully remote role — you can be based anywhere in the world; US preferred and maintaining U.S. business hours (Central Time) required.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Able to operate semi-autonomously with modest supervision
  • Strong commercial legal background
  • Industry experience in technology, fintech, or other relevant commercial sectors
  • Comfort working across a genuinely global legal footprint (currently Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India, with further international expansion expected) - you don't need to already be an expert in each local law, but you should be willing and able to build familiarity with new regulatory norms as the company grows into new markets.
  • Demonstrated experience drafting, negotiating, and managing a broad range of commercial and corporate contracts across borders.
  • Experience supporting mid-large-scale fundraising, financing, or investment transactions (equity, debt, or venture-style deals).
  • Strong grounding in corporate governance, entity management, and regulatory compliance in a multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction structure.
  • Track record of managing outside/local counsel relationships across multiple countries and controlling legal spend.
  • Excellent judgment, organizational skills, and ability to prioritize across competing demands.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality, professional ethics and handling highly sensitive information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and document/contract management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting international, multi-entity business operations across more than one region (e.g., Europe, North America, Middle East, Asia-Pacific), and comfort operating in a company that is actively expanding into new markets.
  • Experience in engineering, manufacturing, technology, infrastructure, construction, or data center industries.
  • Prior experience building or improving a legal operations function from the ground up.
  • Notary Public certification (or willingness to obtain) is a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Multi-Jurisdiction & Cross-Border Coordination
  • Willingness to Learn New Regulatory Environments
  • Spain-Qualified, Bilingual (English/Spanish)
  • Commercial & Transactional Judgment
  • Corporate Governance & Compliance
  • Legal Operations & Process Design
  • Outside Counsel Management & Cost Control
  • Independent Judgment & Constructive Pushback
  • Adaptability & Comfort with Ambiguity
  • Confidentiality & Integrity
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

What we offer

  • Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
  • Medical Insurance Plan.
  • 401k Employee volunteer contribution Plan.
  • A great work environment characterized by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
  • You´ll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

job.title: Associate Director/ Director, Southeast Asia (Real Estate Investment)
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

As part of the CapitaLand Investment SEA business, you will be part of the SEA Investment team, reporting to the Head of Investment. You will play a pivotal role in supporting and leading investment, M&A, and related activities within the Southeast Asia (SEA) Investment landscape. Your key responsibilities will encompass the following areas:

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive investment strategies to support existing funds and facilitate the creation of new funds, with the objective of growing Funds Under Management (FUM).
  • Identify and secure pipeline assets for the fund through proactive deal sourcing and origination efforts.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop optimal investment structures and capital strategies to enhance investment returns.
  • Perform comprehensive market studies, develop operating assumptions, and conduct financial analyses with investment team to evaluate the feasibility of potential investments.
  • Conduct thorough due diligence and negotiations on potential pipeline assets and fund-related investments, ensuring compliance with investment criteria and risk management standards.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of investment-related documentation required for internal and fund investment committee approvals.
  • Ensure successful execution of divestment transactions to optimize portfolio performance.
  • Lead and mentor junior investment team members fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Good understanding in a wide variety of asset classes.
  • The Company may assign additional duties and/or vary the scope of work according to business requirements. Flexibility and adaptability to evolving business needs are essential.
  • Experience in fund management is preferred, but open to exploring candidates with fund management perspective, with a solid track record of deal experience in Southeast Asia.
  • Open to candidates from banking sector but possess good knowledge of Real Estate.
  • Proficient in stakeholder management.
  • Resourceful, solution-oriented with the ability to connect the dots to drive successful investment outcomes in a dynamic and competitive environment.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Qualifications for the role

  • Degree, diploma, or vocational qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Maintenance Technology, or a related technical field.

  • Experience working in marine, shipyard, offshore, power generation, or other heavy industrial environments is preferred.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, procedures, and engineering documentation accurately.
  • Strong safety awareness, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and the flexibility to work in demanding operational environments.
  • Effective communication, teamwork, and customer relationship skills, with the ability to collaborate across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Proficient in spoken and written English; additional language capabilities are an asset.

What's in it for you?

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

More about us

The Marine & Ports Division serves the shipping and ports industries through its extensive portfolio of integrated systems and solutions that improve the flexibility, reliability and energy efficiency of vessels and container terminals. By coupling power, propulsion, automation, marine software and services that ensure maximum vessel uptime, the Division is well positioned to help the marine industry to achieve its decarbonization targets while improving the profitability and sustainability of our customers’ business throughout the entire lifecycle of vessels. With ABB Ability™ Marine software solutions and ABB Ability™ Collaborative Operations Centers around the world, shipowners and operators can run their fleets at lower fuel and maintenance costs, while improving crew, passenger and cargo safety as well as overall productivity of their operations. Further, the Division delivers automation, electrical systems and digital solutions for container and bulk cargo handling, from ship to gate. These solutions help terminal operators meet the challenge of larger ships, taller cranes and bigger volumes per call, and make terminal operations safer, greener and more productive.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Safe Coding
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google’s Product Security team is a global force of over 300 engineers in Zurich, Munich, Sunnyvale, Seattle, San Francisco and some other exciting places around the globe.

Our mission is as critical as it gets: Keep Google products secure and their users safe.

The Safe Coding team contributes to that mission by managing some of the biggest risks in software security. We innovate at scale by making secure coding effortless, for everyone.

In this role, you will help anchor our Software Supply Chain security team and co-lead innovation at scale to make secure coding absolutely effortless for everyone.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Lead by example, driving engineering excellence across the team while actively mentoring and developing technical talent.
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Technical Program Managers (T/PgMs) to define, refine, and execute the team’s goal, roadmap, and broader AI strategy.
  • Stay ahead of the evolving agentic threat landscape and navigate a dynamic AI environment, leading fast-paced, creative problem-solving to address emerging and legacy technical challenges.
  • Cultivate strong, actionable partnerships across internal stakeholders including Google's software supply chain integrity program and executive leadership as well as external industry leaders and academic partners.

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

In this role, you will drive a cross-functional team of SREs and developers in managing Spanner’s high-scale serving path, which handles over 7 billion Queries Per Second (QPS). Your role focuses on delivering Google-critical compliance, security, and observability projects while maintaining a commitment to customer centrism and service reliability. You will be responsible for people development, program management, and deep technical oversight of monitoring, data integrity, and service level objectives to ensure the continuous improvement of one of Google’s most vital services.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of Software/Systems Engineers on projects for users and be directly responsible for uptime.

Own end-to-end availability and performance of key services and build automation to prevent problem recurrence. Automate response to all non-exceptional service conditions.

Lead by example, mentor the team and establish credibility through quality technical execution.

Manage on-call rotations across continents, using a follow-the-sun model.

Design, write and deliver software to improve the availability, scalability, latency and efficiency of Google's services.

job.description:

job.description:

You will partner with Architects and Engineers (A/E) to drive technical design across multiple projects. Using programmatic design principles, you will review A/E deliverables to ensure all project goals, safety standards, and Google requirements are met. job.title: Data Center Controls Facilities Technician
job.description:

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components).

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

job.title: Technical Lead
job.description:
Technical Lead

Johnson Controls (JCI) is searching for a highly skilled and experienced Technical Lead to lead a team of developers and testers on the construction of JCI’s internal and customer facing web and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have 8+ years of technical leadership capable of driving development and testing efforts in an agile environment.

Responsibilities

The Technical Lead will provide technical leadership as we design and build robust, elastic, and maintainable mobile and web-based applications. You must be a self-starter having a thorough understanding of Spring Boot, REST and SOAP services, ReactJS, Oracle or comparable RDBMS systems, SQL, Microsoft Azure software development and deployment tools, design patterns, and deployment strategies.

You will report to the Customer Experience Engineering Manager and work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Master, Solutions Delivery Leads, Solutions Architects, and partner companies as we deliver fresh and modern customer experience portals and mobile solutions to Johnson Controls North America customers.

The following areas are expected of the Technical Lead:

  • Technical Leadership: Lead end-to-end design, development, and deployment of scalable web applications using modern front-end (ReactJS), back-end (Java/Spring Boot), RDBMS (Preferably Oracle) technologies.
  • Architecture & Strategy: Define system architecture, ensure code quality, and drive adoption of best practices in performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Team Management: Lead developers and testers, conduct code reviews, and foster a collaborative environment to deliver projects on time.
  • Innovation & Upskilling: Stay updated with emerging technologies, introduce new tools/frameworks, and upskill the team to maintain a competitive edge.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required, specializing in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Minimum 8+ years of experience leading technical teams and architecting web and mobile applications
  • Strong experience with building complex web and mobile applications using onshore and offshore developers
  • Strong experience with providing technical guidelines to developers and performing code reviews
  • Strong experience with ReactJS and Spring Boot development
  • Strong experience in design, construction, and deployment of REST and SOAP services
  • Strong experience with Oracle or comparable RDMBS, SQL, and creating stored procedures
  • Experience with cloud platforms (with a strong preference for Microsoft Azure)
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure App Services, REDIS cache, and other cloud-based development tools
  • Experience with AI development tools, e.g. GitHub Copilot
  • Experience with incorporating Okta authentication and authorization into web and mobile applications
  • Experience with troubleshooting and solving application memory and performance issues
  • Experience with WebSphere Portal (HCL DX), WebSphere Application Server, and WebSphere Content Manager, a plus
  • Experience with JavaServer Pages (JSP) and JavaServer Faces (JSF), a plus
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum development practices and concepts
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Experience and desire to work within a fast-paced, iterative development environment

Ability to work independently delivering to tight deadlines

Able to create the Statement of Objectives (SOO - internal contracts) with the internal leaders to capture the Project and Financial Objectives

Able to support SOW refinements with various vendors ensuring all the mandatory information are clear and objectives are met

Experience

  • Knowledge of best practices for Service Now – Hardware Sourcing
