job.title: Commissioning Manager
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

Role Overview

The Commissioning Lead is responsible for leading and coordinating the successful delivery of commissioning and warranty activities across the designated region. The role ensures projects are commissioned safely, efficiently and to the required technical and quality standards, while meeting client expectations, project requirements and commercial objectives. The Commissioning Lead works closely with internal teams, technicians, clients and contractors to drive timely resolution of issues, effective project handovers and a high standard of customer service.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Lead commissioning activities across warranty sites and designated client accounts, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to required standards.
  • Monitor and manage commissioning and warranty performance, ensuring outcomes meet project, client and business requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to Field Technicians in resolving commissioning, warranty and technical issues.
  • Coordinate commissioning handovers, scheduling, resourcing and project requirements with CML, Service Coordinators and Local Branch Managers.
  • Manage warranty claims and ensure all commissioning, warranty and project documentation is completed accurately and within required timeframes.
  • Support the transition from warranty to preventative maintenance, ensuring PM requirements are communicated and established prior to the expiry of the Defects Liability Period (DLP).
  • Build strong relationships with clients and contractors, providing responsive service and supporting effective delivery of commissioning and warranty works.
  • Identify recurring issues and continuous improvement opportunities, providing feedback to management to improve processes, technical outcomes and customer satisfaction.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

  • 5–10 years’ experience in HVAC, HVACR or a related mechanical services industry.
  • Proven experience in service, account management, commissioning or a customer-facing technical role.
  • Strong technical knowledge and demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve HVAC and mechanical service issues.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the confidence to build trusted relationships with clients and contractors.
  • Strong organisational, planning and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver outcomes within required timeframes.
  • Demonstrated leadership, negotiation and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Ability to identify customer needs and opportunities, with strong commercial awareness and sales capability.
  • HVAC, engineering or related technical qualifications, supported by strong computer skills and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as a team player, building strong relationships at all organizational levels.
  • Strong capability to work both independently and as part of a team, with a service-oriented mindset.
  • Proficiency in English (written and verbal communication).

Benefits

  • Competitive salary package + Full time opportunity
  • Excellent job stability + Ongoing training and development opportunities
  • Inclusive work environment + Supportive management team
  • Opportunity to work across diverse operations throughout Australia

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

What You Will Do

Key responsibilities in collaboration with global teams include:

Manage staffing, budgeting, and operational oversight for India-based engineering teams across - design, implementation, and testing for Caterpillar’s Dealer ERP and CRM system based on Microsoft Dynamics 365 apps and supporting modules (Sales, Customer Insights, Commerce, Contact Center, Field Service, Finance, Supply Chain Management, Project Operations) ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical standards.

  • Design, implement, and test Power Platform solutions that enhance the core Dynamics 365 functionality through Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.

  • Adapt Microsoft's Common Data Model to fit Caterpillar's data domains, ensuring future compatibility with D365 updates.
  • Collaborate with the Product Management team to create and share product roadmaps that align with Microsoft's Wave 1 and Wave 2 release cycle.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

  • Analyses and discusses alternatives with multiple stakeholders.

Software Engineering: Knowledge of software engineering; ability to deliver new or enhanced fee-based software products.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

  • Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
  • Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

  • Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
  • Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
  • Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

Building Relationships and Using Influence:

  • Naturally connects and builds strong relationships with global stakeholders, demonstrating strong emotional intelligence and an ability to communicate clearly and persuasively.
  • An ability to inspire trust and followership in others through compelling influence, powerful charisma, passion in their beliefs, and active drive.

Considerations For Top Candidates:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field; Master's degree preferred
  • Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and/or Supply Chain Management solutions
  • Strong understanding of dealer operations and business processes in equipment/heavy machinery industries
  • Experience with full lifecycle implementations of Dynamics 365, from requirements gathering to deployment
  • Extensive experience in systems architecture, focused on Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementations
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365: Deep expertise with Finance & Operations, Supply Chain Management, Field Service, and other relevant modules
  • Microsoft Azure: Experience with Azure PaaS and IaaS services, including Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus, Event Grid, and Azure Data Factory
  • Power Platform: Proficiency with Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, and AI Builder
  • Integration Technologies: Experience with Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Azure Service Bus, and Azure Integration Services
  • Data & Analytics: Knowledge of Azure Synapse Analytics, Power BI, and data modeling for Dynamics 365 implementations
  • Development: Understanding of C# and X++ development, extensions, and other customization approaches within Dynamics 365
  • DevOps: Experience with Azure DevOps, including source control, pipelines, and ALM practices for Dynamics 365
  • Security: Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), role-based security, and data protection in Dynamics 365 implementations

Certifications (preferred)

  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Solution Architect Expert
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert

job.title: Digital Customer Experience Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Integrated Components & Solutions (ICD) division owns Caterpillar’s Wear & Maintenance (W&M) components business — the ground engaging tools, undercarriage, hose & coupling, fluids & filters, and associated hardware that keep the world’s machines running. Our team is building the digital, data, and AI capabilities that make these products easier for customers and dealers to find, buy, use, and get value from.

As Data Specialist, Wear & Maintenance (W&M), you will help maintain and automate the W&M data layer that powers our digital and AI capabilities. Supporting the W&M Digital Solutions team and the W&M Customer Experience strategy lead — and partnering closely with data owners and engineering teams — you will help build and run the processes that carry W&M data from parts information, through compatibility, to service options — keeping it complete, accurate, and automated. This is a hands-on, technical role: you will develop data pipelines and automation, support data analytics, and track data quality so that every downstream digital and AI experience is built on trusted data.

You will play a key role in maintaining and improving these data processes, while also supporting the analytics and quality tracking behind smarter customer and dealer experiences.

Job Summary

Maintain and automate the W&M data layer, and develop the processes that transform W&M data from parts information, through compatibility, into service options. You will support data analytics and data-quality tracking across the teams and systems that make up the W&M digital ecosystem — from the underlying data, to the AI capabilities that use it, to the customer- and dealer-facing channels where it all comes together. You will help build, run, and monitor data pipelines and automation — using approaches such as SQL, Python, and AI-assisted tooling such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) — that keep W&M part, compatibility, and service-option data complete, accurate, and trustworthy.

You will be a key contributor to the team that owns W&M domain data quality — helping close gaps, remediate defects, and improve coverage so W&M offerings surface reliably across VisionLink, Cat Central, SIS2, and the Cat AI Assistant.

What You Will Do

  • Maintain and automate the W&M data layer — build and run the processes that carry data from parts information, through compatibility, to service options.
  • Write and maintain SQL and Python to transform data, build automation, and validate that data- and AI-driven processes return accurate, trustworthy results.
  • Support data analytics and quality tracking — monitor coverage, completeness, and accuracy, and surface defects for remediation.
  • Contribute to and support our core product and component data — helping close gaps, improve accuracy, and ensure high quality, because good data is the foundation of every digital and AI capability. Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate data maintenance, classification, and enrichment at scale, with appropriate human review.
  • Serve as a W&M data domain contributor, ensuring data reflects our business needs and how customers and dealers work.
  • Communicate data status, quality metrics, and results clearly to stakeholders across functions and geographies.

What You Will Have:

  • Data Management: Working knowledge of the processes, tools, and techniques of data management; ability to maintain the quality, integrity, and accessibility of organizational data across its lifecycle, and integrate data resources for business processes and functional support.
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of data and process problems and create alternative solutions that resolve them.
  • Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Solid Understanding of the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision and to monitor and improve the quality of organizational data.
  • Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques for requirements analysis; ability to elicit, analyze, and document data and process requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  • Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools, and techniques; ability to effectively receive, interpret, and convey data status, quality metrics, and business needs in written and oral communications across many geographies and functional disciplines.

Considerations for Top Candidates:

  • 3+ years of experience in data management, engineering, or analytics.
  • Hands-on proficiency with SQL and Python for querying, transforming, and automating data workflows.
  • Experience with data platforms and pipelines (e.g., Snowflake, SQL, ETL) and comfort turning data into usable, trustworthy results. Ability to build Snowflake database objects (views, tables, stored procedures, etc.).
  • General knowledge of Wear & Maintenance products (ground engaging tools, undercarriage, maintenance parts) is a plus; familiarity with engineering/BOM data is valued.
  • Ability to build pipelines that leverage machine learning and/or AI agents to incorporate business logic and ensure data quality and completeness. Interest in and aptitude for AI-assisted data tooling (e.g., MCP, LLM-based tools) to accelerate data maintenance and quality.
  • Strong attention to detail and a track record of improving data quality, coverage, and consistency.
  • Strong communication skills in a collaborative, cross-functional, cross-geography environment.

Additional Details:

  • This position requires the candidate to work full-time at the Caterpillar office in Chennai, India.
  • This position may require up to 10% travel.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield Office, Bangalore, India

What you will do

The incumbent has outsourcing transition project management experience (captive or third party), whereby they can support the GBS Transition Managers to execute transition project planning, Knowledge Transfer, Ramp-up / Service Readiness Testing and Stabilization.

job.title: Supply Chain Planning Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Manager, Supply Chain Planning provides leadership for Caterpillar's Enterprise Capacity Planning (ECP) team in India and the extended ICS support team. This role is responsible for leading the execution and continuous improvement of Enterprise Capacity Requirement (ECR) processes that support Caterpillar's long-term growth strategy.

The position plays a key role in enabling enterprise-wide capacity readiness by leading EPP and ECR engagements, facilitating cross-functional collaboration, driving automation initiatives, and implementing standardized capacity planning methodologies. This role serves as the primary ECP contact for business partners across the Asia region while supporting global enterprise capacity planning objectives.

What you will do

  • Provide leadership and development for the India ECP team and extended ICS support team.
  • Lead critical Executive Product Plan (EPP) engagements across the Asia and Europe region and support global capacity planning engagements as required.
  • Ensure timely execution of Enterprise Capacity Requirements for Components (ECR-C) and Enterprise Capacity Requirements for Suppliers (ECR-S) refresh activities in support of Caterpillar's growth strategy.
  • Facilitate capacity planning workshops with manufacturing facilities, product groups, engineering, procurement, and operations teams.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for ECP business partners across the Asia region.
  • Drive development and implementation of automation solutions that improve workshop execution efficiency, process consistency, and scalability.
  • Oversee deployment and governance of the Efficiency Calculator initiative across Caterpillar facilities.
  • Lead deployment and adoption of Agility initiatives across internal manufacturing facilities.
  • Establish and strengthen partnerships and best practices with business partners and internal functions.
  • Lead the development and analysis of capacity, demand, and operational data to identify and prioritize opportunities for improving facility capacity and supply chain performance.
  • Drive continuous improvement of enterprise capacity planning processes, tools, reporting, and governance activities.
  • Communicate engagement results, risks, recommendations, and action plans to business leaders and stakeholders.

What skills you will have:

  • Leadership: Ability to lead, coach, and develop employees while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine root causes of organizational challenges and develop practical solutions.
  • Cross-Team Integration: Understanding the importance of collaboration across functions and organizations, with the ability to align teams toward shared enterprise objectives.
  • Project Management: Ability to plan, organize, monitor, and successfully execute multiple complex initiatives and engagements.
  • Process Improvement: Ability to identify process inefficiencies, establish standard work, and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Supply Chain Management: Knowledge of supply chain planning, manufacturing operations, capacity planning methodologies, and performance improvement techniques.
  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to establish effective partnerships, communicate clearly, and influence decisions across multiple business functions.
  • Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Ability to analyze information, assess risk, evaluate alternatives, and make sound business decisions.

Top candidates will also have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Management, Business, or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Operations, Capacity Planning, or related disciplines.
  • Previous people leadership experience managing technical, analytical, or supply chain teams.
  • Experience leading enterprise-wide or cross-functional projects.
  • Knowledge of Enterprise Product Planning (EPP), Enterprise Capacity Requirements (ECR-C / ECR-S), or similar strategic planning processes.
  • Experience facilitating workshops and presenting recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Experience leading automation, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Additional Information

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

job.title: Lead, Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Establish reliable and scalable quality engineering practices for StarHub’s digital platforms across mobile, web, backend and cloud-native systems. The Senior SDET will partner with engineering, product, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security and delivery teams to shift quality left, build meaningful automated quality gates, transition vendor-owned automation into sustainable in-house ownership, and provide fast, risk-based release confidence during migration, refactoring and platform modernisation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of the existing test automation from vendors and establish clear quality and governance standards, documentation, CI integration, reliability and maintainability expectations so automation becomes an integral part of product engineering.
  • Improve coverage, reliability and efficiency of automated tests across different platforms like web, mobile and backend
  • Improve quality of releases in terms of user experience and satisfaction by ensuring testability and automated tests are treated as first class citizens in the SDLC

Responsibilities

  • Partner with developers to design and implement tests at the right layer of the test pyramid or testing trophy, including unit, component, contract, API, integration, e2e, visual, accessibility
  • Setup automated quality gates across the SDLC to ensure issues are found as early as possible
  • Establish and track metrics for test automation to drive improvement and accountability
  • Improve test automation coverage, reliability and efficiency.
  • Use AI agents and coding assistants responsibly to assist with test planning, requirements analysis, risk discovery, test design, automation development, test data generation, failure triage, coverage gap analysis, documentation and refactoring.
  • Build internal tools, libraries, and platforms that make quality practices easier for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, data setup, environment reliability and release confidence.
  • Work with stakeholders across engineering and QE to ensure alignment on automation approaches and goals.
  • Work with vendors to deliver automation solutions to the standards defined.
  • Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, test plans, READMEs, onboarding guides and quality playbooks.

Areas of Impact:

  • Stakeholders: QA, Engineering, Program/Delivery Management, Product
  • Decision Rights: Strongly advise QA/Automation tools and license purchase, strongly advise KPIs for the test automation team
  • Resources: ~10 automation resources from vendors as peers, some existing licenses for UiPath, BrowserStack

Ideal Track Record:

  • Delivered automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) covering significant critical user journeys and behaviours, measurable regression improvement times in hours if not in days
  • Designed, or at least significantly contributed to, and implemented automated test frameworks from scratch that have measurably improved test efficiency.
  • Designed dashboards for reporting on test automation stats to stakeholders
  • Integrated tests with CI/CD pipelines
  • Used AI coding assistants or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent for testing, automation, documentation, triage or quality analysis.
  • Managed test environments and test automation infrastructure on cloud services like AWS, GCP, Browserstack, LambdaTest.
  • Built internal tools and utilities to make testing and QE easily accessible for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders improving productivity.

job.title: Director, Enterprise Client Solutions
job.description:
Job Description

The Director of Enterprise Client Solutions acts as the primary deal architect, story orchestrator, and strategic execution lead for the Chief of Enterprise. He / she leads a team of client-facing orchestrators to align multidisciplinary teams to pitch and convert large complex enterprise opportunities into technically feasible, commercially sound, multi-year deals. This role requires a highly effective communicator who can engage and influence C-suite, procurement, and Board-level stakeholders through clear, compelling executive narratives that articulate EBG’s distinctive value proposition.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Technology Advisor

  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including business, technology, procurement, and operational leaders.
  • Works closely with Strategic Account GMs to drive strategic account plans, including client priorities, whitespace opportunities, stakeholder maps, competitive position, and growth actions.
  • Lead executive client engagements, value-discovery workshops, solution briefings, and business reviews.
  • Act as the single orchestration point for strategic clients, ensuring coordinated engagement across internal teams.

Solution and Pursuit Leadership

  • Identify, qualify, and shape complex opportunities across connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, data and AI, digital workplace, managed services, and industry solutions.
  • Translate client challenges into clear value propositions, business cases, solution roadmaps, and commercial propositions.
  • Lead multidisciplinary pursuit teams comprising account managers, solution specialists, architects, bid, pricing, commercial, delivery, and partners.
  • Drive bid strategy, win themes, executive sponsorship, solution governance, risk reviews, and proposal quality for priority pursuits.
  • Ensure solutions are commercially sound, technically deliverable, scalable, and aligned to the client’s target operating model.

Delivery, Service and Value Realisation

  • Ensure a robust handover from pursuit to delivery, with agreed scope, assumptions, risks, commercials, success measures, and executive governance.
  • Partner with delivery and service-management leaders to resolve escalations and protect client outcomes.
  • Lead post-implementation value reviews to identify service improvements, upsell opportunities, renewals, and references.
  • Champion client experience, ensuring commitments made during the sales process are delivered in practice.

Internal and Partner Orchestration

  • Mobilise service lines to define offerings, product roadmaps, and specialist support required for client opportunities.
  • Work with technology services tribes on solution architecture, technical assurance, implementation approach, and managed-service design.
  • Build and activate strategic partnerships with technology providers, system integrators, and regional delivery teams.
  • Develop reusable account insights, industry plays, solution blueprints, and client references.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, telecommunications, consulting, managed services, or complex solution sales.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategic accounts and multi-service solution pursuits.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, data/AI, and managed services.
  • Proven commercial acumen, including business-case development, pricing, contract negotiation, and margin management.
  • Experience working with C-suite and senior public-sector, regulated-industry, or large-enterprise stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Win rate for priority pursuits and complex bids
  • Renewal rate, expansion revenue, and customer lifetime value
  • Client satisfaction, executive relationship strength, and referenceability
  • Delivery handover quality, major-escalation resolution, and value-realisation outcomes
  • Forecast accuracy and adherence to commercial and pursuit governance

job.title: Product Manager, Ask Maps
job.description:
About the job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

The Ask Maps team is on a mission to build the next generation of Google Maps, powered by Maps’ geospatial capabilities and the latest Gemini models.

We are transforming the Maps experience to a Gemini powered one that puts the user in complete control of their real-world trips, adapting to deep personal context, and anticipating needs before they arise.

You will be stepping into a high-stakes, hyper-growth environment. Our addressable market is massive - over 2 billion users rely on Google Maps.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

Responsibilities

  • Drive development and secure buy-in for a product outlook that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts.
  • Define the long-term direction for how we understand users’ typical mobility patterns and how we can help them proactively for their trips.
  • Partner with other Geo and Google teams to leverage cutting-edge personalization, geospatial intelligence, and agentic capabilities. Build scalable data and quality infrastructure to power personalized mobility suggestions.
  • Launch 0-to-1 Mobility features that make Maps more intuitive, proactive, and assistive. Iterate rapidly based on user feedback to refine AI-driven mobility interactions to drive topline growth for Maps.

The "On Platform" rPSA is a specialized product expert responsible for unlocking the next horizon of YouTube growth by making YouTube the destination platform for brands to build Content, Community, and Commerce while responsible for wider YouTube overall business for APAC and your responsible market.

job.title: Security Engineer, Google Threat Intelligence
job.description:
About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

Google's Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) is looking for a threat intelligence analyst for our Koreas Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) mission.

In this role, you will produce threat intelligence focusing on serious threats to Google, our products, and our users which are consumed by hundreds of security and abuse teams across the company, all levels of leadership, and externally to the security research industry. You will specialize in thwarting government-backed threats. You will be part of a specialized team at the forefront of tracking cyber threat actors. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Identify, analyze, and document network signals, malware behaviors, and threat reports related to trends and developments in adversary Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs).
  • Provide clear, actionable, and structured intelligence to product and security teams, assist in ensuring corporate and production systems are safeguarded.
  • Own the analysis efforts of multiple threat actors, and serve as a subject matter expert on how those actors might impact Google and our users.
  • Enhance analysis efficiency by conceiving and implementing automation opportunities, developing proof-of-concept code, and collaborating with stakeholders to deploy solutions.
  • Be capable of quickly identifying personal and team priorities, and able to work on assignments with minimal supervision while maintaining quality and deadlines.

job.description:
About the job

There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. job.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI, App and EcoSystem Safety
job.description:
About the job

As the Principal Engineer for the Singapore AI Center of Excellence, you will serve as the senior-most on-site technical leader and Individual Contributor (IC) guiding technical efforts across Singapore and the broader Asia-Pacific (APAC) region. In this high-impact, strategic role, you will define and execute the technical vision and roadmap for production-ready AI applications, focusing on applying deep AI and agentic capabilities to real-world product safety and security challenges rather than strictly research-oriented work.

This role requires a rare full-stack ability to operate as both a high-level strategic architect and a deep technical expert. You will lead the transition to Autonomous Defense, securing the Android ecosystem and Play Store by innovating on safety defenses for malware and content abuse to establish trust for our users and developers. Additionally, as the world moves toward an increasingly agentic environment, you will define what "agentic safety" means at Google, architecting frameworks to secure AI agents as they interact with connected apps and servers.

You will provide technical direction, oversight, and guidance to engineering staff. Regionally, you will serve as the technical lead for the APAC region, providing technical oversight and guidance to teams in India and collaborating closely with engineering and product leadership with other teams across the US and UK.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices & Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices & Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and execution strategy for Google’s transition to autonomous defense, ensuring we can scale our defenses ahead of emerging AI-driven threats.
  • Define what "agentic safety" means at Google, creating safety guardrails, policy engines, and architectures to secure environments where AI agents interact with each other and connect to MCP servers and various applications.
  • Apply deep AI and machine learning skills to build production-ready, real-world security applications to automate malware detection and content abuse identification across the Google Play Store and Android ecosystem.
  • Serve as the technical lead for the APAC region, providing technical guidance, architectural oversight, and coaching to engineers in Singapore and teams in India.
  • Provide technical oversight and define the daily work for the local Singapore-based engineering team in partnership with their direct people manager.

job.title: Engineering Manager, Android SRE, Site Reliability Engineering
job.description:
About the job

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to users' needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design.

SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

To learn more: check out our books on [Site Reliability Engineering](https://landing.google.com/sre/book.html) or read a [career profile](https://careers.google.com/stories/site-reliability-engineering-profile-google/) about why a Software Engineer chose to join SRE.

Android Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) manages the mission-critical infrastructure powering the global Android ecosystem of devices. The mission is to bridge the reliability gap between mobile and web platforms, building user trust through availability. We empower Product and Development teams to scale securely and seamlessly.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Lead software and systems engineers through planning, technical execution, and quality delivery. Grow engineering talent through mentoring and coaching strategies.
  • Manage end-to-end availability and performance for mission-critical services while building automation to prevent recurrence.
  • Collaborate with distributed partner teams and manage international on-call rotations.
  • Align with Product and Developer teams to define and deliver Service Level Objectives (SLOs) that ensure reliability.
  • Drive projects by leveraging existing frameworks and providing leadership in changing environments.

job.title: Digital Designer
job.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Digital Designer sits at the front end of scale, shaping the creative assets that fuel our performance marketing and automated ad workflows. The role brings strong design judgement to layout, visual hierarchy, typography, and composition, while taking a results-driven, test-and-learn approach to creative development. Working within structured design systems, the ideal candidate creates brand-consistent assets that can scale across formats and campaign variants, responds to platform performance, and iterates creative work to drive stronger marketing outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Interpret campaign production briefs and execute digital creatives across approved template systems and format families
  • Populate dynamic creative templates with campaign content including copy, pricing, product imagery, and CTA elements
  • Generate digital ad variants across all required placements using the ad automation platform, understanding template logic and catching layout anomalies proactively
  • Adapt and optimise assets for platform-specific specifications using Adobe Creative Suite
  • Ensure layout accuracy, brand consistency, copy integrity, and technical compliance across all outputs
  • Export and package final deliverables across required formats including static and animated assets
  • Maintain organised asset management, naming conventions, version control, and production file structures
  • Identify layout inconsistencies, formatting issues, or outputs outside approved templates and escalate when necessary
  • Support scalable production workflows and contribute to operational efficiency improvements
  • Undertake other duties, responsibilities, and projects as assigned by the supervisor or management, in line with evolving business and operational needs

Qualifications

job.title: Senior Copywriter
job.description:
Employment Type

Fixed Term (Fixed Term)

Closing Date

28 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Senior Copywriter

Job Summary

Job Description

Senior Copywriter – Roam (Telstra’s In-House Creative Agency)

Location: Sydney, NSW Reports to: Creative Lead (Copy) Type: 6-month contract

About Roam

Roam is Telstra’s in-house creative team. We’re a collective of hybrid makers and storytellers from all corners of the industry. We partner closely with Telstra’s marketing team and agency partners to push craft and creativity in everything we do. We move fast, think sharp, and make it memorable. We’re here to raise the bar, create meaningful customer experiences, and make every interaction count.

##

The Role

We’re looking for a copywriter who thrives in the world of 1:1 communications and service messaging. From emergency comms to basic customer service updates, you’ll have a keen eye for detail, and the ability to create clear, compelling, and customer-focused copy that strengthens relationships and drives action across a range of 1:1 channels.

This is a hygiene job for a large communications platform. The right candidate won’t mind rolling up their sleeves and deep diving into a range of different copy templates to weed out repetition and delete unnecessary comms.

With that in mind, you’ll get to shape communications that feel relevant, useful, and distinctly human. Working closely with our strategists, producers, marketers, and channel specialists, you’ll also be required to deliver consistent customer communications that adhere to Telstra’s brand and tone of voice.

A strong understanding of customer behaviour, personalisation, accessibility, and compliance is essential. You’ll know how to turn complex messages into simple, engaging communications that connect with our customers and drive action.

What you’ll do

  • Write engaging, customer-centric service messaging across a range of channels, including email, SMS, push notifications, in-app messaging, and other 1:1 communications.
  • Occasionally develop messaging across the customer lifecycle, including acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and loyalty initiatives.
  • Collaborate with designers, strategists, producers, and marketing teams to create effective customer experiences.
  • Translate customer insights and business objectives into relevant, actionable communications.
  • Apply personalisation principles to create messages that feel timely, useful, and tailored.
  • Ensure all copy meets accessibility, legal, and compliance requirements, while maintaining a strong brand voice.
  • Use testing, performance insights, and customer feedback to continually improve communications.
  • Work fast without sacrificing craft, clarity, or attention to detail.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven experience as a copywriter within service messaging, CRM, direct marketing, customer communications, or a creative agency environment.
  • Exceptional writing skills across short-form and long-form communications, with a sharp eye for detail.
  • Experience writing for email, SMS, push notifications, and customer journey communications.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, personalisation, and behavioural messaging.
  • Ability to balance creativity with performance objectives, compliance requirements, and accessibility standards.
  • Strong collaboration skills and a passion for customer-centred thinking.
  • A curiosity for optimisation, testing, and continuously improving customer experiences.

job.title: Treasury Manager - Reporting & Operations
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As a Treasury Manager (based in Sydney, Australia) for an initial 6 month fixed term contract, you will work closely with our global and local Treasury, Finance and Corporate Development teams, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Functional responsibility for treasury reporting to internal and external stakeholders
  • Contribute to development and refinement of best in class treasury framework, policies and other financial governance.
  • Lead and/or contribute to group treasury initiatives such as process improvements, system implementations and upgrades etc...
  • Collaborating with local and offshore stakeholders, maintaining and strengthening these relationships and building new relationships over time.

What You'll Do

Reporting & Compliance

  • Prepare and deliver comprehensive financial reports on treasury activities for various stakeholders, including board packs, due diligence packs, and investor roadshow packs.
  • Ensure accurate accounting and reporting of all treasury instruments, including mark-to-market valuations.
  • Support internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal policies as required.
  • Monitor compliance of all treasury activities with relevant policies, market best practices and debt facilities and escalate for management and execution as required.
  • Conduct regular reviews and audits to meet and exceed compliance obligations, target to build centre of excellence.
  • Modelling and analysis of cash and liquidity risks, interest rate risks and FX risks (transaction and translation)

Treasury Systems & Operations

  • Help implement and promote best practices in treasury management, operational processes, and reporting.
  • Contribute to the definition and delivery of business requirements for interfaces between the Treasury Management System (TMS) and other internal and external systems (e.g. ERP, banking platforms).
  • Manage TMS notional accounts and reconciliations, establish Middle Office (MO) controls to ensure alignment between physical bank accounts in TMS, ERP, and bank platforms for reporting obligations
  • Drive process improvements, automation, and system enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and control.

Treasury Data, Controls & Oversight

  • Hold functional responsibility for treasury data quality, ensuring all transactional data is complete, accurate, timely, and fit for decision‑making.
  • Own and maintain controls over data capture, validation, and reporting, providing independent oversight of Front Office execution and assurance over Back Office processing.

Leadership:

  • Lead the middle office accounting and reporting function maintaining the collaborative and high-performance culture in place today.
  • Balance project management responsibilities with day-to-day operations

What You'll Bring

  • A Bachelor's degree (or above) in business, commerce, economics, finance or similar field
  • 10+ years previous corporate treasury experience ideally in a business with an international footprint
  • Group Treasury roles within multicurrency, multi-jurisdictional organizations ideally in Data Center/Technology and/or Commercial real estate/REIT and/or project finance
  • Curiosity about Sustainability/ESG (some knowledge of ESG financing desirable)
  • A fast learner who thrives working in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail, integrity and ambition

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.description:
Job Summary

As Senior Program Manager, Corporate Real Estate Design and Delivery for APAC you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of Corporate Real Estate office fit-out capital projects across the APAC region, from project initiation through completion and handover.

Working closely with the Global Senior Delivery Manager, Design Studio, Regional CRE stakeholders, Finance, and external delivery partners, you will lead multiple concurrent projects across diverse markets, ensuring they are delivered on time, on budget, and to Equinix’s global design, quality, and governance standards.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role requiring strong programme management capability, commercial acumen, and the ability to operate effectively across different cultures, time zones, and levels of project maturity.

You will act as the regional point of accountability for delivery, while contributing to the evolution of global delivery standards, playbooks, and ways of working.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure all projects are delivered in accordance with approved scope, budget, schedule, and quality standards
  • Proactively identify, manage, and resolve delivery risks, issues, and dependencies, escalating where appropriate

job.description:
Job Summary

Join our Equinix Corporate Controlling team and step into a dynamic role as a Senior Accountant (Statutory Reporting). The Statutory Reporting team plays a vital role in overseeing statutory reporting, external audit management, and financial control activities related to tax, treasury, and legal transactions.

As a Senior Accountant on this team, you will be at the forefront of managing statutory accounting and reporting for our legal entities across APAC. Your responsibilities will include coordinating the statutory accounts preparation process, overseeing local statutory audits for a portfolio of Equinix APAC legal entities, and ensuring rigorous adherence to control fundamentals that safeguard our organization's financial posture.

Responsibilities

  • Craft Precision: Prepare meticulous financial statements, complete with comprehensive notes, designed to meet statutory filing requirements in compliance with various GAAP regulations
  • Navigate Complexity: Manage reorganization, M&A, and Legal Entity formation transactions in accordance with local GAAP requirements, ensuring accuracy and consistency with local procedures
  • Bridging Expertise: Review the US GAAP to Local GAAP bridges provided by GL, Revenue, Leasing, and FA teams, offering valuable insights and guidance in line with local GAAP procedures
  • Precision Champion: Provide insightful review comments to Accountants, following up to ensure timely corrections and maintain local GAAP accuracy
  • Compare & Analyze: Prepare year-over-year analysis for local GAAP statements, offering clear explanations for major differences to support decision-making
  • Audit Oversight: Review annual local GAAP trial balances prior to submission to third-party financial statement preparers, managing collection of essential reports and supporting documentation for auditors
  • Disclosure Specialist: Assist in preparing specific disclosure schedules to support local GAAP financials, serving as a liaison between accounting teams and auditors
  • Audit Project Management: Support local GAAP and Tax audits, managing the timing and execution of local GAAP adjustments and audits
  • Efficiency Driver: Ensure the timely submission of local GAAP requests, updating and maintaining local GAAP procedures for optimal performance
  • KPI Management: Track and report on late submissions and other key performance indicators (KPIs), enhancing accountability and efficiency
  • Flexibility and Initiative: Embrace ad hoc analysis as need ed, showcasing your adaptability and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

Qualifications

We're seeking a dedicated individual with:

  • 6+ years expereince in audit and accouting preferred
  • Well-Rounded Expertise: Ideally, you bring a background either in combined US GAAP/Local statutory audits or in the preparation of multi-country statutory reporting for a US-listed corporation
  • Solid Foundation: You should have proven years of experience preferred in performing accounting operations, demonstrating a strong accounting background and expertise in multi-country statutory reporting
  • Regulatory Proficiency: An ideal candidate will possess sound knowledge of both US GAAP and/or IFRS, along with familiarity with various regional local GAAPs
  • Audit Expertise: Experience in a public accounting firm is highly preferred, showcasing your understanding of rigorous audit practices

job.title: Manager, Interconnect & Fixed Voice Operations
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

Singtel Networks, the most established telecommunications infrastructure provider in Singapore is transforming to enable the digital generation of tomorrow. We are introducing new capabilities in 5G, Cloud, Analytics, Digital Commerce, Software Engineering, Cyber Security to enhance our core competencies and deliver innovative and differentiated Mobile and Fixed services (Broadband, TV and Telephony) for our customers. We are committed to celebrating inclusion and diversity and is a strong believer to upskill and nurture all individuals. Come join us today as we build Singtel’s Networks of tomorrow, and Empower Every Generation to live, work and play in new ways!

The Manager, Interconnect & Fixed Voice Operations is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and performance of Singtel’s local fixed voice interconnect systems. This role ensures seamless connectivity between Singtel and local and international operators, while maintaining high service availability, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

The incumbent will lead operational activities including system administration, fault management, service provisioning, and number portability operations. The role also drives cybersecurity compliance through system patching, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.

In addition, the role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders, external operators, and vendors to resolve service issues, implement system enhancements, and support regulatory directives such as scam call mitigation in partnership with IMDA and SPF.

Operations & Service Management

  • Oversee daily BAU operations of local fixed voice and interconnect systems to ensure high availability and performance
  • Ensure timely service provisioning, system monitoring, and execution of number migration/porting activities
  • Manage interconnect junctions and signalling links between Singtel and local/overseas operators (FBO/SBO/OLO)

Incident & Fault Management

  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of service issues, including call failures, signalling faults, and number portability issues
  • Manage and resolve escalations from TAC, INOC, ISMC, 1608, and external partners
  • Ensure timely handling of critical and urgent incidents, including after-office-hours escalations (e.g. VIP/VVIP cases)

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as the key point of contact for interconnect-related matters with external operators and partners
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders (Work Order, Product, Account teams) to ensure accurate order capture and timely provisioning
  • Engage vendors for issue escalation, including hardware replacement, software fixes, patching, and system upgrades

System Administration & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage system configuration, software upgrades, patching, and performance optimization
  • Oversee equipment lifecycle management, including refresh planning and execution
  • Review and govern Method of Procedure (MOP) for system changes and upgrades

Security, Compliance & Audit

  • Ensure systems meet cybersecurity standards through regular patching, vulnerability scanning, and mitigation
  • Support internal and external audit exercises and ensure proper documentation and controls
  • Manage IMDA directives related to scam prevention, including testing and implementation

Regulatory & Special Operations Support

  • Work with IAR, IMDA, and SPF to support scam call blocking initiatives and regulatory requirements
  • Support special events and emergency preparedness activities (e.g. SPF contingency planning)

Resource & Capacity Management

  • Manage C4 resource planning, including onboarding of new interconnect partners and capacity expansion

Skills for success:

  • Degree in IT/Computer or equivalent work experience in telecom,networking and IT
  • Strong knowledge of telecom networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
  • Experience with legacy signaling protocols (SS7/ISDN) and SIP-based voice systems

Linux knowledge

  • Understanding of interconnect architecture, number portability, and call routing
  • Good to have CCNA , CCNP or equivalent certification

At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

job.description:
Responsibilities

Data Centre Operations Management

job.title: Staff AI Lead
job.description:
Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

At Optus, we're building the next generation of AI-powered customer and employee experiences. As part of one of Australia's largest customer-facing AI portfolios, you'll play a key role in designing and optimising AI solutions that transform how millions of customers engage with Optus

We're looking for a Staff AI Lead to provide technical leadership in the design and delivery of AI agents and intelligent products across Optus. As one of the organisation's senior AI practitioners, you'll shape technical approaches, influence product direction and help establish the standards, frameworks and best practices that enable AI solutions to scale safely and effectively.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong product thinking and a passion for solving complex business challenges using Agentic AI, Generative AI and LLM-powered technologies.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build and continuously improve AI agents and AI-powered products.
  • Translate business problems and service opportunities into scalable AI solutions.
  • Develop and refine prompts, workflows, tools, orchestration logic and guardrails.
  • Drive experimentation, testing and evaluation to improve agent performance and customer outcomes.
  • Use data and insights to identify optimisation opportunities and measure impact.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Design and Analytics teams to deliver high-quality AI experiences.
  • Contribute to standards, frameworks and best practices for developing and scaling AI solutions.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Demonstrable experience building and delivering AI agents, GenAI solutions, conversational AI or LLM-powered products.
  • Strong knowledge of agent architectures, orchestration patterns, prompt engineering and AI guardrails.
  • Deep hands-on experience building, evaluating and optimising AI agents and LLM-powered products in production environments.
  • Experience using experimentation, analytics and data-driven insights to improve product performance.
  • Strong technical judgement and the ability to influence stakeholders across multiple disciplines.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and drive alignment across teams.
  • A customer-focused mindset, curiosity for emerging technologies and a passion for continuous improvement.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office,gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email[AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au)or call 1800 309 170.

job.title: Application Development & Support Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Data Quality Developer will play a hands-on technical role in implementing and maintaining data quality controls, monitoring frameworks, and integration solutions across our enterprise MDM ecosystem. This position requires a strong technical background combined with excellent communication skills to work effectively with business stakeholders across the globe.

Working closely with the Data Governance Council Lead, this role will be responsible for configuring data quality platforms, implementing validation rules and workflows, developing dashboards and reports, and remediating data quality incidents across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.

Two Data Quality Developers will be hired — one focused primarily on the Ataccama platform (configuration, rules, profiling, monitoring) and the other focused on data quality operations outside of Ataccama (cross-system reconciliation, integrations, dashboards, remediation). Both developers serve as each other's backup and are expected to be cross-trained across all responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities Data Quality Platform Configuration & Customization

  • Configure and customize data quality platforms (primarily Ataccama) to ensure optimal user experience for data management
  • Implement data quality rules, validation logic, and automated controls within the DQ platform
  • Develop and maintain workflows to manage reference data across systems
  • Build monitoring capabilities for operational processes and data quality metrics
  • Perform data profiling and analysis using platform-native tools to identify data quality issues and patterns
  • Configure DQ platform integrations with MDM, Snowflake, and enterprise source systems

Data Quality Analysis & Remediation

  • Run reports across systems to calculate data quality dimensions (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness)
  • Execute data reconciliation reports across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
  • Remediate data quality incidents in a timely manner — triage, investigate root cause, and resolve
  • Identify recurring incidents and implement permanent fixes to resolve root cause issues
  • Manage incident resolution using ServiceNow to meet SLAs
  • Collaborate with MDM developers and integration developers to trace data quality issues across system boundaries
  • Analyze logs and data flows to isolate where quality degradation occurs in the pipeline

Dashboard & Reporting Development

  • Implement and maintain data quality dashboards using Power BI
  • Create business-friendly visualizations of data quality findings and trends
  • Develop reports to track quality metrics across all domains (customer, supplier, contact, item)
  • Build monitoring reports for operational processes and controls
  • Design health scoring dashboards that provide at-a-glance quality status for each domain

Data Integration & Synchronization

  • Implement data integrations to synchronize data across systems for quality monitoring and reconciliation
  • Develop ETL processes to support data quality and reconciliation needs (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, or platform-native connectors)
  • Work hands-on with MDM, Snowflake, and related systems to implement quality controls
  • Ensure data consistency and accuracy across the enterprise data landscape
  • Build automated data validation checks within integration pipelines

Stakeholder Collaboration & Requirements Gathering

  • Participate in requirements gathering sessions with business users
  • Elicit and document data quality requirements from stakeholders
  • Present data quality findings in a business-friendly format
  • Conduct meetings with large audiences independently
  • Work effectively with business users across multiple regions and time zones

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to enhance data quality processes and controls
  • Contribute to the evolution of data quality maturity in the organization
  • Support the long-term data quality roadmap
  • Stay current with data quality best practices and emerging technologies

Required Qualifications Experience

  • 8+ years of total experience in data quality, data development, or related fields, preferably in an MDM and data governance environment
  • 5+ years hands-on experience with at least one data quality platform (e.g., Ataccama, Informatica Data Quality, Talend Data Quality, or similar)
  • 5+ years advanced SQL proficiency for data analysis, profiling, quality checks, and reconciliation (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake)
  • 4+ years ETL development experience for data integration and transformation (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, or platform-native connectors)
  • 3+ years experience building reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar visualization tools
  • 3+ years experience with data profiling tools and techniques for root cause analysis
  • 3+ years experience with data reconciliation across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
  • 2+ years experience with incident management and SLA-driven resolution using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
  • Experience working with business stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones
  • Proven track record of implementing data quality solutions and controls

Communication & Collaboration

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language
  • Experience presenting to diverse audiences including business stakeholders and leadership
  • Proven ability to conduct meetings with large audiences independently
  • Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills
  • Comfortable working across global teams and time zones

Security & Compliance

  • Working knowledge of data security, information security practices, and SOX compliance procedures for data quality changes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ataccama Experience: Hands-on experience with Ataccama ONE platform (DQ rules, profiling, monitoring, workflows)
  • Multi-Domain MDM Experience: Experience working with customer, supplier, contact, or item master data domains
  • Manufacturing Industry: Background in manufacturing industry, particularly across multiple countries
  • Snowflake / Data Lake: Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms for data quality monitoring and reconciliation
  • ServiceNow: Experience using ServiceNow for incident management and meeting SLAs
  • MDM Platforms: Familiarity with MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio) and how DQ integrates with MDM workflows
  • Certifications: Data quality or data management certifications (e.g., CDMP, vendor-specific certifications)
  • Additional Tools: Experience with data governance tools, metadata management platforms, or data catalogs
  • Agile/Scrum: Experience working in Agile delivery environments

job.title: Sr. Manager IT Management
job.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Engineering Manager, MDM will lead a team of developers responsible for the ongoing development, support, and enhancement of our enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) platform. This is a hands-on technical leadership role — the Engineering Manager will personally design solutions, write and review code, estimate work from loosely defined requirements, and solve complex technical problems — while also managing team delivery and performance.

This role operates under a "you build it, you support it" model — there is no separation between development and support teams. The Engineering Manager is accountable for platform stability, sprint delivery, code quality, SLA compliance, and team performance across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.

The successful candidate must be a seasoned technical problem-solver first and a people manager second. They will work closely with the MDM Architect (who drives technical direction and design authority) and the Program Manager (who drives roadmap, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional coordination).

Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and manage a team of developers supporting and enhancing the MDM platform
  • Conduct sprint planning, prioritization, and ensure consistent monthly sprint delivery
  • Perform code reviews to maintain high code quality standards
  • Hire, onboard, and rapidly build capability in new team members
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Enforce the "you build it, you support it" model — ensure developers own their features through production support
  • Drive technical debt reduction and code optimization initiatives
  • Monitor and report on platform KPIs and team performance metrics
  • Work with platform vendors to drive open product issues to closure

Platform Development, Enhancement & Support

  • Personally design solutions for complex problems and estimate effort from loosely defined requirements

  • Handle complex data reconciliation and synchronization across systems

Platform Migration & Modernization

  • Lead the technical execution of MDM modernization
  • Plan and execute phased migration strategy ensuring zero data loss and minimal business disruption
  • Design and validate data mapping between legacy and target platforms
  • Ensure feature parity and regression testing throughout migration phases

Technical Quality & Testing

  • Design and think through complex testing scenarios for platform changes
  • Lead unit testing, system integration testing, UAT, and non-functional testing efforts
  • Maintain and execute regression test cases during significant platform changes
  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment
  • Conduct DR (Disaster Recovery) testing and ensure business continuity
  • Debug, refactor, and rewrite code to improve performance and maintainability

Security & Compliance

  • Ensure security best practices are followed across all platform development
  • Oversee static and dynamic code analysis to identify and remediate vulnerabilities
  • Ensure SOX compliance for all platform changes and controls
  • Maintain secure coding standards and conduct security reviews as required

Required Qualifications Technical Expertise

  • MDM Platform Experience: 8-10 years hands-on experience working with at least one MDM platform (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio, SAP MDM, or similar)
  • SQL Proficiency: 8-10 years of experience and advanced knowledge of SQL for complex queries, data analysis, and troubleshooting
  • Coding Skills: Hands-on ability to write, debug, refactor, and rewrite code — this is not a management-only role
  • Problem-Solving: Proven ability to design solutions for complex problems and triage issues spanning multiple systems
  • Data Migration: Extensive experience with large data migrations and bulk update operations in MDM environments
  • System Integration: Experience onboarding new systems, organizations, and datasets to MDM platforms
  • Data Mapping & Integration: Hands-on experience with data mapping and integration using at least one integration platform
  • Event driven architecture: Experience with event-driven architecture and API-first integration patterns
  • AI/ML: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts for data matching and deduplication
  • Agile: Experience with Service Now agile and project management modules

Software Development Discipline

Deep knowledge of the complete software development lifecycle including:

  • Requirements gathering and analysis
  • Technical design and architecture
  • Development and coding standards
  • Unit testing and test automation, System integration testing (SIT), User acceptance testing (UAT), Non-functional testing (performance, security)
  • CI/CD pipeline implementation and management. Change management and deployment processes
  • Release management including release, post-production validation, roll back planning and execution

Delivery Management

  • Ability to estimate effort, duration, and resource requirements from loosely defined requirements
  • Experience evaluating user stories, establishing story points, and creating delivery schedules
  • Proven track record of sprint planning, prioritization, and consistent delivery
  • Experience managing SLAs and meeting incident resolution targets
  • Discipline to maintain regression test cases and ensure platform stability during significant changes
  • Experience running daily scrums

Leadership & Communication

  • 5+ years of experience managing technical teams of 8+ developers
  • Experience hiring, onboarding, and retaining technical talent
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to explain complex technical problems in business-friendly language
  • Experience creating design and technical documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multi-domain MDM experience (customer, supplier, contact, item)
  • Manufacturing industry experience across multiple countries
  • Familiarity with AI and ML modeling and production integration

Familiarity with Graph databases
