job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

job.title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

About You

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):

  • Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
  • Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
  • Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
  • Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
  • Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
  • Liaising with internal teams & management groups
  • Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
  • Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
  • Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.

People Management. As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.

Incident Management. You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.

Vendor Management. An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.

Process Improvement. You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.

We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.

To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations. The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cuttingedge data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.

Key job responsibilities A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

  • You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
  • Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
  • You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
  • You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
  • You perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
  • You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
  • You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
  • You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
  • More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
  • This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift & rack equipment up to 18kg; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines.
  • This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

Key job responsibilities A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

  • You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
  • Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.

  • You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
  • More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.

job.title: Sr. Data Engineer - Supply Chain Automation
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Services - Supply Chain (AIS - SC) organization works to deliver futuristic solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth !

Do you love problem solving? Do you enjoy learning new ideas and apply them to problems? Are you looking for real world engineering challenges? Do you dream about elegant high quality solutions? Want to be a part of an amazing team that delivers first class automation solutions to our business world-wide?

AWS is seeking a highly motivated and passionate Sr. Data Engineer - Supply Chain Automation who is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying Supply Chain Application and Process Automation. In this role you will collaborate with business leaders, work backwards from customers, identify problems, propose innovative solutions, relentlessly raise standards, and have a positive impact on AWS Infrastructure Services Supply Chain. In this, you will work closely with a team of Data Engineers and Data Scientists to architect the application programming interface (API) and user Interface (UI) in context with the business outcomes. You will be using the best of available tools, including EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, and Elastic Search. You will be responsible for the full software development life cycle to build scalable application and deploy in AWS Cloud.

In this job, you will:

  • Work with business leaders, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to ideate business friendly software solutions.
  • Design client-side and server-side architecture.
  • Develop visually appealing front end website architecture, including translating designer mock-ups and wireframes into front-end code.
  • Develop functional databases, applications, and servers to support websites on the back end.
  • Write effective APIs.
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade applications.
  • Create security and data protection settings.
  • Build features and applications with a mobile responsive design.
  • Develop technical specifications and write technical documentation.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of data engineering experience
  • Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
  • Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field, or PhD
  • - 6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience with 3+ years of in developing Supply Chain Solutions and Software.
  • - Expertise with SQL and NoSQL databases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
  • - Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs.
  • - Having working closely with Business on Supply Chain Planning and Procurement system development.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Telstra Retail: Assistant Store Manager
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

29 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Assistant Store Manager

Job Summary

As an Assistant Store Manager, you will support store operations by assisting with team coordination and maintaining service standards. You will handle moderately complex tasks, ensure adherence to operational guidelines, and work independently on defined responsibilities. This role demonstrates growing autonomy and contributes to a seamless customer experience.

Job Description

Telstra is hiring!

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

Our Capalaba store is hiring an Assistant Store Manager to join their team a full time basis. This is an opportunity to enhance your leadership skills, overseeing a retail team with a unique buzz and energy at Telstra within a dynamic team environment at Telstra.

What we offer our team members

We have a tonne of great benefits here at Telstra, from thousands of training and career-growth opportunities, to exclusive discounts across hundreds of brands and partners. Take a look at all that’s on offer [and how you can shape your benefits, your way](https://www.telstra.com.au/careers/why-telstra/benefits-your-way).

Below is a snapshot of just some of the cool things we offer:

  • Store performance-related commission
  • 30% off Telstra services
  • Telstra mobile and Sim card
  • Exclusive discounts and offers across 240 brands and partners.
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary and secondary carers

As an Assistant Retail Store Manager at Telstra, you’ll work closely with the Store Manager to coach and grow your team. You’ll use your management experience to help coach our retail consultants to success, making sure they’re driven and energised to reach and exceed store targets.

What you’ll do

  • Oversee the induction of your new team members
  • Coach the store’s team to meet (and exceed) store targets
  • Help support your team with customer query escalations
  • Be the Store Manager’s right-hand person, stepping up to act as Store Manager when needed
  • Executing business initiatives in store to meet financial and customer key metrics.
  • Act as team cheer leader – leading from the front and helping to motivate the team, and foster an awesome store culture
  • Organise the store floor and team’s work schedules, to meet customer demand.

About you

  • You have previous experience in a retail leadership / assistant management role
  • You’re able to energise and drive a retail team to exceed sales targets and KPIs with demonstrated success
  • You lead from the front and are able to influence and build rapport with a diverse and varied team
  • You’re able to resolve customer issues with your eyes closed and can put a creative spin on problem solving
  • You’re an excellent communicator who can help support the Store Manager in taking team members through change.

What’s next?

After you’ve submitted your application, the next step is a video assessment supported by our partner, Hire Vue. Please keep an eye out for the email to move your application along swiftly.

Why Telstra?

[Retail Opportunities at Telstra](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UrXQB9m3dH0)

When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued, and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, and abilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive.

We work flexibly at Telstra, talk to us about what flexibility means to you. When you apply, you can share your pronouns and /or any reasonable adjustments needed to take part equitably during the recruitment process.

job.title: Order Handling Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Manager Order Handling ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide customer support, including technical support, order, and payment-related assistance to achieve target levels of service quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Each day, you will implement customer support strategies to increase operational excellence and customer satisfaction in the sales process. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting the achievement of established targets by overseeing progress and implementing improvement actions as needed.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Distribution Solution division at Nashik, India

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Focusing on achievement of defined targets, including inventory turn on finished goods, requested on-time delivery, and Net Promoter Score.
  • Processing orders by coordinating with Sales, Product Marketing, Logistics, and other internal teams to ensure that customers receive accurate and timely delivery of products.
  • Acting as the first port of call for customers’ queries and orders and ensuring the resolution of customer issues.
  • Supporting in pre-sales or after-sales service by resolving customer issues and ensuring effective and efficient customer communication by utilizing specific commercial communication tools.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across business processes to enhance order execution efficiency and operational excellence.
  • Lead digitalization and automation projects to improve overall business efficiency, productivity, and process effectiveness.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

  • Degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering
  • Minimum 5 to 8 years experience in Order Management, Project management, Customer Service, Sales Operations, or Supply Chain processes.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, including Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, for data analysis, reporting, collaboration, and process automation.
  • Experience using ERP systems (SAP preferred) and digital business tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data and drive improvements.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

job.title: Business Controller, Regional Business Line IN, MEA, LATAM
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Business Line Controller, Motors and Generators ###

Your role and responsibilities We are seeking a Business Controller in Motion High Power’s Motors and Generators Regional Business Line IN, MEA, LATAM. You will be acting as a business partner to the Region Business Line Manager influencing strategic decisions, driving financial performance, and helping to shape the future of the Business Line. You will support decision-making by monitoring, analyzing and interpreting financial data, evaluating business scenarios, and recommending the most suitable actions. Possibilities for professional growth are important at ABB so we would like you to be committed to helping your team to grow and develop their skills.

This position offers an exciting opportunity in a dynamic, international environment, with responsibilities spanning multiple areas of financial management. The Regional Business Controller is a member of the Regional Business Line management team.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Motion High Power’s Motors and Generators division based in Vadodara, India:

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Owning and managing the financial performance of the Regional Business Line, focusing on India (market and factory) as well as Middle-East & Africa and Latin Americas markets.
  • Supporting the Region Manager in making effective business decisions by analyzing and interpreting financial data, evaluating alternative business scenarios, and recommending optimal solutions.
  • Translating business strategy into business plans and monitoring of measurable targets. Promoting transparent and efficient controlling structures and financial systems.
  • Leading monthly closing, forecasting, and financial planning processes. Driving cost efficiency, cash flow, productivity improvements and capital efficiency, providing insights and analysis to support operational decision-making. Ensure compliance with the company’s governance model and internal controls within the local business line.
  • Leading and developing the local finance team, including competence development, tools, systems, and processes. Leading, guiding and facilitating best-practice sharing to ensure consistency of controlling practices across the organization.
  • Ensuring timely and efficient communication with stakeholders.

Qualifications for the role

· 15+ experience of business controlling roles in a global environment. Strong business acumen and excellent knowledge of finance processes and tools, including SAP.

· Experience in manufacturing operations and related financial processes is a strong advantage.

· Experience in setting up managing Local Sales Units and related structures is a strong advantage. Proven track record of execution and delivering results in an international setting.

· Good collaboration and communications skills. Experience in leading a finance team and demonstrated leadership capabilities.

· Professional working proficiency in English; additional languages are an asset.

· Recognized as a strong team player with excellent collaboration and business partnering skills.

· India Chartered Accountant with relevant experience.

job.title: Site Supervisor, Network & Fibre Installation
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Site Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day site supervision and execution of Network Layer 1 installation works for large-scale data centre deployment projects.

Reporting to the Site Manager, the Site Supervisor will directly supervise subcontractors and installation crews carrying out fibre optic cabling, network rack installation, rack & stack, patching and associated physical network infrastructure works.

The Site Supervisor is responsible for managing the 4Ms of construction – Manpower, Method, Machine and Money (Change Management) – within assigned work fronts and ensuring daily construction activities are properly planned, resourced and executed.

A key responsibility of this position is maintaining strong control of planned versus actual progress. The Site Supervisor is expected to develop daily and weekly work plans, monitor actual productivity and completed quantities, identify variances early, and implement corrective actions to maintain the project schedule.

This is a full-time site-based position requiring practical fibre installation experience and strong hands-on construction supervision capability.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Network & Fibre Installation

  • Supervise daily Network Layer 1 installation activities.
  • Supervise fibre optic cable installation, pulling, routing, dressing, termination, splicing, patching and labelling.
  • Supervise network rack move-in, positioning and installation.
  • Coordinate rack & stack activities and physical installation of network equipment.
  • Ensure installations are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, cable schedules, port maps, rack elevations, method statements and project standards.
  • Verify installation quality and ensure defects are identified and rectified promptly.
  • Support fibre testing activities including OTDR, insertion loss and continuity testing.
  • Coordinate physical Layer 1 rectification works arising from network testing and troubleshooting.

4M Construction Management

The Site Supervisor is responsible for managing the following four key construction areas within assigned work fronts:

Manpower

  • Plan daily manpower requirements based on scheduled activities and installation targets.
  • Allocate installation crews to specific work fronts and activities.
  • Monitor subcontractor attendance, manpower deployment and productivity.
  • Identify manpower shortages or productivity issues and escalate them to the Site Manager.
  • Ensure appropriate skilled resources are deployed for specialised activities such as fibre splicing, termination and testing.

Method

  • Ensure construction activities follow approved drawings, method statements, installation procedures and quality requirements.
  • Brief installation teams on the correct sequence and methodology before work commences.
  • Identify buildability and installation issues and coordinate resolutions with the Site Manager and Project Team.
  • Ensure approved installation methods are consistently implemented across different work crews.

Machine

  • Ensure required tools, equipment and machinery are available before commencement of planned activities.
  • Coordinate access equipment, lifting equipment, cable pulling equipment, fibre splicing machines, fibre test equipment and other specialist tools.
  • Verify equipment readiness and certification where applicable.
  • Identify equipment constraints that may impact productivity or scheduled activities.

Money / Change Management

  • Identify site conditions, instructions or changes that may result in additional work or variation to the original scope.
  • Maintain records of changes, additional works and associated site instructions.
  • Avoid proceeding with unrecorded or unauthorised additional works without appropriate escalation.
  • Capture supporting information including manpower, materials, equipment, photographs and work records for potential variations.
  • Escalate potential commercial changes promptly to the Site Manager and Project Team.
  • Support verification of subcontractor variation claims and additional work quantities.

Daily & Weekly Planning

  • Develop detailed daily work plans based on the project schedule and Site Manager’s priorities.
  • Develop weekly work plans and short-term look-ahead activities.
  • Break planned activities into measurable installation quantities and targets.
  • Confirm manpower, work fronts, materials, tools, access and information are available before work commences.
  • Coordinate daily activities with subcontractors and installation teams.
  • Conduct daily briefings to communicate work priorities, targets, constraints and safety requirements.

Planned vs Actual Progress Control

The Site Supervisor is expected to maintain clear visibility of what was planned, what was actually completed, and why any variance occurred.

  • Establish measurable daily and weekly installation targets.
  • Record actual completed quantities against planned quantities.
  • Monitor productivity of individual work fronts and installation crews.
  • Identify deviations from the daily and weekly plan as early as possible.
  • Determine causes of delays including manpower, materials, access, design information, equipment, quality issues or other trade dependencies.
  • Implement corrective actions with subcontractors to recover lost productivity.
  • Escalate significant schedule risks and unresolved constraints to the Site Manager.
  • Support development and implementation of recovery plans where required.
  • Maintain accurate records of planned versus actual progress.

Subcontractor Supervision

  • Directly supervise subcontractors and installation crews within assigned work areas.
  • Communicate daily installation targets and priorities.
  • Monitor contractor productivity, workmanship and compliance.
  • Ensure contractors have sufficient manpower, materials, equipment, drawings and access to achieve planned activities.
  • Coordinate multiple installation crews and work fronts where required.
  • Identify poor performance early and drive corrective action.
  • Maintain strong discipline around work completion and closure.

Troubleshooting & Rectification

  • Support the Site Manager in daily network troubleshooting and issue closure.
  • Mobilise fibre installers and subcontractors quickly when Layer 1 faults are identified.
  • Coordinate cable tracing, fibre testing, re-patching, re-termination, cleaning and other physical rectification works.
  • Work closely with Network Engineers during fault isolation where Layer 1 verification is required.
  • Ensure troubleshooting actions assigned to installation contractors are completed within agreed timelines.
  • Report troubleshooting status and unresolved issues to the Site Manager.
  • Capture recurring installation problems and ensure lessons learned are applied to subsequent installations.

Quality & Testing

  • Inspect installation workmanship throughout construction rather than relying solely on final inspection.
  • Ensure fibre installation complies with bend radius, routing, segregation, termination, cleanliness, labelling and cable management requirements.
  • Coordinate inspection and testing activities.
  • Verify fibre test results and ensure failed links are investigated and rectified.
  • Manage punch-list and defect rectification activities.
  • Support preparation of redlines, test records and as-built documentation.

Safety

  • Ensure all site activities comply with project HSE requirements.
  • Conduct daily toolbox talks and pre-task briefings.
  • Ensure subcontractors follow approved method statements and safe working procedures.
  • Monitor housekeeping and work-area conditions.
  • Stop and escalate unsafe activities where required.

Daily Reporting

Provide clear daily reporting to the Site Manager covering:

  • Planned activities versus actual completed works.
  • Installation quantities achieved.
  • Manpower deployed.
  • Productivity achieved.
  • Active work fronts.
  • Outstanding works.
  • Constraints and blockers.
  • Quality issues and defects.
  • Troubleshooting activities.
  • Changes and potential variations.
  • Required actions for the following shift/day.

Qualifications

  • Diploma, Technical Certificate or relevant vocational qualification in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Network Infrastructure or a related technical discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Candidates without formal technical qualifications will be considered where they can demonstrate strong practical experience in fibre optic installation, network infrastructure deployment and site supervision.
  • Relevant fibre optic installation, splicing, testing, structured cabling or networking certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Practical field experience and demonstrated installation capability will be given strong consideration.

Experience

  • 3–8 years of site supervision or network installation experience.
  • Practical fibre optic installation experience is required.
  • Strong preference for candidates from structured cabling contractors, fibre installation contractors, telecommunications contractors, network infrastructure contractors or systems integrators.
  • Experience supervising subcontractors and installation crews.
  • Experience with data center, telecommunications or mission-critical infrastructure projects is highly desirable.
  • Experience working in fast-track construction environments is advantageous.

Technical Knowledge

The successful candidate should have practical knowledge of:

  • Fibre optic cable installation.
  • Fibre pulling and routing.
  • Fibre termination and splicing.
  • Fibre patching and labelling.
  • OTDR and insertion-loss testing.
  • Fibre cleaning and inspection.
  • Structured cabling systems.
  • Network racks and cabinets.
  • Rack & stack activities.
  • ODFs and patch panels.
  • Cable containment systems.
  • Cable schedules, port maps and rack elevations.
  • Basic Network Layer 1 troubleshooting.

Location

  • Location: Wesley Vale, Tasmania

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Site Manager is responsible for the end-to-end site execution of Network Layer 1 infrastructure for large-scale data center deployment projects. The role leads and coordinates subcontractors responsible for network rack move-in, rack installation, rack & stack activities, fibre optic cabling, patching, labelling, testing and associated physical network infrastructure.

The Site Manager works closely with Network Engineers during Layer 2 configuration, activation and testing, ensuring physical installation issues are rapidly identified, isolated and resolved. The role also coordinates closely with the Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) team to progressively bring up power and cooling infrastructure in line with the network deployment sequence.

A critical part of this role is daily troubleshooting management. The Site Manager is expected to establish clear ownership of faults, coordinate contractors and engineering resources, drive root-cause identification, remove blockers and ensure issues are followed through to closure without allowing unresolved problems to accumulate.

This is a site-based, hands-on delivery role requiring strong contractor management, network installation knowledge and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced data center deployment environment.

Network Layer 1 Construction & Installation

  • Take ownership of site execution for Network Layer 1 infrastructure.
  • Plan, coordinate and supervise network rack move-in, positioning and installation.
  • Manage rack & stack and physical network equipment deployment.
  • Coordinate installation of fibre optic cabling, copper cabling, patch panels, ODFs and associated network infrastructure.
  • Manage fibre pulling, termination, splicing, patching, dressing, labelling and testing activities.
  • Ensure installations comply with approved drawings, rack elevations, cable schedules, port maps, method statements and project standards.
  • Ensure physical installation readiness ahead of network configuration, testing and commissioning.
  • Coordinate rectification of installation defects and punch-list items.

Subcontractor & Contractor Management

  • Manage network installation subcontractors and specialist vendors on site.
  • Translate project requirements and construction schedules into clear daily execution plans for contractors.
  • Coordinate contractor manpower, materials, tools, machinery and work fronts.
  • Monitor contractor productivity and installation performance against daily and weekly targets.
  • Ensure contractors have required drawings, materials, access, permits and information before commencing work.
  • Conduct daily coordination meetings and clearly communicate priorities and constraints.
  • Hold contractors accountable for quality, productivity, safety and timely completion.
  • Escalate resource or performance issues and drive corrective or recovery actions.

Construction Planning & Site Coordination

  • Develop detailed daily plans and short-term look-ahead plans aligned with the overall project master schedule.
  • Manage construction sequencing and work-front readiness.
  • Coordinate installation activities with other trades and project stakeholders.
  • Identify access, material, design, resource and sequencing constraints before they impact installation.
  • Coordinate closely with Project Managers, Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Network Engineers, logistics teams and other construction disciplines.
  • Track physical installation progress and maintain accurate site status.

M&E Interface & Progressive Power/Cooling Bring-Up

  • Work closely with the M&E team to coordinate progressive power and cooling readiness in line with the network deployment sequence.
  • Maintain alignment between rack installation, power availability, cooling availability and network equipment activation.
  • Coordinate progressive energisation of network racks and associated infrastructure based on construction and commissioning priorities.
  • Verify rack power, PDUs, grounding/bonding and associated electrical infrastructure readiness before equipment energisation.
  • Coordinate with the Mechanical team to ensure cooling systems and suitable environmental conditions are available before network equipment is powered and placed under load.
  • Participate in M&E readiness reviews and identify dependencies that could impact network rack bring-up.
  • Establish readiness progression from rack installation to power/cooling readiness, equipment energisation, Layer 1 verification, Layer 2 configuration, network testing and commissioning.
  • Coordinate with M&E, Network Engineering and Commissioning teams to develop rack, row, zone or data hall bring-up sequences.
  • Track and escalate power and cooling constraints that could delay network activation or project milestones.
  • Support troubleshooting where network equipment issues may be related to power, cooling, environmental conditions or other facility infrastructure.

Layer 1 to Layer 2 Integration

  • Act as the primary site interface between physical network installation contractors and Network Engineers.
  • Ensure Layer 1 infrastructure is complete, tested and ready before Layer 2 configuration and activation.
  • Coordinate with Network Engineers during switch configuration, network activation, connectivity testing and commissioning.
  • Support Network Engineers in isolating whether faults originate from physical infrastructure, equipment installation, cabling or configuration.
  • Coordinate physical checks, cable tracing, re-patching, fibre testing, equipment replacement and other field activities required during troubleshooting.
  • Ensure physical installation teams are available to support network activation and commissioning activities when required.

Troubleshooting & Issue Closure

A major responsibility of the Site Manager is to drive troubleshooting activities efficiently from identification through to closure.

  • Lead daily troubleshooting coordination across contractors, installation teams, vendors and Network Engineers.
  • Maintain clear visibility of all open installation, connectivity and commissioning issues.
  • Ensure every issue has a clearly assigned owner, priority and target closure time.
  • Rapidly mobilise the appropriate contractor or engineering resource when faults are identified.
  • Coordinate Layer 1 physical checks and Layer 2 engineering troubleshooting in parallel where appropriate.
  • Drive systematic fault isolation rather than repetitive or unstructured troubleshooting.
  • Remove blockers preventing troubleshooting activities from progressing.
  • Prioritise issues according to their impact on network activation, commissioning and project milestones.
  • Escalate critical or ageing issues promptly.
  • Conduct daily review of outstanding issues and drive actions through to verified closure.
  • Capture recurring issues and lessons learned to prevent repetition across subsequent racks, network zones or deployment phases.

Quality, Testing & Handover

  • Ensure Layer 1 installations meet project quality requirements.
  • Coordinate fibre OTDR, insertion-loss and continuity testing as applicable.
  • Verify rack installation, equipment positioning, cabling, patching and labelling against approved documentation.
  • Manage installation punch lists, defects and non-conformances through closure.
  • Ensure test records, redlines, as-built drawings and installation documentation are completed.
  • Support network readiness reviews and final handover to Network Engineering and Operations teams.

Safety

  • Ensure all installation activities comply with project HSE requirements.
  • Coordinate permits, toolbox meetings and pre-task briefings.
  • Ensure contractors comply with approved method statements and safe working procedures.
  • Stop and escalate unsafe work where required.

Planning & Reporting

  • Maintain daily installation and deployment trackers.
  • Report progress against planned quantities and milestones.
  • Maintain an active troubleshooting and issue register.
  • Provide clear daily reporting covering completed works, upcoming activities, blockers, troubleshooting status and critical actions.
  • Identify schedule risks early and develop recovery plans with contractors and the project team.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Construction Management or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant structured cabling, fibre optic or networking qualifications are advantageous.

Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in network infrastructure deployment, telecommunications, structured cabling, data center fit-out or related construction environments.
  • Strong preference for candidates with a network installation contractor, structured cabling contractor, telecommunications contractor or systems integrator background.
  • Demonstrated experience managing subcontractors and installation crews.
  • Practical experience with network rack deployment, rack & stack and fibre optic installation.
  • Experience supporting network testing, activation, commissioning and troubleshooting.
  • Experience coordinating with M&E teams for progressive power and cooling bring-up is highly desirable.
  • Data center or mission-critical infrastructure experience is highly desirable.

Technical Knowledge

  • Network Layer 1 infrastructure and structured cabling systems.
  • Fibre optic installation, termination, patching and testing.
  • Network rack and cabinet installation and rack & stack activities.
  • ODFs, patch panels, cable containment and routing.
  • Cable schedules and port maps.
  • Fibre OTDR and insertion-loss testing.
  • Network equipment installation.
  • Basic understanding of Layer 2 networking and switch configuration.
  • Network testing, commissioning and fault isolation processes.
  • Basic understanding of data center rack power, PDUs, grounding/bonding and cooling readiness.

Key Competencies

  • Strong site and subcontractor management capability.
  • Strong understanding of network installation and deployment.
  • Highly effective troubleshooting and issue-management capability.
  • Ability to quickly organise resources around technical problems and drive them to closure.
  • Strong construction planning and sequencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent work fronts and technical issues.
  • Decisive and comfortable working in a fast-moving site environment.
  • Strong communication between construction, network engineering and M&E teams.
  • High level of ownership and accountability.
  • Strong attention to installation quality and detail.
  • Ability to prioritise activities according to their impact on overall project milestones.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Wesley Vale, Tasmania

Permanent full-time

job.title: Senior Manager- Solution Development, Applied Equipment

Role is to Enable sales organization to achieve the yearly plan by increasing hit rate in large opportunities by promoting YORK chillers and other HVAC solutions thru Opportunity planning, Market intelligence (Competitor information/ Activities) and networking with stake holders.   • Mapping all the stake holders (Consultants/End user/Contractors/PMC etc.) in the region and keeping a good rapport and relationship with them.

  • Identify major jobs (Value wise/Product wise) at conceptualization stage itself / engage ourselves with decision makers and have special focus on those to have our product/solutions specifications / favorable configuration etc. in the tender for all possible packages (Chillers & HVAC Solutions)

  • Special focus on identifying large jobs where End user is the decision maker to push our solutions directly
  • Breaking competition accounts through continuous engagement / sharing of right information / showcasing our abilities.
  • Organizing & delivering presentations thru various avenues
  • Organize site visits / seminars for End users / consultants
  • Getting feedback from the market and give inputs to senior management on issues affecting customer satisfaction levels (be a part of the process if it helps to increase the Customer satisfaction by collaborating with internal teams)
  • Become a “SME” on Chillers and overall HVAC system as such and a preferred person to consultants & customers for any information

Key Performance indicators

  • Increase in no. of jobs / Value of “favorable” pipeline year on year
  • Achieving the assigned target from the BOD pipeline**. The expected target value shall be a minimum of 40% of the sales target assigned for Vertical business for the region.
  • Increasing the favorable pipeline, hit rate and footprint across West region for Chillers & HVAC products.
  • Increase in the number of customers/consultants in the region who become “Favorable” to JCI.

What we look for?

  • A results-driven mentality with a can-do attitude and ability to provide out-of-the-box solutions.

  • A results-driven mentality with a can-do attitude and ability to provide out-of-the-box solutions

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: Strategic Account Manager – Data Centres
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Location: Sydney or Melbourne

Shape the Future of Digital Infrastructure

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Manager – Data Centres to lead growth across hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise customers in the Pacific.

This is not a traditional sales role. It’s a front-line strategic leadership position at the intersection of infrastructure, technology, and sustainability—where you will influence how next-generation data centres are designed, built, and operated.

You’ll own and develop a portfolio of high-value, complex accounts and play a key role in positioning us as a trusted partner in mission-critical environments—from early concept through to delivery and lifecycle optimisation.

What You’ll Do

Lead Strategic Growth

  • Own and expand key hyperscale, colo, and enterprise accounts
  • Develop and execute multi-year account strategies that drive share-of-wallet and long-term value

Influence Where It Matters Most

  • Shape early-stage customer decisions across cooling, controls, and sustainability
  • Engage at executive and technical levels as a trusted advisor, not just a vendor

Win Complex, High-Value Deals

  • Lead end-to-end deal strategy—from early positioning to contract award
  • Craft winning commercial and technical propositions in long-cycle environments

Drive Integrated Solutions

  • Bring together Thermal Solutions, HVAC, BMS/controls, security, and digital solutions into a cohesive value proposition
  • Position outcomes—resilience, efficiency, uptime, and total cost of ownership

Align and Orchestrate

  • Connect regional teams with global account strategies
  • Align sales, engineering, and delivery to ensure successful execution and customer outcomes

Stay Ahead of the Market

  • Engage customers on emerging trends—AI workloads, high-density cooling, and decarbonisation
  • Lead conversations on sustainability, digitalisation, and innovative commercial models

What You Bring

  • Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, or related Engineering discipline
  • 10+ years in technical or solution sales (BMS, controls, automation, HVAC, or integrated systems)
  • Strong understanding of data centre environments—cooling, controls, resilience, and operations
  • Proven track record managing complex, high-value accounts within matrix organisations
  • Experience navigating long sales cycles and structured pipeline management (Salesforce preferred)
  • Commercially astute, self-driven, and comfortable operating at executive level

Why This Role

  • Work on some of the most critical infrastructure projects in the region
  • Influence how data centres evolve in an AI-driven, energy-conscious world
  • Be part of a globally connected organisation with real scale and capability
  • Operate in a role that blends strategy, technical leadership, and commercial impact

Ready to make an impact?

If you’re motivated by complex challenges, strategic customer engagement, and shaping the future of data centre infrastructure—we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now.

job.title: Fire Technician
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Smart Building Technologies, Sustainability & Fire Solutions

At Johnson Controls, we're transforming the way the world's buildings perform. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers optimise energy consumption, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain mission-critical environments across industries including healthcare, data centres, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, education, and commercial infrastructure.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry expertise, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, leading service capabilities, and a highly skilled workforce to deliver solutions that make a real difference. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, helping customers achieve better outcomes while building rewarding and successful careers.

Join our team and receive a $10,000 sign-on bonus! This is a fantastic opportunity to be rewarded from day one while building your career with us

(terms and conditions apply).

About the Role

Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Fire Technician to join our Cairns team.

In this hands-on role, you will be responsible for the maintenance, servicing, fault-finding, repairs, and installation of a broad range of fire protection systems and equipment. You will work across a diverse customer base, ensuring systems remain compliant, reliable, and performing at their best.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct inspections of customer sites and recommend appropriate fire protection and safety solutions.
  • Service, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair fire protection systems and equipment.
  • Carry out preventative maintenance activities in accordance with Australian Standards.
  • Complete installations and system upgrades as required.
  • Ensure all work is completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with relevant WHS requirements.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service and maintain strong client relationships.

What We're Looking For

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • A strong customer-focused approach and commitment to service excellence.
  • QBCC licence and relevant industry qualifications.
  • Current Queensland Electrical Licence.
  • Experience servicing and maintaining fire protection systems.
  • Strong planning, scheduling, and time management skills.
  • Sound understanding and practical application of WHS legislation and procedures.
  • The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team environment.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

At Johnson Controls, we understand the importance of flexibility and work-life balance. That's why we offer the choice of taking Rostered Days Off (RDOs) or earning overtime payments, giving you greater control over how you work.

You'll also benefit from:

  • Competitive salary package, company vehicle, overtime opportunities, and incentive scheme.
  • Ongoing technical training and development programs.
  • Dedicated remote technical support from our experienced specialist teams.
  • Opportunities to expand your technical expertise and develop leadership capabilities.
  • Clear career progression pathways within a global organisation.
  • A supportive, collaborative, and safety-focused team culture.

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls is a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. Through our extensive service network, we deliver innovative HVAC, controls, fire, security, and energy solutions that enhance building performance, improve safety, and create more sustainable communities.

Compliance Requirements

To be considered for this position, applicants must have:

  • Full Australian working rights.
  • Ability to successfully complete a pre-employment medical assessment.
  • Satisfactory criminal history check.
  • Successful drug and alcohol screening.

Ready to Take the Next Step?

If you're looking for a role that offers technical challenge, career development opportunities, flexibility, and the support of a global industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion, contact Janis Sotelo at [janis.sotelo@jci.com](mailto:janis.sotelo@jci.com).

Job Description

What you will do

The Sr. Quality Analyst supports the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple projects within a program. This role works closely with senior program managers, cross-functional teams, and stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.   • Ability to comprehend and make significant contributions to development of business plans.

job.title: Specialist, Strategic Sourcing
job.description:
Job Description – Procurement Specialist**

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Procurement Specialist to join our fiber cable manufacturing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and procuring critical materials and services essential for our production processes, with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, contract manufacturing, and supply chain efficiency. This role demands expertise in sourcing a diverse range of components.

  • Strategic Sourcing & Cost Reduction:
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies to achieve significant cost savings and total cost of ownership (TCO) improvements across assigned categories (polymers, molded plastics, mechanical components).
  • Conduct thorough market research and analysis to identify potential new suppliers, predict cost trends, and assess supply chain risks.
  • Lead renegotiations of existing vendor contracts and terms to ensure the best value and favorable pricing for the company.
  • Implement e-sourcing tools and data analysis techniques to optimize procurement processes and identify ongoing cost-saving opportunities.
  • Market Analysis:Analyze industry and market trends for fiber optic components and raw materials to inform sourcing strategies and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Documentation & Reporting:Maintain accurate procurement records and documentation for all transactions, audits, and performance reporting purposes.
  • Supplier & Contract Management:
  • Supplier Management & Sourcing:Identify, evaluate, select & Onboard suppliers for Polymers, molded plastic components, mechanical parts including Sheet Metal & Machined components, Raw fiber, protective jacketing materials, strength members & ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery benchmarks.
  • Negotiation & Contract Management:Manage the entire contract lifecycle, including drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and ensuring compliance with all contractual terms and legal requirements in collaboration with the legal department.
  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure continuous improvement and reliable supply.
  • Monitor and track supplier performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to quality, delivery, and cost, addressing any discrepancies proactively.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with engineering, manufacturing, finance, and legal departments to align procurement activities with overall business objectives and production schedules.
  • Operational Procurement:
  • Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Production, to understand material needs and ensure alignment of procurement activities with manufacturing schedules.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience:
  • Proven experience as a Procurement Specialist or similar role within a manufacturing environment, preferably in the fiber optics or related industry.
  • Demonstrated expertise in procuring specific commodity types:polymers, molded plastic components, and mechanical components including Sheet Metal & Machined components, Raw fiber, protective jacketing materials, strength members & ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery benchmarks
  • Experience in managingcontract manufacturing(CM) relationships and agreements.
  • Proven track record of successfully implementingcost reduction measuresand achieving measurable savings.
  • Skills:
  • Exceptional negotiation communication, and interpersonal skills to build strong vendor relationships.
  • Proficiency in procurement software, ERP systems (e.g., SAP preferred), and Microsoft Office Suite (advanced Excel skills preferred).
  • Expertise in Power BI:Proficiency in using Microsoft Power BI for data visualization, spend analysis, and creating interactive dashboards to track KPIs and cost-saving initiatives would be a significant advantage. This skill will be highly valued for driving data-informed decisions within the procurement function.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical skills for data analysis, cost modeling, and forecasting.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Education:
  • BE B.TECH – Mech/ Electrical/ Electronics/Instrumentation with Minimum of 10 years of experience in procurement, preferably in Telecom Industry.

Learn more about how we're on a quest to connect the future and build what's next.

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

"Updated: 09/29/2025

Location: Chh. Sambhajinagar, Maharashtra

Experience: 8-12 Years

Role Definition

Leads to ensure the accomplishment of distribution center goals, including those related to budget and cost structure.

Responsibilities

  • Making workflow decisions, improving service levels and costs for distribution center operations.
  • Supervising and motivating distribution center employees through effective coaching and training, clear communication of job expectations, and positive reinforcement of exemplary performance; maintaining a positive distribution center working environment.
  • Developing and implementing productivity, quality, and service standards. Resolving problems and identifying areas for improvements. Contributing performance data to strategic plans and reviews.
  • Ensuring all equipment receives preventative maintenance and repairs, as necessary.
  • Developing and ensuring execution for requirements and procedures for safety regulations.

Degree Requirement

Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Accurately gauges the impact and cost of errors, omissions, and oversights.
  • Utilizes specific approaches and tools for checking and cross-checking outputs.
  • Processes limited amounts of detailed information with good accuracy.
  • Learns from mistakes and applies lessons learned.
  • Develops and uses checklists to ensure that information goes out error-free.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Distribution Center Management: Knowledge of distribution center management; ability to operate a warehouse or distribution center that handles the flow of goods from supplier to production to customer.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes the role of a distribution center in the supply chain.
  • Cites examples of disruptions to the distribution process and common resolutions to these.
  • Explains basic performance measurements for a distribution center.
  • Demonstrates understanding of the processes for managing an inventory distribution center.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Performance Management: Knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational performance.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Demonstrates an understanding of performance management concepts.
  • Describes organization's performance management process.
  • Explains organization's core performance factors and ratings.
  • Participates in own performance review or performance checkpoint session.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Seeks help to modify priorities as new information surfaces or conditions change.
  • Demonstrates the ability to estimate the time and resources required to complete tasks.
  • Identifies own key assignments, schedules, and process steps.
  • Applies the concept of 'critical path' in order to complete work in a timely manner and keep larger tasks on track.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent.
  • Resolves common customer problems.
  • Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action.
  • Provides direct service to internal or external customers.
  • Documents customer complaints in a timely manner.

  • Supporting the tracking and execution of contractual deliverables, timelines, and milestones.

The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of commercial contracts, preferably in the data center, and experience working in a fast-paced, multi-jurisdictional environment.

Contracts Drafting:
