job.title: EBG QA Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission

The Dev-QA Engineer (CRM) is responsible for ensuring the reliability, quality, and stability of CRM platforms across EBG domains, including Whalecloud EBS, Salesforce (SFDC), and telco CRM ecosystems.

This role focuses on end-to-end CRM testing, integration validation, and automation across customer lifecycle processes (e.g., onboarding, billing, order management, customer data synchronization).

The engineer will collaborate closely with developers, integration teams, and business stakeholders to establish robust QA frameworks, automation practices, and quality gates, ensuring high system integrity across cross-platform integrations and cloud migration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated and manual test cases for CRM systems (Whalecloud EBS / SFDC / Telco CRM platforms).
  • Validate end-to-end CRM flows, including:
  • Customer onboarding & lifecycle
  • Order management & fulfillment
  • Billing and charging integrations
  • Customer data synchronization across systems

Perform integration testing across multiple platforms, including:

  • CRM ↔ Billing (e.g., BSCS)
  • CRM ↔ Middleware (Axway / APIs)
  • CRM ↔ Data platforms (EDW, ODS)

Develop and execute API testing (REST/SOAP) for CRM services and integrations. Build and maintain test automation frameworks for:

  • API testing
  • UI testing (where applicable for SFDC / portals)
  • Batch and file-based processing validation

Collaborate with developers to:

  • Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria
  • Ensure sufficient test coverage for new features and integrations

Support UAT, SIT, and regression testing cycles, ensuring alignment with business requirements. Validate data integrity and reconciliation across systems (critical for telco and financial flows). Identify defects, perform root cause analysis, and ensure timely resolution with development teams. Establish and enforce QA best practices, including:

  • Test strategy
  • Test data management
  • Defect lifecycle management

Participate in release validation and production readiness checks, especially for CRM-related deployments. Support cloud migration testing (e.g., AWS), ensuring system behavior consistency post-migration.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–6+ years of experience in QA / Dev-QA roles, preferably in CRM or telco environments.
  • Strong experience in CRM systems, such as:
  • Whalecloud EBS (preferred)
  • Salesforce (SFDC)
  • Other telco CRM platforms

Hands-on experience in:

  • API testing (Postman, REST tools)
  • Integration testing across multiple systems
  • SQL and data validation

Experience with test automation tools/frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, or similar). Familiarity with batch processing, file-based integrations, and middleware platforms. Understanding of end-to-end telco processes:

  • Customer lifecycle
  • Billing & charging
  • Order management

Experience working in Agile / DevOps environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in Whalecloud EBS implementation or support
  • Experience in Salesforce QA (Apex testing, integration validation)
  • Knowledge of Axway / API Gateway integrations
  • Exposure to AWS/cloud migration testing
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, Bitbucket pipelines)
  • Familiarity with data platforms (EDW, ODS) and reconciliation testing
  • Understanding of telco architecture and cross-system dependencies

job.title: Senior Engineer, Security Platform & Infrastructure
job.description:
Job Description

Overview

As the Senior Engineer for Security Platform and Infrastructure, you will manage and enhance endpoint security across telecommunication environments. The role includes Day 1 implementation and Day 2 operational support activities related to Design, Implement and Manage the Security platforms and coordination with Managed Security Service Providers (MSSP) and OEMs.

This role requires expertise in endpoint security technologies, threat detection, operational governance, and collaboration with internal teams, vendors, and MSSP partners to ensure secure and reliable operations. On top of this desire to learn, think out of the box and introduce new security initiatives to support Day 1 and Day 2’s responsibilities.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and participate in the deployment, configuration, and onboarding of EDR solutions across telecommunications environments including servers, workstations, cloud workloads, and remote endpoints.
  • Perform EDR agent deployment, health verification, policy configuration, and integration with other platforms like ticketing, SIEM and SOAR platforms.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure, network, cloud, and application teams for successful onboarding and rollout activities.
  • Work closely with MSSP partners and vendors during implementation, transition, and go-live phases.
  • Validate log forwarding, alert generation, telemetry collection, and endpoint visibility across environments.
  • Support infrastructure readiness activities including sizing, connectivity validation, firewall rules, proxy configurations, and cloud integrations.
  • Participate in Proof of Concepts (POC), product evaluations, feature testing, and security tool assessments.
  • Develop onboarding documentation, operational runbooks, implementation procedures, and knowledge transfer materials.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity architecture and governance teams to align EDR deployment with security standards and compliance requirements.
  • Conduct tuning and optimization of EDR policies, detection rules, exclusions, and alert thresholds to reduce false positives.
  • Manage endpoint security posture by monitoring agent health, policy compliance, coverage gaps, and platform performance.
  • Perform Day 2 operational activities including upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, policy management, and platform maintenance.
  • Support Infra related vulnerability, remediation coordination, and hardening initiatives.
  • Support audit, compliance, and regulatory activities related to endpoint security platform and operations.
  • Coordinate with vendors and MSSP partners for issue resolution, feature enhancements, and product roadmap discussions related to the platform.
  • Participate in 24x7 on-call support and incident related to the platform and infra whenever required and need to be on standby.
  • Lead and work with cross-functional stakeholders and processes to meet the business requirements.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security, or related discipline.
  • 2 – 4 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, EDR management, SOC operations, or endpoint security engineering within telecommunication or large-scale environments.
  • Familiarity with EDR/XDR platforms such as Palo Alto XDR or CrowdStrike Falcon or Sentinel One or VMware Carbon Black.
  • Experience working with MSSP/SOC providers and managing operational governance.
  • Familiarity with Windows, Linux, macOS, cloud (AWS and Ali), and hybrid infra environments.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripting is an advantage.
  • Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and endpoint attack techniques.
  • Good to have certifications such as CEH, CISSP, Security+, GIAC, or vendor-specific EDR certifications.

Essential Skills

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience in endpoint security and security operations.
  • Effective stakeholders, vendors, and MSSP management capabilities.
  • Good communication and incident coordination skills.
  • Knowledge of operational governance, SLA management, and service delivery.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SOC, infrastructure, application, and security teams.

Role Mission

Reduced manual work, exceptions, and policy deviations. Strong alignment between HR strategy, policy, and system-enabled execution. Improved adoption and value realisation from HR transformation initiatives

Ideal Track Record 8–12 years of experience in HR operations, HR transformation, or People Systems functional roles. Strong hands-on experience designing end-to-end HR processes across the employee lifecycle. Proven ability to translate HR policy and business needs into system-enabled process design. Experience working with enterprise HR platforms (e.g. SAP SuccessFactors) from a functional/business perspective. Demonstrated success partnering with HR, IS, and vendors in complex organisations. Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments preferred

job.title: Technical Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager who can combine agile delivery discipline with deep technical literacy to coordinate development and release cycles across StarHub’s digital domains.

In this role, you will work closely with Domain Owners (DOs), Engineering Managers (EMs), Journey Solution Designers (SDs), and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery across systems that support StarHub’s consumer and enterprise journeys.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with agile project delivery in a DevOps or software engineering environment, preferably both front-end and back-end within modern native environments — with a solid understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, microservices, observability, and end-to-end delivery metrics.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Agile Management

  • Drive agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and maintain team rhythm and cadence.
  • Manage backlog hygiene, ensuring stories are well-defined, estimated, and prioritized.
  • Plan and execute phased delivery strategies, ensuring release readiness through Blue/Green deployments, canary releases, and feature flagging.
  • Track delivery health through velocity, throughput, and scope stability metrics.
  • Identify and resolve blockers, risks, and cross-domain dependencies early.
  • Maintain clear delivery dashboards and status reporting to senior stakeholders.

Technical Coordination & Planning

  • Partner with Domain Owners and Tech Leads to align on architecture, delivery scope, and capacity planning.
  • Coordinate with DevOps and QA/QE teams to ensure readiness for integration, testing, and release.
  • Support implementation of continuous delivery and observability practices across teams.
  • Define, Monitor and report on key delivery KPIs, including deployment frequency, Mean Time To Recovery, defect Leakage rate, change failure rate ensuring all releases meet defined Service Level Objectives and performance baselines.
  • Participate in sprint demos and ensure acceptance criteria are met for each increment.

Stakeholder & Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Work with Journey Solution Designers (SDs) and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to align sprint deliverables to journey-level milestones.
  • Collaborate with Journey Owners (JOs) and business stakeholders to clarify priorities and expected outcomes.
  • Communicate risks, decisions, and delivery trade-offs clearly across key stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement & Governance

  • Drive adoption of agile and DevOps best practices across DXP teams.
  • Analyze delivery metrics to identify improvement opportunities in velocity, predictability, and quality.
  • Support incident RCA reviews and ensure learnings are converted into actionable backlog improvements.
  • Contribute to standardized delivery governance, templates, and documentation across domains

Qualifications

Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Agile, PMP, or DevOps certifications (e.g., CSM, SAFe, PMI-ACP) preferred.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in software delivery or digital product management, with at least 3 years in a technical project management, delivery lead or scrum master capacity.
  • Proven track record managing agile teams delivering software through CI/CD pipelines within modern cloud native architecture and container orchestration (EKS/Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience coordinating frontend (Vue.js, Flutter) and backend engineering deliveries.
  • Strong understanding of API management, event-driven architecture, and modern deployment strategies (Blue/Green, Canary, Feature Flags).
  • Strong familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, Monday.com, Splunk.
  • Experience in telecommunications, digital platform delivery, or large-scale integration programs is an advantage.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile, DevOps, and continuous delivery practices.
  • Ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a bias for execution.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resilient in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

job.title: Brand & Social Manager / Senior Manager
job.description:
Job Description

This role shapes an iconic brand by defining the strategy and driving the execution of the StarHub brand across the Consumer Business. As guardian of the StarHub brand, this person brings the brand voice to life across paid, owned and earned touchpoints, including social and influencer channels, to drive reach and engagement with key audiences. job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
Job Description- Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Role Overview

We are looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating enterprise cloud and application infrastructure. The role will own the technical architecture and implementation of servers, virtualization, Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, networking, storage, and application deployment environments, while working closely with technology vendors and system integrators for implementation and support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy hybrid cloud and on-prem infrastructure across AWS, VMware, Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud, including GPU compute platforms.
  • Architect and implement Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, covering cluster design, sizing, HA, networking, storage, security and DR.
  • Define compute, GPU, virtualization, storage, network and capacity architectures for enterprise and cloud-native workloads.
  • Design application platforms using VMs, containers, Kubernetes/OpenShift and cloud-native services; support application onboarding and migration.
  • Implement IaC and automation using Terraform/Ansible and CI/CD pipelines for repeatable infrastructure deployment.
  • Integrate platforms with IAM, DNS, load balancers, PKI, monitoring, logging, backup and security services.
  • Own HLD/LLD, architecture reviews, sizing, implementation plans, acceptance criteria and operational runbooks.
  • Drive performance, resilience, security, capacity management, lifecycle upgrades, patching and technology refresh.
  • Support POCs/MVPs involving cloud, GPU, Kubernetes, automation and emerging infrastructure technologies.

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Act as technical owner for cloud, infrastructure and system-integration vendors.
  • Evaluate and recommend solutions across AWS, VMware, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Kubernetes/OpenShift, GPU and virtualization.
  • Review vendor HLD/LLD, configurations, deployment plans and technical deliverables.

Opportunities to learning and development and get involvement in the advanced technology projects.

  • The opportunities includes learning and development in advanced technology areas such as-Agentic AI, Knowledge graph, AI security and Quantum Security.
  • Agentic AI & Knowledge Graph: LangGraph, OpenAI/Azure AI Foundry, Neo4j, GraphRAG, vector databases, RAG and AI orchestration frameworks.
  • AI & Quantum Security: Palo Alto AI security, NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, IBM watsonx.governance, HSM/KMS, PKI, PQC, cryptographic discovery and crypto-agility tools.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with Linux servers, virtualization, compute, storage, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift; experience managing vendor-led implementations is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of private cloud, hybrid cloud, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Experience with Docker/container platforms, Helm, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
  • Strong understanding of networking including DNS, load balancing, routing, firewalls, VPN, ingress/egress, and network segmentation.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure monitoring, logging, observability, backup, and disaster recovery
  • Scripting/programming knowledge in Python, Bash, or similar languages.

Qualifications

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
  • 5-8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or related roles.
  • Proven experience in building enterprise infrastructure and deploying applications.
  • Experience working with technology vendors/system integrators on infrastructure implementation projects.
  • Cloud, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or infrastructure certifications are desirable.

Key Competencies

  • Cloud & infrastructure architecture
  • Server and platform engineering
  • Kubernetes/OpenShift platform management
  • Application deployment
  • Infrastructure automation
  • Vendor and system-integrator management
  • DevSecOps and infrastructure security
  • Troubleshooting and technical problem solving
  • Capacity, scalability, availability and resilience
  • Strong technical documentation and stakeholder management

job.title: Partner Manager, Platform Technology
job.description:
Job Description

-Manage end-to-end relationships with technology vendors whose products and services form the foundational building blocks of the organisation's internally-built platform, which is productised and offered as-a-Service to customers.

  • Collaborate closely with the Enterprise Architect and key technology vendors to co-develop and incubate new service offerings that can be built on top of the organisation's existing managed services portfolio — translating vendor technology capabilities into differentiated, market-ready services.
  • Engage vendors as strategic innovation partners to identify emerging technology capabilities (e.g., AI-driven operations, SASE, network analytics, automated remediation) that can be integrated into the managed services stack and brought to market as new revenue-generating offerings.
  • Work with the Enterprise Architect to assess the technical feasibility, integration complexity, and architectural fit of new vendor-enabled services; support the development of service blueprints, reference architectures, and go-to-market collateral for new offerings.
  • Participate in joint roadmap planning sessions with vendors to align vendor product evolution with the organisation's managed services strategy, ensuring new platform capabilities are proactively adopted into the service portfolio.
  • Design and maintain Unit of Measure (UOM)-based cost structures that decompose underlying vendor costs into granular, service-consumable units (e.g., per user, per device, per node, per GB, per API call, per ticket, per licence seat), forming the basis for the platform's customer-facing pricing, tiered service packages, and margin management.
  • Translate vendor commercial schedules into standardised internal cost-to-serve models and rate cards, enabling accurate platform product pricing, cost allocation across service tiers, and P&L visibility for the platform business.
  • Perform projected vs. actuals cost reconciliation using UOM consumption data to ensure platform economics remain aligned with customer consumption patterns; identify and address licence over-provisioning, under-utilisation, and cost inefficiencies.
  • Collaborate with Presales, and Solutions Architecture teams to ensure vendor component costs and new service constructs are accurately reflected in the platform's commercial offerings — including subscription tiers, consumption-based billing, and bundled service packages.
  • Lead end-to-end contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments for platform vendor agreements in collaboration with Legal and Procurement; structure vendor terms to support scalability, multi-tenancy, co-innovation, and service-level commitments of the customer-facing platform.
  • Own platform vendor spend tracking and budget forecasting in collaboration with Finance; identify cost optimisation opportunities through vendor consolidation, volume-based pricing negotiations, licence reclamation, and UOM tier renegotiation to improve platform gross margin.
  • Conduct periodic vendor risk assessments for platform components covering cybersecurity posture, regulatory compliance (e.g., MAS TRM, PDPA), availability, and business continuity — ensuring vendor risks do not cascade into customer-impacting service disruptions.
  • Conduct RFI/RFP/RFQ processes for platform component refresh or new capability onboarding; benchmark existing vendor terms and technologies against market alternatives to keep the platform competitive.
  • Produce executive-ready dashboards and reports on platform vendor costs, new service development pipeline, component performance, licence utilisation, and risk posture for Product, Technology, Finance, and C-suite stakeholders.

Qualifications

-Degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field with at least 5–8 years of relevant experience in technology vendor management, platform product commercialisation, or technology procurement within a managed services, telco, or enterprise IT environment.

  • Demonstrated experience in co-developing or incubating new technology service offerings in partnership with vendors and enterprise architects, translating vendor capabilities into managed services or as-a-Service products.
  • Demonstrated experience in building UOM-based cost structures and pricing models for technology platform services (e.g., per-user, per-device, per-GB, per-transaction), with the ability to translate vendor input costs into customer-facing service pricing and margin models.
  • Proven experience managing commercial relationships and contracts with platform technology vendors such as ServiceNow, Palo Alto, HPE/Aruba, AWS, Elastic/Datadog, or equivalent.
  • Understanding of platform product economics — including cost-to-serve modelling, tiered subscription pricing, consumption-based billing, and gross margin management for as-a-Service offerings.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture concepts and the ability to engage meaningfully with Enterprise Architects on service design, integration patterns, and technology roadmap alignment.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or shared-infrastructure cost allocation models is advantageous.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Enterprise Architecture, Presales, Solutions Architecture, Service Delivery, and Finance teams to align vendor innovation and commercial structures with the organisation's managed services and go-to-market strategy.
  • Strong analytical and commercial acumen; able to translate complex vendor cost structures, new service economics, and performance metrics into clear narratives for product, finance, and C-suite audiences.
  • Able to manage multiple vendor relationships concurrently, work independently, and thrive in a dynamic environment where the platform product and managed services portfolio are continuously evolving.

job.title: Growth Manager, MVNO

job.title: Senior Provisioning DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission:

The Application DevOps Engineer will be involved in the end-to-end delivery lifecycle including solution design, application development, QC testing, CI/CD automation and continuous optimization of cloud-native platforms. The candidate will need to manage Kubernetes operations, infrastructure provisioning and software upgrades to ensure systems remain reliable, secure and scalable. The candidate will be working in a team in routine on-call rotations to support day-to-day operations, incident resolution, customer care and defect fixes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Development:
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and resilient microservices using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Camel and its core Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs).
  • Implement RESTful APIs and ensure services meet performance, security, and stability requirements.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and efficient code following best practices and design patterns.
  • Containerization and Deployment:
  • Develop and manage services deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes, including defining Dockerfiles and Kubernetes resource configurations (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, etc.).
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) for automated build, test, and deployment.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot services running in the OpenShift environment.
  • Architecture and Data:
  • Contribute to the architectural design of microservices, focusing on principles like loose coupling, high cohesion, and fault tolerance.
  • Implement various data persistence technologies, including relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
  • Integrate services using messaging systems (e.g., Red Hat AMQ) where required.
  • Collaboration and Quality:
  • Perform code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge within the team.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and industry regulations by performing security vulnerability scans (SAST, DAST, SCA) and disaster recovery exercise.
  • Support on-call duty on shift rotation and handle production incident and root cause analysis with minimal supervision.
  • Knowledge Management:
  • Build technical documentation from scratch, maintaining working documents on architecture overviews, API specifications and system integrations.
  • Create and maintain operational runbooks to support the team and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

• Java Expertise: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using Java and the Spring Boot framework.

• Microservices and API: Strong understanding of microservices architecture, principles, and best practices. Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.

• Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for deployment and orchestration. Experience with OpenShift-specific features is a significant advantage.

• Database: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Tools: Familiarity with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools.

job.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission:

The Senior DevOps Engineer will be involved in the end-to-end delivery lifecycle including solution design, application development, QC testing, CI/CD automation and continuous optimization of cloud-native platforms. The candidate will need to manage Kubernetes operations, infrastructure provisioning and software upgrades to ensure systems remain reliable, secure and scalable. The candidate will be working in a team in routine on-call rotations to support day-to-day operations, incident resolution, customer care and defect fixes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Development:
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and resilient microservices using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Camel and its core Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs).
  • Implement RESTful APIs and ensure services meet performance, security, and stability requirements.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and efficient code following best practices and design patterns.
  • Containerization and Deployment:
  • Develop and manage services deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes, including defining Dockerfiles and Kubernetes resource configurations (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, etc.).
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) for automated build, test, and deployment.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot services running in the OpenShift environment.
  • Architecture and Data:
  • Contribute to the architectural design of microservices, focusing on principles like loose coupling, high cohesion, and fault tolerance.
  • Implement various data persistence technologies, including relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
  • Integrate services using messaging systems (e.g., Red Hat AMQ) where required.
  • Collaboration and Quality:
  • Perform code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge within the team.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and industry regulations by performing security vulnerability scans (SAST, DAST, SCA) and disaster recovery exercise.
  • Support on-call duty on shift rotation and handle production incident and root cause analysis with minimal supervision.
  • Knowledge Management:
  • Build technical documentation from scratch, maintaining working documents on architecture overviews, API specifications and system integrations.
  • Create and maintain operational runbooks to support the team and internal stakeholders.
  • AI Competency:
  • Familiar with or have experience in agentic SDLC with competencies in prompt and context engineering, agent orchestration and supervision, and AI assisted delivery.
  • Automate data gathering, pattern finding, auto fixing or self-healing with anomaly detection and analysis.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Java Expertise: Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using Java and the Spring Boot framework.
  • Microservices and API: Strong understanding of microservices architecture, principles, and best practices. Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for deployment and orchestration. Experience with OpenShift-specific features is a significant advantage.
  • Database: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Tools: Familiarity with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools.
  • Combined experience in DevOps, SRE, or Software Engineering.
  • Familiar with containerized environments, Kubernetes internals, and Helm.
  • Hands-on production experience with Jenkins and CI/CD best practices.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Solid understanding of AWS core services, IAM security, and cost-optimization practices.
  • Comfortable with Linux internals, networking fundamentals, and shell scripting.
  • Agile mindset with experience working in Scrum teams.
  • Experience with AIOps practices and tools is an added advantage.

job.title: Platform Lead, Mobile Engineering (4G/5G)
job.description:

The Lead will own the end-to-end lifecycle of the Private Mobile Core service, including solution architecture, platform engineering, network operations, service assurance, customer onboarding, vendor management, and innovation. The role will also drive the adoption of cloud-native 5G Core technologies, network automation, AI-enabled operations, and industry-specific solutions.

job.title: Application Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a talented and analytical Application Engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will apply your software engineering expertise to design, develop, debug, and implement high-quality web applications and specialized utility programs that meet our end-users' needs.

Working with a high degree of autonomy, you will tackle unfamiliar technical challenges, recommend continuous improvements to existing applications, and ensure system reliability. The ideal candidate is a structured thinker, an eager learner, and a collaborative team player who communicates ideas effectively and integrates seamlessly into a dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Development: Design and build robust web-based applications, producing clean, efficient, and well-documented code based on technical specifications.
  • Database & Automation: Write and optimize database scripts to drive automated workflows and generate accurate reporting.
  • System Maintenance: Troubleshoot, debug, and enhance both new and existing applications to optimize performance and scalability.

Technical Competencies:

job.title: Salesforce/CloudSense Lead
job.description:

The incumbent champions process optimisation, quality assurance, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced, multi-project environment.

Responsibilities

  • Multi stream leadership: guide multiple work streams simultaneously, coach project leads, standardize practices, and ensure each release meets scope, schedule, and quality expectations
  • Solution direction: provide solutioning guidance on SFDC and cross system designs, ensuring practicality, seamless integration, and future readiness
  • Budget ownership and vendor management: own and monitor the Group B budget, partner with vendors to align deliverables, resolve issues, and maintain strong working relationships
  • Process optimization: champion initiatives that simplify workflows, eliminate manual workarounds, and improve deployment reliability
  • Testing and release assurance: oversee SIT, UAT, and production readiness checkpoints, ensuring smooth handovers to operations with minimal post release disruption
  • Primary liaison: serve as the main contact for business leaders, PMO, and technology teams, provide clear updates, manage expectations, and address risks promptly
  • People leadership: lead business analysts, developers, and testers, fostering a collaborative culture focused on ownership, continuous learning, and high quality delivery
  • Governance representation: present delivery status, risk mitigations, and key decisions in change boards and steering committees, ensuring transparency and organizational alignment
  • Continuous improvement mindset: promote a culture that proactively identifies opportunities and embeds lessons learned into future deliveries
  • Stakeholder liaison and management: liaise with business stakeholders to gather and prioritise requirements and act as the primary point of contact for all EBG SURF requests
  • Release coordination: coordinate SIT, UAT, and production-readiness activities, production deployment, investigate issues, and drive root-cause analysis to ensure smooth handovers to operations
  • Application and process analysis: conduct analysis of existing applications and business processes, produce functional specifications, and recommend preventive actions for enhancements and defects

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in application delivery, systems analysis, or solution design within large-scale enterprise or telecommunications environments
  • Hands-on expertise with Salesforce Sales and Service Clouds, including declarative tools (Flows, Process Builder) and integration patterns; certifications advantageous
  • Solid understanding of order management, billing, and provisioning processes and their interaction across CRM and fulfilment systems
  • Proven experience managing project budgets and vendor relationships, with strong negotiation and issue-resolution skills
  • Familiarity with Agile/DevOps methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and REST/SOAP APIs
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a history of driving root-cause analysis and preventive measures
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, able to bridge technical and business viewpoints effectively
  • Demonstrated leadership in guiding cross-functional teams and delivering multiple concurrent projects under tight deadlines
  • Experience with Telco transformation, CRM, CPQ (CloudSense) and Digital Channels considered an advantage
  • Knowledge and experience in Telco BSS/OSS considered an advantage

job.title: Manager, Cybersecurity Assurance
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:The role of Cyber GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) is to ensure that an organization's cybersecurity strategy aligns with its business goals, manages policies/standards/frameworks, manages cyber risks effectively, provides oversight and independent 2nd line control review/testing, and adheres to external regulations.

Accountabilities

  • Drive and lead the end-to-end lifecycle of information security governance & policy management.
  • Drive and lead the cyber risk management and reporting.
  • Drive and lead the 2nd line assurance & compliance monitoring.
  • Drive 2nd line oversight and support for audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders.
  • Drive security culture, advisory & stakeholder engagement

Responsibilities

  • Manage the development of Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies for adoption
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies compliance risk
  • Manage the cyber risk oversight by evaluating the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management practices and controls implemented by 1st line (i.e. risk owner, control owner, control supervisor, control performers) of Starhub to ensure proper adherence to risk assessment processes.
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies security/risk deviation process
  • Manage the Starhub risk profile and maintain the Starhub risk register for IT Security / Cybersecurity risks relating to CII & Non-CII
  • Develop and drive regular monitoring and reporting of Starhub key risk indicators for Cybersecurity
  • Manage regular risk reporting and risk escalation to Senior Management or other relevant risk forums
  • Manage Control & Compliance Framework through timely updates of industry standards and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Perform 2nd line assurance review (e.g. control review/testing) on 1st line stakeholders to ensure adherence with Starhub policies and Sub-policies / Regulatory compliance requirements, provide actionable, recommendations, and engage stakeholders for implementation
  • Provide timely communication / awareness to stakeholders on Starhub policies and sub-policies for implementation
  • Provide advisory to stakeholders on Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies requirement
  • Conduct briefings and trainings on Cyber risk / Policy awareness (i.e. Cyber risk management process, Policy compliance, Emerging cyber risk/trend, Issues and Observations from 2nd line control review/testing, and audit related findings) to relevant stakeholders and to support the Starhub Cybersecurity Awareness Programme.
  • Provide 2nd Line oversight and support throughout the audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders: ensuring readiness before the audit begins, facilitating fieldwork execution, and monitoring remediation of findings post-audit.
  • Maintaining a tracker for audit findings (or audit issues registers) to monitor remediation progress, to ensure audit closure issues, to support the scoping for 2nd line assurance review.

Qualifications

1.More than 5 years of experience in information/cybersecurity and risk management Experience in leading cybersecurity risk assessment and risk reduction initiatives

2.Experience in IT/IT-Security policy development and implementation

3.Experience in driving IT-security thematic assessment and IT audits

4.Good knowledge and experience with handling IT-security and cybersecurity audits

5.Good knowledge of experience in driving compliance to meet cybersecurity regulatory requirements

6.Good problem analysis and resolution skills

7.Good and experience stakeholder management skills

job.title: Engineer, Cybersecurity
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Cyber Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, maintenance, and support of security controls and cyber protection measures in a secure and regulated environment, with a focus on Singapore government-related initiatives. The role requires strong technical security knowledge, hands-on experience in cyber defense and security operations, and the ability to support secure delivery in accordance with security, regulatory, and organisational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain cyber security controls across infrastructure, applications, endpoints, networks, and cloud environments.
  • Support the identification, assessment, and remediation of security vulnerabilities and configuration weaknesses.
  • Perform security hardening, patching, and baseline compliance activities for systems and platforms.
  • Monitor, analyse, and respond to security alerts, events, and incidents in a timely manner.
  • Support incident response activities, including investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Conduct security reviews, risk assessments, and control validation for project and operational environments.
  • Implement and support security tooling such as SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners, firewalls, IDS/IPS, IAM and DLP solutions where applicable.
  • Work with internal and external stakeholders to ensure security requirements are understood and properly implemented.
  • Support secure architecture design, security testing, and security sign-off activities.
  • Prepare and maintain security documentation, including technical specifications, security assessments, remediation plans, and status reports.
  • Ensure compliance with government security requirements, internal policies, and approved security standards and delivery processes.
  • Support vendor and third-party coordination for security-related implementation and issue resolution.
  • Assist with operational handover, knowledge transfer and ongoing support for security solutions.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 to 8 years of relevant experience in cyber security, infrastructure security or security operations.
  • Experience working on government, secure, regulated or enterprise IT environments is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of cyber security principles, security controls, vulnerability management, and incident response.
  • Proficiency in common security technologies and tools such as SIEM, EDR, vulnerability scanners, firewalls, IAM, or equivalent.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Requirements

  • Relevant security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, Security+, GIAC, or equivalent.
  • Experience working in secure environments with strict access control and compliance requirements.
  • Familiarity with government security processes and/or security-related delivery standards.
  • Experience in cloud security, endpoint security, network security, or application security will be an advantage.
  • The candidate should be open to cross-training and may be required to support adjacent technical areas based on project needs.

Key Competencies

  • Cyber security technical knowledge
  • Security operations and incident handling
  • Vulnerability management and remediation
  • Planning and organisation
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Attention to detail
  • Analytical thinking
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Ability to influence and drive outcomes

Security and Compliance Requirement

  • Possession of relevant security clearance or the ability to obtain required clearance may be necessary, depending on project requirements.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and closing projects in a secure and regulated environment, with a focus on Singapore government-related initiatives. The role requires strong stakeholder management, disciplined project governance, risk and issue management, and the ability to deliver projects on time, within scope, and within budget while ensuring compliance with security, regulatory, and organizational standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management activities from initiation to closure.
  • Work with both internal and external stakeholders to define scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Develop project plan, work breakdown structures, milestones and dependencies, resource planning
  • Prepare and conduct project kick-off meetings, status updates and stakeholder reviews.
  • Track project progress against schedule, scope, budget, and quality targets.
  • Manage project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; ensure timely escalation and resolution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure clear ownership and delivery accountability.
  • Monitor project financials including budget, actuals, commitments, and forecast.
  • Ensure compliance with government security requirements, internal policies, and approved delivery processes.
  • Support documentation needs including SOW, status reports, meeting minutes, and closure reports.
  • Manage vendor and third-party delivery where applicable.
  • Ensure deliverables are completed with proper approvals, testing, and handover.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Project Management, Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 to 8 years of experience in project management or project coordination.
  • Experience working on government, secure, regulated or enterprise IT projects is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of project governance, scheduling, stakeholder engagement, and risk management.
  • Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Jira, or equivalent.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Requirements

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, or equivalent.
  • Experience working in secure environments and compliance requirements.
  • Familiarity with government processes and/or security-related delivery standards.

Key Competencies

  • Stakeholder management
  • Planning and organization
  • Risk and issue management
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Attention to detail
  • Analytical thinking
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Ability to influence and drive outcomes

Security and Compliance Requirement

  • Possession of relevant security clearance or the ability to obtain required clearance may be necessary, depending on project requirements.

job.title: AVP, TPM Lead
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Delivery Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a team of TPMs across multiple domains to drive either (a) agile, DevOps-based or (b) waterfall-based delivery excellence
  • Define and maintain a standardized delivery governance framework — covering sprint cadence, backlog hygiene, dependency tracking, and reporting.
  • Oversee delivery execution across DXP domains, ensuring commitments are met with predictable outcomes.
  • Lead monthly delivery health reviews, highlighting key risks, capacity challenges, and improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Domain Owners (DXP) and Journey SDs (DBE) to balance Product, Tech Debt, and Technical Campaign backlogs across teams.

Cross-Domain Coordination & Governance

  • Act as the central delivery integrator across DBE, ensuring synchronization between journeys, domains, and releases.
  • Collaborate with Release Program Managers (RPMs) to ensure alignment of delivery and release plans.
  • Establish and maintain a cross-domain dependency management framework with clear escalation paths.
  • Monitor delivery performance metrics (velocity, predictability, throughput) and drive corrective actions where needed.
  • Drive adoption of continuous improvement practices across all DXP squads.

People Management & Capability Development

  • Coach and mentor TPMs, supporting their career development, skills growth, and performance reviews.
  • Foster a culture of proactive communication, accountability, and continuous learning across the TPM community.
  • Lead training sessions or playbook initiatives to strengthen agile delivery maturity, tooling proficiency, and reporting discipline.
  • Identify and recruit high-performing TPM talent aligned to StarHub’s transformation roadmap.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Serve as a trusted partner to senior engineering, business, and architecture leaders — ensuring transparency on delivery health and execution status.
  • Communicate program-level risks, trade-offs, and delivery decisions clearly to executive stakeholders.
  • Represent the TPM function in enterprise forums, transformation reviews, and cross-functional working groups.

Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or Information Systems.
  • Advanced certifications in Agile, DevOps, or Program Management (e.g., SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, CSM) preferred

Experience

  • 12+ years of total experience in technology delivery, with at least 5 years in managing project/program teams or TPM functions.
  • Proven track record in delivering large-scale, cross-functional software or platform programs using agile and DevOps practices.
  • Experience in telecommunications, cloud platforms, or enterprise-scale digital transformation preferred.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management, dependency resolution, and performance reporting.

job.title: Delivery Architect
job.description:
Job Description

Hybrid IT Architecture Delivery

Lead architecture and delivery across secure hybrid environments including:

  • On-premise data centre infrastructure
  • Private Cloud Platforms (Hypervisor/Containers)
  • Backup, DR and cyber vault architecture

Oversee:

  • Redundant user plane design

Ensure delivery aligned to:

  • CII-grade safety-critical uptime

  • SOC and observability platform integration
  • Telecom-grade high availability and failover mechanisms

Provide cross-layer assurance between mobile core, IT infrastructure, and service management systems.

Network Observability (Elastic Stack)

Own architecture and deployment of Elastic-based observability platform:

  • Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana
  • Infrastructure Monitoring
  • SIEM integration
  • Telco telemetry ingestion (5G KPIs, GTP, PFCP metrics)

Key Outcomes:

  • Single pane of glass across:
  • IT infrastructure
  • Mobile core
  • Security logs
  • AI-driven anomaly detection
  • Cross-layer incident correlation
  • Mission assurance dashboards for executive leadership
  • SLA and compliance visibility

Drive observability-first operational culture.

Lead implementation and operationalisation of:

  • ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Request)
  • CMDB (including telco and infrastructure asset modelling)
  • ITOM (Discovery, Event Management)
  • Service Mapping
  • SecOps integration
  • Workflow automation

Ensure:

  • Closed-loop automation:

Elastic alerts → ServiceNow ticketing → orchestration workflows

  • Mission-based SLA modelling
  • Integrated IT + Telco service visibility
  • Automation-led incident response
  • Operational reporting for agency leadership

Security & Classified Environment Governance

Partner with CISO and security stakeholders to ensure secure-by-design delivery.

Oversee:

  • Secure enclave architecture
  • Network segmentation and boundary defence
  • Data encryption (at rest and in transit)
  • Bastion host and privileged access management
  • Zero Trust architecture implementation

Engage with:

  • Security assessors

Define and operationalise the Target Operating Model (TOM) for steady-state operations.

Oversee:

  • Transition from build to run
  • L1–L3 support structure
  • NOC/SOC integration
  • Escalation matrix and RACI governance
  • Operational playbooks and runbooks

Drive:

  • Observability-first operational readiness
  • Automation and AIOps roadmap
  • Cross-functional integration between IT, Telco, and Security teams
  • Continuous service improvement model

Qualifications

Required Experience

Mandatory

  • 15+ years in infrastructure and complex projects delivery.
  • Proven track record delivering complex government or CII programmes.
  • Experience in secured / classified environment.
  • Preferred Hands-on exposure to:
  • Private 4G/5G core deployment
  • Hybrid cloud platforms
  • Elastic stack deployment

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in:

job.title: Senior Manager, Mobile, M2M and 5G
job.description:
Key Responsibilities • Lead the full product lifecycle for mobile tariffs, VAS, device lifecycle services, and 5G/M2M enterprise offerings. • Shape the vision, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy for StarHub’s enterprise mobile and connectivity products. • Coach and develop a high-performing team of four Product Managers; instill a bias for experimentation and delivery. • Own the 5G/M2M product roadmap, evolving based on market opportunity and organizational readiness. • Collaborate closely with IS, GTM, Sales, Finance, and Marketing to deliver product innovation and commercial outcomes. • Manage partner contracts and alliances across OEMs, device vendors, leasing, and insurance. • Use financial metrics, large data sets, and market analytics to drive decisions and simplify the product portfolio.

Requirements

At least 3 years in mobile products: tariffs, VAS, leasing, and/or enterprise mobile services • Strong financial literacy and ability to extract insights from large, complex datasets • Familiarity with the Singapore telco and enterprise mobility landscape • Proven cross-functional leadership and ability to influence at all levels • Comfortable with ambiguity; thrives in experimentation and delivery environments • Exposure to Agile delivery, vendor management, and strategic partnerships

job.title: Manager, Business Performance
job.description:
Job Description

The Business Performance Manager drives impact by combining data, process improvement, and performance insights to help the company scale sustainably. By bringing together sales, delivery, financial, and people metrics into a clear, actionable story, the role gives leaders visibility into how growth, execution, and capacity connect to business goals. With insights tied to accountability, the role ensures decisions translate into results.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Growth Performance

  • Track sales pipeline health, conversion rates, win/loss trends, and revenue realization by Service Line.
  • Monitor sales productivity (e.g., revenue per head, quota attainment) for affordability assessment.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to highlight risks to targets and opportunities for growth by Service Line.

Delivery & Operational Performance

  • Define and track delivery KPIs (e.g., utilization, backlog, SLA adherence, project profitability etc) by Service Line.
  • Monitor order-to-cash SLA by Service Line and fulfilment accuracy, escalating bottlenecks and operational inefficiencies.
  • Ensure operational execution is aligned with financial and customer commitments.

Financial Performance

  • Integrate financial KPIs (e.g., revenue, GM, EBITDA) with operational and sales metrics.
  • Provide variance analysis and root-cause insights behind financial performance.
  • Partner with Finance to align forecasts with operational capacity and pipeline reality.

People & Capacity Performance

  • Track headcount, attrition, productivity for affordability analysis.
  • Highlight alignment (or gaps) between workforce capacity and business demand.

Process and Performance Improvement

  • Identify and recommend high-impact opportunities for comprehensive process and performance improvements, driving initiatives for expense reduction, revenue enhancement, and efficiency maximization.

Governance & Insights

  • Develop dashboards and performance scorecards integrating all four dimensions.
  • Establish a regular performance review cadence across functions.
  • Ensure KPI owners are accountable for outcomes, and actions are tracked to closure.
  • Provide leadership with forward-looking insights, not just historical reporting.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, or related field
  • At least 6 years’ experience in business performance, FP&A, sales operations, or strategy/ops roles.
  • Strong exposure to commercial, operational, financial, and HR data. Telecommunications and ICT products knowledge is a plus.
  • Proficiency with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) and source systems (CRM, SAP, Workday etc).
  • Advanced analytical skills with expertise in data visualization tools and financial modelling.
  • Experience influencing cross-functional leadership and driving performance outcomes.
  • Knowledge on ITIL, Six Sigma or Agile Methodology is a plus.

job.title: Associate Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

This role will be based at client site. Associate Network Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining mission-critical Wireless network infrastructure. The role involves troubleshooting, maintenance, incident response, preventive maintenance, implementation activities, vendor coordination, and support for large-scale wireless environments operating in a 24/7 environment.

Job Responsibilities

•Support day-to-day operations of wireless infrastructure including Cisco Wireless solutions, Aruba solutions, switches, firewalls, captive portals, and authentication systems.

•Perform troubleshooting for Wireless connectivity issues, DNS, DHCP, captive portal access, OTP login issues, VLAN routing, authentication failures, and internet access problems.

•Manage service technical escalations and support major incident troubleshooting during service disruptions.

•Support preventive maintenance, firmware upgrades, patching, and technology refresh activities for wireless and network infrastructure.

•Support WLC upgrade activities including Access Point image updates, failover testing, rollback planning, and validation activities.

•Work closely with vendor TAC such as Cisco TAC and Aruba TAC for issue analysis and problem resolution.

•Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and prepare incident reports, technical findings, and preventive recommendations.

•Support implementation activities including Access Point deployment, switch replacement, firewall migration, SSL certificate updates, and network migrations.

•Coordinate with stakeholders, vendors, contractors, and facility management teams during maintenance and implementation activities.

•Support testing activities such as congestion testing, failover testing, WiFi roaming optimization, and POE/network validation.

•Monitor infrastructure health using tools such as Catalyst Center, AirWave, SevOne, LogicMonitor, NetAlly.

•Fluent in ITSM Incident, Change Management, Service Request platforms such as ServiceNow.

•Maintain technical documentation including install plans, diagrams, inventory records, validation evidence, and maintenance reports.

•Support after-office-hour maintenance windows, standby support, and emergency troubleshooting activities.

•Ensure compliance with operational governance, safety requirements, and change management procedures.

Qualifications

Diploma, Higher NITEC, or equivalent qualification in IT or related discipline.

Basic knowledge of networking, WiFi, internet connectivity, and endpoint devices.

Experience in Service Desk, Helpdesk, NOC, or customer support environments preferred.

Good communication, coordination, and customer service skills.

Familiarity with ServiceNow or ITSM ticketing systems is advantageous.

Work Arrangement

Onsite support role

May require standby support, shift work, and after-office-hour maintenance activities depending on operational requirements.

job.title: Senior Matrixx SME DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Design and Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and resilient microservices using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks. Hands-on experience with Apache Camel and its core Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs). Implement RESTful APIs and ensure services meet performance, security, and stability requirements. Write clean, well-tested, and efficient code following best practices and design patterns. Containerization and Deployment: Develop and manage services deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes, including defining Dockerfiles and Kubernetes resource configurations (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, etc.). Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) for automated build, test, and deployment. Monitor and troubleshoot services running in the OpenShift environment. Architecture and Data: Contribute to the architectural design of microservices, focusing on principles like loose coupling, high cohesion, and fault tolerance. Implement various data persistence technologies, including relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis). Integrate services using messaging systems (e.g., Red Hat AMQ) where required. Collaboration and Quality: Perform code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge within the team. Ensure compliance with security standards and industry regulations by performing security vulnerability scans (SAST, DAST, SCA) and disaster recovery exercise. Support on-call duty on shift rotation and handle production incident and root cause analysis with minimal supervision. Knowledge Management: Build technical documentation from scratch, maintaining working documents on architecture overviews, API specifications and system integrations. Create and maintain operational runbooks to support the team and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. • Java Expertise: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using Java and the Spring Boot framework. • Microservices and API: Strong understanding of microservices architecture, principles, and best practices. Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. • Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for deployment and orchestration. Experience with OpenShift-specific features is a significant advantage. • Database: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases. • Tools: Familiarity with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools. • Combined experience in DevOps, SRE, or Software Engineering. • Familiar with containerized environments, Kubernetes internals, and Helm. • Hands-on production experience with Jenkins and CI/CD best practices. • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript). • Solid understanding of AWS core services, IAM security, and cost-optimization practices. • Comfortable with Linux internals, networking fundamentals, and shell scripting. • Agile mindset with experience working in Scrum teams. • Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

job.title: Senior Engineer, Cyber GRC
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:The role ofCyber GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance)is to ensure that an organization's cybersecurity strategy aligns with its business goals, manages policies/standards/frameworks, manages cyber risks effectively, provides oversight and independent 2nd line control review/testing, and adheres to external regulations.

Accountabilities

  • Drive and lead the end-to-end lifecycle of information security governance & policy management.
  • Drive and lead the cyber risk management and reporting.
  • Drive and lead the 2nd line assurance & compliance monitoring.
  • Drive 2nd line oversight and support for audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders.
  • Drive security culture, advisory & stakeholder engagement

Responsibilities

  • Manage the development of Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies for adoption
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies compliance risk
  • Manage the cyber risk oversight by evaluating the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management practices and controls implemented by 1st line (i.e. risk owner, control owner, control supervisor, control performers) of Starhub to ensure proper adherence to risk assessment processes.
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies security/risk deviation process
  • Manage the Starhub risk profile and maintain the Starhub risk register for IT Security / Cybersecurity risks relating to CII & Non-CII
  • Develop and drive regular monitoring and reporting of Starhub key risk indicators for Cybersecurity
  • Manage regular risk reporting and risk escalation to Senior Management or other relevant risk forums
  • Manage Control & Compliance Framework through timely updates of industry standards and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Perform 2nd line assurance review (e.g. control review/testing) on 1st line stakeholders to ensure adherence with Starhub policies and Sub-policies / Regulatory compliance requirements, provide actionable, recommendations, and engage stakeholders for implementation
  • Provide timely communication / awareness to stakeholders on Starhub policies and sub-policies for implementation
  • Provide advisory to stakeholders on Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies requirement
  • Conduct briefings and trainings on Cyber risk / Policy awareness (i.e. Cyber risk management process, Policy compliance, Emerging cyber risk/trend, Issues and Observations from 2nd line control review/testing, and audit related findings) to relevant stakeholders and to support the Starhub Cybersecurity Awareness Programme.
  • Provide 2nd Line oversight and support throughout the audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders: ensuring readiness before the audit begins, facilitating fieldwork execution, and monitoring remediation of findings post-audit.
  • Maintaining a tracker for audit findings (or audit issues registers) to monitor remediation progress, to ensure audit closure issues, to support the scoping for 2nd line assurance review.

Qualifications

1.More than 3 years of experience in information/cybersecurity and risk management Experience in leading cybersecurity risk assessment and risk reduction initiatives

2.Experience in IT/IT-Security policy development and implementation

3.Experience in driving IT-security thematic assessment and IT audits

4.Good knowledge and experience with handling IT-security and cybersecurity audits

5.Good knowledge of experience in driving compliance to meet cybersecurity regulatory requirements

6.Good problem analysis and resolution skills

7.Good and experience stakeholder management skills

job.title: Business Analyst, FRCS
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission

Support the delivery and optimisation of StarHub’s Finance, Risk & Compliance Systems (FRCS) by providing business analysis and delivery support for both StarHub core operations and acquired entities (e.g. MRBB).

This role focuses on supporting acquired entities during integration and steady-state operations, while also managing day-to-day partnering with StarHub Finance and FRCS teams to ensure requirements, processes, and system changes are clearly understood and documented.

Accountabilities

  • Support business analysis activities for FRCS initiatives covering both StarHub and acquired entities (e.g. MRBB).
  • Act as a day-to-day analysis support contact for acquired entities, helping them articulate finance, risk, and compliance needs in alignment with StarHub standards.
  • Assist in documenting business and functional requirements for BAU, post-acquisition, and stabilisation activities.
  • Support process understanding and alignment between acquired entities and StarHub FRCS processes.
  • Enable effective communication and partnering between acquired entities, StarHub Finance teams, IS delivery teams, and vendors through clear documentation.

Responsibilities

  • Support acquired entities (e.g. MRBB) by gathering and documenting requirements, issues, and process gaps related to FRCS systems.
  • Assist in documenting current-state processes for acquired entities and comparing them against StarHub target processes, under guidance from Functional Leads.
  • Support StarHub Finance and FRCS teams by documenting change requests, enhancements, and BAU requirements.
  • Translate inputs from Finance users and Functional Leads into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for both StarHub and acquired entities, including test preparation, coordination, and defect tracking.
  • Assist with documenting process and system impacts for acquired entities during post-acquisition changes.
  • Work closely with IS delivery teams and vendors to clarify documented requirements and support issue resolution.
  • Maintain analysis artefacts and documentation in line with FRCS governance standards.

Areas of Impact

job.title: Head, IAM
job.description:

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking an IT Logistics & Network Support Engineer to support IT and network warehouse operations, asset management, equipment staging, deployment, dispatch, collection, RMA coordination, and Level 1 network support.

The role combines hands-on logistics and inventory responsibilities with basic network troubleshooting and deployment support across enterprise networking and security equipment. The successful candidate will ensure IT assets are accurately tracked, properly prepared for deployment, and supported throughout their lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

1. IT Logistics & Asset Management

  • Receive, inspect, asset-tag, label, store, issue, dispatch, and track network hardware and IT accessories.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records covering:
  • Equipment models and serial numbers
  • Asset tags
  • Warranty and support status
  • Site/location
  • Stock movement
  • Project assignment
  • Manage spare units, replacement devices, SFPs, cables, modules, power supplies, and other network accessories.
  • Coordinate equipment delivery, collection, and movement between warehouses, offices, vendors, and customer sites.
  • Prepare equipment for deployment, including packing, labeling, staging, documentation, and handover records.
  • Maintain delivery notes, collection forms, stock reports, inventory trackers, and audit-ready warehouse documentation.

2. RMA & Vendor Coordination

  • Coordinate faulty equipment replacement, RMA processes, warranty claims, repairs, and return-to-vendor activities.
  • Track RMA status and follow up with vendors, suppliers, and relevant internal teams.
  • Maintain records of faulty units, replacement equipment, repair status, and returned assets.
  • Ensure replacement equipment is properly received, recorded, tagged, and assigned.

3. Level 1 Network Support

  • Perform basic checks for:
  • Power and hardware status
  • Cabling and physical connectivity
  • LED indicators
  • Link and port status
  • SFP/module status
  • Interface connectivity
  • Assist with device staging, rack-and-stack activities, patching, labeling, hardware replacement, and site deployment.
  • Provide basic troubleshooting support for LAN, WAN, WLAN, firewall, and general connectivity incidents or service requests.
  • Perform basic network diagnostic activities, including ping, traceroute, cable checks, link verification, and post-replacement connectivity testing.
  • Collect and document relevant technical information such as hostnames, IP addresses, serial numbers, device models, firmware versions, interface status, screenshots, and basic logs.
  • Escalate complex routing, switching, firewall, wireless, security, or configuration issues to Level 2/Level 3 engineers with clear diagnostic information.

4. Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate network and asset documentation.
  • Update port maps, rack layouts, deployment trackers, inventory records, and equipment movement records.
  • Prepare regular stock, asset, deployment, and RMA reports.
  • Ensure all warehouse and IT asset records remain accurate, complete, and audit-ready.
  • Maintain clear handover documentation for equipment issued to engineers, projects, vendors, and customer sites.

Qualifications

  • Experience in IT logistics, warehouse operations, inventory control, IT asset management, or network equipment handling.
  • Ability to identify and handle enterprise network and infrastructure equipment, including:
  • Switches
  • Routers
  • Firewalls
  • Wireless access points
  • SFPs and transceiver modules
  • Network modules
  • Ethernet/fiber cables
  • Power supplies
  • Rack and patching components
  • Basic knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, IP addressing, VLANs, network cabling, rack layouts, and first-level connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Basic understanding of physical network connectivity, port/link status, SFP status, power indicators, and equipment health checks.
  • Strong coordination skills with vendors, couriers, suppliers, field engineers, project managers, network engineers, and technical teams.
  • Good documentation and record-keeping skills using spreadsheets, ticketing systems, inventory management tools, asset trackers, deployment trackers, and equipment handover records.
  • Able to maintain accurate records of equipment models, serial numbers, asset tags, locations, stock movements, project assignments, warranty status, and RMA status.
  • Willing to support site rollouts, hardware refreshes, equipment replacements, maintenance windows, and deployment activities when required.
  • Comfortable performing hands-on activities such as equipment staging, packing, labeling, rack-and-stack, patching, hardware replacement, dispatch, collection, and site support.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate inventory and audit-ready documentation.
  • Good communication, coordination, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Minimum Higher NITEC, NITEC, Diploma, or equivalent qualification in:
  • Information Technology
  • Networking
  • Electronics
  • Telecommunications
  • Logistics
  • Supply Chain
  • Warehouse Management
  • Or a related discipline
  • Relevant hands-on experience in IT logistics, network equipment handling, infrastructure deployment, or Level 1 network support may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.
  • The following certifications are preferred but not mandatory:
  • Cisco CCNA
  • CompTIA Network+
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Huawei HCIA
  • Aruba entry-level certification
  • Palo Alto PCNSA
  • Fortinet entry-level certification
  • Equivalent networking, infrastructure, or IT service management certifications

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
