job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
Be a part of something BIG!

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-driven Software Engineer (OutSystems) to be responsible for the design, development, testing, implementation, support, and maintenance of enterprise applications using the OutSystems platform. The role works closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions, provide BAU application support, and deliver Change Requests and Projects.

The role also play an important role in ensuring application quality, stability, performance, and maintainability, while providing technical guidance and coordinating development and testing activities where required.

Make an Impact by:

  • Analyze functional and module specifications and translate business requirements into application and technical designs using established methodologies and guidelines
  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain applications using the OutSystems platform, covering both front-end and back-end development
  • Work closely with developers and other technical team members to coordinate development activities, track progress, and ensure timely and quality delivery
  • Provide BAU application support, including investigation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect resolution, and production support
  • Support the delivery of Change Requests (CRs) and Projects throughout the development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and development through testing, implementation, and post-production support
  • Manage and support end-to-end testing and implementation activities, including unit testing, SIT, UAT, and integration testing, ensuring test results are documented, defects are tracked and resolved, and solutions are successfully deployed to production
  • Investigate production incidents, application errors, and performance issues and implement appropriate fixes and preventive measures
  • Develop and maintain integrations with internal and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies
  • Support application deployment, troubleshooting, and hotfix activities using OutSystems Service Center
  • Develop and maintain integrations and extensions using OutSystems Integration Studio where required
  • Evaluate and appropriately use or adapt OutSystems Forge components in accordance with application and security requirements
  • Prepare, review, and maintain technical documentation, application flow diagrams, system documentation, and knowledge-transfer materials
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand business needs and recommend appropriate technical solutions

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or an equivalent discipline
  • At least 5 years of hands-on OutSystems development experience, preferably covering OutSystems 10/11 and Traditional and/or Reactive Web applications
  • Strong hands-on experience in OutSystems 10/11, including Traditional Web and/or Reactive Web application development
  • Strong knowledge of both front-end and back-end OutSystems development
  • Proficiency in OutSystems tools, including Service Center for application monitoring, troubleshooting, deployment and hotfix activities, Integration Studio, and the use and adaptation of OutSystems Forge components
  • Good understanding of software development lifecycles, testing practices, and Agile development methodologies
  • Experience supporting BAU operations, Change Requests, and Projects in an enterprise application environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to work effectively within a geographically distributed team

Your career growth starts here. Apply Now!

job.title: Product Manager (Robotics)
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

We’re assembling a small, high-calibre team to build a new robotics-powered service from the ground up. This programme is designed for a select group of high-potential individuals who want to go beyond execution into building, shaping, and scaling something new.

If you’re looking for structured roles and clear playbooks, this isn’t it.

If you want ownership, steep learning curves, and the chance to work on emerging tech… read on.

What you’ll do

  • Identify real-world problems and validate high-impact use cases
  • Translate ideas into tangible service concepts and test them quickly
  • Build and run pilots end-to-end with cross-functional teams and partners
  • Shape how the service works, from experience design to commercial models
  • Scale what works into a repeatable, high-quality offering

What you’ll gain

  • A front-row seat to building a new offering from 0→1 (and beyond)
  • Exposure to robotics, AI, and real-world deployment of emerging technologies
  • Accelerated growth across product thinking, strategy, and execution
  • Direct visibility with senior stakeholders and decision-makers
  • A platform to prove and stretch your potential

About the role

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for individuals who demonstrate:

  • Sharp thinking. You break down ambiguous problems and form clear, structured approaches
  • Ownership mindset. You take initiative and see things through end-to-end
  • Bias for action. You move fast, test, learn, and adapt
  • Strong influence. You can align different stakeholders and drive progress
  • Resilience. You operate effectively in uncertainty and high expectations

You don’t need prior robotics experience but you do need to learn fast and think independently.

This is an opportunity to build, not inherit… and to be part of a small group shaping what comes next.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Customer Success Manager
job.description:
Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact (SPOC) for assigned wholesale roaming customers, managing both commercial and technical engagements.
  • Own the post-sales relationship for strategic roaming wholesale accounts, ensuring high customer satisfaction, retention, and business growth.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers' commercial, operational, and technical stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor.
  • Conduct regular business reviews to discuss service performance, project updates, future initiatives, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Lead end-to-end customer incident and escalation management, coordinating cross-functional teams to ensure timely resolution, drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), implement corrective actions, and provide clear communication to customers throughout the incident lifecycle.
  • Monitor service performance to ensure SLA compliance, proactively identify service risks, and implement preventive measures to minimize customer impact.
  • Understand customers' business objectives and provide strategic and technical recommendations to maximize the value of roaming products and services.
  • Identify and drive upselling, cross-selling, and business expansion opportunities in collaboration with the Sales team.
  • Support contract renewals, commercial negotiations, and customer growth initiatives alongside Sales.
  • Lead customers onboarding and ensure the successful implementation of new roaming products and services.
  • Provide post-sales support, including service development, solution customization, technical workshops, solution design discussions, and technical advisory.
  • Drive continuous service and process improvements by gathering customer feedback and working closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.
  • Develop and maintain customer success plans, tracking account health, service performance, and key customer initiatives.
  • Prepare business forecasts and manage budgeting for the Managed Roaming business portfolio under assigned customer accounts.
  • Travel domestically and internationally as required to support customer engagements, business reviews, technical workshops, and industry events.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • At least 5 years of experience in the telecommunications industry, preferably in wholesale roaming, customer success, account management, or service delivery.
  • Experience managing strategic customer accounts and acting as the main point of contact for commercial and technical matters.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, and Word). Experience with CRM or service management tools is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Director, IT Service Delivery
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Service Delivery

Service Delivery encompasses the end-to-end deliverables specified in the Service Contract provided by Singtel Group (or its subsidiaries). This includes service governance, client engagement with customers, and managing the expectations and outcomes for both external and internal senior stakeholders. Service Delivery also focuses on account growth and ensuring an excellent customer engagement experience.

The Service Delivery Director is responsible for managing multiple account delivery teams in alignment with Singtel's commitments to various service contracts.

The Service Delivery Director is also expected to develop strategic and tactical plans to ensure delivery meets contractual obligations to customers. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to): -

  • Driving service delivery to meet and exceed contractual SLA commitments.
  • Sponsoring delivery teams in implementing digitalization initiatives to enhance efficiency and improve the service engagement experience.
  • Managing senior stakeholders (e.g. CxOs, VPs, and IT Heads) through effective communication and portfolio management during major incidents.
  • Building and strengthening client relationships through in-depth knowledge of customer domains.
  • Identifying opportunities and supporting the Sales Team in pursuing new business prospects to grow the EWO portfolio.

Operations

The Service Delivery Director is expected to lead both the Service and Technical delivery team in day-to-day operations matters, and ensure services are delivered with pride and sustainable model to meet our SLA deliverables. Operation delivery includes leading team on delivery excellence, and drive towards continuous service improvements, and to enhance the service values to the customer.

The Service Delivery Director is also expected to engage and manage 3rd party partners and vendors, to align their delivery competency and capabilities with Singtel service contract to our customers.

Financial Management

The Service Delivery Director is expected to manage the financials for the service portfolios under the purview, in accordance with the Business Case of the service contracts on Cost of Delivery, recovery of cost in respective cost centre in a healthy state.

Financial management responsibilities include but not limited to: -

  • Annual AOP budgeting, financial planning across the portfolio.
  • Manpower and resourcing budgeting
  • Operation run rate and forward planning
  • Monthly financial status tracking and progressive report
  • Operations and Financial optimization

People and Growth

The Service Delivery Director is expected to coach and mentor Associate Directors, Service Delivery Managers, and delivery teams, whether under direct or indirect management (e.g., third-party partners or contractors). This includes providing thought leadership and demonstrating strong people management skills for the various teams within the service portfolios.

The Service Delivery Director is responsible for developing a Portfolio Strategy and Tactical Performance Measurement for the teams under their supervision. They should adopt a top-down approach to KPI setting for the delivery teams within the portfolio.

Additionally, the Service Delivery Director should conduct routine communication sessions with members of the delivery teams and their direct reports to provide directives and guidance. This includes holding weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual meetings, as well as one-on-one sessions and performance assessments, as required.

Corporate Engagement

The Service Delivery Director would support Global Delivery 5 key initiatives within their portfolio: -

  • Customer First,
  • Quality First,
  • People First,
  • Digital First,
  • Security First,

The Service Delivery Director would support any other Singtel and/or SEB corporate program and events, as required.

The Service Delivery Director would support and promote collaboration within the delivery teams, Singtel and/or SEB organization.

Skills for Success:

  • ITIL Foundation
  • Min 8-10 years working in enterprise scale IT environment or 15 years in senior delivery role managing in Cross Domains (multiple technical domains) enterprise environment

Proficient in:

  • Service Delivery Management
  • Project Management
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Proficient in at least 2 or more technical workstreams (Network, System, DB, Storage, Hosting, Cloud, Workplace services, Telco services)
  • Executive Stakeholders Management
  • People management
  • Presentation skills
  • Project P&L & Portfolio Financial Management
  • Coaching / Mentorship skillsets

job.title: Finance Manager - Consumer and Fixed Product Finance
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

The Finance Manager manages Finance Business Partnering for Mobile Postpaid (Residential & Corporate Individual Scheme).

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Perform monthly actual closing to track against budget and forecast. Analyze and present monthly closing results to Line Directors and VP, Mobile Marketing. Call out highlights and help business identify areas of concern to draw up Get Well Plans
  • Liaise with Business Analysts and Line to understand non-financial drivers and how they have impacted performance
  • Prepare monthly flash for circulation to FP&A and VP, Mobile Marketing.
  • Liaise with auditors on balance sheet reconciliations, coordinate requests by auditors with other stakeholders and address auditor queries
  • Work with Line on financial forecasts and budget in light of drivers. Run scenarios. Perform analysis and prepare and review presentation materials for management
  • Review business cases and develop financial models to assess the financial feasibility of Capex and business proposals including measures such as ROIC and NPV
  • Support key projects initiatives e.g. EPM implementation, review business and finance requirement and support Line on new product roll out

Skills for Success

  • A University degree in Accountancy with at least 4-8 years of relevant work experience.
  • Meticulous, detail oriented, strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills;
  • IT knowledge and experience in system implementations would be an advantage
  • Forward looking, proactive and persevering in order to press ahead to introduce new tools and applications to bring about improvements to the Finance community, amidst competing demands for time and resources
  • Ability to handle numerous time-critical assignments simultaneously with sense of urgency and ability to prioritise work;
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office – Excel, Powerpoint, Word

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Senior Manager, Group CEO Office
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Be a Part of Something BIG!

This role’s main objective and purpose is to run and drive GCEO and Corporate Centre engagement activities, as enablers in driving Singtel Group’s corporate strategy & execution, with the primary responsibility of supporting GCEO and Corporate Centre in achieving maximum efficiency and effectiveness across all engagement platforms and business cadence and progress.

This role is expected to act as team lead for Group CEO Office, supervising Managers and Operations Support team members.

Make an Impact by

Lead in planning for engagements and events led by GCEO

  • Responsible for organising internal corporate engagements led by GCEO including townhalls, Workshops and communication sessions (eg Leaders Business Updates, Top Executive Workshops, GCEO Townhalls/Communication Sessions, Overseas Board Trips, ad-hoc Board and Management overseas trips, etc)
  • Develop theme and content for GCEO strategic topics and key messages to the organisation on people and culture, way of working, business direction & focus areas as well as progress towards our Singtel28 growth plan
  • Curate and ensure effectiveness of GCEO leadership brand, key direction and messages across Singtel Group
  • Optimize the organisation of events according to the audience, content, agenda/programme and format to ensure key messages are communicated effectively
  • Take on increased accountability for liaison, negotiation and decisions made with external partners, such as production companies, venue sales teams, leadership development partners, external speakers and workshop content partners
  • Act as unofficial Team Lead for Group CEO Office, overseeing the work of Manager(s) and Senior Admin Executive(s).
  • Responsible for Board engagement and events, including organising Overseas Board Trip which requires extensive planning, facilitation and engagement with Board, senior stakeholders and colleagues across Singtel Group including Associates.
  • Develop agenda, brief and content for Group CEO-led workshops for Board, MC and Top Executives and townhalls for Executives and the rest of organisation.
  • Accountable for negotiations with venues, production companies, business/training consultants and external speakers for Group-wide scale rates.
  • Achievements tied to Singtel Group Your Voice Survey engagement score, progress towards Singtel28 and B.I.G. culture, through impact in Group CEO messaging and people & stakeholder engagement activities.
  • Take on multiple new projects related to Singtel Group Singtel28 growth plan, Future of Work / new ways of working as well as Group Purpose & B.I.G. culture, as and when required.
  • Take on more end-to-end accountability for internal stakeholder management to achieve the required outcome of Group CEO Office activities and work.

Drive Corporate Centre operational cadence

  • Trusted partner to deliver efficient processes, decision-making, collaboration and corporate governance process across Singtel Group.
  • Be very involved in managing and facilitating senior management and Board-level participation in key workshops and conferences.
  • Play a key role in the following efforts and projects, which includes but are not limited to the following:
  • Manage input of engagement activities in integrated corporate calendar
  • Support high-impact content generation and presentations for GCEO, Management Committee (MC) and the Board for key events (where required)
  • Deliver market research and extensive business briefing documents for ad-hoc meetings and Board & Management trips
  • Support key Group Level projects as necessary to assist GCEO and MC members
  • Deliver follow-ups from key events/projects and assist associated reviews

Build and sustain content and activities to support Singtel’s Group Purpose and refreshed Core Values

  • Contribute to the co-creation process of Group Purpose and refreshed Core Values, towards the progress of Singtel28 growth plan
  • Co-ordinate across OpCos and Corporate Centre to cascade, activate and integrate Group Purpose and B.I.G culture throughout the organisation
  • Contribute to continuous activation and embedding activities for Group Purpose, B.I.G. culture and refreshed Core Values across the organisation

Manage ad-hoc events and engagements that GCEO is involved in including external meetings and speaker requests

  • Develop content for GCEO presentations in strategic group-wide activities, for GCEO to deliver key messages to the organisation
  • Conduct in-depth research and develop meeting brief to drive impactful outcome for GCEO meetings with external stakeholders, strengthening Singtel Group’s strong partnerships network
  • Build content for GCEO presentations to key stakeholders including Board of Directors for support of strategic direction and key messages, as required
  • Research on strategic information as required. Increase quality of briefs to Group CEO for external meetings and specific events such as Mobile World Congress.

Main organiser for selected Corporate Centre engagement activities led by Group CEO and/or Management Committee

  • Organise 5 key regional forums, working with different stakeholder teams across Singtel Group. Curate a high-impact agenda and programme content for each forum and administer all logistical arrangements
  • Support or organise forums / conferences / workshops for specific topics or milestone achievements or celebrations, as required

Support Chairman and Board of Directors

  • Render support for Chairman and Board of Directors for key meeting, engagement activities and overseas trips, as required

Be the mentor to and oversee the Management Associate(s) in Group CEO Office.

Skills for Success

  • A degree from a recognised university, preferably specialising in Marketing / Communications
  • Possess minimum 7 years of relevant experience working in a large corporation
  • Competent and experienced in planning and implementation of corporate events
  • Competent in research, content development and presentation to senior management
  • Sharp business acumen with excellent interpersonal, facilitation, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Excellent organisational skills for event planning and management.
  • Able to work well in a fast-paced environment with different stakeholders and manage different projects at the same time.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Associate Director, Personalisation Delivery
job.description:
Date: 25 Aug 2026

Location:

Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream and stay in touch on the Optus network. Behind that experience is a team making critical decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

We're looking for an experienced delivery leader to join our team as Associate Director, Personalisation Delivery. In this role, you'll lead the planning, prioritisation and execution of our personalisation roadmap, ensuring initiatives are delivered efficiently, transparently and in line with business objectives.

Acting as the central point of coordination for personalisation demand, you'll bring together business, data and technology teams to drive delivery across customer data, decisioning, marketing automation and channel experience capabilities.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Own and manage the integrated Personalisation delivery roadmap, ensuring initiatives are prioritised, sequenced and delivered in line with customer and business objectives.
  • Lead demand intake and backlog management, translating business priorities into clear, actionable delivery plans.
  • Partner with business, data and technology teams to coordinate delivery across customer data, decisioning, marketing automation and channel experience streams.
  • Drive planning, governance and stakeholder alignment, providing clear visibility of priorities, progress and outcomes.
  • Manage dependencies, risks and delivery challenges to support successful execution across complex initiatives.
  • Monitor delivery performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, predictability and business value.

What makes you right for the role?

  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional delivery programs, portfolios or strategic initiatives with multiple interdependent workstreams.
  • Strong backlog management, prioritisation and demand planning expertise.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and coordinating delivery across multiple stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or similar delivery and workflow management tools.
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies and governance frameworks.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity and make informed trade-off decisions.
  • Experience within customer, digital, marketing technology or personalisation environments will be highly regarded.

**

The good stuff:

  • Competitive remuneration, plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and exclusive shopping discounts with our retail partners — making everyday life a little more affordable. Genuine Flexibility - work three days in the office, two days from wherever works best for you.
  • An office campus that has it all - cafes chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre. It’s designed for real life. **
  • Great leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever matters most to you.
  • Inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks, because family comes first.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Your wellbeing matters, so we offer with free counselling and support services, available 24/7 in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • A free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon. Or, heaps of onsite parking. Plus, end of trip facilities with lockers, showers, irons and hair dryers.

**

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

job.title: BPO Support Consultant
job.description:
Date: 27 Aug 2026

Location:

Melbourne, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband, and digital solutions.

Reporting to the Associate Director, Global Collections Operations, the Operational BPO Reporting Consultant is responsible for end-to-end operational reporting, performance analytics, and vendor benchmarking across multiple offshore partner sites. The role translates data-driven insights into operational action, driving performance uplift, governance, and continuous improvement across Collections and Recoveries portfolios. Acting as a key link between reporting, operations, and vendor management, the role supports strategic decision-making and optimises customer, financial, and operational outcomes.

What You’ll Do | Your day to day will consist of

  • Own and deliver operational reporting and performance dashboards across all Collections and Recoveries portfolios.
  • Develop and manage vendor benchmarking scorecards, identifying performance trends, risks, and opportunities across partner sites.
  • Analyse operational, financial, compliance, and customer experience KPIs to drive actionable insights and performance improvements.
  • Lead reporting governance, executive reporting, and performance review packs to support business decision-making.
  • Partner with vendors and operational leaders to implement corrective actions, coaching initiatives, and performance uplift plans.
  • Drive reporting innovation through automation, dashboard enhancements, and optimisation of reporting tools and processes.

What You Bring | What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Strong experience in operational reporting, business intelligence, analytics, or performance management within a contact centre or collections environment.
  • Advanced capability in reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar platforms.
  • Proven ability to analyse complex data, identify root causes, and translate insights into practical business outcomes.
  • Experience managing vendor performance, benchmarking frameworks, and stakeholder engagement across multiple sites.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to present insights and recommendations to leadership teams.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for automation, operational excellence, and data-driven decision making.

The good stuff…. | What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and outstanding shopping discounts with our retail partners.

job.title: Senior Quality Engineer
job.description:
Date: 24 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

Senior Quality Engineer plays the Test Lead role and is responsible for driving project-wide quality engineering practices, embedding quality early in software development lifecycle, and leading test strategy, planning, automation, execution, reporting and governance initiatives.

This role defines quality frameworks, develops test solutions across platforms, and integrates robust quality gates within CI/CD pipelines, while fostering cross-functional collaboration and observability through test analytics.

Test Automation Strategy and Implementation:

  • Design, develop, and maintain sophisticated and scalable test automation frameworks, test suites, and solutions for web, API, and mobile applications.
  • Provide architectural guidance and best practices for test automation.
  • Lead the adoption of automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Playwright, RestAssured, Appium) within teams and potentially across multiple projects or the organization.
  • Integrate automation seamlessly into the development lifecycle.
  • Implement, optimize, and oversee CI/CD pipelines with well-defined and automated quality gates
  • Integrate various test types (unit, integration, E2E, non-functional) into the CI/CD process
  • Monitor pipeline effectiveness and provide actionable feedback and insights to development teams
  • Contribute to the evolution and standardization of CI/CD processes.

Strategic Test Planning and Execution:

  • Define and lead the development and execution of comprehensive test strategies for projects and programs.
  • Determine test scope, methodologies, resource estimation, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Effectively apply mocking and contract testing techniques
  • Implement advanced test automation techniques and testing methodologies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional parties to execute testing.

Test Analytics and Reporting:

  • Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure process efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Leverage test data and metrics to provide insightful reports and identify areas for improvement.
  • Enhance observability through test analytics at the project, program, and potentially organizational levels.
  • Report on the progress and effectiveness of automation and testing efforts.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software testing, including experience in test management.
  • Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools, and best practices.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills.
  • Experience in test automation is a plus.
  • Relevant certifications such as ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) are beneficial.

Technical Proficiency

  • Expertise in Test Automation: Proven ability to design, develop, and maintain complex and scalable test automation frameworks for web, API, and mobile applications using relevant tools (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, RestAssured, Appium).
  • Deep Understanding of CI/CD: Comprehensive knowledge of CI/CD principles, tools, and the integration of automated testing within pipelines (e.g., Bamboo, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of Testing Methodologies: Solid understanding of various testing methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) and test design techniques.
  • Experience with Performance Testing: Hands-on with performance test Execution (Jmeter, NeoLoad) and respective toolset.
  • API Testing Skills: Proven ability to test APIs effectively using relevant tools and protocols.
  • Scripting and Programming Skills: Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages relevant to test automation (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript).
  • Experience with Test Management Tools: Familiarity with tools like Jira with Qmetry, or similar.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Lead Specialist, Mobile Data Engineering (Networks)
job.description:
Date: 23 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

Singtel Networks, the most established telecommunications infrastructure provider in Singapore is transforming to enable the digital generation of tomorrow. We are introducing new capabilities in 5G, Cloud, Analytics, Digital Commerce, Software Engineering, Cyber Security to enhance our core competencies and deliver innovative and differentiated Mobile and Fixed services (Broadband, TV and Telephony) for our customers. We are committed to celebrating inclusion and diversity and is a strong believer to upskill and nurture all individuals. Come join us today as we build Singtel’s Networks of tomorrow, and Empower Every Generation to live, work and play in new ways!

Make an Impact:

1. Mobile Data Engineering Planning

  • Lead end-to-end planning for mobile data platforms across 4G and 5G environments, including mobile core, packet core, service assurance, probe, analytics, data feeds, and observability platforms.
  • Own the planning roadmap for 4G VNF and 5G CNF domains, ensuring scalability, resiliency, lifecycle readiness, capacity sufficiency, and alignment with business, technology, and operational priorities.
  • Provide domain expertise across 4G EPC, 5G Core, control plane, user plane, roaming, VoLTE, VoNR, IoT, 5G slicing, xDR, session tracing, performance analytics, and end-to-end service correlation.
  • Define architecture, capacity, interface, integration, monitoring, and performance requirements for new mobile data capabilities and platform enhancements.
  • Ensure engineering plans support business growth, customer experience, operational efficiency, automation, security, and cost optimization.

2. End-to-End Architecture and Technical Ownership

  • Lead end-to-end solution planning across mobile core, IP transport, data centre, cloud infrastructure, virtualization, container platforms, monitoring, orchestration, and operational support systems.
  • Ensure complete E2E setup readiness, including IP design, routing, firewall requirements, DNS, load balancing, connectivity, security zones, platform onboarding, operational access, monitoring, logging, backup, and disaster recovery considerations.
  • Provide technical leadership for cloud-native and virtualized environments, including 5G CNF and 4G VNF architecture, platform dependencies, lifecycle management, resource planning, software upgrades, and vendor roadmap alignment.
  • Drive readiness of environments for deployment, testing, integration, commissioning, production acceptance, and operational handover.
  • Serve as the technical planning authority for mobile data use cases that span network, IT, cloud, security, automation, analytics, and business teams.

3. DevOps, GitLab and Automation

  • Lead the adoption of DevOps practices for mobile data engineering, including GitLab-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, change traceability, automated testing, and controlled deployment workflows.
  • Drive automation initiatives to improve delivery speed, configuration consistency, service assurance, operational efficiency, and incident response.
  • Promote infrastructure-as-code, pipeline-driven deployment, repeatable testing, automated validation, and standardized rollback practices where applicable.
  • Work with engineering, operations, vendors, and platform teams to industrialize automation for 4G VNF and 5G CNF deployment, upgrade, monitoring, and lifecycle activities.
  • Ensure DevOps and automation practices comply with security, governance, change management, and production control requirements.

4. LMP, Platform and Lifecycle Management

  • Provide planning and domain leadership for LMP-related capabilities, platform onboarding, lifecycle management, orchestration, inventory, performance, and operational readiness.
  • Manage technology lifecycle planning for mobile data platforms, including hardware, software, licences, capacity, support contracts, end-of-life, end-of-support, refresh, migration, and decommissioning.
  • Maintain forward-looking platform roadmaps aligned with business demand, vendor evolution, 5G standalone development, cloud-native transformation, and operational requirements.
  • Identify technical risks, obsolescence risks, security risks, capacity constraints, and cost pressures, and develop mitigation plans.

5. CAPEX, OPEX and P&L Accountability

  • Manage P&L accountability for assigned Mobile Data Engineering platforms, including CAPEX and OPEX planning, forecasting, tracking, optimisation, and reporting.
  • Develop business cases, investment papers, budget submissions, procurement justifications, cost models, and financial impact assessments for new platforms, capacity expansions, renewals, upgrades, and transformation initiatives.
  • Track and manage vendor costs, maintenance charges, software licences, cloud or infrastructure consumption, support services, professional services, hardware refresh, and project delivery costs.
  • Optimise total cost of ownership through platform consolidation, automation, capacity efficiency, vendor negotiation, lifecycle planning, and operational simplification.
  • Ensure spending aligns with approved budgets, business priorities, governance requirements, and measurable value delivery.

6. Business Use Case Leadership

  • Lead conversations with business, product, commercial, enterprise, network, IT, security, finance, and operations stakeholders to convert business ideas into practical mobile data use cases.
  • Translate business opportunities into technical requirements, solution options, cost estimates, implementation plans, KPIs, delivery milestones, and operational acceptance criteria.
  • Assess feasibility, financial impact, security impact, customer experience impact, operational complexity, and delivery risk for proposed business use cases.
  • Drive use cases from ideation through planning, business case approval, design, delivery, testing, launch, and post-launch benefit tracking.
  • Act as the bridge between business ambition and network/platform realisation, ensuring solutions are technically sound, financially justified, secure, and operationally sustainable.

7. Security, Risk and Compliance

  • Apply security-by-design principles across mobile data planning and delivery, including confidentiality, integrity, availability, accountability, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, secure access, network segmentation, and data protection.
  • Ensure mobile data solutions comply with internal security policies, change management processes, vulnerability management requirements, regulatory obligations, and operational governance.
  • Lead security assessment planning for new platforms and major changes, including vulnerability assessment, penetration testing coordination, risk review, remediation tracking, and secure production rollout.
  • Ensure proper management of privileged access, system accounts, logs, audit trails, asset inventory, software licences, patching, backup, restoration, and secure disposal where applicable.
  • Work closely with cybersecurity, network security, architecture, operations, vendors, and governance teams to manage risks and ensure secure implementation.

8. Project and Program Management

  • Lead complex mobile data engineering projects from planning to delivery, including scope definition, budget planning, solution design, procurement, vendor engagement, implementation, testing, commissioning, acceptance, documentation, and handover.
  • Manage project schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, resources, financials, governance forums, and executive reporting.
  • Ensure project delivery follows agreed scope, timeline, budget, quality, change management, security, and operational acceptance requirements.
  • Lead cross-functional project teams across network engineering, operations, IP, cloud, IT, cybersecurity, finance, procurement, vendors, and business units.
  • Drive timely decision-making, issue resolution, escalation management, and stakeholder alignment.

9. Stakeholder and Vendor Management

  • Act as a senior technical and planning interface for internal stakeholders, vendors, suppliers, and delivery partners.
  • Manage vendor performance, roadmap alignment, solution compliance, commercial discussions, technical escalations, support quality, and delivery commitments.
  • Influence stakeholders across business and technology teams to align priorities, resolve conflicts, and deliver outcomes.
  • Prepare and present technical papers, investment proposals, architecture options, risk assessments, financial summaries, project updates, and management recommendations.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders by combining strong technical credibility, financial discipline, business understanding, and clear communication.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline.
  • 10 or more years of experience in mobile network planning, mobile data engineering, packet core, mobile core, service assurance, cloud-native telecom platforms, or telecom infrastructure delivery.
  • Strong domain knowledge in both 4G and 5G mobile data environments, including 4G VNF and 5G CNF architecture.
  • Experience in mobile core, packet core, EPC, 5GC, control plane, user plane, roaming, VoLTE, VoNR, IoT, slicing, probes, analytics, xDR, KPI monitoring, and service assurance.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end telecom setup, including IP networking, routing, DNS, firewall, load balancer, data centre, cloud platform, virtualization, containers, orchestration, monitoring, and operational support.
  • Experience with GitLab, DevOps practices, CI/CD, automation, scripting, configuration management, and controlled software delivery processes.
  • Experience managing CAPEX, OPEX, budget planning, cost tracking, procurement support, business cases, and financial governance.
  • Strong project management experience, preferably with exposure to large-scale telecom platform delivery, vendor management, change management, and operational handover.
  • Good security knowledge across telecom networks, cloud-native platforms, access control, vulnerability management, patching, logging, network segmentation, secure change, and production risk management

job.description:

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. Be a Part of Something BIG

We create great technology that can change the future, and we're looking for people to be part of our digital and 5G journey. If you like to work in a dynamic, leading communications technology group to deliver innovations and excellence across the region, come join our digital, software engineering, data and cyber security teams!

The Group Security Architect is a visionary leader responsible for shaping the Singtel Group’s security architecture strategy and embedding “secure-by-design” principles across all technology domains. Working closely with the Group Enterprise Architect, Security Architects from Operating Companies, this role defines the Group Security Guardrails that underpin our Reference Architecture and technology blueprints.

As a trusted advisor and design authority, the Group Security Architect ensures that emerging technologies are securely adopted at scale across the Group. The role bridges business, technology, and security strategy, driving alignment between innovation and resilience while strengthening architectural consistency across OpCos.

This position demands both technical depth and strategic foresight and someone who can anticipate technology trends, translate them into actionable security patterns, and influence decision-making at the Group level.

Apply now, and ignite our digital future together.

Make an Impact by

  • Strategic Leadership & Vision
  • Define and maintain the Group Security Architecture Vision and roadmap, ensuring alignment with Group Enterprise Architecture and business strategy.
  • Anticipate emerging technology shifts and translate them into forward-looking security design principles and guardrails.
  • Support Group’s technology modernisation initiatives by embedding “secure-by-design” and “zero-trust” concepts into enterprise blueprints.
  • Security Guardrails & Reference Architecture
  • Co-develop with the Group Enterprise Architect the Group Security Guardrails to guide technology adoption, integration, and operations across OpCos.
  • Maintain the Security Reference Architecture (SRA) for major technology domains
  • Ensure alignment with regulatory frameworks
  • Translate architectural blueprints into adoptable and actionable implementation guidance for solution architects and engineering teams.
  • Security Technology Stack Alignment
  • Drive Group-wide alignment of the security technology stack across OpCos, ensuring rationalisation, interoperability, and consistent adoption of Group-endorsed platforms.

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

The Domain Architect – Fixed Voice and Interconnect is responsible for the end‑to‑end architecture, evolution, and technical governance of Fixed Voice platforms and services, ensuring solutions are secure, resilient, scalable, and aligned with business strategy and industry standards. Acting as the technical authority across legacy and next‑generation voice technologies, the role drives roadmap development, solution design, and complex transformation initiatives within the Fixed Voice and Interconnect domain.

Your day to day will consist of

  • Own and maintain end‑to‑end Fixed Voice and Interconnect architectures, covering current, transitional, and target states across domestic and international environments.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Security, Commercial teams, vendors, and international carriers to deliver end‑to‑end voice outcomes.
  • Ensure architectures meet availability, performance, security, and compliance obligations, and lead improvements from incident and post‑incident reviews.

What makes you perfect for the role

  • Extensive experience in Fixed Voice architecture within carrier and/or large enterprise environments;
  • Strong understanding of international and domestic interconnect voice routing models, SIP trunking, and network protocols (SIP, Diameter, TLS, etc);
  • Knowledge of regulatory obligations impacting access, interconnect and international voice services;
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear architectural guidance for senior stakeholders;
  • Exposure to virtualised or cloud‑hosted SBC and voice platforms;
  • Strong hands‑on architectural experience with Ribbon solutions (PSX, SBCs, C20) or equivalent carrier‑grade platforms;
  • Strong problem‑solving, risk management, and decision‑making capability in regulated environments;
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and vendor management skills.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.

  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. job.title: Senior AI Solution Architect
job.description:
Date: 24 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Powering the Future with AIDA

To lead the next phase of our AI evolution, we’ve launched a new business unit AIDA – Artificial Intelligence & Data Analytics – a strategic engine driving our transformation designed to scale our AI ambitions with precision and purpose. This marks a pivotal shift in how we operate, innovate, and serve to embed intelligence into every layer of our business.

At Singtel, this is more than a technology upgrade. It’s a strategic transformation that redefines how value is created across the enterprise core— augmenting human capabilities and unlocking entirely new potential. It is a transformation journey by aligning people, platforms, and processes under one cohesive strategy. Our mission is to build AI literacy, and foster a culture where intelligence empowers people.

We welcome you to join us on a transformational journey that’s reshaping the telecommunications industry — and redefining what’s possible with AI at its core. Grow with us in a workplace that champions innovation, embraces agility, and puts human potential at the heart of everything we do.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As a Senior AI Solution Architect, you will serve as the technical expert in architecting enterprise-grade and end-to-end AI solutions across Singtel. Working within the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) business unit, you will drive the design, integration, and deployment of scalable AI workflows that are secure, interoperable, and business-aligned.

This role sits at the intersection of data, platforms and business systems that plays a critical role in translating AI vision into actionable architecture and technical designs. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams across Networks, IT, and external partners to ensure that AI solutions are integrated seamlessly into existing infrastructures and future-ready ecosystems.

Make an Impact by:

  • Design end-to-end AI solutions that are robust, scalable, and span data ingestion, model deployment, API orchestration, and business system integration across hybrid cloud and on-prem environments
  • Architect and deliver solutions for the Central AI platform, encompassing Agentic AI, AI Workbench and Tooling, Model Management, shared RAG service, MCP, AI Runtime environments, etc
  • Develop solution blueprinting by translating business needs into technical architecture, including selecting appropriate tools, frameworks, and infrastructure for AI model development and operations
  • Integrate AI capabilities with internal APIs, enterprise platforms and user-facing applications in IT and Networks including LLM-based and agentic workflows
  • Ensure secure and compliant architecture in collaboration with cybersecurity and governance teams, embedding PDPA and enterprise policy requirements into designs
  • Evaluate and recommend AI platforms and tools (e.g. Portkey, Databricks, open-source toolkits) based on enterprise goals and technical fit
  • Collaborate with AI engineering and data teams to operationalize AI models, ensuring architectural alignment, scalability, and lifecycle support
  • Contribute to proof-of-concepts (PoCs), technical evaluations, and prototyping efforts under supervision
  • Stay current with AI technologies and best practices in integration, model lifecycle management, and platform operations
  • Participate in architecture reviews, technical discussions, and sprint planning with cross-functional teams.
  • Define and enforce architectural standards, reusable design patterns, open-standard, and reference implementations to streamline AI deployment across business units
  • Provide technical leadership in prototyping, experimentation, vendor technology evaluations, and innovation pilots
  • Stay updated on emerging AI technologies such as vector databases, context-aware agents, orchestration protocols (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, A2A, etc) and assess their applicability within the enterprise
  • Responsible for leading solutioning activities and managing a small development team consists of AI engineer and application developer for selected use cases

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data, AI/ML, or related field.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in solution architecture in AI/ML platform integration, data pipeline design and API-driven systems
  • Proven expertise in designing and integrating end-to-end AI workflows, including data pipelines, model orchestration, and serving APIs across hybrid cloud environments
  • Experience in designing AI/ML systems, cloud-native architectures, and API ecosystems.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based AI services such as Microsoft Azure ML, AI Foundry, AWS SageMaker, Bedrock, including model deployment, monitoring, and scaling.

job.description:
Date: 25 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

The role reports into the Senior Director – Group Strategy, Engineering, and Innovation (GSEI) / Network Services Development (NSD). It plays a pivotal role in shaping Singtel Group’s AI-driven network, Autonomous Networks (AN), OSS and CPaaS architecture strategy.

The role defines and governs the Group Network AI and AN architecture, framework, and roadmap, while guiding OpCos on AI/AN use cases and aligning OpCo roadmaps with Group strategy and AN maturity targets.

The role focuses on enabling the transition from traditional network operations to AI-enabled and autonomous operating models, spanning network, OSS and IT domains, while ensuring architectural consistency, scalability, and long-term sustainability across the Group.

Make an Impact by

**

Network AI / AN Strategy and Architecture

  • Define the Group Network AI and Autonomous Networks (AN) architecture, framework, and roadmap aligned to Singtel28 and TM Forum AN maturity models (L3/L4).
  • Develop and maintain AN reference architectures, architectural guardrails, and best practices to guide OpCo implementations.
  • Work with network domain experts to align AI/AN adoption across RAN, Mobile Core, Transport, Fixed Access, OSS, and Network Operations.

OpCo Engagement and Alignment

  • Partner with OpCos to identify AN use cases, assess architectural readiness, and identify gaps across network, OSS, and IT layers.
  • Provide architectural advisory support to OpCos to guide roadmap definition and prioritisation toward AN maturity targets.
  • Ensure alignment of OpCo AN initiatives with Group architecture and strategy

OSS Strategy & Transformation

  • Provide architectural leadership and guidance on OSS transformation initiatives, including platform strategy, AI enablement, and alignment with AN L4 objectives.
  • Support and align Group and OpCo OSS-related decisions, including tender evaluations, vendor assessments, and strategic direction (e.g. agentic AI on existing OSS platforms versus platform replacement).
  • Work with OpCos and vendors to ensure OSS solutions support AI-driven service assurance, closed-loop automation, and future AN L4 evolution.
  • Engage stakeholders during tender specifications, vendor clarification workshops, and solution evaluations to ensure alignment with Group AN architecture and roadmap.

CPaaS Architecture & Enablement

  • Provide Group-level architectural guidance for CPaaS initiatives, ensuring alignment with Network architecture, and digital service exposure strategies.
  • Work with OpCos to align CPaaS architectures, API exposure models, and integration patterns with Group standards.
  • Support CPaaS tender specifications, vendor evaluations, and clarification workshops, ensuring scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions.

Technical Leadership and Governance

job.title: Security Operations Centre Specialist
job.description:
Date: 26 Aug 2026

Location:

Macquarie Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband, and digital solutions.

The Security Operations Centre (SOC) Specialist plays a critical role in delivering industry-leading security management, monitoring, and support services for Optus Enterprise and its clients. This position focuses on implementing and operating security monitoring solutions, addressing emerging threats, conducting dark web monitoring, and reviewing technical infrastructure and designs. It is a hands-on technical role involving configuration changes and detailed analysis of security data and products.

Working within the Technical Operations group, the specialist will engage with internal and external stakeholders to provide insights and recommendations on security decisions, support operational environments, and contribute to broader information security initiatives.

Due to the nature of this role and security clearance requirements, applicants must be Australian citizens.**

What you’ll be doing

  • Investigate complex cases by correlating patterns from SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, DEVO) and other security data sources to identify threats and anomalies.
  • Configure, manage, upgrade, and maintain SIEM platforms; develop and tune use cases, alerts, dashboards, and reports to improve detection capabilities.
  • Create, document, and refine processes for handling and monitoring security solutions, ensuring operational efficiency and compliance.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to onboard logs, baseline detection thresholds, and enhance threat detection methods.
  • Configure, manage, upgrade, and maintain Cloud Web Proxy platforms (e.g., Zscaler).
  • Participate in security incident response processes, including red team exercises; proactively resolve issues to prevent recurrence.
  • Develop reporting frameworks, deliver operational security reports, and regularly meet with account and security teams to review risks, incidents, and improvements.
  • Work with SIEM vendors for support issues and provide observations and recommendations to internal stakeholders to strengthen security posture.

**

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • 3–5 years’ experience in security operations, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, thorough, with preferred certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CRISC.
  • Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience with SIEM technologies (especially Splunk), including logging, monitoring, triage, alert reporting, and use case development.
  • Solid background in day-to-day security operations, incident classification, investigation, remediation, and familiarity with frameworks like NIST, PSPF, and Australian ISM.
  • Experience with security tools such as Tenable, Symantec Endpoint Protection, Firepower IPS/IDS, vulnerability management, network security, and endpoint protection systems.
  • Solid grasp of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), awareness of ISO 27001 and SOC2 standards, and experience supporting audits.
  • Ability to analyse data for insights, develop security documentation, and contribute to delivery and project engagements; scripting knowledge for reporting is desirable.

**

Optus is a place where we let you do you. We offer a range of benefits including:

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

job.title: Commercial Contract Manager
job.description:
Date: 26 Aug 2026

Location:

ACT, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

The Commercial Contract Manager (CCM) is a senior role within Optus Business responsible for optimising contractual and commercial performance across Optus' largest and most strategic customer contracts. Partnering closely with Account Directors, Customer Delivery Directors and key stakeholders, the CCM protects commercial value, manages contractual risk, ensures compliance obligations are met and drives successful customer and business outcomes throughout the contract lifecycle.

Based in Canberra or Melbourne, this role is primarily focused on managing high-value Tier 1 customer contracts, particularly within the Federal Government sector, where contracts are complex, highly regulated and subject to significant governance, change and compliance requirements. The CCM acts as a trusted commercial advisor, providing expert guidance on contract management, negotiations, governance, risk management and commercial strategy while ensuring Optus' interests are protected and customer commitments are successfully delivered.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Commercial Contract Management by owning and managing complex customer contracts end-to-end, ensuring contractual obligations, governance requirements, commercial outcomes and customer commitments are effectively delivered throughout the contract lifecycle.
  • Drive Contract Governance and Risk Management through the establishment of robust governance frameworks, proactive management of contractual, commercial and operational risks, and the provision of expert advice to support informed business decisions.
  • Draft, review and negotiate customer and supplier agreements, contract variations, Statements of Work, schedules and commercial amendments, ensuring contractual arrangements appropriately allocate risk, protect Optus' interests and support successful customer outcomes.
  • Manage Contract Changes and Commercial Negotiations by assessing, negotiating and implementing contract variations, Statements of Work and commercial amendments, while protecting contract value and minimising commercial risk.
  • Support Strategic Growth Opportunities by partnering with Sales, Delivery and Bid teams on new business pursuits, renewals and account expansion initiatives, providing commercial leadership, contractual expertise and negotiation support.
  • Optimise Commercial Performance and Supplier Outcomes by overseeing contract profitability, financial exposures, supplier agreements and back-to-back contracting arrangements to ensure customer commitments are met and business value is maximised.
  • Ensure Compliance, Reporting and Continuous Improvement through maintaining audit-ready contract records, overseeing compliance with regulatory and organisational requirements, delivering executive-level reporting, and driving best-practice contract management across the business.

What You Bring

  • Relevant Qualifications and Professional Expertise – Degree qualification in Business, Law, Commerce, Accounting, Engineering, or equivalent experience in a similar commercial role. Professional certifications in Contract Management, Commercial Management, Procurement, Law or related disciplines will be highly regarded.
  • Security Clearance Eligibility – Holds an appropriate Government Security Clearance (Baseline) or has the ability to obtain and maintain the required clearance to support work within Federal Government and security-sensitive customer environments.
  • Industry Experience – 7–15 years' experience in ICT, telecommunications, managed services, outsourcing, Federal Government or similarly regulated industries, with a strong understanding of complex commercial, contractual and operational environments.
  • Strong Commercial, Financial and Risk Acumen – Demonstrated ability to identify, assess and mitigate contractual, commercial and financial risks while driving value creation, margin improvement, commercial optimisation and revenue growth opportunities.
  • Advanced contract drafting, contract negotiation and commercial management capability, including demonstrated experience preparing and negotiating complex customer and supplier agreements with minimal legal support.
  • Advanced Negotiation and Stakeholder Management Skills – Proven success leading complex customer and supplier negotiations, contract variations, disputes and commercial discussions across Federal Government, ICT, telecommunications, managed services or other highly regulated industries.
  • Governance, Compliance and Contract Lifecycle Expertise – Strong experience managing contract governance frameworks, compliance obligations, audits, regulatory requirements and contract lifecycle activities, with the ability to implement best-practice processes and drive continuous improvement.

The good stuff….

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170. We're here to help.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.description:
