Demonstrates a proactive, self-service mindset with strong initiative, ownership, accountability, and resourcefulness. Independently investigates and solves problems using available tools, documentation, systems, and resources while understanding when escalation or additional support is appropriate.

Recognises personal capacity, workload constraints, and technical complexity and proactively seeks support before quality, safety, wellbeing, customer outcomes, or delivery are adversely affected.

Collaboration in a Matrix Environment

Experience working effectively within a global matrix organisation, collaborating across multiple functions, regions, teams, and reporting structures. Able to build alignment and influence outcomes through credibility, communication, and collaboration rather than direct authority.

Continuous Learning and Improvement

Demonstrates openness to feedback, coaching, continuous learning, and constructive conflict resolution. Willingly adopts new processes, tools, technologies, and ways of working and actively contributes ideas that improve operational effectiveness and support a high-performing team culture.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, position, and move IT equipment weighing 15 kg or more.
  • Comfortable working within data centre environments, including standing for extended periods, bending, reaching, and working in confined or restricted spaces.
  • Able to safely and efficiently perform rack and stack, hardware installation, cabling, component replacement, and equipment decommissioning activities.
  • Commitment to following relevant workplace health, safety, and operational procedures.
  • Valid drivers license and access to a car.

Security Requirements

Applicants must be Australian citizens and either:

  • Hold a current NV1 Security Clearance, or
  • Be eligible and willing to obtain NV1 clearance through the Australian Government security vetting process.

Why ORACLE?

Join a global technology leader operating some of the world's most advanced cloud infrastructure. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, solve challenging infrastructure problems, collaborate with talented professionals across a global organisation, and contribute directly to the reliability, availability, and performance of critical cloud services used by customers around the world.

You'll join an environment that values technical excellence, customer focus, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, continuous learning, safety, and continuous improvement.

If you're looking for your next challenge and want to develop your career in large-scale, mission-critical data centre and cloud infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the team powering ORACLE Cloud Infrastructure.

job.title: Lead Principal Advanced Services Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Serves as a trusted advisor to customers and technical expert on technologies across the marketplace to shape guidance provided to customers. Serves as a go-to technical expert with highly specialized knowledge across Oracle and non-Oracle technologies, products, services, and best practices. Leads organization-wide optimizations (e.g., automation) into solutions and technical delivery in coordination with the customer team. Acts as an internal and/or external expert point of contact and escalation point for critical technical and process issues and provides proactive and reactive technical assistance in close cooperation with Support and Product Development teams for problem analysis and investigation. Assists customers with highly complex software updates, upgrades, configuration, and incident remediation and educates and mentors junior engineers to educate customers on product features, upgrades, and best practices. Leads the scoping, creation, and maintenance of customer deliverables to help customers with solution implementation. Leads highly complex problem analysis and investigation, providing documented technical solutions ready for customers to implement, test, and maintain. Drives cross-functional solution alignment with technology strategy and business goals. Delivers presentations and acts as a technical expert and executive presence during presentations for junior engineers.

Responsibilities

Key

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership:

-Serves as a trusted advisor to customers and a technical expert on technologies across the marketplace (e.g., technical speaking engagements, publications) to shape guidance provided to customers.

  • Recognized as a technical expert with highly specialized knowledge across

Oracle and non-Oracle technologies, products, services, and market trends, serving as a go-to expert for complex or high-impact scenarios.

  • Defines or adjusts strategy for highly complex pre-sales activities,

contributing to long-term account growth and solution fit.

  • Leads organization-wide and customer fleet-wide optimizations or efficiency

efforts (e.g., automation, streamlined processes, elimination of redundant effort), coordinating with the TAM, ASE engineers and others on the Oracle customer team.

  • Works with external partners to ensure appropriate design and implementation

of solutions and promote best practices for technology deployment and workloads, and their stability, maintainability, upgradeability, and performance.

Service Delivery:

-Acts as internal and/or external expert point of contact and escalation point for critical technical and process issues encountered in the customer's supported environment.

  • Provides proactive and reactive remote or onsite technical assistance in close

cooperation with Support and Product Development teams, for problem analysis and investigation and providing and verifying workarounds and acting as a field point of contact for various LOBs.

  • Assists customers with highly complex software updates, upgrades, change

management, and incident remediation, identifying key risks and mitigation strategies that may impact project success.

  • Analyzes new and highly complex issues encountered by customers by performing

thorough technical root cause investigations.

  • Reviews themes across lessons learned post-project and leads changes to

improve technology implementation.

Global Customer Engagement & Education:

-Acts as expert technical lead for customers and partners with customer leadership to, ensuring solutions address business needs and drive long-term business transformation.

  • Educates and mentors junior engineers to educate customers on product

features, upgrades, and patches, and drives and shapes adoption of best practices for technology deployment and workloads, and their stability, maintainability, upgradeability, and performance.

  • Provides executive presence for junior team members during customer meetings

where technical expertise is required for critical or escalated issues or where expert technical direction is needed for key decisions.

  • Uses holistic view of solutions and contextual understanding of customer

solutions to influence customer direction.

Technical Design & Documentation:

-Leads the scoping, creation, and maintenance of customer deliverables, SOPs, and documentation to help customers implement solutions.

  • Leads highly complex problem analysis and investigation, providing documented

technical solutions ready for customers to implement, test and maintain.

  • Oversees how solution designs are developed across programs, ensuring the use

of appropriate methodologies and adherence to Oracle and enterprise architectural standards.

  • Scopes potential customer requests and clarify value-add for a service during

pre-sales.

  • Defines best practices and provides mentorship to engineers across multiple

teams.

  • Ensures technical designs are forward-looking, scalable, and aligned with

broader strategic direction.

  • Translates market trends into design strategies that prepare the business for

future growth.

Influence & Collaboration:

-Drives cross-functional alignment of internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with technology strategy and business goals, facilitating collaboration across multiple programs and senior stakeholders.

  • Identifies opportunities for expanding partnerships and with key contacts

across functions and creates opportunities to facilitate networking for lower levels.

  • Works with customer senior leadership to influences priorities based on

technical vision to support customer's technical roadmap.

Innovation & Business Development:

-Leverages customer insights and partners with product management to ensure alignment with technical ecosystem when driving new service offerings and engagement methods.

  • Leverages customer insights to shape new service offerings and engagement

methods.

  • Leads technical scoping in strategic deals, partnering with sales teams to

define the solution approach and ensure business needs are translated into viable technical deliverables.

  • Shapes growth opportunities by aligning Oracle solutions with customer

roadmaps and business drivers.

  • Delivers presentations and acts as a technical expert and executive presence

during presentations for junior team members and communicates details on integrated solutions that drive strategy.

  • Uses deep technical, functional, and service delivery expertise across

technologies to strategically influence customer perception of value.

Additional Responsibilities (as needed)

Technical Solution Design:

-Drives technical strategy and architecture across the organization, mentoring technical leaders and ensuring alignment with business goals using broad knowledge across multiple technologies/ services.

  • Oversees architectural and solution design reviews across programs, ensuring

technical excellence and mentoring senior engineers across technologies and services in scalable design principles.

  • Guides teams in applying consistent design practices aligned to current and

emerging business needs using expertise across multiple technologies/services.

  • Shapes and maintains architectural principles, introducing innovative

approaches and evolving design practices to remain competitive in a rapidly changing market.

  • Drives high-level design (HLD) development by introducing new methods across

technologies/services, promoting creativity, and ensuring solutions reflect a deep understanding of organizational technical operations.

  • Creates and establishes internal policies, processes, and standards for

security, scalability, and other product/service fundamentals related to solution delivery across a family of technologies or services at the organization or cross-organization level.

Delivery Program Management:

-Owns the planning, execution, and service value creation of delivery engineering projects across multiple customer accounts within a technical domain.

  • Leverages deep project management knowledge to scope delivery engineering

projects, design project schedules, and document resource requirements.

  • Manages technical delivery along with Technical Leader, coordinating resources

and managing projects to drive results and maximize value to customers.

  • Proactively partners with customers and other account team members (e.g., TAM,

Technical Leader) to understand customers' technical projects, goals, and KPIs, and provide required technical guidance to delivery engineering team.

  • Leverages domain expertise to lead escalation calls and assist in managing all

aspects of escalations, including situation management and executive communication.

  • Oversees the quality and completeness of deliverables across customers.

opportunities with customers.

Collaboration & Partnership:

-Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Continuous Improvement:

-Drives implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Seeks and integrates diverse feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.

Planning & Execution:

-Manages and provides direction on timelines and budgets for critical high-impact projects, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Problem Solving:

-Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for highly complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

-Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise within a specialty area to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

job.title: Lead Principal Application Software Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the application software development lifecycle; coaches engineers across teams or units to drive application-focused improvements. Acts as a subject matter expert within the organization to develop and guide new application features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify application design and code. Leads process, architecture, and code reviews across application projects and/or products/services to drive improvements. Utilizes modern/emerging technologies to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix highly complex application issues. Resolves and may troubleshoot highly complex and systemic issues requiring innovation related to application programming interface (API) functionality, integration, and service-to-service interactions. Leads task and project initiatives for the design and development of application software, systems, and services. Defines project or design scope; reviews, influences, and approves scope and design recommendations for application components and services. Collaborates with stakeholders internally and externally to lead efforts to understand customer use cases, root causes, and mitigations to align and explain rationale behind application solutions. Must provide expert technical guidance and support to customers regarding application-related issues to mitigate recurrence. Collaborates with the security team and leadership teams to establish, follow, and improve upon application development practices, secure coding standards, and code quality, providing coaching to less experienced team members. Leads project initiatives for periodic maintenance and testing operations for application systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Application Software Development:

  • Architects and delivers multi-team features and modernization initiatives with clear, organization-level KPIs.
  • Establishes global production-readiness standards (SLOs, error budgets, incident tooling) and drives adoption.
  • Diagnoses and resolves high-severity, multi-system failures; creates systemic reliability improvements across apps/OCI.
  • Harmonizes QA strategy across teams (test pyramids, non-functional testing) to ensure consistent app quality.
  • Makes significant architectural decisions; leads migrations and pattern adoptions with deprecation plans.
  • Creates scalable blueprints and reference implementations adopted by multiple teams.
  • Defines cross-team API governance and dependency management frameworks.
  • Shapes prioritization across multiple teams using data from field/customer, telemetry, and live-site signals.
  • Institutionalizes feedback loops into planning cadences; measures impact.
  • Mentors Staff engineers; partners with Product and Design to balance customer value and technical strategy.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

  • Leads project initiatives to design software solutions and identify and analyze requirements. Writes and defines foundational code for new projects or prototypes.
  • Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; coaches engineers across teams or units to drive improvements.
  • Acts as a subject matter expert within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
  • Leads process, architecture, and code reviews across projects and/or products/services to drive improvements.
  • Utilizes modern/emerging technologies to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix highly complex software issues.
  • Leads strategic initiatives to optimize software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
  • Encourages innovation, research, and relevant industry practices to optimize performance across products and domains.
  • Resolves and may troubleshoot highly complex and systematic issues requiring innovation related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
  • Implements innovative API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

  • Leads task and project initiatives for the design and development of software, systems, and services. Defines project or design scope; reviews, influences, and approves scope and design recommendations.
  • Provides technical guidance, domain expertise, and coaching in software architecture decisions and best practices that drive key organizational decisions, including industry standards and competitive considerations, providing mentorship and coaching for small teams and peers and contributing to both individual and team development across line of business/function.
  • Utilizes innovative methods to conduct highly complex periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders across lines of business and externally, to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities.
  • Implements innovative performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
  • Conducts regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements and translates into decisions and plans that can have a major impact on the organization.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

  • Collaborates with stakeholders internally and externally to lead efforts to understand customer issues, root causes, and mitigation to align and explain rationale behind solutions.
  • Must provide expert technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues to mitigate recurrence.
  • Acts as an advisor to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements and solutions based on feedback.
  • Networks across lines of business to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
  • Guides implementation of strategic solutions for customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.
  • Investigates and troubleshoots the most complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

  • Collaborates with the security team and leadership teams to establish, follow, and improve upon development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.
  • Participates in peer review processes and provides technical leadership with initiatives to ensure quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.
  • Demonstrates, contributes to, and shares deep expertise of industry best practices and their application to software development processes.
  • Implements highly complex secure software development practices/solutions requiring modern/emerging innovation to prevent security vulnerabilities, leveraging automated solutions to augment the manual review process.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

  • Leads project initiatives for periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
  • Acts as subject matter expert to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

  • Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements.
  • Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives.
  • Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success.
  • Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

  • Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues.
  • Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

  • Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization.
  • Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions).
  • Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices.
  • Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization.
  • Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.
  • Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

  • Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy.
  • Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

Qualifications

Career Level - IC5

job.description:
About the Role

At Oracle Health, we're transforming healthcare administration through Oracle Health Insurance (OHI), a cloud-native payer platform supporting enrollment, billing, benefits administration, provider payments, and claims adjudication.

As Oracle expands Oracle Health Insurance capabilities globally, including support for U.S. Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance programs, and AI-enabled claims processing, we're investing in engineers who are passionate about building the next generation of healthcare payer solutions.

As an IC3 Software Development Engineer, you will contribute to the design and development of scalable cloud services, healthcare business workflows, and AI-powered capabilities that improve operational efficiency for health plans and government programs.

Responsibilities

As a member of the software engineering division, you will assist in defining and developing software solutions associated with Oracle Health Insurance products. You will design, develop, test, and deploy software components while collaborating with cross-functional teams across product management, architecture, QA, and customer implementations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance OHI modules supporting enrollment, benefits, claims, and payments.
  • Build scalable microservices and APIs supporting payer workflows.
  • Contribute to healthcare payer platform capabilities and country-specific configurations.
  • Participate in AI and automation initiatives leveraging LLMs and agent-based solutions.
  • Develop integrations using healthcare standards and EDI transactions.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-quality software.

  • BS/MS in Computer Science or related field.
  • 3–7 years of software engineering experience.
  • Strong programming skills in Java and/or Python.
  • Experience with REST APIs and distributed systems.
  • Strong SQL and database fundamentals.
  • Experience with cloud technologies (OCI, AWS, or Azure).
  • Knowledge of software design patterns and object-oriented design.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted software development tools and modern developer productivity technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare payer domain knowledge.
  • Exposure to claims processing, enrollment, benefits administration, or provider payments.
  • Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, or commercial insurance workflows.
  • Experience with EDI transactions (837, 834, 835).

job.title: Data Center Technician
job.description:
Job Description

Are you an experienced Data Centre Technician with a background in racking & stacking to deployment & decommissioning – and everything in between? Interested in new challenges and being part of a team working on critical projects? Then we’d like to talk to you!

As an Oracle Data Centre Technician you will be the technical liaison between the technology teams and the Data Centre Environment. You will be able to troubleshoot and solve all but the most complex infrastructure issues. As a skilled troubleshooter across a wide range of Data Centre environments and systems, you understand which issues should be escalated to the appropriate resolver groups.

You create and maintain documentation on the technologies you support. You understand all aspects of the equipment you support. You know how to innovate and make decisions on your own, but also know how to take direction when it is given, paying attention to all details involved. You will be expected to improve current processes and introduce automation with an aim towards simplification.

Responsibilities

Following are some of the responsibilities and requirements of the role:

  • Previous experience working in a Data Centre environment.
  • Review and action incoming and open tickets, prioritising work based on ticket severity.
  • Participate in the installation, monitoring, maintenance, support, and optimisation of all production server hardware and software.
  • Provide escalated second-level technical support for complex issues, which may include leading problem management cases and providing management updates.
  • Communicate confidently and clearly with all stakeholders.
  • Maintain strong adherence to processes and act as a process champion.
  • Understand internal customer problems and deliver timely technical solutions.
  • Work on a 24/7 rotating shift basis, including on-call support.
  • Background in Linux.
  • Knowledge of Data Centre Ecosystem (cooling, electrical, networking, and structured cabling).
  • Applicants must be an Australian citizen and either hold NV1 clearance or be eligible to undergo the vetting process.

job.title: Senior Security Engineer - Architecture
job.description:
About us

We’re growing, not slowing, here at Macquarie Technology Group because we’re passionate about doing things differently. We want to challenge the industry and look for better ways of doing things. As a team, Macquarie Government are hardworking, results and success focused. We also take the time to celebrate our success and make sure our people are doing work that makes a difference.

We believe that collaboration & team connection is key for success. This role will be based in Sydney with a blended working arrangement of 3 days in our CBD offices & the remaining working from home. #LI-Hybrid

We require security clearance for this role, you must be an Australian citizen to be eligible to obtain a security clearance.

The Opportunity

Are you a Security Engineer who thrives on building and enhancing cyber security solutions that protect critical Australian Government environments?

As a Senior Security Engineer - Architecture, you'll play a key role in designing, implementing and optimising security services across Macquarie Government's Secure Internet Gateway (SIG) and managed cyber security environments. Working alongside a highly skilled cyber team, you'll leverage technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk to strengthen detection and response capabilities, deliver security outcomes for customers and drive continuous improvement across our security platforms. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex government environments while influencing the future direction of our cyber security services.

Are you a Security Engineer who thrives on building and enhancing cyber security solutions that protect critical Australian Government environments?

As a Senior Security Engineer - Architecture, you'll play a key role in designing, implementing and optimising security services across Macquarie Government's Secure Internet Gateway (SIG) and managed cyber security environments. Working alongside a highly skilled cyber team, you'll leverage technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk to strengthen detection and response capabilities, deliver security outcomes for customers and drive continuous improvement across our security platforms. This role offers the opportunity to work on complex government environments while influencing the future direction of our cyber security services.

Why Us?

  • We're Australia's Great Place to Work 2025 certified for 3 years in a row.
  • For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award!
  • Over 42% of Australian government agencies use and trust us. They depend on us to protect them from private and state-sponsored cyber attackers.
  • We have the highest Net Promoter Score on the ASX, the [World's best customer experience](https://www.businessthink.unsw.edu.au/articles/macquarie-telecom-tudehope-customer-experience) & [crowned in 2020 at the World Communications Awards](https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/BU2010/S00476/macquarie-telecom-group-wins-best-customer-experience-in-the-world.htm).
  • You’ll make an impact: Enjoy being part of a driven team with a collaborative culture that values decision-makers and action.
  • We Invest in you: Accelerate your career through our learning and development opportunities - think Gallup strengths-based training, defined career pathways and fantastic internal mobility opportunities across the group.
  • A dynamic and supportive team that values smart thinking.
  • A workplace where your business insights are celebrated.

What you'll be doing.

  • Design, implement and support cyber security solutions for Australian Government customers.
  • Lead customer onboarding and implementation activities, including solution design and technical documentation.
  • Build, configure and optimise Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk environments.
  • Develop and tune security detections, analytics rules, dashboards and reporting capabilities.
  • Investigate cyber threats, identify trends and implement preventative security controls.
  • Support and enhance Secure Internet Gateway (SIG) infrastructure and managed security services.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations, Infrastructure and Customer Success teams to deliver exceptional outcomes.
  • Drive automation, process improvements and operational efficiencies through scripting and orchestration technologies.
  • Provide technical guidance and escalation support for complex security incidents and customer enquiries.

About You.

  • 3+ years' experience in Security Engineering, Security Operations or SIEM environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel and/or Splunk.
  • Advanced Kusto Query Language (KQL) skills and/ or Splunk SPL.
  • Experience developing and tuning SIEM detections, analytics rules and threat hunting use cases.
  • Solid understanding of security operations, incident response and cyber threat detection.
  • Strong knowledge of networking fundamentals, firewalls and security architecture principles.
  • Understanding of log collection technologies including syslog and security telemetry.
  • Experience working within environments aligned to Essential Eight, ISM or similar security frameworks.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to analyse and interpret large volumes of security data.
  • Excellent communication skills with a customer-focused mindset.

Nice to Have.

  • SC-100, SC-200, AZ-500 or equivalent security certifications.
  • Splunk Enterprise Security certification.
  • Experience with SOAR platforms and security automation.
  • Scripting experience with Python, Bash or similar languages.
  • Experience working within Federal Government or highly regulated environments.
  • Current NV1 Security Clearance.

If this excites you, apply now, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Cyber Security Architect
job.description:
About Us

At Macquarie Cloud Services, our people are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’re proud to be Australia’s #1 Great Place to Work in Technology for 2026, Australia’s #1 Great Place to Work for two consecutive years, and Great Place to Work Certified for three years running.

Macquarie Cloud Services are the Australian specialists in cloud services for business and government. Locally owned and operated, with an industry-leading customer service model, we’re trusted by our customers to provide the services that enable their business success.

We have made it our challenge to make our people feel good and love the work they do. Because of this, our people are energised and motivated in their work.

The Opportunity.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining and evolving the technology, platforms, use cases and processes that power Macquarie Cloud Services' Security Operations Centre (SOC). As the Cyber Security Architect, you will provide the technical vision and leadership that enables our SOC to detect, respond to and remediate cyber threats at scale across a diverse customer base.

You will act as the technical authority across our Managed Security Practice, guiding security analysts, engineers and stakeholders while continuously improving our managed security services. Working closely with Product, Operations and Engineering teams, you will help shape our security strategy, evaluate emerging threats, design new capabilities and ensure our customers remain protected in an ever-evolving threat landscape.

You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on technical leadership, contributing to architecture, detection engineering, threat management, security automation and service innovation. Whether developing new security use cases, evaluating Microsoft security technologies or mentoring the next generation of security professionals, you'll play a key role in strengthening Macquarie's position as a leader in managed security services.

The Opportunity.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining and evolving the technology, platforms, use cases and processes that power Macquarie Cloud Services' Security Operations Centre (SOC). As the Cyber Security Architect, you will provide the technical vision and leadership that enables our SOC to detect, respond to and remediate cyber threats at scale across a diverse customer base.

You will act as the technical authority across our Managed Security Practice, guiding security analysts, engineers and stakeholders while continuously improving our managed security services. Working closely with Product, Operations and Engineering teams, you will help shape our security strategy, evaluate emerging threats, design new capabilities and ensure our customers remain protected in an ever-evolving threat landscape.

You'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on technical leadership, contributing to architecture, detection engineering, threat management, security automation and service innovation. Whether developing new security use cases, evaluating Microsoft security technologies or mentoring the next generation of security professionals, you'll play a key role in strengthening Macquarie's position as a leader in managed security services.

Why Us?

Australia's #1 [Great Place To Work](https://www.linkedin.com/company/great-place-to-work-us/) in Technology, 2026. We have been awarded Australia's #1 Great Place to Work 2025 for the second year running! We're Great Place to Work Certified 2023, 2024 and 2025. For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award! We're the #1 Managed Services Cloud business in Australia. We have the highest Net Promoter Score on the ASX, the [World's best customer experience](https://www.businessthink.unsw.edu.au/articles/macquarie-telecom-tudehope-customer-experience) & [crowned in 2020 at the World Communications Awards](https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/BU2010/S00476/macquarie-telecom-group-wins-best-customer-experience-in-the-world.htm). You’ll make an impact: Enjoy being part of a driven team with a collaborative culture that values decision-makers and action. We Invest in you: Accelerate your career through our learning and development opportunities - think Gallup strengths-based training, defined career pathways and fantastic internal mobility opportunities across the group.

What you’ll be doing.

  • Define the strategy, technology roadmap, platforms and operational processes that underpin Macquarie's Security Operations Centre (SOC).
  • Design and evolve managed security services including SIEM-as-a-Service, Extended Detection & Response (XDR), Global Secure Access and Microsoft Security solutions.
  • Act as the technical authority for the Microsoft Security stack, including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, Entra ID and Zero Trust architectures.
  • Design, enhance and continuously improve security use cases, detections, dashboards, playbooks and response workflows to improve threat detection, response and operational effectiveness.
  • Provide guidance to customers on security strategy, cyber maturity and security framework alignment, including the ACSC Essential Eight, NIST, ISM and ISO27001.
  • Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance to SOC analysts, security engineers and other technical stakeholders.
  • Evaluate emerging threats, vulnerabilities and security advisories, assessing the impact on customer environments and recommending mitigation strategies.
  • Drive continuous improvement across security monitoring, threat detection, automation and incident response through innovation and operational excellence.
  • Support customer engagements, technical workshops, solution design discussions and strategic security conversations.
  • Collaborate with Product, Operations and Engineering teams to shape the future direction of Macquarie's Managed Security Practice.
  • Mentor and develop team members, fostering a culture of learning, innovation and technical excellence.

Required Skills and Experience.

  • Significant experience in Cyber Security Architecture, Security Engineering or a senior technical security leadership role.
  • Strong architecture and solution design experience across enterprise, MSP, consulting or vendor environments.
  • Deep expertise across the Microsoft Security stack, including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, Entra ID, Global Secure Access and Zero Trust principles.
  • Strong hands-on experience building and optimising Microsoft Sentinel detections, analytics rules, workbooks, automation and SOC processes.
  • Strong understanding of Security Operations Centre (SOC) design, detection engineering, threat management and security operations processes.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise SIEM platforms and modern security operations practices.
  • Experience designing security use cases, response playbooks, automation opportunities and operational frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of cyber threats, adversary tactics and security frameworks including ACSC Essential Eight, NIST, ISO27001, ISM, SABSA or TOGAF.
  • In-depth networking knowledge across Layers 3-7, including protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS and SMTP.
  • Experience with scripting, automation and analytics technologies including KQL, Python, PowerShell or similar.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A passion for Cyber Security, innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Proven ability to mentor and uplift technical teams within a high-performing environment.
  • Australian Citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain an NV1 Security Clearance.

If this excites you, apply now, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: SitecoreAI Content and Personalization Specialist
job.description:
SitecoreAI Content and Personalization Specialist

Position Overview

Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced SitecoreAI Content and Personalization Specialist to join our Global Marketing IT team. This role will be responsible for driving enterprise content operations, digital asset management, AI-powered content optimization, personalization, and experimentation across the global Sitecore ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Sitecore Content Hub, Sitecore AI, Sitecore XM Cloud, and Sitecore Personalize, with proven experience designing and executing content strategies that enable scalable omnichannel experiences. This individual will partner with business, marketing, analytics, and technology teams to ensure content is structured, governed, optimized, and activated effectively across customer journeys.

A key objective of this role is to leverage Sitecore AI and Content Hub capabilities to improve content discoverability, automate content operations, enhance personalization, accelerate content production, and drive measurable business outcomes through testing and optimization.

Key Responsibilities

Sitecore AI Enablement

  • Leverage Sitecore AI capabilities to improve content creation, optimization, classification, tagging, and asset enrichment.
  • Define and implement AI-assisted content workflows that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Utilize AI-driven insights to identify content gaps, optimization opportunities, and personalization strategies.
  • Support AI-powered content recommendations and customer experience optimization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with marketing teams to operationalize AI-enhanced content generation while ensuring governance and brand compliance.
  • Evaluate and implement emerging Sitecore AI capabilities and best practices across the enterprise.

Sitecore Content Hub Leadership

  • Serve as the subject matter expert for Sitecore Content Hub DAM, CMP, and Content Operations capabilities.
  • Design and manage enterprise content taxonomies, metadata models, content schemas, and governance frameworks.
  • Establish and maintain content lifecycle processes including creation, review, approval, publication, archival, and compliance.
  • Drive adoption of Content Hub as the central source of truth for digital assets and marketing content.
  • Configure and optimize Content Hub workflows, governance policies, permissions, and content approval processes.
  • Lead metadata standardization, asset classification, tagging, and content discoverability initiatives.
  • Support Content Hub integrations with XM Cloud, personalization platforms, analytics solutions, and downstream marketing channels.
  • Drive content reuse and content modularization strategies to support omnichannel delivery and composable architecture.

Personalization & Customer Experience Optimization

  • Design, implement, and optimize content experiences using Sitecore Personalize.
  • Define personalization strategies based on audience segments, behavioral data, customer journeys, and engagement metrics.
  • Partner with analytics teams to create audience targeting rules and content decisioning frameworks.
  • Enable dynamic content delivery based on customer preferences, geography, product interests, lifecycle stage, and behavioral signals.
  • Develop and maintain personalization governance and measurement frameworks.
  • Monitor personalized experiences and continuously optimize outcomes based on data-driven insights.

A/B Testing & Experimentation

  • Lead digital experimentation strategies across web experiences and customer journeys.
  • Design and execute A/B tests, multivariate tests, content experiments, and personalization experiments using Sitecore capabilities.
  • Define hypotheses, success metrics, statistical requirements, and reporting methodologies.
  • Analyze experiment results and provide actionable recommendations to improve engagement, conversions, and customer experience.
  • Establish best practices for testing, optimization, and experimentation governance.
  • Collaborate with UX, Digital Marketing, Product, and Analytics teams to prioritize and execute testing roadmaps.

Content Strategy & Governance

  • Define enterprise content architecture and reusable content models supporting XM Cloud and composable DXP initiatives.
  • Establish best practices for content structure, SEO, accessibility, localization, and omnichannel publishing.
  • Drive content quality assessment and optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment between content strategy, customer journeys, personalization objectives, and business goals.
  • Maintain governance standards for metadata, taxonomy, tagging, content ownership, and lifecycle management.

Required Qualifications

Must-Have Experience

  • 8+ years of hands-on Sitecore experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Sitecore Content Hub (DAM/CMP) administration, implementation, or content operations.
  • Strong experience with Sitecore AI capabilities and AI-driven content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with Sitecore Personalize.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing A/B testing and experimentation programs.
  • Strong understanding of customer journey mapping, audience segmentation, and content personalization.
  • Experience creating and managing enterprise taxonomies, metadata structures, and content governance frameworks.
  • Experience with content modeling and reusable content design in Sitecore XM Cloud.
  • Deep understanding of composable architecture and omnichannel content delivery.
  • Experience working closely with marketing, content authors, product teams, UX teams, and analytics teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline
  • Experience with Sitecore Search and content discovery capabilities.
  • Experience with CDP, customer data platforms, and audience activation use cases.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted content operations and content supply chain initiatives.
  • Knowledge of digital analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or similar tools.
  • Familiarity with SEO, accessibility, localization, and global content management practices.

Top Mandatory Skills (Screening Criteria)

  • Sitecore Content Hub (DAM + CMP)
  • Sitecore AI & Personalize
  • Content Personalization Strategy
  • A/B Testing & Experimentation
  • Content Taxonomy & Metadata Management
  • Content Governance
  • Omnichannel Content Operations
  • Analytics-Driven Content Optimization

Preferred Certifications

  • Sitecore Content Hub Certification
  • Sitecore XM Cloud Certification
  • Sitecore Personalize Certification
  • Sitecore Experience Platform Certification
  • AI or Generative AI related certifications

job.title: Account Manager (Building Solutions)
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Smart Building Technologies, Fire Protection & Sustainable Solutions

At Johnson Controls, we're transforming the way buildings perform. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers enhance safety, optimise energy use, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain critical infrastructure across industries including healthcare, education, commercial facilities, manufacturing, and government sectors.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry expertise, Johnson Controls combines leading technology with world-class service delivery to create smarter, safer, and more sustainable environments. Our people are at the centre of our success, and we're committed to providing opportunities for growth, development, and long-term career success.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

As part of a global organisation, you'll have the opportunity to work with some of the industry's most experienced professionals while managing a diverse portfolio of customers across Sydney and NSW. This role offers autonomy, strong earning potential, and genuine career progression within a market-leading business.

What we offer:

  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Competitive salary package + superannuation
  • Car allowance
  • Attractive incentive program
  • Supportive team culture and industry-leading training
  • Career development opportunities within a global organisation

About the Role

As an Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of existing customers while identifying new business opportunities across our service offerings. You will partner closely with customers to understand their operational needs and deliver tailored solutions across Building Management Systems (BMS), HVAC, Fire, Security, and related building services.

Your focus will be on building trusted customer relationships, driving recurring service revenue, increasing account penetration, and delivering long-term value to both customers and the business.

Key Responsibilities

Account Management & Customer Success

  • Manage and develop strategic relationships across an assigned customer portfolio.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring a high level of service, engagement, and satisfaction.
  • Conduct regular account reviews to identify opportunities for improvement, renewal, and growth.
  • Develop a strong understanding of customer operations, objectives, and future requirements.

Business Development & Growth

  • Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities within existing and prospective accounts.
  • Drive growth in recurring service agreements and project-based opportunities.
  • Develop and implement account plans to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to deliver comprehensive solutions that meet customer needs.

Solution Selling

  • Engage customers through a consultative sales approach to identify challenges and recommend value-driven solutions.
  • Prepare proposals, quotations, and presentations aligned to customer requirements.
  • Support contract negotiations and successful commercial outcomes.

Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate closely with service technicians, operations teams, project managers, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of customer commitments.
  • Maintain regular communication with customers regarding service performance, project updates, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Market Engagement

  • Build and maintain a strong industry network across facilities management, property, healthcare, education, commercial, and industrial sectors.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify emerging opportunities.

About You

You are a customer-focused and commercially driven professional who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and driving business growth.

You will bring:

  • Proven experience in Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or Customer Relationship Management.
  • Strong knowledge of Building Management Systems (BMS), HVAC, Fire, Security, Building Services, or related technical industries is highly regarded.
  • A track record of achieving sales targets and growing customer accounts.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to identify growth opportunities.
  • A consultative and solutions-focused approach to customer engagement.
  • Ability to build credibility with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and results-oriented.
  • An established network within the Sydney building services, facilities management, construction, property, or infrastructure sectors will be highly advantageous.

Compliance Requirements

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet.   • Competitive salary

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. Maintain project quality, on time delivery and manage escalations.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Provides coaching and professional development to team members in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills to bridge the gap.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.

  • Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.),Blue Beam.
  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

3 to 8 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System.

job.title: Senior Manager – AMC Sales (CFS & IBMS))
job.description:
Who we are?

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

Why JCI: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nrbigjbpxkg)

Asia-Pacific LinkedIn: [https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all)

Career: [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue: [This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What will you do?

Business Development

  • Identify and target potential clients for AMC sales across multiple industry verticals.
  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of prospects through networking, referrals, cold calling, and cross-selling activities.
  • Collaborate with inside sales teams to build a strong sales funnel and drive opportunity conversion.
  • Generate new business opportunities while expanding existing customer accounts.

Sales & Negotiation

  • Prepare customized proposals, quotations, and commercial agreements based on customer requirements.
  • Negotiate contract terms and close deals to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
  • Present and demonstrate IBMS AMC solutions and service offerings to prospective customers.
  • Ensure accurate sales forecasting and pipeline management.

###

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customer stakeholders.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for AMC customers throughout the sales and onboarding process.
  • Drive contract renewals and identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities.
  • Ensure high customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and support.

Market Intelligence & Strategy

  • Monitor industry trends, market developments, and competitor offerings.
  • Analyze customer requirements and tailor AMC proposals to meet operational and commercial needs.
  • Develop strategies to recover lost accounts and strengthen customer retention.
  • Provide market insights and feedback to support business growth initiatives.

Collaboration & Execution

  • Work closely with service delivery teams to ensure commitments made during the sales process are fulfilled.
  • Coordinate with technical and operations teams to align AMC solutions with service capabilities.
  • Support seamless customer onboarding and handover processes.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration to enhance service quality and customer experience.

What we look for?

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • 5-10 years of experience in B2B sales, AMC sales, facility management services, building management systems, or related service industries.
  • Proven track record in business development, customer acquisition, and contract negotiations.
  • Strong understanding of AMC business models, service contracts, and customer lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems and sales reporting tools.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents.

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

  • Mentor and guide junior team members in SAP MDG and DevOps methodologies.
  • Stay updated with the latest SAP technologies and industry trends.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Proficiency in DevOps tools and methodologies, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud services.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and leadership abilities.

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Power Platform Developer with 3-5 years of experience in designing, building, deploying, and maintaining enterprise-grade Power Platform solutions that combine apps, automations, data, and conversational AI to solve real business problems.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven, Code Apps) ​, Power Automate Flow, Power Automate Desktop, Copilot studio, AI-powered agent development, Dataverse, Integration with Microsoft 365 and external data sources.

  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs, collaborate with stakeholders, perform testing and optimization, and support deployment across environments while adhering to governance, security, and Responsible AI principles

job.title: IT Tech Analyst II
job.description:
What you will do:

· Assess entirety of Johnson Controls' internal and external attack surfaces, with special focus on assessing exposure of Johnson Controls' assets to vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and other findings.

· Maintain vulnerability management and external attack surface platforms for both Product and Corporate teams, including defining scan schedules, analyzing agent deployments and coverage gaps, building reports, and creating dashboards, etc.

· Partner with operational teams to identify, prioritize, and communicate vulnerability details.

· Support various audits by ensuring adherence to documented process and providing supporting data as needed

· Periodically assess security policies, standards, baselines, procedures, and metrics to drive improvements that help Johnson Controls adapt to evolving regulatory, customer, and threat environments.

How you will do it:

· Exhibit knowledge in various exposure and vulnerability management platforms and concepts

· Establish relationships with operational stakeholders by assisting teams with vulnerability data, prioritization rationale, guidance on remediation steps, etc.

· Prepare stakeholder prioritization reports and data ahead of scheduled touchpoints. Ensure all relevant data is posted for archival. Participate in stakeholder meetings with focus on note taking and recording action items for follow-up.

· Lead emerging threat review process, monitoring for newly announced vulnerabilities and assessing impact to JCI with immediacy.

· Support audits by providing supporting data as needed

· Periodically assess security policies, standards, baselines, procedures, and metrics to drive improvements that help Johnson Controls adapt to evolving regulatory, customer, and threat environments.

What we look for:

· 2+ years of professional experience; Cyber security or Vulnerability management experience a plus

· Ability to follow and manage previously built, well-documented processes

· Attention to detail, ensuring that all necessary documentation/ artifacts are preserved to support audits

· Effective communication skills; focusing on delivering potentially complex technical details to non-technical stakeholders

· Ability to learn new tools and concepts quickly

· Demonstrated problem-solving skills to analyze customer cyber issues and requirements (regulatory, policy, customer, industry standard) and link to appropriate security controls.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.
