  • You will follow agile ways of working, communicate progress clearly, and raise risks early when support is needed.
  • You will use code reviews, testing, and automation to keep standards high and releases dependable.
  • You will approach troubleshooting methodically, using data and root-cause analysis to resolve issues quickly.

Qualifications

  • 5-9 years of professional experience in backend software development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience designing and building RESTful services and microservices.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases, SQL, and query optimization.
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes in development or deployment workflows.
  • Good understanding of Linux or Ubuntu-based environments.
  • Experience with code reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to work effectively in an Agile or Scrum environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Exposure to performance tuning and scalability improvements in high-volume applications.
  • Experience with legacy code modernization or SaaS application development.
  • Python scripting experience for automation or support tasks.

job.title: Oracle EBS R12 Projects Functional Consultant
job.description:
Oracle EBS R12 Order Management Techno-Functional Consultant

Application Management / ERP Order Management

Experience Level: 6+ years total IT experience, including 6+ years hands-on in Oracle EBS R12 Order Management techno-functional roles, with demonstrated experience as a technical/functional escalation point:

About the Role

We are looking for an Oracle EBS R12 Order Management Techno-Functional Consultant to own both sides of our order-to-cash ERP landscape: translating business requirements into sound functional design across Order Management and building or troubleshooting the technical components — PL/SQL, interfaces, reports, and personalization — that make that design work in production. This is a senior role: day-to-day ticket resolution sits with the support team, and you act as their escalation point and mentor for hard-to-resolve issues, stepping in personally only in exceptional cases.

Key Responsibilities

Functional

  • Serve as subject matter expert across Oracle EBS R12 Order Management and the broader order-to-cash cycle: order entry, pricing, scheduling, shipping, and invoicing interfaces to Receivables.
  • Gather and document business requirements; perform gap analysis between standard Oracle functionality and business needs; propose and design solutions.
  • Configure and customize Order Management setups: order types, pricing rules, workflow assignments, and shipping/scheduling rules.
  • Lead or support full-cycle implementations and rollouts of Order Management functionality.
  • Partner with Inventory, Shipping/Warehouse, Pricing, and Finance (Receivables) teams to ensure end-to-end order-to-cash process integrity.

##

Technical

  • Develop and maintain PL/SQL packages, procedures, and functions supporting Order Management interfaces, conversions, and custom reports.
  • Build and troubleshoot inbound/outbound interfaces (Order Import, Open Interfaces, APIs) between Oracle EBS and third-party or upstream systems (e.g., EDI, webstore, warehouse management).
  • Design and maintain custom reports using XML/BI Publisher or Oracle Reports; build and modify Forms Personalization and OAF extensions where needed.
  • Configure and extend Oracle Workflow Builder for order processing, hold/release logic, and approval routing.
  • Write SQL scripts of low-to-high complexity for data extraction, reconciliation, and analysis.
  • Develop source-to-target data mapping and execute data migration/conversion into or out of Order Management.

##

Support & Delivery

  • Act as the escalation point for the support team on hard-to-resolve Order Management issues: guide root-cause analysis, review proposed fixes, and unblock the team when standard troubleshooting stalls.
  • Step in personally to resolve issues directly in exceptional cases — critical/complex defects the support team cannot close on its own.
  • Provide technical and functional guidance to end users on third-party interface issues and data integrity questions raised by the support team.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of configurations, customizations, and troubleshooting procedures; contribute to a shared knowledge base.
  • Develop and deliver end-user training materials and sessions on Order Management and any custom functionality.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve application performance, process efficiency, and user experience; help scope and deliver enhancements.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior consultants.

#

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Supply Chain, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of overall Oracle EBS experience, with 10+ years focused on R12 Order Management in a techno-functional capacity.
  • Prior experience acting as a technical/functional escalation lead or mentor for a support team — not just as an individual contributor resolving own tickets.
  • Strong functional grounding in order-to-cash processes, and hands-on configuration experience in Order Management, pricing, and shipping/scheduling.
  • Demonstrated technical skills: PL/SQL development, SQL scripting, and at least one of Forms Personalization, OAF, XML/BI Publisher, or Workflow Builder.
  • Experience building or supporting EBS interfaces, conversions, or custom extensions in a production environment.
  • Solid understanding of Oracle EBS functional and technical architecture.
  • Working knowledge of adjacent EBS modules such as Inventory, Pricing, and Receivables, and how they integrate with Order Management.
  • Strong business requirements analysis, gap identification, and solution design skills.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; strong cross-functional communication skills for working with both business users and technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Order Management certification (R12 or 11i).
  • Exposure to Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM/Order Management, or active participation in an EBS-to-Fusion migration.
  • Experience with SDLC/Agile delivery methods and standard project/ticket tracking tools (e.g., Jira).
  • Prior experience in a shared-services or multinational corporate IT environment.

job.title: Baan Functional Consultant
job.description:
Job Title: Baan Finance Consultant – Baan ERPs

Experience: 8+ years in Finance modules in Baan IV, ERP LN FP3 and LN 10.4 ERP versions.

Job Description: We are seeking an experienced Baan ERP Finance Specialist to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in all Baan ERP Finance sub modules with strong knowledge on one or more ERP Finance functional modules and a strong background in application development, deployment and production support processes. Candidate should have experience in Baan IV, ERP LN FP3 and LN 10.4 ERP versions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Subject Matter Expertise: Deep understanding and experience with Baan ERP Finance modules (General Ledger and Fixed Assets).
  • Application Support: Leading Production support for Baan Finance modules. Identifying and resolving complex issues while providing support to end users on Baan applications. Provide support for third-party interfaces and ensure data integrity.
  • Troubleshooting: Identifying and resolving issues related to Baan Finance modules. Identify root causes of problems and implement effective solutions.
  • User support: Providing technical support to end users on Baan ERP applications, addressing queries and resolving issues.
  • Training: Developing and delivering training materials and sessions for end-users on Baan Finance modules.
  • Knowledge Management: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of system configurations, processes, and troubleshooting procedures. Contribute to the development and maintenance of a knowledge base for easy access to information.
  • Collaboration: Collaborating with clients, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure smooth application management.
  • Data Analysis: Develop simple to medium complexity SQL scripts to extract ERP data for analysis.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities for improvement in application performance, processes, and user experience. Participate in the development and implementation of new enhancements.
  • Business Requirements Analysis: Understanding client's business processes and identifying areas for improvement using Baan Finance modules. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and document business requirements.
  • Solution Design: Designing and configuring Baan Finance solutions to meet specific business needs.
  • Module Configuration: Configuring and customizing Baan Finance modules.
  • Implementation: Participating in implementations of Baan Finance modules.
  • Data Migration: Develop Source to Target ERP mapping from or to Baan Finance modules.
  • Mentoring: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Information Technology (or) Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related degree.
  • 8+ years of experience working with Baan ERP application versions with focus on Finance module.
  • Strong understanding of financial processes and accounting principles.
  • Strong understanding of General Ledger and Fixed Assets modules.
  • Good understanding of Accounts Receivables, Accounts Payables and Cash Management.
  • Proficient in Business requirement analysis, Gap identification, Solution proposals and Design development.
  • Understanding of Baan functional architecture.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities to work with functional teams and business users.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experienced with SDLC/Agile methodologies and project management tools.

job.title: Sr. Application Engineer I
job.description:
Job Description

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. Maintain project quality, on time delivery and manage escalations.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Provides coaching and professional development to team members in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills to bridge the gap.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System
  • Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.),Blue Beam.
  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

2 to 8 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System.

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou)

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Provides coaching and professional development to team members in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills to bridge the gap.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System
  • Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.),Blue Beam.
  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

2 to 8 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System.

job.title: OTC Controller
job.description:
Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

Role Summary • The OTC (Order-to-Cash) Leader will be responsible for leading end-to-end revenue cycle operations for UK and US entities, ensuring accurate, compliant, and efficient execution across customer onboarding, billing, collections, and cash application. The role will drive working capital improvement, process standardization, and governance, while partnering with global stakeholders across Finance, Sales, and Operations.

What you till do

  • End-to-End OTC Operations Leadership • Lead the full OTC lifecycle including: o Customer master data governance o Order management and invoicing o Credit management o Collections and dispute resolution o Cash application and reconciliation • Ensure adherence to standardized global processes across UK & US customer portfolios
  • Working Capital & AR Management • Drive DSO reduction, overdue collections, and cash flow optimization • Conduct regular reviews of: o Aged receivables o Bad debt provisions o Collection effectiveness metrics • Implement structured escalation mechanisms for delinquent accounts
  • Controls, Compliance & SOX Governance • Ensure strong internal controls across OTC processes: o Segregation of duties (SoD) o Approval workflows for pricing, credit notes, and master data changes o Audit trails and documentation • Own audit readiness for internal/external audits and remediation of control gaps
  • Stakeholder Management (UK & US) • Act as primary finance partner to: o UK & US business leaders o Sales, Operations, and Customer Success teams • Align on billing accuracy, dispute resolution, and customer experience improvements • Provide regular reporting and insights to global finance leadership 5. Process Transformation & Optimization • Drive continuous improvement initiatives including: o Automation (billing, cash application, collections tools) o ERP optimization (Sage Intact) o Standardization of global OTC processes • Lead transitions / migrations
  • Team Leadership & Capability Building • Build and lead a high-performing India-based OTC team • Define clear roles, KPIs, and performance metrics • Drive capability development across collections, billing, and analytics • Foster a culture of accountability, quality, and customer orientation
  • Revenue Assurance & Reporting • Ensure accurate revenue recognition in line with accounting standards • Partner with FP&A and controllership on: o Month-end close o Revenue reporting o Variance analysis • Maintain robust reconciliation between sub-ledger (AR) and GL

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) • DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) • % Overdue AR / Aging profile • Cash collection vs target • Billing accuracy / First-pass yield • Dispute resolution cycle time • Audit findings / control effectiveness

Skills & Qualifications Education & Experience • CA (Mandatory) • 8–12+ years of experience in OTC / AR / Finance Operations • Proven experience managing global OTC operations (US / UK markets preferred) • Experience in Shared Services / Global Capability Centers (GCC) Functional Competencies • Strong knowledge of: o Order-to-Cash cycle o Revenue recognition o SOX / internal controls • Strong data analytics and reporting capability Leadership & Behavioral Skills • Strong stakeholder management (global teams) • Ability to drive transformation and change • Strong communication and executive presence Preferred Experience • Experience in transitioning OTC operations to India • Exposure to digital / SaaS / recurring revenue models Reporting Line • Reports to: Finance Director • Direct Reports: AR, Billing, Collections, Cash Application teams Location • Commerzone Office (Yerwada, Pune )India, supporting UK & US time zones

job.title: Manager/Sr. Manager – CFS Service Sales
job.description:
Who we are?

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

Job Summary

As a Manager/Sr. Manager – CFS Service Sales, you will be responsible for driving service sales across West India for Controls (BMS), Fire Detection & Suppression, and Security Systems. You will collaborate with internal teams and customers to deliver tailored solutions, meet sales targets, and grow our service business.

What will you do?

  • Lead service sales for systems including Access Control, CCTV, Fire Detection (Conventional/Addressable), BMS, Fire Suppression (Gas-based), VESDA, Water Leak Detection, Rodent Repellent, Flap/Boom Barriers, UVSS, IoT, and Parking Management.
  • Engage with Field Operations to understand site requirements and prepare cost-effective proposals.
  • Drive customer negotiations and close orders efficiently.
  • Maintain a strong sales pipeline (5x of target) and ensure timely order conversion.
  • Comply with internal sales processes and documentation standards.
  • Explore new business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships.

What we look for?

  • BE/B.Tech (Mechanical, Industrial Engg, Electrical & Electronics, Production Engg)
  • 7–15 years of experience in service/project sales in building technologies.
  • Strong commercial and technical acumen.
  • Proven contract and sales negotiation skills.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management abilities.

What we offer

We offer a challenging and exciting position as part of a global, multi-industrial corporation. Joining us provides a stimulating work environment, career development opportunities, and the chance to make a significant impact on society.

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion stems from our core values. We lead with integrity and aim for a future aligned with our customers' vision for success. Our culture fosters engagement, innovation, and collaboration, ensuring every employee contributes to our collective mission.

job.title: Oracle Fusion Senior Technical Analyst
job.description:
Senior Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst

Johnson Controls creates smart, healthy, and sustainable environments. In this role, you will help strengthen Oracle Fusion technical capabilities that support reliable reporting, efficient business processes, and effective delivery across critical enterprise flows.

Role Overview

As a Senior Oracle Fusion Technical Analyst, you will lead technical development and support for Oracle Fusion ERP solutions, with a strong focus on Project to Close flows. You will partner with functional, technical, and business teams to deliver stable integrations, extensions, and reporting solutions that improve performance, simplify processes, and support end-to-end delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead development and support of Fusion extensions across Project to Close and related ERP functional flows.
  • Design, build, and maintain BIP and OTBI reports that support business and operational needs.
  • Develop and support integrations using Oracle Fusion REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Work with Oracle Fusion ERP data models to enable technical solutions and data-driven process support.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve system performance, reliability, and user experience.
  • Support implementation activities, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Analyze enhancements, change requests, and support issues; help manage backlog and conduct code reviews.
  • Contribute to automation, simplification, and reduction of support tickets through practical process improvements.

How You Will Do It

  • Own outcomes with accountability and integrity by delivering well-tested solutions, protecting data quality, and following disciplined change control.
  • Stay close to the business process by partnering with functional teams and understanding how each change affects users and downstream flows.
  • Improve every day through automation, root-cause analysis, simplification, and candid problem-solving.
  • Work as one team with technical and business partners to unblock issues quickly and keep delivery moving.
  • Use clear documentation, traceability, and thoughtful handoffs so support teams can sustain what you build.
  • Balance speed and quality by validating changes carefully before release and staying focused on business impact.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Systems, or an equivalent field.
  • 8+ years of overall experience with Oracle Fusion and Oracle EBS ERP environments.
  • Proven experience delivering and supporting technical configurations and extensions in Oracle Fusion ERP.
  • Hands-on experience with BIP and OTBI reports.
  • Strong knowledge of Oracle Fusion ERP data models.
  • Experience developing interfaces with Oracle Fusion REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with functional teams and business stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting implementation, testing, and post-go-live operations in a complex ERP environment.

Nice to Have

  • Basic understanding of MuleSoft and Oracle Integration Cloud.
  • Exposure to Agile delivery practices.
  • Familiarity with Oracle Analytics Cloud, VBCS, or Oracle ATP.
  • Experience supporting process improvement initiatives in large-scale ERP programs.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.

job.title: HVAC Technician
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Building Technologies, Sustainability & Advanced HVAC Solutions

At Johnson Controls, we're transforming how the world's buildings perform. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers optimize energy use, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain mission-critical environments across industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, education, and commercial infrastructure.

With more than 140 years of innovation and expertise, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, industry-leading service capabilities, and a highly skilled field team to deliver solutions that matter. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, helping customers achieve better performance while building rewarding careers.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced HVAC Service Technician to join our Brisbane team in Windsor.

In this role, you'll work across a diverse portfolio of commercial and industrial sites, servicing and maintaining a broad range of HVAC equipment and systems. Whether you're a seasoned technician looking for your next challenge or someone eager to expand into chillers, BMS, and advanced building technologies, we'll provide the training, support, and opportunities to help you succeed.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a respected industry leader offering long-term career stability, ongoing technical development, and genuine pathways for advancement.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

Work With Industry-Leading Technology

  • Service and maintain commercial HVAC systems across multiple industries
  • Gain exposure to advanced technologies, including chillers, controls, and Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Learn from one of the most experienced technical teams in the industry

YORK OEM Advantage

As a YORK OEM, we provide exclusive access to in-house chiller training and manufacturer-supported technical development programs. This gives you the opportunity to build specialised expertise and accelerate your career in advanced HVAC systems.

Career Development Without Limits

  • Structured training and development programs
  • Ongoing manufacturer and technical certifications
  • Career progression opportunities across Australia and internationally
  • Access to specialist technical support and remote experts

A Culture That Supports You

  • Flexible work arrangements because work-life balance matters
  • RDO or overtime options to suit your lifestyle and financial goals
  • Strong team culture and supportive leadership
  • Global organisation with local team values

What You'll Be Doing

  • Service, maintain, troubleshoot and repair commercial HVAC systems
  • Diagnose faults and provide effective solutions for customers
  • Perform scheduled preventative and reactive maintenance
  • Install, commission and optimise HVAC equipment and components
  • Complete service documentation and maintain accurate records
  • Collaborate with customers and internal teams to deliver exceptional outcomes
  • Ensure all work is completed safely and in accordance with industry and regulatory requirements

What You'll Bring

  • Certificate III in Air Conditioning and Refrigeration (or equivalent)
  • Queensland Restricted Electrical Licence (minimum requirement)
  • Previous experience in HVAC service, maintenance or repairs
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Current driver's licence
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and professional workmanship
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

What's In It For You?

  • Competitive salary package + benefits
  • Ongoing technical training and career development
  • Exposure to industry-leading HVAC technologies
  • YORK OEM training and specialist chiller pathways
  • Flexible work arrangements and work-life balance
  • Supportive team environment
  • Long-term career opportunities with a global leader

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls is a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. Through our extensive service network, we deliver innovative HVAC, controls, fire, security, and energy solutions that improve building performance and create more sustainable communities.

Our Brisbane team plays a critical role in supporting customers across Queensland, delivering technical excellence, trusted expertise, and exceptional service every day.

Compliance Requirements

  • Full Australian working rights are required
  • Pre-employment medical assessment, criminal history check, and drug & alcohol screening will be conducted

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

If you're looking for a role that offers technical challenge, career growth, flexibility, and the backing of a global industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and take your HVAC career further with Johnson Controls.

For a confidential discussion, contact Janis Sotelo at [janis.sotelo@jci.com](mailto:janis.sotelo@jci.com)

#LI-JS4

job.title: Business Development Manager - HVAC Projects
job.description:
As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

About the Company:

Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Business Development Manager to drive growth for our HVAC Retrofit (projects) business. This is a strategic sales role will focus on delivering secured sales through HVAC project solutions in the built environment.

This position is based in Sydney.

You’ll have autonomy, flexibility, and the chance to work with some of the best minds in the industry. If you’re a self-starter with a passion for solution selling and building strong networks, this is your opportunity to make an impact.

What You’ll Do:

  • Leverage your local industry knowledge to develop a pipeline of project opportunities focused on Mechanical plant upgrades.

Why Johnson Controls?

job.title: EHS Officer (part time - 3 days per week)
job.description:
Help Build a Safer, More Sustainable Future with Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

Joining JCI means becoming part of a global organisation where you'll collaborate with some of the industry's most experienced professionals. We offer a supportive and inclusive culture, opportunities for professional development, and the flexibility to make a genuine impact while shaping your own career journey.

This role is ideal for an experienced EHS professional seeking flexibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to influence safety, quality, and environmental performance across a diverse New Zealand business.

About the Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced EHS Officer to join our Auckland-based team on a part-time basis (3 days per week).

Reporting into the Pacific EHSQ team, you will play a key role in supporting our New Zealand operations, driving compliance, continuous improvement, and fostering a strong safety culture. This position offers exposure to a variety of business functions and projects, creating excellent opportunities for professional growth within a global organisation.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Develop, implement, and maintain JCI's Integrated Business Management Systems (EHSQ).
  • Ensure compliance with company systems through regular audits and assessments.
  • Conduct and coordinate site audits, inspections, and compliance reviews.
  • Support EHSQ reporting and performance metrics across the Pacific region.
  • Manage non-conformance reports (NCRs) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead quality assurance activities and monitor performance against established procedures.
  • Deliver EHSQ and compliance training to employees and stakeholders.
  • Assist with incident investigations and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant health, safety, environmental, and quality legislation.
  • Conduct risk assessments and develop safe work method statements.
  • Coordinate Health & Safety Committee activities and communicate outcomes to key stakeholders.
  • Provide expert advice on health, safety, environmental, welfare, and quality matters.
  • Manage Return to Work processes and injury management activities.
  • Champion best practices and drive a proactive culture aligned to our commitment to Zero Harm.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • Qualification in Quality Assurance or a related discipline (preferred).
  • Minimum Certificate IV in Workplace Health and Safety or equivalent.
  • Lead Auditor qualifications in ISO 9001, ISO 45001, and ISO 14001.
  • 3-5 years' experience within a heavy manufacturing, industrial, or similar environment.
  • Incident investigation training or qualification (preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of workplace health and safety legislation and quality management systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and SharePoint.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and influencing skills.
  • A proactive approach and passion for creating safe, high-performing workplaces.

Compliance Requirements

  • Full New Zealand working rights.
  • Ability to successfully complete a pre-employment medical assessment, criminal history check, and drug and alcohol screening.

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

If you're looking for a role that offers meaningful work, flexibility, professional growth, and the opportunity to make a lasting impact within a global industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Click Apply to submit your application.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Janis Sotelo at [janis.sotelo@jci.com](mailto:janis.sotelo@jci.com).

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, diversity and inclusion are fundamental to who we are. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, strengthen collaboration, and create better outcomes for our customers and communities.

We are committed to creating an environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work. Together, we foster a culture where everyone has the opportunity to grow, contribute, and succeed.

job.title: RMC Supervisor-3
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Provides in-depth technical support and leads problem solving and quality implementation efforts for all supported products and services.

Responsibilities

  • Determining service level standards for customer service requests for product lines.
  • Answering technical questions for complex issues and procedures or to handle technical problems with customers' products.
  • Prioritize and implement product improvements related to customer issues and manage cost impact.
  • Implementing service strategies for a given product to improve its repairability and maintenance.
  • Developing in-depth knowledge of organizational products and programs, as well as capabilities of team members within the department.

Skill Descriptors

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Focuses activities on developing and maintaining positive customer relationships.
  • Discusses general differences between internally and externally focused organizations.
  • Cites the cost and benefits of good versus poor customer service.
  • Explains why customer satisfaction is important to successful product/service delivery.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.
  • Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.
  • Participates in gathering and analyzing an organization's data based on requirements.
  • Documents data from various sources and in various formats.
  • Utilizes basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.

Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides a quality of service that customers describe as excellent.
  • Resolves common customer problems.
  • Responds to unexpected customer requests with a sense of urgency and positive action.
  • Provides direct service to internal or external customers.
  • Documents customer complaints in a timely manner.

Consulting: Knowledge of techniques, roles, and responsibilities in providing technical or business guidance to clients, both internal and external; ability to apply consulting knowledge appropriately.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the roles and responsibilities of a consultant.
  • Lists the typical phases of a consulting assignment or project.
  • Presents a professional image, especially when dealing with customers.
  • Describes the consulting process and relationship with clients.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the value of a disciplined approach to problem solving.
  • Describes problem reporting and escalation practices.
  • Utilizes accepted procedures for problem analysis and resolution.
  • Identifies key aspects of problem-solving techniques used in own area.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.
  • Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.
  • Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.
  • Differentiates the roles and responsibilities in a business relationship.
  • Works with clients to address critical issues and resolve major problems.

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
  • Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components.
  • Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
  • Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
  • Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of “essential job functions” as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

job.title: Mining Technical Training Consultant
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Work Shapes the World

At Caterpillar, the work we do matters. For more than 100 years, we've delivered products and solutions that support mining, construction, and infrastructure worldwide. Our teams combine engineering expertise, manufacturing excellence, and disciplined execution to deliver equipment that performs in the toughest conditions.

We are seeking an experienced Training Consultant to join Resource Industries, responsible for designing, developing and delivering MineStar service training programs for Caterpillar dealers and mining customers. Based in Perth or Brisbane, this role is ideal for someone with strong practical experience installing, commissioning, integrating, maintaining and troubleshooting MineStar, or similar mining technology systems.

You will play a key role in building the capability of dealer technicians and customer support personnel, ensuring they have the skills and knowledge required to safely support and maintain MineStar solutions in operational mining environments.

Whether you're an experienced trainer or a technical specialist looking to move into a training-focused role, your field experience, technical expertise and ability to translate complex concepts into practical learning outcomes will be critical to your success.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver technical training programs covering MineStar products, systems and service procedures.
  • Provide instruction on the installation, commissioning, configuration and maintenance of MineStar technologies.
  • Deliver practical, hands-on training focused on machine integration, onboard hardware, communications networks and system troubleshooting.
  • Support dealer and customer technicians in developing diagnostic and fault-finding capability.
  • Develop and continuously improve training materials to align with product updates and industry best practice.
  • Partner with product support, engineering, dealers and customers to identify capability gaps and training requirements.
  • Provide coaching and technical mentorship to service personnel across Caterpillar's dealer network.
  • Promote safe work practices and Caterpillar service excellence standards

What You Will Bring

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience installing, commissioning, troubleshooting and supporting MineStar systems in mining environments.
  • Strong understanding of onboard mining technology, machine electronics, communications systems and system integration.
  • Experience working directly on mobile mining equipment and supporting mining technology deployments in operational environments.
  • Well-developed diagnostic and fault-finding skills across hardware, software and communications systems.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to technicians and service personnel.
  • Willingness to travel to support dealer and customer training requirements.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience with MineStar Fleet, Terrain, Health or Command products.
  • Caterpillar dealer or OEM field service experience.
  • Experience delivering technical training, mentoring or coaching technicians.
  • Trade, technical or engineering qualifications relevant to mining technology, electrical systems, communications or mobile equipment.
  • Background in mining, heavy mobile equipment, oil & gas, or other heavy industrial environments.

What Will Set You Apart

The successful candidate will bring practical field experience and a strong understanding of how MineStar systems are installed, integrated, commissioned and supported on mining equipment.

While experience using MineStar as an operator, planner, dispatcher or system administrator is valuable, this role is best suited to candidates who have directly supported the deployment, maintenance and troubleshooting of MineStar technologies on machines.

Additional Information

  • Site-based in Perth orBrisbane (5 days per week)
  • Also you will be required to travel for 30 to 60% of the time
  • Visa sponsorship is not available

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration, including bonus and share options
  • Generous parental leave with flexible payment options
  • Strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity
  • Employee discounts across health, wellbeing, travel, and retail
  • Global career progression and development opportunities within Caterpillar

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role with a global industry leader, apply via:

www.caterpillar.com/careers

Your road to success begins with Caterpillar.

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Caterpillar of Australia is not currently hiring applicants who require sponsorship. As a global company, opportunities may be available in other locations via our careers website.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Senior Desktop Support Engineer
job.description:
Position Objective

The Group (GRP) Senior Field Support Engineer is responsible for providing technical assistance and support to Goodman Group employees at the Goodman Headquarters (Hayesbery) office. You will provide white-glove support to the Group Board and Executive team and ensure seamless experiences in their use of Goodman technology and devices. You will support their use of collaborative technology including audio-visual technology to ensure successful business events and meetings. You will play a crucial role in maintaining the stability and efficiency of our desktop infrastructure, ensuring that all Group system users have access to the necessary tools and resources to perform their job functions effectively.

This role demands a proactive, service-oriented professional who thrives in high-pressure environments and understands the nuances of executive-level support.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Support

  • Deliver high-touch, discreet, and responsive IT support to Goodman Board and Executive teams and their immediate teams.
  • Manage and maintain executive devices (laptops, mobile phones, tablets), ensuring optimal performance and security.
  • Provide on-site and remote support for meetings, presentations, and travel-related tech needs.
  • Anticipate and resolve issues before they impact executive productivity.

Event Technology Enablement

  • Lead the technical setup and support for internal and external business events, including town halls, board meetings, and hybrid conferences.
  • Coordinate AV, video conferencing, and collaboration tools (including Goodman Teams and others like Zoom, Webex) to ensure flawless execution.
  • Liaise with internal teams, vendors and office management teams to ensure venue readiness and technology compatibility.
  • Support and maintain meeting room audio-visual technology including collaboration with 3rd party vendors to resolve ongoing issues.

Operational Excellence

  • Resolve complex technical issues related to desktop operating systems (Windows and macOS), applications, and network connectivity.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of support activities, configurations, and incident resolutions.
  • Collaborate with IT teams to ensure alignment with broader infrastructure and security policies.
  • Monitor and report on support metrics, identifying areas for improvement.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in desktop support to provide innovative solutions and improve existing processes.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and access rights across various systems, ensuring data security and compliance with company policies.
  • Participate in IT projects, such as system upgrades, migrations, and deployments, ensuring successful implementation and minimal disruption to end-users

Flexibility, Availability and Facilities

  • Provide early morning and after-hours support as required, including occasional weekends and travel.
  • Be available for rapid response to urgent executive needs, including remote troubleshooting and support.
  • Maintain tidiness of the IT Services Tech Hub and IT build room ensuring safety and cleanliness at all times.

Knowledge, Experience and Skill Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

Proficient in troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues related to desktop systems, applications, and network connectivity.

Specific areas of knowledge: Compliance & Technical Knowledge

Subject Matter

Essential/

Desirable

Experience supporting board-level executives with excellent communication, professional, discretion, and customer service skills.

Essential

Strong customer service orientation with a focus on providing exceptional support and building positive relationships with end-users.

Essential

Proven experience working as a Field or Desktop Support Engineer or in a similar technical support role, with a focus on providing second and third-level support.

Essential

Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Tools and Teams; experience working with Zoom, and other collaboration tools.

Essential

Strong knowledge of contemporary Desktop operating systems (Windows, macOS), hardware, and software applications.

Essential

Experience with service management, desktop management and remote support tools (e.g., CA Service Desk, ServiceNow, SCCM, JAMF, TeamViewer).

Essential

Experience with Active Directory, and user account management in a Windows domain environment.

Essential

Proven ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Essential

Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician (MCDST), or ITIL Foundation are advantageous.

Desirable

Experience

10+ years experience in desktop support roles across large organisations

Essential

Experience dealing with senior internal and external stakeholders

Essential

Skills/Characteristics

Ability to influence senior stakeholders and build strong relationships.

Essential

Strong and professional communication skills.

Essential

Willingness to adapt to changing schedules and event demands.

Essential

Calm under pressure with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

Essential

Self-starter/highly motivated, can work autonomously.

Essential

Strong attention to detail and commitment to excellence.

Essential

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

Job Title

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.

Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs with LinkedIn Learning, and develop your career with our Future Ready program designed to build on your skills and prepare you for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is it You We’re Looking For?

  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.
  • Customer-Facing Experience: Previous experience is a plus but not required—bring your enthusiasm and we’ll teach you the rest!

How to Apply:

Ready to kickstart your journey with us? Click "Apply Now" to submit your application! After applying, keep an eye out for an email from our partner, HireVue, to complete the next step in our assessment process.

Join Us at Telstra Retail:

When you become part of the Telstra team, you’re joining a brand that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone is respected, valued, and can thrive. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to our team!

job.title: Solutions Architect Manager, AI & Growth - ASEAN, ASEAN APO PSA Team
job.description:
Are you passionate about helping AI-driven consulting partners to scale across ASEAN using the cloud and AI services? We are looking for an experienced and technically strong people manager to lead our Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) teams within the ASEAN Partner Organization. This role owns the technical strategy, team development, and partner engagement for:

  • AI Partner PSAs: A team of Partner Solutions Architects who support AI/ML Consulting Partners to co-build solutions on AWS, co-sell through AWS Marketplace, and scale globally across AWS Regions. These partners are building next-generation AI applications leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and other AWS AI/ML services.
  • Growth Partner PSAs: A team of Partner Solutions Architects supporting AWS Growth Partners, driving technical enablement, solution design, and scale motions through the channel partners to accelerate Cloud and AI adoption across ASEAN markets.

This is a highly visible, dual-charter leadership role that requires to cover ASEAN countries (Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Philippines) to engage directly with partners, lead executive briefings, and represent AWS at area and country events.

Key job responsibilities Technical Strategy, Migration & Modernization & AI Enablement

  • Set the technical vision, Migration & Modernization and AI acceleration strategy across teams, identifying common enablement needs and opportunities for shared tooling, mechanisms, agentic tools and AI/ML reference architectures.
  • Stay current on AWS AI/ML services (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Quick, Kiro etc.) and industry trends to inform partner technical guidance and co-build motions.
  • Build mechanisms to measure and improve partner technical outcomes including Migration & Modernization, AI competency and Managed Services certifications, validated AI solution designs, Marketplace listings, and customer wins.
  • Drive partner enablement programs for both AI Partners and Growth Partners, ensuring partners can effectively leverage generative AI, agentic tools, foundation models, and ML services in their solutions.
  • Establish technical bar-raising mechanisms to ensure partners deliver production-quality AI/ML solutions to end customers.

Stakeholder & Partner Engagement

  • Serve as a senior technical voice to AI Partner and Growth Partner executives, building trusted advisor relationships at the CTO/VP Engineering level.
  • Represent partner technical needs internally, influencing AWS AI service teams, partner programs, and product roadmaps to better serve the ASEAN partner ecosystem.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Sales, Marketing, Training, and Professional Services to drive holistic partner success across the AI and distribution segments.
  • Present at partner events, executive briefings, AWS Summits, and industry forums across ASEAN to elevate AWS partner technical thought leadership in AI.
  • Cultivate relationships with AI Partner founders and Growth Partner technical leadership to drive co-innovation and joint go-to-market motions.

People Management and Operational Excellence

  • Define and track team goals and performance metrics aligned to ASEAN Partner organizational priorities and business outcomes.
  • Recruit, hire, and retain top technical talent across ASEAN; build a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team culture that spans multiple countries and cultures.
  • Establish scalable operating rhythms, reporting mechanisms, and continuous improvement practices across both team charters.
  • Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, and prioritization across AI Partner and Growth Partner engagement models.

About the team The Partner Solutions Architecture (PSA) organization is the technical backbone of the AWS Partner community. PSAs work hands-on with AWS Partners to raise their technical bar, help them build differentiated solutions, and ensure customers receive world-class outcomes through the partner channel. The ASEAN Cloud and AI Acceleration team is at the forefront of driving AI adoption across Southeast Asia’s diverse and rapidly growing markets. This role offers a unique leadership opportunity: you will shape how AWS engages technically with both the fast-moving Partner segment (startups and ISVs building AI-first solutions) and the high-scale Growth Partner channel (distributors enabling downstream resellers). By leading across these two domains, you will develop cross-pollination strategies, identify common AI enablement patterns, and build mechanisms that amplify partner impact at scale. You will work closely with Partner Development Managers, AWS service teams, and regional leadership to ensure ASEAN partners are equipped to deliver AI solutions to customers.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise IT application work that includes at least 2 years of hands-on software development or DevOps engineering experience
  • 2+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
  • 8+ years of technology solutions development and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience leading and growing teams of senior technology professionals, ideally in customer facing roles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
  • Knowledge of cloud technology partner ecosystem and related products
  • Experience in a technical role within a sales organization

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Market Intelligence & Growth

  • Track Asia Pacific Data Center demand drivers, including AI workloads, hyperscale and cloud investment, colocation expansion, power constraints, sustainability requirements, and competitor activity.
  • Summarize market sizing, customer intelligence, and competitive analysis into clear briefs for regional sales and business stakeholders.
  • Support prioritization of countries, segments, accounts, and sales plays with concise data, insight, and recommendations.

Market Development & Positioning

  • Develop practical messaging and content that connect CommScope solutions to customer needs in AI, cloud, high-density infrastructure, resilience, and scalable growth.
  • Support go-to-market activities, product launches, sales plays, and executive-ready presentation materials.
  • Assist major opportunity pursuits by preparing value propositions, competitive notes, customer briefs, and stakeholder messaging.

Customer & Industry Engagement

  • Support customer workshops, industry events, analyst discussions, and partner engagements with preparation materials, market insights, and follow-up actions.
  • Help develop thought leadership content on Data Center market trends, AI infrastructure requirements, and CommScope's role in next-generation digital infrastructure.
  • Build working relationships with customers, consultants, partners, and internal stakeholders to improve market understanding and execution support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with Sales, Product Management, Marketing, and Engineering to gather inputs, align content, and support execution of regional market priorities.
  • Assist with pricing inputs, competitive response materials, and customer engagement for high-value opportunities.
  • Capture customer, channel, and market feedback and share it with relevant teams to support portfolio, marketing, and sales planning.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Marketing, Technology, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in Data Center, networking, telecommunications, cloud, or digital infrastructure markets.
  • Experience in market development, product marketing, business development, strategic sales, or consulting.
  • Strong understanding of Data Center infrastructure, AI trends, cloud, enterprise, and colocation markets.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience engaging with customers, partners, and industry organizations across Asia Pacific.

Success Measures

  • High-quality market briefs, customer materials, and sales enablement content delivered on time for Asia Pacific Data Center priorities.
  • Improved visibility of market trends, competitor activity, customer needs, and priority opportunities for regional sales and business stakeholders.
  • Practical contribution to opportunity preparation, customer engagement, launch support, and follow-through on regional growth initiatives.

Ideal Candidate

A commercially curious and analytical professional with strong communication, structured thinking, and reliable execution. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across teams, preparing customer-facing materials, analyzing market and pricing trends, supporting events and opportunity pursuits, and growing into broader market development responsibilities over time.

job.title: Sr Staff Agentic AI Engineer - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

Build the Surfaces Where Humans Command the Agents

Equinix Incubation builds the agentic systems that run the software delivery lifecycle end to end: AI agents, with humans directing the work and owning every gate. Agents without great human surfaces are just noise. This role builds the surfaces.

You will own the consoles and dashboards through which product managers approve, engineers review, security screens, and executives see value: decision inboxes, review queues, gate approvals, and live value boards. It is full-stack work where the front end is the product and the stakes are trust.

Responsibilities

Build the Consoles

  • Design and build persona consoles: decision inboxes, review surfaces, approval queues, and commitment views, one clear surface per role
  • Make agent work legible: what an agent did, why, with what confidence, and what needs a human, rendered so a busy owner decides in seconds
  • Sweat the interaction details with UX; approval fatigue is the failure mode, and design is the defense

Build the Value and Telemetry Layer

  • Build the dashboards that report cycle time, throughput, quality, adoption, agent health, and cost, live from the pipeline
  • Turn telemetry into narrative: executive value boards that show committed versus realized without manual curation
  • Instrument everything; the platform's credibility rests on numbers nobody has to assemble by hand

Engineer the Full Stack

  • Build the backend-for-frontend layer, APIs, and event consumers that connect consoles to the orchestrator and enterprise systems such as Jira
  • Implement enterprise-grade authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth) and respect data boundaries by design
  • Ship on the approved enterprise React stack with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability as defaults

Raise the Bar

  • Use agents in your own workflow and feed friction back into the platform; you are user zero
  • Set frontend and BFF patterns others reuse: components, state, accessibility, performance
  • Bring craft: the fundamentals still decide whether this works

What Success Looks Like

  • Approvers clear their queues in minutes and trust what they see; nobody asks for a spreadsheet export as a workaround
  • Executives quote your value board in their own decks
  • Console patterns you built become the default for every new agent the fleet adds
  • The stack stays fast, tested, and observable as surfaces multiply

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of large-scale production systems.
  • Significant hands-on experience designing and deploying LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or intelligent automation platforms.
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks, testing strategies, and governance models for AI-enabled systems.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python or Java or TypeScript.
  • Strong background in distributed systems, APIs, platform engineering, cloud-native architectures, and event-driven systems.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives across teams.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI systems to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence architecture, standards, and engineering direction.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience with agent frameworks and technologies such as MCP, A2A, LangGraph, OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, or Vertex AI.
  • Experience building developer platforms, internal engineering products, or enterprise orchestration systems.
  • Experience with RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and enterprise search.
  • Experience leading AI governance, privacy reviews, security reviews, and responsible AI initiatives.
  • Strong record of technical leadership through open-source contributions, patents, technical publications, or industry speaking engagements.

Why This Role

Incubation is a durable capability, not a project team: the team persists, and the product rotates. Agentic delivery is product one; the next incubation bets follow. Every agent the platform adds makes the human surfaces more important, not less. You will define how a global organization sees, steers, and trusts its AI workforce.

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).
