job.title: Senior Specialist Construction
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Specialist – Civil Construction Project is responsible for leading and managing the civil engineering scope for large scale, mission critical data centre projects. The role combines deep technical expertise in civil engineering with strong project management capabilities to ensure high quality, cost effective, and timely delivery of civil works. This position requires close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, strict adherence to safety and quality standards, and effective oversight across the full project life cycle from design and permitting through construction and commissioning.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead civil engineering activities for data centre construction projects from concept to commissioning.
  • Review and validate civil design drawings, specifications, and engineering calculations.
  • Oversee site execution of civil works: excavation, grading, foundations, base build, fit‑out works, external infrastructure, and civil finishes.
  • Ensure civil works adhere to project quality, safety, and compliance standards.
  • Collaborate closely with structural, architectural, MEP teams, and contractors to ensure integrated project delivery.
  • Monitor onsite progress and implement corrective actions to maintain schedule and quality.
  • Support project managers in delivering civil scope on time and within budget.
  • Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:
  • Strong understanding of civil engineering principles, construction materials, and data centre infrastructure requirements.
  • Knowledge of site development, foundations, utilities, drainage, and civil finishes.
  • Familiarity with mission‑critical construction standards and multidisciplinary coordination (Structural, MEP, Architecture).
  • Ability to interpret drawings, specifications, and technical documents accurately.
  • Strong project management skills including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management.
  • Proficiency with project tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, Excel, and SharePoint.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem‑solving skills.
  • High focus on quality, safety, documentation accuracy, and timely delivery in fast‑paced environments.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (mandatory).
  • Required Experience:
  • 8–12 years of civil engineering experience.
  • 3–5 years in data centre or mission‑critical construction.
  • Experience in large-scale infrastructure or industrial projects.
  • Strong civil site execution experience (foundations, grading, utilities, external works).
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary teams (Structural, MEP, Architecture).

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

Job Description

Job Description

Engineer - Technical Support

Job Title: Engineer - Technical Support

Role Focus: I&C Costig, Planning, Sourcing Coordination, Vendor Finalisation, CAS Portal Drive and PAN India Franchisee Compliance Support

Department: Thermal Management Services

Location: India / Project Support Location, as required

Job Purpose

Support Installation and Commissioning operations across India by managing costing, planning, sourcing coordination, vendor finalisation, CAS portal tracking and franchisee compliance activities. The role helps ensure smooth project execution, timely coordination, process discipline, documentation control and compliance with service quality and safety requirements.

Key Responsibilities

I&C Costing and Planning

  • Prepare basic costing, budget inputs and commercial estimates for I&C activities.
  • Support manpower planning, travel planning, tools planning and project resource allocation.
  • Coordinate project schedules and execution plans with regional teams.
  • Track project progress against approved timelines and cost requirements.

Sourcing Coordination and Vendor Finalisation

  • Coordinate with procurement, vendors and service partners for project requirements.
  • Collect quotations and support technical and commercial comparison.
  • Assist in vendor evaluation, documentation and finalisation process.
  • Follow up with vendors for delivery, quality, compliance and project support requirements.

CAS Portal Drive

  • Drive CAS portal updates for I&C project registration, tracking and closure.
  • Monitor approval status, documentation status and pending actions.
  • Coordinate with sales, operations and service teams for timely CAS process completion.
  • Maintain CAS related records, reports and follow-up trackers.

PAN India Franchisee Compliance Support

  • Support franchisee partners to follow Vertiv I&C, safety, quality and reporting standards.
  • Track mandatory documents, manpower deployment, certifications and daily reporting.
  • Monitor checklist usage, calibrated tools, PPE compliance and site documentation.
  • Support franchisee audit follow-up and corrective action closure.

Project Coordination

  • Coordinate with customers, franchisees, consultants, PMCs, testing agencies and internal teams.
  • Support material planning, delivery tracking and site execution readiness.
  • Share project updates, risks, delays and escalation points with stakeholders.
  • Support execution teams during commissioning, handover and project closure.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Costing and budget tracking.
  • Sourcing coordination and vendor management.
  • CAS portal tracking and process follow-up.
  • Franchisee and partner coordination.
  • MS Excel, MIS reporting and documentation control.
  • Customer and internal stakeholder coordination.
  • Safety, quality and compliance awareness.

Key Deliverables

  • Accurate project costing and planning support.
  • Timely sourcing coordination and vendor finalisation support.
  • Effective CAS portal tracking and closure follow-up.
  • Franchisee compliance with Vertiv standards.
  • Improved project coordination and execution visibility.

Job Description

Job Description

Brief Job Description:

Responsible for providing on-site and remote technical support, maintenance, and troubleshooting for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, PDU (Power Distribution Units), STS (Static transfer Switches), AHF(Active Harmonic filters) and other similar Power electronics products. The role requires extensive knowledge of UPS systems, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team to ensure the reliability and performance of power systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Support:

Provide on-site and remote support for installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of UPS systems.

Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network-related issues affecting UPS performance.

Assist in the configuration and commissioning of new UPS installations.

  • Preventive Maintenance:

Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance on UPS systems to ensure optimal performance.

Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, including any repairs or replacements.

  • Customer Interaction:

Communicate effectively with customers to understand their needs and provide appropriate solutions.

Train customers on the proper use and maintenance of UPS systems.

  • Documentation and Reporting:

Prepare detailed reports of service visits, including diagnostic findings, actions taken, and recommendations for future maintenance.

Maintain up-to-date documentation of all service activities and customer interactions.

  • Technical Training and Development:

Stay current with the latest developments in UPS technology and industry best practices.

Participate in ongoing training and professional development to enhance technical skills and knowledge.

  • Compliance and Safety:

Adhere to all safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a safe working environment.

Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards in all service activities.

Qualifications

  • Education: Diploma/bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering/Electronics Engineering.
  • Experience:  Minimum of 8-10 years of experience in UPS systems support or a related field.

Experience with Vertiv Products is preferable.

  • Technical Skills:

Strong understanding of electrical and electronics principles and UPS technology.

Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing UPS systems.

Familiarity with network protocols and remote monitoring tools.

  • Soft Skills:

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively.

Work Environment

The position may require travel to customer sites and may involve working in various environmental conditions.

Flexibility to work outside regular business hours for emergency support and maintenance activities.

job.title: Assistant Engineer - Field Service
job.description:
Job Description

Assistant Engineer - Field Service

Bengaluru, India

Job Description

UPS System Maintenance Engineer:

A UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) engineer installs, maintains, and repairs UPS systems to ensure continuous power for critical equipment. This role often involves troubleshooting technical issues, performing preventative maintenance, and providing customer support. They also conduct site surveys, design systems, and manage project timelines.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Installation and Commissioning:

Installing and setting up new UPS systems, including associated equipment like transfer switches and power distribution units.

  • Onsite Maintenance and Repair:

Performing routine maintenance, diagnosing and repairing faults, and replacing components like capacitors & batteries.

Configure, and maintain UPS systems in accordance with manufacturer specifications and industry best practices.

Conduct routine maintenance for AC / DC Power Systems Hardware and testing of UPS systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability.

Performing routine maintenance of Li-ion / Nicad / Sealed Lead Battery Maintenance.

Drafting of service reports following Breakdown / maintenance visits.

  • Onsite Troubleshooting:

Identifying and resolving technical issues with UPS systems, often using diagnostic tools and software.

Maintain accurate records of work performed and parts used in accordance with company policies and procedures.

Remote support / corrective attendance on short notice to priority sites during critical system failures / doomsday scenarios.

Development of upgrade plans to suit client needs. System modifications / upgrades.

  • Customer Support:

Providing technical support to clients, answering questions, and training them on the proper use of UPS systems.

Work with clients to identify their power requirements and recommend appropriate UPS solutions.

  • Documentation:

This role also has a customer facing element to it, so good email communications and literacy/report writing skills are a must.

Maintaining accurate records of maintenance, repairs, and site visits.

Able to read and provide Single Line Diagram.

  • Safety:

Adhering to safety regulations and procedures when working with electrical equipment.

  • Project Management:

Managing project timelines and ensuring successful completion of installation and maintenance tasks.

Collaborate with other team members and subcontractors to complete projects on time and within budget.

  • Site Assessments:

Evaluating customer sites to determine the appropriate UPS system requirements.

Qualifications

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • Qualification in diploma / degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering with at 3-4 years’ experience in UPS services & Computer related discipline

Additional / Preferred Qualifications:

  • Expert Knowledge in UPS systems in a data center or similar environment
  • Experience in 3 phases UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supplies)
  • A strong understanding of electrical and electronic systems, including power distribution, automatic Transfer Switch, PDU, SKRU and related components
  • Strong, demonstrable troubleshooting/fault-diagnostics skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with clients and team members
  • A commitment to providing excellent customer service and support
  • Familiarity with Energy Management / Automation Systems
  • Knowledge and understanding in reading Electrical One Line Schematics
  • Be efficiently organized and able to prioritize multiple tasks

job.title: Sr. Engineer BIM
job.description:
Job Description

Vertiv Global Engineering Centre, Pune is looking for dynamic and experienced BIM MEPF Lead with well-versed in basic coordination with all trades to work closely in with BIM Manager.

BIM - Senior Engineer is responsible for coordinating the BIM efforts of all project teams at Vertiv. This includes ensuring that all members of the team are following BEP, Vertiv standards and process, adhering to the model standards set with right software, exchanging of data regularly.

In addition to these duties the Senior engineer-BIM is also responsible for training new members on BIM process, Maintaining BIM models throughout project life cycle and developing BIM tools and templates on Revit. Family/Content Creation using the Revit tool for the Data Centers and other Vertiv Products. He/ she will be responsible for delivering quality deliverables as per the organization’s standards. Work closely with different LoB’s and stakeholders to meet deadlines. He should ensure all team related timesheet, quality plan, project updates on time.

Job Specifications:

  • Must have full time bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical or electrical preferred)
  • Must have 6-8 years of experience in BIM modeling using Revit.
  • Proficient in implementing BIM requirements (creating families, floor plans, 3D modelling, MEP services, clash detection, schedules, BOQ, coordination) associated with large projects.
  • Design & domain knowledge of MEP engineering systems for data centers (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of BIM principles and practices.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, Autodesk Revit in MEP, Navisworks and other BIM related tools
  • Proficiency in Dynamo Scripting & APIs to create custom tools and workflows that address specific project needs is required.
  • Creation of Parametric and non-parametric families
  • Develop plans, sections, elevations, and details from a 3D BIM model for projects of all sizes and technical complexities.
  • Setup and manage large sheets set including revisions and markups for each project. Plot drawings to pdf & dwg.
  • Knowledge of COBie implementation and 4D to 7D deliverable at LOD 350.
  • Supervise and contribute to create Revit content/families (Parametric) and oversee maintenance of family libraries according to relevant projects and Vertiv Products.
  • Review, estimate and give inputs into delivery schedules and level of efforts required to produce deliverables.
  • Collaborate with BIM managers and project managers to ensure BIM deliverables align with project timelines and objectives.
  • Create and maintain all BIM documentation not limited to BEP, MOM, LOD matrix.
  • Train, mentor and troubleshoot CAD & Revit modeling, Navisworks queries.
  • Create and maintain quality checks and follow standards for project and revit content delivers.
  • Excellent in English communication and prestation skills.
  • Strong Conceptual, problem solving and Analytical Skills.
  • Demonstrate positive attitude, high ethics, and a working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment.

job.title: Sr. Engineer BIM
job.description:
Job Description

Vertiv Global Engineering Centre, Pune is looking for dynamic and experienced BIM MEPF Lead with well-versed in basic coordination with all trades to work closely in with BIM Manager.

BIM - Senior Engineer is responsible for coordinating the BIM efforts of all project teams at Vertiv. This includes ensuring that all members of the team are following BEP, Vertiv standards and process, adhering to the model standards set with right software, exchanging of data regularly.

In addition to these duties the Senior engineer-BIM is also responsible for training new members on BIM process, Maintaining BIM models throughout project life cycle and developing BIM tools and templates on Revit. Family/Content Creation using the Revit tool for the Data Centers and other Vertiv Products. He/ she will be responsible for delivering quality deliverables as per the organization’s standards. Work closely with different LoB’s and stakeholders to meet deadlines. He should ensure all team related timesheet, quality plan, project updates on time.

Job Specifications:

  • Must have full time bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical or electrical preferred)
  • Must have 6-8 years of experience in BIM modeling using Revit.
  • Proficient in implementing BIM requirements (creating families, floor plans, 3D modelling, MEP services, clash detection, schedules, BOQ, coordination) associated with large projects.
  • Design & domain knowledge of MEP engineering systems for data centers (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of BIM principles and practices.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, Autodesk Revit in MEP, Navisworks and other BIM related tools
  • Proficiency in Dynamo Scripting & APIs to create custom tools and workflows that address specific project needs is required.
  • Creation of Parametric and non-parametric families
  • Develop plans, sections, elevations, and details from a 3D BIM model for projects of all sizes and technical complexities.
  • Setup and manage large sheets set including revisions and markups for each project. Plot drawings to pdf & dwg.
  • Knowledge of COBie implementation and 4D to 7D deliverable at LOD 350.
  • Supervise and contribute to create Revit content/families (Parametric) and oversee maintenance of family libraries according to relevant projects and Vertiv Products.
  • Review, estimate and give inputs into delivery schedules and level of efforts required to produce deliverables.
  • Collaborate with BIM managers and project managers to ensure BIM deliverables align with project timelines and objectives.
  • Create and maintain all BIM documentation not limited to BEP, MOM, LOD matrix.
  • Train, mentor and troubleshoot CAD & Revit modeling, Navisworks queries.
  • Create and maintain quality checks and follow standards for project and revit content delivers.
  • Excellent in English communication and prestation skills.
  • Strong Conceptual, problem solving and Analytical Skills.
  • Demonstrate positive attitude, high ethics, and a working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment.

job.title: Senior Engineer Thermal
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

  • This position will work as a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure Solutions team for the mechanical HVAC design of integrated modular solutions, reporting to and supporting the lead engineer on the project until a valid HVAC technical solution is achieved. The role is responsible for preparing documentation such as single-line diagrams, cooling load calculations, mechanical equipment modelling in Revit, and basic calculations. The thermal engineer must have knowledge of relevant international standards (North American, European, Indian, OR Australian/NZ region) and a basic understanding of international and other standards related to overall HVAC design.
  • Be responsible for mechanical HVAC design on a dedicated (small/medium) project and will coordinate HVAC mechanical installations with other disciplines.
  • Handle one or multiple projects at a time for technical details and also with cross-functional teams. Provide inputs to CFD team and also review analysis.
  • Well versed with details of cooling equipment functions(Leibert) and incorporate cooling equipment in project. Learn and understand equipment details and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Piping design, chiller design, precision cooling units, etc...
  • Preferred experience in Data Center projects or relevant field.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop project concepts and detailed designs

Create mechanical design documentation based on input data (information, requirements, standards): thermal load, ventilation, layouts, detailed drawings, descriptions, schedules, instructions, material submissions, presentations, marketing materials, etc.

Follow and consider international, national, company standards and good engineering practices during design

Use knowledge and experience to meet project task requirements

Participate in kick-off meetings, regular project team meetings, and site coordination meetings

Report project status to the lead project engineer.

Based on Project and priorities he needs to align with North America, India region, EMEA or ANZ region timeline

Proactively collaborate with all team members during project execution

Initiate Requests for Information (RFI) when further clarification is needed

Prepare defined documents according to the document list (DLIST)

Review and approve workshop documentation prepared by subcontractors

Define descriptions of materials and services required for project execution

Specify required certificates for materials to be ordered

Support suppliers with additional information during the bid submission phase

Provide technical approval for received supplier bids

Provide technical support to subcontractors and installers during production/installation

Collaborate with the manufacturing team and on-site implementation team

Work with the site manager during installation, providing technical solutions to raised issues

Cooperate with Quality Control during component/system quality checks and site installation

Collaborate with the commissioning engineer in preparing test documentation

Participate in internal testing and FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing

AUTHORITIES

Review and approve external mechanical design documentation with support from the lead thermal engineer

  • Approve/reject technically received supplier bids with support from the lead thermal engineer
  • Approve/reject proposed changes by subcontractors to approved workshop documentation with support from the lead thermal engineer

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: ME/Mtech OR Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferably in Thermodynamics)
  • 5-7 years of experience
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Software:
  • Required: Revit, AutoCAD, MS Office
  • Preferred: MagiCAD, Linear
  • Other skills: attention to detail, problem-solving ability, organisation, creativity, teamwork, diligence

job.title: Director, Investment, Data Centre (Based in Singapore)
job.description:
The Role

This position will be primarily responsible for leading the Group’s Data Centre investment activities across Asia Pacific, including asset acquisitions, development projects and M&A opportunities. The role will involve originating and evaluating opportunities, driving investment execution, and supporting the growth of the Group’s data centre platform in the region.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and drive business strategies for data centre markets in Asia Pacific region, including the pursuit and evaluation of new investment and business opportunities.
  • Drive portfolio growth by building strategic relationships with key market participants, operators, developers, advisers and capital partners.
  • Originate and assess data centre investment opportunities, including site feasibility, power availability, connectivity, development risk, tenant demand and market competitiveness.
  • Formulate market entry and exit strategies to optimise returns upon disposition, supported by deep-dive analytical reviews to identify opportunities that enhance profitability and value creation.
  • Develop and implement sound business plans for sourcing acquisition and investment opportunities, including strategies to achieve short and long-term growth and profit objectives.
  • Lead investment transactions end-to-end, including origination, research, deal evaluation and structuring, financial analysis, financial modelling, approval processes, negotiation and execution.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders, including development, asset management, legal, finance and tax teams, as well as external advisers, to support transaction execution and portfolio growth.

Job Requirements

  • Degree in Engineering, Building, Real Estate, Business, Finance or a related discipline.
  • Candidates with Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) qualification would be an added advantage.
  • At least 12 years of relevant working experience in real estate investments, asset acquisitions, development projects and/or M&A transactions.
  • Prior exposure to data centres, infrastructure or related asset classes will be preferred.
  • Resourceful, with strong analytical capability and proficiency in financial modelling.
  • Proven track record in originating, evaluating, underwriting and executing investment transactions.
  • Strong investment, financial and commercial acumen, with experience in site selection, business development and/or development management in data centre property investments preferred.
  • Excellent leadership skills, strong initiative, sound business judgement and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

#LI-WL

job.title: GTM Specialist, Infrastructure Migration and Modernization, WWSO India
job.description:
The Infrastructure Migration and Modernization Go-To-Market (GTM) team is responsible for growing the adoption of a portfolio of services that enable our customer’s transformation from commercial software-based legacy platforms to modern, cloud-native services on the AWS cloud. As a part of this team, you will have the opportunity to help shape the future of how customers transform AI-ready application and database workloads by modernizing their technology stack across compute, memory, storage, commercial licensing and allied infrastructure workloads. You will develop scalable motions to establish new business in target market segments and enable the global field organization to drive the day-to-day interactions that identify prospects for long-term business opportunities. You will be the single-threaded owner for developing and executing the GTM plan for the assigned portfolio and act as the extension of the AWS Infrastructure Migration and Modernization product team to customers globally, understanding their use cases, gathering customer feature requests and feedback, and influencing product direction. You will also work directly with the most interesting and demanding customers - leaders in their respective fields - earning trust to understand their requirements and turn them into reality. You will demonstrate Customer Obsession, representing the voice of the customer as you work with product teams across AWS to evolve AWS services.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as a key member of the WWSO India GTM team and focus on increasing adoption of AWS Infrastructure Migration and Modernization services.
  • Help define market segments, customer base, and industry verticals we target, build and own a strategic Go-To-Market plan for target market segments in line with AWS strategic direction.
  • Work with AWS partners to develop their capability, capacity and selling skills to drive our customers’ transformation at scale.
  • Engage senior stakeholders (CIO/CTO/CDO/Head of Applications) in large enterprises to understand their top business priorities and challenges, build the business case for AI-led digital transformation, by working alongside AWS account team, Migration BD and solution architects.
  • Conduct AI-led infrastructure assessments to derive AWS TCO, present AWS value proposition for cloud migrations, and drive the use of AI tools for workload transformation.
  • Support creation of lighthouse references and share customer and market insights with WW service teams to influence roadmap for services and tools and develop investment programs.
  • Work with sales and technical leadership to drive accountability, establish engagement models, and mechanisms for review and reporting.

About the team Are you a customer-obsessed builder with a passion for helping customers achieve their full potential? Do you have the business savvy, Infrastructure Migration and Modernization background, and sales skills necessary to help position AWS as the cloud provider of choice for customers? Do you love building new strategic and data-driven businesses? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Application Modernization team as a Go-to-Market Specialist! The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS), which is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. We work backwards from our customer’s most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire life cycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big and helping our customers arrive at the most optimal technology decisions for an AI future - spanning infrastructure, applications, database, analytics, and security.

job.description:

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

As a Solution Architect, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services within strategic accounts and partners. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the Amazon Web Services technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the Amazon Web Services platform.

  • As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.

As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. job.title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

About You

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):

  • Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
  • Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
  • Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
  • Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
  • Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
  • Liaising with internal teams & management groups
  • Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
  • Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
  • Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.

People Management. As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.

Incident Management. You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.

Vendor Management. An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.

Process Improvement. You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.

We are hiring a Program Manager - Procurement Excellence to work closely with procurement stakeholders, operations, functions, systems and engineering to enable scalable, well-controlled business processes and decision-making.

This role sits within a broader team of program managers that operates as highly embedded business partners to procurement, focused on operational effectiveness and impact, scalable mechanisms, and risk-informed execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong business process thinking, stakeholder influence, operational rigor, and technical literacy to help teams move quickly while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

The ideal candidate require a high tolerance of ambiguity aligned to AWS Day 1 culture, ability to influence executive decisions, drive strategic initiatives and change management that deliver meaningful programmatic improvements.

This is not a traditional audit or policy-focused role. We designed this role for individuals who enjoy solving operational problems, driving influence and alignment across teams, and building scalable mechanisms in fast-paced environments. Over time, this role has opportunity to evolve toward broader technical program management style leadership responsibilities.

Your role

Business Partnership & Operational Enablement

  • Partner closely with Technical, Engineering, Operations, Procurement, and Risk stakeholders to shape scalable business processes and controls.
  • Engage early with teams to influence decisions, identify risks, and enable efficient execution.
  • Translate risk and controls requirements into practical, actionable operating mechanisms.

Risk & Controls Integration

  • Design and improve scalable controls, guardrails, and operational frameworks that support business velocity while managing risk appropriately.
  • Simplify and modernize existing processes to align with evolving business needs and risk appetite.
  • Ensure controls are operationally practical and embedded into day-to-day workflows.

Business Process & Mechanism Ownership

  • Identify process gaps, friction points, and operational inefficiencies across programs and workflows.
  • Build mechanisms, playbooks, decision frameworks, and scalable patterns that improve consistency and reduce ambiguity.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across governance, operational readiness, and execution processes.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Audit Readiness

  • Act as a business partner to Procurement teams and a key coordination point across Risk, Audit, Assurance, Legal, Technical and Engineering teams.
  • Streamline audit readiness and evidence gathering through scalable operational processes rather than manual coordination.
  • Ensure teams have clarity on ownership, expectations, and escalation paths.

Technical & Operational Collaboration

  • Engage effectively with technical teams by understanding system architecture, workflows, dependencies, and operational trade-offs.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure controls and operational requirements are designed into solutions early.
  • Use data and operational signals to identify risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.

What good looks like for this role:

  • Procurement teams and functional partners proactively engage you as a trusted partner early in planning and execution.
  • Decisions move faster because of your involvement, not slower.
  • Processes become simpler, clearer, and more scalable over time.
  • Risk Management and controls are embedded into operational workflows rather than managed as separate activities.
  • Stakeholders experience clear ownership, practical guidance, and streamlined engagement across governance functions.

  • Candidates who operate primarily through approvals or gatekeeping or arm's length approach
  • Candidates who identify problems without driving practical solutions.

job.title: Principal Network Architect, Backbone Network
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Role Summary

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity at Firmus, you will lead the architecture and technical assurance of the backbone connectivity platform that underpins the Firmus AI Factory ecosystem and Firmus AI Cloud. The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support of the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity, with focus on building and evolving Firmus’s national and international backbone across terrestrial and subsea networks, optical transport, IP backbone, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity.

The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity.

This role is responsible for the technical integrity of the backbone architecture across the full lifecycle, from concept and design assurance through delivery readiness, operational resilience and continuous improvement. You will work across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers, data-centre partners and internal engineering teams to ensure Firmus’s network connectivity is high-performance, secure, operationally robust and ready to scale with the company’s AI infrastructure growth.

Key Responsibilities

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity, you will own the technical architecture of Firmus's backbone network and act as the principal technical adviser to the Head of Connectivity, while operating as a senior technical lead within the Network Engineering team. You will convert the Firmus Connectivity Strategy into an integrated, executable backbone architecture spanning subsea and terrestrial fibre, optical transport (DWDM/OTN), IP/MPLS and segment routing, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. You will define the reference architecture, standards and reusable design patterns that guide engineers and partners, ensuring every AI Factory and Firmus AI Cloud service attaches through resilient, diverse and scalable backbone nodes free of unmanaged common-mode failure.

Working across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers and data-centre partners, you will set minimum resilience profiles, validate physical-route and shared-risk-link-group diversity, and provide independent technical assurance that designs can be delivered, operated and scaled safely across their full lifecycle. You will act as technical design authority in vendor and technology selection for backbone and subsea services, lead complex backbone changes and cutovers, mentor the engineering team, and benchmark Firmus's designs against leading global operators and hyperscalers — keeping Firmus at the forefront of AI-ready network connectivity.

What you’ll bring

You are, first and foremost, an accomplished network architect for large-scale, mission-critical connectivity infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in national and international backbone design across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea systems, including landing-station connectivity, cable-landing diversity, and terrestrial route and duct engineering. You are fluent in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent and client-side optics, ROADM and amplification/regeneration planning) and in IP backbone design, including IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange, and high-capacity data-centre and customer interconnection. You understand how to design resilient, diverse networks free of unmanaged common-mode failure, using SRLG analysis, engineered failure-state capacity and physical-route evidence to prove your claims rather than assert them.

Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading architecture and design reviews, carrier and technology-vendor governance, technical evaluation of backbone and subsea services, change control, cutover planning, and operational-readiness and handover to network operations. You have authored or materially shaped reference architectures, design standards, reusable patterns and architecture decision records at a hyperscale operator, carrier, or equivalent, and you know how to keep an architecture modular and vendor-neutral so the business can flex across managed services, wavelengths, dark fibre and subsea assets as demand and economics change. You are comfortable engaging carriers, subsea consortia, internet exchanges and major equipment vendors, and you can drive value engineering and sustainability outcomes without compromising resilience or performance.

Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under delivery and incident pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of network engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI-ready network connectivity that performs reliably from day one and positions Firmus as a leader in the field.

Skills & Experience

The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in network and connectivity engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related discipline, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience designing and operating large-scale backbone networks across carrier, hyperscale, cloud or specialist AI infrastructure environments. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as a principal-level network architect or distinguished engineer on national and international backbone programmes, and a proven track record owning reference architectures, design standards and technical assurance across a portfolio of concurrent connectivity initiatives.

This experience should include end-to-end design and delivery across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea cable systems — including landing-station connectivity, route and duct diversity, and SRLG-based resilience modelling — alongside deep expertise in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent optics, 100G/400G/800G) and IP backbone design (IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange). They will have led technical evaluations of carriers, subsea operators and equipment vendors, defined the technical sections of RFPs and evaluation criteria, and worked effectively across the design-to-operate interface with Network Engineering, Data Centre and Operations teams.

Experience authoring or contributing materially to global backbone reference architecture, minimum standards or interconnection strategy at a hyperscale, carrier or AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia, Australia and Singapore — under diverse regulatory, licensing and provider conditions. Above all, the successful candidate will combine hands-on architectural depth with the influence and communication skills to lead as a senior technical authority

  • *

Location & Reporting

  • This role is based in Sydney, Australia.
  • Reporting to Senior Manager, Networking

**

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Compliance Specialist
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Specialist Compliance Lead is responsible for developing and maintaining the organisation's compliance, governance and assurance activities to ensure ongoing compliance with regulatory, legal, contractual and corporate obligations. Operating within a highly regulated and scrutinised data centre and cloud technology environment, the role ensures compliance to organisation-wide policies, standards, laws, frameworks, and management systems.

The role acts as a trusted advisor to the Head of Risk & Compliance and business stakeholders, ensuring governance and compliance obligations are embedded within business operations, technology platforms and company initiatives. The position plays a critical role in supporting enterprise wide governance processes, maintaining stakeholder confidence, and promoting a culture of integrity, accountability and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Risk and Compliance

  • Develop, implement and ensure continuous improvement of the Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) framework.
  • Maintain regulatory obligations, compliance registers and policy frameworks.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments and coordinate implementation of compliance requirements across the business.
  • Provide governance and compliance reporting to Senior Management.

Assurance and Audit

  • Coordinate internal and external audits, compliance reviews and assurance programs.
  • Monitor findings and remediation activities to completion.
  • Develop compliance monitoring and testing programs.
  • Support regulatory reviews, customer due diligence assessments and certification activities.

Third Party Risk and Operational Resilience

  • Maintain oversight of third-party risk management processes and supplier compliance requirements.
  • Support business continuity, operational resilience and crisis management programs.
  • Monitor contractual compliance obligations relating to security, privacy and regulatory requirements.

ESG and Corporate Responsibility

  • Support environmental, social and governance (ESG) reporting obligations.
  • Assist with sustainability reporting, governance disclosures and assurance activities.
  • Monitor emerging ESG regulatory requirements and industry expectations

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Five to eight years of experiences acquired in governance, risk, compliance, assurance or internal audit roles.
  • Strong understanding of corporate governance and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting audits, certifications and regulatory compliance programs.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and reporting capabilities.

Desirable

  • Experience within a highly regulated organisation.
  • Knowledge of information security, privacy and cyber security frameworks.
  • Experience supporting Board and Audit & Risk Committee reporting.
  • Familiarity with ESG reporting, operational governance requirements.
  • Experience with GRC platforms and compliance management systems.

Qualifications

  • Degree qualification in Business, Law, Governance, Accounting, Commerce or a related discipline.
  • Relevant professional certifications.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Sydney, Australia
  • Reports to: Head of Risk & Compliance

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Head of Physical Security - Data Centres
job.description:
About Goodman

At Goodman, your career is more than just a job – it’s about growth, innovation, and making a lasting impact. Whether you’re building your career in property, data centres, finance, legal, or beyond, we value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about driving our business forward.

As providers of essential infrastructure for the digital economy, Goodman has been developing its data centre capability since 2005. Since then, we have grown to become a large owner of powered sites globally. Our global power bank of 5.0GW includes completed facilities, secured power and potential data centre projects across 13 major international cities. This has been built up over time through our expertise in securing land, planning and power in highly sought after locations in major global cities.

We are seeking an experienced Head of Physical Security, Data Centres to establish and lead the physical security strategy, governance framework and operating model across our growing portfolio. Reporting to the General Manager, IT, Cyber and Security – Data Centres, this role will work closely with senior leaders across Critical Environments, Operations, Design, Construction, Digital Integration, Property and Enterprise Security.

This is a unique opportunity to build and mature a security function from the ground up while influencing the design, construction and operation of some of Australia's most critical digital infrastructure.

The Opportunity

  • As Head of Physical Security, you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction for physical security across the data centre lifecycle, from site selection and design through to construction, commissioning, operations and customer assurance.
  • You will lead the development of security standards, governance frameworks and assurance programs while ensuring physical security controls align with cyber, information security and operational technology requirements.
  • You will also act as the senior security representative for customers, regulators, industry bodies and government agencies, helping ensure our facilities meet the highest standards of resilience, compliance and trust.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Security Across the Data Centre Lifecycle

  • Establish and execute the physical security strategy, standards and roadmap for the data centre portfolio.
  • Embed security-by-design principles into new data centre developments and major capital projects.
  • Provide leadership throughout design, construction, commissioning and operational readiness phases.
  • Ensure physical security requirements are considered alongside uptime, resiliency, customer commitments and operational outcomes.

Protect Critical Infrastructure

  • Lead the design and assurance of layered security controls including:

Access control systems

  • CCTV and video management platforms
  • Perimeter intrusion detection
  • Vehicle and pedestrian access management
  • Visitor management systems
  • Security Operations Centres
  • Guard force operations

Develop and maintain site security plans, response procedures and escalation frameworks. Lead threat, vulnerability and risk assessments across existing and future sites.

Customer Security & Assurance

  • Act as the senior physical security contact for hyperscale, cloud and enterprise customers.
  • Support customer audits, security questionnaires, inspections and due diligence activities.
  • Ensure facilities meet customer assurance requirements and security obligations.
  • Partner with customers to understand emerging security expectations and incorporate them into future planning.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Own physical security policies, standards and assurance programmes across the portfolio.
  • Lead audit preparation, evidence management, compliance reviews and remediation activities.
  • Maintain alignment with industry and government security frameworks including:

Hosting Certification Framework (HCF)

  • Defence Industry Security Program (DISP)
  • PSPF
  • ISO 27001
  • SOC and customer assurance requirements

Contribute to broader cyber and information security governance where physical security controls support overall security outcomes.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Function

  • Establish and mature the physical security operating model for the data centre business.
  • Lead strategic relationships with guarding providers, security integrators, consultants and specialist advisers.
  • Develop future organisational capability, succession plans and leadership frameworks.
  • Provide executive-level reporting and risk insights to senior leadership.

About You

  • 10+ years' experience in physical security, protective security, critical infrastructure or mission-critical environments.
  • Direct experience supporting hyperscale, colocation or large-scale data centre operations is essential
  • Demonstrated success developing and implementing physical security strategies, governance frameworks and assurance programmes.
  • Strong knowledge of data centre security technologies, including electronic access control, CCTV, perimeter detection and security operations centres
  • .Experience managing customer audits, security reviews and compliance obligations
  • Knowledge of PSPF, DISP, HCF, ISO 27001 and other security and assurance frameworks.
  • Experience operating within converged physical, cyber and operational technology environments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement and executive communication skills.

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

job.title: Specialist, Indirect Procurement
job.description:
Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the Role

  • Support strategic sourcing and procurement activities across indirect spend categories to achieve cost savings, process efficiency, compliance, and supplier performance objectives.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to manage sourcing, contracting, supplier engagement, spend analysis, and purchase requisition requirements.
  • Drive procurement best practices, policy compliance, and data-driven decision-making to deliver business value and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute sourcing and procurement activities across indirect categories such as IT, Professional Services, Marketing, Facilities, HR, Travel, Fleet, MRO, and Corporate Services.
  • Conduct spend analysis and identify cost-saving, productivity, and supplier optimization opportunities.
  • Manage RFx processes including RFI, RFP, RFQ, bid analysis, supplier evaluation, and negotiation support.
  • Collaborate with Category Managers, business stakeholders, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to support sourcing initiatives.
  • Support contract review processes and ensure all sourcing activities adhere to procurement policies and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor supplier performance and assist in developing supplier scorecards and governance processes.
  • Create and maintain procurement dashboards, savings trackers, sourcing pipelines, and management reports.
  • Support purchase requisition (PR) to purchase order (PO) processes and resolve procurement-related operational issues.
  • Ensure data accuracy in procurement systems such as SAP Ariba, SAP, Coupa, Oracle, or equivalent platforms.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, automation opportunities, and process standardization within procurement operations.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Procurement, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 6-8 years of experience in Indirect Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, or Category Management support.
  • Strong understanding of sourcing methodologies, supplier management, contract management, and procurement processes.
  • Experience working with procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, SAP, Coupa, Oracle, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis/reporting.
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global procurement operations across multiple regions is preferred.
  • Professional certifications such as CPSM, CIPS, CSCP, or equivalent are an added advantage.

Preferred Competencies

  • Strategic Sourcing
  • Spend Analytics

  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • SAP Ariba / Procurement Systems
  • Continuous Improvement & Automation

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Lead to drive AI-powered engineering transformation across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The ideal candidate will lead the design, development, adoption, and governance of enterprise-scale AI accelerators that improve software productivity, quality, modernization, knowledge management, and engineering efficiency.

The role involves building and scaling AI-driven platforms, collaborating with business units and engineering organizations, driving technology modernization programs, and establishing best practices for AI adoption across global teams. This position will work closely with architects, product teams, engineering leaders, cloud providers, and external technology partners to shape the future of AI-enabled engineering.

Responsibilities

AI Product & Platform

  • Development and enhancement of AI-powered engineering platforms and accelerators.
  • Drive the roadmap for solutions supporting requirements management, software design, coding, testing, knowledge management, and software modernization.
  • Define reusable architectures, frameworks, and engineering standards for AI-enabled platforms.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and AI tools to accelerate engineering productivity.

Software Productivity & SDLC Transformation

  • Implement AI solutions across the end-to-end V-Model / SDLC lifecycle.
  • Establish developer productivity initiatives using AI coding assistants and engineering accelerators.
  • Design and deploy solutions for:

Intelligent Requirements Engineering

  • AI-assisted Architecture & Design
  • AI-powered Code Generation & Analysis
  • Automated Testing & Validation
  • Knowledge Discovery & Enterprise Search
  • DevOps & Operations Automation

Engineering Modernization

  • Lead application modernization initiatives including:

Legacy code understanding

  • Platform migration
  • Technology upgrades
  • Re-platforming programs

Develop AI-based approaches for modernization assessment and execution.

Create engineering insights and diagnostics for software health, technical debt, and performance optimization.

AI Governance & Adoption

  • Establish AI governance frameworks, guardrails, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with security, legal, compliance, and enterprise architecture teams.
  • Define responsible AI adoption processes and maturity models.
  • Measure and report productivity savings, quality improvements, and business impact.

Stakeholder & BU Engagement

job.title: Associate Director, Global People Experience
job.description:
Role: Associate Director, Global People Experience

Location: Hyderabad

Full/ Part-time: Full Time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the role

The HR Ops Assoc Director position influences business decisions made by leadership and recommends functional strategies and operational plans with direct impact on results. Recognized within the organization as a thought leader in area of expertise. Problems are complex and require extensive investigation and analysis. Requires communication with executive leadership. Establishes and implements critical functional strategies and operational plans for the area of responsibility, with impact on the achievement of results. Focus is on medium to-long term strategies (e.g., 2 - 3 years) to achieve business results, which may require substantial development of new processes, standards or operational plans. Typically negotiates and compromises to influence internal and external parties to accept concepts, practices and approaches of the job area. Requires ability to communicate with senior executive leadership regarding matters of strategic importance to the organization. Frequently conducts briefings to senior leaders both within and outside of the function. Requires expert knowledge of multiple work areas typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience.

Key Responsibilities

Experience Strategy & Design

  • Define and evolve the future‑state experience strategy and design principles for key employee and manager journeys, with explicit ownership of HR experience design for onboarding and offboarding.
  • Lead experience design for high‑impact “moments that matter”, ensuring experiences are simple, consistent, and human‑centered across geographies.
  • Apply service design, journey mapping, and customer‑centric methodologies to improve usability, reduce friction, and strengthen trust in HR services.
  • Embed co‑creation with employees, managers, and HR stakeholders into experience discovery and design.
  • Inspire customers and key stakeholders by crafting tailored communications and engaging storytelling, delivering key messages via focus groups, preview briefings, Town Halls, internal communications platforms and other vehicles.

**

Digital, Automation & AI‑Enabled Experiences

  • Shape and maintain a global digital experience roadmap spanning:Workday Journeys and self‑service experiences
  • Leveraging knowledge, search, guidance, and notification capabilities to enable intuitive, self-serve experiences
  • Agentic HR support, including employee-facing HR agents and AI-enabled experiences

Identify and apply opportunities for automation and AI‑enabled capabilities, including the use of Copilot and agent‑based approaches, to improve experience quality, speed, and decision support. Translate experience intent into clear solution design direction and priorities for HR Technology and Digital teams. Lead the design, piloting, and scaling of new digital capabilities aligned to enterprise platforms and standards.

Orchestration & Cross‑Functional Leadership

  • Orchestrate delivery across HR Technology, HR Shared Services, COEs, Digital teams, and vendors, aligning stakeholders around a shared experience vision and outcomes.
  • Establish experience standards, success measures, and design guardrails that guide implementation and continuous improvement.
  • Act as a strategic connector and escalation point, supporting alignment and effective decision‑making where experience, service delivery, and technology intersect.
  • Continually review and adjust priorities as business needs change; manage multiple workstreams/project with an agile mindset.

Insight, Influence & Governance

  • Use Voice of Customer, experience analytics, self‑service insights, and operational signals to shape priorities and roadmap decisions.
  • Regularly engage with senior HR and enterprise leaders, providing briefings on experience strategy, progress, insights, and outcomes.
  • Balance innovation with governance, ensuring experiences align to risk, compliance, and enterprise requirements.
  • Stay connected to external best practices and emerging trends in digital employee experience, automation, and AI.

Requirements

  • 10+ years’ experience in managing complex processes, together with practical application of process improvement and project/change management methodologies
  • Demonstrated experience designing and evolving digital employee or manager experiences, ideally using enterprise platforms.
  • Technology driven, with experience of process design in Workday, Service Now, or equivalent software and tools, preferably in an enterprise environment.
  • Excellent storytelling skills; ability to assist others in understanding new ways of working and influencing them to try new ways of doing business without direct control in a matrixed and collaborative environment.
  • Experience documenting processes, assessing useful key metrics, critical thinking, and very comfortable “living in the details” of the process.
  • Collaborative, adept at partnering with diverse HR teams and stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Preferred / Additional Requirements (Non‑essential but strongly advantageous)

  • Experience applying automation, AI, or Copilot‑enabled solutions within HR or enterprise environments.
  • Background in experience design, service design, digital transformation, or product‑led delivery.
  • Experience designing and scaling Workday Journeys or similar guided experiences.
  • Familiarity with knowledge‑led self‑service, intelligent routing, or agent‑based interaction models.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.

  • Have peace of mind and body with our health insurance
  • Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
  • Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!
