job.title: Underground Technologies Sr. Project Lead
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About Caterpillar & MineStar

Caterpillar is a global leader in mining technology, delivering integrated solutions that improve safety, productivity, and operational performance.

Cat® MineStar™ Solutions is our flagship digital platform, connecting equipment, people, and data across mining operations. Through advanced automation, tracking, safety, and productivity technologies, MineStar enables customers to operate more efficiently while supporting safer and more autonomous mining environments.

The Underground Technologies team develops and supports a broad portfolio of solutions including automation and tele-remote machine operation, positioning and production recording, people and vehicle tracking, and proximity awareness and collision avoidance systems. These solutions are deployed globally and help customers safely and efficiently manage their underground mining operations.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Sr. Project Lead - Underground Technologies to lead investigation and resolution activities for customer-reported issues across Caterpillar’s underground technology portfolio.

This role sits at the intersection of customer support, engineering, product development, and validation. You will work closely with product support teams, deployment specialists, systems engineers, software developers, architects, and validation teams to understand complex customer challenges, perform deep technical analysis, and drive engineering improvements that enhance product quality and customer outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Lead Customer Issue Resolution

  • Lead a small technical team responsible for daily customer issue triage across the Underground Technologies product portfolio.
  • Work closely with Product Support, Deployment, and Application Specialists to understand customer-reported issues and prioritise investigation activities.
  • Facilitate technical discussions across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Track issue progress from initial report through analysis, root cause identification, and resolution.

Drive Technical Analysis

  • Perform detailed analysis of customer and engineering data to understand system behaviour and identify root causes.
  • Develop advanced data collection and experimentation plans to support complex investigations.
  • Apply modern data analysis techniques and AI-assisted tools to accelerate problem solving and engineering decisions.
  • Identify product improvement opportunities through analysis of customer issues and operational trends.

Partner with Engineering Teams

  • Work with architects and software engineering teams to determine corrective actions and long-term product improvements.
  • Support implementation and validation of engineering solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for cross-functional investigations involving hardware, software, communications, and operational systems.

Improve Product Quality

  • Partner with Systems Integration and Validation teams to improve engineering test coverage, data collection methods, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Develop better validation approaches for identifying issues before deployment.
  • Drive continuous improvement in root cause analysis and product quality processes.

Support Underground Technology Solutions

  • Automation and Tele-remote capabilities for LHDs
  • Positioning and Production Recording systems
  • People and Vehicle Tracking solutions
  • Proximity Awareness and Collision Avoidance technologies

Stakeholder Leadership

Partner with:

  • Product Support and Deployment teams to understand customer challenges
  • Software, Systems, and Architecture teams to develop effective solutions
  • Integration and Validation teams to improve product robustness
  • Global customers and mining operations to support data-driven investigations

Act as a technical leader who can align teams, communicate complex findings, and drive resolution of highly complex system-level issues.

What You Bring

Experience

  • Previous experience in underground mining and mining technologies.
  • Technical leadership experience leading teams or complex engineering initiatives.
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving complex systems issues in operational environments.
  • Experience working across multiple engineering disciplines including software, systems, integration, and validation.

Capabilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to lead investigations involving multiple stakeholders and technical disciplines.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to influence technical direction and drive alignment across organisations.
  • Experience working in global cross-functional teams.

Technical & Domain Knowledge

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

  • Underground mining technologies
  • Data analytics and data science
  • AI-based tools for data analysis
  • Mining automation and tele-remote systems
  • Positioning and production management systems
  • People and vehicle tracking technologies
  • Proximity awareness and collision avoidance systems
  • Systems integration and validation

What Success Looks Like

  • Faster identification and resolution of customer-reported issues.
  • Improved product quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Strong collaboration between support, engineering, and validation teams.
  • Better engineering data collection and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Measurable improvements delivered across Caterpillar’s Underground Technology products.

Why Join Us

  • Work on some of the most advanced underground mining technologies in the world.
  • Help shape the future of underground automation and autonomy.
  • Solve challenging real-world engineering problems impacting mining operations globally.
  • Influence product quality and technology strategy across a growing portfolio.
  • Be part of a highly collaborative global team focused on innovation, safety, and customer success.

Additional Information

Location:This position can be based in either Perth (Bibra Lake) or Brisbane

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

August 12, 2026 - August 27, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Assembler III-1
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

岗位目标: 完成普通或者关键工作岗位的各类装配测试任务

岗位职责:

1、完成由工艺或者产品定义的普通或者关键工作岗位的装配工作，可能包括装配、测试、诊断电气系统或者其它控制系统

2、在职有能力培训装配学徒工或装配技工，帮助他们取得不同装配工位的工作资格认证。

3、参与班前流程改进对话，积极提出生产中发现的问题和建议, 认真听取主管的各项要求

4、严格执行岗位PPE的穿戴规定，严格遵守各项安全规定避免安全伤害事故的发生

积极参与发现生产过程中存在的问题和风险，积极提交持续改进建议卡

6、按时完成公司要求的各项培训，自主完成对工作有益的其他培训

7、主动学习CPS和6 Sigma的知识并将相关知识应用到工作中

8、严格执行标准化工作流程及其他各项质量管理规定，避免质量缺陷的发生

9、积极配合质量管理人员分析发生质量问题的根本原因并按要求执行改进措施，避免类似问题再次发生

10、严格按照计划实施生产、努力提高工作效率

11、当因原材料、设备及质量等原因导致生产中断时应及时报告生产主管或领班，以便尽快恢复生产或安排其他生产任务

按要求完成5S和TPM (全面生产力维护) 工作

13、积极关注成本节约，努力消除工作中的各项浪费

14、严格执行公司的其他各项规章制度, 及时完成主管或领班安排的其他工作其他工作

背景/经验:

1、正直，良好的沟通能力，强烈的责任心和团队精神；

2、中专及以上学历，机械专业，能读懂机械图纸, 了解一般的技术要求, 如公差配合等；

3、至少拥有中级钳工操作证；

4、具备良好的安全和质量意识, 严格按规定和流程操作；

5、具备良好的5S和TPM (全员生产维护) 理念；

6、具备简单日常英语阅读能力，了解简单的英语装配术语；

7、具备简单的计算机操作能力 ；

8、有三年以上外部装配经验或者一年以上内部的装配经验；

9、取得至少两个普通工位和一个关键工位的工作资格认证；需要至少在最近一年度取得有价值的工作表现。

JOB PURPOSE

Perform a variety of assembly/test tasks for both normal and/or critical work stations

JOB DUTIES

1、Perform assembly for normal and/or critical work stations defined by process and product, the task may involve assembling, testing, diagnosing electrical system or other control system

2、Train assembly apprentices or assembly technicians to help them get work certification for normal assembly work station

3、Participates in pre-shift PID (Process Improvement Dialogue), raise the issues and suggestions per the passed production, and follow all requirements from supervisor

4、Wears the required PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) of his position properly. Strictly follow all safety policy to avoid any injury

5、Actively participate in finding issues and risks during production, and submit them by CI (Continue Improvement) cards actively

6、Finish all required training on time, and finish all other work-related trainings that are helpful to his/her job

7、Learns all work-related knowledge of CPS & 6 sigma actively and apply them to his/her job

8、Performs Standard Work Sheet and all other quality management policy and guideline to avoid quality issue

9、Actively works with related people to analyze the root cause of quality issue, and take the action per requirement to avoid similar issue happens again

10、Perform production per schedule completely, and continuously improve efficiency

11、Timely report to operation supervisor or team lead when the production shut down because of material, equipment and quality issues, in order to recover to production ASAP or change the schedule

12、Perform 5S and TPM (Total Productivity Maintenance) per requirement

13、Actively focus on cost saving, and continuously eliminate all sorts of waste among his/her job

14、Seriously perform all policies and guidelines, and finish any other job, which is arranged by the supervisor or team lead

BACKGROUND/EXPERIENCE:

1、Be integrity, good communication skill, strong consciousness at commitment and team work

2、Technical Secondary School or equal education background, major in mechanic. Can read mechanic print, and know normal technical requirement such as tolerance and fit and so on

3、Got semi-senior certification at least for bench work

4、Good consciousness of safety and quality, seriously follow all policies and guidelines

5、Good consciousness of 5S & TPM

6、Can read simple information in English; Know simple English assembly term

7、Can do simple computer operation

8、Has worked as an external assembly technician over 3 years, or worked as an internal assembly technician over 1 year.

9、Got at least 2 work certifications of normal assembly station and 1 certification for critical assembly station; Should get Valued Performance at least in last year

Posting Dates:

八月 18, 2026 - 八月 30, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Production Support Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Schedules, plans and oversees material procurement, production and delivery processes.

Responsibilities

  • Participates in scheduling production and delivery processes in accordance with current productivity and cost efficiency standards.
  • Develops and executes material planning for a product line to ensure that all material requirements for assigned programs are met within the allocated time frame.
  • Organizes the flow of materials within the manufacturing unit and the transferring of materials to and from the inventory or warehouse.
  • Generates forecasts and manages replenishment planning for parts and materials to ensure specified service levels are met.

Degree Requirement

Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP): Knowledge of the process, issues and considerations for systematically managing distribution of inventory for multiple plants or warehouses; ability to apply related knowledge and experience in real practice.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Works with real-time inventory software, moving supplies to where needed, when needed.
  • Interprets the impact of bottlenecks and delays on operating costs.
  • Follows processes and applies technologies for items and inventory management.
  • Assists in solving issues related to distribution to meet orders or inventory replenishment requirements.
  • Works with basic distribution requirements planning (DRP) processes and operations.

Internal Resource Coordination: Knowledge of the techniques, tools and applications associated with coordination of internal resources; ability to synchronize and integrate activities, responsibilities, and command and control structures to ensure that internal resources are used most efficiently in pursuit of business objectives.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies basic characteristics of good business relationships or partnerships.
  • Attends training to learn coordination skills with individuals and groups.
  • Lists major techniques, tools and approaches for resource coordination.
  • Describes the organization's culture and policies for coordinating with others.

Manufacturing Requirements Planning (MRP): Knowledge of the processes, practices and systems used in manufacturing requirements planning (MRP); ability to optimize planning for manufacturing cycles and ensure capacity and materials availability.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes basic concepts of materials and capacity management processes and procedures.
  • Describes product life cycle and associated MRP cycle.
  • Identifies parameters and considerations used in making decisions about production runs.
  • Describes the use of bills of materials and other documentation needed to provide supplies.

Materials Handling and Management: Knowledge of material handling and management in plants; ability to perform, monitor and improve processes related to storage, transportation and handling of raw and hazardous materials.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies key issues involved with different types of manufacturing materials.
  • Discusses considerations for physical management of major types of materials.
  • Identifies types of materials used in manufacturing flagship products or components.
  • Describes packaging regulations and locates those specific to the requirements of the situation.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Seeks help to modify priorities as new information surfaces or conditions change.
  • Demonstrates the ability to estimate the time and resources required to complete tasks.
  • Identifies own key assignments, schedules, and process steps.
  • Applies the concept of 'critical path' in order to complete work in a timely manner and keep larger tasks on track.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the value of a disciplined approach to problem solving.
  • Describes problem reporting and escalation practices.
  • Utilizes accepted procedures for problem analysis and resolution.
  • Identifies key aspects of problem-solving techniques used in own area.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Provides examples of the characteristics of effective business relationships.
  • Identifies key business relationships in own organization.
  • Describes the nature of a productive business relationship.
  • Explains the benefits of building business partnerships.

This position requires the candidate to work a 5-day-a-week schedule in the office.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

八月 19, 2026 - 九月 1, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: GL Accountant
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The General Ledger (GL) Accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate accounting records, supporting month-end and year-end close activities, preparing reconciliations, assisting with tax and statutory compliance, maintaining finance systems and ensuring transactions are recorded in accordance with company policies and accounting standards.

What You Will Do: ​

General Ledger Accounting & Month-End Close

  • Prepare journal entries, accruals and supporting schedules.
  • Perform balance sheet, bank and intercompany reconciliations and resolve reconciling items.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records, working papers and audit-ready documentation.
  • Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies and system-related issues.

Tax, Statutory Compliance & Audit Support

  • Prepare GST/VAT returns and supporting schedules.
  • Support corporate tax filings, statutory reporting and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with e-invoicing administration and compliance documentation.
  • Prepare audit schedules and respond to auditor and tax agent requests.
  • Ensure accounting records comply with company policies and local regulations.

Regional Financial Operations & Expense Management

  • Support day-to-day finance operations and accounting transactions across multiple legal entities and countries.
  • Support customer invoicing and revenue-related accounting activities.
  • Review employee expense claims and ensure accurate GL coding.
  • Administer and maintain expense management processes, including Concur.

Controls & Process Documentation

  • Support account analysis, variance investigations and reconciliations.
  • Follow established internal controls and highlight identified control gaps.
  • Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures and supporting records.

Systems Support & Continuous Improvement

  • Support ERP, Concur and finance system testing, implementation and enhancements.
  • Assist with data cleanup, standardisation and reporting improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in finance integration activities and process improvement projects.
  • Work closely with the COE on finance transformation initiatives, including strategy alignment, process standardisation and operating model improvements.
  • Support the development of reports and tools that improve accounting accuracy and efficiency.
  • Perform other ad hoc accounting, compliance, reporting and finance-related duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Degree in Accountancy, Finance or related discipline.
  • Min. 3 to 5 years of accounting experience, preferably in a multinational environment.
  • Good understanding of general ledger accounting, reconciliations, GST/VAT and month-end close processes.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP/accounting systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet reporting deadlines.
  • Able to work independently and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders.

Additional Info: ​

  • This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  • Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of Singapore which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).
  • International Assignment is not available.

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Final Details:

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Posting Dates:

August 25, 2026 - September 7, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: MineStar® Site Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar is seeking a MineStar® Site Manager to join our Underground Mining Technology team.

Based in Perth or Brisbane on an international FIFO roster, this role supports MineStar® Fleet and Command for Underground systems at Freeport Indonesia. As Caterpillar’s senior representative on site, you will work closely with customer leadership teams to develop, implement and manage product support strategies, equipment management processes and technology adoption initiatives that deliver measurable operational outcomes.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced mining technology professional to lead customer engagement and drive the long-term success of autonomous and fleet management solutions at one of the world's largest underground mining operations.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Acting as Caterpillar's primary MineStar® representative and trusted advisor at site
  • Developing strategies to improve technology performance, fleet utilisation and customer outcomes
  • Monitoring key site performance metrics including availability, production, operating costs, utilisation and safety
  • Identifying customer needs and supporting the deployment of new products, technologies and services
  • Providing guidance on equipment management, technology adoption and operational improvement initiatives
  • Leading the resolution of complex operational and technical issues
  • Supporting system implementation, upgrades and continuous improvement activities
  • Analysing performance data to identify optimisation opportunities
  • Aligning Caterpillar support activities with customer objectives and recovery strategies
  • Coaching and developing site personnel to maximise capability and system utilisation

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, IT, Software Engineering or a related discipline, required to meet Indonesian work visa eligibility requirements
  • Significant experience in mining technology, MineStar®, fleet management systems, automation or operational technology (OT)
  • Strong knowledge of mining operations, equipment management and operational improvement
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across operational and leadership teams
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with a focus on customer success
  • Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency, and the ability to obtain and maintain all visas, work permits and approvals required to work in Indonesia

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary based on qualifications and professional industry experience.

The Total Rewards package includes:

  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Site, Shift and FIFO Allowances
  • Attractive Bonus and Share options
  • Career development with global prospects
  • A strong commitment to safety and your wellbeing
  • An inclusive workplace culture focused on quality, customer service and the environment
  • A commitment to diversity and inclusion, equal opportunity and equal outcome
  • SMART spending APP
  • The opportunity to do truly meaningful work in a supportive, constructive culture that encourages you to make the most of your talents

Additional Information

  • FIFO roster
  • Candidates must be based in Australia and meet the requirements to obtain an Indonesian work visa

How to Apply

If you're ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role with a global industry leader, apply via:

www.caterpillar.com/careers

Your road to success begins with Caterpillar.

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact.

_Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer._

_Caterpillar of Australia is not currently hiring applicants who require sponsorship. As a global company, opportunities may be available in other locations via our careers website._

This position requires working onsite five days a week. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Solution Lead Architect - SAP Sales & Distribution
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Solution Lead (SAP Sales and Distribution (SD))to join our OTC-Machine Orders SAP&CMOPS-CAT IT Division.

Caterpillar is seeking a highly qualified SAP Sales and Distribution (SD) Solution Lead to join our Order to Cash (OTC) team. This individual will play a pivotal role in implementing technical solutions that align with our evolving business objectives and support strategic growth initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in SAP SD, demonstrated experience leading complex solution designs, and successful implementation of intricate order scenarios and pricing procedures. This position requires effective leadership within a global, collaborative environment, working closely with other OTC Solution Leads, functional leads, technical programmers, and various IT teams. Acting as both a strategic advisor and partner to multiple business units, the Solution Lead will be responsible for gathering requirements, developing tailored solutions, preparing project cost estimates, and overseeing project deployments and enhancements. The role often involves addressing unique and complex challenges, necessitating strong analytical skills and innovative approaches. The incumbent may be required to adapt existing processes or develop new methodologies based on a comprehensive understanding of business operations and unit-specific needs. Additionally, this role is accountable for establishing, implementing, and monitoring policies and guidelines to ensure projects meet management objectives and deliver desired outcomes. As an advisor and consultant, the Solution Lead will also support groups in achieving quality improvements as specified by key performance measures.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield PSN Office, Bangalore, India

What You Will Do

  • Deliver SAP SD/OTC solutions aligned to enterprise templates and business objectives.
  • Offer expert guidance to SAP SD/OTC support teams and integration partners.
  • Analyze, document, and revise business processes and system logic as needed.
  • Collaborate with business partners to understand operations and benchmark best practices.
  • Advise on business case analysis and multi-generational product planning.
  • Design business processes that support Caterpillar's strategic goals.
  • Provide recommendations to Process Owners and serve as a subject matter consultant.
  • Lead and drive complex solution implementations and provide project leadership.
  • Create high-level test plans to ensure quality and efficiency.
  • Oversee User Acceptance Testing and script sign-off for key releases.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships through effective communication and leadership.
  • Identify opportunities, assess risks, and ensure alignment with strategic outcomes.
  • Design and configure pricing procedures, including condition tables and types.
  • Demonstrate expertise in OTC processes and related business functions.

What You Have:

  • Core Application Systems: Extensive knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  • Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Extensive knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan.
  • Products and Services: Working knowledge of major products and services and product and service groups; ability to apply knowledge of product and service appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Analytical Thinking: Expert knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.
  • Application Delivery Process: Extensive knowledge of major tasks, deliverables, and formal application delivery methodologies; ability to utilize these to deliver new or enhanced applications.
  • Architecture Modeling: Working knowledge of Architecture Modeling; ability to develop and modify enterprise architecture through conceptual, logical and physical approaches.
  • Information Security Technologies: Basic knowledge of technologies and technology-based solutions dealing with information security issues; ability to protect information security across the organization using encryption technologies and appropriate security software.
  • System and Technology Integration: Expert knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

Top Candidates Will Also Have:

  • Four-year bachelor’s degree preferably in computer science, information systems, engineering, or related field.
  • 15+ years of SAP Sales & Distribution focused IT experience.
  • Demonstrated leadership in large-scale ERP implementations and transformations.
  • Proficient in integration technologies such as Snap Logic or API’s.
  • Exceptional presentation, oral, and written communication abilities.
  • Extensive experience designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining software at scale.
  • Recognized as an expert level SAP SD functional consultant with comprehensive knowledge of invoicing, pricing procedures, sales order conversions, loan processes, system configuration (SPRO), and interface management.
  • Adept at collaborating with business partners to translate requirements into detailed functional designs & specifications.
  • Highly skilled in complex problem-solving and excelling in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
  • Knowledge of Caterpillar dealer network, facilities, product structure, and machine ordering landscape and logistics
  • SAP Certified Associate - Sales
  • Experience with brownfield uplift from ECC to S4/HANA

Additional Info:

  • This position will be in Bangalore PSN Office.
  • This position requires the employee to work a 5-day-a-week schedule in the office.
  • This position may require 10% travel.
  • The position requires the candidate to work a 5-a day -week schedule in the office
  • Shift Timing: EMEA Shift: 01:00PM -10:00PM IST

Skill Descriptors

Core Application Systems:Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
  • Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
  • Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
  • Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
  • Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
  • Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Develops, refines, and communicates tactical plans for own responsibilities.
  • Provides the right level of detail as input for strategic plan development.
  • Demonstrates the value and necessity of linking tactical plans to overall strategic plan.
  • Ensures attention to the detail and dependencies of existing departmental-level plans.
  • Plans for allocation of resources in line with unit goals, technical and business objectives.
  • Ensures the planning process is integrated with the overall business plan.

Products and Services: Knowledge of major products and services and product and service groups; ability to apply knowledge of product and service appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Obtains information about product and service linkages with other products and services elsewhere in organization.
  • Researches the target market and how the product and services are sold and delivered.
  • Explains current status, delivery alternatives and announced updates to products and services.
  • Summarizes key features of major products or services in own unit.
  • Assesses own unit's product alternatives, costs, and pricing.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Expert:

  • Monitors industry trends and directions and discusses possible impact on internal strategies.
  • Designs and orchestrates the use of business analytics for strategic decision making.
  • Champions the use of business intelligence applications for tactical and strategic decisions.
  • Helps others discover the diverse features, parameters, or considerations to take into account.
  • Implements operating metrics and performance gauges such as the balanced scorecard.
  • Employs statistical and quantitative analysis, explanatory and predictive modeling techniques.

Application Delivery Process: Knowledge of major tasks, deliverables, and formal application delivery methodologies; ability to utilize these in order to deliver new or enhanced applications.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates the relative criticality, risk and potential reward of each and all major tasks.
  • Performs all major development and delivery phases and activities.
  • Oversees development of best practices documentation for all major activities and tasks.
  • Contrasts benefits, drawbacks and appropriateness of different methodologies.
  • Utilizes industry experience and benchmarks to evaluate methodology effectiveness.
  • Supervises the full spectrum of delivery activities on multiple development projects.

Architecture Modeling: Knowledge of Architecture Modeling; ability to develop and modify enterprise architecture through conceptual, logical and physical approaches.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Participates in formatting enterprise architectural models after NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology).
  • Diagnoses the rationality and reliability of conceptual, logical and physical layers.
  • Troubleshoots connections between information architecture and information systems and data architecture and data delivery systems.
  • Initiates application software, hardware, infrastructure and information store inputs.
  • Analyzes the domain and capabilities of each phase of technology architecture.

Information Security Technologies: Knowledge of technologies and technology-based solutions dealing with information security issues; ability to protect information security across the organization using encryption technologies and appropriate security software.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains how a firewall restricts access to information resources.
  • Discusses why both user-IDs and passwords are required to manage access.
  • Identifies different types of technology used for information security purposes.
  • Describes basic types or groups of security software and hardware.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

Level Expert:

  • Consults with others on system and/or technology integration efforts.
  • Monitors system and technology integration trends and directions.
  • Plays a leadership role in defining systems integration processes and practices.
  • Designs complex interfaces, integration strategies and plans.
  • Holds an industry wide conference on system integration and migration issues, problems and considerations.
  • Demonstrates extensive experience with system and technology integration.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers)

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO)

EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans and individuals with disabilities - are encouraged to apply.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

Analysis & Reporting

  • Utilize ERP tools (SAP, Oracle) and reporting platforms (Power BI) for data analysis and visualization.

  • Manage new projects and process transitions from other business units to ABB GBS.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
  • Proven experience in process improvement, compliance, and project management.

job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. This Position reports to:

Head of Central Finance ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

We are looking for a M&A CFIN architect to support System of Record (SOR)–related activities within the Central Finance (CFIN) landscape. This role supports mergers, acquisitions, divestments, and new company code onboarding by assisting in the alignment and integration of acquired entities’ SOR finance data and processes into the target CFIN environment, in line with defined business requirements and standards.

This position requires close coordination with Deployment team, Functional architects and external vendors, to maintain and evolve the CFIN M&A Solution Architect, ensuring it meets business needs and complies with ABB's standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Assist in configuring and deploying M&A-related finance solutions in CFIN for new company codes, mergers, acquisitions, and divestments.
  • Support SOR data migration from source systems, including initial load, AVL load, and data validation for new clients.
  • Work across O2C, P2P, R2R, Tax, and Treasury processes to ensure accurate integration and operational readiness.
  • Perform financial reconciliations, system testing, and support issue resolution during deployments.
  • Assist with real-time data replication and CPAY activation to enable seamless transactions and reporting in CFIN.
  • Collaborate with CFIN solution teams, IS architects, M&A leads, vendors, and business stakeholders to support integration and deployment activities.
  • Follow ABB standards, data governance, and regulatory requirements while building expertise in CFIN, SAP S/4HANA, and SOR processes for continuous improvement.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

Background & Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications in SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture.
  • 7-10+ years of experience as CFIN Finance Architect, or similar role, with strong hands-on experience in mergers, acquisitions, and divestments, including finance systems integration and separation activities.
  • Deep expertise in SAP Central Finance (CFIN), SAP S/4HANA Finance, and related ERP platforms, with practical experience integrating acquired entities, harmonizing finance processes
  • Proven experience in M&A integration capabilities, such as data migration, Testing Automation, legal entity setup, intercompany processing, and transitional service arrangements (TSA).
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end finance processes (Order to Cash, Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Tax, Treasury) as they relate to M&A integration and carve-out scenarios.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and technical teams.
  • A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems.
  • Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

You will also showcase your expertise by providing technical support to commissioning and start-up activities.

This role is contributing to the Electrification discipline of the Automation business within Process Industries for the India, Middle-East and Africa Region. Main stakeholders include end customers, EPC/LSTK contractors, engineering consultants, project managers, process engineering teams, electrical and automation engineering teams, vendors, system integrators, and internal sales and execution teams.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Acting as a role model in applying design thinking or design for excellence concepts in projects, including modelling, prototyping, simulation, and calculations.
  • Serving as a specialist in the application of advanced concepts and methods.
  • Leading, supervising, and coordinates teams (5-25 members) in all engineering disciplines (both in-house and outsourced) on projects of medium complexity.
  • Collaborating on project installation, commissioning, and site activities, to clarify potential issues or provide solutions to rectify the engineering errors.

Qualifications for the role

  • You are immersed in and highly skilled in Electrical Engineering for Process Plants, working with electrical systems ranging from 220 kV to 110 V AC and 220/110 V DC across the Cement, Metals, Mining, Material Handling, Pulp & Paper, and Minerals industries.
  • You have a First Class B.E./ B.Tech. in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering with 18–20 years of relevant experience in project engineering, with consulting companies or with engineering departments of EPC / LSTK companies / Mill Builders.
  • You have extensive hands-on experience in the electrical engineering of Cement Clinkerization Plants, Grinding Units, WHRS, CPPs, HSMs, CRMs, Processing Lines, Open-cast and Underground Mines, CHPs, and Long-Distance Conveyor Systems.
  • You possess advanced expertise in the engineering of Outdoor Switchyards, Indoor Substations and Electrical Rooms and specifications of HV/MV/LV Switchgear, MCCs, IMCCs, Batteries & Chargers, VVVF Drives, LRS, Transformers, Cables, Lighting Systems.
  • You are highly adept in System and Layout Engineering, including Substation Equipment Assignment Layouts, Earthing Layouts, Cable Layouts, Lightning Protection Layouts, and Illumination Layouts.
  • You have proven experience in delivering large-scale electrification projects for the Cement, Metals, Minerals, Material Handling, Mining, and Paper industries.
  • You are passionate about technical problem-solving, stakeholder management, multidisciplinary coordination, and engineering excellence, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient project execution.
  • You have extensive experience in managing and coordinating with leading engineering consultants such as HOLTEC, DCPL, PENTA, MECON, CET, DASTURCO, and TCE, while effectively communicating with clients, contractors, vendors, and project teams.

More about us The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Control Architecture Design: Develop scalable, high-performance control architectures for gas turbine and combined-cycle plants. Validate system performance across various operating conditions, including start-up, load changes, and grid disturbances.
  • Migration & Upgrade Projects: Lead engineering activities for Mark V to ABB control system migrations, including detailed I/O mapping, logic conversion, and validation of functional equivalence.
  • Integration & Commissioning: Oversee integration with electrical systems, instrumentation, and plant DCS. Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and commissioning at international sites.
  • Compliance & Standards: Ensure all work adheres to IEC, IEEE, NFPA, and local grid codes. Implement cybersecurity measures for control systems.
  • Digital Enablement: Integrate predictive analytics, remote monitoring, and AI-driven diagnostics into control solutions.
  • Documentation & Training: Prepare comprehensive engineering documentation, test procedures, and training materials for plant operators.

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role:

  • At least 8-12 years’ experience in power plant automation, specifically in gas turbine control (experience with GE Mark V and ABB Symphony Plus is highly desirable).
  • Proven track record of successful retrofit or upgrade projects for turbine control systems and Strong proficiency in control logic design, PLC/DCS programming, and HMI development.
  • Hands-on experience with ABB Symphony Plus and GE Mark V control systems, as well as relevant communication protocols (such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850) and excellent project management and effective stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to influence and drive change across global initiatives and analytical approach and strong problem-solving abilities for complex integration projects.
  • Certifications (Preferred)- ABB Control Systems Certification, Cybersecurity for Industrial Control Systems and PMP or equivalent project management certification.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical, Electronics, or Automation Engineering.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Engineering Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects.

The work model for the role is: Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Process Automation business for Marine & Ports division based in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

-Evaluating, selecting, and applying standard techniques and procedures to perform engineering assignments.

  • Kick off meeting (KOM) with the client to mutually agree on scope of work and deviations.
  • Preparing the man hour estimate, technical and commercial offer for the project

-Providing technical support for testing, installation, and commissioning activities.

  • Conducting Power system studies such as,

o Load flow study o Short circuit study o Dynamic Motor starting study o Harmonic analysis o Transient & load shedding study o Relay coordination study with Unit protection o Arc flash study o Insulation co-ordination study o Transformer inrush current study o Renewable Energy and Grid Integration Studies Preparation of study report. Harmonic measurement at site

Qualifications for the role

Candidate should have a master’s degree in Power system Analysis/ Bachelor of Electrical and Electronics

4 to 8 years of relevant experience

Hands on and working knowledge on any one of power systems study software such as ETAP/ NEPLAN/ SKM Power /PS CAD/ DigSILENT/ CYME tools etc.

Must have successfully executed at least two power system studies projects for big networks involving 300buses and

above independently.

Project execution experience in MV, LV switchgear package and detail engineering would be an added advantage.

More about us ABB Marine & Ports supplies world-leading technologies that are driving the evolution of sustainable shipping. Electrical propulsion, data-driven decision support and integrated solutions for ship and shore from ABB are paving the way to a zero-emission marine industry, providing greater efficiency and reliability to shipowners, and preparing vessels to meet the demands of tomorrow. Our automation and electrical solutions are making port and terminal operations safer, greener and more productive.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.description:

This Position reports to:

LPG Manager LVS IN ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to manage the marketing of ABB’s offerings to targeted market segments and manage the offerings throughout their lifecycle, in line with market needs and division/product group/business line strategy and targets. Each day, you will be accountable for the long-term profitable growth of an offer. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting business results by overseeing each step involved in the offer lifecycle including development, launch, go-to-market, maintenance, pricing, and profitability.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Smart Power division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading the market intelligence analysis and identifying potential gaps in the portfolio, with respect to the competition and new market opportunities.
  • Owning technical and market specification for the offer and determining an offering business plan that supports sustainable growth while leading customer need and value analysis, planning the roadmap to create maximum value, and following-up on portfolio performance.
  • Leading the offer lifecycle management process, analyzing current offers, defining, and tracking performance metrics, and making decisions on offer obsolescence and end-of life to ensure that current and future market requirements are met to maximize their profitability.
  • Setting targets, monitoring offering costs and giving inputs to operations functions (e.g., Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Production) to maximize competitiveness and profitability.

Our team dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

Qualifications for the role

  • 15+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Marketing, or Business Development in Low Voltage Switchgear industry.**
  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (Should be full time)
  • Hands-on experience in New Product Development (NPD) and Product Lifecycle Management.
  • Proven expertise in product positioning, pricing strategy, and profitability analysis.
  • Experience in product forecasting, inventory planning, and demand management.
  • Strong understanding of LV systems is must (MCC / PCC / PDP / ACB / MCB / MCCB/ RCCB/ Panels / Breakers)
  • Experience working with R&D and engineering teams during product development.
  • Exposure to sales enablement, technical support, and customer engagement
  • You are at ease communicating in English, with excellent verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.title: Principal Software Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Lead Technology Product Manager ###

What we believe in

ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for an experienced Principal Software Engineer – Full Stack to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role requires a strong technical leader with extensive experience in React or Angular, .NET, and modern software architecture to design and deliver scalable industrial software platforms.

You will lead the architecture and development of cloud-native, high-performance applications that integrate Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) systems while driving engineering excellence across the software development lifecycle. You will also champion AI-assisted software engineering practices by enabling development teams to leverage LLM-powered coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate software delivery, testing, and architectural decision-making.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • ### Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable full-stack applications using React/Angular, .NET, microservices, and cloud-native technologies while ensuring high performance, maintainability, and software quality.
  • ### Drive engineering excellence by defining software architecture standards, mentoring development teams, promoting best practices, and leading adoption of modern software development methodologies including AI-assisted engineering workflows.
  • ### Design and deliver secure, reliable, and highly available industrial software solutions by integrating enterprise applications with automation platforms, real-time communication protocols, REST APIs, WebSockets, and modern cloud technologies.
  • ### Collaborate with architects, product managers, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver complex software solutions, reduce technical debt, improve system performance, and ensure predictable delivery of high-quality releases.

Qualifications for the role:

  • ### 12+ years of experience in Full Stack Software Development with strong expertise in .NET (C#), ASP.NET Core, React or Angular, and enterprise-scale application development.
  • ### Proven experience designing scalable microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications using modern software engineering principles.
  • ### Strong knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL or NoSQL databases along with backend frameworks, ORM technologies, and frontend state management concepts.
  • ### Experience with Azure or AWS cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes/K3s), DevOps practices, and software security standards.
  • ### Good understanding of industrial automation technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, SCADA, MES, IoT platforms, and integration between Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) systems is preferred.
  • ### Demonstrated technical leadership with experience mentoring engineers, defining engineering standards, driving architectural decisions, and successfully delivering complex enterprise software solutions across cross-functional teams.
  • ### BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related engineering disciplines with excellent communication skills and passion for innovation, continuous learning, and AI-driven software engineering practices.

More about us

ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures. Through its five divisions, it serves customers across energy, process, hybrid and maritime industries by delivering innovative automation, digitalization and industrial software solutions that enable safer, smarter and more sustainable operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: ITI - Trainee
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Shift Leader ###

What we believe in

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the Production Technician in defining processes. Each day, you will learn to accomplish relevant tasks through on-the-job training and applying this knowledge to support production. You will also showcase your expertise by optimizing the cost, quality, and on-time delivery of products.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Supporting the implementation, delivery, and continuous improvement of products and services within the defined area as directed.
  • Monitoring (under the supervision of a mentor) the production process and performs basic quality and testing checks.
  • Ensuring effective usage of consumables, spare parts for machinery and equipment, and all sorts of preventive and corrective maintenance processes.
  • Providing cycle time data for the production process to internal teams.

Qualifications for the role

  • Must possess a valid ITI Certificate from a recognized institute.
  • Trades accepted: Electrician, Fitter, Machinist, Mechanic, etc.
  • Basic knowledge of tools and machinery related to the trade.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings (for engineering trades).
  • Understanding of safety protocols and quality standards.

More about us The Large Motors and Generators Division offers a comprehensive product portfolio of large AC motors and generators. From general purpose to highly customized designs, synchronous motors and high voltage induction motors provide high efficiency, reliability and availability across all major industries and applications, including some in the toughest and most demanding environments. The division also has a long track record of designing and building generators for wide range of industries, including power generation, marine, oil and gas, mining, and data centers.

A future opportunity

This role is part of our talent pipeline, which means it’s not currently open, but we’re always looking for curious minds, bold thinkers, and people who want to make an impact.

Click Apply to express your interest and be considered for future opportunities that match your experience and aspirations.

At ABB, we welcome people from all backgrounds and believe that diverse perspectives help us build a cleaner, smarter future.

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about how we help run what runs the world.

job.description:

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Engineering Manager (Electrical) ###

Your Role and Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline of low to medium complexity. Each day, you will work on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also demonstrate your proficiency by applying basic design thinking and design-for-excellence concepts in your work.

The work model for the role is: #LI – Onsite.

This role contributes to the Automation segment within the Energy Division in Bangalore-(Nelamangala) region in India , specifically for the Excitation business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate, select, and apply standard techniques and procedures to perform engineering assignments.
  • Provide technical support for testing, installation, and commissioning activities.
  • Assist in preparing proposals and presentations for engineering projects.
  • Use checklists to perform design verification in accordance with applicable standards and engineering guidelines.

Qualifications for the role

  • Commitment to project engineering, with a focus on excitation systems.
  • 3 to 7 years of experience in project engineering, with direct design experience using E3 or EPlan.
  • Advanced knowledge of electrical design and engineering in excitation or LV drives
  • Keen interest in customer management.
  • Diploma or B.E/B.Tech degree in Electronics, EEE, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication in English.

More About Us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation, and water with integrated solutions that automate, digitalize, and electrify operations, the division supports established industries in their decarbonization efforts. It also plays a key role in developing, integrating, and scaling up new and renewable energy models.

Our goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly evolving global energy transition. Leveraging data, machine learning, and artificial intelligence (AI), the division brings over 50 years of domain experience to deliver solutions that improve energy, process, and production efficiency, reduce risk and operational costs, and minimize waste—supporting customers from project start-up through the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.description:

  • Solid foundation in process control and instrumentation, with experience handling large projects (100+ MW).
  • Skilled in installation, service, maintenance and commissioning in DCS.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage commissioning activities across Pan India (70-80% travel).
  • Diploma & B.E/B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Telecommunication, or Instrumentation, with effective verbal and written communication skills.

job.title: Sales Manager- Area sales
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Director- Maharashtra & Southeast Asia ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for growing sales of B&R’s next generation technology, machine connectivity, automation & edge, high end motion system & technology software solutions in the defined area. The role demands a mix of sales acumen, technical understanding, and customer engagement.

The work model for the role is: #LI- Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Machine Automation Division -B&R in Pune region in India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Develop and sustain positive customer relationships through consistent engagement, while creating new inquiries and building a robust opportunity pipeline.
  • Analyze customer requirements and market trends to develop and present value-driven techno-commercial solutions.
  • Support business growth by handling negotiations, closing opportunities, and meeting sales targets.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional B&R teams to ensure seamless project execution and customer satisfaction.
  • Act as a trusted automation consultant and brand ambassador, promoting B&R’s innovative technologies and solutions.
  • Expand market presence through participation in exhibitions, seminars, customer events, and product demonstrations.
  • Maintain accurate CRM data, develop reliable sales forecasts, and provide regular business performance reports.
  • Monitor customer needs, market developments, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities and build long-term partnerships.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or a related field).
  • 8–10 years of demonstrated sales experience within industrial automation environments, with experience in PLCs, SCADA, Drives, Motion Control, and Mechatronics solutions.
  • Solid experience in industrial sales and consultative selling, including the delivery of automation solutions tailored to customer requirements.
  • Practical experience in automation application development and translating technical requirements into practical business solutions.
  • Demonstrated business judgment and the ability to negotiate effectively, manage relationships, and close opportunities.
  • Clear communication and relationship management skills, along with a consistent focus on professionalism and integrity in customer-facing situations.
  • Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional regional language will be considered an advantage.

More about us:

B&R Industrial Automation GmbH is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and is headquartered in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. Today, B&R is one of the world's leading solution providers for machine and factory automation and is responsible for machine automation within ABB's Process Automation division.

Continuous innovation and strong partnerships have been B&R hallmarks for over 45 years!
