job.title: Sales Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Channel Specialist ###

What we believe in

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will deliver both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your sales skills by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Karnataka. Main stakeholders are Panel builders, Channel partners/Distributors, EPC's/Contractors and End customers.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Customer Communication & Sales Support Manage customer communications on delivery schedules, payment terms, commercial conditions, and order status while ensuring compliance with company policies and sales strategies.
  • Business Development & Market Expansion Identify and develop new market opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and help grow the business within the assigned territory.
  • Marketing & Customer Engagement Carry out marketing initiatives and clearly convey the value of products and solutions to boost customer engagement and expand market reach.
  • Sales Operations & Project Coordination Manage sales administration, support cash collection activities, coordinate project execution, and ensure seamless order processing and commercial

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s Degree (B.E./B.Tech) or Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering with 5–8 years of demonstrated sales experience in electrical switchgear, panel builder business, and power distribution solutions.
  • Solid experience in growing sales for ELSP & ELSB products through the Panel Builder Channel by developing and executing effective sales strategies to meet business targets.
  • Skilled at building and managing relationships with Panel Builders, System Integrators, Channel Partners, and key customers to increase market reach and pursue new business opportunities.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of Low Voltage (LV) Switchgear, LV Panels, and Power Distribution Solutions, with a sound understanding of customer applications and industry requirements; knowledge of IEC 61439 standards.
  • Proficiency in SAP, CRM platforms, Microsoft Excel, and other sales management tools for pipeline management, sales forecasting, customer relationship management, and business reporting.
  • Effective collaboration and stakeholder management skills, along with the ability to coordinate with Technical Promotion, Product Marketing, and cross-functional teams to increase customer engagement and guide product specifications.
  • Effective communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with fluency in English and South Indian regional languages, coupled with the ability to thrive in a busy, target-driven, and customer-focused sales environment.

More about us

ABB Smart Power and Smart Buildings divisions deliver advanced energy distribution, automation, and power protection solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing facilities, commercial buildings, infrastructure, and residential applications. The divisions work closely with industry partners to support rapid growth, digital transformation, energy transition, and sustainability objectives through innovative and energy-efficient technologies. The portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, switches, relays, UPS solutions, DIN rail products, enclosures, emergency lighting systems, industrial plugs and sockets, and conventional wiring accessories. In addition, integrated digital technologies enable intelligent control of HVAC, lighting, shutters, security, and building automation systems, helping customers optimize operational efficiency, safety, and energy usage. Through scalable smart energy and automation platforms like ABB Ability™ Energy Manager, ABB helps organizations lower CO₂ emissions, boost energy efficiency, and meet long-term sustainability and carbon reduction targets across industrial, commercial, and residential settings.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

  • Processing accounts payable transactions, ensuring accurate tracking and processing.

job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Service Sales Manager

岗位职责：

  • 客户关系管理：
  • 维护与现有客户的关系，确保客户满意度，并通过高效沟通和问题解决推动持续的业务合作。
  • 定期与客户进行反馈沟通，深入了解客户需求，确保公司提供的服务和解决方案持续满足或超越客户预期。
  • 渠道合作伙伴开发与管理，定期与渠道伙伴共同拜访非直签客户，支持渠道合作伙伴的销售活动，制定渠道合作伙伴年度发展计划。
  • 价值销售：
  • 熟练掌握ABB机器人全系售后服务产品：原厂备件、年度维保、数字化产品、机器人调试、程序优化、整机及备件翻新、停产机型升级改造等；结合产品价值，向客户对比原厂服务与第三方服务差异，输出价值型销售方案，独立完成商务沟通、报价、谈判、签单，达成个人及团队销售业绩指标。
  • 客户装机信息摸排与台账搭建:

将客户机器人装机信息摸排列为日常客户拜访核心工作，精准统计区域内客户的ABB机器人现有装机总量、型号、投产年限、设备工况、在用数量、闲置数量等核心数据；同步更新客户装机台账，精准盘点区域存量设备资源，依托装机数据匹配对应维保、备件、改造升级等服务商机，为销售策略制定、客户分层运营、业绩增量挖掘提供精准数据支撑。

  • 市场分析：
  • 进行市场趋势分析，研究竞争对手，并结合技术背景提出有价值的销售策略建议。
  • 售后服务协调：
  • 处理客户的售后服务请求，跟进服务进度，以技术为导向确保客户问题得到及时和有效的解决，提升客户满意度。
  • 开展客户满意度调查，分析反馈，持续改进服务质量，以提升客户忠诚度。
  • 销售文档管理：
  • 管理和更新客户档案及销售相关文件，确保所有技术和销售信息准确无误。
  • 培训与发展：
  • 为客户及内部团队提供技术导向的产品及服务培训支持，确保他们能够充分理解和应用ABB的解决方案。

职位要求：

  • 本科或以上学历，机械工程、电气工程、自动化、控制工程或相关工科专业背景优先。

•3年及以上工业产品销售经验，有售后或服务相关销售经验优先

  • 优秀的中英文书面及口头沟通能力，能够将复杂的技术概念转化为客户易于理解的商业价值。
  • 快速学习新技术和产品的能力，尤其是在工业机器人领域，具备将技术优势转化为销售机会的能力。
  • 具有良好的团队合作精神，能够在跨职能团队中工作，协调技术和销售资源以达成目标。
  • 熟练使用Microsoft Office，特别是Excel和PowerPoint，能够处理复杂的技术数据和制作专业报告。
  • 强大的时间管理能力，能够在压力下有效工作，确保按时交付客户期望的解决方案。

job.title: Senior Scientist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Department Lead ###

Your role and responsibilities:

You will be a member of the ABB India Corporate Research Center (INCRC), at the ABB Innovation Center (AIC) located in Bangalore, India. INCRC researchers perform high-end research on diverse topics to develop cutting-edge technologies for ABB’s global businesses to propel the organization towards a productive and sustainable future. We collaborate with other ABB corporate research centers, R&D units, and academic institutes. The position offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, global, and creative environment, collaborating with a wide range of experience and expertise. You will work in applied research projects, developing innovative Control and Artificial Intelligence technologies toward building intelligent autonomous systems for the Industry, Transport, and Infrastructure sectors.

The work model for the role is Onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Requirements gathering and identification of use cases to aim towards fully autonomous process plants, and minimizing expert interventions in designing, deploying, and maintaining advanced control applications
  • Evaluation of the state-of-the-art Control and Artificial Intelligence approaches and/ or development of a new approach for identified use cases.
  • Development of a proof of concept, prototypes, and support in pilot evaluation and productization of solutions.
  • Contribute to building and managing the laboratory setup for experimental research
  • Communication of project results to Technical experts and Management.
  • Creation of Intellectual property (invention disclosures) and publications in scientific journals and conferences.
  • Travel to customer sites and ABB locations on a need basis.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

  • Ph.D. in Chemical/ Control/ Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Mechanical engineering with a strong publication and patent record, with a minimum of 7 years of experience; industrial research experience is preferred.
  • Experience in the development of model-based or model-free controllers, such as Model Predictive Control, Approximate Dynamic Programming, and Reinforcement Learning
  • Knowledge of operation and control in the process industry e.g., Oil and Gas, Pulp and Paper, Metals, etc, is preferred.
  • Good knowledge of Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, Supervised and unsupervised learning, Multivariate statistics, Time-series analysis, Signal Processing, and related areas.
  • Experience in the usage of Machine learning for the development of predictive maintenance, diagnosis, and monitoring solutions.
  • Proficiency in Matlab and Python programming languages.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English with internal and external partners, including the academic community.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.description:

This position reports to:

Workshop Manager__

ABB Motion Services, based in Eagle Farm, Queensland, is seeking a number of skilled Electrical Fitters to join our team on fixed-term contracts, with the potential for contract extensions or future permanent opportunities.

As Australia's ABB Traction Workshop, we bring over 40 years of expertise in AC/DC traction motor testing, diagnostics, manufacturing, machining, repairs, and full overhauls. Supported by industry-leading onsite testing facilities, we deliver critical services to some of Australia's leading rail and transport customers.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with a global industry leader, gain hands-on experience with specialised equipment, and be part of a team recognised for technical excellence, quality, and innovation. If you're looking to grow your career in a dynamic and supportive environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The work model for the role is: Onsite #LI-Onsite

Your role and responsibilities

  • Contribute to customer satisfaction by executing workshop orders according to workshop processes and guidelines.
  • Perform workshop tasks such as troubleshooting, repair, assembly, and testing.
  • Check bill of materials and other documents to identify required parts needed for service activity and ensure that all materials, parts, and equipment are available.
  • Ensure the completion, processing, and maintenance of all required documentation.
  • Perform Electrical testing and recording of measurements as per OEM standard and complete motor stator and armature rewind.

Qualifications for the role

  • Hold a recognised Australian Electrical Fitter trade qualification and current Electrical Licence (mandatory).
  • Recently completed apprenticeship or have up to 2 years of post apprenticeship experience in a relevant electrical trade role.
  • Exposure to, or a strong interest in, stator and armature rewinding, with a willingness to develop specialised skills through on the job training.
  • Basic understanding of rotating motors and generators, with an interest in working across the Industrial and Rail sectors.
  • Demonstrated aptitude for electrical and mechanical repair, maintenance, or refurbishment activities, with a strong focus on safety and quality.
  • Able to produce clear and accurate inspection reports, both handwritten and via digital reporting platforms.
  • Hold a current Queensland driver’s licence.

What's in it for you?

Join a team where your input is valued, and your work has a clear impact. You’ll have the support, tools, and autonomy to develop your skills and grow your career. We work collaboratively, share knowledge, and support each other, with leaders who respect your contribution and support your development.

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • 16% super
  • Incentive bonuses
  • Paid overtime
  • Paid parental leave
  • Salary sacrifice packaging

More about us

ABB Motion Service Division serves customers worldwide by maximising uptime, extending product life cycle and enhancing the performance and energy efficiency of their electrical motion solutions. The Division is leading the way in digitalisation by securely connecting motors and drives, increasing operational uptime and improving efficiency. The services offered make the difference for our customers and partners every day by helping keep their operations running profitably, safely and reliably.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

  • Design and develop scalable cloud-native and edge-enabled industrial software solutions using microservice architectures.
  • Drive end-to-end product development from requirements analysis and architecture design through implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Define and govern application, data, integration, and security architectures across cloud and edge environments.
  • Lead major technology initiatives, providing technical direction, mentorship, and architectural oversight to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with product management, R&D teams, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Establish and promote software engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural governance.
  • Drive DevOps adoption, CI/CD strategies, automated testing, and release management practices.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, observability, and maintainability of distributed systems.
  • Champion cybersecurity principles, secure-by-design approaches, and compliance with industrial security standards.
  • Lead quality improvement initiatives, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement programs across the product portfolio.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies in cloud, edge computing, industrial connectivity, and AI-driven solutions.
  • Contribute to strategic technology roadmaps aligned with ABB’s industrial digitalization and automation objectives.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 15+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with C#/.NET/.NET Core and modern web technologies.
  • Strong expertise in microservices, distributed systems, software architecture patterns, SOLID principles, and system design.
  • Experience designing and implementing IoT solutions using REST APIs, WebSocket, MQTT, AMQP, or similar technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, MicroShift, K3s, or other container and edge orchestration platforms.
  • Strong cloud-native experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP, preferably for Industrial IoT workloads, including Azure IoT Hub or AWS IoT Core.
  • Deep understanding of security concepts including OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Zero Trust architecture, PKI, certificate management, and secure edge deployments.
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms, including automated testing and release strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of observability practices, including logging, monitoring, tracing, and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases, time-series data management, historian integration, and industrial data modeling.
  • Familiarity with industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA and industrial standards such as ISA-95.
  • Awareness of industrial cybersecurity and compliance frameworks including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001, with experience applying them in enterprise or industrial environments.
  • Experience in working within agile teams, e.g., using SCRUM or SAFe

job.title: Regulatory Compliance Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

At Caterpillar, the work we do matters. For more than 100 years, we've delivered products and solutions that support mining, construction, and infrastructure worldwide. Our teams combine practical engineering expertise, manufacturing excellence, and disciplined execution to deliver equipment that performs in the toughest conditions.

As a global leader in mining equipment, we are committed to designing safe, reliable, and compliant products that meet the evolving needs of customers and regulators around the world.

What You’ll Be Doing

This is an exciting opportunity for a compliance, engineering, or product safety professional who enjoys working across technical, regulatory, and business functions to ensure products meet global safety and certification requirements.

You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Groups, Caterpillar Product Compliance & Safety, certification agencies, and regulatory authorities to:

  • Lead product regulatory compliance activities across our Underground Hard Rock product portfolio
  • Support new product development, market expansion, and continuous product improvement initiatives
  • Ensure products meet applicable global regulatory, safety, and certification requirements

Importantly, we're open to candidates from a range of backgrounds including product compliance, product safety, engineering, certification, or regulatory roles within mining, heavy equipment, construction, rail, defence, oil & gas, or other highly regulated industries.

Your mission is to ensure Caterpillar products can be delivered confidently into global markets while meeting the highest standards of safety, compliance, and product integrity. This role extends beyond documentation and certification activities. You will work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the product lifecycle, identifying compliance requirements, supporting risk assessments, and driving successful certification outcomes.

In addition, you will collaborate with internal specialists and external authorities to monitor emerging regulatory requirements and implement appropriate compliance strategies that support both business objectives and customer needs.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead and coordinate product compliance activities across the Underground Hard Rock product portfolio
  • Act as the primary point of contact for product regulatory compliance matters
  • Interpret and communicate global regulations, directives, standards, and legislative requirements
  • Prepare and maintain Technical Construction Files and related compliance documentation
  • Manage product certifications, approvals, and relationships with third-party certification agencies
  • Develop and maintain Declarations of Conformity and supporting compliance records
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI), Continuous Product Improvement (CPI), New Market Introduction (NMI), and New Source Introduction (NSI) programs
  • Determine market-specific compliance requirements and product certification needs
  • Coordinate compliance activities between engineering, legal, product management, certification agencies, and other stakeholders
  • Facilitate product safety risk assessments and support risk mitigation activities
  • Review and approve compliance validation reports and certification documentation
  • Monitor emerging regulatory changes and coordinate implementation plans with relevant teams
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of product compliance processes and governance frameworks

What You Will Bring

We're looking for a technically capable professional who can translate complex regulatory requirements into practical business outcomes. Ideally you will have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Safety Engineering, Product Compliance, or a related discipline
  • Experience in product compliance, product safety, engineering, certification, quality, or regulatory affairs
  • Knowledge of international product safety standards, machinery regulations, and certification requirements
  • Experience participating in product risk assessments and product safety reviews
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing, legal, and commercial teams
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and project coordination capability
  • High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving

Highly Regarded

  • Experience within mining, underground equipment, heavy mobile equipment, construction machinery, rail, defence, or oil & gas industries
  • Familiarity with global machinery legislation and certification frameworks
  • Experience working with regulatory authorities and third-party certification bodies
  • Knowledge of compliance management systems and technical document control processes
  • Exposure to global product certification and market-entry requirement

Why Join the Burnie Product Development Team

Burnie has a proud heritage in underground mining equipment design and development and remains a key location within Caterpillar's global Underground Hard Rock Mining business. The site supports the engineering, validation, and product development activities that help deliver safe, reliable, and productive mining solutions to customers worldwide.

In this role you'll:

  • Contribute to products used in some of the world's most demanding underground mining operations
  • Partner with engineering, product safety, legal, and certification specialists across the Caterpillar enterprise
  • Play a critical role in supporting market access and regulatory compliance for global product launches
  • Influence product safety and design decisions throughout the product lifecycle
  • Be part of a highly experienced team recognised for its underground mining expertise
  • This is a site-based position located in Burnie, Tasmania, requiring attendance in the office 5 days per week. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration, including bonus and share options.
  • Generous parental leave with flexible payment options
  • Strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity
  • Employee discounts across health, wellbeing, travel, and retail
  • Global career progression and development opportunities within Caterpillar

How to Apply

If you're ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role with a global industry leader, apply via:

www.caterpillar.com/careers

Your road to success begins with Caterpillar.

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Caterpillar of Australia is not currently hiring applicants who require sponsorship. As a global company, opportunities may be available in other locations via our careers website.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.description:

Quality Control Specialist

What we believe in

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, The Quality Specialist is responsible for ensuring product and process quality across the assembly line, meeting customer quality standards, and driving continuous improvement through structured problem-solving, process audits, inspections, and compliance with ISO 9001:2015 requirements. This role requires expertise in quality control systems, process validation, and technical knowledge of electrical and switchgear standards.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Buildings Business to be based at Nelamangala, BANGALORE, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensure product and process quality as per customer requirements, ISO 9001:2015 standards, drawings, PCPs, and defined quality procedures; monitor and improve key quality KPIs.
  • Inspection & Non-Conformance Management: Conduct visual, dimensional, functional, and pre-dispatch inspections; identify non-conformities, perform RCA, manage UD clearance, customer complaints, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Process Quality & Validation: Maintain and update PFMEA, Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and Work Instructions; conduct process validation, Cp/Cpk capability studies, LPA, poka-yoke audits, and support FPY improvement.
  • Calibration & Quality Documentation: Ensure timely calibration and upkeep of electrical/mechanical equipment and process instruments; maintain accurate daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual quality reports and records.
  • Continuous Improvement & Cost Reduction: Review FPY, Final Yield, Rework Yield, IFC, and Customer Complaint PPM; support Kaizen, OPEX/cost-saving initiatives, 5S, and structured problem-solving activities to raise quality and cut process losses.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Education & Experience: Diploma or bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering with 4+ years of relevant experience in Process Quality within a manufacturing environment.
  • Industry Exposure: Prior experience in Switchgear, Automobile, Electrical, or similar manufacturing industries, with practical experience in production quality processes.
  • Quality Management Systems: Good knowledge of ISO 9001:2015, PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow Diagrams, Work Instructions, and quality documentation.
  • Statistical & Technical Skills: Proficiency in SPC, Cp/Cpk capability analysis, Minitab, calibration processes, and Poka-Yoke; basic knowledge of IEC 60898-1, IEC 60947-2, and IEC 61008-1 standards.
  • Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Practical skills in RCA, 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa/Fishbone, and DMAIC, with the ability to analyze quality trends, investigate failures, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Systems & Reporting: Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SAP for documentation, reporting, UD clearance, lot tracking, and inventory management; Windchill knowledge.

job.description:

This position reports to:

Commissioning&Warranty Suport Specialist

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for leading and executing commissioning activities for marine and port projects, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality project delivery in accordance with contractual, technical, and cybersecurity requirements. You will work closely with project teams, site personnel, contractors, and customers to support installation, testing, commissioning, and final acceptance activities. Your expertise will contribute to successful project execution and customer satisfaction while upholding ABB's commitment to safety, integrity, and operational excellence.

The work model for the role is: Onsite (Most of the time at site - fabrication yard or site office)

This role is contributing to the Offshore solution under AUEN – eHouse solution, supporting ASEAN region, majority will be in Batam, Singapore) Main stakeholders. (Engineering, Planner, Construction, MC, QA/QC, Factory, warranty, warehouse, field service engineers)

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Planning, coordinating, and executing commissioning activities for marine and port automation, electrification, and control system projects, ensuring delivery in accordance with project specifications, quality standards, and schedules.
  • Supporting and coordinating installation and commissioning activities with Site Managers, Project Managers, contractors, and customers to ensure safe and efficient project execution.
  • Conducting testing, troubleshooting, commissioning design updates, and documentation mark-ups, ensuring accurate as-built documentation and technical completion of projects.
  • Ensuring compliance with ABB safety, quality, cybersecurity, and contractual requirements while supporting customer acceptance testing, project close-out activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications for the role

  • You hold a Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • You have experience in commissioning, field service, installation, testing, or project execution within marine, port, industrial automation, power, or electrification environments.
  • You possess a solid understanding of electrical distribution, automation, control systems, drives, or marine electrical systems, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues on site.
  • You are experienced in coordinating site activities with project teams, contractors, and customers, ensuring projects are delivered safely and efficiently.
  • You have strong knowledge of HSE requirements and demonstrate commitment to safety, quality, compliance, and cybersecurity standards in project execution.
  • You are a proactive problem-solver with strong communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of working independently in a dynamic project environment.
  • You communicate effectively in English and are willing to travel domestically and internationally, including working onboard vessels and at customer sites when required.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Accounting & Reporting Manager - AR

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support account receivables and/or credit activities in line with defined strategies, policies, and procedures. Each day, you will be responsible for managing and analyzing accounts receivable data. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring accurate financial reporting and compliance with the relevant accounting standards.

The work model for the role is: onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Managing month end and year end closing activities, including posting intercompany journal entries, accruals and managing foreign exchange (FX) impacts.
  • Performing intercompany matching and reconciliation to resolve imbalances.
  • Ensuring accuracy in financial records and timely month-end closing.
  • Overseeing the intercompany payment settlements and clearing within group entities.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

  • Experience & Education: You hold a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in finance and have a demonstrated track record in financial management and comfortable working in English , Generally 2-5 years for analysts.
  • Functional Skills: Strong knowledge of Intercompany Reconciliation (ICR), General Ledger (GL), Accruals and Balance Sheet Reconciliation.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP FICO and MS Excel.
  • Process Expertise: End-to-end month-end closing includes accruals calculation, supporting group team in terms of financial reporting, and intercompany settlements (IC Matching) Soft Skills:- High attention to detail, analytical skills, ability to work under tight deadlines, and good communication
  • You hold a valid India work permit, and you are comfortable working in Bangalore as work Location.
  • Permanent shift timings 05:30 PM to 02:30 AM – Currently 3 weeks working from office and 1 week WFH.

  • Kindly note that ABB provides transportation facilities only to employees residing within the designated ABB Transport Zone. Please verify whether your current location falls within the serviceable area by using the link below.

job.title: HR Operations Team Lead - Compensation and Benefits
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

HR Delivery Manager ###

Key Responsibilities

1. Compensation & Benefits Operations - Cluster Countries

Lead and manage end-to-end C&B operations for assigned cluster countries, ensuring timely and accurate execution of all rewards transactions.

Oversee salary benchmarking, pay review cycles, merit increase processing, and market data analysis for cluster geographies.

Ensure country-specific compensation structures and benefit programmes are maintained and aligned with global ABB policy.

Manage benefits enrolment, renewals, vendor coordination, and employee queries related to health, wellness, retirement, and other benefit plans.

Partner with local HRBPs and country HR teams to address C&B escalations, exceptions, and complex cases.

Maintain data integrity in HR systems (Workday / SAP) for all compensation and benefits records across cluster countries.

2. Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) Process Management

Own and drive the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) process end-to-end for Global: from target setting, mid-year review, year-end calculation to payout processing.

Coordinate with P&R, HRBPs, and Business Leaders to ensure accurate AIP eligibility lists, payout calculations, and exception management.

Manage AIP communication and employee-facing documentation in coordination with HR Front Office and COE.

Ensure all AIP activities comply with ABB global guidelines, local labour laws, and audit requirements.Perform quality checks and reconciliation of AIP data before final payroll submission.

Track AIP timelines, identify risks, and proactively escalate issues to the Hub Delivery Manager.

3. Team Leadership & Performance Management

Lead a team of C&B specialists; manage work allocation, capacity planning, and business continuity. Conduct regular performance reviews, one-on-ones, and development conversations. Coach and mentor team members to build technical C&B capability and process expertise.

Foster a high-performance, customer-centric, and collaborative team culture.

Handle escalations with composure and resolve complex issues in a timely manner.

4. Compliance & Regulatory Adherence

Ensure all C&B operations comply with local labour laws, statutory regulations, GDPR, and ABB internal controls across cluster countries.

Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and evidence.

Monitor regulatory changes impacting compensation and benefits in cluster geographies and implement required updates.

5. Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Experience

Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, COEs, Finance, and Payroll teams across cluster countries.

Proactively manage stakeholder communication on C&B matters, process timelines, and issue resolution.

Analyse customer satisfaction feedback and drive continuous improvement in C&B service delivery.

Serve as the primary point of contact for all C&B-related escalations from cluster country stakeholders.

6. Operational Optimization & Innovation

Continuously review C&B processes to identify inefficiencies and implement improvements. Leverage HR technology (Workday, SAP, ServiceNow) to automate and streamline C&B workflows.

Support global HR initiatives such as total rewards redesign, policy harmonisation, and M&A activities. Explore AI-enabled tools and analytics to enhance C&B reporting, benchmarking, and decision support.

Qualification for the role

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Administration, or other relevant fields
  • Must have 7 to 10 years of experience in the Compensation and Performance function

Should possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong analytical abilities and strategic thinking.

  • Excellent user knowledge of Microsoft Office and Excel skills and other analytic tools and techniques is a must
  • Must have team handling and delegation skills and the ability to create a learning atmosphere among team members
  • Strong Customer service orientation and collaborative and conflict-resolving skills is an added advantage

job.title: Principal Software Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Digital Solution Engineering Manager

What we believe in

ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

Your role and responsibilities

The Lead (QE) for PA Core will serve as a dynamic techno-functional leader dedicated to enhancing the Quality Engineering framework across DataOps, Edge, Visualization, Packaging, and IAM within ABB Genix. The role is accountable for shaping automation-first practices, embedding QE in CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring governance and reusability across platform and customer project validations.

This position requires both technical depth and leadership capability – guiding teams, cross-functional stakeholders, and ensuring that PA Core QE becomes the foundation of trust for Genix APM and customer solutions.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Define and own the QE strategy across PA Core areas (DataOps, Edge, Visualization, Packaging, IAM) while establishing governance for functional, non-functional, and regression coverage.
  • Implement the adoption of automation-first and shift-left practices, embedding CI/CD-integrated testing and continuous quality validation.
  • Coordinate the development and recycling of Golden Test Packs and acceptance packs, working with Platform, APM, and Domain teams to align QE outcomes with business KPIs.
  • Mentor QE engineers to build a high-performance, specialist-driven culture while ensuring compliance, security, and performance baselines are validated and measurable.

Qualifications for the role:

  • 15+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, including 3–5 years in a lead or architect role.
  • Demonstrated experience in platform/IIoT or industrial software solutions, ABB, Honeywell, AspenTech, GE Digital.
  • Demonstrated knowledge in creating testing strategies, ensuring quality governance, developing automation frameworks, and establishing teams focused on quality engineering.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of CI/CD integration using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, and GitHub Actions.
  • Practical involvement with automation tools and validation frameworks (PyTest, Playwright, JMeter, SQL/KQL) along with comprehension of industrial data flows (DataOps, Edge, OT/IT adapters, IAM security).
  • Knowledge of security and compliance standards, combined with effective leadership and cross-functional collaboration skills to engage senior stakeholders.
  • Delivered measurable outcomes including >90% QE automation coverage, 100% governance adoption,

More about us

Our R&D engineers and scientists develop breakthrough technologies and products that change the way the world works and industries do business. We consistently explore new boundaries in technology, while retaining our focus on delivering solid returns for our customers and shareholders

Product & Process Engineering Manager

What we believe in

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also showcase your expertise by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to achieve the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Building Business to be based at Nelamangala, Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Identifying and recommending improvement opportunities and implements improvement projects, ensuring adherence to timeframe, quality, and cost requirements.
  • Approving the design for processes developed internally or externally and performing final tests with respect to the project.
  • Providing support to Production during the internal/external process/equipment start-up, defining action plans and training relevant maintenance and production resources.
  • Evaluating new process technologies to improve productivity, quality, and cost reduction, defining and leading testing activities, approval criteria, and external provider choices.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Highly skilled in process planning, execution, and continuous improvement for low-voltage switchgear products such as MCBs, RCCBs, Switch Disconnectors, and wiring accessories.
  • Over 5 years of experience in process engineering, including line balancing, headcount efficiency analysis, and productivity enhancement using tools like MOST and VSM/VSD.
  • Proficient in using CAD tools (Creo, AutoCAD) and enterprise systems (SAP, Windchill) for design and process documentation.
  • Strong focus on lean manufacturing principles, product cost optimization, and conducting process audits to drive operational excellence.
  • Holds a diploma in engineering with in-depth knowledge of IEC and IS standards, including their interpretation and testing relevance for switchgear applications.
  • Effective communicator in English; recognized as a team player with a proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a strong drive for innovation and problem-solving.
  • Familiar with spot welding, thermoset and thermoplastic molding processes, and possesses sound knowledge of material properties relevant to switchgear manufacturing.

More about us:

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

Service Sales Specialist

As a Service Sales Specialist, you will drive the growth of ABB's service business by developing opportunities within the installed base (IB), promoting lifecycle services, upgrades, retrofits, and value-added solutions. You will build long-term customer relationships, identify new service opportunities, and deliver profitable growth by expanding ABB's service footprint while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Drive service sales growth by identifying and developing opportunities within ABB's installed base, promoting lifecycle management solutions, upgrades, retrofits, maintenance services, and the broader service portfolio to achieve sales and profitability targets.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships by understanding customer needs, translating requirements into ABB service solutions, providing technical and commercial expertise, and ensuring customer satisfaction throughout the sales process.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in service sales and proven track record in developing service business opportunities, managing customer accounts, and achieving sales growth targets.

  • Strong understanding of service agreements, maintenance solutions, upgrades, retrofits, lifecycle management, and value-added service offerings.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage customers at multiple organizational levels.
  • Experience using CRM systems and sales pipeline management tools, with strong analytical and commercial acumen.
  • Demonstrated commitment to customer satisfaction, safety, integrity, and compliance, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams to deliver reliable and cost-effective customer solutions.

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. Working as Global Product Manager - Industrial Networks, you will be a key member of the Global Product Management team within Process Control Platform. You will shape the future of secure and resilient industrial networking across ABB’s process automation portfolio.

The role is fundamental to the realization of ABB’s Automation Vision. You will own the network strategy and define how network technologies and products enable open, modular, interoperable and cyber-secure automation architectures while ensuring the reliability and continuity expected in mission-critical industrial operations.

The position combines strategic product management with a strong understanding of industrial automation, networking and cybersecurity. In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead and execute the sales support strategy for Process Industries, aligning local initiatives with ABB’s global business objectives and growth ambitions.

Each day, you will provide technical and commercial leadership to support both internal and external customers, ensuring the delivery of high-quality proposals and solutions. You will demonstrate your expertise by overseeing bid, estimation, and proposal activities, driving compliance with ABB standards, improving win rates and profitability, and coaching and developing a high-performing Sales Support team.

The work model for the role is: Onsite

This role contributes to ABB’s Process Industries Division across Australia and the Pacific Islands, driving excellence in sales support, customer engagement, and commercial performance.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Leading and developing the Spares, Bids and Proposals teams, fostering a high-performance culture focused on customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Defining key performance targets and ensuring their achievement by monitoring progress, driving corrective actions, and enhancing customer support and service delivery outcomes.
  • Establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving RFQ, pricing, governance, and bid management processes to ensure consistency, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Driving the development of competitive, commercially sound proposals by evaluating market conditions, customer requirements, and the most effective delivery models, including direct sales, partnerships, consortiums, and channel strategies.
  • Overseeing the review and validation of commercial, technical, legal, and pricing terms within customer offers, while supporting bid/no-bid assessments and strategic decision-making.
  • Participating in project risk reviews and providing technical and commercial guidance throughout the sales process, ensuring Sales teams are equipped to successfully engage customers through presentations, negotiations, and solution discussions.

Qualifications for the role

  • Proven leadership experience in sales operations, bids, proposals, or commercial teams within process industries such as mining, metals, minerals, energy, or heavy industry.
  • Strong background in sales, business development, or commercial management within automation, electrification, digitalisation, or process control environments.
  • Experience developing and optimising sales systems, governance processes, and performance metrics in high-volume, customer-focused organisations.
  • Sound technical knowledge of industrial automation and electrification solutions, including DCS, PLCs, drives, process control systems, and digital technologies.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities, negotiate contracts, manage profitability, and drive business growth.
  • Degree qualified in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline, with excellent communication, stakeholder management, and people leadership skills.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based incentives
  • Flexible working arrangements and international travel opportunities
  • Professional development, training, and career growth support
  • Employee assistance program and local-specific benefits in Australia

More about us

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems.

The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

job.description:

R&D Team Lead ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute significantly to successful project results in technology, software, product, and/or solution development, as well as associated Intellectual Property (IP). Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development for specific product-related issues and maintenance. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying, proposing, and implementing innovative solutions.

The work model for the role is:#Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Distribution Solution division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Maintaining recognized expertise in a specific area by integrating the latest developments in technologies, tools, and methodologies into your work.
  • Finding new ways of solving problems by following your ideas, creating hypotheses, and defining ways to validate them.
  • Documenting work results (like findings, designs, or software), allowing others to maintain and improve them.
  • Understanding and initiating IP generation in your area of specialization and participating in the project IP strategy development.

Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering (should be full-time)
  • Minimum 8 to 12 years of experience in Design and Development of Mechanical Parts and Assemblies (Sheet-Metal components, Casted & Machined Metal parts and Molded Plastic parts)
  • Hands-on experience in prototyping, type testing, and interpreting technical drawings.
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks or Creo 3D CAD software.
  • Strong technical knowledge of Medium Voltage Switchgear (AIS / GIS / RMU).
  • Good verbal and written communication skills in English

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

In this role you will be primarily responsible for End-to-End Lease Accounting Process as SME or team focused on the complete, accurate, and timely completion of Lease Accounting & Reporting and related activities within the General Accounting (GA) team. Ensure compliance with internal guidelines and procedures as well as external regulatory requirements

Lease Accounting Operations

  • Support end-to-end lease accounting activities for global entities.
  • Ensure accurate accounting and reporting of lease contracts in compliance with IFRS 16 and/or ASC 842.
  • Review lease classifications, calculations, remeasurements, modifications, and terminations.
  • Validate right-of-use (ROU) assets and lease liability calculations.
  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end lease accounting close activities.
  • Monitor lease capitalization and amortization schedules.

Financial Reporting & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, and statutory requirements.
  • Prepare and review lease-related journal entries, reconciliations, and financial disclosures.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and explanations.
  • Maintain SOX and compliance controls related to lease accounting processes.

Team Leadership

  • Allocate workloads and monitor team performance against KPIs and SLAs.
  • Conduct performance reviews and support employee development plans.
  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with business units, real estate teams, procurement, legal, and controllers.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for lease accounting matters.
  • Support global finance and business stakeholders with accounting guidance.
  • Manage escalations and resolve complex accounting issues.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through standardization and automation.
  • Lead system enhancement projects and process transformation initiatives.
  • Support implementation and optimization of lease accounting tools (CoStar, Trintech Cadency).
  • Develop and maintain process documentation and SOPs.

Governance & Controls

  • Ensure adherence to financial controls and company policies.
  • Monitor aging items, reconciliation exceptions, and control failures.
  • Track and report operational metrics to management.

Required Qualifications

  • A master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce (MBA/Mcom) is must.
  • Minimum 10to 12 years of experience in Lease Accounting and Record to Report GA.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS 16, ASC 842, and financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience leading teams in a shared service, GBS, or multinational environment.
  • Strong knowledge of working in Tririga, SAP, CFIN, Costar.

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who deliver forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operate with the highest standards

job.title: Regulatory Compliance Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

At Caterpillar, the work we do matters. For more than 100 years, we've delivered products and solutions that support mining, construction, and infrastructure worldwide. Our teams combine practical engineering expertise, manufacturing excellence, and disciplined execution to deliver equipment that performs in the toughest conditions.

As a global leader in mining equipment, we are committed to designing safe, reliable, and compliant products that meet the evolving needs of customers and regulators around the world.

What You’ll Be Doing

This is an exciting opportunity for a compliance, engineering, or product safety professional who enjoys working across technical, regulatory, and business functions to ensure products meet global safety and certification requirements.

You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Groups, Caterpillar Product Compliance & Safety, certification agencies, and regulatory authorities to:

  • Lead product regulatory compliance activities across our Underground Hard Rock product portfolio
  • Support new product development, market expansion, and continuous product improvement initiatives
  • Ensure products meet applicable global regulatory, safety, and certification requirements

Importantly, we're open to candidates from a range of backgrounds including product compliance, product safety, engineering, certification, or regulatory roles within mining, heavy equipment, construction, rail, defence, oil & gas, or other highly regulated industries.

Your mission is to ensure Caterpillar products can be delivered confidently into global markets while meeting the highest standards of safety, compliance, and product integrity. This role extends beyond documentation and certification activities. You will work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the product lifecycle, identifying compliance requirements, supporting risk assessments, and driving successful certification outcomes.

In addition, you will collaborate with internal specialists and external authorities to monitor emerging regulatory requirements and implement appropriate compliance strategies that support both business objectives and customer needs.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead and coordinate product compliance activities across the Underground Hard Rock product portfolio
  • Act as the primary point of contact for product regulatory compliance matters
  • Interpret and communicate global regulations, directives, standards, and legislative requirements
  • Prepare and maintain Technical Construction Files and related compliance documentation
  • Manage product certifications, approvals, and relationships with third-party certification agencies
  • Develop and maintain Declarations of Conformity and supporting compliance records
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI), Continuous Product Improvement (CPI), New Market Introduction (NMI), and New Source Introduction (NSI) programs
  • Determine market-specific compliance requirements and product certification needs
  • Coordinate compliance activities between engineering, legal, product management, certification agencies, and other stakeholders
  • Facilitate product safety risk assessments and support risk mitigation activities
  • Review and approve compliance validation reports and certification documentation
  • Monitor emerging regulatory changes and coordinate implementation plans with relevant teams
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of product compliance processes and governance frameworks

What You Will Bring

We're looking for a technically capable professional who can translate complex regulatory requirements into practical business outcomes. Ideally you will have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Safety Engineering, Product Compliance, or a related discipline
  • Experience in product compliance, product safety, engineering, certification, quality, or regulatory affairs
  • Knowledge of international product safety standards, machinery regulations, and certification requirements
  • Experience participating in product risk assessments and product safety reviews
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing, legal, and commercial teams
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and project coordination capability
  • High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving

Highly Regarded

  • Experience within mining, underground equipment, heavy mobile equipment, construction machinery, rail, defence, or oil & gas industries
  • Familiarity with global machinery legislation and certification frameworks
  • Experience working with regulatory authorities and third-party certification bodies
  • Knowledge of compliance management systems and technical document control processes
  • Exposure to global product certification and market-entry requirement

Why Join the Burnie Product Development Team

Burnie has a proud heritage in underground mining equipment design and development and remains a key location within Caterpillar's global Underground Hard Rock Mining business. The site supports the engineering, validation, and product development activities that help deliver safe, reliable, and productive mining solutions to customers worldwide.

In this role you'll:

  • Contribute to products used in some of the world's most demanding underground mining operations
  • Partner with engineering, product safety, legal, and certification specialists across the Caterpillar enterprise
  • Play a critical role in supporting market access and regulatory compliance for global product launches
  • Influence product safety and design decisions throughout the product lifecycle
  • Be part of a highly experienced team recognised for its underground mining expertise
  • This is a site-based position located in Burnie, Tasmania, requiring attendance in the office 5 days per week. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration, including bonus and share options.
  • Generous parental leave with flexible payment options
  • Strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity
  • Employee discounts across health, wellbeing, travel, and retail
  • Global career progression and development opportunities within Caterpillar

How to Apply

If you're ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role with a global industry leader, apply via:

www.caterpillar.com/careers

Your road to success begins with Caterpillar.

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Caterpillar of Australia is not currently hiring applicants who require sponsorship. As a global company, opportunities may be available in other locations via our careers website.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Pricing Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About FG WILSON

For over 50 years, FG Wilson generator sets have been trusted to provide essential power to a wide range of applications globally. From 6.8 to 2,500 kVA, FG Wilson oﬀers one of the widest ranges of diesel-fuelled generator sets, built in modern facilities in Brazil, China and India.

Over our long history, FG Wilson generator sets have been installed in more than 150 countries worldwide. You’ll ﬁnd our generator sets installed in many of the world’s most iconic buildings, in hospitals, banks, airports, data centres, factories, construction sites, hotels, oﬃces and telecommunications networks, quietly guaranteeing that they are never without electric power.

Role Definition:

The FG Wilson team is seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Aftermarket team as we seek to achieve our ambitious targets to double our aftermarket revenue by 2030.

In this role you will partner with product, financial and industry teams to guide the execution of dynamic and differentiated pricing strategies that align with product and enterprise goals for revenue and profitability.

Responsibilities

  • Analyzes, interprets and communicates a wide variety of data (economic and competitive environment, revenue and profitability, and historical forecasted sales, prices, discounts and price realization) to draw business insights and recommend actions to maximize sales and profitability
  • Develops advanced strategic pricing recommendations for new and existing products and services to drive value-based pricing
  • Provides thought leadership to key stakeholders in the development of pricing strategies for new and existing products and services
  • Executes strategic and tactical price action within a robust pricing governance framework to implement future price changes

Skill Descriptors

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.
  • Researches and verifies customer needs and expectations.
  • Solicits customer satisfaction feedback and acts on improvement opportunities.
  • Helps link organizational objectives to customer needs and expectations.
  • Meets regularly with customers to understand their wants, needs and expectations.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Advises on advanced data gathering and analysis methodologies and technologies.
  • Oversees data gathering and analysis activities within the organization.
  • Documents sources and validates the accuracy of data analysis by evaluating the pros and cons of data analysis methods used.
  • Implements procedures and policies within a data processing function.
  • Teaches others how to improve the validity and reliability of data used in various analyses.
  • Evaluates best practices of data gathering and analysis within the industry.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Value Selling: Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Uses 'value selling' techniques to successfully engage customers.
  • Researches the customer's industry and organization before attempting sales calls.
  • Discusses issues and considerations regarding current 'value selling' practices and recommends potential improvements.
  • Quantifies proposed costs, benefits and value in customer terms.
  • Defines and documents value-added activities and their benefits to customers beyond the initial sales transaction.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Negotiating: Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes qualities of effective and ineffective negotiations.
  • Explains the basic concepts of negotiating.
  • Accesses organizational policies and practices for negotiating.
  • Utilizes techniques for establishing rapport and building trust.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Communicates to clients regarding expectations of all parties.
  • Participates in negotiating the terms of the business relationship.
  • Conducts periodic reviews of work effort, progress, issues, and successes.
  • Maintains productive, long-term relationships with clients or vendors.
  • Creates opportunities to educate support teams on client priorities.
  • Empowers others to establish collaborative, healthy relationships.

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization.

Additional information: This job required 5days working from office.

Posting Dates:

August 18, 2026 - August 31, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.description:

You'll contribute to the continuous improvement of procurement processes while helping ensure quality, cost, delivery, and supplier performance objectives are achieved.

Evolving Regulatory and Compliance Landscape

  • India continues to experience frequent regulatory and compliance changes that require close collaboration between business, legal, compliance, and IT stakeholders. Core Application Systems:Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Helps create contingency plans to mitigate impact of disruption on core applications.
  • Identifies key players, criticalities, roles, and responsibilities.
  • Investigates application-related issues with both business and IT professionals.
  • Recommends enhancements for a major application system or related subsystems.
  • Works with core application systems for a major business unit or function.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Technology Advising:Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain.

technologies or services within a domain of technology expertise.

Application Design, Architecture:Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.

  • Uses design tools and technologies to develop prototypes and proof of concepts.

Implementation:Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
  • Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
  • Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
  • Provides instant support for end users of application software.
  • Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis:Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

Level Extensive Experience:

System and Technology Integration:Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

  • Explores major issues and considerations for successful system integration.
  • Works with applications, data, technology bridges and a variety of platforms.
  • Works with existing interfaces as well as integration and migration plans within own area.Plays an active role in local integration efforts.

System Testing:Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

This role is accountable for driving construction industries technology utilization and adoption at scale across dealer and customer operations. The focus is not just selling technology but ensuring it is actively used to deliver measurable productivity, safety, and aftermarket outcomes.

You will work directly with dealers and customers to close the gap between technology installed and technology used, driving execution in the field.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Utilization & Execution

  • Lead actions to increase utilization of Cat technologies across installed fleets (Grade, Payload, VisionLink, Safety)
