  • Drive execution discipline — ensuring technology delivers real outcomes, not just activation

Dealer Capability & Accountability

  • Build dealer capability to support technology adoption and ongoing use
  • Set clear expectations and review dealer performance against utilization targets
  • Drive corrective actions where execution gaps exist

Customer Engagement & Value Delivery

  • Work directly with customers to improve jobsite performance through technology

Training & Enablement

job.title: Site Leader - Thermal & Electric - El Paso Tx
job.description:
Job Description

The Site Leader will provide world class jobsite leadership for large, long-duration, high-profile projects for Vertiv power and/or thermal equipment. The Site Leader is the primary Vertiv Service on-site technical representative for large jobs, from construction start, through start-up, site acceptance testing, and project completion. The Site Leader is required to establish, grow and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate. The Site Lead is required to work in tandem with the assigned Project Manager to drive cost controls, schedule adherence, resource management, and ultimately a positive customer experience.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE SUMMARY

  • Provide jobsite construction and technical leadership for large projects
  • Working knowledge of critical infrastructure equipment in data centers, including Vertiv-manufactured equipment
  • Leads a multi-disciplinary on-site team consisting of Project Leaders, Installers, Technicians, Customer Engineers, and subcontractors
  • Represents Vertiv at daily customer meetings and can speak to technical requirements for the day’s schedule to coordinate activity with other parties on-site
  • Leads and supports start-up and site testing activities for assigned projects
  • Ensure sufficient manpower on-site each day to perform start-up and site testing work
  • Assist during start-up and site testing as necessary, depending upon man-power availability and site location
  • Provide daily status reports to Service Management, Project Management and sales rep

TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Keeps current on Vertiv equipment start-up and commissioning processes, procedures, and tools-of-the-trade
  • Keeps current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips

SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads daily Vertiv toolbox talk, pre-job safety walk and inspection, and drives any necessary corrective/preventative actions required in a timely fashion
  • Responsible for the adherence and administration of all site and Vertiv Safety policies on job sites
  • Operates in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel
  • Must be a role model to fellow associates with regards to safety by setting a positive example
  • Lead by example with the use of STOP WORK Authority, Good Catch engagement, and timely closure of necessary corrective/preventative actions

ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure adherence to Vertiv Warranty process in partnership with Project Manager
  • Provide accurate and timely reporting in accordance with published guidelines
  • Timecards, expense reports, mileage reports, SR/task closure, forms, et al.
  • Supports Project Manager with obtaining any necessary technical data so Project Manager can maintain project systems
  • Maintain company property according to company policies
  • Credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, smartphone, et al.

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Ensure daily alignment of customer expectations and Vertiv activity, and drive clarification/re-alignment if there appears to be misalignment of expectations
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates according to company guidelines

PERSONAL PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Make decisions based on the Fundamental 5 in order of importance: Safety, Quality, Timeliness, Cost, Productivity
  • Capable of making timely decisions, technical and commercial, under pressure
  • Maintain productive utilization rate according to company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation process and procedures
  • In all aspects of job requirements, must lead by example, and conduct themselves aligned to Vertiv Behaviors
  • Ability to communicate with all levels within the organization -Managers, co-workers, Support Services, sales, electronic communications, et al.
  • Ability to handle stressful situations and provide a calming effect to customer
  • High level of diplomacy when interacting with internal and external customers

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience (one or more of the following)
  • ASEET or ASMET preferred
  • Equivalent industry experience, specifically leading and actively participating in start-up and commissioning of power and/or hvac equipment preferred
  • Six years’ military experience in a related field
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Industrial construction management
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Vertiv Behavior practitioner
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Independent operator
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Able to build and maintain trusting customer relationships
  • Collaborative and cooperative in high-stress environments
  • Able to communicate at all levels of an organization with a base level of executive presence
  • Able to quickly respond to changing customer priorities without disruption or resistance
  • Must be able to read and interpret electrical one-line diagrams and blueprints
  • In all aspects of the job, need to lead by example, and be held to a higher standard of conduct
  • Product certifications up to date
  • Meet all aspects of the job description
  • Performance evaluation rating of meets all aspects of job requirement or better
  • Consistent performance and customer relation skills
  • Technical skills
  • Ability to make an immediate site evaluation, skills to include environmental temperature, and general operating conditions without supervision
  • Ability to summarize and report all work related tasks performed
  • Independently evaluate, recognize and recommend acceptable customer solutions based upon site evaluation
  • Recommend and direct activities at a customer site by leading technical activities of other technicians
  • Provide on-site customer consultation with the assistance of Project Leader(s)
  • Capable of providing project leadership and on-site direction for assigned projects
  • Expert in COHE procedures
  • Expert in site acceptance testing procedures and equipment
  • Computer skills
  • Advanced word processing, report generation
  • Spreadsheet processing
  • Electronic mail
  • Testing equipment and data analysis programs
  • Familiarity with computer networks
  • Mechanical aptitude

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Job assignments will typically be long-term assignments ranging from 4 weeks to 12+ months duration based upon the scope and schedule of the project
  • If assigned a project not located in the vicinity of Site Leader residence, travel will consist of a field rotation that includes (3) consecutive weeks on the customer site followed by (1) week of a service break in their home office whereby the Site Leader is expected to work their minimum of 40 hours on billable tasks and any administrative duties (i.e. Safety training, cycle counts, etc.) as necessary
  • Jobsites consisting of industrial new construction (greens field) or retrofit construction (browns field)
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Deployable in the event of emergencies

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

Notes: Vertiv will make reasonable accommodations whenever necessary for all qualified employees or candidates with disabilities (as defined by applicable law), provided that (1) the individual is otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job and (2) such accommodations due not impose an undue hardship.

  • _Financial Strength_

job.description:
Job Description

The Site Leader will provide world class jobsite leadership for large, long-duration, high-profile projects for Vertiv power and/or thermal equipment. The Site Leader is the primary Vertiv Service on-site technical representative for large jobs, from construction start, through start-up, site acceptance testing, and project completion. The Site Leader is required to establish, grow and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate. The Site Lead is required to work in tandem with the assigned Project Manager to drive cost controls, schedule adherence, resource management, and ultimately a positive customer experience.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE SUMMARY

  • Provide jobsite construction and technical leadership for large projects
  • Working knowledge of critical infrastructure equipment in data centers, including Vertiv-manufactured equipment
  • Leads a multi-disciplinary on-site team consisting of Project Leaders, Installers, Technicians, Customer Engineers, and subcontractors
  • Represents Vertiv at daily customer meetings and can speak to technical requirements for the day’s schedule to coordinate activity with other parties on-site
  • Leads and supports start-up and site testing activities for assigned projects
  • Ensure sufficient manpower on-site each day to perform start-up and site testing work
  • Assist during start-up and site testing as necessary, depending upon man-power availability and site location
  • Provide daily status reports to Service Management, Project Management and sales rep

TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Keeps current on Vertiv equipment start-up and commissioning processes, procedures, and tools-of-the-trade
  • Keeps current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips

SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads daily Vertiv toolbox talk, pre-job safety walk and inspection, and drives any necessary corrective/preventative actions required in a timely fashion
  • Responsible for the adherence and administration of all site and Vertiv Safety policies on job sites
  • Operates in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel
  • Must be a role model to fellow associates with regards to safety by setting a positive example
  • Lead by example with the use of STOP WORK Authority, Good Catch engagement, and timely closure of necessary corrective/preventative actions

ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure adherence to Vertiv Warranty process in partnership with Project Manager
  • Provide accurate and timely reporting in accordance with published guidelines
  • Timecards, expense reports, mileage reports, SR/task closure, forms, et al.
  • Supports Project Manager with obtaining any necessary technical data so Project Manager can maintain project systems
  • Maintain company property according to company policies
  • Credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, smartphone, et al.

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Ensure daily alignment of customer expectations and Vertiv activity, and drive clarification/re-alignment if there appears to be misalignment of expectations
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates according to company guidelines

PERSONAL PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Make decisions based on the Fundamental 5 in order of importance: Safety, Quality, Timeliness, Cost, Productivity
  • Capable of making timely decisions, technical and commercial, under pressure
  • Maintain productive utilization rate according to company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation process and procedures
  • In all aspects of job requirements, must lead by example, and conduct themselves aligned to Vertiv Behaviors
  • Ability to communicate with all levels within the organization -Managers, co-workers, Support Services, sales, electronic communications, et al.
  • Ability to handle stressful situations and provide a calming effect to customer
  • High level of diplomacy when interacting with internal and external customers

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience (one or more of the following)
  • ASEET or ASMET preferred
  • Equivalent industry experience, specifically leading and actively participating in start-up and commissioning of power and/or hvac equipment preferred
  • Six years’ military experience in a related field
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Industrial construction management
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Vertiv Behavior practitioner
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Independent operator
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Able to build and maintain trusting customer relationships
  • Collaborative and cooperative in high-stress environments
  • Able to communicate at all levels of an organization with a base level of executive presence
  • Able to quickly respond to changing customer priorities without disruption or resistance
  • Must be able to read and interpret electrical one-line diagrams and blueprints
  • In all aspects of the job, need to lead by example, and be held to a higher standard of conduct
  • Product certifications up to date
  • Meet all aspects of the job description
  • Performance evaluation rating of meets all aspects of job requirement or better
  • Consistent performance and customer relation skills
  • Technical skills
  • Ability to make an immediate site evaluation, skills to include environmental temperature, and general operating conditions without supervision
  • Ability to summarize and report all work related tasks performed
  • Independently evaluate, recognize and recommend acceptable customer solutions based upon site evaluation
  • Recommend and direct activities at a customer site by leading technical activities of other technicians
  • Provide on-site customer consultation with the assistance of Project Leader(s)
  • Capable of providing project leadership and on-site direction for assigned projects
  • Expert in COHE procedures
  • Expert in site acceptance testing procedures and equipment
  • Computer skills
  • Advanced word processing, report generation
  • Spreadsheet processing
  • Electronic mail
  • Testing equipment and data analysis programs
  • Familiarity with computer networks
  • Mechanical aptitude

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Job assignments will typically be long-term assignments ranging from 4 weeks to 12+ months duration based upon the scope and schedule of the project
  • If assigned a project not located in the vicinity of Site Leader residence, travel will consist of a field rotation that includes (3) consecutive weeks on the customer site followed by (1) week of a service break in their home office whereby the Site Leader is expected to work their minimum of 40 hours on billable tasks and any administrative duties (i.e. Safety training, cycle counts, etc.) as necessary
  • Jobsites consisting of industrial new construction (greens field) or retrofit construction (browns field)
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Deployable in the event of emergencies

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

Notes: Vertiv will make reasonable accommodations whenever necessary for all qualified employees or candidates with disabilities (as defined by applicable law), provided that (1) the individual is otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job and (2) such accommodations due not impose an undue hardship.

_The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities._

_OUR CORE PRINCIPALS: Safety. Integrity.  Respect.  Teamwork. Diversity & Inclusion._

_OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES_

  • _Customer Focus_
  • _Operational Excellence_
  • _High-Performance Culture_
  • _Innovation_
  • _Financial Strength_

_OUR BEHAVIORS_

  • _Own It_
  • _Act With Urgency_
  • _Foster a Customer-First Mindset_
  • _Think Big and Execute_
  • _Lead by Example_
  • _Drive Continuous Improvement_
  • _Learn and Seek Out Development_

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

job.title: Test Engineering Technician
job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description

This is a Test Engineering Technician role is in the Product Integrity department of the Power Management business unit.  The Product Integrity team setups and executes test cases to validation new AC Power products.  Products may have a regional scope or a global scope.

Job Summary

This is a _Test Engineering Technician_ role is in the Product Integrity department of the Power Management business unit.  The Product Integrity team setups and executes test cases to validation new AC Power products.  Products may have a regional scope or a global scope.

The Test Engineering Technician will setup the unit under test and the instrumentation as per the test plan.  They will operate the unit under test and collect data as per the individual test cases. While executing the test cases, the technician will make observations and keep notes regarding the unit under test’s performance.  All of the data collected and the technician’s notes are entered into the test results by the technician.  The technician participates in daily standup meetings, keeps their work areas clean and safe, and assists with keeping all the test labs clean and safe.

This position will be based onsite at our Delaware, OH location.

Responsibilities

  • Follow safety policies and lead by example with safe job execution.
  • Setup the unit under test and other equipment which entails connecting large cables (up to 50lbs).
  • Setup instrumentation (oscilloscopes, power meters, CTs, voltage probes, and other equipment).
  • Execute test cases, operate unit under test, operate the instrumentation, collect data, and document the results.
  • Troubleshoot and correct problems with test setups and with units under test.
  • Suggest continuous improvement opportunities.

Requirements

  • Associate of Science majoring in Electronics or Electrical Engineering or military certification achieved.
  • 1 to 3 years of relevant experience.
  • Broad knowledge of electrical and mechanical test techniques.
  • Experience with 208/230/480V/600V 3-phase 60/50 Hz wiring and equipment.
  • Experience with 120v 1-phase 60Hz wiring and equipment.
  • Experience with instrumentation and low volt wiring.
  • Experience with electrical safety tools and techniques.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word and Excel
  • General mechanical skills assembling and disassembling electrical equipment including but not limited to, high power electronics, large magnetic components, circuit boards, high current wiring etc.
  • Must have good working knowledge and skills in testing of electrical equipment.
  • Must be able to read electronic and electrical schematics.
  • Good troubleshooting skills related to AC and DC power circuits.
  • Basic experience setting up and using oscilloscopes, power meters for 3 phase measurements.
  • Shift/Schedule flexibility for short periods/projects is a plus

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to lift 50lbs.
  • Ability to stand and/or walk while performing tasks 70% of the time.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • ~5%

job.title: Product Strategist - Emerging Technologies
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Product Strategist - Emerging Technologies is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and developing product and market strategies for next-generation technologies that will shape the future of data center infrastructure. This role serves as a key link between market intelligence, customer needs, technology innovation, product management, engineering, and business leadership. The Product Strategist assesses emerging market trends, competitive dynamics, customer requirements, and technology advancements to support Vertiv’s long-term growth strategy, product roadmap development, and investment decisions.

_This position will be based onsite at our Westerville, OH location._

Responsibilities

  • Commercial Assessment: Evaluate research programs for commercial potential — assessing market demand, technical feasibility, regulatory pathway, and time-to-market.
  • Customer Discovery & Competitive Analysis: Conduct customer discovery interviews, competitive landscape analysis, and market sizing to inform research priorities and investment decisions.
  • Research-to-Business Alignment: Work with research teams to align research roadmaps with business strategy, product portfolio needs, and market timing.
  • Go-to-Market Planning: Develop preliminary go-to-market strategies for promising research outcomes, including pricing frameworks, channel strategies, and launch sequencing.
  • Proof-of-Concept Guidance: Guide proof-of-concept development to ensure experiments address business-critical questions (not just technical curiosity).
  • Regulatory & IP Strategy: Identify regulatory requirements and intellectual property considerations that impact commercialization timelines and investment decisions.
  • Cross-BU Collaboration: Work across business units to ensure research initiatives align with broader market needs and avoid duplication of effort.
  • Financial Modeling: Build business cases and financial models to support investment decisions, including TAM/SAM analysis, ROI projections, and risk-adjusted returns.

Preferred Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking with Commercial Pragmatism
  • Commercial Acumen and Business Case Development
  • Customer Empathy and Voice of Customer Discovery
  • Comfort with Ambiguity in Early-Stage Research
  • Energy Efficiency and Sustainability Solutions

Requirements

  • 8–10 years in product strategy, product management, or business development in technology-driven organizations.
  • Demonstrated success in evaluating and commercializing early-stage technology or research.
  • Strong market analysis, customer discovery, and competitive intelligence skills.
  • Ability to assess technical feasibility at a conceptual level (without needing to do the engineering).
  • Excellent stakeholder management — ability to influence without authority across research, engineering, and commercial teams.
  • Experience building business cases and financial models for technology investments.

Preferred:

  • Background in engineering, science, or technical field (degree or equivalent experience).
  • Industry experience in data center infrastructure, thermal management, power systems, or energy efficiency.
  • Understanding of regulatory environments relevant to infrastructure technology.
  • Experience working with or within R&D organizations.

job.title: Program Manager – Emerging Technology
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Program Manager – Emerging Technology coordinates and manages complex, multi-disciplinary research programs that span multiple business units, research domains, and external partnerships. The role’s primary purpose is to remove organizational and logistical friction so domain scientists can focus on research, and ensure dependencies, budgets, and timelines across teams stay visible and aligned.

This position will be based onsite at our Westerville, OH location.

Responsibilities

  • Program Coordination: Own end-to-end delivery of 2–3 large research programs; establish timelines, milestones, and cross-team dependencies; escalate blockers to leadership.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Facilitate planning meetings across Research Scientists, Research Engineers, Data Engineers, and external partners (universities, vendors, contract labs); ensure alignment on objectives and resource needs.
  • External Resource Management: Coordinate with external labs, academic partners, vendors, and contract researchers; manage SOWs, timelines, deliverables, and communication.
  • Budget & Resource Tracking: Monitor program spend, resource allocation across internal and external teams, and forecast variances.
  • Status & Reporting: Maintain program dashboards; provide leadership with visibility on health, risks, and upcoming milestones.
  • Cross-BU Coordination: Work with product/commercial teams to ensure research roadmaps align with business priorities; unblock resource conflicts between business units.
  • Risk Management: Identify dependencies, critical path risks, and resource constraints early; develop mitigation plans.

Preferred Areas of Technological Focus:

  • Thermal Management and Advanced Cooling Systems
  • Data Center Infrastructure and Architecture
  • Power Systems and Power Conversion
  • Energy Efficiency and Sustainability Solutions
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC) Environments
  • Advanced Materials and Manufacturing Processes

Requirements

  • Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Technology Management, or related technical discipline.
  • MBA or advanced technical degree preferred.
  • 5-7 years of program or project management experience in technology, critical infrastructure, data center, power systems, energy storage, thermal management, or related industries.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional technology development or product commercialization programs.
  • Strong understanding of data center infrastructure technologies including power, thermal, digital management, or energy systems.
  • Experience with NPDI methodologies.
  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Knowledge of DFSS, FMEA, requirements traceability, and technology readiness frameworks preferred.
  • PMP certification preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, and Power BI.

Preferred:

  • Background in engineering, science, or technical field (degree or 5+ years hands-on experience).
  • Experience managing research programs or innovation initiatives.
  • Familiarity with academic partnerships or contract research organizations.
  • Background in data center, thermal management, power systems, or related industries.

job.title: System Controls Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Description

Who are we?

At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected.  With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.

We are currently seeking a System Controls Solution Architect to join our dynamic team in Piove di Sacco (PD), Italy!

The Thermal System Controls Architect will be responsible for defining the technical and commercial architecture of Vertiv’s system-level thermal controls and optimization solutions for customer projects. The role will cover the full thermal chain, including CDU systems, secondary fluid network management, pumps, chillers, heat rejection systems, heat reuse applications and plant-level optimization solutions. This position will translate customer requirements, project specifications and site constraints into a complete controls solution, including hardware architecture, software scope, integration requirements, commercial assumptions, economics, risks, exclusions and upselling opportunities. The Architect will act as a bridge between Offering Management, Sales, Application Engineering, Controls Development, Project Execution, Commissioning and Service teams, ensuring that each opportunity is properly scoped, costed, documented and handed over for successful execution.

What kind of work will you be doing?

  • Define the system architecture for Vertiv’s thermal controls and optimization solutions on customer projects.
  • Support solutions such as the Chilled Water Manager and Optimizer, Secondary Fluid Network Manager and future system-level thermal control platforms.
  • Analyze customer specifications, sequence of operation documents, P&IDs, system architecture, equipment lists and project requirements.
  • Define the required hardware and software scope for each project.
  • Identify required PLC/control hardware, I/O architecture, communication interfaces, HMI/SCADA requirements, software modules and integration points.
  • Define how the controls solution interfaces with CDU systems, secondary fluid networks, pumps, chillers, heat rejection equipment, heat reuse systems and higher-level supervisory platforms.
  • Support the commercial definition of the offering for specific opportunities, including scope, assumptions, exclusions, risks and deliverables.
  • Support project economics, budgetary estimates, cost build-up, pricing inputs and margin analysis.
  • Identify upselling opportunities related to advanced control features, optimization, monitoring, analytics, energy efficiency, serviceability and lifecycle support.
  • Manage requirement intake, clarification and alignment with Offering Management, Sales, Engineering and technical teams.
  • Translate customer and project needs into clear technical requirements for the Controls Development team.
  • Support preparation of technical proposals, architecture descriptions, compliance responses and customer-facing documentation.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Application Engineering during pre-sales, tender and customer clarification phases.
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineering and Business Unit teams to align project needs with standard platform capabilities and future roadmap synergies.
  • Support project execution from initial definition through engineering alignment and handover to commissioning.
  • Ensure a clear handover package to commissioning, including scope, controls architecture, requirements, open points, assumptions, risks and project-specific constraints.
  • Capture lessons learned from projects and provide feedback to Offering Management for roadmap and product improvement.

What will make you successful?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering or equivalent technical experience.
  • Experience in HVAC controls, liquid cooling controls, BMS, chiller plant controls, data center infrastructure, industrial automation or mission-critical thermal systems.
  • Strong understanding of hydronic and liquid cooling systems, including CDU systems, secondary loops, pumps, valves, chillers, heat rejection equipment, buffer tanks and heat reuse applications.
  • Ability to interpret customer specifications, P&IDs, control diagrams, sequence of operation documents, I/O lists and electrical/control architecture.
  • Good understanding of PLCs, SCADA, HMI, industrial networks and communication protocols.
  • Ability to translate technical requirements into commercial scope, cost assumptions and project deliverables.
  • Experience working with Sales, Application Engineering, Offering Management, Engineering, Project Management, Commissioning and Service teams.
  • Ability to manage technical clarification, scope definition and customer expectation alignment.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex controls topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with chilled water plant management, liquid cooling systems, secondary fluid networks or data center thermal infrastructure.
  • Experience with system-level controls, supervisory control platforms, optimization layers, energy management or analytics.
  • Familiarity with Ignition, Unify, Codesys, Modbus TCP, BACnet, MQTT or similar technologies.
  • Experience in technical sales support, solution architecture, application engineering, offering management or project engineering.
  • Knowledge of energy optimization, plant sequencing, control stability, heat reuse strategies and lifecycle service opportunities.
  • Experience supporting global projects across multiple regions.

If YOU are the person we are looking for, feel free to apply and let's start drafting your future career in a healthy and growing environment!

job.title: Strategy & Integration Sr. Manager
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

T he Strategy & Integration Senior Manager advances the Americas Strategy and Portfolio Growth agenda by leading strategic initiatives and cross-functional workstreams. Partnering closely with Americas leadership, this role transforms complex business questions into data-driven insights, actionable recommendations, and execution plans that deliver measurable results. The position serves as a critical link between strategy and execution, helping define priorities, drive alignment, and ensure key initiatives are successfully implemented across the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the regional strategic planning process

  • Coordinate development of the Americas three-year strategic plan in alignment with the corporate strategy and finance-led planning process, timeline, templates, and required deliverables.
  • Partner closely with sales, operations, and the product organization to translate product strategy, portfolio priorities, market assumptions, and growth opportunities into the regional strategic plan.
  • Manage inputs, milestones, and review cycles across functions to ensure the plan is complete, consistent, and delivered on schedule.
  • Prepare clear summaries, working sessions, and leadership review materials that connect product priorities, regional growth choices, financial assumptions, and required decisions.
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, risks, and tradeoffs in the plan and coordinate follow-up with product, finance, and functional owners to resolve them.
  • Maintain structured tools, trackers, and templates that support the corporate process and make the three-year planning cycle easier to manage and repeat.

Coordinate and manage business cadence and reporting

  • Run the business governance cadence, including recurring leadership reviews, operating meetings, and cross-functional check-ins.
  • Maintain action logs, decision trackers, milestone plans, and risk / issue registers to ensure commitments are visible and followed through.
  • Develop simple, repeatable reporting mechanisms that highlight progress, blockers, ownership, and upcoming decisions.
  • Surface risks and tradeoffs early, escalate issues appropriately, and help leadership focus on the decisions needed to keep execution on track.
  • Continuously improve governance, reporting, and follow-up processes through better systems, automation, and fit-for-purpose AI use cases that improve reliability and reduce administrative burden.

Lead special projects and craft executive communications

  • Independently lead short-cycle, cross-functional special projects for the Americas leadership team, typically requiring fast, clean analysis, a clear recommendation, and implementation tracking.
  • Develop executive-ready communications: decks, narratives, and briefing notes that drive alignment and action.
  • Conduct targeted research on priority companies, competitors, market trends, and emerging themes to inform strategic recommendations and leadership decisions.
  • Improve team effectiveness by creating templates, playbooks, and repeatable mechanisms that reduce friction and improve follow-through.

Manage regional post-merger integration execution

  • Drive post-merger integration planning by translating deal rationale and diligence findings into clear integration priorities, milestones, risks, and value capture opportunities.
  • Maintain integration workplans, decision trackers, dependency maps, and risk / issue logs to ensure functional owners stay aligned and on pace.
  • Coordinate cross-functional integration workstreams across commercial, operations, finance, legal, HR, and other functions as needed.
  • Build and maintain simple KPI reporting for integration progress, milestone completion, and value capture.
  • Create repeatable tools, templates, and process improvements that make integration workstreams easier to manage and scale.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Business, Engineering, Finance, or similar); MBA preferred.
  • 7-10 of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, internal consulting, transformation/program management, or adjacent roles.
  • Strong analytical skills (Excel modeling, business cases, KPI design) and ability to structure ambiguous problems.
  • Strong PowerPoint and writing skills with an executive audience in mind.
  • Practical project management capability: cadence, action tracking, dependency management, and escalation.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools such as Microsoft Copilot and reporting / visualization tools such as Power BI; able to apply them practically to improve analysis, reporting, automation, and workflow efficiency.
  • Proven ability to work across functions and influence without authority.
  • High judgment and discretion with sensitive information.
  • Exposure to post-merger integration, synergy tracking, integration management, or related workstream coordination.
  • Experience in a complex B2B / engineered products / services environment.
  • Comfort working with senior leaders (VP-level) and adapting communication style to the audience.
  • Experience mentoring analysts or coordinating small teams/workstreams (no direct reports required).
  • Familiarity with common project tracking tools (Smartsheet, Asana, MS Project, etc.).

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • No special physical requirements

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • <20%

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

What to Expect:As a Mechanical Technician I, assembling our world-class machines, you can expect to safely assemble a quality product with a name known across the world. Put your mechanical aptitude and personal and/or professional experience into building the next generation of heavy paving equipment.Apply today!

Pay Rate and Schedule:

The position includes a total wage of $26.98 /hour plus a comprehensive Day-One Benefits program.Total compensation includes a base hourly of $25.73/hr plus an additional shift differential of $1.25/hr. Paid weekly. Paid time-off: Vacation, holiday, and Winter Holiday. Retirement: 401K matching AND additional 2-5% annual company contribution.

Openings available on 2nd shift: Monday –_**Friday, 2:00 p.m.

  • 10:00 p.m.**_ Overtime opportunities may be available on a voluntary basis based on business needs and with leader prior authorization. All initial communication and status updates will be via email.

  • 2 years' cumulative experience in a mechanic or assembly field, heavy equipment assembly, or technical school with a focus in a mechanical or manufacturing field.
  • Relevant experiences such as mechanical aptitude in a personal or professional setting must be described in application

Top Candidates Will Have:

  • 6 months minimum Caterpillar Paving experience
  • Experience reading blueprints / schematics
  • Heavy assembly, manufacturing machines, Caterpillar manufacturing experience or automotive
  • Intermediate or greater proficiency using electronic and digital devices and mediums
  • Experience using mechanical tools including torque tools and operation of crane equipment

As a Mechanical Technician team member, you will support facility initiatives and daily tasks focused on people, safety, quality, velocity and cost. As a team member, you will be responsible for safely assembling heavy paving products according to model pictures and build instructions utilizing mechanical tools, torque tools, metric units, hydraulics and electrical components within allotted process time. You will work with team members on identifying, electronically documenting and communicating opportunities for improvement, communicating discrepancies, and recommending solutions. Work with limited supervision.

THIS IS A SECOND SHIFT ROLE

job.title: Director, Commercial
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

About the role

The purpose of this role is to drive and manage commercial aspects of customer prospects across DayOne’s portfolio of data centres globally. You will be responsible for managing the profitability of DayOne’s customers, including reviewing, negotiating and overseeing contracts, pursuing new business opportunities and supporting sales and marketing strategies.

You must have a good knowledge of the ICT and data centre market and possess strong commercial acumen. This role will be based in Singapore.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead strategic pricing for bids/RFPs and non-standard or complex products/solutions
  • Conduct commercial risk assessment for customer contracts and other strategic initiatives / investment. Work with all business units (eg legal) to review non-standard contracts or non-standard terms
  • Drive the review/approval process with Deal Committee for proposals that are non-standard/complex/capex-intensive
  • Provide support to Sales on commercial proposals (pricing and costing). Perform win-loss analysis.
  • Co-drive regular review of costing / pricing in the various markets with Sales and Product.
  • Co-drive the review the renewal / churn of service agreements / leases with Sales
  • Prepare Sales forecast and pipeline analysis
  • Proactively present suggestions for process/business improvements and assume accountability for implementation of relevant initiatives.
  • Drives the digitizing of commercial and quotation processes to improve efficiency

Qualifications and experience required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Engineering, IT, or a related field.
  • Minimum 12 years of relevant experience in business analysis, preferably in a data centre, IT infrastructure, telecommunications, or technology environment.
  • Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong commercial acumen
  • Financial knowledge to build business cases and financial models
  • Appreciation of technical knowledge of data centres, telecommunications and other technologies relevant to data centres
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc)

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer - Singapore, Central Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

The Critical Facilities Engineer is responsible for the operation, maintenance, monitoring, and reliability of mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role supports the continuous availability of electrical, mechanical, fire life safety, and building management systems through preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, incident response, and vendor management activities.

The successful candidate will apply technical expertise and sound judgment to identify risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure all systems operate safely, efficiently, and in accordance with operational standards

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Performs specialized preventative and corrective maintenance on-site to critical facility components and/or systems
  • Performs moderately difficult repairs, maintenance, installations and on-site inspections to critical facility systems
  • Monitors the Building Monitoring System (BMS) and resolves alarms for specialized issues requiring considerable judgement and implications to resolve; follows guidelines on standard procedures and makes recommendations for solutioning
  • Operates and maintains plumbing, fire suppression, and life-safety systems
  • Implements energy efficiency measures
  • Assists team members on coordinating critical infrastructures
  • Works on assignments requiring considerable judgment and initiative. Understands implications of work and makes recommendations for solutions

Vendor Support

  • Coordinates and directs vendors on skilled tasks to ensure that maintenance activities are carried out per standards and requirements
  • Assists with the creation and submission of scripts for maintenance
  • Tracks and implements the work approval process for service providers for critical maintenance (including briefing at the start of work, control of work during the day workday/shift, final review of the work carried out)
  • In cooperation with the vendors, changes/updates technical files for plants and equipment ensuring files and builds are up-to-date

Site Administration & Incident Support

  • Performs specialized site logs and data gathering for issuing of permits, such as Maintenance Operation Protocol (MOPs) and scripts
  • Identifies Single Points of Failure (SPOFs) and makes recommendations for solutions
  • Responds to all on-site incidents, including failures, significant problems and delays
  • Performs Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and make recommendations for solutions
  • Supports the on-site staff during incidents
  • Demonstrates and supports processes and procedures are followed and adhered to

Work Orders & Additional Projects

  • Completes skilled work requests and circuit installations
  • Performs advanced troubleshooting and maintenance of office equipment (if necessary); supports auxiliary equipment and machines with problem solving and repairs to avoid/minimize downtime
  • Makes moderate changes to mechanical, electrical and specialized systems, as directed
  • Carries out more complex infrastructure projects
  • Supports life cycle maintenance/end of life. infrastructure projects and critical replacements
  • May recommend infrastructure projects

Collaboration

  • Collaborates with others to resolve difficult facility incidents
  • Effectively collaborates within the department; may mentor team members on skilled maintenance activities
  • Informs stakeholders of inventory needs to maintain optimal stock levels of critical parts and equipment, may support in coordinating processes for maintaining inventory
  • Acts as a mentor to others in resolving incidents

Qualifications

  • We welcome candidates with experience in electrical, mechanical, facilities, manufacturing, telecommunications, industrial operations, military technical roles, or data center environments.
  • Direct data center experience is preferred but not required, as training will be provided.

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities III - Singapore
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Critical Facilities Engineer III supports the operation, maintenance, and reliability of mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role performs a broad range of maintenance and operational activities while applying technical knowledge and established procedures to resolve issues and support site operations. Working as part of a collaborative team, the engineer helps ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations while continuing to develop expertise across critical facility systems.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on facility systems and equipment to support reliable operations.
  • Carry out repairs, inspections, and installation activities across facility infrastructure in accordance with established procedures and safety standards.
  • Monitor the Building Monitoring System (BMS) and respond to alarms by investigating issues and supporting resolution efforts.
  • Support the operation and maintenance of critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, plumbing, fire suppression, and life-safety systems.
  • Assist with energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives by identifying opportunities and supporting implementation activities.
  • Perform day-to-day operational tasks independently while seeking guidance on more complex or unfamiliar situations.

Vendor Support

  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers performing maintenance activities within the data center.
  • Support the work approval process, including pre-work briefings, monitoring activities, and confirming completion of work.
  • Ensure vendor activities are conducted in accordance with site procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate technical documentation, records, and asset information.

Site Administration & Incident Support

  • Prepare and maintain site documentation, permits, logs, and records, including Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs) and operational scripts.
  • Identify potential infrastructure risks and Single Points of Failure (SPOFs) and raise recommendations for review.
  • Respond to site incidents, equipment failures, and operational issues in accordance with established procedures.
  • Support incident investigations and documentation activities to improve operational reliability and resilience.
  • Apply operating procedures and compliance requirements to support safe and effective site operations.

Work Orders & Additional Projects

  • Complete operational work orders and support system installations related to facility infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain auxiliary systems and supporting equipment to minimize operational impact.
  • Support approved changes to mechanical, electrical, and specialized systems.
  • Participate in infrastructure upgrades, maintenance programs, lifecycle replacement initiatives, and site improvement projects.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts that enhance operational performance and reliability.

Collaboration

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support operational activities and resolve facility issues.
  • Share knowledge and support team members during maintenance activities and operational events.
  • Communicate inventory and spare-parts requirements to maintain operational readiness.
  • Participate in training and development activities to expand technical capabilities and support career growth.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or equivalent qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience is also valued.
  • Typically 1–3 years of experience in critical facilities, facilities operations, data center operations, industrial facilities, building operations, or a related technical environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Understanding of electrical, mechanical, cooling, or building systems.
  • Familiarity with maintenance procedures, facility monitoring systems, and safe work practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Commitment to safety, operational excellence, and continuous learning.

Work Requirements

  • Ability to perform hands-on operational and maintenance tasks within a data center environment.

job.title: Principal Data Engineer - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

As a Principal Data Engineer at Equinix, you will be responsible for driving end-to-end delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions on Google Cloud Platform. This role combines hands-on technical expertise, requiring you to design sophisticated system architectures, lead cross-functional initiatives, and mentor data engineers. You will act as a trusted technical advisor for the team championing innovation across GCP, Data Engineering, AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled technical depth, exceptional strategic thinking, and a demonstrated history of delivering transformational data platform capabilities at a global scale.

Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture Leadership

  • Architect and evolve cloud-native, petabyte-scale data platforms and data products, with clearly defined and measurable SLOs for data freshness, availability, and reliability
  • Design data solutions balancing scalability, performance, cost, and operational excellence through clear architectural trade-offs
  • Establish reference architectures, architectural guardrails, and engineering standards adopted organization-wide
  • Lead architectural governance across all data engineering squads, ensuring consistency, scalability, and security
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies (including Agentic AI/LLM and real-time systems) to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes
  • Drive adoption of domain-oriented data architecture (e.g., data mesh principles) across business domains to enable ownership, consistency, and reuse

Technical Solutioning & Innovation

  • Design scalable data solutions using modern cloud-native technologies (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, dbt/Dataform, Pub/Sub), selecting the right tools based on problem context
  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex data engineering initiatives from design through production, and continuous evolution.
  • for real-time streaming, event-driven architectures, and unified batch-streaming pipelines at petabyte scale
  • Evaluate and adopt AI/LLM capabilities to improve engineering productivity and enable intelligent data consumption, using standard interfaces (e.g., Model Context Protocol) to integrate AI with data systems
  • Establish engineering excellence frameworks covering performance engineering, cost governance, reliability, and observability
  • Lead proof-of-concept and rapid prototyping of breakthrough technologies before scaling org-wide

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Serve as a technical role model and multiplier — elevating the capabilities of Senior Staff, Staff, and Data Engineers across the organization
  • Lead org-wide engineering communities of practice and knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Partner with engineering managers and HR to drive technical hiring strategy and raise the engineering talent bar
  • Drive culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous learning
  • Establish mentorship programs that systematically grow the next generation of technical leaders

Data Governance & Compliance

  • Architect automated data quality platforms, end-to-end lineage tracking, and enterprise metadata management systems
  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, SOX, and emerging global data regulations through proactive architecture and policy design
  • Lead privacy-by-design initiatives, zero-trust data access models, and data anonymization at scale
  • Establish cross-cloud security standards and enforce them through automated policy guardrails
  • Design privacy-preserving techniques, data anonymization, and secure data sharing mechanisms

Strategic Influence & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams and business units
  • Present technical concepts and architectural decisions to executive leadership
  • Represent Equinix externally — at industry conferences, in open-source communities, and in strategic vendor partnerships
  • Drive build-vs-buy decisions, vendor evaluation, and strategic technology partnerships at the enterprise level

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • GCP Platform Mastery: 8+ years of hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, including deep expertise in BigQuery (advanced SQL, scripting, optimization, ML integration), Cloud Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, and Vertex AI
  • Programming Excellence: Expert-level Python/Java programming, proficiency in Python/Scala for Spark development
  • Advanced Data Technologies: Deep expertise in Apache Beam, Apache Spark, Airflow, Kafka, and distributed computing architectures
  • Infrastructure: Extensive experience with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure management
  • Database & Data Modeling: Advanced knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL systems (BigTable, Firestore, MongoDB); expertise in data modeling, normalization, and performance optimization
  • System Design: Proven ability to architect and deliver distributed, fault-tolerant, globally distributed data systems with rigorous security and cost governance
  • AI/ML Integration: Deep experience with MLOps, feature engineering platforms, model serving infrastructure, and integrating LLM-powered capabilities into production data pipelines

Professional Experience & Leadership

  • Master's or bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree strongly preferred
  • 15+ years of Data engineering experience with 8+ years specifically on Google Cloud Platform
  • Proven track record of leading end-to-end delivery of complex, enterprise-scale data platform initiatives

  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures and solutions

job.title: Head of Sales Governance and Enablement
job.description:
About Us

At Macquarie Cloud Services, our people are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we’re proud to be Australia’s #1 Great Place to Work in Technology for 2026, Australia’s #1 Great Place to Work for two consecutive years, and Great Place to Work Certified for three years running.

Macquarie Cloud Services are the Australian specialists in cloud services for business and government. Locally owned and operated, with an industry-leading customer service model, we’re trusted by our customers to provide the services that enable their business success.

We have made it our challenge to make our people feel good and love the work they do. Because of this, our people are energised and motivated in their work.

The Opportunity.

Macquarie Cloud Services is looking for a commercially minded Head of Sales Governance and Enablement to help mature the way our sales organisation uses data, governance and performance insights to run the business.

Following a significant investment in the maturity of our sales operating model, Macquarie Cloud Services is entering the next phase of growth and optimisation. This role will build on that investment by strengthening the frameworks, processes and data that underpin sales performance, ensuring leaders have access to consistent, reliable insights that drive informed decision-making and continued commercial success.

This is a strategic commercial operations role, not an ad hoc reporting, administration, BI development or data engineering position. We are looking for someone who can spot opportunities to improve performance, use data to understand what is happening, partner with sales leaders to drive change, and clearly demonstrate the impact.

The Opportunity.

Macquarie Cloud Services is looking for a commercially minded Head of Sales Governance and Enablement to help mature the way our sales organisation uses data, governance and performance insights to run the business.

Following a significant investment in the maturity of our sales operating model, Macquarie Cloud Services is entering the next phase of growth and optimisation. This role will build on that investment by strengthening the frameworks, processes and data that underpin sales performance, ensuring leaders have access to consistent, reliable insights that drive informed decision-making and continued commercial success.

This is a strategic commercial operations role, not an ad hoc reporting, administration, BI development or data engineering position. We are looking for someone who can spot opportunities to improve performance, use data to understand what is happening, partner with sales leaders to drive change, and clearly demonstrate the impact.

Why Us?

Australia's #1 [Great Place To Work](https://www.linkedin.com/company/great-place-to-work-us/) in Technology, 2026. We have been awarded Australia's #1 Great Place to Work 2025 for the second year running! We're Great Place to Work Certified 2023, 2024 and 2025. For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award! We're the #1 Managed Services Cloud business in Australia. We have the highest Net Promoter Score on the ASX, the [World's best customer experience](https://www.businessthink.unsw.edu.au/articles/macquarie-telecom-tudehope-customer-experience) & [crowned in 2020 at the World Communications Awards](https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/BU2010/S00476/macquarie-telecom-group-wins-best-customer-experience-in-the-world.htm). You’ll make an impact: Enjoy being part of a driven team with a collaborative culture that values decision-makers and action. We Invest in you: Accelerate your career through our learning and development opportunities - think Gallup strengths-based training, defined career pathways and fantastic internal mobility opportunities across the group.

About You.

You are commercially sharp, influential and confident working with sales leaders in a fast-moving technology environment. You understand that strong sales operations is not just about reporting; it is about setting clear standards, creating reliable operating rhythms and using evidence to help leaders make better decisions and lift performance. You are comfortable working with data, but your real strength is turning insight into action through stakeholder trust, strategic thinking and disciplined follow-through.

You may come from Commercial Operations, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Compliance within banking, insurance or other regulated industries, Business/ Commercial Analysis, Business Analysis or FP&A. What matters most is that you can bridge commercial context and data, turn messy problems into clear frameworks, and work with stakeholders to lift sales performance.

Who would enjoy this role.

  • Someone who can partner with sales leaders, understand what is happening in the field and translate that into clear measures, actions and operating rhythms that improve sales performance.
  • Someone who enjoys solving business performance problems, bringing structure to ambiguity and building practical frameworks across sales, data, commercial performance and business operations.
  • Someone who gets energy from improving data quality, reporting confidence and the way sales leaders access insight, using tools such as Salesforce, Power BI, Excel and other sales operations platforms to create clearer, more reliable ways of working.

Required Skills.

  • Experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Analysis, FP&A, Governance, Compliance or a similar commercial performance role, ideally within a sales-led or regulated environment.
  • Strong understanding of governance, compliance, process ownership, metric definitions, documentation, reporting confidence and the operating rhythms needed to support a high-performing sales function.
  • Ability to bring structure to ambiguity by building clear frameworks around ownership, accountability, definitions, measures and decision-making across sales and commercial operations.
  • Strong understanding of sales performance, pipeline, forecast discipline, sales methodology, activity measures, conversion metrics and commercial KPIs.
  • Comfortable working with CRM and reporting environments as a strong business user, with the ability to define requirements, interrogate outputs, challenge assumptions and ensure reporting is trusted by the business.
  • Proven ability to identify business performance problems, understand the root cause, work with stakeholders to drive change and show what improved.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence sales leaders and hold constructive conversations around governance, accountability, performance and data quality.
  • Experience building more mature operating models, processes, documentation, controls, measures or governance rhythms in a growing or changing environment.
  • Experience in technology, cloud, telecommunications, managed services, SaaS, banking, insurance or other complex B2B or regulated environments would be highly regarded.

If this excites you, apply now, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Head of Information Technology (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

The Summary:

We are seeking a transformational Head of IT (APAC) to define and lead our regional IT strategy, with cybersecurity, resilience and scalability at its core. Combining strategic leadership with a hands-on approach when required, this role will lead Corporate IT across enterprise systems, workplace technology, infrastructure and digital platforms, ensuring technology effectively supports business growth, operations and customer commitments.

The Head of IT will work closely with the Operational Technology (OT) function, maintaining clear ownership boundaries while ensuring strong alignment across shared areas including architecture, connectivity, cybersecurity, identity and access, data and resilience.

This role will also drive the practical adoption of AI, automation and advanced analytics to improve productivity, operational efficiency and decision-making. Working in partnership with functional leaders across APAC, the Head of IT will deliver a secure, standardised and high-performing technology environment that enables scalable growth and operational excellence. This role reports to the MD (ANZ) and supervises the Corporate IT team directly.

Key Responsibilities

Regional IT Strategy Leadership

  • Define and execute the APAC IT strategy and roadmap, aligned with business growth and operational priorities.
  • Advise APAC leadership on technology priorities, risks and investments, translating business needs into secure and scalable solutions.
  • Drive regional technology standardisation, governance and an operating model that supports continued growth.
  • Establish clear performance measures and provide visibility of IT performance, risks and priorities.
  • Maintain sufficient technical depth to provide hands-on leadership and support when required.

Cybersecurity, Risk & Resilience

  • Own the APAC Corporate IT cybersecurity strategy, framework and risk management programme.
  • Strengthen security across identity and access, endpoints, networks, cloud, data, vulnerabilities and third-party services.
  • Ensure effective security monitoring, incident response, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities.
  • Partner with OT to manage cybersecurity risks across IT/OT interfaces, maintaining clear ownership boundaries and effective governance, escalation and incident response.
  • Drive cybersecurity awareness and ensure alignment with relevant regulatory, customer and industry requirements.
  • Embed recognised cybersecurity controls across APAC, including the ACSC Essential Eight in Australia and equivalent controls in other markets, and maintain readiness for applicable security assurance requirements.

IT Operations, Systems & Digital Platforms

  • Lead reliable, secure and responsive Corporate IT services across infrastructure, cloud, workplace technology and enterprise applications.
  • Drive standardisation, integration and modernisation of technology platforms while reducing complexity and technical debt.
  • Establish effective service management and ensure critical technology issues are appropriately managed and resolved.
  • Support new offices, data centre developments and business expansion with scalable technology solutions.
  • Partner with OT where Corporate IT and operational environments interface, ensuring appropriate connectivity, integration, security and governance while maintaining clear system ownership.
  • Oversee the design, deployment and lifecycle management of Corporate IT infrastructure, hardware and software, including upgrades, migrations and multi-site network environments.
  • Establish effective IT asset and configuration lifecycle controls, including accurate inventories and CMDB records, ownership, warranty and renewal planning, licensing and critical spares where appropriate.

Technology Transformation & Innovation

  • Lead regional IT transformation initiatives to modernise platforms, improve capability and enable scalable growth.
  • Identify and adopt emerging technologies that deliver meaningful business and operational value.
  • Drive the practical adoption of AI, automation and advanced analytics to improve productivity, efficiency and decision-making.
  • Enable greater use of data through clear data governance, integrated platforms and improved data accessibility, quality, ownership and access controls.
  • Foster continuous improvement and innovation while ensuring appropriate security, governance and risk controls.

Technology Governance, Investment & Vendors

  • Establish and maintain effective governance across technology standards, architecture, cybersecurity, investment and project delivery.
  • Own the regional Corporate IT budget, ensuring investments are prioritised and deliver measurable business value.
  • Manage strategic technology vendors and partners, including performance, commercial outcomes, security and risk.
  • Optimise technology platforms, vendors and licensing to improve efficiency and cost effectiveness.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, privacy, contractual and customer technology requirements.

Leadership & Business Partnership

  • Build and lead a high-performing, commercially minded and service-oriented regional IT function.
  • Partner with functional leaders to align technology priorities with business, operational and customer requirements.
  • Maintain a strong partnership with OT leadership, recognising OT's ownership of operational technology and control systems, while ensuring effective governance of shared IT/OT dependencies and risks.
  • Communicate technology and cybersecurity priorities, risks and opportunities effectively to senior leadership.
  • Lead technology-enabled change and foster a culture of ownership, innovation and continuous improvement.

Travel

This role requires travel across the APAC region. Approximately 20% travel may be expected. Reasonable after-hours support or availability during critical incidents, major technology changes or business continuity events is to be expected.

Qualifications & Competencies

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline; relevant postgraduate qualifications are advantageous.
  • Typically 10 or more years of ICT experience, including significant senior IT leadership experience within a regional, multi-country or complex operational environment.
  • Proven experience developing and executing IT strategies, transformation roadmaps and technology operating models.
  • Strong cybersecurity, technology risk, business continuity and operational resilience experience.
  • Broad technical knowledge across enterprise applications, cloud, infrastructure, networks, workplace technology, identity and access, data and cybersecurity.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud services, enterprise networking and SD-WAN technologies, virtualisation and storage platforms, Windows Server, APIs and automation or scripting tools such as PowerShell.
  • Experience leading technology transformation, systems integration and platform modernisation.
  • Practical understanding of AI, automation and analytics and their application to deliver business value.
  • Strong experience in technology governance, IT service management, budgets, investments and vendor management; ITIL Foundation certification or higher is preferred.
  • Proven people leadership, commercial judgement and ability to influence senior stakeholders.
  • A pragmatic, delivery-focused approach with the technical depth and willingness to be hands-on when required.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience within data centres, critical infrastructure, telecommunications, cloud infrastructure or another high-availability environment.
  • Experience working across IT and OT environments, with an understanding of ownership boundaries, shared dependencies and cybersecurity risks.
  • Experience operating across multiple APAC markets and leading geographically dispersed teams.
  • Familiarity with recognised frameworks and assurance requirements such as ISO 27001, the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, the ACSC Essential Eight, SOC 2, PCI DSS and ITIL, as applicable.
  • Experience with enterprise AI governance, cloud transformation and technology standardisation.
  • Relevant technology, cybersecurity or management qualifications and professional certifications.

Core Competencies

  • Translates business priorities into clear technology strategy and outcomes.
  • Demonstrates strong judgement in managing technology risk, security and resilience.
  • Brings strong technical acumen and drives practical adoption of AI, automation and emerging technologies.
  • Balances investment, cost, risk and service performance to deliver business value.
  • Builds trusted relationships and influences effectively across senior leadership and business functions.
  • Builds high-performing teams with a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Combines strategic thinking with pragmatic execution, operates effectively at both strategic and operational levels, with the willingness to step into detail, resolve issues and provide hands-on leadership when required.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK Infrastructure provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

job.title: Data Engineer
