job.title: Sr. Workforce Manager, CXQO, Just Walk Out Technology
job.description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Just Walk Out (JWO) Technology is a team of entrepreneurial, analytical, and creative builders with innovation at our core. Designed and custom-built by Amazonians, JWO operates with the speed and agility of a start-up while leveraging the scale of Amazon. We use computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning to push the boundaries of what is possible in retail technology — enabling customers to shop in engaging, fast, and safe ways.

Our checkout-free shopping experience automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to shelves, maintaining a real-time virtual cart for each shopper. When a customer finishes shopping, they simply walk out. Shortly after, we charge their account and send a receipt — no lines, no checkout, no friction.

We are looking for a Sr. Workforce Manager- who is passionate about customer experience, thinks and acts globally, a strong communicator and networker to build successful working relationships across worldwide JWO network and has the edge to drive industry standard innovations.

The successful candidate will:

  • Lead the Workforce planning team for multiple regions.
  • Create best capacity plan for business by managing trade-offs between Customer Experience/Service Levels and Cost Effectiveness.
  • Develop, improve and optimize work assignment, prioritization logic to manage work from various regions with multiple constraints.
  • Mitigate capacity risks by managing dependencies across multiple operating units. Clearly communicate dependencies and manage/track exceptions.
  • Partner with Operations, Capacity Planning and Finance teams to analyze historical data and work trends and provide workforce inputs. Manage the analyses of daily, weekly, and monthly reporting of regional performance via Key Performance Indicators.
  • Support management to optimize staffing requirements. Manage Service Levels (SL) and provide recommended workflow options and directives to maintain acceptable SL.
  • Fully leverage existing technology, including global standardization of reporting.

You lead by example and are a role model when it comes to insisting on the highest standards and maintaining an atmosphere of respect for customers. No task is beneath you. You fully live the Amazon Leadership Principles and are passionate about helping your team do the same. You have a high bar for quality and hold your team to the same standards. This role requires candidates to be flexible to working in Night shifts and Rotational Week offs Please note: this team is not customer-facing.

Key job responsibilities Job Responsibilities:

  • Understand and communicates the department vision to team members, at the same time assess behaviors and coach direct reports in their role.
  • Lead Projects to improve planning and execution efficiency and support worldwide network of business units, and operational centers.
  • Identify/Implement workforce management tools and technology enablers that will improve operating accuracy and efficiency
  • Manage the development of global standards (Average Handle time, NPT, Shrinkage, Attrition) working with Capacity planning ensuring that all changes successfully inter-operate with existing operational processes.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Capacity Planning, Technology and internal workflow teams to maintain and update plans.
  • Communicate these plans and report on their execution to various stakeholders, and continuously improve the planning and execution cycle.
  • Monitor performance by analyzing performance statistics; evaluating staffing schedules to match volume demand; evaluating potential productivity & quality standards; identifying and resolving problems; determining system and process improvements.
  • Prepare management reporting by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends and developing recommendations.
  • Improve quality of reporting and work to streamline various data sources to drive consistent reporting.
  • Promote process improvement and standardization of processes across all sites.
  • Lead and participate in global projects and initiatives & own providing optimal solutions for upcoming initiatives.
  • Proactively identify service improvement opportunities and ensure continuous improvement within Workforce Management across advisor scheduling, metric reporting and real-time delivery.
  • Participate in global initiatives to cater to growing business needs
  • Communicate and maintain vision, Leadership Principles and culture with the team
  • Written and verbal communication up to senior leadership.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in management directly
  • 5+ years of data interpretation and analysis to influence stakeholders experience
  • 7+ years of with Excel experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python)
  • Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
  • Experience managing teams who deliver on defined goals and timelines
  • Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in a relevant industry working within technology teams
  • Experience in managing and troublshooting network, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
  • Experience being responsible/leading large and complex negotiations
  • Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

job.title: Research and AI Lead, APJ, AWS Global Education, WWPS
job.description:
AWS is seeking a senior business development leader to drive the regional go-to-market strategy for Academic Research and contribute directly to AWS’s global research strategy development. This role requires deep expertise in the higher education and research ecosystem, a track record of building and scaling market development initiatives, and the ability to engage effectively with university leadership, research executives, and government stakeholders. You will lead how AWS engages research institutions in region, build a strong pipeline of research opportunities, leverage global education and research assets for the benefit of customers, and provide direct feedback to inform the broader global research strategy.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of the research community and account managers in region to establish trust, identify high-impact opportunities, and build a strong pipeline across markets at varying stages of cloud maturity. You will define repeatable, scalable solutions for research customers, build coalitions across internal teams, partners, and institutional stakeholders, and establish AWS as the long-term strategic partner for research and education transformation. You will also be responsible for understanding the technology layer relevant to the research community, translating researcher needs into cloud benefits, and leveraging subject matter experts in areas like procurement, secure research environments, research data management, and AI for science.

This role provides direct feedback to inform global research strategy and coordinates across domains including commercial, nonprofit, healthcare, and government research communities in region.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the regional GTM strategy for academic research. Drive pipeline through direct institutional engagement, account team enablement, and scalable frameworks that BDMs and account teams can replicate across markets.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with chief research officers, university leadership, and relevant government officials. Lead EBCs, workshops, and multi-institutional convenings that position AWS as the strategic research computing partner.
  • Understand researcher workflows well enough to connect customer needs to existing AWS solutions. Surface recurring product and partner gaps to the SA and product organizations with documented use cases that justify investment.
  • Source and shape flagship research engagements (migrations, GenAI builds, HPC expansions) that SA and ProServe teams deliver, ensuring outcomes are documented as replicable models for the region.
  • Develop use cases, playbooks, and competitive positioning for education-specific constraints such as data sovereignty, academic calendars, and responsible AI governance.
  • Represent AWS externally through keynotes, publications, conferences, and government forums. Coordinate internally across product, SA, partner, marketing, and policy teams to align research GTM with broader AWS education priorities.

About the team The AWS Global Education team helps universities, research institutions, school systems, and education technology companies use cloud and AI to transform how they teach, discover, and operate. We work globally across every education segment and combine deep sector expertise with the ability to drive real business outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of technology related sales, business development or equivalent experience
  • Experience building and managing a healthy sales pipeline focused on driving revenue, adoption, and market penetration
  • Experience with C-level sales and strategic partnership building
  • Experience designing and executing joint marketing plans with strategic alliance partners with global footprint
  • degree in advanced technology, or 5+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or above in public policy or equivalent
  • Familiarity with modern application patterns (containers, serverless, microservices) and research-specific infrastructure requirements (secure enclaves, data sovereignty, large-scale data management).
  • Experience with generative AI, foundation models, and machine learning solutions deployed in research or production environments.
  • Experience influencing product roadmaps or shaping service offerings based on customer and market intelligence.
  • Experience operating across international regulatory environments including data sovereignty, procurement frameworks, and academic governance structures.

job.title: Senior Water Resources Manager, AWS Water Team, DCC Communities
job.description:
APAC is at the centre of significant growth, particularly in AI. As a Water Resources Manager on AWS's APAC team, you'll be at the forefront of enabling AI capacity in APAC by leading the responsible use of treated and recycled water for our data centres and pioneering innovative technologies in sustainable water sourcing.

AWS is looking for a results-oriented individual to join the AWS water infrastructure team in APAC region. In this role, you will provide engineering and due diligence support for AWS’s new and existing APAC projects related to water-based cooling system infrastructure. For new projects, you will be responsible for executing multiple water projects across different geographies, conducting due diligence on water and wastewater infrastructure solutions, negotiating directly with water utilities, evaluating cost and schedule to deliver water, and ensuring smooth start-up of new water infrastructure. At existing sites, you will support AWS operations and engineering teams to operate and troubleshoot water treatment systems. You will develop metrics, communicate performance to technical teams and senior leadership, and be the subject matter expert for all issues pertaining to water infrastructure and risk analysis. You will deliver water sustainability projects for AWS Infrastructure in APAC regions. You will also be the central point of contact for all issues pertaining to water and wastewater treatment and disinfection systems and for managing healthy relationships with utilities. You will play a key role with due diligence and site selection efforts in existing and new regions by compiling and analyzing geographical location and specific prospective site information, including (i) permitting and land use data, (ii) data on water and wastewater availability and cost, (iii) reliable back up supplies and availability of alternate water sources.

Key job responsibilities The Senior Water Resources Manager will be responsible for the following:

  • Work with internal engineering, operations, real estate and risk and resiliency teams to manage water and wastewater service delivery at new and existing AWS facilities.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive water infrastructure delivery for global AWS infrastructure expansion.
  • Recommend AWS water based cooling launch strategies for new regions based on in-market and desktop due diligence.
  • Ensure that all water systems at existing sites are operating effectively and will not adversely impact operations.
  • Identify and develop cost savings projects and initiatives related to water infrastructure and supply. Responsible for completing due diligence on in-market opportunities and developing those opportunities into cost saving for the business.
  • Track and manage reliability and maintenance of water systems, as well as the resiliency of sources of water supply required for data center cooling. Never constrain business growth.
  • Work with internal teams to trouble shoot problems and conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Corrective Action (CA) for design and fleet deployed water systems.
  • Deliver projects that directly support water sustainability goals
  • Work on concurrent projects in multiple regions. 20% regional travel for site review and conduct engineering evaluations, audits, and site launches.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience
  • 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field
  • Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
  • Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance
  • Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
  • Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineering or Architectural License
  • Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
  • Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

  • Deliver seamless service rectification and product installations, to the full satisfaction of Telstra’s customers.
  • Copper cable maintenance and installation including fault finding, jointing, jumpering, and networking.
  • Maintenance and management of Fibre network technology, Core network technology and Data services
  • Customer Premises Equipment maintenance and installation (both consumer and business).
  • Fault finding over copper networks in a rural or remote setting.

Qualifications

You will be required to hold and maintain the relevant and applicable licenses and qualifications to perform this role, as deemed mandatory by regulatory and legal authorities and must also maintain a current driver’s license.

  • Certificate III in Telecommunications
  • Open cabling license
  • Traffic management qualifications
  • An industry white card

Telstra can support you through offering training on Traffic management and white card certificates. This role requires the successful candidate to be vaccinated against Covid-19, to ensure the safety and wellbeing of our people and customers. However, please speak to us if you have any questions about this based on your individual circumstances.

If this opportunity sounds like a perfect fit for you, we'd encourage you to apply!

Current locations in demand:

  • Townsville
  • Brisbane

job.title: Job Application for Regional Marketing Manager NAM at SUBMER
job.description:
Requirements:** Frequent travel required across North America, including regular travel to Houston (Submer office) and the West Coast (clients, events)

Reporting line: This is a group-level role reporting directly to the Global Marketing Director, Submer Group. You will be part of the global marketing team rather than reporting into a US country manager or a local business.

Working pattern: Time flexibility is a genuine requirement. You will work across European time zones to keep in-sync with the global marketing team, and the role carries the flexibility expectations that come with a fast-moving, group-level scale-up remit.

About Submer

Submer designs and delivers end-to-end AI datacenter infrastructure built on a strong legacy in industry-leading liquid cooling.

We help organizations scale AI beyond the limits of traditional data centers by enabling higher density, greater efficiency and lower environmental impact – accelerating time-to-AI from first deployment to full production.

What impact you will have

We are seeking a Regional Marketing Manager to own marketing strategy and execution across North America – taking central marketing strategy / objectives and deploying them locally.

You'll own North America marketing for the Submer Group and the companies within it that cover the full AI infrastructure stack, working at the cutting edge of one of the most dynamic industries in tech - and helping us build that future the responsible way, driven by a strong green agenda at the heart of how we grow.

You will play a key role in shaping how the North America region builds and powers its digital future. By developing and executing regional marketing strategy, strengthening partner relationships, and driving brand visibility, you'll help Submer become North America's trusted leader in sustainable digital infrastructure.

You will be our first full-mix marketing hire in North America, with a remit spanning multiple companies across the group. That breadth is unusual: full-stack coverage of the AI infrastructure landscape gives you a vantage point on the industry that few marketing roles offer, alongside direct exposure to the executives shaping it.

Submer is in the middle of a significant transformation from a liquid cooling specialist into a full-stack AI infrastructure group. This is a chance to help shape a business as it is being built rather than maintain something already set in stone - and to grow the region's marketing function, and potentially a team, around you.

Role overview

You will help build the global marketing strategy and own the adoption and execution of it for the North American region - adapting global campaigns and messaging to the region's market dynamics.

Equally important, you will operate as part of the group's global marketing team. Some of your work will be global - brand, content and campaign programs delivered with colleagues in Europe - and some will involve tailoring that same work to the North America market. You will also be the on-the-ground marketing partner for the group companies and senior leaders operating from the US.

This is a foundation-building role. There is no established marketing function in the region and no playbook waiting for you: expect to define what good looks like, build regional marketing processes close to from scratch, wear several hats at once, and be comfortable with autonomy, leading from the front and frequent change synonymous with tech companies as the market and demands shift.

You will have proven experience driving B2B marketing strategy across North America, including customer engagement, partner collaboration, ABM, and multichannel campaigns. Skilled in partnering with commercial and technical colleagues to grow market presence, you combine technical credibility with strategic marketing acumen and genuinely hands-on execution in technology-driven businesses. You proactively monitor market dynamics, ensuring marketing strategies are aligned with regional priorities and emerging trends.

What you'll do

1\. Regional Strategy & Budget

  • Develop the North America regional marketing plan, aligned to global strategies and initiatives
  • Allocate budget across channels

2\. Marketing Program Execution

  • Develop and implement regional marketing campaigns and tailor content to the North America market, across both digital and in-person channels
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute Submer's participation in industry events, roundtables, and forums, and represent Submer at key industry and government initiatives
  • Own event delivery end to end - logistics, messaging, on-site execution and follow-up - sometimes single-handedly, and always willing to be at the sharp end on the day
  • Support senior leadership on speaking slots, briefings and executive visibility at regional events, including at short notice
  • Track, measure, and report on the effectiveness of regional marketing initiatives

3\. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work as an integrated member of the group marketing execution team, contributing to global brand, content and campaign work as well as adapting corporate campaigns to regional and partner needs
  • Act as the marketing partner for US-based group company leadership and commercial teams
  • Embed marketing into the day-to-day conversation across the group companies operating from the US, so that marketing is brought in early rather than called in late
  • Provide regional insights and feedback to inform global marketing strategy

4\. Market & Industry Intelligence

  • Monitor industry trends, government-led funding programs (e.g. AI and digital transformation initiatives), and regulatory developments across the region
  • Anticipate market shifts and advise internal stakeholders on opportunities for Submer to align with national and regional priorities
  • Leverage insights to shape campaign strategy, event participation, partner strategies, and localized marketing content

What you'll need

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration/Management, Communications, Public Relations or related fields, if paired with relevant marketing experience
  • Or equivalent experience: relevant hands-on experience in regional marketing, field marketing, partner marketing, communications or events management may substitute for a formal degree
  • A minimum of 5 years' experience in B2B marketing - regional or field marketing, partner marketing, event management, and/or communications and PR. We are open to this being a step up into your first senior regional role if you bring the right breadth and attitude
  • Strong understanding of B2B marketing in technology-driven sectors, including campaign strategy and budget management. A background in AI infrastructure, data centers, IT and power infrastructure, or enterprise software is ideal - what matters is credibility with technical subject matter and technical audiences from day one
  • Direct, day-to-day exposure to C-level stakeholders, with the presence to manage senior personalities and push back constructively when needed
  • Demonstrable experience delivering high-quality events, including the hands-on execution and on-the-ground elements rather than oversight alone
  • Strong writing and analytical skills - able to assess a market, form a view and argue it, not only execute campaigns

job.description:

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant BROKEN HILL

Job Summary

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. You will create positive experiences through effective communication and adherence to retail standards. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Hourly Rate: $33.33 per hour

*Junior rates apply for those under 20 years of age.

Penalty rates are as follows: Additional 25% for weekday hours worked after 6 PM, 25% for hours worked on Saturday, 100% for hours worked on Sunday and 150% for hours worked on public holidays.*

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs through LinkedIn Learning and take advantage of a range of development opportunities designed to build your skills and support your career growth, helping you prepare for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is it You We’re Looking For?

  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.
  • Customer-Facing Experience: Previous experience is a plus but not required—bring your enthusiasm and we’ll teach you the rest!

How to Apply:

Ready to kickstart your journey with us? Click "Apply Now" to submit your application! After applying, keep an eye out for an email from our partner, HireVue, to complete the next step in our assessment process.

Join Us at Telstra Retail:

When you become part of the Telstra team, you’re joining a brand that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone is respected, valued, and can thrive. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to our team!

job.title: Telstra Retail: Full Time Assistant Store Manager BROKEN HILL
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

18 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Full Time Assistant Store Manager BROKEN HILL

Job Summary

As an Assistant Store Manager, you will support store operations by assisting with team coordination and maintaining service standards. You will handle moderately complex tasks, ensure adherence to operational guidelines, and work independently on defined responsibilities. This role demonstrates growing autonomy and contributes to a seamless customer experience.

Job Description

Telstra is hiring!

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

Our Broken Hill store is hiring an Assistant Store Manager to join their team a Full Time basis. This is an opportunity to enhance your leadership skills, overseeing a retail team with a unique buzz and energy at Telstra within a dynamic team environment at Telstra.

What we offer our team members

We have a tonne of great benefits here at Telstra, from thousands of training and career-growth opportunities, to exclusive discounts across hundreds of brands and partners. Take a look at all that’s on offer [and how you can shape your benefits, your way](https://www.telstra.com.au/careers/why-telstra/benefits-your-way).

Below is a snapshot of just some of the cool things we offer:

  • Store performance-related commission
  • 30% off Telstra services
  • Telstra mobile and Sim card
  • Exclusive discounts and offers across 240 brands and partners.
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave for primary and secondary carers

As an Assistant Retail Store Manager at Telstra, you’ll work closely with the Store Manager to coach and grow your team. You’ll use your management experience to help coach our retail consultants to success, making sure they’re driven and energised to reach and exceed store targets.

What you’ll do

  • Oversee the induction of your new team members
  • Coach the store’s team to meet (and exceed) store targets
  • Help support your team with customer query escalations
  • Be the Store Manager’s right-hand person, stepping up to act as Store Manager when needed
  • Executing business initiatives in store to meet financial and customer key metrics.
  • Act as team cheer leader – leading from the front and helping to motivate the team, and foster an awesome store culture
  • Organise the store floor and team’s work schedules, to meet customer demand.

About you

  • You have previous experience in a retail leadership / assistant management role
  • You’re able to energise and drive a retail team to exceed sales targets and KPIs with demonstrated success
  • You lead from the front and are able to influence and build rapport with a diverse and varied team
  • You’re able to resolve customer issues with your eyes closed and can put a creative spin on problem solving
  • You’re an excellent communicator who can help support the Store Manager in taking team members through change.

What’s next?

After you’ve submitted your application, the next step is a video assessment supported by our partner, Hire Vue. Please keep an eye out for the email to move your application along swiftly.

Why Telstra?

[Retail Opportunities at Telstra](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UrXQB9m3dH0)

When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued, and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, and abilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive.

We work flexibly at Telstra, talk to us about what flexibility means to you. When you apply, you can share your pronouns and /or any reasonable adjustments needed to take part equitably during the recruitment process.

job.title: DGM - Service Strategy
job.description:
Job Description

We are looking for an energetic, dynamic and a collaborative person to join Services India team for key strategic initiatives driving Services transformation.

Services India is on a tremendous growth and is undergoing significant transformation. This transformation is being propelled through select initiatives emphasizing on key Services growth areas like driving recurring growth, improving reach through channel partners, improving efficiency and more. The candidate will play key role in driving these initiatives starting from defining them, to tracking their progress & milestones, key challenges, stakeholder alignment to successfully closing the initiatives while ensuring their sustainability over time.

This exciting new career opportunity will see you;

  • Collaborating & work closely with various teams within the organisation and key stakeholders (Sales, Offer Management, Tendering, Marketing and Operations)
  • Tracking launch success, monitoring key metrics, analytics and reporting on other performance data
  • Well-developed interpersonal skills, previously partnering with key stakeholders
  • Deep Data Analysis to develop actionable insights
  • Have Services Leadership visibility
  • 7-9 years of experience with relevant tertiary qualifications (MBA, Engineering or similar) coupled with demonstrated experience in a similar role (Marketing, Offer Management etc.)

job.title: Finance Digital Transformation, Lead
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Global Key Responsibilities

Finance Transformation & Strategic Alignment

  • Finance Strategy Mapping: Align global finance transformation goals (e.g., closing the books faster, working capital optimization, real-time profitability analysis) with standard SAP capabilities like S/4HANA Finance, Central Finance, and Group Reporting.
  • Global Standardization: Enforce a global finance template strategy to standardise the global Chart of Accounts (CoA), cost structures, and ledger architectures while minimizing local customisations.
  • Cross-Border Prioritization: Lead demand management for financial systems, balancing corporate finance transformation milestones against regional compliance requests.

Matrix Finance Stakeholder Management

  • C-Suite Advisory Presence: Partner directly with executive financial leadership, including the Global CFO, Deputy CFO, Group Controllers, and Heads of Tax and Treasury, to shape technical strategy.
  • Global Change Management: Drive global change leadership for financial professionals, navigating teams through the process shifts required by real-time accounting, automated reconciliations, and continuous close cycles.
  • Fiscal Compliance Mediation: Mediate conflicting requirements between global finance uniformity and critical local statutory/fiscal regulations (e.g. e-invoicing mandates, localized payroll tax, and regional data residency laws).

Required Qualifications & Experience

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Finance, Accounting, or equivalent. Professional certifications (e.g. SAP certifications) are highly advantageous.
  • Years of Experience: 10+ years in IT business partnering, enterprise architecture, or leading global SAP transformation programs.
  • Finance Transformation Track Record: Proven experience delivering at least two large-scale, multi-country SAP Finance Transformation programs
  • Group Consolidation Expertise: Direct, hands-on experience designing or managing global financial consolidation systems utilizing SAP BPC (Business Planning and Consolidation) or SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting (GR) solutions.

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • SAP Finance Portfolio: Deep architecture and functional understanding of SAP S/4HANA Finance (General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Controlling, Treasury, Cash Management) and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) for finance extensions.
  • Group Reporting and Consolidation: Robust technical fluency in automated intercompany reconciliations, matrix consolidations, currency translation rules, and multi-GAAP disclosures within SAP BPC or GR landscapes.
  • Analytics & Performance Management: Strong familiarity with corporate performance management solutions, such as SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) for financial planning and analysis (FP&A) integrated with group reporting engines.
  • Global Fiscal Compliance: Robust knowledge of international accounting standards (IFRS, US GAAP) and automated global tax compliance integration.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Financial Fluency: Ability to speak the language of finance fluently, seamlessly bridging the gap between technical IT architecture and complex accounting workflows.
  • Strategic Influence: Strong negotiation skills to challenge legacy, manual finance practices and steer stakeholders toward automated, out-of-the-box SAP financial processes.

Global Performance Metrics (KPIs)

  • Group Consolidation Acceleration: Measurable reduction in the time-to-close for global entity consolidations and corporate financial disclosures.
  • Finance Process Efficiency: Measurable reduction in month-end close timelines and manual reconciliation hours post-SAP deployment.
  • Template Adoption Rate: Percentage of standard SAP Finance capabilities used versus localized, custom financial reports or code.
  • Finance Stakeholder Satisfaction: Satisfaction rating and alignment metrics from the Global CFO and regional finance leadership teams.
  • Portfolio Delivery: On-time and within-budget delivery of global finance modernizations across all specified geographies.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Senior Staff Engineer, Kubernetes Platform & Networking - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Staff Engineer to join the Reliability Engineering team that operates a bare-metal Kubernetes platform across multiple metro locations. The platform's architecture is defined and the build is underway, you will help deploy, operate and continuously improve it, from OS provisioning on racked servers through a multi-cluster fleet managed from a central management plane, with a software-defined data plane deployed via GitOps.

This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who owns a layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will work alongside the teams that own the physical hardware, the underlay network, and the data plane software, and you need enough fluency in all three to reason about a fault before escalating it. Where you find the design falls short in practice, we expect you to say so and to shape how it evolves.

You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.

Responsibilities

OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure

  • Own OS installation (Debian/Ubuntu) across bare-metal servers in multiple metros using PXE/iPXE imaging and cloud-init, and harden the OS prior to cluster bootstrap
  • Build and maintain a repeatable, zero-touch provisioning pipeline so every metro is deployed consistently without manual per-node intervention
  • Partner with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, high-speed NIC configuration and disk layout standards (separate NVMe for etcd, SSD for OS) and be able to diagnose faults at that layer, not just report them

Kubernetes Control Plane & Worker Nodes

  • Deploy and operate Kubernetes clusters across all metros with quorum-based control-plane fault tolerance and correct failure-domain placement across racks, PDUs, or availability zones
  • Maintain the Layer 4 load balancer or keepalived VIP fronting all kube-apiserver instances, so no client depends on a single node
  • Manage worker node provisioning, CNI configuration, and end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded

CI/CD & Data Plane Deployment

  • Build and own the CI/CD pipeline that deploys the software-defined data plane, including automated throughput and latency validation gates that must pass before promotion to production. The data plane software itself is configured and troubleshot by the team that owns it, your ownership is the pipeline and the gates
  • Own data-plane observability: monitoring, alerting thresholds, and operational runbooks

Network

  • Operate on top of a multi-metro underlay and partner with network and security teams on VLANs, BGP peering, NIC bonding, private connectivity, firewall rules and segmentation
  • Validate connectivity end to end across environments, and troubleshoot far enough into the network layer to isolate a problem before handing it over

OS & Kubernetes Upgrades

  • Plan and execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet with zero unplanned downtime; maintain tested upgrade runbooks and validated etcd snapshot/restore procedures before every major change
  • Own the etcd snapshot schedule, retention policy, and offsite storage; verify restore runbooks before each site goes live
  • Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Management Plane

  • Administer the centralized management plane across all clusters, including RBAC, cluster registration and policy enforcement, and keep production and non-production management planes strictly isolated to prevent blast-radius cascades from configuration changes
  • Drive GitOps-based fleet configuration management to keep clusters consistent, auditable, and drift-free

On-Call & Incident Management

  • Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and lead incident response for control-plane, data-plane, and network events
  • Drive blameless postmortems and systematically eliminate recurring failure modes through automation, better runbooks, and sharper alerting
  • Contribute to the shared incident-command process, and maintain the runbooks for the systems you operate

What Success Looks Like, First 9-12 Months

  • Provisioning is fully automated and repeatable, new nodes and metros brought up with no manual per-node steps
  • Deployment pipeline in production, with throughput and latency gates enforced before promotion
  • Management plane administered across all clusters; production and non-production planes isolated; GitOps driving cluster configuration
  • OS and Kubernetes upgrades executed on cadence across the fleet with documented, tested runbooks
  • etcd snapshot and restore tested and signed off before each site goes live
  • Observability and alerting in place for the systems you operate, including the data plane
  • Recurring failure modes measurably reduced through automation and runbook improvements

Qualifications

Required

  • OS & bare metal: Deep hands-on Linux/Ubuntu provisioning at scale, PXE/iPXE imaging, cloud-init, BIOS/firmware management, OS hardening
  • Hardware fluency: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI, SMART data and platform sensors; able to diagnose disk, memory, NIC and power faults and work with vendors through warranty replacement
  • Kubernetes: Strong experience deploying and operating RKE2 or kubeadm clusters on bare metal, etcd operations, kube-apiserver HA, CNI (Multus/SR-IOV), multi-cluster fleet management
  • Rancher or equivalent management plane: Production experience managing multiple clusters through Rancher Prime, Rancher, or comparable fleet tooling
  • CI/CD for infrastructure: GitOps or pipeline-driven infrastructure deployment, Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, or Fleet
  • Networking: Hands-on with VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs, SR-IOV and private connectivity, with enough depth to troubleshoot across the boundary rather than only consume it
  • Upgrades: Demonstrated zero-downtime rolling upgrades of both OS and Kubernetes across a multi-node fleet
  • Operational rigor: Experience running platforms where availability is measured in minutes of downtime per year, and where an unreviewed change is the most likely cause of an outage
  • On-call: Comfortable owning an on-call shift and leading infrastructure incident response
  • Automation mindset: Everything-as-code, repeatable and auditable; strong bias toward automation over manual operations

Preferred

  • Familiarity with 6WIND VSR or other DPDK-based data planes, enough to build and validate a deployment and performance-testing pipeline around one
  • SR-IOV NIC tuning and data-plane performance validation
  • SDN or private-connectivity platforms (Equinix Fabric, VyOS, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with LLM provider APIs and AI/agent gateway proxying patterns, since inference traffic from multiple providers transits this platform
  • Experience operating infrastructure across geographically distributed sites

This is a deliberately broad role. We are not looking for someone who works one layer and hands everything below it across a boundary. You will join the Digital Interconnection Engineering organization. The team owns the full application stack for interconnection and the Kubernetes platform for the software-defined data plane across multiple metros. We operate with an automation-first, GitOps-driven culture and a strong commitment to operational rigor, documented runbooks, and blameless postmortems.

OS Provisioning & Bare-Metal Infrastructure

  • Work with the teams that own the hardware on BIOS/firmware baselines, NIC configuration and disk layout standards, and use BMC/IPMI and platform sensors to isolate hardware faults before handing them over

Kubernetes Cluster Operations

  • Provision worker nodes, configure CNI, and run end-to-end cluster validation before workloads are onboarded
  • Perform routine cluster operations: node drains and replacements, certificate rotation, capacity checks, and remediation of cluster-level alerts

GitOps & Fleet Configuration

  • Make cluster and fleet configuration changes through GitOps, keeping clusters consistent, auditable and drift-free
  • Perform cluster registration, RBAC and policy changes in the management plane, respecting the isolation between production and nonproduction planes
  • Extend the deployment pipeline for the software-defined data plane adding validation coverage and test cases working from the pipeline design and gates owned by the senior engineers on the team

Upgrades & Patching

  • Execute rolling OS and Kubernetes upgrades across the fleet from tested runbooks, with no unplanned downtime, and improve those runbooks as you find gaps
  • Take etcd snapshots ahead of significant changes, and run scheduled restore drills to prove the recovery path works
  • Apply the platform's patching cadence across the fleet, tracking CVEs affecting the OS, Kubernetes and cluster components

Observability & On-Call

  • Own your shift of a follow-the-sun on-call rotation, and act as first responder for control-plane, node, and cluster-level incidents
  • Build and tune dashboards and alerts for the systems you operate, and reduce alert noise where it is costing the rotation time
  • Write up incidents you respond to, contribute to blameless postmortems, and turn recurring toil into automation
  • Author and maintain runbooks for the components you operate

What Success Looks Like First 9-12 Months

  • Provisioning and bringing up nodes and clusters independently, without per-node manual steps
  • Running OS and Kubernetes upgrades on cadence from runbooks, and improving those runbooks where they fall short
  • Owning your on-call shift unassisted, as first responder for cluster and node-level incidents
  • Restore drills run on schedule, with the recovery path demonstrated rather than assumed
  • Measurable reduction in toil or alert noise in the areas you operate
  • Runbooks and dashboards in place for the components you own

Qualifications

Required

  • Linux on bare metal: Solid hands-on Linux/Ubuntu administration and provisioning; familiarity with PXE/iPXE imaging or equivalent, cloudinit, and OS hardening
  • Hardware working knowledge: Comfortable with BMC/IPMI consoles, SMART data and platform sensors; able to identify a failing disk, NIC, DIMM or power supply and follow a vendor replacement process
  • Kubernetes: Production experience operating clusters ideally RKE2 or kubeadm on bare metal including etcd basics, node lifecycle, CNI configuration and cluster-level troubleshooting
  • Infrastructure as code: Day-to-day use of Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Fleet or similar; comfortable making infrastructure changes through a pipeline rather than by hand
  • Networking: Working knowledge of VLANs, BGP, bonded NICs and SR-IOV enough to read a configuration, interpret what you see, and isolate whether a problem is above or below the network layer
  • Upgrades: Experience executing OS and Kubernetes upgrades in production against an established runbook
  • On-call: Experience in an on-call operations role, responding to production incidents and writing them up afterward
  • Automation mindset: A reflex to automate repeated manual work, and to leave the runbook better than you found it

Preferred

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities V - Singapore, Central Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

The Critical Facilities Engineer is responsible for the operation, maintenance, monitoring, and reliability of mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role supports the continuous availability of electrical, mechanical, fire life safety, and building management systems through preventative maintenance, troubleshooting, incident response, and vendor management activities.

The successful candidate will apply technical expertise and sound judgment to identify risks, resolve complex issues, and ensure all systems operate safely, efficiently, and in accordance with operational standards

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Performs specialized preventative and corrective maintenance on-site to critical facility components and/or systems
  • Performs moderately difficult repairs, maintenance, installations and on-site inspections to critical facility systems
  • Monitors the Building Monitoring System (BMS) and resolves alarms for specialized issues requiring considerable judgement and implications to resolve; follows guidelines on standard procedures and makes recommendations for solutioning
  • Operates and maintains plumbing, fire suppression, and life-safety systems
  • Implements energy efficiency measures
  • Assists team members on coordinating critical infrastructures
  • Works on assignments requiring considerable judgment and initiative. Understands implications of work and makes recommendations for solutions

Vendor Support

  • Coordinates and directs vendors on skilled tasks to ensure that maintenance activities are carried out per standards and requirements
  • Assists with the creation and submission of scripts for maintenance
  • Tracks and implements the work approval process for service providers for critical maintenance (including briefing at the start of work, control of work during the day workday/shift, final review of the work carried out)
  • In cooperation with the vendors, changes/updates technical files for plants and equipment ensuring files and builds are up-to-date

Site Administration & Incident Support

  • Performs specialized site logs and data gathering for issuing of permits, such as Maintenance Operation Protocol (MOPs) and scripts
  • Identifies Single Points of Failure (SPOFs) and makes recommendations for solutions
  • Responds to all on-site incidents, including failures, significant problems and delays
  • Performs Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and make recommendations for solutions
  • Supports the on-site staff during incidents
  • Demonstrates and supports processes and procedures are followed and adhered to

Work Orders & Additional Projects

  • Completes skilled work requests and circuit installations
  • Performs advanced troubleshooting and maintenance of office equipment (if necessary); supports auxiliary equipment and machines with problem solving and repairs to avoid/minimize downtime
  • Makes moderate changes to mechanical, electrical and specialized systems, as directed
  • Carries out more complex infrastructure projects
  • Supports life cycle maintenance/end of life. infrastructure projects and critical replacements
  • May recommend infrastructure projects

Collaboration

  • Collaborates with others to resolve difficult facility incidents
  • Effectively collaborates within the department; may mentor team members on skilled maintenance activities
  • Informs stakeholders of inventory needs to maintain optimal stock levels of critical parts and equipment, may support in coordinating processes for maintaining inventory
  • Acts as a mentor to others in resolving incidents

Qualifications

  • We welcome candidates with experience in electrical, mechanical, facilities, manufacturing, telecommunications, industrial operations, military technical roles, or data center environments.
  • Direct data center experience is preferred but not required, as training will be provided.

job.description:

Department: IT Infrastructure / Data Center Operations

Location: [Navi Mumbai]

**Industry: BFSI (Banking, Financial Services & Insurance)**

Role Summary

The Level 1 Data Center Engineer will be responsible for performing day-to-day data center operational activities, including preventive maintenance, physical installation, cabling, and providing console access for network and server devices. The role involves first-level troubleshooting and coordination for incidents related to hardware, network interfaces, and device connectivity within the BFSI data center environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform **preventive

and scheduled maintenance** activities for network, server, and storage devices as per the maintenance calendar.

  • Handle **rack

mounting, de-racking, and patch cabling** for routers, switches, firewalls, servers, and other DC equipment.

  • Provide **console

access** to remote teams for troubleshooting or configuration support.

  • Monitor

DC environment parameters such as power, temperature, and connectivity; escalate anomalies as per process.

  • Work

on incident and task tickets related to device down, link down, or interface issues through ITSM tools (ServiceNow / Remedy / etc.).

  • Perform **first-level

checks and troubleshooting** for devices and coordinate with Level 2/3 teams or OEMs for resolution.

  • Maintain **asset

and inventory records** of all equipment, patch panels, and cabling layouts.

  • Support

during change management activities, including patching, upgrades, and configuration updates.

  • Ensure

compliance with **BFSI data center security and operational standards**.

  • Participate

in regular audits and maintain proper documentation for all operational activities.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Education: Graduation/

B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics, IT, or Computer Science.

  • Certifications: Basic **CCNA

certification (preferred)** or equivalent networking knowledge.

  • Experience:Min

2 years of experience in Data Center or IT Infrastructure operations, preferably in BFSI or managed services environment.

  • **Technical

Skills

  • Knowledge

of network fundamentals (LAN/WAN, VLANs, IP addressing).

  • Experience

in physical infrastructure handling – rack mounting, cabling, labeling, and documentation.

  • Familiarity

with ITSM ticketing tools.

  • Basic

understanding of server, storage, and power systems in data centers.

**Soft

Skills

  • Strong

communication and coordination skills.

  • Ability

to follow process and adhere to SLA timelines.

  • Willingness

to work in rotational shifts and during planned maintenance windows.

**Reporting To: Data Center Operations Manager / Service Operations Lead**

Work Environment

  • Onsite

presence at Bank Data Center(s).

  • Coordination

with Network, Server, and OEM vendor teams.

  • Strict

adherence to BFSI compliance and security protocols.

job.description:
Join us as a Direct Procurement Sourcing Management Specialist and drive real business impact through strategic sourcing. You'll optimize procurement processes, negotiate high-value contracts, and partner with teams across the organization to deliver cost savings and quality excellence.

What will you do?

  • Lead direct procurement initiatives that optimize cost efficiency while maintaining quality standards
  • Negotiate contracts and manage supplier relationships to secure competitive terms and drive performance
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities through strategic purchasing and process improvements
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to understand requirements and align sourcing strategies with business goals

What are the key skills we are looking for?

  • Procurement Strategy— intermediate level; developing sourcing plans that align with business objectives
  • Supplier Management— intermediate level; building and maintaining strong supplier partnerships
  • Contract Management— intermediate level; negotiating and managing agreements to protect business interests
  • Procurement Negotiations— intermediate level; securing favorable terms while maintaining supplier relationships
  • Cost Analysis— intermediate level; identifying savings opportunities through detailed spend analysis
  • Influencing Skills— intermediate level; driving alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities
  • Problem Solving— intermediate level; resolving procurement challenges with practical, effective solutions
  • Conflict Management— intermediate level; navigating supplier and stakeholder disagreements constructively

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • Strategic thinking and business acumen to shape procurement direction
  • Strong communication and influencing skills to align diverse stakeholders
  • Proactive approach with a commitment to continuous improvement
  • Ability to work independently and provide guidance to others when needed

What's in it for me?

  • High-impact role where your decisions directly influence business outcomes
  • Opportunity to lead strategic initiatives and drive meaningful change
  • Collaborative culture that values expertise and invests in your development
  • Autonomy to manage priorities and shape your work approach

Bring your procurement expertise to a team that's ready to welcome you — apply today!

job.title: Services Engineer (Cooling)
job.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a qualified and responsible Cooling Service Engineer to support the installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance of cooling systems and HVAC equipment. The candidate will be involved in site coordination, technical support, preventive maintenance, and ensuring system performance meets project and operational requirements.

What will you do?

  • Carry out installation, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of cooling systems, HVAC equipment, CRAC/CRAH units, and related controls.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance for cooling equipment and associated electrical/control components.
  • Diagnose system faults and propose corrective actions to restore normal operation.
  • Support site inspections, technical evaluations, and service activities.
  • Monitor equipment performance and ensure systems are operating efficiently and safely.
  • Prepare service reports, maintenance records, testing results, and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal teams on project and service activities.
  • Assist in spare parts planning, warranty claims, and component replacement recommendations.
  • Ensure all works are carried out in accordance with safety requirements, project specifications, and company procedures.
  • Provide technical support during project execution and after-sales service activities.
  • Keen to learn, proactive, and willing to take initiative in solving technical issues.

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • Diploma / Higher Nitec in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, HVAC, Building Services, or related field.
  • Minimum2–5 yearsof relevant working experience in cooling systems, HVAC, CRAC/CRAH, liquid cooling, inrows cooling or any air-conditioning equipment.
  • Experience in installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance of cooling equipment.
  • Familiar with electrical controls, BMS interface, and HVAC system operation.
  • Able to read and understand technical drawings, wiring diagrams, and service manuals.
  • Hands-on experience in data centre cooling systems will be an added advantage.
  • Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Able to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Good communication and report-writing skills.

Preferred Skills / Advantage:

  • Knowledge of chilled water systems, DX systems, CRAC/CRAH units, and control systems.
  • Familiarity with Modbus / BMS communication and control troubleshooting.
  • Possess Class 3 driving licence (if required ).

What's in it for me?

  • Direct customer impact through meaningful technical work in the field
  • Mentorship and structured support to build your technical skills and confidence
  • Career growth opportunities within a global leader in energy management and automation
  • Exposure to diverse industries and innovative technologies

Ready to launch your technical service career? Apply today!

job.title: Business Development-UPS
job.description:
Job Description

Skills & Profile Requirements

  • Core Responsibility: Responsible for Pre-sales and Business Development of the 3-Phase UPS and Critical Power product line.
  • Financial Metrics: Drive Sales & Gross Margin for the 3-Phase UPS Business in the assigned region. Key performance metrics include Revenue, Market Share, and Gross Margin.
  • Expertise in Schneider Electric 3-Phase UPS Portfolio, including:
  • Galaxy V-Series: Galaxy VS, Galaxy VL, Galaxy VX, and the high-density Galaxy VXL.
  • Modular & Scalable Systems: Easy UPS 3-Phase Modular systems.
  • Easy UPS 3-Series: Easy UPS 3S, 3M, and 3L systems for cost-optimized deployments.
  • Energy Storage Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of Schneider Electric Galaxy Lithium-ion Battery Systems alongside traditional VRLA battery sizing.
  • Technology & Features: Strong working knowledge of efficiency-saving modes like Schneider Electric’s proprietary eConversion mode, Live Swap modularity, and unity power factor engineering.
  • Business Growth: Grow and sustain the 3-Phase UPS Business as standalone products and as part of integrated turnkey Data Center solutions.
  • Pre-sales Support: Provide specialized technical pre-sales support to sales teams across regions for Data Center infrastructure segments (C&SP, Enterprise, Channel).
  • Strategic Alignment: Coordinate, review, and strategize Data Center power business with the broader Schneider Electric team.
  • Consultative Approach: Act as a trusted advisor during customer engagements, demonstrating strong domain expertise in power continuity, efficiency, and reliability.
  • Solution Design: Understand customer requirements and develop robust power solutions using EcoStruxure-ready architectures for:
  • Mega, Hyperscale & AI-Load Data Centers
  • Edge DC & Micro Data Centers
  • Modernization & Retrofit Data Centers
  • Critical Industrial/Facility Operations
  • Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with Electrical Consultants, EPC contractors, and key accounts.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in electrical sizing, efficiency calculations (Total Cost of Ownership/TCO), and power monitoring software (EcoStruxure IT).
  • Technical Literacy: Thorough knowledge of Electrical Single-Line Diagrams (SLDs), short-circuit & discrimination studies, and space/floor loading layouts.
  • Learning & Aptitude: Quick learner with a passion for high-tech power solution design, value engineering, and conceptual selling.
  • Competitive Positioning: Analyze customer needs to create techno-commercially competitive, compliant, and optimized solutions.
  • Internal Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams (Solution, Product, Project Execution) to define, design, and optimize power infrastructure solutions.
  • Governance: Strong in reporting, forecasting, and follow-ups to track the regional sales funnel and update leadership on pipeline progress.

Key Internal Stakeholders

  • Sales Opportunity Leader
  • Central Business Development Organization
  • Global Field Services (UPS Commissioning, EcoStruxure Asset Advisor, & AMC)
  • Data Center Regional Application Center
  • Zonal / Regional Execution Center
  • Commercial Operations & Pricing Team
  • Supply Chain Management
  • Other Activity Business Development Managers (Cooling, Racks & Enclosures, Software, etc.)

Minimum Qualification:

B.E. / B.Tech. (Electrical / Electronics & Telecommunications)

Work Experience

Minimum 4–5 years (or more) in sales/pre-sales within the domain of 3-Phase UPS systems and critical power infrastructure for Data Centers.

job.title: Senior Manager - R&D
job.description:
Job Description

Schneider’s purpose is to empower all to make the most of our energy and resources, bridging progress and sustainabilityfor all. We call this Life Is On.

Our mission is to be your digital partner for Sustainability and Efficiency.

We drive digital transformation by integrating world-leading process and energy technologies, end-point to cloud connecting products, controls, software and services, across the entire lifecycle, enabling integrated company management, for homes, buildings, data centers, infrastructure, and industries.

We are the most local of global companies. We are advocates of open standards and partnership ecosystems that are passionate about our shared Meaningful Purpose, Inclusive and Empoweredvalues.

[www.se.com](https://brand.se.com/www.se.com)

Lauritz Knudsen - Electrical & Automation is a unit of Schneider Electric India Private Limited.

Electrical & Automation (E&A) offers a wide range of products, solutions and turnkey services for electricity distribution and control, across various sectors: Industries, Utilities, Buildings, Residences and Agriculture. Electrical & Automation (E&A) is one of the largest manufacturers of low and medium voltage switchgear components, low & medium voltage switchboards, power quality solutions, solar energy solutions, energy management system & metering solutions, life cycle enhancement (modernization) and industrial automation solutions. These products and solutions cater to the distribution, monitoring and control of electrical power in industries, utilities, buildings & critical infrastructure, national assets and agriculture sectors. A popular brand in the country, Switchgear performs efficiently and delivers quality of power and management of energy in different environmental conditions. Designed to perform with reliability, all switchgear products offer several safety, communication and data management features.

Currently, over 1000 channel partners in major cities and towns distribute E&A’s switchgear products. A network of 120 approved service centers supports the necessary maintenance of these products. E&A makes high quality energy meters and protective relays for utilities, industries, commercial establishments and domestic consumers. The meter range, popular as Meters, includes programmable tri-vector meters, single phase, three phase meters and intelligent meter panels.

E&A’s manufacturing operations in India are located at Navi Mumbai (Mahape), Ahmednagar, Vadodara, Coimbatore and Mysore.

Educational Qualification: B.Tech / M.Tech Mechanical Engineering

Eligibility Criteria: Should have 70% and above in X, XII and Graduation (wherever applicable), CGPA 8 and more in B.Tech / M.Tech . Minimum 5+ years of experience in CAE, design, analysis, CFD / thermal simulations, experience in switchgear domain is preferable

Job location: Mumbai (Mahape office)

Job Designation: Manager

Key Responsibilities/Deliverables:

  • To work on Sustainability projects and activities for New product development
  • Lifecycle assessment - Environmental product data declaration (PEP & EoLI document creation )
  • Digitization of environmental data
  • Design for Environment / Ecodesign activities for new products
  • Proficiency in subjects like - Machine design, Heat transfer, Fluid mechanics, Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanism
  • Proficiency in Thermal, CFD, linear/non-linear Structural, Mechanism simulations and analysis
  • Proficiency in Ansys Workbench, Fluent, Altairs, Creo
  • Result interpretation and report preparation
  • Good analytical skills, Basic programming knowledge, Python, data analysis and AI/ML will be preferable
  • Experimental testing for validation of simulations and results
  • To work on emerging technologies, advanced simulations
  • WBS and MS projects for completion of projects as per timelines
  • Ability to work on multiple platforms, Teamwork
  • Work on sensors, data acquisition and build data from various tests for Digital twin of switchgear

job.title: Senior Associate Network & Security Engineer
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Associate Network Engineer is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for leveraging their networking skills and experience to support, design, and optimize company network infrastructure.

This role works closely with network engineers, architects, and cross-functional teams to ensure the stability, security, and performance of the network environment.

The Senior Associate Network Engineer represents a progression from an Associate Network Engineer, requiring a higher level of expertise and responsibilities.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Collaborates with senior network engineers to design, implement, and optimize network solutions, including LAN, WAN, and data centre networks Contributes to network architecture discussions and provide technical input Configures and manages network devices such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and wireless access points Implements advanced features and protocols to enhance network functionality Diagnoses and resolves network issues, utilising advanced troubleshooting techniques and tools Analyses network traffic patterns to identify performance bottlenecks and recommends improvements Implements and maintains network security measures, including firewall rules, access controls, VPNs, and intrusion detection/prevention systems Utilises network monitoring tools to proactively monitor network performance, analyse trends, and take corrective actions to optimize network efficiency and reliability Creates and maintains comprehensive network documentation, including detailed network diagrams, configurations, procedures, and incident reports Collaborates with cross-functional teams, including systems administrators, security teams, and application developers, to ensure seamless integration of network solutions Communicates technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Contributes to network-related projects, migrations, upgrades, and expansions Follows project plans, meets deadlines, and provides technical expertise to ensure successful project outcomes Stays updated with emerging networking technologies, trends, and industry best practices Pursues relevant certifications and training to enhance networking skills Knowledge, Skills and Attributes: Strong understanding of networking concepts, protocols, architectures, and services Proficiency in configuring and managing network devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers In-depth knowledge of network protocols and technologies such as BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VPNs, QoS, and security protocols Hands-on experience with network monitoring and analysis tools Strong documentation and communication skills to convey technical information effectively Ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues using analytical problem-solving skills Project participation experience, including adherence to project timelines and deliverables Familiarity with network security principles and best practices Proficient in using network administration and configuration tools Leadership and mentorship skills to guide junior team members Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field Relevant cloud provider Network Administration certification (Azure, Google, Amazon) Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Network+, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or Juniper Networks Certified Associate (JNCIA) are beneficial Relevant certifications such as Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP), or equivalent certifications are preferred Required Experience: Extended relevant experience in networking, including previous experience as an Associate Network Engineer or similar role Extended experience working in a networking environment Some experience with network security Extended WAN and LAN experience Extended experience in wireless equipment, protocols, standards, and wireless LAN design Extended experience with cloud networking (AWS, Azure, etc.) is a plus

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

This senior management role is accountable for leading cross functional teams, fostering a collaborative and innovative team culture focused on achieving operational excellence.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Provides applied electrical, mechanical, integrated control and water chemistry technical expertise for the entire data centre.
  • Coordinates the activities of contractors and consultants for daily operations and critical maintenance (UPS systems, generators, switchgear, and chiller maintenance).
  • Ensures relevant teams works effectively to achieve required goals/objectives.
  • Manages budget, staff planning, relevant feedback, operational efficiency, etc.
  • Directly interfaces with Construction management team, contractors, and consultants for all phased data centre construction commissioning, including integration and testing of new systems while maintaining critical systems online.
  • Works with relevant teams to develop and track annual budgets.

  • Participates in rotational on-call schedule to respond to emergency situations at the data centre.
  • Provides site leadership, implements training, and acts as both a coach and mentor to site employees.

Data centre power distribution and management systems Has demonstrated technical ability and innovative thinking cross functionally, including integrated systems and IT Strong background in safety and code compliance assessments Ability to train the Critical Facilities Staff on systems and procedures Ability to operate in and promote a rigorous process-driven, team environment Ability to logically analyse and solve problems Detailed oriented Analytical thinking, problem solving, customer oriented, and commitment to quality Excellent problem-solving skills Academic Qualifications and Experience

Handover & Compliance

The 1st shift supervisor is responsible for management function relating to manufacturing operations and material movements through the plant to service customer requirements.  The supervisor integrates the functions of production control, workforce planning, materials transactions, supervision of the workforce and trouble-shooting production issues. Daily report outs will be required between the 1st shift supervisors and the 2nd shift supervisor.
