Job Description

Position title: ERP Second Level Support (RUN) – Senior Analyst

Reporting to: ERP Second Level Support (RUN) – Shift Manager

Location: India

Role Statement

The ERP Second Level Support (RUN) Senior Analyst is accountable for ensuring advanced functional support and deep root-cause analysis for complex issues escalated from Triage and Junior Analysts, acting as the subject-matter expert for a specific Oracle EBS module.

This role contributes to stable operations by driving effective resolution, implementing preventive measures, and supporting continuous improvement of Oracle EBS processes. The Senior Analyst takes end-to-end ownership of complex tickets, designs and validates functional fixes and workarounds, and ensures structured ticket handover within the Follow-the-Sun model to deliver uninterrupted support coverage.

As a qualified first line of defense within the ERP Second Level Support team, this role partners with the Shift Manager, Domain Head, Junior Analysts, ERP Tech Factory, and ERP Product Specialists to ensure seamless escalation paths, high-quality resolution, and consistent service delivery aligned with the organization’s Run operating model.

Key Duties

Ticket Resolution & Backlog Management

  • Take end-to-end ownership of complex tickets escalated from Triage and Junior Analysts, ensuring thorough analysis and resolution within SLA targets.
  • Support prioritization and backlog management, especially for high-severity incidents, ensuring alignment with business impact and SLA requirements.
  • Design, validate, and implement functional fixes and workarounds, confirming solution effectiveness with key business stakeholders.
  • Generate structured ticket handover materials to ensure continuity in the Follow-the-Sun model.

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Perform in-depth root-cause analysis for complex or non-standard incidents, accurately identifying underlying functional and process failures.
  • Define corrective actions and drive preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents and improve process stability.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying patterns, proposing configuration or process enhancements, and sharing findings with the broader team.

Escalation & Collaboration

  • Promptly engage the ERP Product Specialist when additional expertise is required or challenges arise beyond functional scope.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to ERP Tech Factory, providing comprehensive documentation of analysis performed and resolution attempts.
  • Provide updates on solution design and technically resolved tickets to the Shift Manager and relevant stakeholders.
  • Participate in cross-functional stand-ups to remove blockers and accelerate cross-module resolution.

Governance & Knowledge Management

  • Maintain and enhance knowledge assets, including functional documentation, troubleshooting guides, and known-error records.
  • Support regression, UAT, and hypercare testing to ensure operational readiness for releases.
  • Drive the adoption of enabling technologies (ServiceNow, Oracle EBS, SharePoint) for efficient ticket tracking and resolution documentation.

Qualification and Experience

Required:

  • 3–5 years of experience in Oracle EBS functional roles with exposure to complex incident management.
  • Established specialization in at least one Oracle EBS module (e.g., Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Services).
  • Proven experience in handling complex, unstructured, or cross-module incidents.
  • Deep understanding of end-to-end business processes related to the assigned Oracle EBS module.
  • Advanced capability in conducting root-cause analysis and translating findings into actionable corrective measures.
  • Proficiency in executing low-risk functional configurations following fit-to-standard principles.
  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
  • High sense of ownership and end-to-end accountability.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management, including in international contexts.

Preferred:

  • Experience working in Follow-the-Sun or shift-based global support models.
  • Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident management frameworks and tools (ServiceNow).
  • Background in ERP support environments within manufacturing or industrial organizations.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and preventive maintenance approaches.

Key Performance Indicators

  • SLA compliance rate
  • Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)
  • First Contact Resolution rate (FCR)
  • ERP incident recurrence rate
  • Ticket re-open rate
  • Knowledge base contribution rate

Job Description

Job Summary

The Service Sales Coordinator is responsible for supporting the service sales team in managing customer inquiries, preparing quotations, coordinating service agreements, maintaining customer records, and ensuring timely execution of sales-related activities. The role acts as a key link between customers, sales teams,  and internal stakeholders to achieve business objectives and enhance customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities Sales Support

  • Prepare and process service quotations, proposals, and contract documents.
  • Coordinate with service engineers and operations teams for accurate pricing and service scope.
  • Follow up with customers on submitted quotations and pending orders.
  • Support service sales representatives in achieving business targets.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Handle customer inquiries related to AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts).
  • Ensure prompt resolution of customer issues by coordinating with relevant departments.

Contract & Order Management

  • Process service orders and maintain accurate records in ERP/CRM systems.
  • Track contract renewals and proactively engage customers before expiry.
  • Ensure all service contracts and purchase orders are properly documented and archived.

Coordination & Administration

  • Coordinate between sales, service, finance, and logistics teams for smooth order execution.
  • Maintain sales reports, customer databases, and service contract records.
  • Generate periodic reports on quotations, orders, revenue, and customer activities.

Business Development Support

  • Identify potential opportunities for service contract renewals.
  • Assist in lead generation and customer engagement activities.
  • Support sales campaigns and marketing initiatives related to service offerings.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree, Business Administration, Commerce, or related field.
  • 2-3 years of experience in service sales coordination, customer support, inside sales, or related functions.
  • Experience in industrial equipment, engineering services, HVAC, power generation, thermal services, or manufacturing industries is preferred.

Required Skills Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Working knowledge of ERP/CRM systems such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, or Microsoft Dynamics.

Behavioral Skills

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Customer-focused approach.
  • Excellent coordination and organizational abilities.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Service quotation turnaround time.
  • Contract renewal rate.

  • Customer satisfaction level.

The 2nd shift supervisor is responsible for management function relating to manufacturing operations and material movements through the plant to service customer requirements.  The supervisor integrates the functions of production control, workforce planning, materials transactions, supervision of the workforce and trouble-shooting production issues. About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. job.title: AI Specialist SA
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands-on AI Specialist Solution Architect (SSA). AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.

As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. You will craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing an entirely new cloud-based system.

SSAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating roadmap enhancements, and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.

This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.

Key job responsibilities

  • The AI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
  • You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
  • Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
  • In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
  • You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
  • If you can educate AWS customers about the art of the possible, while challenging the impossible, come build the future with us.
  • Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Lead hands-on deep dives and technical workshops, contributing reusable code, reference architectures, and internal technical assets for the broader engineering organization.

job.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, AWS Cloud Logistics
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Cloud Logistics (ACL) is looking for an experienced Technical Program Manager to lead our Data Governance and EDI Integration function. In this role, you will own the end-to-end strategy and execution of data quality, EDI compliance, and system integrations that power visibility across our global supply chain — ensuring planning teams, systems, and operations teams have accurate, timely data to make critical decisions.

This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of technical program management, data architecture, and operational excellence. You will define and drive the data governance roadmap, establish EDI compliance frameworks with logistics service providers (LSPs), oversee ASN (Advanced Shipment Notice) and inventory data quality, and serve as the technical authority for data integrations across transportation management systems (TMS), warehouse management systems (WMS), and supply chain visibility platforms.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned technical program manager who thrives in ambiguity, understands data architecture and system integrations, and has a track record of building scalable data governance frameworks in logistics or supply chain environments. You are data-driven, technically deep, and energized by the challenge of ensuring that thousands of shipments and millions of data points flow accurately through our systems every day.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the data governance strategy for ACL's global transportation and inventory visibility systems — defining data quality standards, compliance frameworks, and monitoring mechanisms that ensure accuracy across EDI-214, EDI-852, ASN, and other critical data feeds.
  • Lead EDI compliance programs with logistics service providers (LSPs), establishing performance frameworks, conducting monthly error reviews, identifying schema violations, and driving vendor accountability for data accuracy and timeliness.
  • Oversee data and EDI integrations across transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, real-time shipment tracking platforms, and internal planning systems — partnering with engineering teams to troubleshoot integration issues, define technical requirements, and ensure seamless data flow.
  • Establish and own data quality reporting cadences (WBR/MBR/QBR), providing executive-level visibility on EDI performance, ASN accuracy, inventory discrepancies, and system integration health.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment with business intelligence teams, operations teams, planning teams, and software engineering teams to resolve data quality issues, define new metrics, and ensure downstream consumers (operations, global supply managers, planning) trust the data they rely on.
  • Build scalable frameworks for onboarding new LSPs, suppliers, and systems into our data ecosystem — including EDI setup, schema validation, testing protocols, and go-live readiness criteria.
  • Identify and resolve systemic data issues (timezone discrepancies, schema violations, event mapping errors, inventory mismatches) that impact thousands of shipments, escalating appropriately to director-level leadership and vendor executives when necessary.
  • Partner with engineering and business intelligence teams to automate data quality monitoring, build self-service dashboards, and reduce manual intervention in data validation workflows.
  • Define and continuously improve the end-to-end data lifecycle — from LSP transmission through system ingestion, transformation, and consumption by operations and planning teams.
  • Become team expert on on data governance best practices, EDI standards, and system integration troubleshooting.

A day in the life

  • Assess data quality pipeline health across EDI-214, EDI-852, and ASN feeds — identifying LSPs with high error rates, diagnosing root causes (schema violations, timezone issues, event mapping errors), and coordinating fixes with vendor IT/systems PMs and their teams.
  • Lead monthly EDI compliance reviews with logistics service providers — presenting error data, holding vendors accountable for performance, and tracking remediation to completion.
  • Coordinate with business intelligence teams to update data quality dashboards, add new metrics (ASN accuracy, inventory reconciliation), and ensure operations teams have real-time visibility into shipment status and data reliability.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues between transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, and real-time visibility platforms — working with engineering teams to diagnose API failures, data transformation errors, and system latency issues.
  • Pull data from internal systems (TMS, WMS, EDI logs, shipment databases) to conduct root cause analysis on data discrepancies affecting operations teams, global supply managers, or planning forecasts.
  • Lead cross-functional meetings with operations, planning, and engineering stakeholders — setting expectations for data quality SLAs, tracking commitments for system fixes, and escalating blockers that impact business-critical reporting.
  • Identify patterns in data quality issues (repeated schema errors, timezone gaps, inventory mismatches) and propose process improvements or automation opportunities that prevent recurrence and reduce manual intervention.
  • Partner with technology teams to translate manual data validation processes into automated workflows — building monitoring tools, error alerting systems, and self-service capabilities that scale without proportional headcount growth.

About the team This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing, high-impact team. AWS Cloud Logistics manages a continuously evolving portfolio of shipments and warehousing operations through a worldwide supply chain. We deliver the right product at the right time, cost, and place — ensuring our AWS supply chain is reliable, scalable, and cost-optimized. The data governance function is critical to how we operate: every planning decision, every operational escalation, and every system automation depends on accurate, timely data flowing through our ecosystem.

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of technical product or program management experience
  • 6+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
  • Experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday), or experience with data analytics platforms (Power BI, Python, SQL, Tableau)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
  • Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
  • Master's degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration
  • Experience troubleshooting system integration issues across transportation management systems, warehouse management systems, and third-party real-time tracking platforms
  • Knowledge of transportation and logistics operations (shipment lifecycle, carrier performance, warehouse operations)
  • Familiarity with ANSI X12 EDI standards and troubleshooting EDI transaction sets (214, 852, 856, 997)

Join Us at Telstra Retail:

When you become part of the Telstra team, you’re joining a brand that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone is respected, valued, and can thrive. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to our team!

Job Summary

Job Description

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will work without immediate supervision or direction to provide our customers with a great experience by activating and assuring telecommunications / technology products and services, in the home and/or business.

You will actively participate in a diverse team environment to deliver the optimum customer and commercial outcomes aligned to the corporate strategy.

We have several positions available around the country. Find the specific locations below. The expectation is to reside in the targeted area or be willing to relocate.

  • Everything from head to toe. From the vehicle, tools, and equipment through to the full uniform, we provide it all.
  • Pay for performance. We recognise outstanding contributions through our competitive incentive programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver seamless service rectification and product installations, to the full satisfaction of Telstra’s customers.
  • Copper cable maintenance and installation including fault finding, jointing, jumpering, and networking.

  • Customer Premises Equipment maintenance and installation (both consumer and business).

Qualifications

You will be required to hold and maintain the relevant and applicable licenses and qualifications to perform this role, as deemed mandatory by regulatory and legal authorities and must also maintain a current driver’s license.

job.title: Senior Critical Facilities Engineer (Controls) - Singapore
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

A senior, highly skilled specialist responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and safe operation of mission‑critical data center infrastructure through advanced controls and automation systems. The Senior Critical Facilities Engineer (Controls) applies deep expertise in BMS, control systems, and system integration to monitor, optimize, and stabilize critical facilities operations. This role operates with a high degree of independence within standard operating procedures and supports operational excellence by improving system behavior, alarm management, and control logic across the site.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Performs specialized preventive and corrective maintenance with a focus on controls, automation, and monitoring layers supporting critical facilities systems.
  • Acts as a technical authority for Building Management Systems (BMS), DCOS, and associated control platforms, ensuring reliable monitoring and control of power, cooling, and life‑safety systems.
  • Monitors and analyzes complex alarms, trends, and events within the BMS, independently resolving issues related to control logic, system behavior, and signal integrity.
  • Leads investigation of abnormal system behavior, including false alarms, control sequence failures, sensor drift, and communication faults, recommending corrective actions.
  • Supports control system interfaces across mechanical and electrical systems (e.g. chillers, CRAH/CRACs, generators, UPS interfaces), working closely with Electrical and Mechanical CF teams.
  • Reviews, validates, and optimizes alarm configuration, thresholds, and escalation logic to reduce noise and improve incident response effectiveness.
  • Supports configuration, testing, and validation of control strategies during maintenance windows, system upgrades, or commissioning activities.
  • Implements and supports energy efficiency and optimization initiatives through improved control strategies, setpoint tuning, and automated response mechanisms.
  • Works on assignments requiring significant judgment and initiative, fully understanding how controls failures or misconfigurations can impact customer infrastructure, availability, and SLAs.

Vendor Support

  • Acts as the primary technical interface for controls and BMS vendors, integrators, and service providers.
  • Reviews and validates vendor proposed control logic, graphics, and sequences of operation to ensure alignment with site standards and operational intent.
  • Assists with the creation, review, and approval of Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs) and scripts related to control system changes.
  • Oversees vendor execution during controls‑related maintenance, system upgrades, or retrofits, including pre‑work briefings, live supervision, and post‑work validation.
  • Ensures control system documentation, network diagrams, point lists, and as‑built records are maintained accurately.

Site Administration & Incident Support

  • Prepares and maintains specialized documentation for control system operations, alarm management, and automated response mechanisms.
  • Identifies Single Points of Failure (SPOFs) and systemic risks within the controls and monitoring layer and recommends architectural or configuration improvements.
  • Responds to on‑site incidents involving BMS failures, alarm floods, loss of visibility, or automation defects, providing controls expertise during restoration.
  • Leads or contributes to Root Cause Analysis (RCA) related to controls, automation, or monitoring system failures.
  • Supports on‑site teams during incidents by providing control‑system insight, diagnostic guidance, and decision support.
  • Ensures controls‑related procedures, alarm management policies, and change processes are followed consistently during normal operations and incidents.

Work Orders & Additional Projects

  • Completes skilled work requests related to control system changes, monitoring enhancements, and automation improvements.
  • Supports commissioning, re‑commissioning, and control validation activities for new or modified infrastructure.
  • Implements approved changes to controls logic, alarm strategies, and system interfaces in support of operations and improvement initiatives.
  • Executes and supports complex controls‑focused projects, including BMS upgrades, platform migrations, and integration of new plant systems.
  • Supports life‑cycle management and end‑of‑life replacement of controls hardware, networks, and software platforms.
  • Recommends controls and automation improvement projects based on operational data, incident trends, and system performance.

Collaboration

  • Collaborates closely with Electrical, Mechanical, Operations, Security, and IT teams to ensure controls systems accurately reflect facility behavior and operational needs.
  • Acts as a technical mentor for engineers in the areas of BMS usage, alarm interpretation, and control system troubleshooting.
  • Works with stakeholders to forecast controls‑related spare parts, licensing, and system capacity requirements.
  • Serves as a senior controls subject‑matter expert during incidents, complex changes, and multi‑discipline projects.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience supporting controls, BMS, automation, or monitoring systems in mission‑critical environments such as data centers, smart buildings, utilities, or industrial facilities.
  • Diploma or Degree in Controls Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, or Building Services Engineering preferred.
  • Hands‑on experience with BMS / DCOS platforms, PLC‑based systems, alarm management strategies, and system integration is highly desirable.

If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

job.title: Data Center Technician (Entry Level) - Singapore, Central Singapore
job.description:
About the Role

Join our world-class data center operations team and play a critical role in supporting some of the world's leading cloud, network, and enterprise customers. As a Data Center Customer Operations Technician, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional customer service while supporting the installation, maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting of customer infrastructure within our Singapore data center.

Responsibilities

Queue Management / Reporting

  • Reviews work order requests in the queue and responds to semi-routine work orders by adhering to commitment times
  • Escalates and expedites orders to appropriate teams upon standard operating procedures; supervision needed on the escalation of nonstandard procedure escalation requests
  • Ensures adherence to commit times within standard operating procedures
  • Maintains detailed written records of all work activity
  • Updates local asset databases and other systems

Installations

  • Rack and stack semi-routine customer equipment tickets
  • Supports intra-cage infrastructure installations by following the standard operating procedures of semi-routine customer installs, which may include:
  • fiber trays, ladder racks, customer equipment and cabinets
  • semi-basic cage installs for mesh and overhead cable trays
  • performs tape changes and standard operating back-up changes

Cross-Connect

  • Supports semi-routine data center standard operating cross-connect work order requests (installs, terminations, modifications, and testing)
  • Ensures the standard operating procedures are followed on cable management of: coax, fiber, twisted pair copper, and semi-routine intrabuilding cross connects
  • Learns to install 'across' connect circuits (switched, multiplexed, etc.), under supervision

Testing / Troubleshooting

  • Supports semi-routine standard operating testing and standard operating installations of customer assets
  • Supports standard operating procedures of layer 1 cross-connect certification testing
  • May learn non-standard operating testing, such as: layer 2 and layer 3 testing, under supervision

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Supports the operations and security personnel team for breaks or other activities, when necessary
  • Supports standard operating procedural tasks provides back-up assistance to team members when necessary

Customer Management

  • Supports customer satisfaction with timely adherence to following semi-routine execution order requirements
  • Delivers a high level of service and an excellent customer experience when interfacing with customers
  • Provides support with time expectations on new deployments and existing alterations, by following standard operating procedure guidelines
  • Supports customers on-site by through access control and escorting services

Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in customer deployment projects and infrastructure expansion initiatives.
  • Support physical customer audits and compliance activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, processes, and customer experience.

Learning & Development

  • Complete all assigned technical and operational training.
  • Build expertise across data center operations, connectivity, and customer support functions.
  • Support onboarding and knowledge sharing with new team members as experience grows.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma, technical certification, vocational qualification, or equivalent practical experience within IT
  • Internship within a DC or similar space

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Familiarity with structured cabling, data center infrastructure, or telecommunications environments.
  • Basic understanding of networking and connectivity concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Effective problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment.
  • We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage applications from individuals with transferable technical skills and a willingness to learn.

Work Requirements

  • Ability to complete hands-on tasks at height or in tight spaces.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends, night shifts, holidays, and shift-based schedules as required to support 24x7 data center operations.
  • Candidates must have current authorization to work in Singapore

job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Accountant will work exclusively within the CAPEX accounting area, supporting the accurate accounting, reporting, and statutory compliance of capital expenditure, fixed assets, and capital projects. We are looking for someone with strong CAPEX accounting knowledge under local GAAP, primarily IFRS. Where direct CAPEX experience is more limited, we would expect strong overall IFRS knowledge and the ability to apply this to CAPEX-related accounting matters. This role is suited to an experienced finance professional who is comfortable working with statutory reporting requirements and wants to develop further within a specialised CAPEX accounting environment.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage all aspects of the CAPEX accounting process, including the recording, classification, and reporting of capital expenditure in line with statutory requirements and internal policies
  • Prepare and review statutory financial statements and disclosures related to fixed assets and capital projects, ensuring compliance with relevant accounting standards (e.g., IFRS or local GAAP as applicable)
  • Provide support and guidance on statutory accounting matters related to CAPEX, including technical issues, policy developments, and process improvements
  • Coordinate with project managers, procurement, and operational teams to ensure CAPEX transactions are accurately captured and appropriately documented
  • Lead or support the CAPEX audit process, liaising with internal and external auditors to provide required schedules, explanations, and reconciliations
  • Drive enhancements in CAPEX reporting, controls, and systems, identifying opportunities to streamline processes and improve data quality
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of changes in statutory accounting standards and ensure ongoing compliance across all CAPEX activities
  • Mentor and support junior finance team members, sharing expertise in statutory accounting and CAPEX management

Qualifications

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent) with significant post-qualification experience in statutory accounting. CAPEX accounting experience is preferred but is not essential where the candidate has strong overall IFRS knowledge
  • Demonstrable experience in preparing statutory accounts. Experience relating to fixed assets and capital projects is preferred
  • Strong CAPEX accounting knowledge under local GAAP, primarily IFRS, or strong overall IFRS knowledge with the ability to apply it to CAPEX-related accounting matters
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly to non-finance stakeholders
  • Advanced proficiency in Oracle, MS Excel, and reporting tools
  • Experience in process improvement, audit liaison, and cross-functional collaboration
  • High attention to detail, integrity, and a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Desirable Attributes

  • Experience in a similar role within a large, multinational organisation
  • Experience working with large, complex fixed asset registers and CAPEX portfolios
  • Exposure to international statutory reporting requirements

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer - Shenton Park, Western Australia, Australia
job.description:
Job Summary

At Equinix our Critical Facilities Engineers operate, manage, maintain and repair critical and non-critical Power systems, HVAC, plumbing, fire control and suppression, and all site services, and performs all related vendor support in a mission critical environment.

This fast-paced role supports the overall functioning of the Data Center by focusing on maintaining and improving the facility’s critical infrastructure. This includes all regularly scheduled maintenance and ad hoc repairs/troubleshooting.

Based predominantly out of PE3 at Shenton Park and with a shared on-call roster the role will suit an experienced and qualified tradesperson or engineering degree holder to join the team.

Mission critical, commercial, or industrial experience is preferred particularly within a hands-on service role, and the position will encompass project, commissioning, and varied tasks onsite. We have a diverse team from different engineering backgrounds who work across streams (electrical/mechanical/controls) in a collaborative atmosphere, so teamwork and a positive attitude a are a must.

Key responsibilities

  • Completes all maintenance protocols, plans, activities on time and accurately, including daily, weekly and monthly site checks
  • Manage and oversee specialist vendors for all major works, planned repairs and maintenance to mechanical, electrical and special systems
  • Performs minor changes to mechanical, electrical and special systems if necessary
  • Ensures that sufficient spare parts are available on site for frequently used parts or parts with long lead times and maintains critical spares register
  • Monitors for and responds to BMS (Building Monitoring System) alarms in accordance with engineering policies and procedures, escalating to and working with Controls Engineering team where required.
  • Oversee plumbing and fire suppression systems vendor activities
  • Coordinates/oversee work with vendors to ensure that maintenance activities are carried out as per Equinix's requirements
  • Commissioning and project work that will vary in scale and scope over time
  • Edits and tracks the work approval process for service providers (including briefing at the start of work, control of work during the day, final review of the work carried out)
  • Recommend changes/updates to technical files for plants and equipment in cooperation with vendor, and the supervisors, ensuring as built are up to date
  • Creates engineering scripts (switching schedules)
  • Ensures that all Equinix safety standards are followed, as well quality procedures related to maintenance, including all Incident Management
  • Reviews processes, procedures, systems. Communicates process deviations and proposed changes to a higher level so that relevant follow-up measures can be carried out
  • Develops training and supports training of other IBX (International Business Exchange) employees in relevant engineering topics and processes
  • Provides guidance and mentoring to junior engineers within the team

Qualifications, key skills and attributes required:

  • Understanding through practical experience of critical facility operations, with a focus on electrical, mechanical, systems
  • Trade or Degree Certified
  • Sound knowledge or understanding of HVAC and electrical Controls
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting and repairing complex mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in time-sensitive situations.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workload effectively.
  • Collaborative mindset but also with the drive to complete assigned tasks autonomously when required

Benefits of the role:

  • Monday-Friday role based at a static site with evenly split on-call roster
  • Salary package containing company shares, annual bonus, healthcare allowance
  • Career development opportunities and access to Equinix Global Ops Academy, whilst working in a collaborative and flat structured environment
  • Access to wide range of company wellness, financial and employee benefits

job.title: AI & Business Process Transformation Intern
job.description:
Job Description

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient,electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You are part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

We are now hiring i nterns for ourH 1 202 7 cohort!Internships will start inJanuary 202 7.Students who can commit full-time will be preferred.

Join us as anAI & Business Process Transformation Internto make an impact!

Location:Kallang

Ready to explore the power of data, AI, and automation? Join us as an intern and gain hands-on experience improving business processes, enhancing reporting and forecasting, and driving operational efficiency through data-driven solutions.

What will you do:

Reporting & Data Consolidation

  • Review existing manual reporting processes across Business Units.
  • Identify repetitive data collection, consolidation, and formatting activities.
  • Use AI tools, Excel automation, Power BI, Power Automate, or other digital tools to simplify reporting.
  • Create cleaner, faster, and more user-friendly dashboards or reporting templates.

Forecasting Support

  • Analyze historical business data to identify trends, patterns, and gaps.
  • Support improvement of forecasting accuracy through data analytics and AI-enabled insights.
  • Help develop simple forecasting models or dashboards to support business planning.
  • Highlight risks, assumptions, and opportunities based on available data.

Delivery & Performance Tracking

  • Review delivery tracking processes and identify bottlenecks or manual follow-up activities.
  • Propose tools or dashboards to monitor delivery status, delays, and key actions.
  • Support better visibility of progress, risks, and ownership across teams.
  • Help automate regular status updates where possible.

Cross-BU Communication & Coordination

  • Identify communication gaps across Business Units that impact speed, alignment, or decision-making.
  • Explore AI-enabled communication tools, summaries, trackers, or shared dashboards to improve collaboration.
  • Support creation of standardized templates for updates, meeting summaries, action tracking, and follow-ups.
  • Improve information flow between teams through digital and AI-assisted solutions.

AI Use Case Identification

  • Work with business stakeholders to identify practical AI use cases.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on impact, feasibility, and ease of adoption.
  • Develop proof-of-concept solutions for selected use cases.
  • Measure productivity gains, time saved, and improvement in process efficiency.

What qualifications will make you successful:

  • Currently pursuing or recently graduated with a degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, or Business Administration with a strong analytics focus.
  • Demonstrated strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and data consolidation; experience with Power BI, Power Automate, Python, SQL, or similar analytics and automation tools is an added advantage.
  • Familiarity with AI and Generative AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or equivalent platforms.
  • Able to understand business processes and translate challenges into digital solutions, while effectively collaborating and communicating with stakeholders across functions; proactive, curious, and willing to challenge existing ways of working to drive continuous improvement.

What's in it for me:

  • Real-world experience working on data and AI projects that matter
  • Mentorship and guidance from professionals who care about your development
  • Exposure to data privacy, governance, and advanced analytics in action
  • A welcoming, supportive environment designed to help you grow and succeed
  • The chance to contribute to strategic initiatives and build a strong career foundation

Start your data and AI journey with a team that's excited to support you — apply today!

Rewards designed for you

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our [Career Page](https://www.se.com/careers).

  • Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

+9% organic growth

150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

job.title: Customer Engineer - Power, NSW
job.description:
Job Description

The purpose of this position is to carry out service of equipment, after hours service, commissioning and service contracts as planned and directed by the Service Operations Manager and Service Supervisor – Power.

Key Responsibilities

Planning & Reporting:

  • Ensure that service reports, expense claims and any other reports required by Management are completed and submitted by the due date.
  • Time Sheets must be filled out correctly (ie, accurately record of hours worked, and all call out and response times) and submitted to the Operations Manager or Service Supervisor – Power by the due date each week.
  • A Doctor’s Certificate must be supplied for any more than two days absence from work due to illness/injury.
  • Field Service Reports are to be completed for every service call made
  • These reports MUST also be signed by the customer whether the work is chargeable or not.
  • All items used on a job, whether Liebert spares or consumables must be detailed on the FSR.

Operational Delivery:

  • Carry out commissioning, service contract maintenance and after hours service commitments in a professional, efficient manner, and achieve a high level of service to our clients within the restraints of time, expense and profitability.
  • Maintain proper levels of relationships between the Company and our customers, by ensuring all complaints are reported promptly so that remedial action can be taken.
  • Ensure that a level of competence is maintained to adequately handle the degree of technology required by application to training available and personal updating.
  • At all times ensure that your Company vehicle, personal dress and appearance are presentable within the restraints of the work to be carried out, the Company policy is well understood and that Company business is carried out in an efficient and professional manner.
  • Spare Parts Van stock requisitions must be filled out when stock is required to maintain accurate records of stock in service vans and store.

Continuous Improvement:

  • To be aware at all times of both Sales & Service opportunities for the Company, and to report any such opportunities to Management.
  • To ensure that the Sales Department is made aware of all new sales opportunities and prospects, and to work closely with them in achieving this business.

WHS, Environment & Quality:

  • Comply with all Work, Health & Safety, Environment and Quality obligations
  • Actively promote safety in the workplace

Daily work duties and expectations

  • Driver's License is required (may involve visit to remote sites)
  • Overnight or longer trips may be required.
  • Unaccompanied (Lone worker)
  • After-hours work and being on an On-Call Roster are needed.
  • Attending customer Service calls.
  • Occasional use of ladders
  • Working in tight and restricted locations.
  • Working on and around Energized Electrical equipment.
  • Lifting, carrying, relocating equipment and components (e.g. Batteries, tools and spare parts)

Main contacts within Company

  • Other Customer Engineers – Power
  • Service Supervisor – Power
  • Service Operations Manager
  • Safety Manager
  • Technical Support Team
  • Sales Team
  • Finance

Main contacts outside the Company

  • Customers
  • Product Suppliers
  • Contractors
  • Vertiv Partners

Education/Qualification:

  • Electrical/Electronics Trade Certificate (ideally)
  • Relevant State-based Electrical Licence

Specialist Knowledge:

  • Commercial acumen
  • Technical knowledge in data centres, telecom, commercial & industrial or similar industries

Practical Experience:

  • Proven track record within the power industry as a service technician
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office

Personal Characteristics:

  • Excellent communication, inter-personal and problem solving skills
  • Learning agility
  • Interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
  • Ability to multitask and priorities workloads
  • Negotiation & influencing skills
  • Computer literacy at an intermediate level

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute

job.title: Commercial Business Development Manager, Next Gen Automation
job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven professional with deep expertise in industrial automation, digital transformation, and Industry 4.0. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in business development, technical sales, and solution consulting, with a proven ability to influence key decision-makers and drive the adoption new technology.

This role requires a strategic thinker who can work autonomously while collaborating effectively within a matrix organization. The successful candidate will be recognized as a subject matter expert, providing guidance to both internal teams and external customers and partners as they implement Next Gen Automation. Having an in-depth knowledge of how Industrial segments and their associated applications work is key to this role. (WWW, MMM, CPG, E&C, Infrastructure, C&SP is advantageous.

Key Responsibilities

Sales & Revenue Growth – Direct Selling

  • Drive commercial success through consultative and prescriptive selling techniques.
  • Identify, qualify, and nurture high-potential business opportunities, including pilot projects, proof-of-concept (PoC) implementations, and full-scale rollout of Offer.
  • Collaborate with channel partners, system integrators, and EPC firms to develop joint go-to-market strategies.
  • Negotiate contracts, pricing structures, and long-term agreements to maximize revenue potential.

Market Development & Strategy Execution

  • Develop and execute a go-to-market strategy that positions Next Gen Automation as a disruptive open automation platform.
  • Align business development initiatives with global trends in industrial automation, Industry 4.0, and software-driven control systems.
  • Analyze customer pain points, competitor offerings, and emerging market trends to refine the value proposition and influence OEM’s, System Integrators and End Users to adopt Next Gen Automation platform.

Stakeholder Engagement, Influence & Prescription

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with engineering, operations, IT, and executive decision-makers to promote Next Gen Automation adoption at the customer.
  • Engage with C-level executives, plant managers, automation engineers, and IT-OT leaders to drive digital transformation initiatives.
  • Collaborate internally with lines of business, offer managers and other stakeholders to ensure the growth of Next Gen Automation.
  • Build a network of early adopters, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and reference customers to advocate for Next Gen Automation within the industry.
  • Support System Integrators and consultants to integrate Next Gen Automation into their project specifications.
  • Be the voice of the customer internally and to the LOB to influence roadmaps and provide market insights that will help grow Next Gen Automation
  • Segment Focus: Collaborate with segment teams to identify and penetrate strategic sub-segments and applications for Next Gen Automation.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Leadership

  • Work closely with Next Gen Automation COE (Center of excellence), product management, marketing, and customer success teams to align solutions with market needs.
  • Provide direct customer feedback to product development teams to enhance Next Gen Automation features, usability, and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Proposals, pre-sales specialists, solution specialists, and application specialists to develop and present tailored automation solutions to the customer using Next Gen Automation.
  • Be the subject matter expert on Next Gen Automation to the customer.

Education, Experience and Skills

  • Bachelor’ degree in Industrial Automation, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in consultative, technical solution sales – Essential to this role
  • A deep understanding of Industrial Automation and applications – Essential to this role
  • Experience with industrial control systems (ICS), PLC/SCADA, DCS, edge computing.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value propositions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: General Project Engineering - Entry Professional
job.description:
Job Description

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.) is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

Position Title:Deputy Manager – R&D (MV – ESE)

Work Location: Ahmednagar

Educational Qualification & Exp:B.E/ B.Tech (Mechanical/ Electrical) with 3 - 7 yrs of experience.

Key Deliverables

1) Design and development of medium voltage switchgears.

2) Providing technical expertise in product performance, and reliability.

3) Conducting Type tests as per IEC for MV products at third part labs like CPRI,ERDA,CESI., indepth knowledge of IEC std.

4) Conducting inhouse verification & validation for medium voltage equipment

5) Collaborating with cross-functional teams to successful completion of V&V activities.

6) Follow V&V program to ensure new package/product release to production within timeline.

Functional Competencies:

  • Develop and Implement V&V Plans: Create detailed verification and validation plans, including test strategies, test cases, and acceptance criteria, based on product requirements and specifications for MV switchgear up to 36kV.
  • Design and Execute Tests: Design, set up, and execute a wide range of tests, including but not limited to:
  • Type Tests: Hands On experience in Short-circuit withstand, lightning impulse withstand, power-frequency withstand, temperature rise, mechanical endurance, IP rating, etc., according to IEC and other relevant standards.
  • Routine Tests: Dielectric tests, resistance measurements, mechanical operation tests, etc.
  • Functional Tests: Operational performance, interlocking mechanisms, protection system functionality, etc.
  • Environmental Tests: Temperature cycling, humidity tests, vibration tests (as applicable).
  • Test Equipment and Instrumentation: Select, configure, and maintain test equipment and instrumentation required for accurate and reliable testing. Ensure proper calibration and functionality.
  • Data Acquisition and Analysis: Collect, record, and analyze test data. Prepare comprehensive test reports documenting the test setup, procedures, results, and any deviations or failures.
  • Identify and Resolve Issues: Investigate test failures, identify root causes, and work collaboratively with design and production teams to implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Standards Compliance: Ensure that all verification and validation activities are conducted in compliance with relevant national and international standards (e.g., IEC 62271 series), customer specifications, and internal quality procedures.
  • Documentation and Traceability: Maintain accurate and traceable records of all V&V activities, including plans, test procedures, test reports, and defect tracking.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including design engineers, production engineers, quality assurance, and sales/marketing, to ensure product quality and customer satisfaction.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for improving V&V processes and methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.

job.title: Senior Manager - Quality Control
job.description:
Job Description

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Assurance and Control Engineer to ensure compliance with IEC 61439 standards in low-voltage (LV) switchgear and control gear assemblies. The role involves hands-on testing, auditing panel builders, delivering training, and driving process improvements to maintain high-quality manufacturing standards. This position requires strong expertise in LV panel verification, quality management systems (QMS), and IEC compliance.

Designation: Senior Manager – Quality

Work Location: Bangalore / Delhi

Qualification: B.E. Electrical

Experience: 6-8 years

Key Deliverables / Key Responsibilities/Deliverables (Min 4 need to be filled in decreasing order of importance)

  • Conduct routine inspection of IEC 61439 panels at panel builder facilities, including in-process (manufacturing, wiring etc.) and final inspection (APFC, AHF, VFD, Soft Starter, PCC & MCC).
  • Perform QMS audits at panel builders to identify non-conformities, suggest corrective actions and ensure process traceability.
  • Provide training to panel builders on quality systems, IEC 61439 requirements, panel testing protocols, and best practices in LV assembly.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyse data and perform root cause analysis for product & process improvement.
  • Support panel builders with customer inspections/ interactions for LV panel inspection.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering.
  • Min 5 years of experience in quality assurance/control within LV electrical panels or switchgear industry, with direct exposure to IEC 61439 testing and verification.
  • Certification in quality tools (e.g., Six Sigma Green Belt, ISO 9001) preferred.

Key Skills and Competencies:

  • Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of IEC 61439 standards (routine, type, and design verification testing); proficiency in LV components (MCCBs, ACBs, Relays, switchgear, busbars etc.); hands-on experience with electrical testing equipment (e.g., dielectric testers, temperature rise testers).
  • Quality Management: Expertise in QMS auditing, 8D problem-solving, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation.
  • Testing & Auditing: Skilled in on-site panel testing protocols, process audits, and non-conformance reporting.
  • Training & Communication: Ability to deliver technical training sessions; strong presentation and documentation skills for reports and SOPs.

Soft Skills:

  • Analytical mindset, attention to detail, ability to work independently at remote sites
  • Proficiency in MS Office, quality software (e.g., Minitab), and ERP systems.

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with surface finishing (e.g., powder coating, plating), industrial safety standards.

What's in it for you:

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge manufacturing equipment and technologies
  • Professional growth through handling complex quality control challenges
  • Collaborative environment with cross-functional teams
  • Impact on product excellence and manufacturing efficiency
  • Career advancement opportunities in quality management

job.title: Cyber Security Architect - Senior Professional
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

Position: Deputy General Manager – Product Security (Security Advisor)

Location: Navi Mumbai (Mahape) Experience: 12–15 Years Qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech (Computer Science / IT / related discipline)

Role Overview

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation is seeking an experienced Product Security Advisor to lead and drive Security by Design and Shift-Left Security initiatives across connected products and platforms. This role is responsible for adoption, governance, and execution of Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices in line with IEC 62443-4-1, advising R&D and product teams on cybersecurity architecture, secure implementation, and regulatory compliance.

The role combines deep technical expertise, process ownership, and assertive stakeholder engagement, ensuring cybersecurity requirements are embedded from early design through product release.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product & Secure Development Lifecycle Leadership
  • Act as Subject Matter Expert (SME) to ensure cybersecurity is prioritized and embedded in offer/product development from concept and design phase onward.
  • Drive implementation of Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL) practices aligned with IEC 62443-4-1, including:

o Threat modeling

o Secure design and architecture

o Secure coding practices

o Security testing and validation

  • Support development teams in risk-driven cybersecurity decision-making throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Security Governance & Compliance
  • Ensure adherence to IEC 62443 standards, including exposure to:

o IEC 62443-4-2 (Product Security Requirements)

o IEC 62443-3-3 (System Security Requirements)

  • Support internal SDL audits, cybersecurity reviews, and regulatory compliance activities.

General

  • Advise on regulatory, data protection, and privacy requirements for connected products and cloud-based offers.
  • Represent product development teams in Business Unit, PSO, and corporate cybersecurity forums.
  • Technical Advisory & Risk Management
  • Provide expert guidance on:

o Threat modeling (STRIDE and equivalent frameworks)

o Risk analysis and CVSS scoring

o Vulnerability triage, remediation, and closure

  • Support teams in maintaining secure software environments, including:

oSecure coding

o Static code analysis

o Software Composition Analysis (SCA)

o Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)

  • Advise on DevSecOps practices and secure CI/CD pipelines. Metrics, Maturity & Continuous Improvement
  • Define and collect SDL and cybersecurity metrics to support data-driven security strategies.
  • Monitor and improve organizational maturity using Cybersecurity Maturity Frameworks.
  • Track SDL effectiveness, risk posture, and security KPIs and report to R&D leadership.

Training, Awareness & Community Engagement

  • Conduct cybersecurity training sessions, workshops, and awareness programs for development and architecture teams.
  • Actively participate in internal and external cybersecurity communities and stay updated on emerging threats, standards, and regulations.
  • Continuously update leadership on relevant cybersecurity trends, policies, and legislative changes.

Key Technical & Functional Competencies

Strong expertise in Product Security and Cloud Security

In-depth understanding of OT & IoT technologies, protocols, and architectures

Hands-on experience with:

o Secure Development Lifecycle (IEC 62443-4-1 or equivalent)

o Threat modeling and security testing

o Secure design and secure coding

o Vulnerability management and risk-driven security

Strong knowledge of:

o IEC 62443, NIST frameworks

o Data protection, privacy screening, and data security

o Cybersecurity maturity models and governance frameworks

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field

12–15 years total experience in engineering/product organizations

8+ years in Product Security / Cloud Security

Minimum 5+ years hands-on experience with IEC 62443-based product security

Exposure to IEC 62443 certification activities (4-2 and 3-3)

Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Azure Security certifications are highly desirable

Preferred Industry Experience

Power Distribution

Energy Management

Water & Utilities

Oil & Gas

Industrial Automation / OT environments

job.title: Senior Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description

In Schneider Electric everything we do promotes progress and sustainability for all — our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies where we live and work. From the products, software, and services driving the digital transformation of energy management and automation to corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make an impact by helping people and organizations become more resilient and efficient, more electric and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

This position is for a Senior Project Manager (Packages Leader) in Singapore, you will be directly responsible for the end-to-end execution, financial health, contractual integrity, and technical validation of all independent product lines or packages dedicated to hyper-scale data center projects. You will act as the core driving force of the country execution team, managing complex engineering systems, strict rolling financial forecasts, and high-stakes risk frameworks while leading cross-functional teams and regional manufacturing partners to achieve successful delivery timelines.

What will you do?

1. Cross-Product Package Execution & Delivery:Direct the localized deployment, installation, and final site handover for all core product types, ensuring individual component packages seamlessly integrate into the overall site architecture:

  • Modular Power Train Units (PTU) & Enclosures: Oversee the delivery, structural positioning, and subsystem integration of modular power skids and prefabricated plant enclosures, encompassing heavy structural frames, main power modules, integrated Low Voltage (LV) distribution cabinets, Cooling System, UPS and Lithium-ion battery containment systems.
  • Critical Cooling Systems: Execute specialized thermal management and precision cooling infrastructure packages, encompassing liquid-to-liquid Coolant Distribution Units (CDU), high-airflow Fan Wall Units (FWU), close-coupled In-Row cooling units, and outdoor heat rejection or specialized cooling modules.
  • Power Busway Distribution: Drive the deployment of high-capacity electrical busway tracking systems, including high-amperage perimeter busway runs, intelligent overhead Tap-Off Boxes (TOB), and flexible row-based track busway solutions.
  • Medium & Low Voltage (MV/LV) Switchgear: Lead the execution and delivery of primary substation and power distribution packages, including Medium Voltage Ring Main Units (RMU), distribution transformers, integrated feeder sets, and modular, type-tested Low Voltage switchboard assemblies.

2. End-to-End Quality Governance via the CXL (Data Center Commissioning) Framework:Govern the entire lifecycle of all equipment packages using the structured Data Center Commissioning Levels (CXL) framework, tracking progression across all execution stages.

  • Level 1 (L1) – Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT): Partner with regional manufacturing hubs to monitor factory-level assembly, QA/QC testing, and witness compliance audits prior to equipment release.
  • Level 2 (L2) – Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) & Delivery: Oversee the logistics pipeline, on-site reception, visual equipment inspections, proper staging, and structural positioning of components on-site.
  • Level 3 (L3) – Pre-Commissioning / Static Verification: Lead the component-level static checks, de-energized inspections, insulation testing, and early quality verification to ready all systems for power-on.
  • Level 4 (L4) – Functional Performance Testing (FPT): Drive isolated dynamic operations and system-level functional checks under specific operating profiles to validate design compliance.
  • Level 5 (L5) – Integrated Systems Testing (IST) & Handover: Orchestrate full-scale facility failure simulations (e.g., loss of utility power, load-bank testing) to ensure total system interoperability and achieve formal client sign-off.

Project Finance & Rolling Forecasts

  • Financial Accountability: Assume full ownership of the package profit and loss (P&L), ensuring execution remains strictly within budgeted Capex allocations across all product tracks.
  • Rolling Forecast Management: Establish and maintain dynamic monthly rolling forecasts for package expenditures, cash flow, resource utilization, and milestone billing.
  • Revenue Optimization: Track local vendor invoicing, manage payment milestones, and proactively drive timely project collections to maximize cash flow metrics.

Contractual Management & Governance

  • Contract Compliance: Administer and enforce all commercial contracts with regional supply chains and local subcontractors, protecting the business from scope creep and potential liabilities.
  • Variation & Claim Management: Robustly manage variation orders (VOs), change notices, and potential claims, ensuring proper documentation, technical evaluation, and commercial positioning.

Strong Risk Management

  • Risk Mitigation: Implement a comprehensive risk management framework spanning the entire multi-factory supply chain down to the local project site.
  • Predictive Issue Resolution: Proactively identify, quantify, and mitigate technical, financial, and logistical risks before they impact the critical path or client capacity deadlines.

Leadership & Team Mobilization

  • Drive & Motivation: Act as a high-energy leader capable of motivating, inspiring, and unifying diverse cross-functional teams, factory production heads, engineering experts, and contractors toward a singular execution vision.
  • Matrix Alignment: Establish clear accountability, high performance standards, and collaboration channels to break down silos across internal and external stakeholder groups.

What qualifications will make you successful?

Education

  • Bachelors Degree in engineering or higher
  • PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent professional project management certification is preferred.

Working Experience

  • 10-15 years working experience preferred.
  • Significant project management experience focusing on the simultaneous execution, financial tracking, and commissioning delivery of highly technical multi-product engineering packages.
  • Must have 5-8 years proven track record in high-stakes critical infrastructure sectors (e.g., Hyper-scale Data Centers).
  • Demonstrated success in managing substantial package budgets, navigating complex commercial contracts, and handling rigorous corporate financial reporting.

Business Understanding

  • Deep technical familiarity with data center modular architectures, power distribution systems, industrial thermal solutions, and switchgear packages.
  • Strong proficiency in project financial controlling, earned value management, and building accurate rolling financial forecasts.
  • Practical experience executing governance frameworks across supply chain, commercial, and engineering boundaries (such as the Data Center Commissioning framework process).

Others

  • Strong customer focus
  • Negotiation and influencing skills
  • Analytical skills
  • Able to animate technical experts’ community
  • Listening and communication skills

Rewards designed for you

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential.
