job.title: Senior Manager, System and Architecture Design-Cooling
job.description:
Job Description

MISSION

The Principal Architect – Mechanical/cooling is the discipline authority for cooling and thermal systems across all presales engagements. This role owns cooling standards, reference architectures, and capability development for the zone. The PA-Mechanical manages a pool of 8–12 SAM specialists, allocates their time between account work (70%) and standards/innovation work (30%), and ensures technical quality across all cooling designs submitted in bids. The role is accountable for cooling solution excellence, standards enforcement, specialist development, and the continuous evolution of cooling capabilities in response to market innovation (especially AI DC thermal management).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Discipline Standards & Architecture

  • Define and maintain cooling reference architectures for all datacenter segments and technologies
  • Set Tier 1 non-negotiable standards: ASHRAE compliance, safety, environmental controls
  • Define Tier 2 efficiency standards: PUE contribution from cooling, WUE targets, free-cooling strategies
  • Review all qualifying bids for cooling scope: quality gate approval/rework authority
  • Document standards exceptions and manage deviation approvals
  • Evolve standards based on market feedback and emerging technologies: AI DC, immersion cooling, liquid cooling innovation

SAM Pool Management & Resource Allocation

  • Manage 8–12 SAM specialists: hiring, performance management, development, retention
  • Allocate SAM time: protect 30% for standards/innovation; manage account requests beyond 70%
  • Approve/deny staffing requests from SSAs based on capacity and priorities
  • Track capacity and forecast for bid planning
  • Manage SAM performance and development

Cooling Capability & Innovation

  • Lead SAM 30% standards time: new cooling architectures, liquid cooling playbooks, AI DC thermal design patterns
  • Drive cooling capability roadmap: what new technologies/products should we develop (immersion, 2-phase, high-temp cooling)
  • Evaluate and qualify OG cooling products: CDU partners, immersion platforms, next-gen chillers
  • Build standardized cooling modules: primary plant configs, chilled water distribution patterns, CDU sizing playbooks
  • Track AI DC thermal innovation: GPU cluster cooling requirements, warm water interfaces, immersion feasibility
  • Lead SAM community: knowledge sharing, mentoring, innovation forums

Quality Assurance & Governance

  • Review all submitted bid designs for cooling scope: first-pass quality gate
  • Issue rework notices for designs not meeting standards
  • Escalate ASHRAE/compliance violations to Technical Sales, Offers & Solutions Leader
  • Participate in Technical Architecture Council: advise on cooling trade-offs, constraints, integration points
  • Advise Technical Sales, Offers & Solutions Leader on standards exceptions and overrides
  • Track override log: identify trends and update standards/messaging

Strategic & Market Leadership

  • Engage with strategic accounts: technical relationships with hyperscaler cooling engineering teams
  • Competitive intelligence: track competitor cooling architectures, inform strategy
  • Collaborate with Product Management and cooling OG partners: align portfolio with market needs
  • Technical representation: industry events, standards bodies, customer advisory boards

BE/Btech/MBA

job.title: General Manager - Production Planning and Control
job.description:
Job Description

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.) is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

Job Title : General Manager –Production Planning & Control (PPC)

Experience – 15 -20 years

Education-

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline.
  • MBA / PGDM in Operations Management or Supply Chain Management preferred.

Location: LK Factory, Ahmednagar

Department: Production Planning & Control

Job Purpose

To lead and manage end-to-end Production Planning & Control functions for the plant by ensuring optimum production scheduling, resource utilization, inventory management, customer delivery performance, and cross-functional coordination. The role is responsible for aligning manufacturing operations with customer demand, business objectives, and operational excellence initiatives while ensuring inventory optimization and supply chain efficiency.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Production Planning & Scheduling

  • Develop annual, monthly, weekly, and daily production plans based on sales forecasts and customer requirements.
  • Ensure optimum machine loading and capacity utilization across manufacturing departments.
  • Monitor production adherence against plan and take corrective actions to address deviations.
  • Balance demand and capacity to achieve desired service levels and manufacturing efficiency.

Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)

  • Lead S&OP reviews with Sales, Marketing, Procurement, Production, and Finance teams.
  • Ensure effective demand planning and conversion into executable production plans.
  • Identify constraints and recommend mitigation plans.

Inventory Management

  • Drive inventory optimization of Raw Materials, WIP, Bought-out Components, and Finished Goods.
  • Establish inventory norms and monitor compliance.
  • Reduce excess, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory.
  • Ensure uninterrupted material availability for production.

Customer Delivery Management

  • Ensure achievement of OTIF (On-Time In-Full) delivery targets.
  • Monitor customer order fulfillment and dispatch schedules.
  • Coordinate with logistics and supply chain teams for timely deliveries.

Material Planning & Procurement Coordination

  • Collaborate with Procurement and Supply Chain teams to ensure availability of materials and components.
  • Review material shortages and expedite critical supplies.
  • Manage risk associated with supply disruptions.

Capacity & Resource Planning

  • Conduct capacity analysis and identify bottlenecks.
  • Recommend investments, outsourcing, or process improvements to meet growing demand.
  • Optimize manpower and equipment utilization.

Production Control & Monitoring

  • Review daily production performance and adherence to schedules.
  • Analyze production losses and implement corrective actions.
  • Establish robust production control systems and MIS reporting.

ERP & Digitalization

  • Drive effective utilization of ERP systems for planning and inventory management.
  • Implement digital dashboards and analytics for real-time monitoring.
  • Improve data accuracy and planning effectiveness.

Continuous Improvement

  • Lead Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, and productivity improvement initiatives.
  • Improve inventory turns, order fulfilment rates, and planning accuracy.
  • Drive cross-functional process improvements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the PPC team.
  • Establish performance goals and succession planning.
  • Coach and mentor planning professionals for future leadership roles.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Delivery & Customer Service

  • OTIF Delivery Performance (%)
  • Customer Service Level (%)
  • Schedule Adherence (%)

Planning Effectiveness

  • Production Plan Adherence (%)
  • Forecast Accuracy (%)
  • Capacity Utilization (%)

Inventory Management

  • Inventory Turns
  • Inventory Days
  • Raw Material Coverage Days
  • WIP Reduction (%)
  • Obsolete Inventory Reduction (%)

Productivity

  • Manufacturing Throughput
  • Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) Support
  • Planning Cycle Time

Financial

  • Working Capital Reduction
  • Inventory Carrying Cost Reduction
  • Cost Savings through Planning Optimization

Experience

  • 18 to 25 years of experience in Manufacturing Operations, PPC, Supply Chain, or Industrial Engineering.
  • Minimum 8 years in a senior managerial leadership role.
  • Experience in large-scale manufacturing environments.
  • Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent.

Required Competencies

Functional Competencies

  • Production Planning & Scheduling
  • Demand Forecasting
  • Inventory Management
  • Supply Chain Management
  • Capacity Planning
  • S&OP Process Management
  • ERP Systems
  • Lean Manufacturing
  • Data Analytics & MIS

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Decision Making
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Team Development
  • Change Management
  • Problem Solving
  • Results Orientation

What's in it for me?

  • High-impact role where your expertise shapes supply chain strategy and customer outcomes

job.title: Manager Process Automation and IT
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Automation System Design & Implementation

  • Design and develop automation solutions using PLC, DCS, and SCADA systems
  • Prepare control philosophies, functional design specifications (FDS), and detailed engineering documents
  • Configure and program PLCs (Siemens, Allen-Bradley, Schneider, etc.)
  • Develop HMI/SCADA screens for process visualization and control

2. Project Execution

  • Execute automation projects from concept to commissioning
  • Vendor coordination and review of engineering deliverables
  • Conduct FAT (Factory Acceptance Test) and SAT (Site Acceptance Test)
  • Ensure adherence to project schedules, quality, and safety standards

3. Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Provide support for existing automation systems
  • Diagnose and resolve PLC/DCS/SCADA-related issues
  • Perform periodic system health checks and preventive maintenance
  • Implement system upgrades and modifications

4. Process Optimization

  • Analyze process performance and implement automation improvements
  • Reduce downtime and increase plant efficiency through control strategies
  • Integrate advanced control techniques where applicable

5. Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain technical documentation (loop diagrams, P&IDs, IO lists)
  • Ensure compliance with industrial standards and safety regulations
  • Support audits and regulatory inspections

6. Safety & Cybersecurity

  • Implement safety interlocks and fail-safe mechanisms
  • Ensure secure industrial network architecture
  • Follow cybersecurity best practices for OT systems

Required Skills & Competencies

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience in PLC/DCS/SCADA systems
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus, Profibus, Ethernet/IP, OPC)
  • Hands-on programming experience (Ladder Logic, Function Block, SFC)
  • Understanding of instrumentation (flow, pressure, temperature, control valves)
  • Basic knowledge of electrical systems and panel design
  • Familiarity with MES/IIoT systems is an advantage

What's in it for me?

  • Lead high-impact automation projects that directly improve manufacturing performance
  • Access to ongoing technical training, certifications, and career development opportunities
  • Collaborative team environment where innovation and continuous improvement are valued
  • Growth potential within a technical career track that rewards specialized expertise

Bring your automation expertise to a team that's ready to innovate with you!

job.title: Manager -Maintenance
job.description:
Job Description

Join our dynamic maintenance team and be at the forefront of keeping our manufacturing operations running smoothly and efficiently! We're looking for a skilled Repair & Maintenance Professional to help drive excellence in our facility operations.

Role Purpose

The Maintenance Supervisor is responsible for planning, directing, and monitoring all preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities to ensure optimal performance, reliability, and availability of plant equipment, machinery, and facilities. The role ensures alignment with safety, quality, cost, and operational efficiency objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Maintenance Operations

  • Lead and manage all maintenance activities including preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance.
  • Ensure maximum equipment availability and reliability across production lines.
  • Develop and implement maintenance strategies to maintain equipment in optimal condition.
  • Monitor key performance indicators such as OEE, MTBF, and MTTR. [[IIT5_Maint...upervision | PDF]](https://schneiderelectric-my.sharepoint.com/personal/sesa745690_se_com/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/IIT5_Maintenance%20Supervision.pdf)

People Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop the maintenance team.
  • Drive performance management, goal setting, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Build team capability through structured training and competency development.

Safety & Compliance

  • Enforce health, safety, and environmental standards.
  • Promote and embed 5S and safe working practices across maintenance operations. [[IIT5_Maint...upervision | PDF]](https://schneiderelectric-my.sharepoint.com/personal/sesa745690_se_com/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/IIT5_Maintenance%20Supervision.pdf)
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and organizational safety frameworks.

Maintenance Planning & Execution

  • Define, prioritize, and execute maintenance plans in alignment with production requirements.
  • Coordinate with manufacturing teams to minimize downtime and ensure continuity.
  • Support installation and ramp-up of new equipment, production lines, or workstations. [[IIT5_Maint...upervision | PDF]](https://schneiderelectric-my.sharepoint.com/personal/sesa745690_se_com/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/IIT5_Maintenance%20Supervision.pdf)

Continuous Improvement

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean, TPM, and other methodologies.
  • Enhance reliability and availability of equipment through structured problem-solving.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce maintenance costs and improve efficiency.

Technical & Asset Management

  • Ensure proper preservation and management of all tools and equipment.
  • Manage maintenance budgets, including optimization of spare parts inventory. [[IIT5_Maint...upervision | PDF]](https://schneiderelectric-my.sharepoint.com/personal/sesa745690_se_com/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/IIT5_Maintenance%20Supervision.pdf)
  • Provide technical expertise for equipment capability and manufacturing processes.
  • Support introduction and standardization of new technologies.

Systems & Data Management

  • Maintain and ensure accurate data in the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System). [[IIT5_Maint...upervision | PDF]](https://schneiderelectric-my.sharepoint.com/personal/sesa745690_se_com/Documents/Microsoft%20Copilot%20Chat%20Files/IIT5_Maintenance%20Supervision.pdf)
  • Track maintenance activities, asset history, and performance metrics.
  • Support business continuity planning related to equipment and tooling.

Supply Chain & Facilities Coordination

  • Optimize maintenance-related supply chain processes.
  • Ensure efficient coordination for spare parts procurement and inventory.
  • Where applicable, support facility management initiatives including energy optimization and sustainability.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Manufacturing Maintenance & Reliability Engineering
  • Maintenance Planning & Execution
  • Continuous Improvement (TPM, Lean, Kaizen)
  • Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
  • Digital Tools & CMMS
  • Change Management
  • Manufacturing Diagnostics & Problem Solving
  • Leadership & Team Management
  • Stakeholder Management & Influence
  • Customer Focus

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (or related field).
  • 5–10+ years of experience in maintenance within manufacturing/industrial environments.
  • Proven experience in managing maintenance teams and plant equipment.
  • Strong knowledge of CMMS, ERP systems, and maintenance KPIs.
  • Proficiency in English (intermediate/advanced level).

Success Metrics

  • Equipment availability and uptime
  • Maintenance cost optimization
  • Reduction in downtime and breakdowns
  • Safety compliance and incident reduction
  • Improvement in OEE, MTBF, MTTR
  • Team engagement and capability development

job.title: DGM - Supplier Quality
job.description:
Job overview

The DGM - Supply Quality is responsible for ensuring that all incoming materials and components from suppliers meet quality standards and specifications, while also actively engaging in supplier collaboration and qualification to enhance overall supply chain quality. Additionally, the role involves fostering customer satisfaction, driving impact in sustainability, contributes to the supplier strategy and leveraging digital tools to optimize quality processes.

Mission

•Identify day-to-day non-quality factors, conduct or have other departments conduct in-depth analyses and monitor quality improvement plans at suppliers.

•Identify potential issues before they occur and implement preventive solutions.

•Lead quality issue resolution through containment, correction and prevention steps and check effectiveness of suppliers’ actions.

•Conduct process audits at suppliers and launch improvement action plans to help them develop their quality performance.

•Follow and act as per Corporate Schneider Supplier Quality Management (SSQM) guideline applying Schneider Performance System (SPS) card 9A (Supplier Quality) requirements

Key responsibilities

Pilot the Part/Product Qualification Process and manage Supplier performance at the level of the plant, with a coordination role (hierarchical or functional) of quality supply assurance engineers

Actively apply and is involved in Supplier Qualification Process

•Manage the sustainability recovery of his plant panel of suppliers

Main activities

•Pilot the containment, corrective and preventives actions to solve the technical part quality issues of the plant using the 8D methodology.

•Address gaps and noncompliance to the suppliers and check the effectiveness of the supplier actions

Manage supplier roadblocks with Supplier and the support of the Regional Supplier Quality Developer (RSQD), Plant Procurement Manager (PPM), Schneider Supplier Leader (SSL), when needed (Plant Supman/Quality review meeting)

•Pilot the qualification of the part through the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) ) within the Optimize process and participate actively to the

APQP/PPAP with Offer LifeCycle Management (OLM) specifically during the responsibility transfer milestone

Enforce the incoming inspection according to Procedure ProQ_GL06 and optimize it manage the incoming inspection dynamic rules (when applicable in the organization structure)

•Monitor supplier quality performance at the plant level, reports it and manage Most impacting Quality Suppliers actions (Plant Supman/Quality review meeting)

oLevel 0 and level 1 – lead 8D (PRB evaluation), Temporary Quality Wall implementation

oLevel 2 - Contribute with RSQD to SE Process audit, pFMEA evaluation

oBuild annual audit plan

oLead continuous improvement projects

•Manage the Supplier Qualification status and the tool status in a partnership with Tooling & Technology experts

•Lead the End to End PPEP PPAP flow, ensuring PSW signed before mass production

•Manage Suppliers e-derogations in Supplier Process Change Notification (SPCN) animation when plant is impacted

Lead and execute SAM Audits when possible and follow the SAM supplier status Supplier Quality qualification process to assure improvement the plant spplier panel

•Management (hierarchical or functional) of the Quality control Multi Skilled operators (QCS),

•Manage his team according to SPS / SIM rules and cycle event of the plant

Interactions

CS&Q Manager, Manufacturing change owner (MCO)/Technical Antenna (TA), Material Provide Leader (MPL), Upstream Flow supervisor (UFS), Quality Control Skilled operator (QCS)/Incoming inspector

Advanced Supplier Quality (ASQ), Regional Supplier Quality Developer (RSQD), Line of Business (LoB) SQUAD, Schneider Supplier Leader (SSL), Plant Procurement manager (PPM), Schneider Tool supervisor (STS), Supplier, Customer Quality & Satisfaction Excellence team

Required skills

•Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

•Quality improvement tools, techniques & models

oSE Procurement and Quality Systems related to Supplier Quality management

•ERP system

•Statistical quality techniques and analysis

Education

•Graduated engineer

•English B2 (refer CEFR)

•>5 years relevant experience - Supplier Quality Management work

job.title: Business Offer Manager (SG)
job.description:
About the Role (Mission)**

Schneider Electric is seeking aBusiness Offer Manager for Motor Management Solutions, Source Management, and Low Voltage Systems, to drive the market success, competitiveness, and adoption of these portfolios across key customer segments. The role combines deep technical understanding with strong commercial acumen to ensure our solutions are properly positioned, prescribed, and selected by consultants, end users, and ecosystem partners. This includes shaping the offer strategy, influencing specifications, enabling sales teams, and coordinating closely with channel partners and internal functions to maximize project wins as well as monitoring market trends, competitive movements, and customer needs to refine value propositions and support business growth. Ultimately, the role ensures our offers deliver the right performance, safety, and efficiency outcomes for customers while contributing strongly to the company’s growth ambitions.

What will you do?

  • Lead the L ow V oltage systems,s ource management solutions and motor management portfolios for the Singapore market
  • Act as the primary business interface advocate and decision maker for product marketing strategy and execution
  • Develop and implement the annual marketing plan and/or strategic plans to push product,solution and services
  • Elaborate offer pricing strategy,monitor its implementation, control the results
  • Work closely with the sales managers in order to ensure that the strategic objectives are achieved
  • Conduct market research and business development
  • Create the data-driven decision-making processes in the product marketing sphere (pricing, stock management, competition analysis)
  • Deliver training and presentations for internal and external audiences
  • Hold products’ launch and products’ withdrawal processes

  • 8+years of experience in marketing in the B2B field, strong knowledge in pricing and offer management, business development skills

job.title: Senior Engineer I - Electronics Hardware Test
job.description:
Job Description

Join our validation team as a Senior Electronics Hardware Test Engineer and play a critical role in ensuring our products meet rigorous quality and compliance standards. You'll lead testing initiatives across diverse electronics domains while driving innovation in test methodologies and automation.

What will you do?

  • Create and execute validation plans that ensure electronic hardware quality across analog, digital, power, EMC, and RF systems
  • Build automated test environments and testbenches to efficiently identify design issues and verify performance
  • Perform functional, environmental, and compliance testing to meet regulatory requirements and industry standards
  • Mentor team members and provide technical leadership on complex validation challenges

What are the key skills we are looking for?

  • Electronics— intermediate level; validating hardware systems across analog, digital, power, and RF domains
  • Test Automation— intermediate level; building automated test frameworks to improve efficiency and coverage
  • Debugging— intermediate level; identifying and resolving hardware issues through systematic analysis
  • Testbench Development— intermediate level; designing test setups that accurately simulate real-world conditions
  • Design For Testing— intermediate level; ensuring hardware designs support effective validation strategies
  • Environmental Compliance Assessment— intermediate level; verifying products meet regulatory and industry standards
  • Troubleshooting— intermediate level; diagnosing complex hardware failures and implementing corrective actions
  • Critical Thinking— intermediate level; analyzing test results to drive design improvements

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • Strong problem-solving abilities with a track record of resolving complex technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills to partner effectively with cross-functional engineering teams
  • Natural leadership qualities with experience guiding others through technical obstacles
  • Creative approach to developing innovative test methods that push validation boundaries

What's in it for me?

  • Direct impact on product quality and reliability that reaches customers worldwide

job.title: Enterprise Key Account Manager
job.description:
Job Description

The Key Account Manager (KAM) is a significant technical sales leadership role managing the relationship with nominated Country targeted, Multi country targeted and strategic Account(s) across the region in India.

The KAM will be expected to develop strong relationships within existing named accounts or account. It is therefore essential that this person has extensive experience of identifying and influencing senior key decision makers, up to C Level within the account and Specifiers & Contractors that the account relies upon for its DC construction activity. The KAM will be instrumental in developing, implementing, and managing the commercial strategy for the Data Centre Enterprise Service Provider and Colocation segments at Schneider Electric.

This position will lead the selling complex solutions strategy into the targeted accounts. As the opportunity leader, they will need to work seamlessly throughout the Zone with the country organizations and other divisions and build a committed network of sales and technical professionals to help best address the customer needs. In addition, they will take ownership of large project pursuit, driving the sales cycle (from presales through tendering and execution) and aligning internal/external partners and key resources.

This role will be selling the complete portfolio of Schneider Electric by working across our different business units / Divisions. Experience of selling within a matrix organisation is essential and good internal stakeholder management will also be important.

This role requires a deep understanding of the Hyperscale Datacenter and Colocation Segments and the key business drivers, a strong appreciation and understanding of key technologies involved and extensive knowledge of the market’s value chain. They will need to be seen an expert to lead the team members to successful client engagement. Importantly the KAM must be able to translate his knowledge into a business language and fluently articulate it within a client environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop Relationships with key Decision makers within nominated Account(s) and associated ecosystem of consultants and contractors
  • Develop Mechanical, Electrical & Building Automation Infrastructure Data Center business opportunities related to Schneider Electric's EcoStruxure for Data Centers offer
  • Become the opportunity leader for identified major projects, leading a virtual team and add value to ensure a successful outcome
  • Process and analyze feasibility assessments for all bid/contract documents related to developed opportunities
  • Build a strong working relationship with the Divisions and Country leadership to develop and drive an account winning strategy
  • Build strong relationships within all relevant countries within the Region, and lead the Sales, Presales, Tendering and Execution professionals to best address the customer needs
  • Develop the Strategic Account Plan/Strategy and roll it out across the Region.
  • Consult with customers and shape opportunities to optimize the value we offer
  • Map key decision makers at customers or prescribers
  • Follow Customer Project Process (CPP) follow Best In Sales Practice and be best in class for account profiling and record keeping in our CRM system.

Commercial experience

  • Demonstrates deep technical sales (direct and indirect) experience
  • Strong track record of capability to manage and grow large accounts
  • Understanding of account management, customers, sales channels & third parties
  • Demonstrates significant experience in detecting and discussing industry and customer pain points and proposing high value solutions
  • Proven knowledge of building automation, mechanical systems, electrical distribution, critical power, and associated services.

Leadership

  • Ability to mobilize and manage networks / remote and virtual team
  • Ability to navigate complex matrix organizations in multicultural environment
  • Ability to understand and animate complex ecosystem of influencers
  • Strong initiative, self-starter and highly organized

Communication and Interpersonal skills

  • Successful track-record in establishing local customer intimacy through connections at Executives level and key decision makers within the customer organization
  • A strong ability to understand complex requirements, able to clearly communicate client needs, challenge the client on solutions and translate solutions to business value.
  • Able to politically navigate through an organization; balancing interactions with the Key Decision Maker and reaching senior executive / C-Level ranks
  • Strong influencing skills and intercultural skills
  • Tenacity, resilience, emotional intelligence

Engineering / Master's degree

job.title: Engineer I, Embededd Software Test
job.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Firmware Verification and Validation Engineer to join our team. As a Firmware Verification and Validation Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our firmware used in UPS systems. Your primary responsibility will be to design, implement, and execute test strategies and plans to validate firmware functionality, performance, and adherence to specifications. Your expertise will contribute to identifying and resolving firmware-related issues, ensuring the smooth operation of our products throughout their lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the firmware development team to define comprehensive test strategies that cover functional, performance, and reliability aspects of the firmware.
  • Design and create detailed test plans, including test cases and test scripts, based on firmware requirements and specifications.
  • Execute tests on target hardware platforms, ensuring the proper functioning and compatibility of firmware with the hardware.
  • Develop and maintain test automation frameworks and scripts to optimize testing efficiency and enhance test coverage, with a focus on automated system firmware testing.
  • Identify, investigate, and report firmware defects using issue tracking systems, such as JIRA, and proficiently manage the end-to-end defect lifecycle.
  • Work closely with the development team to prioritize and resolve identified issues, providing timely feedback and updates to stakeholders.
  • Analyse and debug firmware issues using appropriate debugging tools, such as oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and software debugging tools.
  • Analyse test results and provide meaningful feedback to the firmware development team, suggesting improvements and optimizations for enhanced firmware performance and stability.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation related to test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test reports.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including firmware developers, hardware engineers, quality assurance teams, and product managers, to ensure a comprehensive verification and validation process.
  • Continuously research and explore emerging testing methodologies, tools, and technologies to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of firmware verification and validation processes, particularly in the field of automated system firmware testing.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication, Embedded system, Electrical /Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in embedded systems firmware testing and verification.

Required Skills

  • Proven experience in firmware verification and validation in the embedded systems domain.
  • Solid understanding of firmware development principles, including knowledge of programming languages such as C/C++ for embedded systems.
  • Proficiency in test methodologies, test case design, and test automation frameworks, with specific experience in automated system firmware testing.
  • Familiarity with hardware testing tools, such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG debuggers.
  • Knowledge of software development tools, such as integrated development environments (IDEs) and version control systems.
  • Knowledge of integrating data loggers, power analyzers, and other relevant test equipment to automate system testing for power electronics products.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python for test automation and analysis.
  • Experience with LabVIEW for hardware-in-the-loop testing and automated test system development.
  • Strong JIRA management skills, including the ability to create, manage, and track issues, defects, and project tasks efficiently.

Let us learn about you! Apply today.

Job Description

Senior Identity, Access & Microsoft 365 Technical Lead

The Senior Identity, Access & Microsoft 365 Technical Lead is responsible for the administration, security, governance, and operational support of Vertiv's Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Microsoft 365 environments. This role serves as the technical lead for Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Microsoft 365 services, privileged access management, identity governance, automation, compliance, and cloud security initiatives.

This position provides advanced technical leadership for enterprise identity platforms, Microsoft cloud technologies, user lifecycle management, access governance, security controls, and operational support while partnering closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Service Desk, Engineering, Compliance, and business stakeholders.

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Okta, Sailpoint, identity governance, hybrid identity, automation, and cloud security, with a strong focus on operational excellence, customer service, compliance, and continuous improvement. The role combines responsibilities from both IAM and M365 technical leadership functions.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management and Microsoft 365 administration.
  • 3+ years of experience implementing or administering SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC), or equivalent Identity Governance platform.

  • Okta
  • Active Directory
  • ServiceNow
  • HR platforms
  • Enterprise applications
  • Experience with user access certifications, entitlement reviews, role management, and governance processes.

job.title: Construction Manager, MY
job.description:
Job Description

Your role

As a Construction Manager, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing the planning, coordination, and execution of construction projects related to data centre facilities. You will be responsible for ensuring the successful completion of projects within budget and on schedule, while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and client satisfaction.

The Digital Realty Construction Manager is responsible for the planning, coordination, and oversight of the construction of our facilities which range from full builds to fit-outs, upgrades, landing stations or infrastructure. This includes managing budgets, schedules, and resources, as well as ensuring that projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest Safety & quality standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of data centre construction principles and practices, as well as excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

In addition, this role will assist with improving the conception, definition and execution of our construction projects and be based on site full time whilst maintaining best practices as well as clear roles & responsibilities for any consultant support.

The primary purpose of the role will ensure consistent, efficient, predictable, timely and high-quality execution of our construction projects.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of data center construction projects, including new builds, fit-outs, upgrades, and infrastructure projects.
  • Develop and manage project plans, budgets, schedules, resources, and performance metrics to ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants, vendors, and customers to align project objectives and execution plans.
  • Oversee all phases of construction, from design development and procurement through construction, commissioning, and project closeout.
  • Champion a strong safety culture by partnering with Health & Safety teams and ensuring compliance with all safety requirements and standards.
  • Monitor project progress, manage risks, resolve issues, and drive corrective actions to maintain schedule, budget, and quality targets.
  • Manage contracts, change requests, contractor payments, cost controls, financial tracking, and value engineering initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain project governance, reporting, communication structures, and stakeholder engagement across local and global teams.
  • Conduct quality inspections, audits, and reviews to ensure compliance with project specifications, regulatory requirements, and industry standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement, standardization, cost savings initiatives, and best-practice adoption across construction projects.

What you’ll need

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Proven experience managing large-scale construction projects, preferably within data centers, mission-critical facilities, or similar complex environments.
  • Strong knowledge of construction project management methodologies, processes, and industry best practices.
  • Familiarity with data center infrastructure, design principles, and MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) systems.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project budgets, schedules, contractors, risk mitigation, KPIs, and financial controls.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, influencing, and people management skills.
  • Experience driving continuous process improvement, governance frameworks, and performance reporting.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and attention-to-detail capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Fluency in English, with excellent verbal and written communication skills, is essential.
  • Proficiency with project management tools and software, along with a customer-focused, proactive, adaptable, and collaborative approach.

A bit about us

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company’s global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

To learn more about Digital Realty, please visit [digitalrealty.com](http://www.digitalrealty.com/) or follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/digitalrealty) and [Twitter](https://twitter.com/digitalrealty).

What we can offer you

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

Join us and you’ll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you’ll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We’ll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

Health and Safety

Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals - they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress.

Our Compensation Philosophy

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned to the company's overall goals and values.

job.title: Senior Manager, Subsea Cable Project Management
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

The responsibility of this position is to drive and manage the Keppel submarine cable infrastructure projects which includes the following activities.

  • ### Work with the Joint build partners, customers and internal business/commercial teams and implement new subsea cable projects through diverse, secure and practical routes that meet all stakeholders needs and where there is a customer demand.
  • ### Convert the business requirements into partnership model subsea cable project and work out the project plan for execution with Joint build partners, landing service providers and internal teams.
  • ### Develop ownership and participation structures for consortium projects and work on the Joint Build Agreements (JBA), Landing Party Agreements (LPA), Memoranda of Understanding (MOU), IRU Consortium Agreements as required .
  • ### Consolidate budget inputs from Suppliers, Landing parties, Service providers, Permitting consultants, Internal stakeholders.
  • ### Track Approved budgets, Committed costs, Actual expenditure, Forecast expenditure, Cost-to-complete, Identify cost overruns and financial risks and recommend corrective actions where required for the Supply and Non-Supply items of the Project.
  • ### Manage cost-sharing arrangements among consortium partners, cost allocation methodologies, billing/reimbursement, and cost recovery processes, Monitor compliance with agreed partnership arrangements.
  • ### Evaluate project agreement risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • ### Review and support the development of schedules, project milestones, implementation plans, and commissioning strategies.
  • ### Work with the submarine cable vendors & partners and drive the implementation of the submarine cable system including design, manufacturing and installation activities.
  • ### Collaborate with the landing service providers, vendors, partners and various internal teams and ensure that the purchasers’ deliverable items (say permits, cable landing station, fronthaul route, wayleave/lease for the land, etc.) are made ready on or before the target timelines, which also includes the formulation and execution of agreements from the technical aspects.
  • ### Work closely with the customers, partners and suppliers on project implementation activities like site survey, design/build of CLS, installation, testing and commissioning of submarine cable and terminal equipment and follow up regularly to get all activities completed on time.
  • ### Ownership and management of the customer experience and relationship management;
  • ### This position serves as a subject matter expert and a point of contact for the customers and partners on the implementation of the subsea cable projects.
  • ### Conduct periodic review meetings with partners/customers/stakeholders and various vendors/providers to discuss about performance, issues and related action items.
  • ### Travel may be required within the region or other regions to assist at various sites. Must have good communications skills.
  • ### Project activities can often require after-hours coordinated activity and/or unplanned after-hours accessibility involving customer specific.
  • ### Ability to multi-task and work independently with minimal supervision in a non-structured environment. Superior interpersonal skills required to work with suppliers, partners, customers and internal departments for managing the life cycle activities of the submarine cable.

###

Join our vibrant and inclusive workforce to shape a better future for all!

###

job.title: Principal Engineer – HV Infrastructure (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Principal Engineer – HV Infrastructure is the senior technical engineering role within STACK’s Power & Energy function responsible for the technical integrity, engineering governance and design assurance of STACK’s upstream high-voltage infrastructure.

The role provides technical leadership across the development and delivery of transmission and distribution connections, HV substations, transformers, switchgear, HV cables/lines, protection and control systems, contestable assets, BESS and associated infrastructure.

The Principal Engineer will act as STACK’s owner’s engineer and HV technical authority, establishing engineering requirements, reviewing and challenging EPC designs, managing specialist engineering consultants and ensuring delivered infrastructure meets STACK, NSP, regulatory, safety, reliability and operational requirements.

The role works closely with the Grid Connection Manager, Senior Project Managers, Engineering, Operations, NSPs, EPC contractors and OEMs throughout the asset lifecycle.

HV Engineering & Technical Authority

  • Provide technical leadership and engineering governance for STACK’s HV infrastructure portfolio.
  • Establish and maintain HV engineering requirements, design criteria, technical specifications and standard solutions.
  • Lead development and technical review of substation architecture, transformers, switchgear, HV cables/lines, protection and control, SCADA, metering, earthing and associated systems.
  • Ensure engineering solutions appropriately address reliability, redundancy, maintainability, safety, operability and future expansion.
  • Provide technical recommendations and resolve complex engineering issues throughout project development and delivery.

Design Assurance & EPC Engineering Management

  • Act as STACK’s owner’s engineer for HV infrastructure delivered through ECI/EPC arrangements.
  • Review and approve contractor design deliverables against STACK requirements and applicable standards.
  • Lead technical reviews, design workshops, HAZID/design-risk reviews and engineering hold points.
  • Challenge EPC and consultant proposals where appropriate to optimise technical performance, constructability, reliability and lifecycle outcomes.
  • Manage specialist engineering consultants where additional technical expertise is required.
  • Maintain technical configuration and design-change control through project delivery.

Grid Connection & Power-System Interface

  • Work closely with the Grid Connection Manager to ensure connection requirements, CPS, GPS and grid-study outcomes are incorporated into HV infrastructure design.
  • Provide HV plant data, equipment characteristics and design inputs required for power-system studies and modelling.
  • Support technical assessment of fault levels, harmonics, reactive power, system strength, protection and other grid-facing requirements.
  • Ensure changes to HV equipment or architecture are assessed for potential impacts on connection studies and compliance.
  • Support resolution of technical matters with NSPs, AEMO, consultants and OEMs where they relate to HV infrastructure.

Delivery, Commissioning & Operational Readiness

  • Provide engineering support to Senior Project Managers throughout procurement, construction, testing and commissioning.
  • Lead technical evaluation of major HV equipment and OEM submissions.
  • Participate in FATs, SATs, protection testing, commissioning and technical acceptance activities as required.
  • Provide technical assurance that installed assets comply with approved design and performance requirements.
  • Work with DC Operations to ensure maintainability, operating philosophy, asset information, spares and technical requirements are incorporated before handover.
  • Support investigation and resolution of technical issues during commissioning and early operation.

Engineering Governance & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain appropriate technical standards, design records, specifications and engineering decision documentation.
  • Develop standardised HV solutions and lessons learned across STACK’s Australian portfolio.
  • Monitor relevant Australian and international standards, NSP requirements and emerging HV technologies.
  • Provide technical mentoring and support to project engineers and broader project teams.
  • Promote strong engineering governance and disciplined technical decision-making across the organisation.

Competencies

  • Deep technical expertise in HV electrical systems and substation engineering.
  • Strong understanding of transmission and distribution infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of primary plant, protection and control, transformers, switchgear, HV cables and associated systems.
  • Ability to critically review complex engineering designs and consultant/EPC deliverables.
  • Understanding of power-system studies, CPS, GPS and grid-connection requirements.
  • Strong engineering judgement and ability to make risk-based technical decisions.
  • Strong consultant, contractor and OEM management capability.
  • Excellent technical communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to translate technical issues into clear recommendations for project and senior leadership teams.

Work Environment/Conditions

Working across STACK project, development and engineering environments in Australia, including project sites, offices, utility facilities and external stakeholder locations.

Travel Required

Travel within Australia and, from time to time, internationally to support STACK projects, stakeholder meetings, technical reviews, workshops and commissioning activities.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Power Systems Engineering.
  • 10+ years’ relevant experience in transmission, distribution, utilities, renewable energy, major industrial infrastructure or similar HV environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in HV substation design and engineering.
  • Experience reviewing and managing engineering delivered by EPC contractors and consultants.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian electrical standards and utility/network requirements.
  • Experience across design, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning of HV infrastructure.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience with 132 kV, 220 kV, 275 kV, 330 kV or higher-voltage systems.
  • Experience with Australian TNSPs/DNSPs and contestable assets.
  • Experience with hyperscale data centres or large industrial loads.
  • Experience with BESS and renewable-energy infrastructure.
  • Understanding of PSCAD, PSS®E and/or Power Factory study environments.
  • Experience with protection, harmonics, power quality and grid compliance.
  • Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) and Engineers Australia registration or equivalent professional recognition.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Ability to work flexibly to accommodate project, utility and stakeholder requirements.
  • Willingness to attend site, technical workshops and commissioning activities outside standard business hours where required.
  • Comfortable operating in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

job.title: Senior Project Manager – HV Infrastructure (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Project Manager – HV Infrastructure is a key role within STACK’s Power & Energy function, responsible for the successful delivery of major high-voltage infrastructure supporting STACK’s data centre developments across Australia.

The role provides end-to-end project leadership for HV infrastructure from early design and procurement through construction, testing, commissioning and energisation. This may include transmission and distribution connections, HV substations, transformers, switchgear, transmission lines/cables, contestable works, BESS and associated electrical infrastructure.

The Senior Project Manager will act as STACK’s primary delivery interface with HV EPC contractors and work closely with the Principal Engineer – HV Infrastructure, Grid Connection Manager, Engineering, Delivery, network service providers and other project stakeholders.

The role is accountable for ensuring HV infrastructure is delivered safely, to programme, within approved budget and in accordance with STACK’s technical and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

HV Infrastructure Project Delivery

  • Lead delivery of major HV infrastructure projects from early development and ECI through EPC execution, commissioning and energisation.
  • Develop and maintain integrated project programmes covering engineering, procurement, long-lead equipment, construction, testing, network interfaces and energisation.
  • Manage project scope, programme, cost, risk, quality and change control.
  • Coordinate delivery of substations, contestable works, HV cables/lines, transformers, switchgear, BESS and associated infrastructure as applicable.
  • Ensure HV delivery milestones remain aligned with the overall data centre development programme.

EPC & Contractor Management

  • Lead procurement, engagement and management of HV EPC contractors and specialist delivery partners.
  • Support development of ECI/EPC scopes, tender documentation, commercial evaluations and contract award recommendations.
  • Establish clear contractor deliverables, interfaces, programme requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Monitor EPC performance against programme, cost, quality and contractual obligations.
  • Manage contractor reporting, variations, claims, risks and corrective actions in conjunction with Commercial and Legal teams.
  • Maintain clear single-point accountability for delivery of the upstream HV package.

Engineering & Project Interfaces

  • Work closely with the Principal Engineer – HV Infrastructure to ensure technical requirements are incorporated into EPC design and delivery.
  • Coordinate with the Grid Connection Manager to ensure connection requirements, CPS, GPS, NSP requirements and grid studies are reflected in project execution.
  • Manage interfaces with Engineering and Delivery at the agreed campus electrical interface.
  • Coordinate project dependencies with NSPs, contestable works providers, OEMs and other external stakeholders.
  • Ensure design changes, construction issues and programme decisions are communicated and resolved across relevant teams.

Commissioning & Energisation

  • Own the integrated delivery programme for testing, commissioning and energisation of HV infrastructure.
  • Coordinate EPC contractors, NSPs, OEMs, Grid Connection Manager, engineering teams and Delivery through energisation readiness.
  • Establish commissioning milestones, hold points, prerequisites and completion requirements.
  • Ensure required documentation, test records, defects and technical approvals are completed prior to handover.
  • Manage transition of completed HV assets into Operations, including documentation, training, spares and operational readiness.

Governance, Safety & Risk

  • Promote a strong safety culture across all HV project activities.
  • Ensure contractors comply with STACK standards, applicable legislation, network requirements and project safety systems.
  • Maintain project risk, issue, change and decision registers.
  • Provide clear reporting on programme, cost, risk and delivery status to senior leadership.
  • Capture lessons learned and contribute to standardisation of future STACK HV infrastructure projects.

Competencies

  • Strong project leadership and major infrastructure delivery capability.
  • Strong knowledge of HV electrical infrastructure and substation delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage major EPC contracts and contractors.
  • Strong programme, commercial, risk and change-management capability.
  • Ability to manage complex interfaces between engineering, construction, utilities and data centre delivery.
  • Strong stakeholder management, negotiation and communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of testing, commissioning and energisation of HV infrastructure.
  • Ability to communicate complex delivery issues clearly to senior leadership.

Travel Required

Travel within Australia and, from time to time, internationally to support STACK projects, stakeholder meetings, technical reviews, workshops and commissioning activities.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 10+ years’ experience delivering major electrical, transmission, renewable-energy, utility or infrastructure projects.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering HV substations and associated electrical infrastructure.
  • Experience managing EPC contractors and major construction packages.
  • Experience managing projects through engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and energisation.
  • Strong understanding of project controls, programme, cost, risk and contract management.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience delivering 132 kV, 220 kV, 275 kV, 330 kV or higher-voltage infrastructure.
  • Experience with Australian TNSPs/DNSPs and contestable HV infrastructure.
  • Experience with hyperscale data centres or other large industrial loads.
  • Experience with BESS and renewable-energy infrastructure.
  • Experience with ECI-to-EPC delivery models.
  • PMP, AIPM or equivalent project-management accreditation.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Ability to work flexibly around major construction, testing and energisation activities.
  • Comfortable operating in complex, high-pressure project environments with multiple stakeholders and changing priorities.

job.title: Electrical Systems Specialist - Field Engineering (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

The Position:

The Electrical Systems Specialist – Field Engineering is a hands-on technical expert responsible for the safety, reliability, and performance of mission-critical electrical infrastructure within a live data centre environment.

The role has a strong focus on UPS systems, battery infrastructure, and critical power distribution, while also supporting HV/LV systems, transformers, switchboards, generators, protection systems, and electrical controls.

Working across operations, engineering, and risk, the specialist provides field support during incidents, leads fault investigations, reviews switching procedures, and improves the technical capability of site teams.

Key Responsibilities

Electrical and UPS System Ownership

  • Act as the technical specialist for UPS systems, batteries, HV/LV distribution, transformers, switchboards, generators, and associated controls.
  • Maintain detailed knowledge of system design, operating modes, protection settings, redundancy, and recovery strategies.
  • Monitor UPS loading, battery condition, autonomy, alarms, and equipment performance.
  • Identify capacity, reliability, lifecycle, and single-point-of-failure risks.
  • Ensure electrical systems operate within approved safety, protection, and reliability limits.

Field Engineering and Fault Response

  • Provide hands-on technical support during UPS faults, electrical outages, protection trips, nuisance alarms, and abnormal operating conditions.
  • Lead fault isolation, technical diagnosis, and restoration planning.
  • Analyse UPS event logs, relay records, alarms, and power-monitoring data.
  • Support switching, UPS bypass operations, load transfers, energisation, commissioning, and post-incident recovery.
  • Provide clear technical direction to operations teams, contractors, and equipment vendors.

Engineering Governance

  • Author, review, and approve:

Electrical switching procedures

  • EOPs, MOPs, and SOPs
  • Isolation and energisation plans
  • Temporary operating procedures
  • Risk assessments and recovery plans

Ensure procedures align with system configuration, protection coordination, discrimination, arc-flash requirements, and equipment limitations.

Improve procedures based on incidents, operational feedback, and lessons learned.

Reliability and Technical Leadership

  • Lead or support electrical incident investigations and Root Cause Analysis.
  • Provide technical input into maintenance, asset replacement, capacity planning, and system upgrades.
  • Review commissioning plans and witness UPS, battery, generator, and integrated systems testing.
  • Coach site teams on UPS operation, electrical switching, fault response, and safe systems of work.

Must-have Qualifications:

Essential:

  • Trade, diploma, or degree qualification in Electrical Engineering or equivalent
  • Extensive experience with mission-critical electrical systems (data centres, utilities, hospitals, industrial facilities, or similar)
  • Strong hands-on switching and fault-finding capability
  • Experience with protection coordination and discrimination studies
  • Proven experience authoring and reviewing switching procedures
  • Strong understanding of redundancy philosophies (N, N+1, 2N, etc.)

Desirable:

Desirable Experience

  • Authorised HV switching experience.
  • Experience in live data centre operations.
  • UPS manufacturer training or certification.
  • Experience with VRLA, lithium-ion, nickel-cadmium, or other battery technologies.
  • Commissioning and energisation experience.
  • Familiarity with relay configuration, power-quality analysis, EPMS, SCADA, or BMS platforms.
  • Experience leading or contributing to Root Cause Analysis investigations.

This might be right for you if:

  • You don’t get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple high-level priorities with competing timelines while welcoming a new, urgent challenge with ease.
  • Are culturally sensitive and enjoy working with a diverse group of individuals from multiple regions.
  • You pay attention to the details – meticulously, and every time. Nothing falls through the cracks on your watch.
  • You’re collaborative. You enjoy working with others to solve problems – and people enjoy working with you. You can shift from being a leader to a contributor when needed.
  • You’re smart. You think five steps ahead and see issues from multiple angles. You’re not just a problem solver – you’re a problem preventer.

Why STACK:

  • We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits.
  • We have a culture of appreciation and recognition.
  • We are passionate about what we do and have fun doing it.
  • Be part of the growing business and make an impact.

STACK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ALL qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify and expression, age, national origin, mental or physical disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

job.title: Senior Engineer, Colt Design Center (CDC)
job.description:
Job location: Gurugram, IN Bangalore, IN

Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.

Why we need this role

This role is required to strengthen CDC pre-sales design support and ensure timely handling of Sales Requests across Internet Access, SD-WAN, Capital Markets, and IPVPN product lines.

#LI-DNI

What you will do

  • Design and develop robust SD-WAN, MPLS, Internet, and WAN solutions aligned with customer business and technical requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), network diagrams, and technical documentation.
  • Design and validate solutions involving routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, and EIGRP, along with MPLS VPNs, QoS, and security technologies.
  • Conduct proof-of-concept validations for new services and customer-specific requirements.
  • Provide technical expertise during customer workshops, design discussions, and solution presentations.
  • Perform risk, impact, capacity, and resiliency assessments to ensure designs meet performance and availability requirements.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of complex design-related issues during implementation and service activation phases.
  • Drive continuous improvement through design standardization, process optimization, and adoption of emerging technologies such as SD-WAN, IPv6, and cloud connectivity solutions.

What we're looking for

  • Network Solution Designer with 5–6 years of experience in designing and delivering enterprise network solutions.
  • Strong hands-on understanding of SD-WAN, MPLS, Internet, IPVPN, WAN, routing, switching, QoS, and VPN technologies.
  • Experience in analysing customer requirements and translating them into scalable, resilient, and cost-effective network designs.
  • Good exposure to technical feasibility assessments, solution reviews, capacity checks, and design validations.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams including Sales, Architecture, Product, Delivery, and Operations.

job.title: Manufacturing Quality Senior Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

In-Process Quality Management

  • Lead in-process quality inspection and verification activities across manufacturing lines.
  • Ensure compliance with Control Plans, SOPs, Process Flow, PFMEA, and work instructions.
  • Monitor critical process parameters and quality checkpoints.
  • Ensure First Piece Approval (FPA) and process setup verification before production release.
  • Drive adherence to quality gates and process controls.

Quality Issue Management

  • Lead investigations of in-process defects, line rejections, and process deviations.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, and other quality tools.
  • Implement and monitor containment, corrective, and preventive actions.
  • Verify effectiveness of corrective actions and ensure sustainable closure.

Process Audits & Compliance

  • Conduct Layered Process Audits (LPA), Process Audits, and Product Audits.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, QMS requirements, and customer specifications.
  • Support internal, customer, and certification audits.
  • Maintain audit records, inspection reports, and quality documentation.

Manufacturing Process Improvement

  • Analyze process rejection trends and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce defects, rework, scrap, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ).
  • Support Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, Six Sigma, and Operational Excellence projects.
  • Implement mistake-proofing (Poka-Yoke) and process control improvements.

New Product Introduction (NPI)

  • Support Proto Builds, Pilot Builds, and Production Readiness Reviews.
  • Participate in PFMEA, Control Plan, and process validation activities.
  • Ensure quality requirements are incorporated during new product introduction.
  • Support Gate Reviews and manufacturing process qualification.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Supplier Quality, Incoming Quality, and Customer Quality teams.
  • Participate in daily production review meetings and quality escalation discussions.
  • Support customer complaint investigations related to manufacturing defects.
  • Drive timely closure of manufacturing quality concerns.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Production, or Industrial Engineering.
  • 4 to 7 years of experience in Manufacturing Quality, IPQA, Production Quality, or Quality Assurance.
  • Experience in assembly, fabrication, electrical panel manufacturing, or industrial equipment manufacturing.

Required Skills

  • In-Process Quality Assurance
  • PFMEA, Control Plan & Process Flow
  • Root Cause Analysis (8D, 5 Why, Fishbone)
  • Process Auditing
  • SPC & Process Capability Analysis
  • GD&T and Drawing Interpretation
  • Measurement System Analysis (MSA)
  • SAP/ERP Knowledge
  • Quality Reporting & Data Analysis
  • Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement

Preferred Experience

  • Electrical Panel Assembly
  • UPS, ATS, PDU, Thermal Products
  • Sheet Metal Fabrication
  • Wiring & Harness Assembly
  • Torque-Controlled Assembly Processes
  • Functional Testing & Validation
  • Manufacturing Process Audits

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • First Pass Yield (FPY)
  • In-Process Rejection Reduction
  • Rework & Scrap Reduction
  • Process Audit Compliance
  • Internal Defect Reduction
  • Corrective Action Closure Effectiveness
  • Customer Complaint Reduction Related to Manufacturing Defects
  • COPQ Reduction

Competencies

  • Strong Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
  • Leadership & Team Coordination
  • Decision-Making Ability
  • Effective Communication
  • Process Improvement Mindset
  • Ownership & Accountability
  • Customer Focus

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

job.description:
Job Description

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

1. Position Overview

The Senior Production Analyst is responsible for driving data-driven production control, performance analysis, and continuous improvement across HVAC manufacturing operations (FWU, Chillers, Thermal Solutions). The role plays a critical part in ensuring plan vs actual adherence, loss reduction, and operational efficiency in a high-demand production environment.

  • Conduct RCA (Root Cause Analysis) for downtime, quality issues, and productivity gaps
  • Track and ensure closure of all Tier-1 / Tier-2 action items

C. Data Analytics & Reporting

  • Develop and maintain MIS dashboards and production reports
  • Track key KPIs:
  • OEE
  • Line efficiency
  • Throughput
  • Rejections / rework
  • Provide real-time insights for decision-making
  • Use tools like Excel, Power BI, ERP (SAP) for reporting and analytics

D. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Act as a central coordination point between:
  • Production (FWU / Chillers)
  • Planning
  • Quality
  • Maintenance
  • Stores & Procurement
  • Ensure proactive follow-up on:
  • Material shortages
  • Quality concerns
  • Process delays

E. Capacity Planning & Demand Alignment

  • Support capacity planning and shift utilization
  • Analyze demand pipeline vs production capability
  • Identify constraints and recommend corrective actions
  • Drive planning readiness for new orders / ramp-ups

F. Continuous Improvement & Digitization

  • Lead Lean / Kaizen / Six Sigma initiatives
  • Identify opportunities for process optimization and cost reduction
  • Drive digitization of production tracking systems
  • Improve data accuracy and reporting cadence

G. Governance & Reviews

  • Prepare and present insights in:
  • Tier-2 meetings
  • Monthly production reviews
  • Management review forums
  • Ensure accountability tracking for all action plans

3. Key Deliverables

  • Daily production performance dashboard
  • Function-wise loss analysis report
  • RCA reports with closure tracking
  • Capacity vs demand analysis
  • OEE improvement roadmap
  • Tier-2 action tracker

4. Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering

5. Required Skills

  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills
  • Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, Power BI
  • Knowledge of:
  • OEE
  • Lean manufacturing
  • Root cause analysis tools
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to work under pressure in a dynamic production setup

6. KPIs / Success Metrics

  • Production plan adherence (%)
  • Reduction in total loss hours
  • Improvement in OEE and line efficiency
  • Timely closure of Tier-2 actions
  • Accuracy and timeliness of reporting
  • Reduction in escalations
