job.title: Sr. Go-To-Market Specialist, Data, AWS, WWSO Data APJC
job.description:
Are you a customer-obsessed builder with a passion for helping customers achieve their full potential? Do you have the business savvy, deep data background, and technical sales skills necessary to help position AWS as the cloud provider of choice for customers across Asia Pacific, Japan and China? Do you love building new strategic and data-driven businesses, and helping customers turn their data into the foundation that powers AI in production? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Data & AI team as a Sr. Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist for Data.

This role owns the AWS data go-to-market across ASEAN with a primary focus on helping customers run agentic and AI workloads in production, working hand-in-hand with the AI team to turn AI pilots into production reality. Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated outcomes; every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it. To run these workloads in production, customers need the right context layer with the right level of governance, which means getting the metadata right. It is truly about getting the right data to the right people and agents at the right time. That starts with strong foundations, helping customers build and modernise the underlying data estate (the data stores, pipelines, and data engineering) that the context layer is built on and doing it in a way that makes it simple for customers, removing complexity rather than adding it. You will span AWS's storage, analytics, and database portfolio, partnering with the AI team, account teams, and partners on some of ASEAN's largest customers and most strategic deals. You will also be the voice of ASEAN back to the service teams, carrying the needs of ASEAN customers to our data service teams to help reshape our service and roadmap strategy.

The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) and acts as the force multiplier for AWS. We are the deep domain experts, in this case, in data — who are brought in to support customers and our sales teams when they need to unblock or accelerate a customer. We work backwards from our customers' most complex and business-critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist, and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire lifecycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the GTM strategy and execution for AWS Data (storage, analytics, database) across ASEAN, across all segments.
  • Get customers ready to run agentic and AI workloads in production — partner with the AI team to build the context layer, governance, and metadata that gets the right data to the right people and agents at the right time.
  • Help customers build and modernise the foundational data estate — data stores, pipelines, and data engineering beneath the context layer — making it easy by removing complexity.
  • Serve as the ASEAN point of contact for all data motions — the connective tissue between the AI team, Specialists, Specialist SAs, Partners, and the area teams carrying data quota.
  • Lead engagement on ASEAN's largest and most strategic deals with the AI team, account, commercial/deal, and partner teams, and design Scale Sales Motions using Field teams, partner channels, and funding levers to unblock deals.
  • Be the voice of ASEAN to the data service teams — feed customer needs, adoption signals, and competitive gaps back to product leadership to reshape roadmap strategy.
  • Engage at CxO/VP level and with developers and architects to build pipeline, secure lighthouse customers, drive revenue, and host executive briefings and workshops.

A day in the life You are the person the field, partners, and customers come to for anything data in ASEAN. One day you're with the AI team in a CxO briefing making the case for the governed data foundation a customer needs to move an agentic workload into production; the next you're helping an account team stand up the right metadata and governance so agents can access the right data safely, unblocking a stalled deal with the right partner funding lever, or feeding ASEAN customer signal back to the service teams to shape the roadmap. You operate across the ASEAN areas and every segment, building the strategy and executing it, measuring success by the collective growth of the ASEAN data business.

About the team The WWSO Data & AI team helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies. We are technology specialists. This role sits on the ASEAN Data GTM team, working as an integrated unit with the AI team, account teams, Specialist SAs, and partner teams to drive data adoption across ASEAN. We believe in a collaborative working model where BD, Sales Specialists, and Specialist SAs operate in concert, each bringing unique strengths to deliver customer outcomes. We value individuals who are not only strong strategists but also effective communicators who can bridge the gap between local market needs and global organizational priorities. If you thrive where you build the strategy AND execute it, where you influence across organizational boundaries, and where you measure success by the collective growth of the team, this is the role for you.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
  • Experience working with, presenting to, and negotiating with C-level executives, IT, lines of business, procurement, finance, legal and internal stakeholders for sizeable commercial/enterprise deals
  • 5+ years of technology domain experience across data, analytics, data platform, storage, and/or database and large-scale data workloads.
  • Experience helping customers build the foundational data estate for AI/ML, data stores, data pipelines/engineering, data readiness, governance, and metadata/cataloguing and getting data accessible to applications and agents.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements
  • Experience with C-level sales and strategic partnership building
  • 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
  • Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers
  • Experience leading and influencing cross-functional sales teams
  • Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps
  • Experience owning end-to-end GTM strategy for a technology domain across multiple geographies and segments.

job.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. Amazon Web Services is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for a dynamic results-oriented candidate to join as a Partner Development Manager, SAP GROW, APJ. SAP GROW is SAP's public cloud ERP solution built for companies of any size, delivering AI-embedded finance, supply chain, and HR capabilities with rapid, standardised implementations. This role will own the partner-led execution of the SAP GROW GTM across Asia Pacific and Japan. As the Partner Development Manager, SAP GROW within Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to recruit, enable, and scale the partner community required to drive SAP GROW customer acquisition on AWS. You will be the single-threaded owner of GROW partner GTM execution across APJ, working at the intersection of SAP's public cloud ERP strategy and AWS's partner-led scale motions. Your broad responsibilities will include defining and executing the GROW partner recruitment and onboarding plan, establishing business and technical relationships with SAP GROW Fast implementation partners, collaborating with AWS SAP specialist sales teams and SAP alliance counterparts, and managing the day-to-day partner cadence to build a pipeline of new GROW customers on AWS. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions for cloud ERP modernisation.

  • Identify and address gaps in partner readiness
  • Prepare and give business reviews to senior management regarding progress against GROW customer acquisition targets, partner pipeline, and any potential roadblocks

  • Embed GROW into AWS field sales cadences (weekly deal reviews, QBRs, SAP account alignment) to ensure AWS account teams actively position GROW with eligible customers and drive CSP selection for AWS
  • Develop and execute co-sell plays with partners that generate qualified GROW pipeline, convert opportunities through joint customer engagement, and deliver wins measured by launched ARR and number of GROW go-lives on AWS
  • Establish a joint SAP-AWS GROW governance cadence with SAP's partner and direct sales leadership to track attainment against mutual customer acquisition commitments, address blockers, and align on pipeline priority accounts

  • Ensuring close alignment between AWS SAP sales teams, SAP alliance, and GROW implementation partners
  • Aligning AWS GROW GTM with SAP's regional launch timelines and co-sell mechanisms
  • Close loop on partner escalations including CSP choice, funding eligibility, and SAP Direct Motion access
  • Facilitating AWS investments (SaaS funding, co-innovation funding, demand generation) to accelerate partner-led GROW customer acquisition
  • Driving co-sell motions: working directly with AWS account teams and partners to progress GROW opportunities from qualification through close, ensuring partner delivery readiness for each deal

Key job responsibilities Own and Support the Test Ecosystem: Architect, develop, and maintain the manufacturing test infrastructure for AI server hardware products, spanning board-level validation through full rack integration and networking.

Build and Scale Test Software: Design and maintain production test software and automation frameworks using Python, Bash, and related tooling, including test sequencing, equipment control, data collection, and reporting pipelines.

Drive Automation & Self-Remedy: Develop automated test processes and self-healing capabilities that reduce manual intervention, increase throughput, and improve first-pass yield across the production line.

Define Test Strategy: Establish modular test strategies, define pass/fail limits, and implement statistical process controls (GR&R, Cp/Cpk, correlation analysis) to ensure product quality at scale.

Analyze Production Data: Compile and analyze test data using both automated reporting systems and exploratory analysis techniques to identify trends, root-cause failures, and drive corrective actions

Own Uptime & Yield: Monitor functional test yield across shifts, lead triage efforts for test-station failures, and drive weekly production quality reviews with cross-functional partners.

Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with hardware design, firmware, process engineering, quality, and operations teams to ensure test requirements are aligned and products are designed for efficient, high-quality manufacturing.

Guide Fixture & Infrastructure Design: Partner on test fixture design and procurement, ensuring alignment to cost, scalability, and schedule requirements; engage in RFQ processes for optimal end-to-end test solutions.

Support New Product Introduction (NPI): Support partner teams in the development of test solutions for new product builds, from concept prototypes through production ramp, ensuring readiness at each phase gate.

Sustain & Improve: Provide ongoing support for deployed test systems, implement configuration changes for new product variants, and maintain comprehensive documentation of test procedures, specifications, and infrastructure.

Provide Feedback Upstream: Deliver actionable design-for-test (DFT) feedback to hardware and firmware development teams to improve testability and manufacturing efficiency for future platforms.

job.description:
AWS Support Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. job.description:
AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders, we try new things, and imagine big dreams. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, testers, and doers. Come join us and work with the latest cloud technologies that enable our customers to adopt cloud based solutions.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

FSI Digital Natives Solutions Architects (SA) work closely with technical decision maker, co-founders, engineers and developers to help them make the most of the Cloud. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with organizations at all stages of cloud adoption. Our Solutions Architects also take a leading role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.

THE ROLE

You will collaborate with customers, partners and other AWS teams to craft architectures, proof of concepts and demonstrations of our platform that work back from customer's business needs and accelerate the adoption of appropriate AWS technology. You will help shape and design solutions covering a spread of tech concerns like security, tenant isolation in compute and storage, hybrid networking, CI/CD to reduce time to market, rightsizing and auto-scaling of infrastructure, purpose-built databases to name a few. The ability to learn new technology and develop industry relevant architectures and convey business value is critical to the role.

What if I don’t meet all the requirements? That’s okay! We hire people who have a passion for learning and are curious. You will be supported in your career development here at AWS. You will have plenty of opportunities to build your technical, leadership, business and consulting skills. Your on-boarding will set you up for success, including a combination of formal and informal training. You’ll also have a chance to gain AWS certifications and access mentor-ship programs. You will learn from and collaborate with some of the brightest technical minds in the industry today.

Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities

  • Work directly with customers to accelerate their projects and recommend best-practice cloud architectures in line with their long-term business outcomes
  • Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical business problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures
  • Scope and own each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well- defined objectives and success criteria
  • Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, Customer Solution Managers and consulting/managed services partners)
  • Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops

A day in the life Our Solutions Architects (SA) are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The key to AWS success is its top-tier collaborative culture. You will have the opportunity to work with multiple AWS professionals that can help you accelerate your career and bring ideas to market. You will be working closely with a talented team of managers and SAs that will push your technical abilities while you bring new innovations to a widely adopted and fast-growing service.

job.title: Controls Engineer , AWS Control, Deployment and Service Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems which monitor and ensure the health of our data centers. APAC CDS’ mission is to safely provide our customers with the unmatched reliability, security, and performance that AWS is known for. APAC CDS covers six disciplines of deployments, projects, service, colo, on-call support, and management.

Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade collocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors.

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms.

To be successful in this team, you will also have:

  • Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
  • Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
  • Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

Key job responsibilities

  • Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)
  • Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
  • Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
  • Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

A day in the life

  • Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip—especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips.
  • Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won’t just be observing from the sidelines; you’ll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon’s global presence.
  • Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds.
  • Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career.

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

  • Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
  • Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA

job.title: ASEAN Strategy Lead, Global Sales Operations, ASEAN AGS Global Sales Operations
job.description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking an experienced ASEAN Strategy Lead to join Global Sales Operations (GSO), supporting AWS Global Sales (AGS) across ASEAN to manage strategic analysis, planning mechanisms, and end-to-end initiative management for AGS GTM The role sits at the intersection of strategy, planning, operations, and execution. You will partner closely with senior leaders across AGS, Field Tech, Partner, Professional Services, Finance, Marketing, and APJ teams to define, land, and scale strategic priorities that accelerate customer adoption and business growth. A core part of this role is managing AWS' strategic mechanism framework, including Operating Plan cycles (OP1 and OP2) for AGS across ASEAN. You will help translate customer insights, business performance, field capacity, investment priorities, and GTM trade-offs into clear strategic recommendations and executable plans. This role will also be responsible in translating the strategies into investment asks, including headcount and will be responsible in prioritizing headcount deployment and headcount related reporting. The ideal candidate combines strong sales strategy experience, analytical depth, operational discipline, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority. They must be comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels, from framing complex business questions to building mechanisms, inspecting KPIs, and driving cross-functional action.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own and drive ASEAN-wide GTM strategy priorities for AGS, ensuring alignment between APJC strategy and ASEAB business needs.
  • Lead annual planning mechanisms, including OP1 and OP2, across AGS in ASEAN, translating business goals into investment priorities and execution plans, working closely with the APJC and ASEAN Country teams across various functions.
  • Conduct strategic analysis on customer trends, sales productivity, coverage capacity, pipeline health, partner contribution, migration and modernization, AI, and other priority growth initiatives.
  • Develop data-driven recommendations to support senior leadership decisions on sales investment, resource allocation, GTM design, and operating model improvements.

Manage highly visible, cross-functional strategic initiatives from problem definition through execution, inspection, and scale.

  • Author clear, concise, and compelling narratives, proposals, and strategic documents for senior executive review.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to ASEAN senior leadership on complex business decisions requiring strategic judgment, analytical rigor, and strong stakeholder alignment.
  • Drive adoption of global standards, processes, and programs while ensuring they are practical and relevant for ASEAN’s diverse markets.

job.title: Senior Specialist SA, Developer Transformation
job.description:
Developers and development teams are key influencers who steer organizational adoption of new methodologies, technologies, services and platforms. The mission of the Developer Transformation (DevTx) team is to help developers gain greater familiarity and confidence building modern, cloud-native applications that take full advantage of the latest AI-driven tools and AWS’s wide range of services. Through direct developer engagement, DevTx helps customers to address actual business problems and accelerated design, development and deployment of production quality cloud native application workloads.

As a DevTx Senior Solution Architect (SA), you will help customers to innovate and transform their software development practices, applying modern patterns, the latest architectural best practices using the latest AI-native tools for developing and operating full-stack, cloud-native workloads. You will collaborate with customers and peers, develop content and enable the wider community to harness the power of AWS Cloud.

In this role, you will continuously sharpen and apply your expertise in programming languages, distributed systems, design patterns and the full software development life-cycle, to upskill developers and development teams on AWS cloud services, the third-party ecosystem and partner solutions.

Key job responsibilities

  • Be an active member of the AWS Solution Architecture team by leading and influencing stakeholders in on-to-one and one-to-many application architecture and development discussions and workshops with developers, software engineers, enterprise/solution architects and CTOs
  • Accelerating adoption of AWS in the student, startup and professional developer communities by engaging through conferences, startup events, meetups, user groups and hackathons
  • Help lead the direction for AWS developer events to make them best-in-class from a developer’s perspective, representing AWS through speaking, doing live demos and interacting with attendees
  • Creating technical content such as reference applications, starter kits and patterns and practical guidance that will get developers excited about the potential of AWS as a development platform
  • Contributing to a library of highly-reusable developer-focused artefacts such as demonstrations, sample code, blog posts, tutorials, and other modes of technical enablement
  • Providing end-user feedback to AWS Product Management and Engineering teams based on the developer ‘voice of the customer‘. Participate in technical and design discussions with AWS technical teams to help speed customer adoption and ensure best practices during implementation
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead hands-on deep dives and technical workshops, contributing reusable code, reference architectures, and internal technical assets for the broader engineering organization.

If you are keen to help AWS customers adopt the latest methods, practices and tools in software development, while challenging the impossible, come build the future with us.

About the team AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Developer Transformation (DevTx) team interacts with software development teams in leading companies to innovate and deliver mission-critical business solutions on top of AWS services.

Basic Qualifications

  • degree in advanced technology, or 10+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience
  • 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • The right person will have passion for software development, application architecture and technology in general, as well as a desire to work with, educate and inspire a community of developers
  • Ability to work with all levels of customer engagement – start-ups, enterprises, mid-market, and the ability to organize and explain complex technical concepts to development teams and executive-level audiences
  • Outstanding verbal and written communications skills are a must, with the ability to communicate complex ideas and concepts clearly in one-to-one and one-to-many public presentations

Preferred Qualifications

  • In-depth working knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and experience designing, developing, refactoring and operating distributed applications - based on event-driven microservice architectures - that take full advantage of a leading cloud platform
  • Hands-on experience with a selection of programming languages, tools and frameworks (e.g. C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, .NET, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Rust) and cloud-centric technology domains such as Serverless, Containers, Big Data, Analytics, Machine Learning, high-performance databases (SQL and NoSQL), complex networking implementations, and highly secured workloads.
  • Knowledge of or experience with AI-driven coding assistants and tools that accelerate the design, development and deployment of enterprise grade software
  • Experience working in a customer-facing role or a role which involved public speaking

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Recruiting Senior Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Recruiting Analyst

This role would involve Sourcing, recruiting, screening, interviews and recommends external and/or internal candidates for all level jobs. Person may utilize the services of employment agencies, place employment ads in appropriate sources, including the Internet and print media. Ensures the maintenance of accurate and concise records and reports concerning all phases of the recruitment process

Brief Job Description:

Are you a recruitment powerhouse ready to shape the future of talent acquisition. Vertiv India is seeking a passionate Talent Acquisition Partner to lead our recruitment initiatives and redefine the landscape of talent acquisition.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Forge Collaborative Relationships: Build robust connections with key stakeholders and hiring managers, elevating the visibility of our Recruitment Team through proactive engagement.
  • Strategic Direction: Craft and implement strategic recruitment directions alongside our team, shaping the future of talent acquisition at Vertiv.
  • Innovative Solutions: Develop and deliver cutting-edge presentations, offering insight into market trends, specialist recruitment strategies, and forecasting.
  • Streamlined Recruitment: Collaborate with hiring managers to craft detailed recruitment plans, ensuring a robust candidate pipeline for each vacancy.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Provide regular reports and market information to hiring managers, empowering them with actionable insights.
  • Creative Sourcing: Implement creative solutions to source top-tier candidates, fostering relationships with recruitment suppliers and driving candidate generation.
  • Exceptional Support: Offer candidates and managers comprehensive CV and interview feedback, ensuring a seamless recruitment experience.
  • Continuous Improvement: Contribute to project work, refining recruitment processes, and delivering impactful training sessions within the team.

Qualifications

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • A master's degree or MBA related to Human Resource is preferred.
  • Recruitment Expertise: Proven success in recruitment, handling permanent roles.
  • Min of 4 to 7 years of progressive Recruiting experience with strong exposure in Head hunting, Passive sourcing, Social Media Recruiting.
  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to effectively liaise with clients, showcasing a positive, decisive, and forward-thinking approach.
  • Proficiency in using applicant tracking systems (ATS) and recruitment software.
  • Strategic Insight: Strong reasoning, reporting, and organizational skills, complemented by excellent presentation abilities.
  • Industry Acumen: Sound understanding of market sectors, competitors, and adept problem-solving and negotiation skills.
  • Professional Acumen: Project professionalism, influence at all levels, and network within large client sites.
  • Resilience and Drive: A resilient, flexible attitude coupled with an achievement orientation, driving activities to successful conclusions.

Preferred Experience:

  • On-Site Proficiency: Experience in on-site environments or familiarity with on-site interview demands.
  • Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing complex accounts and client situations, including competency-based interviewing.

job.title: Lead Data Center Delivery Engineer
job.description:
About Submer

Submer designs and delivers end-to-end AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling.

We help organizations scale AI beyond the limits of traditional datacenters by enabling higher density, greater efficiency and lower environmental impact – accelerating time-to-AI from first deployment to full production.

What impact you'll have

The Lead Data Center Delivery Engineer is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of Submer's modular data center deployments. You will personally own the technical execution of deployments in the field, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) integration, on-site installation and commissioning, and the hands-on troubleshooting that gets systems live and stable, while leading two project teams across two geographies.

You will lead a full execution team based in India that drives development and build-out of the modular systems, and a customer-facing engineering team based in the United States that handles on-site adjustments, modifications, and customer-specific requirements. Your job is to connect the two: making sure what is developed in India translates cleanly into field-ready systems the US team can adapt and deploy.

This is deliberately not a director or VP seat in name only. We are hiring a builder who has done the work on the product themselves, deployed data centers with their own hands, and still wants to be on site with the equipment while leading the teams that build and adapt it.

What you'll do

  • Lead two project teams
  • Lead the India-based full execution team that drives development and build-out of Submer's modular data center systems.
  • Lead the US-based, customer-facing engineering team that handles on-site adjustments, modifications, and customer-specific requirements.
  • Own the handoffs and a clear working rhythm between the two teams so development in India feeds directly into field execution in the US.
  • Set the technical standard across both teams, resolve conflicts, and keep development and field work aligned to the same specifications.
  • Deployment Execution
  • Lead modular data center deployments end to end, from site readiness through installation, commissioning, and handover to the customer.
  • Own deployment schedules and on-site sequencing, and keep work moving against timeline and budget.
  • Coordinate with product, manufacturing, and logistics to make sure systems arrive site-ready and install as designed.
  • MEP & Systems Integration
  • Own MEP integration on site: mechanical and cooling systems, electrical distribution and power, and plumbing / fluid systems.
  • Review and validate mechanical and electrical designs against real site conditions and adjust in the field when conditions differ from the plan.
  • Stand up the basic networking and controls needed to bring monitoring, telemetry, and management systems online at deployment sites.
  • Commissioning & Troubleshooting
  • Drive systems through commissioning, functional testing, and stable operation before handover.
  • Troubleshoot faults hands-on during installation and commissioning and drive issues to resolution rather than escalating them away.
  • Enforce safe work practices and compliance with site safety and data center standards throughout execution.

What you'll bring

  • A degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical, or related) or equivalent hands-on field experience.
  • Direct, hands-on experience deploying and commissioning data centers, on the product itself, not solely in an oversight or program-management capacity.
  • Strong working knowledge of MEP systems and practical experience integrating mechanical, electrical, and plumbing on live sites.
  • Hands-on competence in electrical systems: power distribution, and safe work practices in a data center environment.
  • Hands-on competence in mechanical systems: cooling loops, pumps, heat exchangers, and fluid handling.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, CREO or SolidWorks, and specialized structural or piping software. Proficiency in thermal-fluid systems design, mechanical packaging, and system-level integration.
  • Strong knowledge of Cooling and Server systems Deep knowledge of closed-loop fluid dynamics, structural piping design, materials compatibility.
  • Working understanding of networking sufficient to stand up monitoring, controls, and management connectivity at a site.
  • Experience leading technical teams and, ideally, coordinating work across multiple sites or geographies (a distributed development and field team).
  • Willingness to work on-site in the Houston area, coordinate with a team in India across time zones, and travel to deployment locations as needed.

Desired Attributes

  • Direct experience with modular, prefabricated, or containerized data center deployments.
  • Experience managing distributed or offshore engineering teams and translating development work into field execution.
  • Data center commissioning credentials or MEP / electrical / mechanical certifications.
  • Experience deploying high-density, AI, or HPC infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with data center standards and site safety requirements (e.g., Uptime Institute, NFPA, OSHA).
  • A strong bias for action, resourcefulness on site, and a drive to leave each deployment better documented than the last.

What we offer

  • Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and hands-on experience.
  • The opportunity to build the infrastructure behind sustainable, high-performance computing.
  • A dynamic, diverse, and mission-driven environment inside a fast-growing scale-up.

_Our job titles may span more than one job level. Actual base pay depends on factors such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and market demand._

Our commitment to inclusion

Submer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law.

Job Title

Field Installer Repairer - Multiple Locations

Job Summary

The Field - Installer Repairer is key to delivering end-to-end installation of Telstra’s telecommunications networks. It plays a vital role in delivering end-to-end installation of Telstra’s telecommunications networks.

Job Description

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will work without immediate supervision or direction to provide our customers with a great experience by activating and assuring telecommunications / technology products and services, in the home and/or business.

You will actively participate in a diverse team environment to deliver the optimum customer and commercial outcomes aligned to the corporate strategy.

We have several positions available around the country. Find the specific locations below. The expectation is to reside in the targeted area or be willing to relocate.

What we can offer:

  • Everything from head to toe. From the vehicle, tools, and equipment through to the full uniform, we provide it all.
  • Pay for performance. We recognise outstanding contributions through our competitive incentive programs.
  • 8-hour shifts, Mon-Fri. Overtime when required.
  • Parental Leave. A gender-equal policy for all parent/s so you can choose how and when you take your leave (16 weeks full pay or 32 weeks half pay). Receive superannuation contributions on paid and unpaid parental leave.
  • Industry recognised training & unlimited learning. Take part in industry recognised training courses and level up your skills with access to 17,000 on-demand learning programs.
  • Extra perks. Receive 30% off Telstra products and services, plus unlock exclusive discounts from over 240 brands and partners.
  • Plus so much more!

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver seamless service rectification and product installations, to the full satisfaction of Telstra’s customers.
  • Copper cable maintenance and installation including fault finding, jointing, jumpering, and networking.
  • Maintenance and management of Fibre network technology, Core network technology and Data services
  • Customer Premises Equipment maintenance and installation (both consumer and business).
  • Fault finding over copper networks in a rural or remote setting.

Qualifications

You will be required to hold and maintain the relevant and applicable licenses and qualifications to perform this role, as deemed mandatory by regulatory and legal authorities and must also maintain a current driver’s license.

  • Certificate III in Telecommunications
  • Open cabling license
  • Traffic management qualifications
  • An industry white card

Telstra can support you through offering training on Traffic management and white card certificates. This role requires the successful candidate to be vaccinated against Covid-19, to ensure the safety and wellbeing of our people and customers. However, please speak to us if you have any questions about this based on your individual circumstances.

If this opportunity sounds like a perfect fit for you, we'd encourage you to apply!

job.title: 5144 - Project Manager, In-Life Infrastructure
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

NTT Global Data Centers is a member of the NTT Group of companies and is one of the leading Data Center providers in with facilities located in across the world. NTT GDC have In-Life expansion projects across the region.

NTT GDC is seeking an In-Life Project Manager to join its Technical Operations team which is responsible for supporting the operational requirement of the region in line with NTT GDC policies and procedures.

The Project Manager, In-Life in conjunction with the In-Life Project Delivery Leader will co-ordinate and facilitate In-Life projects across a regional cluster. The Project Manager, In-Life will work to ensure projects are delivered on time, correctly and to budget. They will clearly communicate project status and business risks to all key stakeholders.

Project Manager, In-Life will work with all the regional teams to ensure that the “Zero Outage” mentality, processes and procedures are maintained in the field of project delivery.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Project Planning: Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders. Develop comprehensive project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation. Identify and manage project dependencies, risks and issues.
  • Project Execution: Coordinate and lead project teams, ensuring tasks are completed on schedule and within budget. Monitor project progress, ensuring tasks are completed on schedule and within budget. Monitor project progress, identify potential roadblocks, and take proactive measures to keep the project on track. Conduct regular meetings and provide project updates to stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder Management: Engage and communicate with stakeholders at all levels to understand project requirements, expectations, and changes. Foster positive relationships and ensure alignment on project objectives. Manage stakeholder feedback, address concerns, and negotiate changes when necessary.
  • Resource Management: Allocate resources effectively to meet project goals. Coordinate with functional managers to secure necessary resources, including personnel and equipment. Optimize resource utilization and maintain a balanced workload across the project team.
  • Quality Assurance: Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and fulfil customer requirements. Implement effective quality assurance processes and conduct regular reviews to identify and address any quality issues. Collaborate with the quality assurance team to ensure adherence to best practices.
  • Risk Management: Identify project risks and develop risk mitigation strategies. Proactively monitor and manage risks throughout the project lifecycle. Escalate critical rises to senior management and recommend appropriate action plans.
  • Project / Programme Documentation: Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including project charters, plans, schedules, budgets, and status reports. Ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation is accessible to relevant stakeholders. Facilitate knowledge transfer and lessons learned sessions to improve future project execution.

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

  • Excellent knowledge and understanding of working within a matrixed global organisation
  • Excellent project management skills
  • Assertive in approach coupled with confidence in the area of expertise and the ability to facilitate business conversations
  • Excellent client engagement and relationship building skills
  • Ability to persuade, negotiate and influence key stakeholders
  • Good conceptual insight and ability to think strategically
  • Excellent ability to establish and manage processes and practices through collaboration and the understanding of business
  • Ability to manage assigned work processes
  • Ability to manage urgent tasks simultaneously
  • Display excellent influencing and negotiating ability
  • Display credible writing ability motivational and inspirational leaders
  • Ability to display superior decision-making skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent business acumen knowledge
  • Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of information requires evaluation of identifiable factors
  • Resolves and assesses a wide range of issues in creative ways and suggests variations in approach

Academic Qualifications and Certifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Project Management
  • PMP Qualification preferred

Required Experience:

  • Seasoned demonstrable experience working in a similar position in a global organization
  • Seasoned experience overseeing projects through the full life cycle
  • Seasoned demonstrated experience in working closely with a variety of internal and external stakeholders at different levels in the business
  • Seasoned stakeholder engagement experience at all levels in the organization
  • Seasoned experience operationally managing a team

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: IBMS Design Engineer
job.description:
About Submer

Submer enables organizations scaling AI to overcome the limits of traditional datacenters across power, compute density and efficiency.

We design and deliver scalable, high-density AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling, supporting everything from early AI deployments to full-scale production environments.

Acting as a full-stack delivery partner, Submer provides advisory, design, build and IT integration through a single point of accountability, working with a deep ecosystem of technology specialists. This end-to-end approach accelerates time-to-AI while reducing operational cost, complexity and environmental impact.

The result is AI infrastructure that performs today, scales predictably and avoids the redesigns and inefficiencies slowing the market down.

What impact you will have

The role is responsible for :the design, development and integration of building management systems and the controls that run our modular MEP platforms for data centers. This role is responsible for the full controls stack: architecture, PLC/SCADA programming, data integration, control logic, sequencing and system-level validation.

You’ll work closely with mechanical, electrical, and systems architects to define how each MEP module is monitored, automated and coordinated so the entire facility operates reliably and efficiently. You’ll also guide best practices, review vendor implementations and help shape the long-term controls roadmap.

What you’ll do

  • Own the architecture and development of control systems across cooling, power, plumbing and support utilities.
  • Design and integration of PA, FA, Rodent repellant, WLD, BMS, ASD, Security and access control, CCTV system etc.
  • Define control strategies, sequences of operation, alarm logic, failover logic and interlocks across mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Develop PLC, HMI and SCADA code and oversee software integration with building management systems, EPMS and monitoring platforms.
  • Produce control architecture diagrams, network layouts, data models and interface specifications.
  • Perform cross-functional design reviews to ensure control systems align with mechanical, electrical and systems architecture requirements.
  • Review and approve vendor controls submittals, functional specifications, hardware selections and software implementations.
  • Validate system performance during FAT, SAT and commissioning, including troubleshooting controls, sensors, networks and automation workflows.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity and IT teams to ensure controls networks meet security and reliability requirements.
  • Mentor controls engineers and support training for engineering, operations and commissioning teams.
  • Support continuous improvement of the MEP modules by identifying opportunities for automation, optimization and predictive insights.

What you’ll need

  • Bachelor’s degree Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering or related discipline.
  • 8+ years of experience in IBMS solutions design, controls engineering, automation or industrial software development, ideally with mission-critical facilities or modular equipment.
  • Hands-on experience with PLC programming (Allen-Bradley, Siemens or equivalent) and HMI/SCADA platforms.
  • Solid understanding of control theory, sequencing, PID loops, interlocks and safety logic.
  • Familiarity with building utilities and mechanical and electrical systems found in data centers (cooling systems, switchgear, power distribution, pumps, valves, sensors).
  • Experience with industrial communication protocols (Modbus, BACnet, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP).
  • Ability to read and produce P&IDs, control narratives, wiring diagrams and network architecture documents.
  • Experience with commissioning, field testing and troubleshooting automation systems.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.
  • Experience leading smaller teams or mentoring engineers in a controls environment.

What we offer

  • Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
  • A great work environment characterized by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
  • You´ll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

Our job titles may span more than one job level. The actual base pay is dependent on a number of factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands.

Our inclusive responsibility

Submer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law.

job.title: Senior Construction Scheduler
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Sr. Construction Scheduler is responsible for reviewing and analyzing General Contractors’ schedules and reporting on schedule health to the Project Team and other key stakeholders. This role involves working closely with NTT’s Construction Team and General Contractors to drive consistency, accountability, and adherence to established scheduling standards across all projects.

The Construction Scheduler will also support the analysis of schedule delays by reviewing, summarizing, and comparing General Contractors’ Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) against other available project data. This position plays an integral role in providing data-driven insights to enhance project predictability. Additionally, the Construction Scheduler will be responsible for collecting as-built data.

What we are looking for

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES

  • Lead baseline schedule development by partnering with NTT’s General Contractors to establish accurate, fully logic-driven project baselines.
  • Review General Contractors’ project schedules to identify potential risks, constraints, and sequencing issues, with a proactive focus on mitigation and recovery strategies.
  • Develop periodic schedule reports and proactively communicate schedule risks and performance trends to the Project stakeholders.
  • Ensure client-specific scheduling requirements are met, including compliance with contractual obligations, reporting standards, and project specific deliverables.
  • Develop schedule what-if scenarios and perform comparative schedule assessments to inform and drive data-based decision making.
  • Champion and support the implementation of scheduling best practices across GID, driving standardization of processes, templates, coding structures, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency, data integrity, and alignment with portfolio-level controls and governance standards.
  • Develop meaningful scheduling key performance indicators (KPIs) that accurately reflect project progress at any given point in time, enabling clear visibility into performance against baseline.
  • Review Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) and provide structured feedback to the Construction Team and General Contractors.
  • Partner with project stakeholders to support planning efforts and maintain schedule control throughout the project lifecycle by developing and managing internal schedules that accurately reflect current progress across all phases.
  • Lead schedule progress meetings with the Construction Team and General Contractors to review status, validate updates, and address variances.
  • Perform any other related tasks as required.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Fully versed in Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling requirements for construction projects, including development and maintenance of logic-driven schedules, critical path analysis, risk assessment, and adherence to contractual scheduling specifications.
  • Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM) and the ability to apply its principles in internal schedule and performance reporting.
  • Proficient in Primavera (P6) and Microsoft Project (MSP) scheduling software.
  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications to analyze and evaluate contractor-produced schedules.
  • Excellent analytical skills, creative thinking ability, and strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience reviewing Time Impact Analyses (TIAs) and recovery schedules to assess schedule impacts and proposed mitigation strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to clearly set and lead meetings to develop strong project control systems
  • Ability to be highly confidential.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Ability to manage stress effectively in a fast-paced work environment.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Professional certification such as PSP is preferred.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • 8 - 12 years of experience in construction scheduling, including baseline schedule development, critical path and variance analysis, earned value management (EVM), and forensic schedule analysis.
  • Experience with Data Center construction projects is preferred.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Primarily sitting with some walking, standing, and bending.
  • Able to hear and speak into a telephone.
  • Close visual work on a computer terminal.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate any required computer keyboard, mouse, and other technical instruments.
  • Able to lift and carry up to 20 lbs.

Work conditions & other requirements

  • Standard office; Data Center environment with varying temperatures and loud noises; extensive daily usage of workstation or computer.
  • This role is expected to be remote with an occasional need to be on-site and/or construction jobsite.
  • Ability to travel up to 25%.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Manager Solution Engineering provides managerial, oversight and tactical direction to India region Solution Engineering, responsible for developing and delivering innovative and effective solutions that meet customer needs and drive business growth. This role is technical and managerial, specifically focused on helping close neocloud, enterprise, and retail business via data center and wholesale product knowledge, presentation, solution design, quoting, and leading tours of the NTT GDC facilities. While the role is focused on neocloud/enterprise customers, occasional support for closing hyperscale deals will be required. Solutions are win-win focused to maximize NTT GDC and customer’s value. The Senior Manager India region Solution Engineering will ensure the highest standards of technical excellence and customer satisfaction, contributing to the overall success of the organization. This role requires a tactical and technical oriented thinker with a deep understanding of data center infrastructure including electrical, mechanical, liquid cooling, telecom/fiber, security (MEP/T) technologies and neoloud/enterprise customer requirements. The candidate shall be capable to manage a diverse team of engineers and work collaboratively across various departments.

What we are looking for

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

& RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Work closely with Director of Solution Engineering at a global level, and execute the overall tactical requirements for the India region Solution Engineering team in alignment with company goals and objectives.
  • Lead, and manage a team of highly skilled solution engineers in India, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee the design, development, and delivery of complex MEP/T solutions, ensuring they meet the highest standards of quality and performance.
  • Drive innovation within the Solution Engineering team, staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies.
  • Work with the Product team and assist in facility space planning and management.
  • Demonstrate expert understanding of data center design concepts and differentiators (liquid cooling, maintainable fault tolerant power, security redundancy, etc.).
  • Review lease terms and aligns with the customer’s technical requirements.
  • Ensure effective communication and coordination between the Solution Engineering team and other departments
  • Work closely with sales, product management, bid management, design, construction, operations and customer support teams to ensure seamless integration of solutions and successful project delivery.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES

  • Leadership and people management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think strategically and make data-driven decisions.
  • A thorough understanding of modern data center and IT client requirements and environments with a primary focus on wholesale customers and their data center requirements.
  • Comfortable to evaluate and delve deep into any MEP/T concepts and single line diagrams and work with customer technical teams to integrate their requirements into our data centers.
  • Engage customers to extract critical technical and business drivers that may position client deliverables.
  • Effective at working with 3rd party contractors and vendors to aid in the design of large customer infrastructure deployment requirements.
  • Excellent problem solver/creative thinker.
  • Comfortable speaking/presenting to groups of all sizes.
  • Proficient with software application such as AutoCAD, CFD Modeling, Visio, Word, Excel, Power Point, Project Outlook, SharePoint and Salesforce.
  • Able to work in a team/cross-team/multi-site environment.
  • Manages stress and/or fast-pace effectively.
  • Ability to develop and write a bill of materials and scope of work to meet large customer infrastructure deployment requirements.
  • Maintains familiarity with competitive offerings to effectively position products and solutions in a competitive environment.
  • Must possess effective oral and written communications and strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Must be a master storyteller and presenter.

Education & Experience

  • At least 10 years experience in a similar role within a related environment with particular exposure to the design and installation of data center mechanical, electrical, Telecom, Security systems, Liquid Cooling.
  • Highly preferred: Four-year college engineering or engineering technology degree or bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering from an accredited institution.
  • Previous experience operationally managing a sales engineering team
  • Extensive technical pre-sales with MEP/T engineering experience
  • Extensive experience dealing with stakeholders to influence sales
  • Extensive previous experience in the sales operations / effectiveness management role
  • Extensive strategic and solid operational planning experience
  • Extensive budget and financial management experience

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Primarily sitting for extended periods
  • Ability walk and lead technical tours throughout data center.

Work conditions & other requirements

  • Preference is for Mumbai-based candidate.
  • Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.
  • Exposure to outdoor weather conditions.
  • Travel required 25% of time.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

30 Aug 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Field Installer Repairer - Casino

Job Summary

The Field - Installer Repairer is key to delivering end-to-end installation of Telstra’s telecommunications networks. It plays a vital role in delivering end-to-end installation of Telstra’s telecommunications networks.

Job Description

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will work without immediate supervision or direction to provide our customers with a great experience by activating and assuring telecommunications / technology products and services, in the home and/or business.

You will actively participate in a diverse team environment to deliver the optimum customer and commercial outcomes aligned to the corporate strategy.

We have several positions available around the country. Find the specific locations below. The expectation is to reside in the targeted area or be willing to relocate.

What we can offer:

  • Everything from head to toe. From the vehicle, tools, and equipment through to the full uniform, we provide it all.
  • Pay for performance. We recognise outstanding contributions through our competitive incentive programs.
  • 8-hour shifts, Mon-Fri. Overtime when required.
  • Parental Leave. A gender-equal policy for all parent/s so you can choose how and when you take your leave (16 weeks full pay or 32 weeks half pay). Receive superannuation contributions on paid and unpaid parental leave.
  • Industry recognised training & unlimited learning. Take part in industry recognised training courses and level up your skills with access to 17,000 on-demand learning programs.
  • Extra perks. Receive 30% off Telstra products and services, plus unlock exclusive discounts from over 240 brands and partners.
  • Plus so much more!

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver seamless service rectification and product installations, to the full satisfaction of Telstra’s customers.
  • Copper cable maintenance and installation including fault finding, jointing, jumpering, and networking.
  • Maintenance and management of Fibre network technology, Core network technology and Data services
  • Customer Premises Equipment maintenance and installation (both consumer and business).
  • Fault finding over copper networks in a rural or remote setting.

Qualifications

You will be required to hold and maintain the relevant and applicable licenses and qualifications to perform this role, as deemed mandatory by regulatory and legal authorities and must also maintain a current driver’s license.

  • Certificate III in Telecommunications
  • Open cabling license
  • Traffic management qualifications
  • An industry white card

Telstra can support you through offering training on Traffic management and white card certificates. This role requires the successful candidate to be vaccinated against Covid-19, to ensure the safety and wellbeing of our people and customers. However, please speak to us if you have any questions about this based on your individual circumstances.

If this opportunity sounds like a perfect fit for you, we'd encourage you to apply!

Current locations in demand:

  • Casino

When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued, and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, and abilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive.

We work flexibly at Telstra, talk to us about what flexibility means to you. When you apply, you can share your pronouns and /or any reasonable adjustments needed to take part equitably during the recruitment process.

job.title: Specialist - Data Centre Operations
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The role of Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

This role designs, plans, installs, and / or maintains mechanical, electrical, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability data center environments.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Assist in scheduling and supervising vendors/subcontractors during equipment / systems maintenance and service.
  • Provides recommendation of improvements to the operations and maintenance program on an on-going basis.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Seasoned understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Seasoned proficiency of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Seasoned knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Seasoned knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.)

  • Experience required:
  • Seasoned experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Seasoned experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Seasoned experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Seasoned experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Seasoned experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.
