job.title: Data Science Specialist
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

9 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Data Science Specialist

Job Summary

As a Data Science Analyst, you are proactive and curious about finding hidden patterns in data to deliver better customer and business outcomes. You collaborate with your colleagues to drive data led decision making across Telstra. By supporting the business to identify opportunities and risks you are central to our success.

Job Description

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

This includes making Telstra the place you want to work.

For you, that means a having career that grows with you, and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises well-being and choice.

Here’s what you can expect from us

  • Flexible working. Wherever you live, choose where, when, and how you work so you can be at your best.
  • There when life happens. From Gender Affirmation Leave to Telstra’s Additional Leave Day, we give you time to spend away from work when you need it most.
  • Pay for performance. We recognize outstanding contributions through our generous incentive programs.
  • Parental Leave. A gender-equal policy for parents so you can choose how and when you take your leave (16 weeks full pay or 32 weeks half pay). Receive superannuation contributions on paid and unpaid parental leave.
  • Unlimited learning. Level up your credentials with access to 17,000 learning programs. Learn ‘on the job’ and achieve university credits toward degrees and Master's programs.
  • Global presence. With a global presence across 22 countries, there are many opportunities to work where we do business.
  • Extra perks. Receive 25% off Telstra products and services, plus unlock exclusive discounts from over 240 brands and partners.

Make a Difference

As a Data Science Analyst, you are proactive and curious about finding hidden patterns in data to deliver better customer and business outcomes. You collaborate with your colleagues to drive data led decision making across Telstra. By supporting the business to identify opportunities and risks you are central to our success.

Support with development of complex analytical and reporting solutions for stakeholders based on diverse data sources and automated dataflows critical to Operations and Infrastructure.

The role is pivotal in enabling data-driven decision-making across Operations and Infrastructure. This role combines business acumen with technical expertise to design, automate, and implement analytics solutions using diverse data sources. The analyst develops clear, actionable and insight-driven dashboards to track investment outcomes, ensure compliance, support planning and forecasting growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

This is how you’ll bring the purpose of your role to life.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand and define business problems, translating the business needs into actionable insights, and undertake relevant reporting solutions following an Agile framework.
  • Produce clear and concise reports and dashboards that communicate key findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the business.
  • Continuously enhance dashboard functionality based on user feedback and evolving business requirements.
  • Build, automate and maintain complex analytics on performance management to identify opportunities and risks and maximise performance for business areas.
  • Analyse complex data sets and identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and insights using various data analysis techniques and tools such as SQL, Power BI, R/Python.
  • Perform in-depth quantitative analysis, articulate complex data patterns using descriptive analysis, and prepare data using statistical models for use in predictive/prescriptive analysis.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders to identify and define KPIs that align with the business objectives, and develop, and track to monitor operational and strategic performance.
  • Build and maintain scalable dataflows and pipelines ensuring data quality and integrity.
  • Use Power Platform tools such as Flows and PowerApps to automate reporting and optimise processes.
  • Contribute to building a strong team dynamic so working together is fun and everyone thrives.
  • Significantly drive continuous improvement, transformation and efficiency into current reporting and analytics processes, including driving self-serve ability across the organisation.
  • Understanding of cloud data analytics technology stack and their application to explore and pilot predictive analytical solutions using Fabric, AI, Lake.

About you

To be successful in the role, you'll bring skills and experience in:

Essential Skills

  • 4+ years’ experience in data science, analytics, reporting and business intelligence.
  • Experience working within Agile frameworks and methodologies, using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Stakeholder collaboration, business engagement and process lifecycle management experience.
  • Ability to document complex business requirements and translate them into actionable reporting insights.
  • Define KPIs with stakeholders and develop measures to track risk, compliance and operational outcomes.
  • Strong analytics capability across root cause, statistical, descriptive, predictive and prescriptive analysis.
  • Experience building ETL pipelines, ingestion strategies and scalable data preparation processes.
  • Advanced Power BI, Power Query, dataflows and semantic models to develop dashboards and reporting.
  • Power Platform, Power Automate, PowerApps, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, lakehouse architecture and notebooks.
  • Enterprise data modelling using star and snowflake schemas to improve efficiency, consistency and reusability.
  • Clear communication, structured problem solving and attention to detail in a collaborative team environment.

Desirable Skills

  • Experience working with Python, Databricks and data warehouse platforms.
  • Understanding of AI models, including generative AI and agentic AI capabilities.
  • Prior experience in telecommunications, critical infrastructure and/or asset management sectors.
  • Understanding of data management principles, including governance, process automation and audit trails.
  • Experience working across risk, compliance and operational efficiency domains.

If you are passionate to succeed as part of an agile and experienced team, we welcome you to apply! -------------------------------------

We encourage applications from people of all abilities and backgrounds - including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, the LGBQTI+ community, linguistically diverse, and people living with disability. When you apply, you can choose to note the pronouns you use and /or any reasonable adjustments needed to take part equitably during the interview process. Visit www.telstra.com.au/careers/diversity-and-inclusion or email us at DisabilityandAccessibility@team.telstra.com noting your preferred method of contact

job.title: Senior Quality Commissioning Specialist - Construction Projects
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Quality Commissioning Specialist - Construction Projects is a highly skilled subject matter expert, responsible for supporting with the management of on-site quality and commissioning activities. This role supports with the implementation and management of the quality and commissioning process for Global Data Center facilities on time and on budget. The process is designed to identify and resolve issues early in the design and construction process to ensure quality, reliability, safety, and cost effectiveness of Global Data Center projects.

This role is responsible for ensuring that equipment and systems are functioning at the efficiency level for which they were designed. This includes development of a project specific quality-oriented Commissioning Process for achieving, verifying, and documenting that the performance of the facilities, systems, and assemblies meets the defined objectives and criteria.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and implementation of Project Quality Management Plans (PQMPs) and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) for data center construction projects.
  • Ensure compliance with approved quality procedures, method statements, project specifications, and industry standards throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Facilitate quality planning meetings, quality reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance project delivery and quality performance.
  • Monitor, track, and report project quality KPIs and performance metrics.

Construction Quality Oversight

  • Oversee quality inspections and compliance activities for civil, structural, and architectural works, including foundations, concrete works, structural steel, roofing, raised floors, waterproofing, and façade systems.
  • Review material approvals, testing results, inspection records, and construction documentation to ensure adherence to project requirements.
  • Conduct punch-list inspections and support final acceptance activities.

MEP Quality Assurance

  • Verify installation quality and compliance of critical mechanical systems, including cooling plants, chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, cooling towers, HVAC systems, piping networks, fuel systems, and water treatment systems.
  • Witness and review mechanical testing activities such as pressure testing, flushing, cleaning, balancing, and mechanical completion processes.
  • Inspect and verify electrical systems including utility connections, generators, UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, busways, grounding systems, and battery installations.
  • Witness electrical testing activities including insulation resistance, continuity, relay testing, and energization readiness.
  • Ensure plumbing and fire protection systems are installed and tested in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and applicable codes.

Inspection, Testing & Commissioning

  • Conduct routine quality surveillance inspections across all construction phases.
  • Review contractor quality documentation and inspection records.
  • Witness Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT), Site Acceptance Tests (SAT), and Integrated Systems Testing (IST).
  • Validate Mechanical Completion (MC), Substantial Completion, and commissioning readiness requirements.
  • Support Level 1–5 commissioning activities, including pre-functional and functional testing.
  • Confirm system quality readiness prior to start-up, energization, and client handover.

Non-Conformance & Quality Improvement

  • Manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and drive timely resolution of quality issues.
  • Lead root cause investigations and verify implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).
  • Escalate critical quality concerns and risks to project leadership as required.
  • Promote a culture of quality and continuous improvement across project teams and contractors.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain complete and accurate quality records, turnover documentation, inspection reports, and quality dossiers.
  • Prepare and present weekly and monthly quality performance reports.
  • Track key quality metrics such as NCR closure rate, first-time-pass inspection rate, audit compliance, commissioning readiness, and documentation completion.
  • Support mechanical completion verification, commissioning readiness assessments, and final quality handover packages.

Vendor & Contractor Quality Management

  • Conduct quality audits of contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors.
  • Review vendor quality plans, manufacturing records, and supplier documentation.
  • Participate in factory audits and manufacturing inspections to ensure compliance with project quality requirements.
  • Monitor contractor quality performance and drive adherence to project standards and expectations.
  • Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of data center design, construction, and commissioning practices.
  • Knowledge of critical environment infrastructure and mission-critical facility requirements.
  • In-depth understanding of mechanical cooling systems, including chillers, cooling plants, CRAH/CRAC units, HVAC systems, and associated piping networks.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical power distribution systems, including generators, UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, grounding, and battery systems.
  • Understanding of commissioning processes, mechanical completion, integrated systems testing, and commissioning readiness requirements.
  • Knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS) and construction quality assurance and control programs.
  • Familiarity with inspection, testing, verification, and acceptance methodologies across construction and commissioning activities.
  • Understanding of international and industry standards, including:

ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems ASHRAE Guidelines Uptime Institute Standards TIA-942 NFPA Standards IEC Standards IEEE Standards Local building codes and regulatory requirements Knowledge of Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) requirements applicable to construction projects. Professional Skills

  • Expertise in QA/QC management and construction quality processes.
  • Strong inspection planning and execution capabilities.
  • Experience in root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action management.
  • Working knowledge of MEP systems and critical infrastructure installations.
  • Ability to conduct quality audits and assess contractor, supplier, and vendor performance.
  • Experience in commissioning readiness reviews, quality verification, and project handover activities.
  • Knowledge of quality metrics, reporting, and performance monitoring.

Leadership & Behavioral Attributes

  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence project teams and contractors.
  • Effective stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to evaluate complex technical and quality-related issues.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality excellence.
  • Proactive approach to identifying and mitigating project risks.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced project environment.
  • Collaborative and team-oriented with a focus on achieving project quality objectives.

job.description:

Your role at a glance

The role of Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

This role designs, plans, installs, and / or maintains mechanical, electrical, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability data center environments.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Assist in scheduling and supervising vendors/subcontractors during equipment / systems maintenance and service.
  • Provides recommendation of improvements to the operations and maintenance program on an on-going basis.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Seasoned understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Seasoned proficiency of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Seasoned knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Seasoned knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.)

  • Seasoned experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.

  • Seasoned experience in facilities / building maintenance.

job.title: 5264 - Project Manager, Service Operations
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

Responsible for implementing and deploying infrastructure-related requirements for NTT customers and internal NTT stakeholders within the assigned region, the Project Manager oversees the full project lifecycle for IT, data center, and capital expenditure projects ranging from small and medium deployments to enterprise and select hyperscale initiatives. This position independently plans and manages project scope, timelines, resources, quality, cost, and risk while maintaining a strong focus on health and safety, customer service, and business continuity. The role ensures projects are delivered on time, with high quality, and within budget; communicates status, risks, and business impacts to key stakeholders; and provides a consistent approach to project structure, documentation, delivery, asset management, and closeout. The Project Manager is also accountable for quality assurance of installation and de-installation activities, delivery of critical facility documentation, and maintenance of as-built specifications in accordance with Service Operations records retention standards, while supporting regional alignment with the “Minimum Downtime, Maximum Uptime” mentality, processes, and procedures.

What we are looking for

KEY responsibilities

  • Lead client-facing and internal infrastructure projects from pre-implementation through closeout, ensuring contracted services are delivered on time, within budget, and in accordance with customer requirements, specifications, and contractual obligations.
  • Define project scope, objectives, milestones, tasks, assumptions, risks, dependencies, resource needs, schedules, and delivery plans in coordination with stakeholders, technical teams, contractors, vendors, and internal departments.
  • Review and verify customer requirements, Basis of Design, drawings, contractor documentation, method statements, and risk assessments to ensure alignment with required specifications, installation standards, Health & Safety expectations, and Business Continuity requirements.
  • Coordinate, supervise, and report on implementation activities with Service Operations contractors and internal teams, including equipment orders, shipments, site activities, quality assurance testing, and closeout deliverables.
  • Maintain an onsite presence as required to support project execution, coordinate with contractors and internal teams, validate installation progress, address field issues, and ensure work is completed in accordance with project requirements and site expectations.
  • Identify construction issues, defects, project risks, change requests, and client or team escalations; perform analysis, recommend solutions, and communicate impacts, decisions, and next steps to management, clients, and project stakeholders.
  • Prepare, maintain, and publish project documentation, schedules, Methods of Procedure, status reports, action items, owners, due dates, account documentation, as-built records, and related project artifacts using approved tools such as Microsoft Project and SharePoint.
  • Schedule and facilitate project status meetings with clients, vendors, contractors, and internal project teams to review progress, address risks and issues, track decisions, and maintain alignment across stakeholders.
  • Track, maintain, and report project financial performance in real time, including budgets, costs, deviations, procurement requirements, fair quoting or tendering practices, and updates needed to support value for money and policy compliance.
  • Ensure product quality, manufacturing readiness, serviceability, installation quality, and quality assurance metrics meet applicable standards and support successful project delivery.
  • Conduct site reviews, perform ad-hoc analysis, prepare or update business cases, and provide recommendations that support project governance, decision-making, business benefit realization, and transition of project outputs into business-as-usual operations.
  • Develop and maintain project management frameworks, process improvements, procedure revisions, and performance practices that support departmental objectives, customer service expectations, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Support strategic departmental objectives, adhere to safety reporting and compliance expectations, and perform other duties as assigned.
  • Support training fellow peers by sharing project management best practices, standard processes, lessons learned, and tool usage to promote consistency, knowledge transfer, and continuous improvement across the Service Operations Project Delivery team.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Work with the Service Operations - Regional Manager to define and implement a set of project management key performance indicators (KPI) that are measurable and demonstrate how effectively the Service Operations Project Delivery team is performing against their objectives

Reporting

  • Provides regular Project Delivery performance updates
  • Provide regular reporting on performance against project delivery KPIs and schedule regular meetings with the regional team to address any KPI related issues and concerns. After these meetings, they will provide a regular update to the Service Operations Projects Team Lead on any concern relating to asset management KPI performance
  • Provide support and guidance on how to rectify and improve any reported non-conformance or performance issue identified

Planning

  • Will develop realistic plans, set goals, align plans with objectives and coordinates with other team members

Problem solving

  • Will have the ability to break down problems into smaller components, understands underlying issues, can simplify and process complex issues, understands the difference between critical details and unimportant facts appropriate and escalate when required with strong input and guidance around options / recommendations

Managing performance

  • Apply clear/consistent performance standards to handle performance problems decisively and objectively and communicate in a manner that is direct but tactful and provides assistance to improve performance
  • Develop a positive team culture through achievement of results, teamwork, development, accountability, competency and professionalism
  • Demonstrate a passion for standardisation and operational excellence.
  • Maintain a knowledge of the industry and regulatory rules, requirements and developments to ensure ongoing best practices

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Knowledge of IT, data center, Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing, and building infrastructure systems, with the ability to deliver retrofit projects in active mission-critical environments.
  • Project management experience with commercial specialty and/or general construction firms, including practical understanding of fundamental project management principles.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Teams, Windows, and SharePoint.
  • Proficiency with Bluebeam and Revit, with a general understanding of drawing packages such as Visio and/or AutoCAD.
  • Experience writing and reviewing Method of Procedure documents and reviewing technical drawings, specifications, and project documentation.
  • Knowledge of SSAE 16 and other industry certifications is desirable.
  • Strong problem-solving, critical thinking, analytical, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to remain calm and make sound decisions in dynamic environments.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to prepare, present, and summarize information for varied audience types.
  • Excellent customer service skills with the ability to interface effectively with customers, vendors, contractors, and internal stakeholders.
  • Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to multi-task, work independently, and support team members through changing environments.
  • Working knowledge of Plan Do Check Act or similar continuous improvement methodologies is desirable.
  • Recognized Health and Safety qualifications are desirable.
  • Proficient in English, both written and verbal; additional language capability is desirable.
  • Willing and able to travel as required.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in business management, engineering, project management or a related field / equivalent experience strongly preferred.
  • Professional licenses or certifications such as PMP or PMI are desirable.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in Project/Construction Management or a relevant field is required

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Primarily performs work while seated, with the ability to remain stationary for extended periods and perform close visual work on a computer terminal.
  • Frequently moves about inside and outside of the data center, facility, and jobsite, including in varying weather conditions.
  • Must be able to traverse and inspect all areas of the jobsite, which may include walking, standing, climbing, reaching, bending, crawling, stretching, ascending or descending ladders, and working on raised platforms.
  • Must be able to position self in small spaces as required for inspections, reviews, and project-related activities.
  • Requires manual dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, peripherals, telephone, two-way radio, and other technical instruments.
  • Able to hear and speak with others in person and through communication devices such as a telephone and two-way radio.
  • Able to lift, carry, move, and handle equipment, hardware, and other objects weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Perform work during US business hours and across US time zones as required.

Work conditions & other requirements

  • Work primarily onsite at a data center location.
  • Periodic travel to other NTT GDCA, client, or vendor locations as needed.
  • Travel required up to 10% of time.
  • Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.
  • Exposure to outdoor weather conditions.
  • Must be able to respond to emergency situations at the data center.
  • Responsible to carry a cell phone and provide 24 x 7 support as needed.
  • Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, late nights, holidays.
  • Must possess a current, valid state-issued driver’s license. Can travel internationally if required.

Occasionally perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection with prior Manager approval.

Compensation Pay Range

  • This position requires work to be done onsite at a data center facility and may require use of a personal mobile device. A monthly stipend will be provided to cover expenses incurred for using a personal device, if applicable.
  • NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc. offers competitive compensation based on experience, education, and location. The base salary for this position is $105,500 - $150,700.
  • All regular full-time employees are eligible for an annual bonus; payout is dependent upon individual and company performance.
  • Employees receive paid time-off, medical, dental, and vision benefits, life and supplemental insurance, short-term and long-term disability, flexible spending account, and 401k retirement plan to create a rich Total Rewards package.

Who we are

job.title: Specialist - Data Center Operations
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The role of Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

This role designs, plans, installs, and / or maintains mechanical, electrical, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability data center environments.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Assist in scheduling and supervising vendors/subcontractors during equipment / systems maintenance and service.
  • Provides recommendation of improvements to the operations and maintenance program on an on-going basis.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Seasoned understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Seasoned proficiency of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Seasoned knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Seasoned knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.)

  • Experience required:
  • Seasoned experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Seasoned experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Seasoned experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Seasoned experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Seasoned experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Senior Associate Specialist, System Support & Data
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Your role at a glance

The Senior Associate Analyst, System Support & Data plays a critical operational role within Procurement, supporting the implementation, stabilization, and ongoing optimization of finance systems and data solutions. This role ensures the accuracy, reliability, and efficiency of financial data and processes while acting as a key liaison between finance teams, IT, and transformation initiatives.

The role supports the execution of finance technology and data strategy by troubleshooting system issues, maintaining master data, validating reporting outputs, and assisting with system upgrades, process automation, and user adoption. By providing hands-on system and data support, the Senior Associate Analyst enables the smooth operation of procurement systems, enhances data integrity, and contributes to continuous process improvement across Procurement and its interconnected business functions. Through collaboration with finance stakeholders, IT, and transformation teams, the role helps ensure technology solutions deliver operational efficiency, accurate reporting, and measurable value to the organization

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Procurement Systems & Data Operations Support the implementation, maintenance, and enhancement of procurement systems, platforms, and data solutions, while contributing to finance, cross-functional, and transformation initiatives that drive operational efficiency and business value. Assist in the execution of procurement and enterprise system and data initiatives, including system upgrades, feature enhancements, process automation, and reporting/dashboard development, ensuring solutions align with business requirements, stakeholder needs, and operational priorities Translate procurement process requirements and strategic objectives into actionable system configurations, data solutions, and process improvements, while incorporating the needs of Finance and other business functions and leveraging emerging technologies such as automation, analytics, and AI. Monitor system performance, data quality, and evolving technology capabilities across procurement and related business processes, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, strengthen data integrity, and support the effective adoption of new tools and solutions across the organization.

Finance Systems Support & Implementation

  • Support the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of finance system solutions, ensuring smooth migration from legacy platforms.
  • Assist in the delivery and rollout of system features and enhancements, ensuring accuracy, usability, scalability, and compliance with finance policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to test, configure, and troubleshoot systems, supporting iterative improvements and efficient adoption of new tools.

System & Data Controls and Risk Support

  • Support the establishment and maintenance of system and data controls to ensure adherence to finance processes and policies globally.
  • Monitor compliance with relevant system procedures, data governance standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify and report system or data-related risks, dependencies, and anomalies, escalating critical issues and supporting mitigation efforts.
  • Act as a point of contact for system or data exceptions, assisting in resolution and ensuring process integrity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management

  • Serve as a key liaison between finance, IT, business units, and external vendors to support system and data initiatives.
  • Build and maintain cross-functional relationships to understand user needs, communicate system updates, and facilitate adoption of finance technology solutions.
  • Collaborate with teams to ensure alignment on priorities and support implementation efforts.
  • Partner with the Change Management team to assist with training, communications, and adoption of new systems and processes.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

Understanding of finance operations such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Record-to-Report (R2R), FP&A, and reporting cycles.Hands-on experience with ERP and source-to-pay platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday, Coupa, Ariba), including procurement and financial data management, reporting, system support, and process optimization.Demonstrated expertise and proficiency in process automation, workflow configuration, and digital transformation technologies are required, including analytics and BI platforms such as Power BI and Tableau, Microsoft Power Platform solutions (Power Apps and Power Automate), and advanced technologies such as AI and RPA.Knowledge of master data management, data validation, reconciliation, and reporting integrity.

  • Understanding of finance compliance requirements, regulatory frameworks, and internal control structures.
  • Ability to participate in UAT, configure system features, troubleshoot issues, and support system rollouts.
  • Ability to interpret system and data issues, identify patterns, and recommend actionable solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills to resolve system, process, and data-related challenges efficiently.
  • Precision in handling data, system configurations, and reporting outputs to maintain accuracy and compliance.
  • Works effectively with finance, IT, business units, vendors, and change teams to deliver results.
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, transformation-focused environment; learns quickly and adapts to new systems and processes.
  • Able to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and document processes, issues, and resolutions.
  • Focused on operational excellence, process improvement, and supporting business needs through system and data solutions.
  • Takes responsibility for system and data quality, process adherence, and timely issue resolution.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Certifications like CPA, ACCA, CMA, Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt) or PMP, is advantageous.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years of experience supporting finance transformation initiatives, particularly in system implementation, process automation, or data optimization projects.
  • Moderate experience contributing to finance systems operations, including configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing support across ERP or reporting platforms.
  • Moderate experience working with finance systems, data tools, and analytics platforms, supporting system performance monitoring, data validation, and issue resolution.
  • Moderate experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including finance, IT, business units, and external vendors, to facilitate system adoption, process improvements, and operational efficiency.
  • Moderate experience supporting operational excellence or process improvement initiatives, including maintaining controls, compliance standards, and governance in finance systems and data.
  • Moderate experience assisting with training, documentation, and change management activities, ensuring smooth adoption of new finance systems, processes, and tools.

PHYSICAL requirements

Regularly moves equipment and other hardware up to ## lbs. Frequently move about inside and outside of data center / facility

  • Remain stationary for long periods of time.
  • Ascend / Descend a ladder and perform duties atop a raised platform.
  • Position self in small spaces.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Perform work during US business hours and time zones.

Work conditions & other requirements

  • Work onsite at a data center location.
  • Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.
  • Exposure to outdoor weather conditions.
  • Travel required 10% of time.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

job.title: Application Engineer
job.description:
Job Scope

The Application Engineer plays a crucial role in enabling smooth deployments and stable operations of our cloud platform.

This role is focused on collaborating directly with the TechOps team, diagnosing any application issues during deployment, identifying and remediating security flaws, and fixing bugs to ensure continuous performance, security, and reliability.

The Application Engineer will not be responsible for building new features but instead will apply strong troubleshooting and technical support skills to maintain a robust production environment.

job.title: UI/ UX Designer
job.description:
[About Yotta](https://yotta.com/)

Yotta Data Services is India’s leading sovereign AI infrastructure, cloud platform and data centre services company, enabling enterprises, governments, startups, and digital platforms to build, deploy, and scale next-generation AI and digital workloads securely within India.

With hyperscale data centre campuses in Navi Mumbai and Greater Noida (Delhi NCR), advanced GPU-powered AI infrastructure, and a comprehensive ecosystem of cloud, AI, hosting, cybersecurity, and managed platform services, Yotta delivers high-performance, scalable, and compliant digital infrastructure built for the AI era.

Yotta is at the forefront of powering India’s sovereign AI and digital transformation journey through world-class infrastructure, deep technology partnerships, and fully India-hosted enterprise-grade platforms.

Job Scope

Yotta is building next-generation AI-powered products, including no-code AI builders, enterprise SaaS platforms, intelligent workflow systems, and data-intensive applications.

We are looking for an experienced Product Designer who can transform complex business and technology workflows into intuitive, effective, and scalable product experiences. You will own design initiatives from problem discovery through delivery—working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Data Scientists, and business stakeholders.

This role requires a balance of user empathy, product thinking, interaction design, visual craft, and commercial awareness. You will help shape product direction, improve design quality, and ensure that design decisions contribute to meaningful user and business outcomes.

**Total /Relevant

Experience

**

**

  • 5+ years of experience

Key Responsibilities

**

**

A. Product Discovery and Strategy

**

**

  • Partner with

Product Managers and business stakeholders to understand product goals, customer needs, operational constraints, and success metrics.

  • Participate

in product discovery through stakeholder interviews, user research, competitive analysis, workshops, and data review.

  • Frame

ambiguous problems, identify user pain points, and translate insights into clear design opportunities.

  • Contribute to

product strategy, roadmap discussions, feature prioritisation, and experience principles.

  • Define

hypotheses and success measures for major design initiatives.

  • Advocate for

users while balancing business priorities, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.

B. End-to-End Product Design

**

**

  • Own the

complete design process for assigned products and features, from discovery and concept development through implementation and iteration.

  • Create

information architectures, journey maps, personas, task flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces.

  • Design

complex experiences such as dashboards, workflow builders, configuration tools, editors, administrative systems, and AI-assisted interactions.

  • Simplify

technical and data-heavy workflows without reducing necessary functionality.

  • Account for

complete product behaviour, including loading, empty, success, validation, permission, error, and edge-case states.

  • Design

responsive experiences across relevant devices and screen sizes.

  • Validate

concepts early and refine solutions using research, feedback, and product data.

C. Interaction and Visual Design

**

**

  • Produce

polished, implementation-ready interfaces with strong attention to hierarchy, typography, spacing, colour, and content.

  • Define clear

interaction patterns for navigation, forms, tables, search, filtering, data visualisation, drag-and-drop experiences, and conversational interfaces.

  • Create

interactive prototypes to communicate behaviour, validate ideas, and align stakeholders.

  • Apply

accessibility and inclusive-design principles throughout the design process.

  • Maintain a

high standard of consistency and craft across products.

**D. AI and Emerging Product Experiences**

**

**

  • Design

transparent, usable, and trustworthy experiences for AI-powered products.

  • Create

interaction patterns for prompting, model configuration, AI-generated output, review and approval, feedback, and human oversight.

  • Consider

uncertainty, explainability, user control, data privacy, and failure recovery when designing AI interactions.

  • Explore new

interaction models while ensuring that experiences remain understandable and valuable to users.

E. Design Systems and Scalability

**

**

  • Use and

actively contribute to Yotta’s shared design system and Figma component libraries.

  • Identify

reusable patterns and propose new components, variants, guidelines, and interaction standards.

  • Work with

Engineering to ensure components are feasible, accessible, and implemented consistently.

  • Help improve

design-system governance, documentation, adoption, and quality.

  • Reduce design

and implementation inconsistencies across products.

**F. Research, Validation, and Optimisation**

**

**

  • Plan or

support user interviews, concept validation, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and product reviews.

  • Convert

qualitative and quantitative findings into actionable design improvements.

  • Use product

analytics, customer feedback, support insights, and usability findings to evaluate shipped experiences.

  • Iterate based

on evidence and track whether design changes improve defined outcomes.

  • Present

research findings and design recommendations clearly to product teams and leadership.

**G. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Delivery**

**

**

  • Collaborate

closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.

  • Facilitate

design workshops, critiques, and decision-making sessions.

  • Present

design rationale clearly and build alignment among technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Provide

developers with clear specifications, prototypes, annotations, assets, and interaction guidance.

  • Review

implemented experiences and work with Engineering to resolve quality gaps before release.

  • Represent

design during sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and product demonstrations.

H. Design Leadership

**

**

  • Raise the

quality of product thinking and design execution across the team.

  • Provide

thoughtful feedback during design critiques and product reviews.

  • Mentor

less-experienced designers and support their professional development.

  • Help improve

design processes, collaboration practices, tools, and documentation.

  • Communicate

risks, trade-offs, and recommendations with confidence and clarity.

  • Encourage a

culture of customer focus, experimentation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Must-have skill

**

**

  • 5+ years of professional

product design experience, preferably working on SaaS, enterprise, B2B, AI, cloud, or data-intensive products.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating

end-to-end product design, structured problem-solving, systems thinking, and measurable product impact.

  • Demonstrated experience taking

complex features or products from discovery through launch and iteration.

  • Strong command of interaction

design, information architecture, user flows, prototyping, and visual design.

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma,

including components, variants, auto layout, variables, prototyping, and design libraries.

  • Experience designing responsive

web applications and complex desktop workflows.

  • Strong understanding of

usability principles, accessibility standards, and inclusive design.

  • Experience collaborating with

Product Managers and Engineers in agile product teams.

  • Ability to interpret customer

feedback, research findings, business requirements, and product data.

  • Excellent communication,

presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple

priorities and operate effectively in a fast-moving, evolving environment.

Portfolio Expectations

**

** The portfolio should include at least two detailed case studies demonstrating:**

**

**

  • The problem,

user context, and business objective.

  • The

candidate’s specific role and level of ownership.

  • Research or

evidence used to guide decisions.

  • Exploration

of alternative solutions and relevant trade-offs.

  • Evolution

from early concepts to the final experience.

  • Collaboration

with Product and Engineering.

  • Outcomes,

learnings, and post-launch iteration.

  • Examples of

shipped work, where confidentiality permits.

**Good-to-Have

Skills

**

**

  • Experience designing AI-powered

products or human–AI interactions.

  • Familiarity with no-code or

low-code platforms, workflow builders, developer tools, or cloud products.

  • Experience designing data

visualisations, monitoring platforms, analytics products, or administrative systems.

  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.2

and accessibility testing practices.

  • Basic understanding of HTML,

CSS, and modern frontend component frameworks.

  • Experience contributing to or

governing a multi-product design system.

  • Familiarity with product

analytics and experimentation tools.

  • Experience with

micro-interactions, motion design, or advanced prototyping.

  • Experience mentoring designers

or leading significant design initiatives.

Qualifications

Criteria**

**

**

  • Bachelor’s or

master’s degree in design, Human–Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related discipline.

  • Equivalent

practical experience supported by a strong portfolio will also be considered.

  • Relevant

certifications in product design, UX research, accessibility, or interaction design are beneficial but not mandatory.

**Certification Criteria**

**

**

  • NA

**Shifts Timing, (If rotational, please specify)**

**

**

  • General Shift

**Number of Interview Rounds **

**

** **Name of interviewer**

**

**

  • 3-4 rounds

Behavioral Attributes:

  • Customer empathy and curiosity
  • Product and business acumen
  • Structured problem-solving
  • Creativity and attention to

detail

  • Clear and persuasive

communication

  • Collaboration and

trust-building

  • Ownership and accountability
  • Comfort with ambiguity
  • Bias toward action
  • Openness to feedback
  • Continuous learning
  • Prioritisation and planning
  • Quality-focused execution
  • Mentoring and knowledge-sharing

job.title: Technical Project Manager II, Customer Implementation
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

Title: Technical Project Manager II, Customer Implementation

The TPM II is a member of the Service Delivery Customer Implementation team and will assist in the installation of Customer infrastructure within EdgeConneX Data Centers. This position has a hybrid work schedule and requires regular travel. The TPM III reports to the CSI Manager, Service Delivery, APAC.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead in the installation of Customer infrastructure into ECX sites on time and meeting Customer-defined scope.
  • Lead in the delivery of ECX and Customer products including cabinets, cabinet infrastructure, Meet-Me-Room, structured cabling, cross connect, outside and inside plant builds to meet Customer needs.
  • Lead in the review of Customer infrastructure build requirements and assist in the creation of quoting of build costs.
  • Lead in the communication of project deliverables with internal EdgeConneX teams in addition to communicating with end Customers on project status.
  • Serve as team Lead in ensuring onsite safety protocols are followed, onsite EdgeConneX standards are followed, and general safety practices are adhered to during build of Customer infrastructure within EdgeConneX facilities.
  • Lead efforts in management and reporting of Meet Me Room inventory and availability at assigned locations.
  • Strong ability to understand Customer deliverables and interpreting into site specific power, space, and network connectivity (fiber and copper) needs within EdgeConneX facilities located across the Asia-Pacific region and globally as assigned.
  • Lead with oversight of general contractor and sub-contractor selection, project specific management, creation of and management of schedules and onsite build completion of Customer needs.
  • Update all appropriate EdgeConneX systems: CSI, EdgeOS, Rio, Sugar, etc.
  • Assist in other projects as assigned by Manager.
  • Ability to assist with multiple projects from beginning to end.
  • Ability to travel to sites as required across the Asia-Pacific region (approximately 60%); valid passport and willingness to travel internationally required.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Passionate self-starter who puts the hours needed and readily rolls up sleeves to do what needs to be done.
  • Ability and willingness to make recommendations on Customer specific needs in addition to site specific build necessities to support both Customer and EdgeConneX specific needs.
  • Strong communications, both written and verbal, in leading teams and coordinating with peers and other disciplines on driving projects/issues to closure.
  • Work habits must stay organized, independently manage priorities and scheduling, and efficiently work on multiple projects with conflicting deadlines.
  • Strong awareness of responsibilities and sense of accountability to projects and Customers.
  • Dedicated and effective team player with the ability to perform the tasks required to get the job done. Understanding the contractor scope of work and be ready to lend a hand.
  • Ability and willingness to take direction and to implement with minimal direction from leadership. Is hard working, disciplined, and consistently delivers required results.
  • Ability and willingness to independently and effectively deliver Customer projects of small to large scope across assigned areas.
  • Work habits reflect comfort with ambiguity and agility when goals or situations change.
  • Start to serve in mentor role to junior team members.
  • Commitment to organizational excellence and constant awareness to seek opportunities to improve processes/quality of deliverables.

Experience/Education

  • 3+ years of experience with construction, able to read drawings and understand construction tools.
  • 3+ year of experience in working with build of facility cabinets, infrastructure, copper and fiber distribution, power assignments to Customer cabinets and overall basic understanding of data center builds.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline, Technical School degree or equivalent experience.
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Office applications.

Candidates with field experience and background in construction installation of IT, telecom, data center assets, fiber optics, networking, and gear installation are strongly encouraged to apply.

</div

job.title: Manager, Market Development Engineering- Singapore
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

Job Description

The Market Development Engineering Lead is responsible for supporting the early-stage development of data center projects by delivering comprehensive technical due diligence, site feasibility assessments, and concept engineering solutions. This role focuses on evaluating new market opportunities from an engineering perspective, including power and utility availability, site constraints, constructability, and infrastructure readiness. It plays a critical role in bridging site acquisition and detailed design. Defining initial engineering strategies, identifying risks, and recommending practical mitigation measures.

The role involves close coordination with multi-disciplinary teams — including real estate, electrical, mechanical, civil, and project delivery — as well as external stakeholders such as utilities, consultants, and authorities, to ensure all selected sites are development-ready and compliant with local regulatory requirements. This position must be based in Singapore with 30-40% regional APAC travel, and occasional travel across the globe.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Site Identification & Technical Due Diligence
  • Lead technical evaluation of potential data center sites across APAC, including site visits and feasibility assessments.
  • Assess land suitability, accessibility, infrastructure availability, and development constraints.
  • Identify key risks related to environmental conditions, permitting, zoning, and constructability.
  • Review and validate due diligence studies (power, water, geotechnical, environmental).
  • Provide clear recommendations on site viability and development strategy.

2. Early-Stage Engineering & Concept Development

  • Develop test fits, conceptual layouts, and high-level engineering solutions for new developments.
  • Define initial technical configurations, including capacity planning, scalability, and redundancy strategies.
  • Support development of preliminary design standards aligned with hyperscale and colocation requirements.
  • Ensure engineering solutions are optimized for constructability, efficiency, and future expansion.

3. Power & Utility Engagement

  • Support and lead engagement with utilities and service providers to assess and secure power capacity.
  • Evaluate grid connection strategies (HV/MV), timelines, risks, and cost implications.
  • Assess availability and feasibility of water, cooling solutions, and alternative heat rejection strategies.
  • Support development of resilient and sustainable infrastructure approaches.
  • Development Planning & Project Structuring
  • Prepare high-level development plans outlining key milestones from site acquisition through to operation.
  • Develop preliminary project schedules, CAPEX estimates, and development budgets.
  • Identify key technical and delivery risks and propose mitigation strategies.
  • Support transition from development phase to design and construction teams.
  • Market & Commercial Alignment
  • Translate customer requirements (hyperscalers, enterprise clients) into actionable technical and development strategies.
  • Support capacity planning, density considerations, and scalability aligned with market demand.
  • Collaborate with commercial and real estate teams to ensure site selection aligns with business strategy.
  • Provide technical input to support investment decisions and project prioritization.
  • Stakeholder & Authority Engagement
  • Engage with local authorities, regulatory bodies, and government agencies to support permitting and approvals.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Real Estate, Design Engineering, Finance, and Commercial teams.
  • Coordinate with external consultants, contractors, and partners during early-stage development.
  • Support resolution of technical and regulatory challenges across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Risk Management & Reporting
  • Identify, assess, and track development risks across technical, regulatory, and commercial domains.
  • Prepare and present clear, structured reports for senior management, including:
  • Site feasibility assessments
  • Risk and mitigation strategies
  • Development roadmaps and timelines
  • Communicate complex technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Continuous Improvement & Industry Awareness
  • Stay current with industry trends, including hyperscale requirements, AI-driven infrastructure, and advanced cooling technologies.
  • Contribute to the development of internal standards, tools, and best practices for site development.
  • Drive improvements in development processes, efficiency, and quality of deliverables.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Civil Engineering, or related discipline
  • Direct experience and ownership of early-stage development, feasibility, and site due diligence
  • Minimum 5–8 years of experience in: Mission-critical infrastructure, large-scale industrial or infrastructure projects, and 2+ years in Data center development
  • Strong understanding of Electrical systems (HV/MV, substations, grid connectivity), Mechanical systems (cooling, heat rejection, water systems), and data center design principles (resilience, redundancy, scalability)
  • Exposure to APAC markets (Japan, Australia, Malaysia, Indonesia for example) and multi-country project environments

Overall Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking capability
  • Ability to integrate technical, commercial, and strategic considerations
  • Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Strong communication and presentation skills (technical and executive level)
  • High adaptability in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
  • Self-driven, resourceful, and solutions-oriented mindset

</div
