job.title: Director, Financial Planning & Analysis
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

Title: Director of Financial Planning & Analysis

Position Summary

  • The Director of Financial Planning & Analysis will lead FP&A activities for the EdgeConneX and AdaniConneX joint venture in India, supporting one of the fastest-growing data center platforms in the region. This role will be based in Ahmedabad and will report to the SVP of FP&A for EdgeConneX.
  • The Director will serve as a key finance partner to the India leadership team, EdgeConneX corporate finance, AdaniConneX stakeholders, development, construction, operations, commercial, and investment teams. The role will be responsible for financial planning, forecasting, management reporting, business analysis, capital planning, performance tracking, and strategic decision support across a rapidly scaling hyperscale data center portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Reporting

  • Lead the annual budgeting, long-range planning, and rolling forecast processes for the India joint venture, ensuring alignment with EdgeConneX global FP&A standards and local business priorities.
  • Develop and maintain detailed financial models covering revenue, operating expenses, EBITDA, cash flow, capital expenditures, project-level returns, debt service, and equity requirements.
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting packages for EdgeConneX leadership, AdaniConneX stakeholders, the joint venture leadership team, and board-level review.
  • Analyze actual performance against budget, forecast, prior periods, and investment case assumptions, identifying key drivers, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
  • Establish and maintain financial KPIs and dashboards for the India business, including utilization, contracted capacity, revenue backlog, cost performance, project returns, power costs, operating margins, and capital deployment.

Strategic Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary FP&A partner for the India joint venture leadership team, providing financial insight to support strategic, commercial, operational, and investment decisions.
  • Partner with development, construction, commercial, operations, procurement, tax, treasury, accounting, and legal teams to support data center growth initiatives across India.
  • Support business cases for new data center developments, expansions, customer deployments, land acquisitions, power infrastructure investments, and major commercial contracts.
  • Provide financial analysis for customer pricing, lease economics, contract structures, power pass-through mechanisms, inflation escalation, and long-term profitability.
  • Translate complex financial information into clear, actionable insights for senior executives and non-finance stakeholders.

Capital Planning & Project Economics

  • Lead financial planning and analysis for significant capital investment programs across the India data center portfolio.
  • Track project-level capital expenditures against approved budgets, construction schedules, investment committee approvals, and original underwriting assumptions.
  • Partner with development and construction teams to monitor cost-to-complete, contingency usage, change orders, procurement impacts, and schedule-related financial risks.
  • Assess project returns, including IRR, NPV, payback period, EBITDA contribution, cash yield, and return on invested capital.
  • Support capital allocation decisions and funding requirements for the joint venture, including equity contributions, debt financing assumptions, and cash flow planning.
  • Help establish scalable FP&A processes, controls, reporting standards, and decision-making frameworks appropriate for a fast-growing hyperscale infrastructure platform.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, engineering, or a related field; MBA, CA, CFA, CPA, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
  • 7+ years of progressive finance experience, with significant experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment analysis, infrastructure, real estate, data centers, telecom, energy, construction, or technology-enabled infrastructure.
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including experience with long-range planning, project finance, capex modeling, cash flow forecasting, and investment return analysis.
  • Experience supporting capital-intensive businesses with complex development, construction, or infrastructure investment cycles.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, variance analysis, and business performance management.
  • Experience working in a multinational company, joint venture, private equity-backed business, or high-growth infrastructure platform preferred.
  • Knowledge of Indian business practices, tax, regulatory, accounting, and infrastructure development environments preferred.
  • Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills required; experience with ERP, EPM, BI, or planning tools such as Oracle, SAP, NetSuite, Anaplan, Adaptive, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms preferred.
  • Fluency in English required; additional Indian languages are a plus.

Key Competencies and Experience

  • Strong executive presence and ability to communicate with clarity, confidence, and precision.
  • Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and commercially minded.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Strong business partnering skills and comfort working across cultures, time zones, and stakeholder groups.
  • High integrity, discretion, and professionalism in handling sensitive financial and commercial information.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth, capital-intensive environment.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to build processes, improve reporting, and drive accountability.
  • Collaborative approach with the confidence to challenge assumptions and influence decision-making.
  • Experience in data centers, digital infrastructure, hyperscale cloud infrastructure, telecom towers, fiber, renewable energy, logistics infrastructure, commercial real estate, or other large-scale infrastructure sectors.
  • Experience with joint venture governance, shareholder reporting, investment committee processes, or private capital-backed platforms.
  • Familiarity with project finance, debt facilities, lender reporting, and capital deployment planning.
  • Experience supporting businesses with large construction pipelines, long-term customer contracts, and multi-phase development projects.
  • Exposure to U.S.-based multinational reporting standards and global FP&A processes.

About the Platform

  • EdgeConneX is one of the largest global hyperscale data center companies in the world, with a focus on delivering scalable, high-performance digital infrastructure for leading cloud, content, network, and enterprise customers.
  • AdaniConneX is one of the fastest-growing data center companies in India, focused on building a national data center platform to support the country’s accelerating digital transformation.
  • Together, the platform combines global data center expertise with deep local market knowledge, infrastructure capabilities, and growth ambition in one of the world’s most dynamic digital infrastructure markets.

</div

job.title: Engineer - Electrical
job.description:
Responsibilities

1\. Overall Lead for maintenance task assigned and monitor performance of assigned responsibilities. Perform repair and/or troubleshoot ensuring that work performed in critical environment is accomplished efficiently with a minimum amount of disruption and inconvenience to customer. 2\. Responsible for the day-to-day maintenance, and inspections of assigned critical environment systems, which may include the following Electrical systems on mechanical (including HVAC, computer room air conditioners, chillers, and plumbing) electrical (including UPS, DC battery systems, PDU, generators, transfer switches, and switchgear). 3\. Responsible for supervising prior to sign-off the maintained equipment/system done by maintenance vendor or OEM vendor. Ensure maintenance vendor follows closely to the maintenance work method statement without deviation and sign off for each work step. Should abnormality occur, call for work halt and escalate to monitoring centre and seek for Maintenance Manager work clearance prior proceed to perform troubleshoot and/or investigation. 4\. Process Change Control Application Process work efforts (including 3rd party contractors) for the safe and compliant operation, maintenance (corrective and preventive), and modification of critical equipment. Ensure standard operating procedures and maintenance work instructions are up to standard. 5\. Perform the role of technical support onsite, guiding team members on first level fault analysis with vendor discussions. Provide direction and guidance for team members on new facilities testing and commissioning, working closely with the project team. 6\. Provide on-the-job training and technical support to engineers and technicians. 7\. Monitor critical spare parts level of inventory onsite to support continuous operation without impact. Provides recommendations to Manager for the quantity and types of critical parts required to support the facilities operation. 8\. Deliver all maintenance tasks for customer’s service level agreement always comply to the SLA covers such as, incident to escalate to customer within 15 minutes upon reported to monitoring centre, written incident report issue within 24 hours, etc. 9\. Monitor work order for Preventative and Corrective maintenance on critical systems. Consult with team members and staff as appropriate to identify and order necessary materials to complete all maintenance and perform necessary work. Finalize work orders by completing necessary documentation. 10\. Develop safe maintenance Change Control Application. Implement or ensure implementations of Change Control Application or work method statement including LOTO (log out/tag out) required under Change Management Workflow Process for assigned facilities and systems. 11\. Perform all work safely in accordance with the governing Safety Program. Comply with company policy and local law for the safe storage, usage, and disposal of hazardous materials. Maintains a clean and safe workplace. 12\. Implement SOP and ERP and have in-depth understanding of the critical system/facilities. 13\. Update tools and supply inventories as appropriate. Specific duties include but are not limited to preparing and submitting purchase-order requests, developing sources for stock materials, and performing periodic checks for supplies. 14\. Identify safety hazards within the critical environment, everyone has a role to play to ensure that our coworkers and customers work in a safe environment. Work safety is a key area of focus, staff should put on proper PPE while carrying out their work and comply with safety work rules. 15\. Ensure that compliance with all regulatory laws and guidelines is met as they relate to the operation of the building’s infrastructure and including work deliveries. Responsible for alerting your reporting manager or senior management of any discrepancies.

Qualifications

1\. Proficient in English through all mediums of communication. Ability to write and review good quality detailed work scripts, methods of procedure, and standard operating procedures. Prepare incident report. 2\. Good knowledge of all laws that govern building management and maintenance, including building safety, emergency evacuation and environment protection. 3\. Bachelor of Science degree in an Engineering field with min. 5 years of relevant work experience in Data Centre environment or Hi-tech factory/plant (e.g., semi-conductor). 4\. Technical knowledge with hands on knowledge/experience and understanding of critical data center systems, focusing mainly on electrical systems, including and not limited to HVAC, Standby emergency power, uninterruptible power supplies, and associated infrastructure. 5\. Proficient in computer applications and software, including commercial computerized maintenance management systems, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel 6\. Preferably 33kV/11kV chargeman qualification. 7\. Requires working out of office hours as technical support, 24/7 support to site operation team. To be onsite for incident support.

job.title: Customer Success Specialist
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and customer-focused Customer Success Specialist to support the Customer Success Manager in delivering high-quality services and projects to our clients. This role plays a key part in coordinating daily operations, assisting with project execution, and ensuring service delivery meets contractual and internal standards. The ideal candidate will be an excellent communicator, highly organized, and capable of working collaboratively across teams to enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Support

  • Assist in managing customer communications, ensuring timely and professional responses to inquiries and issues.
  • Support relationship-building efforts by preparing customer-facing documentation and maintaining accurate records.

Service Delivery Monitoring

  • Track service performance against SLAs and assist in preparing regular reports and dashboards.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth service operations and timely issue resolution.

Project Coordination

  • Support the Customer Success Manager in managing project schedules, documentation, and stakeholder communications.
  • Assist in tracking project milestones, procurement activities, and risk identification.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain organized records of service and project activities in line with audit and compliance requirements.
  • Support adherence to ITIL standards and internal governance procedures.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Liaise with internal departments such as operations, network, IT services, and construction to facilitate task execution.
  • Help coordinate meetings, follow-ups, and action items across teams to ensure alignment and progress.

Requirements

  • Possess bachelor’s degree; Major in Project Management, Engineering or related discipline.
  • At least 1 year work experience in DC industry/MEP Consultancy/Construction industry but fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
  • Has excellent customer interface experience, good communication, presentation and coordination skill, good written skill to draft report.
  • Good learning skill and self-driven character, willing to take challenge and changes with a positive mindset.
  • Strong client-servicing willingness and ability. Capability towards emergent public relationship issues.
  • An adept conflict mediator and a trustworthy client advisor.
  • Good logical thinking with problem analysis and solving skills.
  • Working proficiency in English is preferred; a second language is a plus to communicate efficiently with clients from different regions.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: QA QC, Senior Specialist
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Position Summary

The Senior Specialist QA/QC assist to refine the work process and scope-control framework that all site construction QA/QC managers and engineers must comply with and provides program-level governance to verify compliance across all active construction projects. The role owns and drives project-wide data analytics to identify trends, systemic issues, and lessons learned that improve quality across every project.

Key Responsibilities

Work Process & Scope Framework**

  • Establish, update, and maintain the standardized QA/QC work processes, procedures, ITP/NCR templates, supporting construction QAQC personnel.

Program-Level Compliance Oversight

  • Involved in audits of construction project teams across the portfolio to verify that site managers and engineers comply with the defined work process.
  • Support pre-construction teams with quality input and historical data insights on bids, proposals, and project quality plans.

Data Analytics, Trends & Reporting

  • Review and enhancement of the assessment scorecard for construction projects
  • Consolidate quality data from all projects into a central data set, standardizing definitions and metrics so figures are comparable across sites.
  • Perform data crunching and analysis across the construction projects/region— trend analysis, benchmarking between projects/contractors, issue / defect and NCR pattern analysis, and root-cause statistics.
  • Identify systemic trends and recurring issues, from construction project data to quantify their impact, and translate findings into executive-level reports and dashboards for leadership.
  • Conduct performance assessments on general contractor and consultants.
  • Lessons-learned program: capture insights from all projects, anlyze root causes, and embed improvements back into the standardized process and CAPA framework.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering (Civil/Mechanical/Electrical); advanced degree or professional registration a plus.
  • 8–12+ years of QA/QC experience, including senior/lead roles on mission-critical or data center programs.
  • Demonstrated experience building or managing an ISO 9001 QMS and leading audit programs.
  • Strong data analytics capability — advanced Excel, and ideally BI/dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) — with proven ability to turn quality data into actionable insight.
  • Lead Auditor certification (ISO 9001) required or strongly preferred; additional certifications (CQE, CMQ/OE, CxA, CWI) advantageous.
  • Knowledge of data center commissioning (L1–L5), critical systems, and industry standards.
  • Proven ability to standardize process, enforce compliance, and influence at executive level across multiple concurrent projects.

Competencies: Strategic and systems thinking, strong data analysis and trend-identification skills, audit and governance expertise, leadership and stakeholder management, data-driven decision making, and the ability to balance standardization with project-level pragmatism.

job.title: Subregional Construction Lead ANZ
job.description:
Job Description

Your Role

As the Subregional Construction Lead, you will be accountable for overseeing and coordinating construction activities across the subregion, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Reporting to the Regional Head of Construction, you will play a key leadership role in driving consistent project execution, establishing best practices, strengthening governance, and partnering closely with internal and external stakeholders to deliver successful construction outcomes across multiple countries.

What you'll do

  • Lead and oversee construction projects across the subregion, ensuring delivery against agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and business objectives.
  • Promote and uphold a strong safety culture across all construction activities, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations, codes, health and safety standards, and industry best practices.
  • Manage and support Construction Managers, project teams, project controls resources, contractors, consultants, vendors, and other external partners to drive high performance and accountability.
  • Establish and maintain best practices, governance frameworks, project structures, roles and responsibilities, reporting processes, risk management standards, and approval criteria across construction projects.
  • Monitor project performance, budgets, cost controls, financial tracking, change requests, progress reporting, health and safety reporting, and escalation processes through the gating governance process.
  • Build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders, country teams, customers, vendors, general contractors, consultants, and trade partners to enable effective communication and project execution.
  • Identify project risks, challenges, and dependencies, and work with local project teams to develop mitigation plans and resolve issues as needed.
  • Drive quality assurance through site visits, inspections, reporting, corrective actions, and adherence to corporate quality and health and safety standards.
  • Support resource planning, recruitment, performance management, and development of internal staff, contingent workers, and external construction management resources across the geography.
  • Contribute as a senior member of the DE&C leadership team, including supporting business improvement, operational excellence initiatives, senior stakeholder meetings, and the adoption of standardised designs and documentation.

What you'll need

  • 15+ years of experience in construction project management, preferably within data centres, mission-critical environments, or similarly complex technical infrastructure projects.
  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Construction Management, Engineering, Quantity Surveying, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Strong experience managing multi-country construction programmes, regional project structures, and diverse stakeholder groups in a multicultural environment.
  • Solid knowledge of project management methodologies, governance processes, cost control, risk management, reporting, KPIs, and continuous process improvement.
  • Experience with construction contract delivery methods, contract negotiations, change orders, vendor management, and working with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, and trade partners.
  • Strong understanding of greenfield development, ground-up construction, retrofit projects, and local, regional, domestic, and international construction codes and health and safety requirements.
  • Experience with the design and deployment of technical electrical and mechanical systems; experience in data centres or similar environments would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong leadership, people management, influencing, communication, problem-solving, analytical, customer focus, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Good digital competence and experience using key construction management tools, templates, tracking sheets, and reporting systems.
  • Excellent written and spoken English

job.title: Shift Leader (Electrical)
job.description:
Responsibilities

SUMMARY

Your responsibilities are to: I. The Shift Lead is responsible to lead shift operations and maintenance work in a data center facility for 100% facility uptime. This position is required to oversee a team of shift engineer, shift assistant engineer, and shift technician. II. The position requires strong critical environment technical skills and routinely conduct of hands-on operations and inspection work on a variety of critical facility systems and equipment in an operating critical environment. III. Responsible for protecting and improving the value of our assets and ensuring the critical engineering systems reliably perform their intended function. Position is required to perform hands-on operations, conduct equipment/ system functional inspection and troubleshooting prior calling vendor/ equipment supplier specialist on-site. IV. Work requires strong formal conduct of operations skills, technical expertise, personal accountability, and flawless execution of work activities commensurate with a highly critical environment and associated expectations for exceptional customer satisfaction and confidence. V. Accountable to influence, inspire, and guide the team to become their best selves, building their skills and competencies along the way. To promote movement, provide direction and give motivation to the team to act towards achieving a common goal and the company's needs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

AND RESPONSIBILITIES

1\. Lead operations and maintenance on assigned shift and monitor performance of assigned responsibilities. Perform service requests, repair and/ or troubleshoot ensuring that work performed in critical environment is accomplished efficiently with a minimum amount of disruption and inconvenience to customer. It is also followed up with adequate clean up and subsequent inspection to ensure continuous trouble-free operation. Check malfunctioning equipment and ascertains corrective action required to restore to satisfactory operating condition. 2\. Responsible for the day-to-day operation, maintenance, and inspections of assigned critical environment systems, which may include the following: mechanical (including HVAC, computer room air conditioners, chillers, and plumbing) electrical (including UPS, DC battery systems, PDU, generators, transfer switches, and switchgear), cabling (including data and voice, broad band), fire detection and suppression, life safety, lighting, temperature control systems, building management systems, and digital systems (including fire alarm, duress, card access, CCTV). 3\. Responsible to inspect and examine prior sign off the maintained equipment/system done by maintenance vendor or OEM vendor witness by technician. Ensure maintenance vendor follows closely to the maintenance work method statement without deviation and sign off for each work step. Should abnormality occur, Engineer should call for work halt and escalate to monitoring centre and seek for Lead Engineer work clearance prior proceed to perform troubleshoot and/or investigation. 4\. Routinely performs all work in strict accordance with governing Change Control Application Process, standard operating procedures, and maintenance work instructions. 5\. Leads or directly operates and monitors critical system equipment and components. Oversees Change Control Application Process work efforts (including 3rd party contractors) for the safe and compliant operation, maintenance (corrective and preventive), and modification of critical equipment. Disables and enables fire alarm control panels and systems. 6\. Provides on-the-job training and technical support to junior engineer and technicians. 7\. Support implementation of the preventative maintenance program for their assigned shift. Specific duties include but are not limited to scheduling of preventative maintenance with a minimum disruption of building services, performing and/or supervise preventative maintenance tasks, orders parts and equipment required for repair, maintenance and installation of new equipment and facilities, and maintains inventory. 8\. Responsible for the operations of monitoring center, which is the nerve centre of the Data Centre, involving rotate with other shift engineer to ensure building management system is continuously man, handling of incident management (work includes escalation, reporting, investigation, conduct root caused analysis, remediation/rectification through incident closure) and work order management. Respond immediately to emergency situations (fire, evacuation, equipment failure, etc.) and customer concerns.

Qualifications

9\. Deliver all tasks for customer’s service level agreement are in compliance at all times, the SLA covers such as incident escalate to customer within 15 minutes upon reported to monitoring centre, written incident report issue within 24 hours, etc. 10\. Receives work order for Preventative and Corrective maintenance on critical systems. Consult with Lead Engineer/ Engineering Manager and staff as appropriate to identify and order necessary materials to complete all maintenance and perform necessary work. Finalize work orders by completing necessary documentation. 11\. Develops construction and maintenance Change Control Application. Implementations or ensure implementations of Change Control Application or work method statement including LOTO (log out/ tag out) required under Change Management Workflow Process for assigned facilities and systems. 12\. Performs all work safely in accordance with the governing Safety Program. Comply with company policy and local law for the safe storage, usage, and disposal of hazardous materials. Maintains a clean and safe workplace. 13\. Implement to SOP and ERP and have in depth understanding of the critical system/facilities. 14\. Update tools and supply inventories as appropriate. Specific duties include, but not limited to preparing and submitting purchase-order requests, developing sources for stock materials, and performing periodic checks for supplies. 15\. Identify safety hazards within the critical environment, report to Security & Safety Office or Lead Engineer, everyone has a role to play to ensure that our coworkers and customers work in a safe environment. Work safety is a key area of focus, staff should put on proper PPE while carrying out their works and comply with safety work rules. 16\. Ensure that compliance of all regulatory laws and guidelines are met as they relate to the operation of the building’s infrastructure and including work deliveries. Responsible for alerting your reporting manager or senior management of any discrepancies.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Proficient in English through all mediums of communication. Ability to write and review good quality detailed work scripts, methods of procedure, and standard operating procedures. Prepare incident report.
  • Good knowledge of all laws that govern building management and maintenance, including building safety, emergency evacuation and environment protection.
  • Professional Engineering Diploma in an Engineering field (Mechanical or Electrical) with min. 4 to 6 years of relevant work experience in Data Centre environment or Hi-tech factory/ plant (e.g., semi-conductor). Candidate with other professional certificate has advantage.

OR Bachelor of Science degree in an Engineering field with min. 1 to 3 years relevant work experience in Data Centre environment or Hi-tech factory/plant (e.g., semi-conductor).

  • For Electrical Engineer, a valid Electrical switching certificate and/ or license (Chargeman) for LV/ HT electrical system is preferred
  • Some technical knowledge with hands on knowledge/experience and understanding of critical data center systems, including HVAC, Standby emergency power, uninterruptible power supplies, and associated infrastructure.
  • Proficient in computer applications and software, including commercial computerized maintenance management systems, Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.

job.title: Deputy Manager, Health, Safety & Environment (HSE)
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Purpose

The Deputy Manager, HSE supports the implementation and continuous improvement of Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) programmes, governance frameworks and management systems across Keppel's divisions/platform portfolios. The role partners business and operational teams to drive regulatory compliance, effective risk management, operational excellence and a positive safety culture across diverse assets, projects and operational environments.

The incumbent is expected to support HSE initiatives across multiple business segments and be adaptable to changing business priorities and deployment requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. HSE Governance and Assurance

  • Support the implementation and continual improvement of HSE policies, standards and management systems across assigned assets, operations and projects.
  • Coordinate and facilitate HSE committee meetings, management reviews and stakeholder engagements.
  • Plan and conduct workplace inspections, audits and compliance assessments to verify adherence to statutory, corporate and client requirements.
  • Monitor HSE performance indicators and assist in preparing management reports, dashboards and governance updates.

2. Risk Management and Operational Safety

  • Conduct and review risk assessments, safe work procedures and Method Statements to ensure hazards are identified and adequately controlled.
  • Support Permit-to-Work (PTW) processes and verify that critical risk activities are properly assessed and authorised.
  • Provide HSE advice and guidance to operational teams, contractors and project personnel on risk mitigation measures and safe work practices.
  • Participate in design reviews, operational readiness assessments and management of change processes where required.

3. Incident Management and Investigation

  • Support the reporting, investigation and management of incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions.
  • Facilitate root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Track and verify the completion and effectiveness of corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Share lessons learnt and promote continuous improvement across business units.

4. Contractor and Stakeholder Management

  • Support contractor pre-qualification, onboarding and performance monitoring processes.
  • Engage contractors, vendors and service providers to ensure compliance with HSE requirements.
  • Participate in site engagements, safety campaigns and leadership walkthroughs to strengthen HSE culture.

5. Regulatory Compliance and Reporting

  • Maintain HSE documentation, records and statutory submissions in accordance with legal and corporate requirements.
  • Monitor changes in HSE regulations and support the implementation of compliance measures.
  • Liaise with regulatory authorities, auditors and external stakeholders as required.

6. HSE Capability Development

  • Support the planning and delivery of HSE training, awareness programmes, emergency drills and campaigns for employees and contractors.
  • Promote proactive reporting of hazards, near misses and improvement opportunities.
  • Contribute to initiatives that enhance HSE culture, workforce competency and operational excellence.

7. General Support

  • Provide operational and administrative support for HSE programmes and strategic initiatives.

#LI-VB2

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Registered Workplace Safety & Health Officer (WSHO) with MOM, Singapore preferred.
  • Other relevant certifications such as Fire Safety Manager, Environmental Control Officer, ISO 45001/14001 Auditor or equivalent will be advantageous.

Experience

  • Minimum three years of relevant HSE experience in operational, industrial, infrastructure, facilities management, real estate, construction and/or data centre environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in risk management, compliance assurance, incident investigation and contractor safety management.
  • Experience conducting audits, inspections and safety assessments.
  • Familiarity with Singapore Workplace Safety & Health legislation and industry best practices.

Competencies

  • Strong understanding of HSE management systems, governance frameworks and risk management principles.
  • Good communication, stakeholder engagement and influencing skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and report-writing capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Adaptable and willing to support multiple business segments, assets and operational environments.
  • Knowledge of digital technologies, data analytics and Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications that support HSE performance, reporting, inspections, risk management, incident investigations and process improvement will be an advantage.
  • Familiarity with digital tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Power BI, Power Platform or equivalent technologies will be beneficial.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage technology and innovation to improve operational efficiency and safety outcomes is preferred.

job.title: Manager, Business Operations
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a Business Operations Manager to run the day-to-day financial operations of Keppel's Networks business. Reporting to the Financial & Investment Lead, you will own and oversee budgets, cash flow management, payments, purchase orders, billing and management reporting across active operating systems.

You will be the connective tissue between the technical, commercial, business development, procurement and corporate finance teams — ensuring that what is committed is tracked, what is invoiced is verified, what is paid is authorised, and what is reported is accurate and on time. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong financial discipline with the practicality to make processes work in a fast-moving project environment

Key Areas of Ownership

1: Budgets and forecasting

  • Own the annual budgeting process and rolling forecasts for across Networks, consolidating inputs from technical, project, commercial and operations teams.
  • Track budget vs. actuals at project and business-unit level, investigating variances and agreeing corrective actions with budget owners.
  • Support scenario planning and reforecasting when project schedules, scope or supplier terms change.

2: Cash flow and treasury operations

  • ensure short- and medium-term cash flow forecasting across Networks entities, Projects and at operating entities, ensuring liquidity for all obligations and corporate commitments.
  • Coordinate funding requests, intercompany transfers with central finance and treasury functions.
  • Support drawdown requests and covenant/reporting obligations under project facility agreements, working with the commercial project management team to ensure lender requirements are met on time.
  • Monitor FX exposure on multi-currency supplier contracts and customer receipts, flagging hedging needs to treasury where appropriate.

3: Payments, POs and procurement operations

  • Govern the purchase order process end to end: PO raising, approvals in line with delegation of authority, goods/services receipting and closure.
  • Working with procurement and support functions, oversee and review the payments cycle — invoice verification against contracts, milestones and POs, payment approvals, and execution through banking platforms — ensuring suppliers are paid accurately and on time.
  • working with Technical Teams, track vendor payments against contractual obligations and ensuring governance and controls, working closely with the technical teams and various workstream leads where necessary.
  • Manage customer billing operations for IRU, and O&M agreements: invoicing schedules, receipts tracking and collections follow-up.

4: SOP governance and process oversight

  • Govern the development, documentation and upkeep of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across the full Procure-to-Pay (P2P) cycle — supplier onboarding and due diligence, PO raising and approvals, goods/services receipting, invoice verification, payment authorisation and execution, and supplier master data management.
  • Govern equivalent SOPs for the customer billing (Order-to-Cash) cycle — contract-to-billing setup for IRU and O&M agreements, invoicing, receipting, credit control and collections escalation.
  • Ensure SOPs are aligned with Keppel group policies, delegation of authority and audit requirements; conduct periodic compliance reviews, track exceptions and remediate gaps.
  • Train and support budget owners, project teams and new joiners on P2P and billing processes, supporting the procurement team for process, policy creation and controls.
  • Review and update SOPs as the business scales

5: Reporting and controls

  • Produce monthly management reporting: P&L, cash flow, budget vs. actuals, committed spend, AR/AP ageing and project cost dashboards for the FC/Investment Lead and leadership.
  • Maintain and improve financial controls, approval workflows and documentation, ensuring compliance with Keppel group policies and audit requirements.
  • Support statutory audit, tax filings and entity-level compliance across all Network entities, working with finance, tax, R&C, and corporate secretarial colleagues.

6: Business operations support

  • Administer contract and document management for financial records: executed contracts, variation orders, bank guarantees and insurance certificates.
  • Drive process improvement and systems adoption, automating recurring tasks where possible.
  • Provide ad hoc analysis to the various Leads where required — cost reviews, supplier spend analysis, and support for new project setup, etc.

Join our vibrant and inclusive workforce to shape a better future for all!

#LI-AM1

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Required Skills

  • 5+ years' experience in business operations, financial operations, FP&A or project accounting
  • Strong working knowledge of budgeting, cash— ideally in infrastructure, telecoms, construction, marine/offshore or another capital-intensive project environment. flow forecasting, PO/payment cycles and month-end reporting.
  • Experience operating financial controls and delegation-of-authority frameworks, with a track record of accuracy and timeliness; demonstrated ability to write, implement and govern SOPs across P2P and/or billing processes.
  • Confident with ERP and procurement systems (e.g. SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and advanced Excel; comfortable building and maintaining reporting dashboards.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple entities, currencies and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills — able to chase, challenge and support budget owners, suppliers and senior stakeholders constructively.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to project-financed structures: drawdowns, lender reporting, covenant compliance and multi-SPV environments.
  • Familiarity with subsea cable or telecoms commercial structures (supplier milestone contracts, IRU billing, O&M cost allocation).
  • Accounting qualification or part-qualification (ACCA, CPA, CIMA or equivalent), or a degree in finance, accounting or business.
  • Experience supporting audits and working across legal, tax and corporate secretarial functions in multiple jurisdictions.

job.title: Critical Environment Technician
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia’s leading data centres.

  • Melbourne's team is expanding with a new Data Centre. Join our team as we continue to grow in 2026.
  • Critical Infrastructure experience or HVAC or Electrical trades are desired
  • Tailored CDC Academy and hands-on training provided

About Us

CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities across ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

At CDC, our Critical Environment Technicians work hands-on in live data centres, supporting the day-to-day operation of mission critical infrastructure. This is a site-based role focused on planned works, maintenance, site logistics, and overall reliability during business hours.

You’ll play a key role in delivering technical facilities management — coordinating maintenance, managing site operations, and responding to incidents to keep our environments safe, secure, and always on.

If you’ve worked in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, much of this will feel familiar. The difference is the scale, the environment, and the opportunity to step into a stable, high-growth industry.

You’ll be part of CDC’s Operations team — on the ground every day, working closely together to deliver a strong customer experience and keep our facilities running at their best.

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day:

  • Monitoring and responding to alarms and alerts across power, cooling, and fire systems
  • Performing physical inspections to ensure equipment and infrastructure are operating within defined parameters
  • Responding to faults and incidents, prioritising actions, and determining when escalation or contractor support is required
  • Carrying out operational switching and control activities to prevent unplanned outages
  • Supporting planned maintenance and monitoring contractors on site, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures and approved methods of operation
  • Documenting incidents, maintenance activities, and observations to support continuous improvement

Benefits, Training and Offerings:

Our training program provides tailored content through our CDC Academy, specifically designed for individuals starting out in this role. You'll learn hands-on by shadowing and working alongside our experienced Service Technicians, gaining essential knowledge to develop your skillset.

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

You have experience working in environments where reliability, safety, and procedure matter - whether that’s through an electrical, HVAC, mechanical, or broader critical infrastructure background.

You might be a qualified electrician or HVAC technician looking to move away from a traditional tools‑based role and into operations, or someone earlier in their technical career who is curious about how large‑scale, mission‑critical environments operate.

Regardless of background, we value motivation, strong attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and develop within a growing industry.

Desirable experience:

  • A trade or technical background in Electrical, Refrigeration/HVAC, Mechanical, or a related field (highly desirable)
  • Experience working in critical or high‑availability environments with strong safety and compliance requirements
  • Exposure to monitoring or control systems such as BMS, EMS, or SCADA‑type platforms
  • Familiarity with complex infrastructure or plant equipment (e.g. HVAC systems, power systems, generators, fire systems)
  • Strong fault‑finding, problem‑solving, and situational awareness skills

job.title: Critical Environment Technician - Industrial/Commercial Electrician
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia’s leading data centres.

  • CDC is expanding with a new Data Centre in Maddington, WA.
  • Electrical trades with commercial/industrial experience are desired
  • Tailored CDC Academy and hands-on training provided

About Us

CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities across ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

At CDC, our Critical Environment Technicians work hands-on in live data centres, supporting the day-to-day operation of mission critical infrastructure. This is a site-based role focused on planned works, maintenance, site logistics, and overall reliability during business hours.

You’ll play a key role in delivering technical facilities management — coordinating maintenance, managing site operations, and responding to incidents to keep our environments safe, secure, and always on.

If you’ve worked in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, much of this will feel familiar. The difference is the scale, the environment, and the opportunity to step into a stable, high-growth industry.

You’ll be part of CDC’s Operations team — on the ground every day, working closely together to deliver a strong customer experience and keep our facilities running at their best.

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day:

  • Monitoring and responding to alarms and alerts across power, cooling, and fire systems
  • Performing physical inspections to ensure equipment and infrastructure are operating within defined parameters
  • Responding to faults and incidents, prioritising actions, and determining when escalation or contractor support is required
  • Carrying out operational switching and control activities to prevent unplanned outages
  • Supporting planned maintenance and monitoring contractors on site, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures and approved methods of operation
  • Documenting incidents, maintenance activities, and observations to support continuous improvement

Benefits, Training and Offerings:

Our training program provides tailored content through our CDC Academy, specifically designed for individuals starting out in this role. You'll learn hands-on by shadowing and working alongside our experienced Service Technicians, gaining essential knowledge to develop your skillset.

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

You're a qualified electrician with experience in environments where uptime, safety, and attention to detail matter. You're ready to take the next step in your career, moving beyond traditional trade work and into a role focused on the operation and reliability of critical infrastructure.

As part of a newly established site and team, you'll have the opportunity to help shape how the facility operates from day one. We're looking for motivated people who enjoy learning, take pride in their work, and want to be part of something being built from the ground up.

Desirable experience:

  • A trade or technical background in Electrical (highly desirable)
  • Experience working in critical or high‑availability environments with strong safety and compliance requirements
  • Exposure to monitoring or control systems such as BMS, EMS, or SCADA‑type platforms
  • Familiarity with complex infrastructure or plant equipment (e.g. HVAC systems, power systems, generators, fire systems)
  • Strong fault‑finding, problem‑solving, and situational awareness skills
  • The ability to produce clear documentation, logs, and post‑incident reports

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

job.title: Project Finance & M&A Specialist
job.description:
SG

Company: Digital Edge DC

Who we are

 

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

 

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

 

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia. 

 

Our values:

 

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.  
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.   
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

 

About the role

 

Reporting to the General Counsel, the Lawyer will serve as a trusted legal advisor supporting Digital Edge's growth across Asia Pacific. The role will be responsible for leading and advising on complex strategic transactions, including mergers and acquisitions, project financing, joint ventures and corporate development initiatives, while providing practical legal support to business leaders across multiple jurisdictions.

 

The Lawyer will operate as a business-oriented partner, balancing legal risk with commercial objectives in a fast-paced and evolving environment. The successful candidate will work closely with senior executives, finance, development, investment, commercial and operations teams, as well as external counsel and key stakeholders throughout the region.

 

This role will be based in Singapore and will support transactions and projects across Asia Pacific, with a particular focus on Japanese-speaking counterparties and stakeholders.

 

 

Key responsibilities

 

Mergers & Acquisitions and Strategic Transactions

  • Lead legal support for acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, investments and broader corporate development activities across Asia Pacific.
  • Manage transaction execution including legal due diligence, structuring, negotiation, documentation and completion processes.
  • Partner closely with internal stakeholders and external advisors to identify risks, propose solutions and facilitate successful execution of strategic transactions.
  • Support post-acquisition integration activities and ongoing governance matters.

 

Project Financing and Development

  • Advise on complex project financing transactions, including debt financing, security arrangements, intercreditor agreements and related financing documentation.
  • Support the development and expansion of Digital Edge's data center portfolio by providing legal guidance on investment, construction and infrastructure-related matters.
  • Work closely with finance and development teams to structure transactions that support growth objectives while appropriately managing legal and commercial risk.

 

Commercial and Corporate Legal Support

  • Draft, negotiate and advise on a wide range of commercial agreements, including customer contracts, supplier arrangements, technology agreements, confidentiality agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Provide legal advice on corporate governance, regulatory compliance and general commercial matters across the region.
  • Monitor legal and regulatory developments that may impact Digital Edge's business and provide practical recommendations to stakeholders.

 

Stakeholder Management and Business Partnership

  • Build strong relationships with business leaders and become a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate and manage external counsel to ensure high-quality, cost-effective legal support.
  • Deliver clear, concise and commercially practical advice to support efficient decision-making.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of legal processes, templates and governance frameworks that support a rapidly growing organization.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

 

Experience

  • Approximately 8 years of post-qualification legal experience gained from a leading law firm and/or multinational organization.
  • Strong experience advising on cross-border mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures and other strategic corporate transactions.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting complex project financing and infrastructure-related transactions.
  • Prior in-house legal experience within a multinational corporation, infrastructure platform, real asset business or similarly complex environment.
  • Experience in data centers, infrastructure, energy, telecommunications or private equity-backed businesses would be advantageous but is not essential.
  • Candidates with prior in-house experience within a keiretsu-equivalent organization, such as a large, group-affiliated conglomerate, are preferred.

 

Communication and Languages

  • Fluent Japanese and English language skills, with the ability to negotiate, draft and communicate effectively with Japanese and international stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex legal issues in a clear and practical manner to non-legal audiences.

 

Personal Attributes

  • Commercially minded with strong business judgement and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
  • Highly organized and capable of managing multiple priorities and transactions simultaneously.
  • Confident operating independently while collaborating effectively across functions and geographies.
  • Resilient, adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Strong integrity, professional judgement and attention to detail.

 

Education

  • Bachelor of Laws (LLB), Juris Doctor (JD) or equivalent legal qualification.
  • Qualified to practice law in a recognised jurisdiction.
  • Additional qualifications in finance, business or related disciplines would be advantageous.

job.title: Fiber Engineer
job.description:
Job location: Singapore, SG

Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.

Why we need this role

  • Manage and maintain the fibre network infrastructure in accordance with fibre engineering standards, ensuring network reliability, performance, and service availability.
  • Develop, design, and implement new network infrastructure, services, capacity expansions, and supporting documentation to meet business requirements, while supporting customer network rollout and strategic network initiatives.

What you will do

  • Plan, schedule, coordinate, and control construction, fiber installation, splicing activities within the local network, and in-building cabling works at customer sites.
  • Manage and oversee in-building fiber cabling projects at customer sites, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
  • Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities for the local fiber network infrastructure.
  • Conduct quality inspections of subcontractor work and ensure compliance with Colt standards, customer requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Facilitate site acceptance processes with local authorities, building owners, and other stakeholders.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, including site survey reports, as-built drawings, photographs, and project records.
  • Review and validate subcontractor Bills of Quantity (BOQ), work completion reports, and related project documentation.
  • Perform site surveys and feasibility assessments for new fibre installations, expansions, and network upgrades.
  • Monitor third-party construction and civil works activities to identify and mitigate potential risks to Colt's fiber infrastructure.
  • Ensure all construction and installation activities comply with local regulations, safety requirements, and industry standards.
  • Support fault management and service restoration activities, including participation in on-call duties when required.
  • Use geospatial mapping, network planning tools, and CAD systems to support network design and route planning.
  • Perform administrative and reporting tasks related to project execution and network operations.
  • Identify process gaps and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and service quality.
  • Drive network optimization and process enhancement projects through innovative solutions, automation, and best practices.

What we're looking for

  • Business level English skill
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in dealing with Construction/Supervision Management
  • GIS experience
  • Construction and splicing knowledge
  • Strong communication skill _(communicates effectively and presents complex, technical information to a variety of audiences)_

job.description:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Facility Director, BKK Campus
job.description:
TH

Company: Digital Edge DC

Data Center Facility Director (BKK1 - Thailand)

 

Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:  

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.  
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.   
  • Strive: We are driven and determined. 
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.    
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet. 

 

What we need:

 

Reporting to the Vice President, Infrastructure Operations and dotted to the BKK Operations Director, the Facility Director is the accountable owner of infrastructure reliability, plant integrity, maintenance strategy and energy performance for BKK1.

 

This role will lead technical engagement through commissioning, assume authority over MEP system acceptance prior to RFS, and ensure long-term reliability, safety and efficiency of all critical infrastructure.

 

Key responsibilities

Commissioning & Technical Acceptance

  • Lead technical engagement throughout testing & commissioning (T&C), integrated systems testing (IST) and system validation.
  • Own final technical sign-off of critical MEP systems prior to RFS.
  • Ensure mechanical and electrical systems perform in accordance with design intent and resiliency standards.

Plant Integrity & Reliability

  • Own maintenance philosophy, reliability standards and asset integrity strategy for all critical systems including:

Electrical distribution (switchgear, transformers, UPS, STS, DRUPS, batteries, generators, PDUs)

  • Mechanical cooling plant and thermal systems
  • Fire protection systems
  • Building Management Systems (BMS/EPMS)
  • Best PUE (Power Usage Effectiveness)

Approve high-risk MOPs and oversee risk assessments for infrastructure activities. Provide third-level emergency technical support during critical events.

Maintenance & Lifecycle Strategy

  • Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs aligned with DE global standards.
  • Establish appropriate operational documentation (e.g. SOP, MOP, EOP) and prepare management reports
  • Establish 5-year asset lifecycle and maintenance CapEx/OpEx forecasting strategies.
  • Manage vendor performance, contract compliance and service quality.
  • Drive energy optimization programs to achieve lowest feasible PUE while maintaining resiliency.

Change Management & Governance

  • Accountable for technical approval of infrastructure changes in alignment with service impact assessment by Operations Director.
  • Ensure strict compliance with DE maintenance policies and regulatory standards.
  • Lead and support certification initiatives including ISO 27001, 14001, 45001, PCI DSS and related frameworks.
  • Goven Change Management Control

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build and mentor a high-performing Facilities Engineering team.
  • Establish technical competency standards and structured training programs.
  • Foster a safety-first and reliability-driven culture.
  • Support Sales, Sales Engineering & Product Management team for key potential customer / Hyperscale deals.

 

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

 

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
  • 10+ years of experience in data center or mission-critical facility management.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in critical MEP systems and commissioning processes.
  • Proven experience in plant reliability, lifecycle planning and energy optimization.
  • Data center or facility-related certifications (e.g., CDCP, CDCS, CDFOM or equivalent) preferred.
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Experience in hyperscale or digital infrastructure environments highly desirable.
  • Fluency in English and Thai.

Campaigns and communications

Embed CSR as a visible and tangible part of the company’s purpose and values. Support a culture of community contribution, inclusivity and responsible business practices

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

 

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

 

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

 

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

 

Our values:

 

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.  
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.   
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

 

What we need:

 

Reporting to the Customer Project Delivery Director, the Customer Delivery Manager (CDM) will act as the primary customer-facing delivery owner for our hyperscale customers, overseeing the successful coordination, integration, and delivery of customer requirements from contract signing through to Ready for Service (RFS)

The role works cross-functionally with construction, design, and operations teams to ensure alignment between customer requirements and delivery execution across the project lifecycle. The role is project-specific and will be locally-based for the duration of the project, providing on-site delivery leadership, supported by a platform-level Customer Project Delivery Director to ensure governance, escalation management, and consistency across projects.

 

Key responsibilities

 

Customer Delivery Management:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers during project delivery (build phase), RFS, and customer onboarding, ensuring alignment to contractual commitments and delivery milestones
  • Support customer engagement during pre-contract stage to support requirements definition and smooth transition into delivery
  • Ensure key customer milestones (e.g., Early Access, RFS) and contractual requirements are clearly tracked and achieved
  • Deliver regular progress reporting and facilitate customer audits and inspections during project delivery phases
  • Proactively manage customer expectations, escalations, and risks to maintain delivery confidence and satisfaction

 

Requirements Definition and Design Coordination

  • Translate customer requirements into a structured scope and work breakdown
  • Identify and define what needs to be delivered without performing detailed engineering design
  • Coordinate with Design Engineering and Solution Engineering teams to validate technical feasibility and design solutions

 

Project and Program Management

  • Develop and manage delivery programmes covering customer scope and key dependencies
  • Track progress against milestones and ensure alignment with overall project timelines

 

Customer Change Request Management:

  • Manage customer change requests, ensuring all customer changes are assessed for cost and schedule impact

 

Fit-Out Vendor Coordination:

  • Manage delivery of customer fit-out activities, including vendor coordination, site access, and installation sequencing

 

Customer Handover and Onboarding

  • Own handover of facility to customer during RFS
  • Drive successful customer onboarding, working with Customer Success Management and Operations teams to enable a smooth transition into BAU operations

 

Key Performance Index

  • On-time RFS delivery: % of projects delivered on or before committed RFS date
  • Customer satisfaction: Customer satisfaction score (CSAT/NPS) across delivery lifecycle
  • Contract adherence: % compliance to contractual scope with minimal deviations, cost deviations, or disputes
  • Successful customer onboarding: % of onboarding milestones achieved on time with minimal escalations or rework

 

 

The successful candidate:

 

Technical and Delivery Capabilities

  • 10+ years of experience leading and owning end-to-end project delivery within critical operating environments (Data Center preferred)
  • Proven experience in driving data centre infrastructure delivery
  • Experience making delivery and commercial decisions and managing trade-offs across schedule, cost, and technical constraints
  • Experience working with hyperscale or large enterprise customers in data centre, cloud, or IT services
  • Strong understanding of data centre infrastructure, especially electrical & mechanical services
  • Able to define scope and work breakdown, and coordinate engineering inputs

 

Customer and Stakeholder Management

  • Strong customer-facing experience, having operated as a primary interface in delivery environment
  • Customer-oriented, with a proactive approach to ensuring high-quality delivery and satisfaction
  • Proven ability to navigate multi-stakeholder environments across internal teams, vendors, and customer organisations
  • Able to manage escalations, conflicts, and competing priorities

 

Tools and Qualifications

  • Proficient in MS Office, MS Project / Aconex (or similar)
  • Project Management (PMP) certification preferred

 

Language Proficiency

  • Fluent in spoken and written English
  • Fluent in spoken and written Mandarin
