job.title: High Voltage Chief Engineer (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

Reporting to the HV Operations Director, the High Voltage (HV) Chief Engineer provides senior technical leadership for the safe, compliant and reliable operation of the HV electrical network at the Truganina Campus.

As the appointed Operating Authority (OA), the High Voltage (HV) Chief Engineer is the sole person responsible for authorising, coordinating and controlling all electrical switching activities on-site, including energisation, de-energisation, isolation, earthing, restoration and emergency switching.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

HV Operations and Switching

  • Foster and uphold a strong culture of safety across all HV engineering and switching activities.
  • Act as the site Operating Authority (OA) and hold sole responsibility for the governance, authorisation, coordination and control of all electrical switching activities on-site.
  • Authorise, direct and oversee all planned, routine, emergency and restoration switching activities performed by appropriately authorised personnel.
  • Review, validate and approve all switching programs, access permits, isolation plans and associated operational documentation before switching activities proceed.
  • Ensure all switching activities comply with the Victorian Blue Book, STACK procedures and other relevant electrical safety legislation, standards and codes.
  • Provide technical direction and exercise final operating authority during abnormal system conditions, electrical incidents and emergency switching events.

SCADA and Network Control

  • Use STACK’s SCADA system to monitor the condition, status and performance of the HV electrical network.
  • Verify that SCADA indications accurately reflect the physical condition and configuration of the HV network.

Engineering Governance, Change and Technical Leadership

  • Lead the technical coordination of major changes affecting STACK’s HV network and associated critical infrastructure.
  • Train and supervise LV- and HV-accredited personnel from Delivery, FM and Operations to provide 24/7 coverage and ensure shift-team members are competent and accredited to perform LV and HV switching.
  • Manage operational engagement with construction and delivery partners, including Beon, Powercor and Ausgrid.
  • Ensure major changes are supported by approved MOPs, switching programs, contingency and rollback plans, and stakeholder communications.
  • Verify that testing, commissioning and handover requirements have been completed before modified systems are placed into operational service.
  • Maintain the site electrical operating framework, switching rules, authorisation matrix and delegated authorities as the Operating Authority (OA).
  • Lead the development, implementation and auditing of MOPs, SOPs and EOPs relating to HV operations.
  • Provide senior technical support during HV incidents, plant failures and abnormal network conditions.
  • Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis of HV events, switching incidents, equipment failures and system abnormalities.
  • Provide technical oversight of planned and corrective maintenance affecting HV assets.
  • Ensure HV activities are planned and executed using appropriate risk assessments, permits and safe systems of work.
  • Maintain compliance with environmental, building, fire, work health and safety, and electrical safety requirements.
  • Provide clear, confident and technically competent communication to customers and stakeholders.
  • Communicate planned switching, outages, operational risks and restoration activities in a timely and professional manner.
  • Work collaboratively with the HV Operations Director and HV Operations Manager to support a cohesive and effective HV Operations Team.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring and technical guidance to engineers, authorised persons and operational team members.
  • Support the development and assessment of HV competencies, switching capability and operational authorisations.

Competencies

  • Demonstrated expertise in HV switching, isolation, earthing, restoration and major electrical change coordination within mission-critical environments.
  • Strong knowledge of SCADA monitoring and control, HV distribution systems, switchgear, transformers, protection, metering, generators, UPS, batteries, ATS and STS equipment.
  • Strong risk management, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, communication and technical leadership capability.
  • Strong computer skills with a sound understanding of Microsoft Office.

Work Environment

  • Based on-site at the Truganina Campus, Melbourne, with travel to other STACK facilities as required.
  • Attendance outside standard business hours may be required for switching, incidents, maintenance, commissioning and major changes.

Required Education and Experience

  • 5–10 years of relevant experience in HV electrical operations, power systems or mission-critical infrastructure, including coordination of major electrical changes, complex switching, outages or commissioning.
  • Demonstrated experience acting as an Operating Authority (OA), Senior Authorised Person or equivalent, with responsibility for switching governance, authorisation and operational control.
  • Extensive operational knowledge of HV distribution, switchgear, transformers, protection systems, metering and controls, together with practical SCADA experience.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, an electrical trade qualification or equivalent recognised professional experience.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Willingness to work outside standard business hours, participate in an on-call roster and operate effectively in a high-pressure environment.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Full Australian working rights and the ability to attain and maintain NV1 security clearance where required.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

job.title: Senior Critical Engineering Manager (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Critical Engineering Manager is a senior operational leadership role within STACK’s Critical Operations team, responsible for leading critical engineering operations across STACK Data Centre environments.

The role works closely with Critical Operations leadership to supervise, support, and develop engineering teams responsible for the operation, maintenance, performance, and resilience of mechanical, electrical, fire life safety, base building, and other critical Data Centre systems. Direct reports include Engineering Managers and Coordinators.

The Senior Critical Engineering Manager is also the primary Critical Engineering point of contact for STACK Construction and Delivery teams. This includes oversight of construction-related activities that affect existing infrastructure, operational acceptance of newly delivered Data Centres or new phases, review and acceptance of commissioning documentation, O&M manuals, handover packages, and post-construction records.

This role is accountable for driving safe, reliable, compliant and high-performing Data Centre operations, with a focus on safety, availability, communication, team performance, technical standards, continuous improvement and operational readiness.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Operations

  • Lead and embed a standardised safety-first culture across STACK Data Centre Engineering operations.
  • Execute, supervise, and continuously improve all aspects of Data Centre Critical Operations, including the operation, maintenance, and repair of mission-critical equipment and systems supporting a 24x7 Data Centre environment, to achieve 100% uptime, 100% compliance with all customer SLAs, site certifications, and applicable legislative requirements, while delivering concierge-level customer service.
  • Own, develop, and continuously improve programmed preventative maintenance job plans.
  • Supervise, manage, mentor, and support Engineering Managers, Coordinators, Critical Engineering team members, and Facilities Engineering team members to achieve high levels of performance.
  • Set team performance expectations and support development, coaching, and counselling of Critical Engineering and Critical Facilities team members.
  • Ensure electrical and mechanical infrastructure is maintained in accordance with manufacturer recommendations, STACK maintenance job plans, and approved operational standards.
  • Oversee maintenance contractors, service providers, and professional consultants to ensure services are appropriate for Data Centre operations, maintenance, design, construction, and customer requirements.
  • Support building repair, lifecycle replacement, major maintenance, and capital improvement activities, including review of work method statements and risk controls to minimise operational risk.
  • Conduct inspections and surveys, and develop recommendations to improve, repair, or modify electrical, mechanical, and building systems to support operational integrity and energy efficiency.
  • Develop, implement, review, and audit Methods of Procedure, Standard Operating Procedures, Emergency Operating Procedures, Sequences of Operation, and maintenance standards in line with STACK requirements and industry best practice.
  • Own and oversee the Building Management System, Electrical Power Monitoring System, SCADA, and other operational tools and applications to support accurate monitoring, operational efficiency, and energy improvement.
  • Negotiate, manage, and maintain vendor maintenance agreements and service level agreements.
  • Maintain appropriate vendor relationships and lead vendor performance review meetings.
  • Provide effective oversight, leadership, and administration of assigned operational projects, including direction of facilities management contractors, project teams, and third-party contractors.
  • Work with Critical Facilities management contractor teams to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve operational issues, including root cause identification where required.
  • Develop and audit facilities rounds throughout the Data Centre to support site integrity and operational readiness.
  • Act as the Critical Engineering point of contact during critical incident and emergency event management.
  • Prepare, review, and support accurate reporting across Data Centre operations, including power quality, power utilisation effectiveness, power usage, vendor scorecards, engineering team rosters, and operational performance reporting.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable environmental, building, fire, health, safety, and operational regulatory requirements.
  • Actively promote a safe working environment and a culture that supports employee wellbeing.
  • Ensure compliance with work health and safety procedures and requirements, including permit to work, risk assessments, safe work method statements, and personal protective equipment.
  • Conduct site safety and hazard identification inspections.
  • Report safety concerns, hazards, near misses, and incidents within required timeframes.
  • Analyse and interpret complex operational documents, technical reports, procedures, and manuals.
  • Develop and review incident reports, emergency event summaries, root cause analysis reports, CAPEX and OPEX forecasts, and operational manuals.
  • Deliver effective presentations on Data Centre operations to customers, management, and internal stakeholders.
  • Respond effectively to sensitive issues, complex enquiries, and complaints from FM Services Providers, co-workers, supervisors, customers, and management.
  • Positively influence and motivate employees and FM Services Provider teams to achieve agreed operational outcomes.
  • Build customer confidence in STACK operational capability when participating in customer-facing activities.

FM Services Provider Management

  • Foster and maintain positive working relationships with FM Services Provider teams, FM subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and related stakeholders.
  • Support the Critical Operations Manager in managing FM Services Provider contracts and service delivery in accordance with agreed KPIs and SLAs.
  • Review, prepare, and validate reports and operational information as required.
  • Support the Critical Operations Manager with FM Services Provider meetings, performance reviews, and operational governance.
  • Regularly evaluate objectives, plans, and service delivery performance to support continual improvement and alignment with STACK priorities.
  • Hold FM Services Provider teams accountable to performance standards and work with the provider to understand and address underperformance appropriately.

Projects, Commissioning and Handover

  • Provide project management and operational oversight for construction-related activities that modify existing infrastructure or replace end-of-life equipment.
  • Own and coordinate the commissioning and operational handover process from construction to Critical Operations.
  • Provide project management for initiatives that improve Data Centre resilience and for small to medium Critical Operations projects.
  • Review electrical and mechanical designs associated with optimisation of existing Data Centres, new Data Centres, and newly completed phases within existing Data Centres.
  • Develop project scopes and requests for proposal, and support the Director, Critical Operations with capital requests for Critical Operations projects.
  • Review commissioning plans and support acceptance of newly commissioned systems.
  • Record and report key project and operational metrics to team members and management.
  • Review and accept post-construction handover packages, including O&M manuals, procedures, drawings, schematics, spare parts, defects liability period documentation, and maintenance agreements.
  • Work with STACK Delivery teams and vendors to support efficient, high-quality project turnover and operational readiness.

People

  • Lead, coach, and develop direct reports, including Engineering Managers and Coordinators.
  • Operate in accordance with STACK values and contribute to a cohesive, positive, and high-performing working environment.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with stakeholders across STACK, including Critical Operations, Delivery, Construction, customers, FM Services Providers, contractors, suppliers, consultants, joint venture partners, and consortium members.
  • Actively develop team members to maximise performance and realise potential through coaching and mentoring.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, open communication, and constructive working relationships.
  • Keep relevant stakeholders informed of changes and decisions that affect them, ensuring useful and relevant information is communicated promptly and accurately.
  • Participate in work-related team meetings, operational forums, and business activities as required.

Competencies

  • Proven capability in a critical services, Data Centre, or mission-critical operational environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and direct technical teams and contractors.
  • Strong customer service mindset, with the ability to deliver concierge-level service to customers, internal stakeholders, and operational partners.
  • Expert understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in Data Centre environments, including UPS, transformers, LV and HV switchgear, remote power panels, chillers, CRAH units, CRAC units, static transfer switches, automatic transfer switches, and fire detection and suppression systems.
  • Strong operational knowledge of HV and LV electrical distribution, generators, battery management systems, power distribution units, BMS, EPMS, SCADA, and associated monitoring systems.
  • Strong operational knowledge of chilled water, direct expansion systems, pumps, leak detection, variable frequency drives, cooling towers, digital controls, and fire life safety systems.
  • HV Authorised Person capability, or willingness and ability to complete authorisation after commencement.
  • Strong project management capability, including technical scope development, contractor coordination, commissioning review, handover, and operational acceptance.
  • Proficiency in Data Centre commissioning standards and operational readiness processes.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with customers, internal teams, contractors, and senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in high-pressure operational environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and organisational skills.
  • Strong capability in data centre trend analysis, reporting, and use of PC-based site monitoring systems.
  • Competence in Computerised Maintenance Management Systems, Building Management Systems, Data Centre Infrastructure Management systems, and related operational tools.
  • Strong Microsoft Office capability, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Project, Visio, AutoCAD, customer portals, and related technical documentation tools.
  • Strong team orientation and ability to prioritise team and operational outcomes.

Required Education and Experience

  • Minimum 6-8 years’ experience in a Data Centre or related mission-critical operations role.
  • Experience managing Engineering Managers, Coordinators, technical teams, or equivalent operational teams.
  • 3-5 years’ experience administering and managing facility preventative maintenance programmes.
  • Extensive operational knowledge of HV and LV electrical distribution, including switchgear, transformers, automatic transfer switches, UPS, static transfer switches, battery management systems, generators, and power distribution units to branch level.
  • Extensive operational knowledge of chillers, direct exchange systems, CRAH units, CRAC units, dehumidifiers, water pumps, leak detection, variable frequency drives, cooling towers, digital controls, BMS, and fire detection and suppression systems.
  • Experience working with local and national regulatory codes, guidelines, and permit processes.
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to interact successfully with internal and external customers.
  • Strong project management, troubleshooting, reporting, and organisational skills.
  • Competent use of CMMS, BMS, and Data Centre Infrastructure Management systems.
  • Advanced Excel capability, including trend analysis, pivot charts, and formula automation.
  • Ability to prepare and present PowerPoint presentations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and relevant technical systems.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Trade licence or certification acquired through technical education or training in electrical or mechanical trades.
  • Dual trade qualification preferred.
  • HV Authorised Person status or equivalent authorisation.

Work Environment / Conditions

This role is based on site at STACK Data Centres in Victoria, Australia.

The role operates in a live, mission-critical Data Centre environment and requires the ability to work safely around electrical, mechanical, cooling, fire life safety, and base building infrastructure. The role may involve working in operational plant areas, customer environments, and construction or project interface areas.

Travel Required

Travel between STACK Data Centre sites and the STACK Melbourne head office will be required from time to time.

Travel to other STACK Data Centre facilities within Australia and internationally may be required from time to time.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be willing to work outside normal business hours when required, including weekends, late nights, public holidays, and on-call support.
  • Must be comfortable working in a high-pressure, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Must be able to support critical incident response and operational escalation requirements as required by the business.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

The successful candidate must have appropriate work authorisation for Australia.

Additional background screening, site access, or security clearance requirements may apply in accordance with STACK policy, customer requirements, or site-specific access requirements.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Other Duties

job.title: Assistant Manager-Network Projects
job.description:
Job Description

Job Role responsibilities

  • To ensure optimal

performance and reliability, develop and implement network designs, including topology, protocols, and network security measures.

  • Regularly monitor

network systems and proactively identify and resolve network issues to minimize downtime and ensure smooth operations.

  • Implement and maintain

network security measures, such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls, to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access and cyber threats.

  • Lead and manage a team

of network professionals, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure they perform their roles effectively and efficiently.

  • Maintain accurate and

up-to-date documentation of network configurations, diagrams, processes, and procedures to facilitate troubleshooting, maintenance, and future network enhancements.

·Write business requirement document and define technical scope of work for successful execution of the project.

·Coordinate with various customer teams to understand overall requirement trends in banking industry domain.

·Experience building network strategy for public/private cloud adoption and movement from on-premise to hybrid based networks.

·Have deep understanding of customer needs and design recommend appropriate solutions.

·Experience working with IT and Network leadership to articulate network and/or compliance strategies and plans and in develop value based customer proposals.

·Ability to compose compelling, persuasive technical requirement document, solutions, scope of work, bill of material/quantity and commercial models that are passionate about addressing customer business/technical problems

·Understanding client business process operations and business objectives; utilize knowledge on engagements/ analyzing workflow to design solutions (As-Is and To-Be Analysis and Freezing).

·Understanding business environment of the client and positioning appropriate solution and articulating business values presentations.

·Demonstrated effectiveness across multipe technologies. Be independently able to lead, defining scope of work service levels, technical specifications, bill of quantity/material.

·Client business requirements gathering and analysis, solution architecting, designing, deployment architecture, negotiation with OEMs/Vendors, technical compliance and Vendor Interlocks.

·Understanding nuances of OEM/Vendor platforms and solutions – hardware, software, licensing and ability to decide on a specific OEM/Vendor based on technical requirements and work with OEM/Vendors in finalizing solution components, prepare BoQ/BoM along with OEM/Vendor

  • Ownership of change request and

incidents to determine root cause.

  • Identification and mitigate various

security threats Maintaining internal IT System in adherence with policies and standards

  • Play the role of verifier of

configuration/architectural changes by other teams

  • Responsible for resolving escalated

issues and risks with firm mitigation plans and escalate outstanding issues if required

  • Responsible for identifying needs

for implementing new processes and analyse project trends to improve and optimize existing processes. Ensure both new and existing processes are being-followed.

  • Ensuring that all the audits

findings are closed within given time and providing proofs (that can be shown to the auditor) to the Bank

  • Assisting the design team while

designing the architecture for new branches such that all the security best practices are in place from day one.

  • Ensuring that all the network

devices are configured as per the Bank’s security policy, best practices to ensure Secured Network Architecture.

  • Assisting Senior support tiers with

project-based configuration and deployment work

  • Offsite technical implementation,

installation, and configuration of hardware when required

  • All the escalations were done by L2

engineers.

Qualifications

  • BE/B.Tech with 15-20 years of working as a network

security engineer or solution architect for a Network services complany, with emphasis on Infrastructure services and deep knowledge in overall networking security with emphasis on Data Center in banking industry.

  • Experience in design delivering network

projects specifically in the area of DC/Cloud , Infrastructure security, and preferred experience in new deployment models and architectures such as SDN, Virtualization, Network security etc.

Certifications

Applicant should have professional certifications (or equivalent) – CCDP, CCDE, CCIE Data Center, CCIE Routing and Switching, CCIE Service Provider, Juniper JNCIE-DC Juniper JNCIE-SP

  • Good to have any additional certifications

related to network security such as Fortigate, Palo Alto, Checkpoint etc.

  • TOGAF or ZACHMAN or SABSA Enterprise

Architecture certification would be preferred.

Skills

·Good understanding of OSI layer, TCP/IP stack, TCP, UDP operation

·Good knowledge of multi-vendor network products - Switches, Routers, Firewalls Load balancers

·Strong Understanding hands on experience of Data Center Networking technologies

  • OTV, BGP EVPN, LISP, VXLAN, NVGRE, VPC, Spanning tree (MSTP), best practice Data

Center Fabric designs, Etherchannel, Cisco FEX/Juniper Fusion, Policy based routing, SLB/GSLB (E.g., F5, Radware etc)

·Strong Understanding hands on experience of DC network security stack – Firewalls, NGFW, Threat Protection (either Fortigate, Checkpoint, Cisco ASA, FTD)

·Understanding hands on experience of SDN DC Networking concepts like Cisco ACI, Juniper Contrail.

·Understanding hnds on experience of Fabric switching like Cisco Nexus 9000/7000/5000, Juniper QFX 5200/10000 series, Arista family etc.

·Migration of traditional DC Fabrics to SDN enabled such as Cisco ACI/Juniper Contrail.

·Understanding and Working knowledge on Layer 3 following technologies – IPv4, IPv6, ARP, Routing protocols - OSPF, BGP, Multicast, Layer-2 3 MPLS, AAA

·Good understanding on Datacenter Network Transformation

·Knowledge of virtualization, storage and data base technologies Hypervisor – ESXi, KVM, Virtual switches, SAN/NAS, SAP HANA.

·Understanding of various applications used in banking industry – CBS, UPI, IMPS, RTGS, SWIFT, LOC, LMS, etc.

·Working Knowledge of cloud technologies and solutions including public, private and hybrid cloud. Specific public cloud knowledge includes

oAWS concepts – VPC, Direct connect, Elastic storage S3, Amazon compute services EC2

oAzure Concepts – ExpressRoute, Azure Office 365, Familiarity of Azure compute services

·Good understanding of applications – HTTPS, SSL/TLS, FTP and network relation with applications

·Good understanding of business applications used in enterprise networks and network relevance to effective operation of business apps – Core Banking, ERP, CRM, e-mail, VC, real-timeus

·Good understanding of various enterprise market segments need of IT – SMB, large enterprise, government sectors and industry verticals – manufacturing, healthcare, bio-tech and pharmaceuticals, media, education, energy, BFSI, retail

·Working knowledge on system/network integration (SI/NI) capabilities

·Strong oral, written, communication, documentation and presentation skills

·Should have a strong business acumen to understand complex business requirements of different enterprise client

  • Knowledge of ITIL concepts.
  • Must have ability to support

flexible schedule in support of 7x24 operations.

job.description:
About US

A Fortune 500 India company, Sify Technologies is India’s most comprehensive ICT service & solution provider. With Cloud at the core of our solutions portfolio, Sify is focussed on the changing ICT requirements of the emerging Digital economy and the resultant demands from large, mid and small-sized businesses.

Sify’s infrastructure comprising the largest MPLS network, 10 top-of-the-line Concurrently Manageable DCs, partnership with global technology majors, vast expertise in business transformation solutions modelled on the cloud make it the first choice of start-ups, incoming Enterprises and even large Enterprises on the verge of a revamp.

More than 10000 businesses across multiple verticals have taken advantage of our unassailable trinity of Data Centers, Networks and Security services and conduct their business seamlessly from more than 1600 cities in India. Internationally, Sify has presence across North America, the United Kingdom and Singapore.

Sify, https://www.sifytechnologies.com/, Sify Technologies and www.sifytechnologies.com are registered trademarks of Sify Technologies Limited.

Job Details

Job Description

Solution Architect, Cloud

We're looking for a highly skilled and customer-focused Solution Architect, Cloud to join our growing team in India. In this critical role, you'll work closely with our Sales and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams, acting as a technical expert to design compelling cloud solutions for our customers across various industries. Your ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, value-driven proposals will be key to our success in the Indian market.

What You'll Do

  • Collaborate

with Sales GTM: Partner directly with sales teams to understand customer needs, challenges, and business objectives.

  • Solution

Design Architecture: Lead the design and architecture of innovative, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, Hybrid) that align with customer requirements and industry best practices.

  • Technical

Proposal Development: Create detailed technical proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and solution architectures for prospective and existing customers. This includes defining scope, deliverables, timelines, and resource estimates.

  • Customer

Presentations Workshops: Conduct technical presentations, demonstrations, and workshops for customers, effectively communicating the value proposition of our cloud offerings.

  • Proof

of Concept (PoC) Pilot Support: Provide technical guidance and support for PoCs and pilot projects, ensuring successful implementation and showcasing solution capabilities.

  • Market

Technology Insights: Stay abreast of the latest cloud technologies, industry trends, and competitive landscapes in India to inform solution strategies.

  • Cross-Functional

Collaboration: Work closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to ensure proposed solutions are feasible, deliverable, and align with our capabilities.

  • Technical

Due Diligence: Conduct technical due diligence to assess customer environments and identify potential risks or dependencies.

  • Relationship

Building: Develop strong relationships with key customer stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor.

What You'll Bring

  • Education:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

  • Experience:
  • 8-15

years of experience in IT, with at least 4+ years in a Solution Architect or similar pre-sales technical role focused on cloud technologies.

  • Proven

experience working with Sales and GTM teams, specifically in a customer-facing capacity for the Indian market.

  • Demonstrable

experience in designing and proposing solutions on leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Technical

Acumen:

  • Deep

understanding of cloud computing concepts, services, and deployment models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, FaaS, Containers, Serverless).

  • Strong

knowledge of networking, security, data management, and application development within cloud environments.

  • Familiarity

with cloud migration strategies, DevOps practices, and automation tools.

  • Proficiency

in creating architecture diagrams, technical specifications, and detailed solution documents.

  • Sales

Business Acumen:

  • Excellent

understanding of the sales lifecycle and ability to align technical solutions with business outcomes.

  • Proven

ability to articulate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong

commercial awareness and ability to contribute to pricing strategies.

  • Soft

Skills

  • Exceptional

communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong

analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability

to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent

negotiation and influencing skills.

  • Customer-centric

mindset with a passion for delivering value.

Other Requirements

  • Relevant

cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect).

  • Experience

with specific industry verticals relevant to the Indian market (e.g., Financial Services, Manufacturing, Retail).

  • Knowledge

of emerging technologies like AI/ML, IoT, or Blockchain in a cloud context.
